units.sanskrit: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् । देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयम् उदीरयेत् ॥
units.english: Salutation unto Ganesha. Salutation unto Veda Vyasa. Having saluted Nārāyana and the best of male beings Nara as well as the goddess of learning Saraswati let us cry success.

units.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य हृषीकेशं चराचरगुरुं हरिम् ॥ नैमिषारण्ये कुलपतिः शौनकस् तु महामुनिः । सौतिं पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । जज्ञे बहुज्ञं परम् अत्युदारं यं द्वीपमध्ये सुतम् आत्मयोगात् । यो गोशतं कनकशृङ्गमयं ददाति विप्राय वेदविदुषे बहुविश्रुताय । पुण्यां च भारतकथां शृणुयाच् च तद्वत् तुल्यं फलं भवति तस्य च तस्य चैव । शताश्वमेधस्य यद् अत्र पुण्यं चतुःसहस्रस्य शतक्रतोश् च । भवेद् अनन्तं हरिवंशदानात् प्रकीर्तितं व्यासमहर्षिणा च । यद् वाजपेयेन तु राजसूयाद् दृष्टं फलं हस्तिरथेन चान्यत् । तल् लभ्यते व्यासवचः प्रमाणं गीतं च वाल्मीकिमहर्षिणा च । यो हरिवंशं लेखयति यथाविधिना महातपाः सपदि । स याति हरेः पदकमलं कमलं मधुपो यथा लुब्धः । वन्दारुजनमन्दारं वन्दे ऽहं यदुनन्दनम् । व्यासं वसिष्ठनप्तारं शक्तेः पुत्रम् अकल्मषम् । शौनक उवाच सौते सुमहदाख्यानं भवता परिकीर्तितम् । भारतानां च सर्वेषां पार्थिवानां तथैव च ॥ देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि विक्रमा धर्मनिश्चयाः । विचित्राश् च कथायोगा जन्म चाग्र्यम् अनुत्तमम् ॥
units.english: What is the use of bathing at the sacred shrine of Pushkara for him who listens to the recitation of the Mahābhārata, dropped off the lips of Dwaipayana, wondrous, destructive of sins, auspicious and highly sacred. May Vyasa, the son of Parāçara and the delighter of Satyavati, be crowned with success, from whose lotus mouth the wordy ambrosia has come down which the world drinks. He, who listens to the sacred theme of Bhārata, acquires the same fruit with him who makes a gift of a hundred kine with golden horns unto a Brāhmana conversant with the Vedas and many Srutis. By making a gift of Harivamsha a man acquires far more everlasting piety than what is acquired by the celebration of a hundred horse sacrifices, or by the distribution of inexhaustive food, or by doing what secures the dignity of Indra. This has been recounted by the great Rishi Vyasa. This bestows the same fruit as is given by Bajpeya or Rājashuya Yagnas or by making a gift of a car with elephants. Vyasa's word is the proof hereof and this has also been said by the great Rishi Vālmiki. The great ascetic, who duly commits to writing Harivamsha, speedily approaches the lotus-feet of Hari like a bee moving towards a lotus, drawn by the smell of honey. consider Dwaipāyana as the supreme cause of all, who is the sixth in descent from Brahmā, who is a Rishi endued with eternal spiritual greatness, who has descended from a portion of Nārāyana and who has only Suka for his son. Sounakla said:— Souti, you have recounted the great history of the descendants of Bharata as well as that of other kings; of the gods, demons, Gandharvas, serpents, Rākshasas, Daityas, Siddhas and of Guhyakas as well -. You have described in sweet words the most excellent and sacred Purāna, dealing with their wondrous deeds, heroic feats and religious practices and their births.

units.sanskrit: मनःकर्णसुखं तन् मां प्रीणात्य् अमृतसंमितम् ॥
units.english: This nectarine theme, affording pleasure unto the mind and ears, Souti, has given us satisfaction.

units.sanskrit: तत्र जन्म कुरूणां वै त्वयोक्तं लोमहर्षिणे । न तु वृष्ण्यन्धकानां वै तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे ॥
units.english: son of Lomaharshana, while describing the birth and history of the Kurus, you forgot to narrate the history of Vrishnis and Andhakas. It becomes you to relate their history –.

units.sanskrit: सूत उवाच जनमेजयेन यत् पृष्टः शिष्यो व्यासस्य धीमतः । धर्मवित् कथयाम् आस कुलं तेषां सविस्तरम् । तत् ते ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि वृष्णीनां वंशम् आदितः ॥
units.english: Souti said:— shall now relate to you the story of the birth of Vrishnis from the very beginning about which the pious disciples of Vyasa, Vaishampāyana was accosted by Janamejaya.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वेतिहासं कार्त्स्न्येन भरतानां स भारतः । जनमेजयो महाप्राज्ञो वैशंपायनम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Hearing the complete history of the descendants of Bharata, the highly wise Janamejaya, born in their race, said to Vaishampāyana.

units.sanskrit: महाभारतम् आख्यानं बह्वर्थं बहुविस्तरम् । कथितं भवता विप्र विस्तरेण मया श्रुतम् ॥
units.english: Janemejaya said:—You described before in full and heard the story of Mahābhārata full of many meanings and Historical accounts.

units.sanskrit: तत्र शूराः समाख्याता बहवः पुरुषर्षभाः । नामभिः कर्मभिश् चैव वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथाः ॥
units.english: Therein you mentioned the names and deeds of many mighty car-warriors and heroes of the Vrishni and Andhaka families.

units.sanskrit: तेषां कर्मावदातानि त्वयोक्तानि द्विजोत्तम । न च मे तृप्तिर् अस्तीह कीर्त्यमाने पुरातने । एकश् च मे मतो राशिर् वृष्णयः पाण्डवास् तथा ॥ भवांश् च वंशकुशलस् तेषां प्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान् । कथयस्व कुलं तेषां विस्तरेण तपोधन ॥
units.english: foremost of the twice born, you have described briefly and fully their many excellent deeds. Though this ancient story has been recounted again and again, still have not been satiated with it. The Pāndavas and Vrishnis are related to each other; you are competent enough to describe their families and you have with your own eyes seen everything. Therefore, you having asceticism for your wealth, do you describe their family at length –.

units.sanskrit: यस्य यस्यान्वये ये ये तांस् तान् इच्छामि वेदितुम् । पूर्वं कथा समाख्याता विचित्रा च महीपते । तेषां पूर्वविसृष्टिं च विचित्राम् आ प्रजापतेः ॥ सर्वम् एतद् अशेषेण कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम । सूत उवाच सत्कृत्य परिपृष्टस् तु स महात्मा महातपाः । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च कथयाम् आस तां कथाम् ॥
units.english: wish to know who were born in which families. Therefore, great ascetic, beginning with the Patriarch and recollecting their previous creations, do you describe truly everything at length. Souti said:—Having been welcomed and accosted by him, the high-souled ascetic of rigid austerities described in full the whole story from the very beginning.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्यां पुण्यां पापप्रणाशिनीम् । यश् चैनां धारयेद् विप्रः श्रावयेद् वा महात्मनाम् । स्ववंशधारणं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Listen, king, to the sacred theme, as narrated by me, heavenly, destructive of sins, wonderful and abounding in various meanings and sacred stories. He, who circulates this story or listens to it constantly, multiplies his own family and is spoken high of in the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं कारणं यत् तन् नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् । प्रधानं पुरुषं तस्मान् निर्ममे विश्वम् ईश्वरः ॥
units.english: This universe, permeated by Isvara God, emanated from Pradhāna Purusha who is the unmanifest cause, eternal and identical with the existent and non-existent.

units.sanskrit: तं वै विद्धि महाराज ब्रह्माणम् अमितौजसम् । स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां नारायणपरायणम् ॥
units.english: Know him, monarch, as Brahmā Creator of incomparable energy, the creator of all beings and ever devoted to Nārāyana Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: अहंकरस् तु महतस् तस्माद् भूतानि जज्ञिरे । भूतभेदाश् च भूतेभ्य इति सर्गः सनातनः ॥
units.english: From Mahat has emanated Ahankara; from the latter the five subtle elements have sprung and from them the grosser elements: thus the eternal work of creation is carried on.

units.sanskrit: विस्तरावयवं चैव यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम् । कीर्त्यमानं शृणु मया पूर्वेषां कीर्तिवर्धनम् ॥
units.english: Hear, shall relate as have heard and as think, of the long extending genealogies of families increasing the glory of their fore-fathers –.

units.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यं शत्रुघ्नं स्वर्ग्यम् आयुर्विवर्धनम् । कीर्तनं स्थिरकीर्तीनां सर्वेषां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
units.english: The account of these pious men of everlasting glory always gives fruit and leads to the multiplication of race and attainment of heaven.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् कल्याय ते कल्यः समग्रं शुचये शुचिः । तस्मै हिरण्यगर्भाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च । ब्रह्मणे लोकनाथाय गरिष्ठाय स्वयंभुवे । प्रणम्य प्रभवे पूर्वं तस्मै अमिततेजसे । आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता नाम्ना पूर्वम् इति श्रुतिः । अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः ॥
units.english: On account of this theme being fruitful and because you are competent to hear it and are pure shall relate, to you, beginning with the family of Vrishnis the most excellent creation of beings. Thereupon desirous of creating various creatures the Divine Self-sprung Brahmā at first created waters and then created seeds therein. The waters are designated as Nārā for they are the offspring of Nara. The deity first rested thereon and is therefore called Nārāyana.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णम् अभवत् तद् अण्डम् उदकेशयम् । तत्र जज्ञे स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर् इति नः श्रुतम् ॥
units.english: The egg, lying in the waters, assumed golden hue—from that sprang Brahmā, of his own accord and he is therefore called Self-sprung.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् उषित्वा परिवत्सरम् । तद् अण्डम् अकरोद् द्वैधं दिवं भुवम् अथापि च ॥
units.english: Having lived there for many years the divine Hiranyagarbha divided the egg into two and they were called the heaven and earth.

units.sanskrit: अप्सु पारिप्लवां पृथ्वीं दिशश् च दशधा दधे ॥
units.english: The Lord created Akāsa or space between the two portions and in the waters he created the floating earth and the ten quarters.

units.sanskrit: तत्र कालं मनो वाचं कामं क्रोधम् अथो रतिम् । ससर्ज सृष्टिं तद्रूपां स्रष्टुम् इच्छन् प्रजापतिम् ॥
units.english: There-upon desirous of creating the Patriarchs or lords of creation he created time, mind, speech, passion, anger and desire.

units.sanskrit: मरीचिम् अत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । वसिष्ठं च महातेजाः सो ऽसृजत् सप्त मानसान् ॥
units.english: The highly effulgent deity then created his seven mind-born sons—Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vashistha.

units.sanskrit: सप्त ब्रह्माण इत्य् एते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । नारायणात्मकानां वै सप्तानां ब्रह्मजन्मनाम् ॥
units.english: These seven have been ascertained as Brāhmanas in the Puranas. These seven created by Brahmā, are like Nārāyana himself.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽसृजत् पुनर् ब्रह्मा रुद्रं रोषात्मसंभवम् । सप्त त्व् एते प्रजायन्ते प्रजा रुद्रश् च भारत । स्कन्दः सनत्कुमारश् च तेजः संक्षिप्य तिष्ठतः ॥
units.english: There-upon Brahmā created Rudra born of his anger and Sanat Kumar, the predecessor of those born before. descendant of Bharata, these seven and Rudra engaged in the work of creation. Skanda and Sanat Kumar sustained the energy of creation.

units.sanskrit: तेषां सप्त महावंशा दिव्या देवगणान्विताः । क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्षिभिर् अलंकृताः ॥
units.english: Their seven great families consisted of Yakshas, Pishachas, the celestials and others who all performed heavenly deeds and created progeny and were adorned with Kaçyapa and other leading saints.

units.sanskrit: विद्युतो ऽशनिमेघांश् च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंसि च । ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि निर्ममे यज्ञसिद्धये । मुखाद् देवान् अजनयत् पितॄंश् चेशो ऽपि वक्षसः । प्रजनाच् च मनुष्यान् वै जघनान् निर्ममे ऽसुरान् । साध्यांस् तैर् अयजन् देवान् इत्य् एवम् अनुशुश्रुमः ॥
units.english: He then created lightning, thunderbolt, the straight and bent rainbows, the rangers of the sky and clouds. He, then for the successful celebration of Paynas, created Riks, Yuyush and Sāman; he then created the gods from his mouth and the ancestral manes from his breast. He then engendered human beings from his organ of generation and from his hips the Asuras, Sādhyas and other classes of gods. This we have heard.

units.sanskrit: आपवस्य प्रजासर्गं सृजतो हि प्रजापतेः ॥ सृज्यमानाः प्रजा नैव विवर्धन्ते यदा तदा । द्विधा कृत्वात्मनो देहम् अर्धेन पुरुषो ऽभवत् । अर्धेन नारी तस्यां स ससृजे विविधाः प्रजाः । दिवं च पृथिवीं चैव महिम्ना व्याप्य तिष्टति ॥
units.english: From the body of the Patriarch Vashishtha when he was desirous of creating progeny, sprang the various kinds of elemental creations. When the progeny, created by his mind, did not multiply he divided his own body into two and with the half he created man. With the other half he created woman and through her he engendered various kinds of progeny. He resides enveloping the heaven and earth with his own glory.

units.sanskrit: विराजम् असृजद् विष्णुः सो ऽसृजत् पुरुषं विराट् । पुरुषं तं मनुं विद्धि तद् वै मन्वन्तरं स्मृतम् । द्वितीयम् आपवस्यैतन् मनोर् अन्तरम् उच्यते ॥
units.english: Vishnu created a universal form which again created a Purusha: You should know him as Manu and his regeme is known as Manwantara. The second creation of Washishtha is called Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: स वैराजः प्रजासर्गं ससर्ज पुरुषः प्रभुः । नारायणविसर्गः स प्रजास् तस्याप्य् अयोनिजाः ॥
units.english: The great Virat Purusha created the progeny. He is the creation of Nārāyana and his progeny are not born in any sex.

units.sanskrit: आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमान् धन्यः प्रजावांश् च भवेन् नरः । वैशंपायन उवाच स सृष्टासु प्रजास्व् एवम् आपवो वै प्रजापतिः । आपवस्य महिम्ना तु दिवम् आवृत्य तिष्ठतः । धर्मेणैव महाराज शतरूपा व्यजायत ॥ सा तु वर्षायुतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् । भर्तारं दीप्ततपसं पुरुषं प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
units.english: Having known this primaeval creation a man gains longevity, fame, wealth, progeny and his wished-for region. Vaishampayana said:—When the work of his creation of progeny was complete the Patriarch Vashishtha obtained Shatarupā, not born of a woman, as his spouse. While he resided covering the etherial region, he created Shatarupā, monarch, by his greatness and Yoga power. Having carried on rigid austerities for a million of years she obtained her husband of burning asceticism.

units.sanskrit: स वै स्वायंभुवस् तात पुरुषो मनुर् उच्यते । तस्यैकसप्ततियुगं मन्वन्तरम् इहोच्यते ॥
units.english: That Purusha, my child, is called Swayambhuva Manu. His own Manwantara in this world consists of seventy-one Yugas.

units.sanskrit: काम्या नाम महाबाहो कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । सुता सुतपसा युक्ता महती लोकधारिणी । काम्यापुत्राश् च चत्वारः सम्राट् कुक्षिर् विराट् प्रभुः ॥
units.english: The Universal Purusha begat on Shatarupā a son by name Veera who begat on Kāmyā two sons by name Pryavrata and Uttānapāda. Kāmyā, the daughter of the Patriarch Kardama, gave birth to four sons, you of large arms, namely Samrāt, Kukshi, Virāt, and Prabhu.

units.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतं समासाद्य पतिं साजनयत् सुतान् । उत्तानपादं जग्राह पुत्रम् अत्रिः प्रजापतिः । उत्तानपादाच् चतुरः सूनृता सुषुवे सुतान् ॥
units.english: Obtaining Pryavrata as her husband she gave birth to them The Patriarch Atri adopted Uttānapāda as his son. Sunritā gave birth to four sons through Uttānapāda.

units.sanskrit: धर्मस्य कन्या सुश्रोणी सूनृता नाम विश्रुता । उत्पन्ना वाचि धर्मेण ध्रुवस्य जननी शुभा ॥
units.english: The youthful daughter of Dharma was known as Sunritā. She originated from a horse sacrifice and that pure damsel was the mother of Dhruva.

units.sanskrit: उत्तानपादो ऽजनयत् सूनृतायां प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: The Patriarch Uttanapāda begat on Sunritā, four sons by name, Dhruva, Kirtiman, Ayushmān, and Vasu.

units.sanskrit: ध्रुवो वर्षसहस्राणि त्रीणि दिव्यानि भारत । तपस् तेपे महाराज प्रार्थयन् सुमहद् यशः ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, monarch, with a view to obtain the great Brahman, Vishnu, Dhruva carried on hard austerities for three thousand celestial years.

units.sanskrit: तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतः स्थानम् आत्मसमं प्रभुः । अचलम् चैव पुरतः सप्तर्षीणां प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: Being propitiated the Patriarch Brahmā conferred on him a permanent region, peerless on earth, in the front of the region of the seven Rishis.

units.sanskrit: तस्याभिमानम् ऋद्धिं च महिमानं निरीक्ष्य च । देवासुराणाम् आचार्यः श्लोकम् अप्य् उशना जगौ ॥ अहो यस्य तपसो वीर्यम् अहो श्रुतम् अहो व्रतम् । यम् अद्य पुरतः कृत्वा ध्रुवं सप्तर्षयः स्थिताः ॥ तस्माच् छ्लिष्टं च मान्यं च ध्रुवाच् छम्बुर् व्यजायत । श्लिष्टेर् आधत्त सुच्छाया पञ्च पुत्रान् अकल्मषान् । रिपुं रिपुंजयं विप्रं वृकलम् वृकतेजसम् ॥
units.english: Beholding his great prosperity and greatness the preceptor of the gods and demons, Ushanā sang the following hymn. Oh, wonderful is his energy of asceticism, knowledge of scriptures and prowess, placing whom before them the seven Rishis are living . From Dhruva were born Shlishthi, Bhavya and Shumbha. Shlishthi begat on Suchayā seven sinless sons. They were Ripu, Ripunjaya, Pushpa, Vrikala and Vrikatejā.

units.sanskrit: रिपोर् आधत्त बृहती चाक्षुषम् सर्वतेजसम् । अजीजनत् पुष्करिण्यां वैरण्यां चाक्षुषो मनुम् ॥ प्रजापतेर् आत्मजायां वीरणस्य महात्मनः । कन्यायां भरतश्रेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः ॥ ऊरुः पूरुः शतद्युम्नस् तपस्वी सत्यवित् कविः । अग्निष्टुद् अतिरात्रश् च सुद्युम्नश् चेति तेनव । अभिमन्युश् च दशमो नड्वलायां महौजसः ॥
units.english: Ripu begat on Vrihati, a son, gifted with all energies, by the name of Chākshusha. The noble Chākshusha begat Muni on Pushkarini, a mother of heroes and the daughter of the Patriarch Aranya. foremost of Bharatas, Muni begat ten highly powerful sons on Nadvalā, the daughter of the Patriarch Vairaj, Uru, Puru, Shata dyumna, Tapaswi, Satyavān, Kavi, Agnistut and Atirātra; and Sudyumna was the ninth. The tenth was Abhimanyu; these were the sons of Nadvalā.

units.sanskrit: ऊरोर्ऽजनयत् पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान् । अङ्गं सुमनसं स्वातिं क्रतुम् आङ्गिरसं शिवम् ॥
units.english: Uru begat on Agneyi six highly powerful sons-Anga, Sumanas, Swati, Kratu, Angiras and Gaya.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गात् सुनीथापत्यं वै वेनम् एकं व्यजायत । अपचारेण वेनस्य प्रकोपः सुमहान् अभूत् ॥
units.english: Anga begat only one son on Sunithā, by name Vena. By the irregularities of Vena the Rishis were highly irritated.

units.sanskrit: प्रजार्थम् ऋषयो ऽथास्य ममन्थुर् दक्षिणं करम् । वेनस्य पाणौ मथिते संबभूव महान् ऋषिः ॥
units.english: For creating progeny the Rishis churned his right arm. When Vena's right arm was churned by the ascetics, therefrom originated Prithu.

units.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः प्राहुर् एष वै मुदिताः प्रजाः । करिष्यति महातेजा यशश् च प्राप्स्यते महत् ॥
units.english: Seeing him the Rishis said in delight, This highly powerful one will delight his subjects and will attain to fame .

units.sanskrit: स धन्वी कवची जातस् तेजसा निर्दहन्न् इव । प्रजारक्षाकृतोत्साहः । पृथुर् वैन्यस् तदा चेमां ररक्ष क्षत्रपूर्वजः ॥ राजसूयाभिषिक्तानाम् आद्यः स वसुधाधिपः । तस्माच् चैव समुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतम् अगधौ ॥
units.english: As if burning all with his energy he took his birth with a bow and a coat of mail. Born first in the race of Kshatriyas, Vena's son Prithu protected this earth. That lord of the earth was the first born of those who are sprinkled with water at the Rajshuya sacrifices. For him were born Suta and Magadha, experts in singing the glories of kings.

units.sanskrit: तेनेयं गौर् महाराज दुग्धा सस्यानि भारत । प्रजानां वृत्तिकामेन देवैः सर्षिगणैः सह ॥ सर्पैः पुण्यजनैश् चैव वीरुद्भिः पर्वतैस् तथा ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, to give livelihood to his subjects by him the earth was milched for corns in the company of the gods, Rishis, the ancestral manes, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Apsarās, serpents, Guyakas, creepers and mountains –.

units.sanskrit: प्रादाद् यथेप्सितं क्षीरं तेन प्राणान् अधार्यन् ॥
units.english: When milched the earth gave wished-for milk in their respective vessels; by it they maintain their lives.

units.sanskrit: पृथुपुत्रौ तु धर्मज्ञौ जज्ञाते ऽन्तर्धिपालिनौ । शिखण्डिनी हविर्धानम् अन्तर्धानाद् व्याजायत ॥
units.english: Two sons, conversant with religion, were born to Prithu, Antardhi and Pālita. Antardhi begat Havirdhāna on Shikhandin.

units.sanskrit: हविर्धानात् षडाग्नेयी धिषणाजनयत् सुतान् । प्राचीनबर्हिषं शुक्रम् गयं कृष्णं व्रजाजिनौ ॥
units.english: Havirdhana begat on Agneyidhishanā six sons—Prāchina varhis, Sukra, Gaya, Krishna, Vraja and Ajina.

units.sanskrit: प्राचीनबर्हिर् भगवान् महान् आसीत् प्रजापतिः । हविर्धानान् महाराज येन संवर्धिताः प्रजाः ॥
units.english: Thus monarch, Prāchinavarhis, gifted with great spiritual power, was born of Havirdhāna. He was a great Patriarch and multiplied the progeny.

units.sanskrit: प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास् तस्य पृथिव्यां जनमेजय । प्राचीनबर्हेर् अभवन् पृथिवीतलचारिणः ॥ महतस् तपसः पारे सवर्णायां महीपतिः ॥ सवर्णाधत्त सामुद्री दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । पुत्रान् वै जनयाम् आस सर्वलोकाभिपूजितान् । सर्वे प्रचेतस नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya, the tips, of the Kuça grass in his sacrificial ground, were directed towards the east and they covered the entire earth. And therefore he was celebrated by the name of Prāchinavarhis. Having carried on great austerities that king espoused Savarnā the daughter of the ocean, who gave birth to ten sons for Prāchinavarhis who were all called Prachetas and had mastered the science of archery –.

units.sanskrit: अपृथग्धर्मचरणास् ते ऽतप्यन्त महत् तपः । दश वर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः ॥
units.english: Observing the same religion and lying in the waters of the ocean they carried on great austerities for ten thousand years.

units.sanskrit: तपश् चरत्सु पृथिवीं प्रचेतःसु महीरुहः । अरक्ष्यमाणाम् आवव्रुर् बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः ॥
units.english: When the Prachetas were engaged in carrying on penances the trees covered the unprotected earth and so the creatures were being destroyed.

units.sanskrit: नाशकन् मारुतो वातुं वृतं खम् अभवद् द्रुमैः । दश वर्षसहस्राणि न शेकुश् चेष्टितुं प्रजाः ॥
units.english: The wind could not blow and the sky was covered with trees. The creatures could set forth no exertion for ten thousand years.

units.sanskrit: तद् उपश्रुत्य तपसा युक्ताः सर्वे प्रचेतसः । प्राचेतसम् उपस्तव्य तपसः सर्वपर्वतैः । उन्मूलान् अथ वृक्षांस् तान् कृत्वा वायुर् अशोषयत् । तान् अग्निर् अदहद् घोर एवम् आसीद् द्रुमक्षयः ॥ द्रुमक्षयम् अथो बुद्ध्वा किंचिच् छिष्टेषु शाखिषु । उपगम्याब्रवीद् एतान् राजा सोमः प्रतापवान् ॥ कोपं यच्छत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः । वृक्षशून्या कृता पृथ्वी शाम्येताम् अग्निमारुतौ ॥
units.english: Perceiving this and getting angry all those Prachetas, observant of rigid austerities, created air and fire from their mouths. Having uprooted those trees the wind dried them up and the fire then burnt them up—thus their was a dreadful destruction of trees. Informed of the destruction of trees and when a few plants still survived the king Soma, approaching the Patriarchs, said. Ye kings of the family of Prāchinavarhis, do ye control your anger. The earth is shorn of trees and so let fire and air be pacified.

units.sanskrit: रत्नभूता च कन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवर्णिनी । भविष्यं जानता तात धृता गर्भेण वै मया ॥
units.english: This beautiful daughter of the trees is like a jewel. Knowing the future begat her.

units.sanskrit: मारिषा नाम नाम्नैषा वृक्षाणाम् इति निर्मिता । भार्या वो ऽस्तु महाभागा सोमवंशविवर्धिनी ॥
units.english: This girl is called Marishā and is created for the trees. Let this great one, multiplying the race of Soma, be your wife.

units.sanskrit: युष्माकं तेजसो ऽर्धेन मम चार्धेन तेजसः । अस्याम् उत्पत्स्यते विद्वान् दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: By the half of your energy and that of mine, your son, the Patriarch Daksha will be born of her.

units.sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निसमो भूयः प्रजाः संवर्धयिष्यति ॥
units.english: That one, effulgent like fire, will multiply the creation well-nigh destroyed by your fire-like energy .

units.sanskrit: ततः सोमस्य वचनाज् जगृहुस् ते प्रचेतसः । संहृत्य कोपं वृक्षेभ्यः पत्नीं धर्मेण मारिषाम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon in accordance with the words of Soma restraining their anger against the trees the Prachetas duly married Marisha.

units.sanskrit: मारिषायां ततस् ते वै मनसा गर्भम् आदधुः । दशभ्यस् तु प्रचेतोभ्यो मारिषायां प्रजापतिः । दक्षो जज्ञे महातेजाः सोमस्यांशेन भारत ॥
units.english: Then they all mentally thought of conception in Marisha. Bhārata, the Patriarch Daksha was born of Marisha through the tenth Prachetas with a portion of Soma's energy.

units.sanskrit: पुत्रान् उत्पादयाम् आस सोमवंशविवर्धनान् । अचरांश् च चरांश् चैव द्विपदो ऽथ चतुष्पदः ॥
units.english: Then to multiply the race of Soma he created various offspring, mobile, immobile, two legged and four legged sons.

units.sanskrit: स सृष्ट्वा मनसा दक्षः पल्श्चाद् असृजत स्त्रियः । ददौ स दश दर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । शिष्टाः सोमाय राज्ञे तु नक्षत्राख्या ददौ प्रभुः ॥ तासु देवा खगा गावो नागा दितिजदानवाः । ततःप्रभृति राजेन्द्र प्रजा मैथुनसंभवाः । संकल्पाद् दर्शनात् स्पर्शात् पूर्वेषां सृष्टिर् उच्यते ॥
units.english: Having created mentally first the sons Daksha created his daughters. Of them Dharma espoused ten and Kagyapa thirteen. The Lord Daksha then conferred on the king Soma the remaining ones called Nakshatras or planets, They gave birth to gods, sky-rangers, cows, Nagas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Apsaras and various other beings. Since then, king, creatures are being engendered by sexual intercourse. Their predecessors were created by mere thinking, seeing and touching.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । संभवः कथितः पूर्वं दक्षस्य च महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Janemejaya said:—You had described before the birth of the gods, demons, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakshasas as well as that of the high-souled Daksha.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठाद् ब्रह्मणो जातो दक्षश् चोक्तस् त्वयानघ । कथं प्राचेतसत्वं स पुनर् लेभे महातपाः ॥ एतं मे संशयं विप्र व्याख्यातुं त्वम् इहार्हसि । दौहित्रश् चैव सोमस्य कथं श्वशुरतां गतः ॥
units.english: sinless one, you have said that Daksha sprang from the right thumb of Brahmā and his wife from the left. How could they then enter into a matrimonial alliance? How could the great ascetic Daksha attain to the energy of Prachetas? Being a grand-son of Soma how could he become his father-in-law? have grave doubts in this, Vipra, it behoves you to remove them.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच उत्पत्तिश् च निरोधश् च नित्यौ भूतेषु भारत । ऋषयो ऽत्र न मुह्यन्ति विद्यावन्तश् च ये जनाः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Origin and destruction are always present in the elemental creation. The Rishis and the wise are not bewildered at it.

units.sanskrit: युगे युगे भवन्त्य् एते सर्वे दक्षादयो नृप । पुनश् चैव निरुध्यन्ते विद्वांस् तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
units.english: king, the Dakshas are born in every yuga. There is one Daksha in one yuga and another in another. The learned make no mistakes in it.

units.sanskrit: ज्यैष्ठ्यं कानिष्ठ्यम् अप्य् एषां पूर्वं नासीज् जनाधिप । तप एव गरीयो ऽभूत् प्रभावश् चैव कारणम् ॥
units.english: king, there was formerly no priority of birth among them—they were considered elder by asceticism and their prowess was the cause thereof.

units.sanskrit: इमां हि सृष्टिं दक्षस्य यो विद्यात् सचराचरम् । प्रजावान् आयुर् उत्तीर्णः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
units.english: He, who knows the mobile and immobile creation of Daksha, gets offspring and when the lease of his life runs out is worshipped in the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । उत्पत्तिं विस्तरेणैव वैशंपायन कीर्तय ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच मनसा त्व् एव भूतानि पूर्वम् एवासृजत् प्रभुः । ऋषीन् देवान् सगन्धर्वान् असुरान् अथ राक्षसान् ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— Vaishampāyana, do thou describe at length the origin of the gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakshasas. Vaishampāyana said:— king, hear how Daksha created progeny when he was commanded by Swayambhuva, saying create progeny. The capable Daksha first created his mental offspring—the Rishis, gods, Gandharvas, Asuras, Rākshasas, Yakshas, goblins, Pishāchas, beasts, birds, and reptiles.

units.sanskrit: यदास्य यतमानस्य न व्यवर्धन्त वै प्रजाः । अपध्याता भगवता महादेवेन धीमता । ततः संचिन्त्य तु पुनः प्रजाहेतोः प्रजापतिः ॥ स मैथुनेन धर्मेण सिसृक्षुर् विविधा प्रजाः । अथ पुत्रसहस्राणि वैरण्यां पञ्च वीर्यवान् । तांस् तु दृष्ट्वा महाभागान् संविवर्धयिषून् प्रजाः । देवर्षिः प्रियसंवादो नारदः प्राब्रवीद् इदम् । यं कश्यपः सुतवरं परमेष्ठी व्यजीजनत् । दक्षस्य वै दुहितरि दक्षशापभयान् मुनिः ॥
units.english: When this his mind-born creation did not multiply, for such was the thought of the intelligent Mahādeva, the Patriarch, thinking again of the multiplication of his creation and desirous of creating progeny by sexual intercourse, married Asniki, the daughter of the Patriarch Virana, engaged in a penance for a son and capable of giving birth to a great race –. Thereupon the energetic Patriarch Daksha begat five thousand sons on Asniki, the daughter of Virana. Beholding those great men desirous of multiplying progeny, the celestial saint Nārada, ever fond of carrying news, for their destruction and for his own imprecation, said. Afraid of Daksha and his imprecation the ascetic Kaçyapa begat on his daughter the same celestial saint Nārada who had been begotten by Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वं स हि समुत्पन्नो नारदः परमेष्ठिनः । असिक्न्याम् अथ वैरण्यां भूयो देवर्षिसत्तमः । तेन दक्षय पुत्रा वै हर्यश्वा इति विश्रुताः । निर्मथ्य नाशिताः सर्वे विधिना च न संशयः ॥
units.english: Nārada was formerly begotten by Brahmā; and then that foremost of celestial saints Kaçyapa again begat that best of ascetics on Asniki, daughter of Virana. Undoubtedly by him the sons of Daksha, celebrated under the name of Haryaswas were freed from attachment to body through scriptural knowledge and rendered invisible.

units.sanskrit: तस्योद्यतस् तदा दक्षो नाशायामितविक्रमः । ब्रह्मर्षीन् पुरतः कृत्वा याचितः परमेष्ठिना ॥
units.english: When Daksha, of immeasurable prowess, was ready to destroy Nārada, Parameshti Brahmā, with leading saints before him, begged him not to do it.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽभ्निसंधिं चक्रे वै दक्षस् तु परमेष्ठिना । कन्यायां नारदो मह्यं तव पुत्रो भवेद् इति ॥
units.english: Thereupon Daksha made this contract with Parameshti that his son Nārada would be born as the son of his Daksha's daughter.

units.sanskrit: ततो दक्षः सुतां प्रादात् प्रियां वै परमेष्ठिने । स तस्यां नारदो जज्ञे भूयः शापभयाद् ऋषिः ॥
units.english: Thereupon Daksha gave away his daughter unto Parameshti: and the Rishi, in fear of the imprecation of Daksha, begat Nārada on her.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच कथं प्रणाशिताः पुत्रा नारदेन महर्षिना । प्रजापतेर् द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— foremost of the twice-born, wish to hear truly why Daksha's sons were killed by the great saint Nārada.

units.sanskrit: वायोर् अनशनं प्राप्य गतास् ते वै पराभवम् । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः ॥
units.english: Having restrained vital airs, and attained to the pure Brahman they secured emancipation. Even now they have not returned like the rivers from the ocean.

units.sanskrit: हर्यश्वेष्व् अथ नष्टेषु दक्षः प्राचेतसः पुनः । वैरण्याम् एव पुत्राणां सहस्रम् असृजत् प्रभुः ॥
units.english: When the Haryaswas were thus lost sight of, Daksha, the son of Prachetas, capable of creating progeny, again begat one thousand sons on the daughter of Virana.

units.sanskrit: विवर्धयिषवस् ते तु शबलाश्वाः प्रजास् तदा । पूर्वोक्तं वचनं तात नारदेनैव चोदिताः ॥
units.english: When those Shavalashwas were again desirous of multiplying progeny they were addressed by Narada with the self-same words.

units.sanskrit: अन्योन्यम् ऊचुस् ते सर्वे सम्यग् आह महान् ऋषिः । भ्रातॄणां पदवी चैव गन्तव्या नात्र संशयः । ज्ञात्वा प्रमाणं पृथ्व्याश् च सुखं स्रक्ष्यामहे प्रजाः ॥
units.english: They then spoke amongst themselves, The great saint Nārada has spoken the just thing. We should follow the footsteps of our brothers; there is no doubt about that. Learning the dimension of the earth, we will, at ease and with whole minded attention, create progeny in due order .

units.sanskrit: ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण प्रयाताः सर्वतोदिशम् । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः ॥
units.english: They, by the same way, repaired to various directions. Even now they have not returned like the rivers from the ocean.

units.sanskrit: नष्टेषु शबलाश्वेषु दक्ष क्रुद्धो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । नारदं नाशम् एहीति गर्भवासं वसेति च । तदाप्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुर् अन्वेषणे नृप । प्रयातो नश्यति विभो तन् न कार्यं विपश्यता ॥
units.english: When the Shavalāshwas too were lost sight of, Daksha, possessed by anger, said to Nārada:—Do thou meet with destruction and experience the pain of living in the womb . Since then, king, if a brother issues out in quest of another he meets with destruction. So the learned should not do it.

units.sanskrit: तांश् चापि नष्टान् विज्ञाय पुत्रान् दक्षः प्रजापतिः । षष्टिं दक्षो ऽसृजत् कन्या वैरण्याम् इति न श्रुतम् ॥ तास् तदा प्रतिजग्राह भार्यार्थे कश्यपः प्रभुः । सोमो धर्मश् च कौरव्य तथैवान्ये महर्षयः । ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । सप्तविंशति सोमाय चतस्रो ऽरिष्टनेमये ॥
units.english: Knowing his sons thus exiled and destroyed the Patriarch Daksha again begat sixty daughters on the daughter of Virana. This we have heard. descendant of Kuru, the Patriarch Kaçyapa, the Moon, Dharma and other Rishis took their wives from among those daughters of Daksha. Of them Daksha conferred ten on Dharma, thirteen on Kaçyapa, twenty seven on the Moon, four on Arishtanemi, two on Vahuputra, two on Angiras and two on the learned Krisāshwa.

units.sanskrit: द्वे भृशाश्वाय विदुषे तासां नामानि मे शृणु ॥
units.english: Hear from me their names –.

units.sanskrit: अरुन्धती वसुर् जामी लम्बा भानुर् मरुत्वती । संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वा च भारत । धर्मपत्न्यो दश त्व् एतास् तास्व् अपत्यानि मे शृणु ॥ विश्वेदेवास् तु विश्वायाः साध्या साध्यान् व्यजायत । मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो वसोस् तु वसवः स्मृताः ॥
units.english: Arundhuti, Vasu, Yami, Lamvā, Bhānu, Marutvati, Sankalpa Muhurta, Sādhyā and Vishwā, these ten, descendant of Bharata, were the wives of Dharma. Hear from me of their offspring. Vishwadevas were the sons of Vishwā and Sādhyā gave birth to Sādhyas. Marutvati was the mother of Maruts and Vāsus were the sons of Vasu.

units.sanskrit: भानोस् तु भानवस् तात मुहूर्तास् तु मूहूर्तजाः । लम्बायाश् चैव घोषो ऽथ नागवीथी च जामिजा ॥
units.english: Bhānus were the sons of Bhānu and the Muhurttas of Muhurtta. Gosha was born of Lamvā and Nāgavithi of Yami.

units.sanskrit: पृथिवीविषयं सर्वम् अरुन्धत्यां व्यजायत । नागवीथ्याश् च जामिन्या वृषलम्बा व्यजायत । या राजन् सोमपत्न्यस् तु दक्षः प्राचेतसो ददौ । सर्वा नक्षत्रनाम्न्यस् तु ज्योतिषे परिकीर्तिताः ॥ ये त्व् अनेके सुरगणा देवा ज्योतिःपुरोगमाः । वसवो ऽष्टौ समाख्यातास् तेषां वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम् ॥ आपो ध्रुवश् च सोमश् च धरश् चैवानिलो ऽनलः । प्रत्यूषश् च प्रभसश् च वसवो नामभिः श्रुताः ॥ आपस्य पुत्रो वैतण्ड्यः श्रमः शान्तो मुनिस् तथा । ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकप्रकालनः ॥
units.english: Arundhuti gave birth to all the herbs of the earth. The Deity of determination, the soul of all, took his birth from Sankalpa and Vrihalamva took his birth from Nāgabitha. king, all the daughters, whom Daksha conferred on the Moon, have been celebrated by the name of Nakshatras or planets in astrology. The celestials, who have profuse effulgence before them, were celebrated by the name of eight Vasus. will mention their names at length. Apa, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, Pratyusha, and Pravasha—these eight are known as eight Vasus, Apa's sons were Vaitandya, Srānta and Muni. Dhruva's son was the Divine Kāla, the destroyer of creatures.

units.sanskrit: सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा वर्चस्वी येन जायते । धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस् तथा । मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणो ऽथ रमणस् तथा ॥
units.english: Soma's son was the Divine Varchas who begat Varcaaswi. Dhara’s son was Dravina the carrier of sacrificial oblations. He begat on his wife Manoharā, Sishira, Prāna and Ramana.

units.sanskrit: अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या यस्याः पुत्रः पुरोजवः । अविज्ञातगतिश् चैव द्वौ पुत्राव् अनिलस्य तु ॥
units.english: Anila's wife was Shivā whose son was Manojava. Anila, whose course is not known, had two sons.

units.sanskrit: अग्निपुत्रः कुमारस् तु शरस्तम्बे श्रिया वृतः । तस्य शाखो विशाखश् च नैगमेषश् च पृष्ठजः । अपत्यं कृत्तिकानां स कार्त्तिकेय इति स्मृतः ॥ स्कन्दः सनत्कुमारश् च सृष्टः पादेन तेजसः । द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि क्षमावन्तौ मनीषिणौ ॥
units.english: Agni's son Kumara shone in the thickets of Sara grass. His names are Shakha, Vishakha, Naigameya and Prishthaja. And on account of his being an offspring of Kirtikās he was called Kartikeya: With the fourth part of his energy Agni created Skanda and Sanat Kumar. Pratyusha's son was the Rishi Devala whose two sons were forgiving and observant of hard austerities.

units.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेस् तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी । योगसिद्धा जगत् कृत्स्नम् असक्ता विचचार ह ॥
units.english: Shorn of attachment Vrihaspati's sister, the beautiful Yogasiddhā, who led a life of celibacy, ranged all over the earth.

units.sanskrit: प्रभासस्य तु भार्या सा वसूनाम् अष्टमस्य तु । विस्वकर्मा महाभागस् तस्यां जज्ञे प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: She became the wife of the eighth Vasu Prabhasa. The noble Patriarch Vishwakarma was born of her.

units.sanskrit: कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वर्धकिः । भूषणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः ॥
units.english: He made chariots for the celestials, was their architect, the maker of thousands of fine things and dresses and the foremost of artizans.

units.sanskrit: मानुषाश् चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Adopting his art as their profession mankind are now making their livelihoods -.

units.sanskrit: सुरभिः कश्यपाद् रुद्रान् एकादश विनिर्ममे । अजैकपाद् अहिर्बुध्न्यस् त्वष्टा रुद्रश् च वीर्यवान् । त्वष्टुश् चैवात्मजः श्रीमान् विश्वरूपो महायशाः ॥
units.english: By the grace of Siva and having her heart purified by virtue of asceticism, Surabhi gave birth, through Kaçyapa, to the eleventh Rudra. descendant of Bharata, Ajaikapāt, Ahir-Budhna, Rudrashwa, Tasta, Srimān and Vishwarupa, those were the highly illustrious sons of Tastu.

units.sanskrit: हरश् च बहुरूपश् च त्र्यम्बकश् चापराजितः । वृषाकपिश् च शंभुश् च कपर्दी रैवतस् तथा ॥
units.english: Hara, Vahurupa, Tryamvaka, Aparājita, Vrishākapi, Sambhu, Kapardi, Raivata, Mrigavyadha, Sarpa and Kapāli—these are known as the eleven Rudras who lord over the three worlds -.

units.sanskrit: शतं चैवं समाख्यातं रुद्राणाम् अमितौजसाम् ॥ पुराणे भरतश्रेष्ठ यैर् व्याप्ताः सचराचराः । अदितिर् दितिर् दनुश् चैव अरिष्टा सुरसा तथा । सुरभिर् विनता चैव ताम्रा क्रोधवशा इरा । कद्रूर् मुनिश् च लोकेश तास्व् अपत्यानि मे शृणु ॥
units.english: foremost of Bhāratas, in Purānas, hundreds, of such Rudras of incomparable energy, have been mentioned who have spread over the mobile and immobile creation. foremost of Bhāratas, hear from me of the wives of Kaçyapa who have spread over all the worlds: They are Aditi, Diti, Dana, Aristha, Suravā, Surabhi, Vinatā, Tāmrā, Krodhavashā, Irā, Kadru, Muni and Swasā; hear now of their offspring -.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वमन्वन्तरे श्रेष्ठा द्वादशासन् सुरोत्तमाः । तुषिता नाम ते ऽन्योन्यम् ऊचुर् वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे ॥
units.english: In the previous Manwantara they were twelve leading celestials. In the Manwantara of Vaivaswata they used to address one another by the name of Tushita.

units.sanskrit: उपस्थिते ऽतियशस्यश् चाक्षुषस्यान्त्रे मनोः । हितार्थं सर्वलोकानां समागम्य परस्परम् ॥ मन्वन्तरे प्रसूयामस् तन् नः श्रेयो भविष्यति ॥ एवम् उक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः । मारीचात् कश्यपाज् जातास् ते ऽदित्या दक्षकन्यया ॥
units.english: During the reign of the present highly illustrious Manu Chakshusha, they all assembled together for the benefit of all creatures and said. Let us all enter into the womb of Aditi to be born in the Manwantara of Vaivaswata and we will attain well-being . Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this during the Manwantara of Manu Chakshusha, they were begotten on Aditi, daughter of Daksha by Kagyapa the son of Marichi.

units.sanskrit: तत्र विष्णुश् च शक्रश् च जज्ञाते पुनर् एव हि । अर्यमा चैव धाता च त्वष्टा पूषा तथैव च ॥ विवस्वान् सविता चैव मित्रो वरुण एव च । अंशो भगश् चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः ॥
units.english: Sakra and Vishnu were also born of her. Besides, descendant of Bharata, Aryamā, Dhātā, Twastā, Pushā, Vivashmān, Savitā, Mitra, Varuna, Ansha, and the highly effulgent Bhaga—these eight were also born of Aditi; so it is said -.

units.sanskrit: चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वम् आसन् ये तुषिताः सुराः । वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे ते वै आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः ॥
units.english: Those who passed by the name of Tushita during the Manwantara of Chakshusha were known as twelve Adityas during the Manwantara of Vaivaswata.

units.sanskrit: सप्तविंशत् तु याः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्यो ऽथ सुव्रताः । तासाम् अपत्यान्य् अभवन् दीप्तान्य् अमिततेजसाम् ॥
units.english: The twenty seven wives of Soma, observant of vows and of incomparable energy, gave birth to luminous bodies as their offspring.

units.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमेः पत्नीनाम् अपत्यानीह षोडश । बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश् चतस्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः । प्रत्यङ्गिरसजाः श्रेष्ठा ऋचो ब्रह्मर्षिसत्कृताः ॥ भृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षेर् देवप्रहरणाः सुताः । एते युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनर् एव ह ॥
units.english: Arishthanemi's wives had sixteen sons. The learned Patriarch Vahuputra had four sons:—Vidyut lightning, Açani thunder-bolt, Megha cloud and Indradhanu rain-bow. The best of works Riks originated from Pratyangiras and the celestial saint Krishāswa begat deities presiding over various celestial weapons. child, these deities take their births again after a thousand Yugas.

units.sanskrit: सर्वे देवगणास् तात त्रयस् त्रिंशत् तु कामजाः । तेषाम् अपि च राजेन्द्र निरोधोत्पत्तिर् उच्यते ॥ यथा सूर्यस्य कौरव्य उदयास्तमयाव् इह । एवं देवनिकायास् ते संभवन्ति युगे युगे ॥
units.english: Of them thirty three take birth of their own accord. As in this world the sun rises and sets, so king, the origin and disappearance of all these gods are also mentioned. They appear and disappear at every Yuga -.

units.sanskrit: दित्याः पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे कश्यपाद् इति नः श्रुतम् । सिंहिका चाभवत् कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः ॥ सैंहिकेया इति ख्यातास् तस्याः पुत्रा महाबलाः । गणस् तेषां तु राजेन्द्र दशसाहस्र उच्यते । तेषां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । असंख्याता महाबाहो हिरण्यकशिपोः शृणु । अनुह्रादश् च ह्रादश् च प्रह्रादश् चैव वीर्यवान् ॥ संह्रादस् च चतुर्थो ऽभूद् ध्रादपुत्रो ह्रदस् तथा । संह्रादपुत्रौ सुन्दश् च निसुन्दस् ताव् उभौ स्मृतौ । विरोचनश् च प्राह्रादिर् बलिर् जज्ञे विरोचनात् ॥
units.english: Kaçyapa begat on Diti two sons, the powerful Hiranyakashipu and Hiranyaksha. This we have heard. He had a daughter also by name Sinhikā whom Viprachitti espoused. Her highly powerful sons were celebrated by the name of Saihinkeyas. It is said, king, that their number was ten thousand. They had, thou having mighty arms, hundreds and thousands of sons and grandsons. Hear now from me of the children of Hiranykashipu. He had four sons of well-known prowess—Anurhāda, Hrāda, and the energetic Pralhāda. And Sanghrāda was the fourth. Hrāda's son was Hrada. Sangrada's sons were Sunda and Nisunda. Anurahada's sons were Ayu, Sivi and Kāla. Virochana was Pralhada's son; and his son was Vali.

units.sanskrit: बलेः पुत्रशतं त्व् आसीद् बाणज्येष्ठं नराधिप । धृतराष्ट्रश् च सूर्यश् च चन्द्रमाश् चेन्द्रतापनः ॥
units.english: king, Vali had a hundred sons, of whom Vāna was the eldest. Dhritarashtra, Surya, Chandramā, Indratapana, Kumbhanabha, Gardhabhaksha, Kukshi and others were their names.

units.sanskrit: बाणस् तेषाम् अतिबलो ज्येष्ठः पशुपतेः प्रियः ॥
units.english: Of them Vāna was the eldest, powerful and a beloved votary of Paçupati –.

units.sanskrit: पुराकल्पे हि बाणेन प्रसाद्योमापतिं प्रभुम् । पार्श्वतो मे विहारः स्याद् इत्य् एवं याचितो वरः ॥
units.english: In the previous Kalpa, Vāna, having propitiated the Divine Lord of Uma, prayed to him for the boon shall remain by your side.

units.sanskrit: बाणस्य चेन्द्रदमनो लोहित्याम् उदपद्यत । गणस् तेषां तु राजेन्द्र शतसाहस्रसंमितः । हिरणाक्ससुताः पञ्च विद्वांसः सुमहाबलाः । झर्झरः शकुनिश् चैव भूतसंतापनस् तथा । अभवन् दनुपुत्रास् तु शतं तीव्रपराक्रमाः । तपस्विनो महावीर्याः प्राधान्येन निबोध तान् ॥ स्वर्भानुर् वृषपर्वा च विप्रचित्तिश् च वीर्यवान् ॥
units.english: Vāna begat on his wife Lohita, a son, by name Indradamana. Hundreds and thousands of Asuras yielded to his power. The five sons of Hiranyaksha were learned and highly powerful—they were Jarjara, Sakuni, Bhutasantāpana, the powerful Mahānābha and Kālanabha. Hundred sons of dreadful prowess were born to Danu. They were all ascetic and endued with great energy. Hear their names in order of precedence –. Amongst those highly powerful Dinavas Viprachitta was the head -.

units.sanskrit: सर्व एते दनोः पुत्राः कश्यपाद् अभिजज्ञिरे । स्वर्भानोस् तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस् तु शची सुता । उपदानवी हयशिराः शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी ॥
units.english: king, cannot enumerate the offspring, sons and grandsons, of all these Dānavas. Sarvana's daughter was Prabhā, Puloma's daughter was Sachi, Hayasira's daughter was Upadānavi and Vrishaparva's daughter was Sharmishthā.

units.sanskrit: पुलोमा कालका चैव वैश्वानरसुते उभे । बह्वपत्ये महासत्त्वे मारीचेस् तु परिग्रहः ॥
units.english: Vaishwānara had two daughters Pulomā and Kalikā-they were both highly powerful, gave birth to many children and were the wives of Kaçyapa, the son of Marichi.

units.sanskrit: तयोः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिं दानवसत्तमान् । पौलोमाः कालकेयाश् च दानवास् ते महाबलाः । अवध्या देवतानां हि हिरण्यपुरवासिनः । पितामहप्रसादेन ये हताः सव्यसाचिना ॥
units.english: They gave birth to sixty thousand Dānavas; of them fourteen thousand lived in the city of Hiranya. Being observant of rigid austerities Kaçyapa begat highly powerful Dānavas called Poulamas and Kālakeyās. Those living in the city of Hiranya were placed by Brahmā above destruction even by the gods. They were afterwards killed by Savyasachi in battle.

units.sanskrit: प्रभाया नहुषः पुत्रो जयन्तश् च सचीसुतः । पूरुं जज्ञे ऽथ शर्मिष्ठा दुःषन्तम् उपदानवी । ततो ऽपरे महावीर्या दानवा अतिदारुणाः । दैत्यदानवसंयोगाज् जातास् तीव्रपराक्रमाः । सिंहिकेया इति ख्यातास् त्रयोदश महाबलाः ॥
units.english: Nahusha was Prabhā's son, Jayanta was Sachi's son, Sarmisthā gave birth to Puru and Upadānavi gave birth to Dushmanta. Viprachitta begat on Singhikā another class of highly dreadful Dānavas. By the union of Daity and Danava energies they grew of dreadful prowess. Those thirteen highly powerful Dānavas were celebrated by the name of Sainghikeyas.

units.sanskrit: व्यङ्गः शल्यश् च बलिनौ बलश् चैव महाबलः । वातापिर् नमुचिश् चैव इल्वलः खसृमस् तथा ॥
units.english: They were the powerful Aisha, Nabha, Vala, Vatāpi, Namuchi, Ilvala, Khasrima, Anjika, Naraka, Kālanābha, Shara, Potarana, and the energetic Vajranābha -.

units.sanskrit: राहुर् ज्येष्ठस् तु तेषां वै चन्द्रसूर्यप्रमर्दनः । मूकश् चैव तुहुण्डश् च ह्रदपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । मारीचः सुन्दपुत्रश् च ताडकायां व्यजायत । एते वै दानवाः श्रेष्ठा दनुवंशविवर्धनाः । तेषां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
units.english: Of them Rāhu, the represser of the sun and the moon, was the eldest. Hrāda had two sons, Suka and Tuhunda. Sunda begat on Tāraka a son by name Mārachi, another by name Sivamana, energetic like a celestial. All these Dānavas, multiplying the race of Danu, were great. Their sons and grandsons were hundreds and thousands in number.

units.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य तु दैत्यस्य निवातकवचाः कुले । समुत्पन्नाः सुमहता तपसा भावितात्मनः ॥
units.english: The noble Nivātakavachas endued with great asceticism were born in the race of the Daitya Sanghrāda.

units.sanskrit: चतस्रः कोटयस् ताश् च मणिमत्यां निवासिनः । ते ऽप्य् अवध्यास् तु देवानाम् अर्जुनेन विपातिताः । षट् सुताः सुमहासत्त्वास् ताम्रायाः परिकीर्तिताः । काकी श्येनी च भासी च सुग्रीवी शुचिगृध्रिके ॥
units.english: Those Danavas, living in the city of Manimati, begat three Koti offspring. The gods could not destroy them and they were slain by Arjuna. It is said that Tāmrā gave birth to six highly powerful daughters—Kake, Sweni, Bhāsi, Sugrivi, Suchi, and Gidhrika.

units.sanskrit: श्येनी श्येनांस् तथा भासी भासान् गृध्रांश् च गृध्रिका ॥ शुचिर् औदकान् पक्षिगणान् सुग्रीवी तु परंतप । विनतायास् तु पुत्रौ द्वाव् अरुणो गरुडस् तथा । सुपर्णः पततां श्रेष्ठो दारुणः स्वेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Kāki gave birth to crows, Uluki to owls, Sweni to Swena birds, Bhāsi to Bhāsa birds, Gidhri to vultures, Suchi to waterfowls and Sugrivi to horses, camels and asses. Such is the description of Tāmrā's family -. Vinata had two sons, Aruna and Garuda. Suparna, the foremost of birds, grew immensely powerful by his own action.

units.sanskrit: सुरसायाः सहस्रं तु सर्पाणाम् अमितौजसाम् । काद्रवेयास् तु बलिल्नः सहस्रम् अमितौजसः । सुपर्णवशगा नागा जज्ञिरे ऽनेकमस्तकाः ॥
units.english: Surasā gave birth to a thousand highly powerful serpents and high-souled sky-rangers of many heads. Powerful, and many headed Nagas endued with immeasurable energy, the offspring of Kadru, were born as being subject to Suparna.

units.sanskrit: ऐलापत्रश् च शङ्खश् च कर्कोटकधनंजयौ । महानीलमहाकर्णौ धृतराष्ट्रबलाहकौ ॥ कुहरः पुष्पदंष्ट्रश् च दुर्मुखः सुमुखस् तथा । शङ्खश् च शङ्खपालश् च कपिलो वामनस् तथा ॥
units.english: Amongst them Sesha, Vāsuki, Takshaka, Airavata, Mahāpadma, Kamvala, Aswatara, Ekapatra, Shankha, Karko taka, Dhananjāya, Mohāneela, Mahākarna, Dhritarashtra, Valāhaka, Kuhara, Pushpapangstra, Durmukha, Sumukha, Shankhapala, Kapilā, Vāmana, Nahusha, Sangkaroma and Manu were the heads.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च गरुडेन निपातिताः । चतुर्दशसहस्राणि क्रूराणाम् उरगाशिना । गणं क्रोधवशं विद्धि तत्र सर्वे च दंष्ट्रिणः ॥ स्थलजाः पक्षिणो ऽब्जास् च धरायाः प्रसवः स्मृतः । गास् तु वै जनयाम् आस सुरभी महिषी तथा ॥
units.english: Fourteen thousand sons and grand sons of these dreadful serpents were devoured by Garuda, living on serpents. Know this class to be full of anger. All animals having teeth, those born on land, birds and those produced by water are the offspring of Dhara. Surabhi gave birth to kine and buffaloes -.

units.sanskrit: इरा वृक्षलतावल्लीस् तृणजातीश् च सर्वशः । खसा तु यक्षरक्सांसि मुनिर् अप्सरसस् तथा ॥
units.english: Ira produced trees, creepers, groves and all kinds of grasses and Khasa gave birth to Yakshas, Rakshas, Munis and Apsarās.

units.sanskrit: अरिष्टा तु महासत्त्वान् गन्धर्वान् अमितौजसः । एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तिताः स्थाणुजंगमाः ॥
units.english: Aristha gave birth to the powerful Gandharvas of unmitigated prowess and the mobile and immobile creation is said to have originated from Kaçyapa.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । एष मन्वन्तरे तात सर्गः स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः ॥
units.english: Hundreds and thousands of sons and grandsons have been born to them. Such was the creation, my child, in Swarochisha Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: वैवस्वते तु महति वारुणे वितते क्रतौ । जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते ॥
units.english: shall now describe to you the creation of the Patriarch Brahmā who offered oblation to fire at the long-extending sacrifice of Varuna in Vaivaswata Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वं यत्र तु ब्रह्मर्षीन् उत्पन्नान् सप्त मानसान् । ततो विरोधे देवानां दानवानां च भारत । दितिर् विनष्टपुत्रा वै तोषयाम् आस कश्यपम् ॥
units.english: Formerly when seven Rishis were procreated by his mind the grand-father considered them as his sons. descendant of Bharata, when the conflict between the gods and demons raged on, Diti, who had her sons slain, began to propitiate Kaçyapa.

units.sanskrit: तां कश्यपः प्रसन्नात्मा सम्यगाराधितस् तया । वरेण च्छन्दयाम् आस सा च वव्रे वरं तदा ॥
units.english: Being duly adored by her and propitiated, Kaçyapa pleased her by giving a boon.

units.sanskrit: पुत्रम् इन्द्रवधार्थाय समर्थम् अमितौजसम् । स च तस्यै वरं प्रादात् प्रार्थितं सुमहातपाः ॥
units.english: She too prayed for a highly powerful son for killing Indra. That great ascetic, when thus begged, conferred on her the same boon -.

units.sanskrit: दत्त्वा च वरम् अव्यग्रो मारीचस् ताम् अभाषत । इन्द्रं पुत्रो निहन्ता ते गर्भे चेच् छरदां शतम् ॥ यदि धारयसे शौचं तत्परा व्रतम् आस्थिता । तथेत्य् अभिहितो भर्ता तया देव्या महातपाः । धारयाम् आस गर्भं तु शुचिः सा वसुधाधिप ॥
units.english: Having conferred on her the boon without the least anxiety the son of Marichi said:—If being pure and observant of vows you can hold your conception for one hundred years you will give birth to such a son as will slay Indra –. monarch, saying so be it and being pure Diti obtained her conception from her that great ascetic husband.

units.sanskrit: रोचयन् वै गणश्रेष्ठं देवानाम् अमितौजसाम् ॥ तेजः संभृत्य दुर्धर्षम् अवध्यम् अमरैः सदा । शुश्रूषय महाभाग नियतात्मा महाद्युते । तस्याश् चैवान्तरप्रेप्सुर् अभवत् पाकशासनः । ऊने वर्षशते चास्या ददर्शान्तरम् अच्युतः ॥ अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिः शयनम् आविशत् । निद्राम् आहारयाम् आस तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य ह । वज्रपाणिस् ततो गर्भं सप्तधा तं न्यकृन्तत ॥
units.english: Thinking of one of the leadings gods of immeasurable power and infusing energy which the immortals even can not destroy he knew Diti. Then that one of great vows repaired to a hilly region for carrying on penances -. From that day the slayer of Pāka Indra began to seek her fault. One day before hundred years were complete Diti, without washing her feet, lay down on her bed. Beholding her impure state the king of gods entered into her abdomen and made her asleep -. Then the holder of thunderbolt sundered the embryo into seven pieces.

units.sanskrit: स पाट्यमानो गर्भो ऽथ वज्रेण प्ररुरोद ह । मा रोदीर् इति तं शक्रः पुनः पुनर् अभाब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Cut into pieces with the thunderbolt the embryo began to cry. Sakra again and again prevented him saying Do not cry! Do not cry! The embryo was then divided into seven pieces.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभवत् सप्तधा गर्भस् तम् इन्द्रो रुषितः पुनः । मरुतो नाम देवास् ते बभूवुर् भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: Indra too, the slayer of enemies, worked up with anger, again cut every piece into seven portions with his thunder-bolt. From them originated the gods called Maruts, foremost of Bharatas -.

units.sanskrit: मा रोदीर् इति यच् छब्दस् त्वयोक्तः पाकशासन । मरुतो नाम तेनेमे भवन्तु यदि मन्यसे । तेषाम् एवं प्रवृद्धानां भूतानां जनमेजय । निकायेषु निकायेषु हरिः प्रादात् प्रजापतीन् । क्रमशस् तानि राज्यानि पृथोः पूर्वं तु भारत ॥
units.english: Because they were addressed by Maghavan saying Do not weep Ma ruda so the Maruts were born and they all became of help to the holder of thunder-bolt. When creatures thus multiplied, Janamejaya, Hari consoled that foremost of gods of immeasurable energy, and then conferred kingdoms on various Patriarchs of whom Prithu was first installed as king -.

units.sanskrit: स हरिः पुरुषो वीरः कृष्णो जिष्णुः प्रजापतिः । पर्जन्यस् तपनो व्यक्तस् तस्य सर्वम् इदं जगत् ॥ मरुतां च शुभं जन्म शृण्वतः पठतो ऽपि वा । नावृत्तिभयम् अस्तीह परलोकभयं कुतः ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः । ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुम् उपचक्रमे ॥ यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥ आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनाम् अथ पावकम् ॥ प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुताम् अथ वासवम् । दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादम् अमितौजसम् ॥ वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् । मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम् । विप्रचित्तिं तु राजानं दानवानाम् अथादिशत् । सर्वभूतपिशाचानाम् गिरीशं शूलपाणिनम् । शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनाम् अथ सागरम् ॥ गन्धानां मरुतां चैव भूतानाम् अशरीरिणाम् । गन्धर्वाणाम् अधिपतिं चक्रे चित्ररथं प्रभुः । नागानां वासुकिं चक्रे सर्पाणाम् अथ तक्षकम् ॥
units.english: That Hari is the heroic person Vishnu, Jishnu, the Patriarch, the king of rains and is the air in his visible form. The whole universe is His. foremost of Bharatas, he, who is informed of this creation of creatures, and he who reads or hears the auspicious birth of the Maruts, has no fear of being born again in this world—what of fear in the next world ? Janamejaya said:—Having installed Prithu the son of Vena, in the office of the Lord Paramount the Patriarch began to confer kingdoms on Soma and others. He placed Soma in charge of the twice-born, herbs, planets, stars, sacrifices and hard austerities. He then installed Varuna as the king of waters, Vaishravana as the lord of kings, Vishnu the king of Adityas, Pāvaka the king of Vasus, Laksha the king of Patriarchs, Vāsava the king of Maruts, Pralhāda of incomperable energy the king of Daityas, and and Danavas, Yama, the offspring of the sun, as the king of the departed manes, Nārāyana as the king of Mātris, vows, Mantrās, kine, Yakshas, Rākshasas and kings and Siva, having the emblem of a bull, as the king of Sādhyas and Rudras –. He then ordered Viprachitta to become the king of the Dānavas and made Girisha Siva the holder of mace, the king of all ghosts and goblins. He made Himavān, the king of mountains, and the ocean the king of rivers and appointed the greatly power Vāyu as the king of smell, bodiless creatures, sound, ether and earth. He made the lord Chitraratha the king of Gandarvas, Vāsuki, the king of Nāgas and Takshaka the king of serpents.

units.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवसम् अश्वानां गरुडं चैव पक्षिणाम् ॥ मृगाणाम् अथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवाम् अपि । वनस्पतीनां राजानं प्लक्षम् एवाभ्यषेचयत् ॥
units.english: He ordered Airavat to become the king of the elephants, Ushaishrava, of the horses and Garuda the king of birds, tiger the king of beasts and the bull, the king kine, Plaksha the king of trees, and, installed Parjanya as the king of ocean, rivers, showers and Adityas —.

units.sanskrit: सरीसृपाणां सर्पाणां राजानं चैव तक्षकम् । सर्वाप्सरोगणानां च कामदेवः कृतः प्रभुः ॥ ऋतूनाम् अथ मासानां दिवसानां तथैव च । पक्षाणां च क्षपाणां च मुहूर्ततिथिपर्वणाम् ॥ एवं विभज्य राज्यानि क्रमेण स पितामहः । पूर्वस्यां दिशि पुत्रं तु वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः । दक्षिणस्यां महात्मानं कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सो ऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥
units.english: He installed Sesha as the king of wild animals and Takshaka, the king of reptiles and serpents. He made Kāmadeva the king of Gandharvas and Asuras and Samvatsara the king of seasons, months, days, fortnights, moments, conjunctions of planets, Parvas, Kālas, Kāshthās, Pramāsha, Ayanas, Mathematics and all conjunctions. Having divided the kingdom in such an order Brahmā placed all the guardians of the quarters. He installed Sudhanna, the son of the Patriarch Vairaja as the Protector of the eastern quarter. He placed in the South the high-souled Sankhapāda, the son of the Patriarch Kardama. He installed the high-souled Ketuman, the son of Raja, as the king of the West.

units.sanskrit: तथा हिरण्यलोमानं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः । उदीच्यां दिशि दुर्धर्षं राजानं सो ऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥
units.english: And he made the irrepressible, Hirany roma, the son of the Patriarch Prajanya, the king of the North.

units.sanskrit: तैर् इयं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपत्तना । सशैलवनकानना । ससागरा च ससरित् । राजसूयाभिषिक्तश् च पृथुर् एभिर् नराधिपैः । वेददृष्टेन विधिना राजराज्येन राजभिः ॥
units.english: Even now they have been piously ruling over their respective provinces of the earth consisting of seven insular continents and mountains. By all those kings Prithu was appointed as the Lord Pāramonnt in a Rajshuya sacrifice according to rites laid down in the Vedas, king –.

units.sanskrit: ततो मन्वन्तरे ऽतीते चाक्षुषे ऽमिततेजसि । वैवस्वताय मनवे पृथिवीराज्यम् आदिशत् ॥ तस्य विस्तरम् आख्यास्ये मनोर् वैवस्वतस्य ह । तवानुकूल्याद् राजेन्द्र यदि शुश्रूषसे ऽनघ । महद्द् ह्य् एतद् अधिष्ठानं पुराणे परिनिष्ठितम् ॥
units.english: After the expiration of the highly vigorous Manwantara of Chakshusha the Patriarch Brahmā conferred the kingdom on Manu Vaivaswata. If you wish to listen, sinless king, shall give you at length an account of his life for your help. This has been described fully in Purana.

units.sanskrit: पुण्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं स्वर्गवासकरं शुभम् । जनमेजय उवाच विस्तरेण पृथोर् जन्म वैशम्पायन कीर्तय । यथा महात्मना तेन दुग्धा चेयं वसुंधरा ॥ यथा च पितृभिर् दुग्धा यथा देवैर् यथ र्षिभिः । यथा दैत्यैश् च नागैश् च यथा यक्षैर् यथा द्रुमैः ॥
units.english: It is sacred and confers fame, longevity, residence in heaven and auspicious ness –. Janamejaya said:— Vaishampāyana, do thou describe in full, the birth of Prithu and how by that high-souled one this earth was milched ; how was she milched by the ancestral manes, gods, Rishis, Daityas, Nagas, Yakshas, serpents, mountains, Pishachas, Gandharvas, the leading Brāhmanas, Rakshasas, and other great creatures, –.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पात्रविशेषांश् च वैशंपायन कीर्तय । वत्सान् क्षीरविशेषांश् च सर्वम् एवानुपूर्वशः ॥
units.english: Do thou also describe fully, Vaishampāyana, their various vessels, the calves and the various articles in order, for which she was milched.

units.sanskrit: यस्मिंश् च कारणे पाणिर् वेनस्य मथितः पुरा । वैशंपायन उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि पृथोर् वैन्यस्य संभवम् । एकाग्रः प्रयतश् चैव शुश्रूषुर् जनमेजय ॥
units.english: Do thou also relate, why formerly Vena's arm was churned by the angry Rishis. Vaishampāyana said:— Janamejaya, listen, with attention and concentrated mind, shall give you a detailed account of Prithu, the son of Vena.

units.sanskrit: नाशुचेः क्षुद्रमनसो नाशिष्यस्याव्रतस्य वा । कीर्तयेयम् अहं राजन् कृतघ्नस्याहितस्य वा ॥
units.english: monarch, do not describe this unto him, who is impure, little-witted, who is not a worthy disciple, who does not observe vows, who is ungrateful and injures people.

units.sanskrit: स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं धन्यं वेदेन संमितम् । रहस्यम् ऋषिभिः प्रोक्तं शृणु राजन् यथातथम् ॥
units.english: king, do thou listen duly to this theme described by the god-like Rishis which secures heaven, longevity, fame and riches for all.

units.sanskrit: यश् चैनं कीर्तयेन् नित्यं पृथोर् वैन्यस्य संभवम् । ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य न स शोचेत् कृताकृतम् ॥
units.english: He, who having saluted the Brāhmanas daily, listens to the birth story of Vena's son, Prithu, does not grieve for iniquities committed by him.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच आसीद् धर्मस्य संगोप्ता पूर्वम् अत्रिसमः प्रभुः । तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वेनो नात्यर्थं धार्मिको ऽभवत् । जातो मृत्युसुतायां वै सुनीथायां प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Formerly the Patriarch Anga, born in the race of Atri, and equally all-powerful like him, became the protector of religion. highly impious son by name Vena was born to him. That Patriarch was begotten on Sunithā the daughter of Death.

units.sanskrit: स मातामहदोषेण वेनः कालात्मजात्मजः । स्वधर्मं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा कामाल् लोकेष्व् अवर्तत ॥
units.english: Imbibing the defect of his maternal grand-father, that son of Kāla's daughter deviated from his own duties and preached freedom of conduct in the world.

units.sanskrit: वेदधर्मान् अतिक्रम्य सो ऽधर्मनिरतो ऽभवत् ॥ निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः प्रजास् तस्मिन् प्रजापतौ । प्रावर्तन्न पपुः सोमं हुतं यज्ञेषु देवताः ॥ न यष्टव्यं न होतव्यम् इति तस्य प्रजापतेः । अहम् ईज्यश् च यष्टा च यज्ञश् चेति कुरूद्वह । मयि यज्ञो विधातव्यो मयि होतव्यम् इत्य् अपि ॥
units.english: That king established an irreligious order and disregarding Vedic observances he engaged in impious actions. During his administration the study of the Vedas and the performance of the Vedic rites were suspended. And the celestials did not get Soma juice consecrated in Yajnas. Such was the dreadful promise of the Patriarch that no one would perform, even at the time of destruction, either Homa or Yajna. foremost of Kurus, he said am worthy of being adored, am the agent of Yajna, am identical with Yajna—you should dedicate all your Yajnas and Homas unto me.

units.sanskrit: ऊचुर् महर्षयः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखास् तदा ॥ वयं दीक्षां प्रवेक्ष्यामः संवत्सरगणान् बहून् । फलदायी स चास्माकं यज्ञस् ते ऽद्यापि नान्यथा । अधर्मं कुरु मा वेन नैष धर्मः सतां मतः ॥
units.english: Beholding him thus transgress the order and partake unduly and unfairly of the sacrificial offerings the great Rishis, headed by Marichi, said :–We shall enter upon the initiation ceremony for many long years—therefore do not act irreligiously, Vena, for such is the eternal religion.

units.sanskrit: निधने हि प्रसूतस् त्वं प्रजापतिर् असंशयम् । प्रजाश् च पालयिष्ये ऽहम् इति ते समयः कृतः ॥
units.english: After the death of Atri you have forsooth been born as a Patriarch. And you made the contract that you would govern the subjects.

units.sanskrit: तांस् तथा ब्रुवतः सर्वान् महर्षीन् अब्रवीत् तदा । वेनः प्रहस्य दुर्बुद्धिर् इमम् अर्थम् अनर्थवत् ॥
units.english: After they had said this the wicked and ill-disposed Vena, laughing, said to all those great Rishis, the following evil words.

units.sanskrit: स्रष्टा धर्मस्य कश् चान्यः श्रोतव्यं कस्य वा मया । श्रुतवीर्यतपःसत्यैर् मया वा कः समो भुवि । प्रभवं सर्वभूतानां धर्माणां च विशेषतः । संमूढा न विदुर् नूनं भवन्तो मां विशेषतः ॥
units.english: Vena said Who else will be the founder of religion? Whom shall hear? Who else is superior to me on this earth in learning, energy, prowess, asceticism and truth ? All creatures and especially all forms of religion have originated from me. You are all stupid and void of consciousness and therefore you do not know me.

units.sanskrit: इच्छन् दहेयं पृथिवीं प्लावयेयं तथा जलैः । द्यां वै भुवं च रुन्धेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ यदा न शक्यते मानाद् अवलेपाच् च पार्थिवः । अनुनेतुं तदा वेनं ततः क्रुद्धा महर्षयः ॥ निगृह्य तं महात्मानो विस्फुरन्तं महाबलम् । स भीतः प्राञ्जलिर् भूत्वा स्थितवाञ् जनमेजय । तम् अत्रिर् विह्वलं दृष्ट्वा निषीदेत्य् अब्रवीत् तदा ॥
units.english: If wish can burn down the earth or overflow it with water. can obstruct the heaven and earth: there is no need of discussing it . When the noble Rishis could not make Vena humble on account of his pride and egotism, they, worked up with anger, belaboured that highly powerful king and began to churn his left thigh –. When the thigh of that king was thus churned there arose from it a greatly short and dark person. Janamejaya, he stood there, stricken with fear and folding his arms. Beholding him thus possessed by fear Atri said to him Nishida Sit down.

units.sanskrit: निषादवंशकर्ता स बभूव वदतां वर । धीवरान् असृजच् चापि वेनकल्मषसंभवान् ॥
units.english: foremost of speakers, he became the originator of the race of Nishadas hunters and procreated the race of fishermen begotten of the sins of Vena.

units.sanskrit: ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलयास् तुमुरास् तुम्बुरास् तथा । अधर्मरुचयस् तात विद्धि तान् वेनकल्मषान् ॥
units.english: And Tukhāras, Tumuras and other races taking delight in impiety who live on the Vindhya mountain were also born of Vena.

units.sanskrit: ततः पुनर् महात्मानः पाणिं वेनस्य दक्षिणम् । अरणीम् इव संरब्धा ममन्थुस् ते महर्षयः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, those high-souled Rishis, worked up with anger, began to churn the right arm of Vena like a piece of wood used for kindling fire.

units.sanskrit: दीप्यमानः स्ववपुषा साक्षाद् अग्निर् इव ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: From that arm originated Prithu resembling the very flame, and burning in effulgence like the fire itself.

units.sanskrit: आद्यम् आजगवं नाम धनुर् गृह्य महारवम् । शरांश् च दिव्यान् रक्षार्थं कवचं च महाप्रभम् ॥
units.english: The highly illustrious Prithu was born with his most excellent prime bow Ajagava, heavenly arrows and a highly lustrous coat of mail to protect his body -.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिञ् जाते ऽथ भूतानि संप्रहृष्टानि सर्वशः । समापेतुर् महाराज वेनश् च त्रिदिवं ययौ ॥
units.english: At his birth all the creatures were filled with delight and Vena too, monarch, repaired to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: समुत्पन्नेन कौरव्य सत्पुत्रेण महात्मना । त्रातः स पुरुषव्याघ्र पुन्नाम्नो नरकात् तदा ॥
units.english: descendant of Kuru, the great Prithu, a good son, being born he saved Vena from the hell called Put.

units.sanskrit: तं समुद्राश् च नद्यश् च रत्नान्य् आदाय सर्वशः । तोयानि चाभिषेकार्थं सर्व एवोपतस्थिरे ॥ पितामहश् च भगवान् देवैर् आङ्गिरसैः सह । स्थावराणि च भूतानि जंगमानि च सर्वशः ॥
units.english: Taking all the jewels the oceans came to him with water for his installation. The Divine Brahmā with the Devas, the offspring of Angiras, and all other creatures, mobile and immobile, came there and installed the effulgent king, the son of Vena, the lord of an extensive kingdom -.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभिषिक्तो महातेजा विधिवद् धर्मकोविदैः । आधिराज्ये तदा राजा पृथुर् वैन्यः प्रतापवान् ॥ पित्रापरञ्जितास् तस्य प्रजास् तेनानुरञ्जिताः । अनुरागात् ततस् तस्य नाम राजेत्य् अजायत ॥
units.english: The highly energetic and powerful son of Vena, Prithu, was installed as the first king by the leading Rishis conversant with the Vedas and other scriptures By him were pleased the subjects who had been dissatisfied by his father. On account of his being the object of their love he was called Rājā king.

units.sanskrit: आपस् तस्तम्भिरे तस्य समुद्रम् अभियास्यतः । पर्वताश् च ददुर् मार्गं ध्वजसङ्गश् च नाभवत् ॥
units.english: When he used to make a voyage in the ocean the water used be grow hard as land and the mountains made way for him and the branches of the trees were not broken down.

units.sanskrit: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिध्यन्त्य् अन्नानि चिन्तया । सर्वकामदुघा गावः पुटके पुटके मधु ॥
units.english: The earth grew easy of production and yielded articles of food as soon as thought of. The kine gave milk whenever milched and honey grew in every leaf.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु यज्ञे पैतामहे शुभे । तस्मिन्न् एव महायज्ञे जज्ञे प्राज्ञो ऽथ मागधः । पृथोः स्तवार्थं तौ तत्र समाहूतौ महर्षिभिः ॥
units.english: In the meantime at the sacred Yajna of Brahmā, was born the highly intelligent Suta. At that great Yajna was also born the wise Māgadha. They were invited by the celestial saints for chanting the glories of Prithu.

units.sanskrit: ताव् ऊचुर् ऋषयः सर्वे स्तूयताम् एष पार्थिवः । कर्मैतद् अनुरूपं वां पात्रं चायं नराधिपः ॥
units.english: All the Rishis said to them Do ye sing the glories of this king. This is a work that befits you and this king too is also an worthy subject for it .

units.sanskrit: ताव् ऊचतुस् तदा सर्वांस् तान् ऋषीन् सूतमागधौ । आवां देवान् ऋषींश् चैव प्रीणयावः स्वकर्मभिः ॥
units.english: Then Suta and Māgadha said to all those Rishis:—We shall, with our own actions, delight the gods and Rishis.

units.sanskrit: न चास्य विद्वो वै कर्म न तथा लक्षणं यशः । स्तोत्रं येनास्य कुर्याव राज्ञस् तेजस्विनो द्विजाः ॥
units.english: ye twice born ones, we are not cognizant of the actions, characteristics and fame of this energetic king.

units.sanskrit: ऋषिभिस् तौ नियुक्तौ तु भविष्यैः स्तूयताम् इति । तौ स्तुतिं चक्रतुर् युक्तं सूतमागधकौ नृप । यानि कर्माणि कृतवान् पृथुः पश्चान् महाबलः ॥
units.english: How shall we then chant his glories ? They were then engaged by the Rishis to chant his glories saying Do ye chant his glories by the deeds which the highly powerful Prithu did in the previous Kalpa.

units.sanskrit: सत्यवाग्दानशीलो ऽयं सत्यसंधो नरेश्वरः । श्रीमाञ् जैत्रः क्षमाशीलो विक्रान्तो दुष्टशासनः ॥ धर्मज्ञश् च कृतज्ञश् च दयावान् प्रियभाषकः । मान्यमानयिता यज्वा ब्रह्मण्यः साधुवत्सलः । तदाप्रभृति त्रैलोक्ये स्तवेषु जनमेजय । आशीर्वादाः प्रयुज्यन्ते सूतमागधबन्दिभिः ॥
units.english: This king speaks truth, has a good character, keeps his promise, is modest, does good unto all, is forgiving, powerful, represses the wicked, observes his duties, is grateful, merciful, always speaks sweet words and respects those who deserve it, performs Yajnas, is devoted to Brāhmanas, is of a quiet temperament, and observes the rules of society. Since then, Janmejaya, at the time of chanting glories Sutas and Māgadhas panegyrists pour their benedictions in this world -.

units.sanskrit: तयोः स्तवान्ते सुप्रीतः पृथुः प्रादात् प्रजेश्वरः । अनूपदेशं सूताय मगधं मागधाय च ॥ तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीताः प्रजाः प्राहुर् महर्षयः । तम् ऊचुस् तेन ताः पृष्टास् तत्रागमनकारणम् । प्रजा ऊचुः सो ऽभिद्रुतः प्रजाभिस् तु प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया । धनुर् गृह्य पृषत्कांश् च पृथिवीम् आर्दयद् बली ॥ ततो वैन्यभयत्रस्ता गौर् भूत्वा प्राद्रवन् मही । सा लोकान् ब्रह्मलोकादीन् गत्वा वैन्यभयात् तदा । प्रददर्शाग्रतो वैन्यं प्रगृहीतशरासनम् ॥
units.english: Being highly pleased with their eulogy the king Prithu conferred upon Suta the province of Arupa, and on Māgadha, that of Magadha. Thereat delighted the great Rishis and the subjects said The king will forsooth grant us maintenances in abundance . Thereupon at the words of the great saints, the subjects approached the son of Vena and begged of him their maintenances. Thus approached by his subjects and with a view to do them good the powerful king took up his bow and assailed the earth. Thereupon assuming the form of a cow the earth fled away in fear of Vena's son. Prithu too, taking up his bow, pursued her. Traversing the region of Brahmā and all other regions in fear of Vena's son she saw him everywhere before her with the bow in his hand.

units.sanskrit: ज्वलद्भिर् निशितैर् बाणैर् दीप्ततेजसम् अच्युतम् । महायोगं महात्मानं दुर्धर्षम् अमरैर् अपि ॥
units.english: He looked effulgent like the burning eternal fire with his sharpened arrows and even the immortals could not repress that high-souled one.

units.sanskrit: अलभन्ती तु सा त्राणं वैन्यम् एवान्वपद्यत । कृताञ्जलिपुटा भूत्वा पूज्या लोकैस् त्रिभिः सदा ॥ उवाच वैन्यं नाधर्मं स्त्रीवधे परिपश्यसि । कथं धारयिता चासि प्रजा राजन् विना मया ॥
units.english: Even when repairing to the region of Brahmā she could not find safety; the earth, adored even by the three worlds with folded hands then said to the son of Vena:—You should not perpetrate the iniquity of slaying a woman. Without me, how will you be able, king, to protect your subjects -.

units.sanskrit: मयि लोकाः स्थिता राजन् मयेदं धार्यते जगत् । मत्कृते न विनश्येयुः प्रजाः पार्थिव विद्धि तत् ॥ न माम् अर्हसि हन्तुं वै श्रेयश् चेत् त्वं चिकीर्षसि । प्रजानां पृथिवीपाल शृणु चेदं वचो मम ॥
units.english: king, all the worlds are situated on me, and this universe is sustained by me. Know this, king, that with my destruction all the creatures will be destroyed. king, if you wish to encompass the well being of your subjects it does not behove you to kill me. Listen to these words of mine.

units.sanskrit: उपायतः समारब्धाः सर्वे सिध्यन्त्य् उपक्रमाः । उपायं पश्य येन त्वं धारयेथाः प्रजा नृप ॥
units.english: If works are undertaken commensurate with their means they are crowned with success. Do you, king, find out the means by which you will protect your subjects.

units.sanskrit: हत्वापि मां न शक्तस् त्वं प्रजानां पोषणे नृप । अन्नभूता भविष्यामि यच्छ कोपं महाद्युते ॥
units.english: By slaying me, king, you will not be able to protect your subjects by any means. you of great effulgence, will find it out; do you restrain your anger.

units.sanskrit: अवध्याश् च स्त्रियः प्राहुस् तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्व् अपि । सत्त्वेषु पृथिवीपाल न धर्मं त्यक्तुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: Even women of inferior births should not be slain. Therefore, king, you should not forsake your morality.

units.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राजा महामनाः । पृथुर् उवाच एकस्यार्थाय यो हन्याद् आत्मनो वा परस्य वा । बहून् वै प्राणिनो लोके भवेत् तस्येह पातकम् ॥
units.english: Hearing those various words of the earth the high-souled and pious king, restraining his anger, said to her. Prithu said:—He, who for one individual destroys many lives either belonging to his own side or to his opposite party, commits a sin in this world.

units.sanskrit: सुखम् एधन्ति बहवो यस्मिंस् तु निहते शुभे । तस्मिन् हते नास्ति भद्रे पातकं नोपपातकम् ॥
units.english: By slaying that harmful person at whose death many become happy one is not visited by sin, either great or small.

units.sanskrit: एकस्मिन् यत्र निधनं प्रापिते दुष्टकारिणि । बहूनां भवति क्षेमं तत्र पुण्यप्रदो वधः । सो ऽहं प्रजानिमित्तं त्वां हनिष्यामि वसुंधरे । यदि मे वचनं नाद्य करिष्यसि जगद्धितम् ॥ त्वां निहत्याद्य बाणेन मच्छासनपराङ्मुखीम् । आत्मानं प्रथयित्वाहं प्रजा धारयिता स्वयम् ॥
units.english: If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue. shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self under the earth shall uphold my subjects forever -.

units.sanskrit: सा त्वं शासनम् आस्थाय मम धर्मभृतां वरे । संजीवय प्रजाः सर्वाः समर्था ह्य् असि धारणे ॥
units.english: you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them.

units.sanskrit: दुहितृत्वं च मे गच्छ तत एनम् अहं शरम् । नियच्छेयं त्वद्वधार्थम् उद्यतं घोरदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: Do you give milk for me and then will withdraw the dreadful arrow that have taken up for your destruction.

units.sanskrit: वसुंधरोवाच सर्वम् एतद् अहं वीर विधास्यामि न संशयः । वत्सं तु मम तं पश्य क्षरेयं येन वत्सला ॥
units.english: The earth said:— hero, forsooth shall carry out all that you have said. So do you resort to the means by which all the subjects may be protected. Behold this my calf.

units.sanskrit: समां च कुरु सर्वत्र मां त्वं धर्मभृतां वर । यथा विष्यन्दमानं मे क्षीरं सर्वत्र भावयेत् ॥
units.english: Being attached to it shall give milk, you foremost of the pious, do you level my surface all over, so that my milk may reach everywhere.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच तत उत्सारयामास शिलाः शतसहस्रशः । मन्वन्तरेष्व् अतीतेषु विषम् आसीद् वसुंधरा ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thereupon Vena's son, with the end of his bow, uprooted thousands of hills for which they multiplied greatly in number. Vena's son Prithu then levelled the surface of the earth. In the past Manwantara she was of uneven surface.

units.sanskrit: स्वभावेनाभवंस् तस्या समानि विषमाणि च । न हि पूर्वविसर्गे वै विषमे पृथिवीतले । प्रविभागः पुराणां वा ग्रामाणां वा तदाभवत् ॥
units.english: The earth was by nature both even and uneven; such was her state in Chakshusha Manwantara. The earth having been uneven in the previous Manwantara there existed no regular division of the cities and villages.

units.sanskrit: न सस्यानि न गोरक्ष्यं न कृषिर् न वणिक्पथः । नैव सत्यानृतं तत्र न लोभो न च मत्सरः । वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे तस्मिन् सांप्रते समुपस्थिते । वैन्यात् प्रभृति राजेन्द्र सर्वस्यैतस्य संभवः ॥
units.english: There was no corn, no rearing of kine, agriculture or trade. There was neither truth, untruth, avarice nor pride. king, now with the advent of Vaivaswata Manwantara, agriculture, trade and the keeping of kine have originated from Vena's son Prithu.

units.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र समं त्व् अस्या भूमेर् आसीत् तदानघ । तत्र तत्र प्रजाः सर्वा निवासं समरोचयन् ॥
units.english: sinless one, at that time people desired to makes their habitations at all those places of the earth which were levelled.

units.sanskrit: आहारः फलमूलानि प्रजानाम् अभवत् तदा । कृच्छ्रेण महता युक्त इत्य् एवम् अनुशुश्रुम ॥ संकल्पयित्वा वत्सं तु मनुं स्वायंभुवं प्रभुम् । स्वे पाणौ पुरुषव्याघ्र दुदोह पृथिवीं ततः ॥
units.english: Then with great difficulty people could live upon fruits and roots. This have heard. Having converted the Manu Swayambhuva into a calf the powerful son of Vena, Prithu, the foremost of men, milched the earth for all sorts of corns with his own hands.

units.sanskrit: तेनान्नेन प्रजास् तात वर्तन्ते ऽद्यापि नित्यशः ॥
units.english: On that food, my child, the people are daily living even now.

units.sanskrit: ऋषिभिः श्रूयते चापि पुनर् दुग्ध्हा वसुंधरा । वत्सः सोमो ऽभवत् तेषां दोग्धा चाङ्गिरसः सुतः ॥
units.english: have heard the earth was again milched by the Rishis. Soma became their calf; the son of Angiras, the highly energetic Vrihaspati, milched her.

units.sanskrit: क्षीरम् आसीद् अनुपमं तपो ब्रह्म च शाश्वतम् ॥
units.english: The Vedas were the vessels, descendant of Bharata, and the eternal devotion to Brahman was the incomparable milk -.

units.sanskrit: ततः पुनर् देवगणैः पुरंदरपुरोगमैः । काञ्चनं पात्रम् आदाय दुग्धेयं श्रूयते मही ॥
units.english: have heard she was again milched by all the celestials headed by Purandara with golden vessels in their hands.

units.sanskrit: वत्सस् तु मघवान् आसीद् दोग्धा तु सविता विभुः । क्षीरम् ऊर्जस्करं चैव येन वर्तन्ति देवताः ॥
units.english: Then Maghavān Indra became the calf and the lord Sun milched her. continued flow of milk came out on which the Devas are living.

units.sanskrit: पितृभिः श्रूयते चापि पुनर् दुग्धा वसुंधरा । राजतं पात्रम् आदाय स्वधाम् अमितविक्रमैः ॥
units.english: have heard the earth was again milched by the ancestral manes of unlimited prowess, with silver vessels in their hands.

units.sanskrit: अन्तकश् चाभवद् दोग्धा कालो लोकप्रकालनः ॥
units.english: The powerful son of Vivaswat became the calf and Antaka, the destroyer of Lokas worlds, milched her.

units.sanskrit: नागैश् च श्रूयते दुग्धा वत्सं कृत्वा तु तक्षकम् । अलाबुपात्रम् आदाय विषं क्षीरं नरोत्तम ॥
units.english: foremost of men, have heard, that making Takshaka the calf, the Nāgas milched her with the cavity of their palms as vessels and got poison for the milk.

units.sanskrit: तेषाम् ऐरावतो दोग्धा धृतराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् । नागानां भरतश्रेष्ठ सर्पाणां च महीपते ॥
units.english: foremost of Bharatas, king, the powerful Airavata Dhritarashtra became the milcher when the Nāgas and serpents milched her.

units.sanskrit: तेनैव वर्तयन्त्य् उग्रा महाकाया महाबलाः । तदाहारास् तदाचारास् तद्वीर्यास् तदपाश्रयाः ॥
units.english: By that poison the huge serpents of deadly venom are living their dreadful lives. They live on poison, they give out poison and poison constitutes their energy.
