units.sanskrit: असुरैः श्रूयते चापि पुनर् दुग्धा वसुंधरा । आयसं पात्रम् आदाय मायाः शत्रुनिबर्हणीः ॥
units.english: have heard that the earth was again milched by Asuras with iron vessels for the illusory power capable of over-powering the enemies.

units.sanskrit: ऋत्विग् द्विमूर्धा दैत्यानां मधुर् दोग्धा महाबलः ॥
units.english: Pralhāda's son Virochana became their calf and the highly powerful, two-headed Madhu, the priest of the Daityas milched her.

units.sanskrit: तयैते माययाद्यापि सर्वे मायाविनो ऽसुराः । वर्तयन्त्य् अमितप्रज्ञास् तद् एषाम् अमितं बलम् ॥ यक्षैश् च श्रूयते राजन् पुनर् दुग्धा वसुंधरा । आमपात्रे महाराज पुरान्तर्धानम् अक्षयम् ॥
units.english: By that Māyā illusory power the Asuras have been rendered adepts in illusion. The Asuras, endued with immeasurable wisdom, are therefore so very powerful. have heard, monarch, that the earth was again, in the days of yore, milched by Yakshas for eternal disappearance from view with uncouth vessels.

units.sanskrit: वत्सं वैश्रवणं कृत्वा यक्षैः पुण्यजनैस् तथा । दोग्धा रजतनाभस् तु पिता मणिवरस्य यः । यक्षात्मजो महातेजास् त्रिशीर्षः सुमहातपाः । तेन ते वर्तयन्तीह परमर्षिर् उवाच ह ॥ राक्षसैश् च पिशाचैश् च पुनर् दुग्धा वसुंधरा । शावं कपालम् आदाय प्रजा भोक्तुं नरर्षभ ॥
units.english: The highly effulgent and pious Yakshas made Vaisravana their calf. The ascetic three-headed son of Yaksha, by name Rajatanābha, the father of Maninābha, milched the earth. By that power of disappearance into another’s body they are now still living. This the great saint Nārada has said -. foremost of men, with a view to afford gratification to their children the earth was again milched by the Rākshasas and Pishāchas with the skulls of dead bodies.

units.sanskrit: दोग्धा रजतनाभस् तु तेषाम् आसीत् कुरूद्वह । वत्सः सुमाली कौरव्य क्षीरं रुधिरम् एव च ॥
units.english: glory of the Kuru race, Rajatanābha milched the earth for them. Sumāli became the calf and blood came out for the milk.

units.sanskrit: तेन क्षीरेण रक्षांसि यक्षाश् चैवामरोपमाः । वर्तयन्ति पिशाचाश् च भूतसंघास् तथैव च ॥
units.english: By that bloody milk the immortal Yakshas, Rakshasas, Pishāchas and other ghosts are keeping their lives.

units.sanskrit: पद्मपत्रे पुनर् दुग्धा गन्धर्वैः साप्सरोगणैः । वत्सं चित्ररथं कृत्वा शुचीन् गन्धान् नरोत्तम ॥
units.english: foremost of men, having made Chitraratha their calf the Gandharvas and Apsarās again milched her with lotus vessels for sweet perfume.

units.sanskrit: तेषां च सुरुचिस् त्व् आसीद् दोग्धा भरतसत्तम । गन्धर्वराजो ऽतिबलो महात्मा सूर्यसंनिभः ॥
units.english: foremost of Bharatas, the greatly powerful and the high-souled king of Gandharvas, Suruchi, resembling the Sun itself, milched her for them.

units.sanskrit: शैलैश् च श्रूयते दुग्धा पुनर् देवी वसुंधरा । ओषधीर् वै मूर्तिमती रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥
units.english: king, have heard that the mountains again milched her for the herbs in forms and various jewels.

units.sanskrit: वत्सस् तु हिमवान् आसीद् दोग्धा मेरुर् महागिरिः । पात्रं तु शैलम् एवासीत् तेन शैलाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
units.english: Himavāna became the calf and the great mountain Sumeru milched her. Other great mountains were the vessels and by that the mountains are increasing in proportions.

units.sanskrit: दुग्धेयं वृक्षवीरुद्भिः श्रूयते च वसुंधरा । पालाशं पात्रम् आदाय च्छिन्नदग्धप्ररोहणम् ॥ सेयं धात्री विधात्री च पावनी च वसुंधरा । चराचरस्य सर्वस्य प्रतिष्ठा योनिर् एव च । सर्वकामदुघा दोग्ध्री सर्वसस्यप्ररोहिणी ॥
units.english: have heard, king, that the trees, in the days of yore, once milched her with Palāsa leaves as vessels for reviving the scorched and burnt trees and creepers. The blossoming Sāla tree milched her and the Plaksha tree became the calf. That purifying Earth, who sustains all, is the instrument of the birth and preservation of the entire mobile and immobile creations. When milched she gives all desired-for objects and produces all corns -.

units.sanskrit: आसीद् इयं समुद्रान्ता मेदिनीति परिश्रुता । मधुकैटभयोः कृत्स्ना मेदसाभिपरिप्लुता ॥
units.english: Extending up to the ocean she was celebrated under the name of Medini. Her entire surface was filled with the fat of the demons Madhu and Katabha.

units.sanskrit: तेनेयं मेदिनी देवी प्रोच्यते ब्रह्मवादिभिः । ततो ऽभ्युपगमाद् राज्ञः पृथोर् वैन्यस्य भारत । दुहितृत्वम् अनुप्राप्ता देवी पृथ्वीति चोच्यते ॥
units.english: Therefore was she called Medini by Brahmā and others. descendant of Bharata, when she was brought under the subjection of the king Prithu, the son of Vena and became his daughter she came by the name of Prithivi.

units.sanskrit: पृथुना प्रविभक्ता च शोधिता च वसुंधरा । सस्याकरवती स्फीता पुरपत्तनमालिनी ॥
units.english: Being divided and purified by Prithu the earth has become full of corns, mines, cities and provinces.

units.sanskrit: एवंप्रभावो वैन्यः स राजासीद् राजसत्तम । नमस्यश् चैव पूज्यश् च भूतग्रामैर् न संशयः ॥
units.english: best of kings, such a powerful king was the son of Vena –. Undoubtedly he is an object of reverence and adoration of all creatures.

units.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैश् च महाभागैर् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः । पृथुर् एव नमस्कार्यो वृत्तिदः स सनातनः ॥ पार्थिवैश् च महाभागैः पार्थिवत्वम् अभीप्सुभिः । योधैर् अपि च विक्रान्तैः प्राप्तुकामैर् जयं युधि । आदिराजो नमस्कार्यो योधानां प्रथमो नृपः ॥ यो हि योद्धा रणं याति कीर्तयित्वा पृथुं नृपम् । वैश्यैर् अपि च वित्ताढ्यैर् वैश्यवृत्तिम् अनुष्ठितैः । पृथुर् एव नमस्कार्यो वृत्तिदाता महायशाः ॥
units.english: Prithu, born of eternal Brahmā, is worthy of the adoration even of the great Brāhmanas, well-read in the Vedas and all their divisions. The powerful prime king Prithu, the son of Vena, deserves also the adoration of the great kings who desire kingdoms. The first king of the heroes, Prithu, is also worthy of the adoration of the valiant warriors who wish for victory in battle –. The warrior, who issues out for battle after reciting the name of the king Prithu, is crowned with success and glory even in dreadful battles. The illustrious king Prithu, who conferred livelihood on all, is worthy of the adoration of the wealthy Vaisyas who carry on trade.

units.sanskrit: तथैव शूद्रैः शुचिभिस् त्रिवर्णपरिचारिभिः । पृथुर् एव नमस्कार्यः श्रेयः परम् अभीप्सुभिः ॥ एते वत्सविशेषाश् च दोग्धारः क्षीरम् एव च । जनमेजय उवाच मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि विस्तरेण तपोधन । तेषां पूर्वविसृष्टिं च वैशंपायन कीर्तय ॥
units.english: The first king is also worthy of the adoration of the pure Sudras who serve the three other Varnas and who wish for supreme well-being. monarch, have thus described the various calves, those who milched, the various sorts of milk and vessels. What more shall describe to you? Janamejaya said:— Vaishampayana, you having asceticism for your wealth, do you describe at length all the Manwantaras and the creations previous to them.

units.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरकथां ब्रह्मञ् छ्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
units.english: Brahman, wish to hear, in sooth, of all the Manus and the extent of their reigns.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच न शक्यं विस्तरं तात वक्तुं वर्षशतैर् अपि । मन्वन्तराणां कौरव्य संक्षेपं त्व् एव मे शृणु ॥ रुद्रपुत्रस् तु सावर्णिर् भवितैकादशो मनुः । सावर्णिश् च मनुस् तात भौत्यो रौच्यस् तथैव च । रैवतो ब्रह्मसावर्णिः सूर्यसावर्णिर् एव च । तथैव मेरुसावर्णाश् चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— descendant of Kuru, cannot give a detailed account of Manwantaras even in hundreds of years. Do you hear from me in brief. descendant of Kuru, Swayambhuva, Swārochisha, Auttami, Tāmasa, Raivata, Chakshusha, the present Manu Vaivaswata, the four Manus Savarne, Bhoutya, Rouchya and Manu Sāvarna—these all are Manus.

units.sanskrit: अतीता वर्तमानाश् च तथैवानागताश् च ये । ऋषींस् तेषां प्रवक्ष्यामि पुत्रान् देवगणांस् तथा ॥
units.english: have described, as have heard, of Manus, present, past and future. will now describe the Rishis, the sons of Manus, and the celestials who were born in the various Manwantaras -.

units.sanskrit: मरीचिर् अत्रिर् भगवान् अङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः । पुलस्त्यश् च वसिष्ठश् च सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः ॥
units.english: Marichi, the reverend Atri, Angira, Puloha, Kratu, Pulastya and Vasishtha—these seven are the sons of Arahmā.

units.sanskrit: उत्तरस्यां दिशि तथा राजन् सप्तर्षयः स्थिताः । यामा नाम तथा देवा आसन् स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे ॥
units.english: king, during Swāyambhava Manwantara there were seven Rishis and the celestials by the name of Yamas in the north.

units.sanskrit: अग्नीध्रश् चाग्निबाहुश् च मेधा मेधातिथिर् वसुः । ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमान् हव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च ॥ मनोः स्वायंभुवस्यैते दश पुत्रा महौजसः । एतत् ते प्रथमं राजन् मन्वन्तरम् उदाहृतम् ॥
units.english: Agnidhra, Agnivāhu, Medha, Medhātithi, Vasu, Yotishman, Dyutiman, Havya, Savana and Putra: these were the ten highly powerful sons of Manu Swayambhuva. have thus described to you, king, the first Manwantara –.

units.sanskrit: और्वो वसिष्ठपुत्रश् च स्तम्बः काश्यप एव च । प्राणो बृहस्पतिश् चैव दत्तो ऽत्रिश् च्यवनस् तथा । एते महर्षयस् तात वायुप्रोक्ता महाव्रताः ॥
units.english: child, during Swārochisha Manwantara narrated by Vayu, Aurva, the son of Vasistha, Stambha, the son of Kagyapa, Prāna, Vrihaspati, Datta, Atri and Chyavana—these were the great Rishis of great vows and Tushitas were the gods -.

units.sanskrit: हविर्ध्रः सुकृतिर् ज्योतिर् आपो मूर्तिर् अयस्मयः ॥ प्रथितश् च नभस्यश् च नभः सूर्यस् तथैव च । कीर्तिताः पृथिवीपाल महावीर्यपराक्रमाः ॥ द्वितीयम् एतत् कथितं तव मन्वन्तरं मया । इदं तृतीयं वक्ष्यामि तन् निबोध नराधिप ॥
units.english: Havirdhra, Sukriti, Jyoti, Apomurti, Ayaprathita, Nabhasya, Nabha and Urja—these were the sons of the high-souled Swarochisha Manu. They have been described, king, as being gifted with high energy and prowess –. have thus described to you the second Manwantara. Hear, king, shall describe the third.

units.sanskrit: वसिष्ठपुत्राः सप्तासन् वासिष्ठा इति विश्रुताः । हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुता ऊर्जा जाताः सुतेजसः ॥
units.english: The seven sons of Vasishtha, celebrated under the name of Vasishtha and the highly energetic sons of Hiranyagarbha by name Sutejas were the seven Rishis, as have said.

units.sanskrit: औत्तमेयान् महाराज दश पुत्रान् मनोरमान् ॥
units.english: monarch, Auttama had ten beautiful sons. Hear shall describe them –.

units.sanskrit: इष ऊर्जस् तनूपश् च मधुर् माधव एव च । शुचिः शुक्रः सहश् चैव नभस्यो नभ एव च । भानवस् तत्र देवाश् च मन्वन्तरम् उदाहृतम् ॥
units.english: They were Isha, Urja, Tanurjja, Madhu, Mādhava, Suchi, Sukra, Saha, Nabharya and Nabha. It is said that the Bhanus were the celestials in that Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरं चतुर्थं ते कथयिष्यामि तच् छृणु । काव्यः पृथुस् तथैवाग्निर् जह्नुर् धाता च भारत । कपीवान् अकपीवांश् च तत्र सप्तर्षयो नृप ॥
units.english: Hear, shall describe the fourth Manwantara. descendant of Bharata, Kāvya, Prithu, Agni, Jahnu, Dhāta, Kapivan and Akapivān—these were the seven Rishis, descendant of Bharata, in Puranas their sons and grandsons have been mentioned.

units.sanskrit: सत्या देवगणाश् चैव तामसस्यान्तरे मनोः ॥
units.english: Satyas were the celestials in Tāmasa Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: द्युतिस् तपस्यः सुतपास् तपोमूलस् तपोधनः । तपोरतिर् अकल्माषस् तन्वी धन्वी परम्टपः ॥ तामसस्य मनोर् एते दश पुत्रा महाबलाः । वायुप्रोक्ता महाराज चतुर्थं चैतद् अन्तरम् ॥
units.english: king, shall now enumerate the sons of Tamasa Manu-Dyuti, Tapasya, Sutapa, Tapomula, Tapogana, Taporati, Akalmāsha, Tanvi, Dhanvi and Parantapa—these ten were the sons of the highly powerful Manu Tāmasa. So Vayu has said -.

units.sanskrit: वेदबाहुर् यदुध्रश् च मुनिर् वेदशिरास् तथा । हिरण्यलोमा पर्जन्य ऊर्ध्वबाहुश् च सोमजः । सत्यनेत्रस् तथात्रेय एते सप्तर्षयो ऽपरे ॥
units.english: During the fifth Manwantara Vedavāhu, Yadudhra, Muni, Vedaçira, Hiranyaroma, Parijanya, Somasuta, Urdhavahu, Atreya and Satyanetra were the seven Rishis.

units.sanskrit: देवाश् चाभूतरजसस् तथा प्रकृतयः स्मृताः । पारिप्लवश् च रैभ्यश् च मनोर् अन्तरम् उच्यते ॥
units.english: The celestials of that period passed under the name of Abhutarajas—having their nature not permeated by the quality of darkness. There were also two other classes of celestials by the name of Pāriplava and Raivya –.

units.sanskrit: धृतिमान् अव्ययो युक्तस् तत्त्वदर्शी निरुत्सुकः ॥ अरण्यश् च प्रकाशश् च निर्मोहः सत्यवाक् कृतिः । रैवतस्य मनोः पुत्राः पञ्चमं चैतद् अन्तरम् ॥ षष्ठं ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि तन् निबोध नराधिप । भृगुर् नभो विवस्वांश् च सुधामा विरजास् तथा ॥ अतिनामा सहिष्णुश् च सप्त एते महर्षयः । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे तात मनोर् देवान् इमाञ् शृणु ॥
units.english: Hear, shall enumerate the names of their sons—Dhritimān, Avya, Yukta, Tatwadarshi, Nirutsuka, Arany, Prakāsha, Nirmoha, Satyavāk and Kadi were the sons of Manu Raivata-and this is the fifth Manwantara -. Hear, king, shall describe the sixth Manwantara. Bhrigu, Nabha, Vivaswān, Sudhāmā, Virajā, Atinamā and Sahishnu these were the seven Rishis in the sixth Manwantara. Hear the names of the celestials who flourished in Chākshusha Manwantara –.

units.sanskrit: लेखाश् च नाम राजेन्द्र पञ्च देवगणाः स्मृताः ॥
units.english: king, Adya, Prasuta, Rishabha Prithokbhava and Lekha—these have been recorded as the five classes of deities.

units.sanskrit: ऋषेर् अङ्गिरसः पुत्रा महात्मानो महौजसः । नाड्वलेया महाराज दश पुत्राश् च विश्रुताः । उरुप्रभृतयो राजन् षष्ठं मन्वन्तरं स्मृतम् ॥
units.english: The high-souled and the highly energetic sons of Angiras were the Rishis. monarch, those ten sons, Uru and others, passed under the name of Nādvaleyās. This is known as the sixth Manwantara.

units.sanskrit: अत्रिर् वसिष्ठो भगवान् कश्यपश् च महान् ऋषिः । गौतमो ऽथ भरद्वाजो विश्वामित्रस् तथैव च ॥
units.english: Atri, the reverend Vasistha, the great saint Kaçyapa, Goutama Bharadwaja, Vishwāmitra, the reverend Jamadagni, the son of the high-souled Richika-these seven Rishis are now living in heaven –.

units.sanskrit: साध्या रुद्राश् च विश्वे च वसवो मरुतस् तथा । आदित्याश् चाश्विनौ चैव देवौ वैवस्वतौ स्मृतौ ॥
units.english: The Sādhyas, Vishwas, Rudras, Vasus, Maruts, Adityas, Vaivaswān, the two Açwinis are now all living during the present Manwantara of Vaivaswat.

units.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखाश् चैव दश पुत्रा महात्मनः ॥
units.english: He had ten high-souled sons headed by Ikshwāku –.

units.sanskrit: एतेषां कीर्तितानां तु महर्षीणां महौजसाम् । राजन् पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, the sons and grandsons of those great Rishis of great energy are living in all the quarters.

units.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु प्राग्दिशं सप्त सप्तकाः । मन्वन्तरे व्यतिक्रान्ते चत्वारः सप्तका गणाः । कृत्वा कर्म दिवं यान्ति ब्रह्मलोकम् अनामयम् ॥ ततो ऽन्ये तपसा युक्ताः स्थानं तत् पूरयन्त्य् उत । अतीता वर्तमानाश् च क्रमेणैतेन भारत ॥ एतान्य् उक्तानि कौरव्य सप्तातीतानि भारत । मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि निबोधानागतानि मे ॥
units.english: In all the Manwantaras, as in the previous Kalpa, exist the forty nine Maruts for protecting and governing the people. After the expiration of a Manwantara twenty Maruts, having performed heavenly deeds, attain to the region of Brahmā freed from all dangers. Thereupon others, observing rigid austerities, succeed them. descendant of Bharata, have thus described to you the past and present Manwantaras as well as the seven Manus, descendant of Kuru. Hear, shall describe the Manwantara that is to come –.

units.sanskrit: सावर्णा मनवस् तात पञ्च तांश् च निबोध मे । एको वैवस्वतस् तेषां चत्वारश् च प्रजापतेः । दक्षस्यैते हि दौहित्राः प्रियायास् तनया नृप । महता तपसा युक्ता मेरुपृष्ठे महौजसः ॥
units.english: Hear from me an account of the five Sāvarni Manus; of them one is the son of the Sun and the four are the offspring of Prajapati Paramesthi. king, they are the grandsons of Daksha and sons of Pryā. Because those mighty and energetic ones carried on hard austerities on the mount Meru they were called Meru Sāvarni –.

units.sanskrit: रुचेः प्रजापतेः पुत्रो रौच्यो नाम मनुः स्मृतः । भूत्यां चोत्पादितो देव्यां भौत्यो नाम रुचेः सुतः । अनागताश् च सप्तैव स्मृता दिवि महर्षयः । मनोर् अन्तरम् आसाद्य सावर्णस्येह ताञ् शृणु ॥
units.english: The son of the Patriarch Ruchi was celebrated by the name of Rouchya. The son whom Ruchi begat on Bhuti came by the name of Bhoutya. Hear now of the seven Rishis of Sāvarni Manwantara, who have not come as yet and who are said to be living in the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: रामो व्यासस् तथात्रेयो दीप्तिमन्तो बहुश्रुताः । भारद्वाजस् तथा द्रौणिर् अश्वत्थामा महाद्युतिः ॥ गोतमस्यात्मजश् चैव शरद्वान् नाम गौतमः । कौशिको गालवश् चैव रुरुः काश्यप एव च । एते सप्त महात्मानो भविष्या मुनिसत्तमाः ॥ ब्रह्मणः सदृशाश् चैते धन्याः सप्तर्षयः स्मृताः ॥ अभिजात्याथ तपसा मन्त्रव्याकरणैस् तथा । ब्रह्मलोकप्रतिष्ठास् तु स्मृता ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽमलाः ॥
units.english: Rāma, Vyāsa, the effulgent and celebrated Atreya, the highly energetic Aswathama, the son of Drona, the son of Bharadwāja, Kripa, the son of Goutama's son Saradvān, Gālava, the son of Kushika and Ruru, the son of Kaçyapa—these seven high souled ones are the future Munis. These seven Rishis are equal to Brahmā and fortunate -. By asceticism practised from their very birth, by their knowledge of sacred formulae and grammar they will secure a position in the region of Brahmā and will be celebrated as pure Brāhmana saints. Being repeatedly born in every Yuga beginning with the golden, the noble and truthful seven Rishis institute the various orders and lay down their duties.

units.sanskrit: भूतभव्यभवज्ज्ञानं बुद्धा चैव तु यैः स्वयम् । तपसा वै प्रसिद्धा ये संगता प्रविचिन्तकाः । मन्त्रव्याकरणाद्यैश् च ऐश्वर्यात् सर्वशश् च ये ॥
units.english: They are endued with the knowledge of the present, past and future, have themselves become, by means of their asceticism, well known, just and considerate. By the knowledge of formulae, and grammar and by their spiritual insight they see everything like an emblic myrobalam in their hands.

units.sanskrit: सप्तैते सप्तभिश् चैव गुणैः सप्तर्षयः स्मृताः ॥
units.english: They are known as seven Rishis by their sevenfold qualities.

units.sanskrit: दीर्घायुषो मन्त्रकृत ईश्वरा दीर्घचक्षुषः । कृतादिषु युगाख्येषु सर्वेष्व् एव पुनः पुनः । तेषां चैवान्वयोत्पन्ना जायन्ते हि पुनः पुनः । मन्त्रब्राह्मणकर्तारो धर्मे प्रशिथिले तथा ॥ यस्माच् च वरदाः सप्त परेभ्यश् चापराः स्मृताः । तस्मान् न कालो न वयः प्रमाणम् ऋषिभावने ॥ एष सप्तर्षिकोद्देशो व्याख्यातस् ते मया नृप । सावर्णस्य मनोः पुत्रान् भविष्याञ् शृणु सत्तम । संबन्धाच् च स्वयंतेजाः संबुद्धाश् च यतः स्वयम् । यस्माच् छंसन्ति ते ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मर्षयः स्मृताः । वरीवांश् चावरीवांश् च संमतो धृतिमान् वसुः । चरिष्णुर् आढ्यो धृष्णुश् च वाजी सुमतिर् एव च । सावर्णस्य मनोः पुत्रा भविष्या दश भारत ॥
units.english: They are long-lived, far-sighted and have seen the God. They are the first born, well-versed in various duties and the founders of various families -. When virtue suffers any deterioration, the Rishis, the originators of Mantras mystic formulae and Brāhmanas are repeatedly born in their families. When all the Rishis are capable of conferring boons and are all respectively great there is no evidence of the time when they flourished and of their age. king, have thus described to you the seven Rishis. best of the Bhārata race, hear now of the future sons of Manu Sāvarni. The two classes of the deities and the Rishis have already been enumerated. Hear, shall enumerate the names of the seven Rishis who flourished during the eleventh period of the third Manwantara. Kaçyapa's son Havishmān, Bhrigu's son Havishman, Atri's son Taruna, Vasishtha's son Taruna, Angira's son Urudhisna, Pulastya’s son Nischara, Pulaha's son Agnitejā,—these are the future seven great Rishis –. It is said that Brāhma's sons, the deities were divided into three classes.

units.sanskrit: क्षमया नृप सावर्णा भविष्याञ् शृणु भारत । एतेषां काल्यम् उत्थाय कीर्तनात् सुखम् एधते । यशश् चाप्नोति सुमहद् आयुष्मांश् च भवेन् नरः । अतीतनागतानां वै महर्षीणां सदा नरः ॥
units.english: Hear from me the names of the seven Rishis of the fourth Manwantara. It is said, there were five classes of deities—the mind-born sons of Brahmā –. Chanting the glory of their period a man attains happiness, great renown and long life. He, who recites always the names of the great Rishis, past and present, becomes long-lived and gains renown.

units.sanskrit: देवतानां गणाः प्रोक्ताः पञ्च वै भरतर्षभ । तरंगभीरुर् वप्रश् च तरस्वान् उग्र एव च ॥ अभिमानी प्रवीरश् च जिष्णुः संक्रन्दनस् तथा । भौत्यस्यैवाधिकारे तु पूर्णे कल्पस् तु पूर्यते । इत्य् एते ऽनागतातीता मनवः कीर्तिता मया । नमस्कृत्वा जयेत् स्वर्गं ब्राह्मणो नात्र संशयः । क्षत्रियो जयते शत्रून् वैश्यः शूद्रो यथेप्सितम् । तैर् इयं पृथिवी तात ससमुद्रा सपत्तना । यथाप्रदेशम् अद्यापि सर्वतः परिपाल्यते । पूर्णं युगसहस्रं हि परिपाल्या नरेश्वरैः । प्रजाभिस् तपसा चैव संहारान्ते च नित्यशः ॥
units.english: foremost of the Bharatas, five classes of deities, it is said, flourished then. Tarangabhirā, Bushma, Tarashmān, Ugra, Abhimāni, Pravira, Jishuu, Sangkrandana, Tejashi, and Savala are the sons of Manu Bhoutya. With the completion of Bhoutya Manwantara one Kalpa will be complete have thus enumerated the names of the past and future Manus. Janamejaya said:— you highly intelligent twice-born one, you should enumerate the Yugas and mention the extent of Brahmā's day. Vaishampāyana said:— subduer of enemies, hear, shall enumerate the days of Brahmā by the same calculation by which men make divisions of day and night. Such days and nights daily take place in all the countries around the mount Meru –. That which is considered as a Samvatsara year for human beings is a day and night for the celestials. Of them the northern course is considered by the learned as their day and the southern course as their night.

units.sanskrit: युगानि सप्ततिस् तानि साग्राणि कथितानि ते । कृतत्रेतादियुक्तानि मनोर् अन्तरम् उच्यते ॥
units.english: Paksha, when multiplied tenfold, forms one month; and twelve months are regarded by the wise, discriminating truth, as forming a season of Manu.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्दशैते मनवः कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः । वेदेषु सपुराणेषु सर्वे ते प्रभविष्णवः । प्रजानां पतयो राजन् धन्यम् एषां प्रकीर्तनम् ॥
units.english: king, four hundred years form the Sandhyā and four hundred such form the Sandhyāngsha. Its Sandhyā and Sandhyāngsha are said to extend each over two hundred years. The wise have enumerated the duration of Kali Yuga as extending over a thousand years.

units.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु संहाराः संहारान्तेषु संभवाः । न शक्यम् अन्तं तेषां वै वक्तुं वर्षशतैर् अपि ॥
units.english: Its Sandhyā and Sandhyāngsha too extend over one hundred years each. have thus described the extent of Yugas comprising twelve thousand years.

units.sanskrit: विसर्गस्य प्रजानां वै संहारस्य च भारत । मन्वन्तरेषु संहारः श्रूयते भरतर्षभ ॥ सशेषास् तत्र तिष्ठन्ति देवा ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह । तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन च समन्विताः । पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते ॥
units.english: The Ayana, that has been mentioned before, is two-fold, northern and southern –. When one Manu disappears his Ayana is completed, and then another reigns. In this way when many a Manu rise and disappear one Samvatsara of Brahmā is completed. His one Samvatsara has been described by the truth-observing ascetics as consisting of one million of years –. Brahmā's one day is said to be tantamount to one Kalpa.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणम् अग्रतः कृत्वा सहादित्यगणैर् विभो ॥ योगं योगीश्वरं देवम् अजं क्षेत्रजम् अच्युतम् । प्रविशन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम् । स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां कल्पान्तेषु पुनः पुनः । अव्यक्तः शाश्वतो देवस् तस्य सर्वम् इदं जगत् ॥
units.english: foremost of Bharatas, at the completion of that one thousand Yugas, Brahmā's one day is completed and the termination of a Kalpa is said to be brought about. Then scorched by the rays of the sun, all the creatures, placing the lord Brahmā before them, and accompanied by the Adityas, approached the omnipotent lord Nārāyana, the foremost of gods, ever engaged in Yoga, the master of Yogins, unborn, eternal, the soul of all, who repeatedly engenders all creatures at various Kalpas. He is the unseen and eternal God to whom belongs the whole universe –.

units.sanskrit: तत्र संवर्तते रात्रिः सकलैकार्णवे तदा । नारायणोदरे निद्रां ब्राह्मं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥
units.english: Then there sets in night when all are converted into one ocean. They all sleep in the belly of Nārāyana for one thousand years of Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: तावन्तम् इति कालं सा रात्रिर् इत्य् अभिशब्दिता । निद्रायोगम् अनुप्राप्तो यस्याम् अन्ते पितामहः ॥
units.english: That extent of time goes by the name of night when the Grandfather Brahmā enters upon the Yoga of sleep.

units.sanskrit: सा च रात्रिर् अपक्रान्ता सहस्रयुगपर्यया । तदा प्रबुद्धो भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । पुनः सिसृक्षया युक्तः सर्गाय विदधे मनः ॥
units.english: After the expiration of that night extending over a thousand Yugas awakes the Divine Brahmā, the Grand-father of all. Desirous of engendering progeny again he sets his mind on the work of creation.

units.sanskrit: सैव स्मृतिः पुराणेयं तद्वृत्तं तद्विचेष्टितम् । देवस्थानानि तान्य् एव केवलं च विपर्ययः ॥
units.english: There comes into existence the same ancient recollection, the same character, the same energy for action, the same abode for the gods, but only a change in order of things takes place.

units.sanskrit: ततो दग्धानि भूतानि सर्वाण्य् आदित्यरश्मिभिः । देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः । जायन्ते च पुनस् तात युगे भरतसत्तम ॥
units.english: foremost of Bharatas, then are born again at the commencement of Yuga, the celestials saints, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Pishāchas, serpents and Rakshas, that had before been consumed by the rays of the sun –.

units.sanskrit: यथर्ताव् ऋतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये । दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्य् एव तथा ब्राह्मीषु रात्रिषु ॥
units.english: As the signs of various seasons are changed with the change of cycles, so the various orders of creations are metamorphosed in Brahmā's night.

units.sanskrit: निष्क्रमित्वा प्रजाकारः प्रजापतिर् असंशयम् । ये च वै मानवा देवाः सर्वे चैव महर्षयः ॥ ते संगताः शुद्धसङ्गाः शश्वद् धर्मविसर्गतः । न भवन्ति पुनस् तात युगे भरतसत्तम ॥
units.english: Having come out of the lotus navel of Nārāyana Prajapati engages, for sooth, in the work of creation. my child, foremost of Bharatas, those gods, men and saints, who renouncing all attachment for the body, and being pure of mind, are united with Great Brahman, are never born in the next cycle –.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रयुगसंख्यानं कृत्वा दिवसम् ईश्वरः ॥ रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां कृत्वा च भगवान् विभुः । संहरत्य् अथ भूतानि सृजते च पुनः पुनः । व्यक्ताव्यक्तो महादेवो हरिर् नारायणः प्रभुः । अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि मनोर् वैवस्वतस्य ह । विसर्गं भरतश्रेष्ठ सांप्रतस्य महाद्युते ॥ वृष्णिवंशप्रसङ्गेन कथ्यमानं पुरातनम् । यत्रोत्पन्नो महात्मा स हरिर् वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः ॥ सर्वासुरविनाशाय सर्वलोकहिताय च । वैशंपायन उवाच विवस्वान् कश्यपाज् जज्ञे दाक्षायण्याम् अरिंदम । सुरेणुर् इति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु भामिनी ॥
units.english: Having divided his own day into a thousand Yugas cycles and his night into an equal number of cycles in due order, the Divine Brahmā, the ordainer of all, well-versed in the enumeration of time, creates and destroys the creatures again and again –. The Great God the Lord Nārāyana, Hari exists both in his subtle and gross form. shall relate the history of Manu Vaivaswata born of a portion of his energy. foremost of Bharatas, hear the ancient story of the highly effulgent Manu described incidentally along with the description of Vrishni race. Here the omnipotent, Great Lord, Hari was born for the destruction of all the demons and the behoof of all the worlds. Vaishampāyana said:— subduer of foes, Kaçyapa begat Vivaswan on Aditi, the daughter of Daksha. He espoused the goddess Sajnā. That beautiful damsel was celebrated over the three worlds by the name of Surenu.

units.sanskrit: सा वै भार्या भगवतो मार्तण्डस्य महात्मनः । भर्तृरूपेण नातुष्यद् रूपयौवनशालिनी । गात्रेषु परिदग्धं वै नातिकान्तम् इवाभवत् ॥ न खल्व् अयं मृतो ऽण्डस्थ इति स्नेहाद् अभाषत । अजानन् काश्यपस् तस्मान् मार्तण्ड इति चोच्यते ॥
units.english: The wife, of that high-souled, divine Mārtanda sun gifted with beauty and youth as she was was, not satisfied with the beauty of her husband. Amongst females on this earth Sajnā was gifted with great ascetic powers. Having her body scorched by the rays of the sun she did not look beautiful -. Kaçyapa affectionately said to Aditi who was ignorant your embryo is not dead and so he is called Mārtanda.

units.sanskrit: तेजस् त्व् अभ्यधिकं तात नित्यम् एव विवस्वतः । येनातितापयामास त्रींल् लोकान् कश्यपात्मजः ॥
units.english: The rays of the sun are always very powerful, my child, and the son of Kaçyapa oppresses the three worlds therewith.

units.sanskrit: त्रीण्य् अपत्यानि कौरव्य संज्ञायां तपतां वरः । आदित्यो जनयामास कन्यां द्वौ च प्रजापती ॥
units.english: foremost of Kouravas, that best of luminous bodies, Aditya begat on Sajna three children, one daughter and two sons who became patriarchs.

units.sanskrit: मनुर् वैवस्वतः पूर्वं श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः । यमश् च यमुना चैव यमजौ संबभूवतुः ॥
units.english: First was born Manu Vaivaswata and then the patriarch Srāddhadeva, then Yama and Yamunā were born as twins.

units.sanskrit: श्यामवर्णं तु तद्रूपं संज्ञा दृष्ट्वा विवस्वतः । असहन्ती तु स्वां छायां सवर्णां निर्ममे ततः । मायामयी तु सा संज्ञा तस्याश् छाया समुत्थिता ॥ प्राञ्जलिः प्रणता भूत्वा छाया संज्ञां नरेश्वर । उवाच किं मया कार्यं कथयस्व शुचिस्मिते । स्थितास्मि तव निर्देशे शाधि मां वरवर्णिनि ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding the pale countenance of Vivaswān and unable to bear her own form she created Savarnā out of her own shadow. Sajnā was an adept in illusion and so, king, her shadow at once sprang up and bowing with folded hands said to her. She said:— thou of pure smiles, tell me what am to do. Command me, fair one, am at your service .

units.sanskrit: संज्ञोवाच अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते स्वम् एव भवनं पितुः । त्वयेह भवने मह्यं वस्तव्यं निर्विशङ्कया ॥
units.english: Sajna said:—May good betide you, shall now go to my father's house. Do you now live in this my house without any anxiety.

units.sanskrit: इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं कन्या चेयं सुमध्यमा । संभाव्यास् ते न चाख्येयम् इदं भगवते त्वया ॥
units.english: You should look after these my boys and my youthful daughter. Never give out this secret to the Divine Sun .

units.sanskrit: आ कचग्रहणाद् देवि आ शापान् नैव कर्हिचित् । आख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गच्छ देवि यथासुखम् ॥
units.english: The shadow said:— shall not give out your secret so long the sun does not hold me by the hair or imprecate a curse on me. Go now at your pleasure, goddess .

units.sanskrit: समाधाय सवर्णां तु तथेत्य् उक्ता तया च सा । त्वष्टुः समीपम् अगमद् व्रीडितेव मनस्विनी ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having said carefully so be it. to Sarvanā, the ascetic Sajnā went to Twasta as if in shame.

units.sanskrit: निनिन्द बहुधात्मानं स्त्रीत्वं चातिनिनिन्द सा ॥
units.english: When she met her father he remonstrated with her repeatedly and asked her to go to her husband again.

units.sanskrit: अगच्छद् वडवा भूत्वाच् छाद्य रूपम् अनिन्दिता । कुरून् अथोत्तरान् गत्वा तृणान्य् एव चचार सा ॥
units.english: Then hiding her beauty and assuming the form of a mare, that faultless damsel repaired to the province of Uttarakuru and began to graze there.

units.sanskrit: आदित्यो जनयामास पुत्रम् आत्मसमं तदा ॥
units.english: Then taking the second Sajna for the real one, Aditya begat a son on her after his own self.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वजस्य मनोस् तात सदृशो ऽयम् इति प्रभुः । मनुर् एवाभवन् नाम्ना सावर्ण इति चोच्यते ॥
units.english: This lord was like the first-born Manu and people designate him as Manu Sāvarni. He became Manu Sāvarni.

units.sanskrit: संज्ञा तु पार्थिवी तात स्वस्य पुत्रस्य वै तदा । चकाराभ्यधिकं स्नेहं न तथा पूर्वजेषु वै ॥
units.english: Her second son was known by the name of Sani. child, the immitation Sajnā did not show that affection towards the first-born children which she did towards her own son.

units.sanskrit: मनुस् तस्याः क्षमत् तत् तु यमस् तस्या न चक्षमे । तां वै रोषाच् च बाल्याच् च भाविनो ऽर्थस्य वा बलात् । पदा संतर्जयामास संज्ञां वैवस्वतो यमः ॥
units.english: Manu forgave her for that but Yama could not do so. Out of childishness, anger and future glory, Vivaswata's son Yama threatened Sajnā with a stroke of his foot.

units.sanskrit: तं शशाप ततः क्रोधात् सवर्णा जननी तदा । चरणः पतताम् एष तवेति भृशदुःखिता ॥
units.english: king, greatly stricken with sorrow Sāvarni's mother accordingly cursed him in anger, saying your foot shall drop.

units.sanskrit: यमस् तु तत् पितुः सर्वं प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्यवेदयत् । भृशं शापभयोद्विग्नः संज्ञावाक्यैर् विवेजितः । शापो निवर्तेद् इति च प्रोवाच पितरं तदा ॥
units.english: Then worked up with anxiety on account of the imprecation and assailed by Sajnā’s words, Yama, with folded hands, communicated everything unto his sire. He said to his father:—Do thou so arrange as to withdraw the curse.

units.sanskrit: मात्रा स्नेहेन सर्वेषु वर्तितव्यं सुतेषु वै । सेयम् अस्मान् अपाहाय यवीयांसं बुभूषति ॥
units.english: It is the duty of a mother to show affection equally towards all her sons. Disregarding us she always loves the youngest son.

units.sanskrit: तस्या मयोद्यतः पादो न तु देहे निपातितः । बाल्याद् वा यदि वा मोहात् तद् भवान् क्षन्तुम् अर्हति ॥ यस्मात् ते पूजनीयाहं तर्जितास्मि त्वया सुत । अपत्यं दुरपत्यं स्यान् नाम्बा कुजननी भवेत् । शप्तो ऽहम् अस्मि लोकेश जनन्या तपतां वर । तव प्रसादाच् चरणो न पतेन् मम गोपते ॥
units.english: So did lift up my foot but it did not fall on her body. You should forgive me for the offence that have committed out of childishness or ignorance; since have insulted her, being a son, who is worthy of my respect, forsooth shall my foot drop off. son may prove a bad son, but never does the mother. foremost of luminous bodies, lord of the worked, have been cursed by my mother. Let not my foot drop by your favour -.

units.sanskrit: असंशयं पुत्र महद् भविष्यत्य् अत्र कारणम् । यस् त्वं धर्मपरो नित्यं धर्मं संत्यक्तवान् इमम् । न शक्यम् एतन् मिथ्या तु कर्तुं मातृवचस् तव । कृमयो मांसम् आदाय यास्यन्ति तु महीतले ॥ तव पादान् महाप्राज्ञ ततः संप्राप्स्यसे सुखम् । कृतम् एवं वचस् तथ्यं मातुस् तव भविष्यति । शापस्य परिहारेण त्वं च त्रातो भविष्यसि ॥
units.english: Vivaswat said:—Undoubtedly, my son, there must be a mighty cause for it, since anger has possessed you who are truthful and pious. shall not be able to make otherwise your mother's words; taking flesh from your foot the worms shall fall on the surface at the earth, highly wise one, and you will, accordingly attain to happiness. This being done the words of your mother shall prove true –. And you will also be saved from the effect of the imprecation.

units.sanskrit: आदित्यश् चाब्रवीत् संज्ञां किमर्थं तनयेषु वै । तुल्येष्व् अभ्यधिकः स्नेहः क्रियते ऽति पुनः पुनः । सा तत् परिहरन्ती स्म नाचचक्षे विवस्वतः ॥
units.english: Aditya then said to Sajnā:—Equal affection should be shown towards all children. Why are you then again and again showing partiality towards one? In order to evade it she made no reply to the sun –.

units.sanskrit: आत्मानं स समाधाय योगात् तथ्यम् अपश्यत । तां शप्तुकामो भगवान् नाशाय कुरुनन्दन । मूर्धजेषु च जग्राह समये ऽतिगते तु सा । ततः सर्वं यथावृत्तम् आचचक्षे विवस्वतः । विवस्वान् अथ तच् छ्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस् त्वष्टारम् अभ्यगात् ॥
units.english: Then having concentrated his own self by virtue of Yoga, he found out the truth. descendant of Kuru, then to imprecate a curse of destruction on her the lord sun held her by the hair. The terms of contract being thus transgressed she communicated the truth unto Vivaswān -. Hearing all Vivaswān got enraged and approached Twasta.

units.sanskrit: निर्दग्धुकामं रोषेण सान्त्वयामास वै तदा ॥
units.english: He too, having eulogized him the sun properly who was bent upon consuming him, pacified his anger.

units.sanskrit: त्वष्टोवाच तवातितेजसाविष्टम् इदं रूपं न शोभते । असहन्ती स्म तत् संज्ञा वने चरति शाड्वलम् ॥ द्रष्टा हि तां भवान् अद्य स्वां भार्यां शुभचारिणीम् । पर्णाहारां कृशां दीनां जटिलां मलधारिणीम् । हस्तिहस्तपरिक्लिष्टां व्याकुलां पद्मिनीम् इव । श्लाघ्यां योगबलोपेतां योगम् आस्थाय गोपते ॥ अनुकूलं तु ते देव यदि स्यान् मम तन् मतम् । रूपं निर्वर्तयाम्य् अद्य तव कान्तम् अरिंदम ॥
units.english: Twasta said:—This your highly effulgent form does not look graceful. Unable to bear your lustre Sajnā is wandering in the yellow forest. To-day will you behold your wife of pure conduct, who is daily engaged in hard austerities under the guise of a mare. Living on leaves, and a life of a female anchorite, she has grown emaciated and poorly; her hairs have grown into matted locks and she has been agitated like a lotus crushed by the trunk of an elephant. lord of rays, if you accept my view, may, for that praiseworthy damsel endued with ascetic power, resorting to Yoga, king of gods, convert this form of yours into a beautiful one, slayer of enemies –.

units.sanskrit: रूपं विवस्वतश् चासीत् तिर्यगूर्ध्वसमं तु वै । तेनासौ संभृतो देवो रूपेण तु विभावसुः ॥
units.english: The rays of the sun were crooked and extended above. Gifted with such a celestial form the sun was not of a gentle look.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वष्टुः स वै वाक्यं बहु मेने प्रजापतिः । समनुज्ञातवांश् चैव त्वष्टारं रूपसिद्धये । ततो ऽभ्युपगमात् त्वष्टा मार्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः । भ्रमिम् आरोप्य तत् तेजः शातयामास भारत ॥
units.english: So the Patriarch sun attached great importance to Twasta's words and gave order to the celestial Architect for beautifying his own form. Thereupon Twasta approached the effulgent Mārtanda. And then placing him on a chisel, descendant of Bharata, he cut lose his lustre.

units.sanskrit: तत् सर्वं तेजसा तेन विश्वकर्मा ह्य् अकल्पयत् । ततो निर्भासितं रूपं तेजसा संहृतेन वै । ततःप्रभृति देवस्य मुखम् आसीत् तु लोहितम् ॥ आदित्या द्वादशैवेह संभूता मुखसंभवाः ॥ धातार्यमा च मित्रश् च वरुणो ऽंशो भगस् तथा । इन्द्रो विवस्वान् पूषा च पर्जन्यो दशमस् तथा । ततस् त्वष्टा ततो विष्णुर् अजघन्यो जघन्यजः ॥
units.english: When his effulgence was thus reduced and he appeared in his new form he looked superbly beautiful and more than it. The beautiful form of that lord of rays was thus easily formed. Since then the countenance of the deity, sun, is red. The twelve Adityas, originated from his mouth, sprang from the portions of his effulgence dropped from the countenance of Mārtanda when the act of chiselling was performed; they were Dhāta, Aryamā, Mitra, Varuna, Angsha, Bhaga, Indra, Vivaswan, Pusha, the tenth Parjanya, the eleventh Twasta and the youngest Vishnu -.

units.sanskrit: हर्षं लेभे ततो देवो दृष्ट्वादित्यान् स्वदेहजान् । गन्धैः पुष्पैर् अलंकारैर् भास्वता मुकुटेन च ॥ एवं संपूजयामास त्वष्टा वाक्यम् उवाच ह ॥ गच्छ देवेश स्वां भार्यां कुरूंश् चरति चोत्तरान् । ददर्श योगम् आस्थाय स्वां भार्यां वडवां ततः । अधृष्यां सर्वभूतानां तेजसा नियमेन च ॥ वडवावपुषा राजंश् चरन्तीम् अकुतोभयाम् । सो ऽश्वरूपेण भगवांस् तां मुखे समभावयत् । देवौ तस्याम् अजायेताम् अश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ ॥ नासत्यश् चैव दस्रश् च स्मृतौ द्वाव् अश्विनाव् इति । मार्तण्डस्यात्मजाव् एताव् अष्टमस्य प्रजापतेः ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding the Adityas begotten of his own body he attained delight. Then Twasta worshipped him with scents, flowers, ornaments and a brilliant crown and said to him:— god, go to your own wife in Uttarakuru, who, assuming the form of a mare, is grazing in the forest of green grass. Thereupon assuming sportively a similar form, he, by virtue of his Yoga power, espied his own wife in the form of a mare. king, assuming the form of a mare she was fearlessly wandering there and no one could distress her on account of her energy and pious observances. Then the powerful sun, in his horse form, knew her by his mouth –. Taking him for another man the mare did not yeild to his desire. Then from his nostril the two Aswinis, the foremost of the physicians, were born. They were the sons of the eighth Patriarch Mārtanda.

units.sanskrit: संज्ञायां जनयामास वडवायां स भारत । तां तु रूपेण क्रान्तेन दर्शयामास भास्करः । सा तु दृष्ट्वैव भर्तारं तुतोष जनमेजय ॥
units.english: Aditya begat the two Aswinis on Sajnā in the guise of a mare and he then appeared before his wife in his beautiful form –. Janamejaya, beholding her husband she Sajnā was greatly delighted.

units.sanskrit: यमस् तु कर्मणा तेन भृशं पीडितमानसः । धर्मेण रञ्जयामास धर्मराज इमाः प्रजाः ॥ स लेभे कर्मणा तेन शुभेन परमद्युतिः । भाव्यः सो ऽनागते तस्मिन् मनुः सावर्णिके ऽन्तरे ॥ मेरुपृष्ठे तपो नित्यम् अद्यापि स चरत्य् उत । भ्राता शनैश्चरश् चास्य ग्रहत्वं स तु लब्धवान् ॥ नासत्यौ यौ समाख्यातौ स्वर्वैद्यौ तु बभूवतुः । रेवन्तो ऽपि तथा राजन्न् अश्वानां शान्तिदो ऽभवत् । त्वष्टा तु तेजसा तेन विष्णोश् चक्रम् अकल्पयत् । तद् अप्रतिहतं युद्धे दानवान्तचिकीर्षया ॥
units.english: Yama, greatly sorry at heart on account of his own mis-deed, began to please his subjects with his pious rule and he was accordingly called Dharmarāj. By his holy act of pleasing his subjects he was appointed the regent of the ancestral manes and elevated to the dignity of a patriarch. The ascetic Sāvarni Manu was a patriarch and in the future Savarni Manwantara he will be the Manu. The all-powerful Manu, even now, is carrying on penances on the summit of the mount Meru -. His brother Shanischara has attained to the status of a planet. Those, who were known as Aswinis, became the physicians of the celestial region. king, Sevata too became the physician of the horses. Twasta, with that effulgence, created the discus of Vishnu. With a view to destroy the Dānavas that discus is never baffled in a warfare.

units.sanskrit: यवीयसी तयोर् या तु यमी कन्या यशस्विनी । अभवत् सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यमुना लोकभावनी ॥
units.english: Their illustrious twin sister Yamunā became the foremost of rivers of that name purifying the world.

units.sanskrit: मनुर् इत्य् उच्यते लोके सावर्ण इति चोच्यते । ग्रहत्वं स तु लेभे वै सर्वलोकानुपूजितम् । य इदं जन्म देवानां शृणुयाद् धारयेत वा । आपदं प्राप्य मुच्येत प्राप्नुयाच् च महद् यशः ॥
units.english: Manu was known as Sāvarni Manu in the world -. His second son, Manu's brother Sanischara attained to the status of a planet, worshipped of all the worlds. He, who listens to this story of the birth of gods or meditates on it, is freed from all calamities and attains great renown.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच मनोर् वैवस्वतस्यासन् पुत्रा वै नव तत्समाः । इक्ष्वाकुश् चैव नाभागश् च धृष्णुः शर्यातिर् एव च ॥ करूषश् च पृषध्रश् च नवैते पुरुषर्षभ ॥ अकरोत् पुत्रकामस् तु मनुर् इष्टिं प्रजापतिः । मित्रावरुणयोस् तात पूर्वम् एव विशां पते । अनुत्पन्नेषु नवसु पुत्रेष्व् एतेषु भारत ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— foremost of Bharatas, Vivaswata Manu had nine sons after him—Ikshwāku, Nābhaga, Dhrishnu, Sharyāti, Narishyan, Prangsha, Nābhagarishtha, Korusha and Prishadhra –. king, desirous of progeny the patriarch Manu performed a sacrifice before Mitra and Varuna. descendant of Bharata, before the birth of these nine sons of his, Muni offered oblation to the portions of Mitra and Varuna in the present sacrifice.

units.sanskrit: आहुत्यां हूयमानायां देवगन्धर्वमानुषाः । तुष्टिं तु परमां जग्मुर् मुनयश् च तपोधनाः । अहो ऽस्य तपसो वीर्यम् अहो श्रुतम् अहो धनम् । तत्र दिव्याम्बरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता । दिव्यसंहनना चैव इडा जज्ञ इति श्रुतिः ॥
units.english: When this oblation was offered, the gods, Gandharvas, men and ascetics attained to great delight and exclaimed. Oh! wonderful is his ascetic energy! Oh! Wonderful is his knowledge of scriptures –. The tradition is, that in that sacrifice was born Ilā, clad in a celestial raiment, adorned with celestial ornaments and equipped with a celestial armour.

units.sanskrit: ताम् इडेत्य् एव होवाच मनुर् दण्डधरस् तदा । अनुगच्छस्व मां भद्रे तम् इडा प्रत्युवाच ह ॥
units.english: Manu, with a rod of chastisement in his hand, said to her: Follow me, fair one.

units.sanskrit: धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं पुत्रकामं प्रजापतिम् । मित्रावरुणयोर् अंशे जातास्मि वदतां वर । तयोः सकाशं यास्यामि न मां धर्मो हतो ऽहनत् ॥
units.english: She gave the following moral reply to that Patriarch desirous of offspring. Ilā said:— best of speakers, am born of the energy of Mitra and Varuna and so shall go to them. Do not destroy my morality.

units.sanskrit: सैवम् उक्त्वा मनुं देवं मित्रावरुणयोर् इडा । गत्वान्तिकं वरारोहा प्राञ्जलिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । अंशे ऽस्मि युवयोर् जाता देवौ किं करवाणि वाम् ॥ मित्रश् च वरुणश् चोभाव् ऊचतुर् यन् निबोध तत् ॥ अनेन तव धर्मेण प्रश्रयेण दमेन च । सत्येन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतौ स्वो वरवर्णिनि ॥ मनोर् वंशकरः पुत्रस् त्वम् एव च भविष्यसि ॥ सुद्युम्न इति विख्यातस् त्रिषु लोकेषु शोभने । जगत्प्रियो धर्मशीलो मनोर् वंशविवर्धनः ॥
units.english: Having said this to Manu Ilā approached Mitra and Varuna and that fair one with folded hands said to them, am born of your energy; Manu has asked me to follow him. Tell me what shall do -. Hear from me what Mitra and Varuna did say to the pious and chaste Ilā who had addressed them thus. you fair one of beautiful hips, we have been pleased with your virtue, humility, self restraint and truthfulness. Therefore great lady, you will be celebrated as our daughter, fair one, you will be the son of Manu, perpetuating his race, celebrated in the three worlds by the name of Sudyumna. You will be pious, beloved of the world and multiply the race of Manu –.

units.sanskrit: निवृत्ता सा तु तच् छ्रुत्वा गच्छन्ती पितुर् अन्तिकाम् । बुधेनान्तरम् आसाद्य मैथुनायोपवर्तिता ॥
units.english: While she, on hearing this, was about to return to her father Manu, she was invited, on the way, by Buddha, for conjugal purposes.

units.sanskrit: सोमपुत्राद् बुधाद् राजंस् तस्यां जज्ञे पुरूरवाः । जनयित्वा ततः सा तम् इडा सुद्युम्नतां गता ॥
units.english: Then Soma's son Buddha begat on her Pururava. Having given birth to that son Ilā became Pradyumna.

units.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नस्य तु दायादास् त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः । उत्कलश् च गयश् चैव विनताश्वश् च भारत ॥ उत्कलस्योत्तरा राजन् विनताश्वस्य पश्चिमा । दशधा तद्गतं क्षत्रम् अकरोत् पृथिवीम् इमाम् ॥ यूपाङ्किता वसुमती यस्येयं सवनाकरा । इक्ष्वाकुर् ज्येष्ठदायादो मध्यदेशम् अवाप्तवान् । कन्याभावाच् च सुद्युम्नो नैनं गुणम् अवाप्तवान् ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, the three kinsmen of Sudyumna-Uutkala, Gaya and the energetic Vinatashwa were greatly pious, king, the northern quarter was under Utkala, the western under Vinatashwa and the city Gayā was under Gaya. subduer of foes, Manu having entered the sun, his sons divided the earth into ten parts. The eldest of them Ikshwaku obtained the central portion by whose sacrificial stakes the earth, with her forests and mines, has been marked. On account of his partaking of the nature of a female Sudyumna did not obtain this central region.

units.sanskrit: वसिष्ठवचनाच् चासीत् प्रतिष्ठानं महात्मनः । प्रतिष्ठा धर्मराजस्य सुद्युम्नस्य कुरूद्वह ॥ तत् पुरूरवसे प्रादाद् राज्यं प्राप्य महायशाः । धृष्णुकश् चाम्बरीषश् च दण्डश् चेतीह ते त्रयः । यश् चकार महात्मा वै दण्डकारण्यम् उत्तमम् ॥ वनं तल् लोकविख्यातं तापसानाम् अनुत्तमम् । तत्र प्रविष्टमात्रस् तु नरः पापात् प्रमुच्यते ॥
units.english: According to the words of Vasishtha, the high-souled pious king Sudyumna was installed in the province of Pratishtāna. foremost of Kurus. Having obtained that kingdom the highly illustrious Sudyumna conferred it on Pururava and he himself reigned in Partishtana. Utkala had three sons celebrated in the three worlds Dhristaka, Amvarisha and Danda -. Amongst them the noble Danda founded the most excellent Dandakāranya the forest of Danda celebrated in the world as the abode of the ascetics. As soon as a man enters there he is freed from sins.

units.sanskrit: धृतवांस् तम् इडेत्य् एवं सुद्युम्नश् चेतिविश्रुतः । पृषध्रो हिवद्धित्वा तु गुरोर् गां जनमेजय । शापाच् छूद्रत्वम् आपन्नः पुत्रस् तस्य महात्मनः । नारिष्यन्ताः शकाः पुत्रा नाभागस्य तु भारत । अम्बरीषो ऽभवत् पुत्रः पार्थिवर्षभसत्तम ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, having begotten Aila, Sudyumna repaired to heaven, monarch, that son of Manu, who was endowed with the characteristics of both a man and woman, and who took the name of Ilā, was celebrated by the name of Sudyumna. descendant of Bharata, Shakas were the sons of Narishwanta, and Amvarisha, the foremost of kings, was the son of Nābhāga.

units.sanskrit: धृष्णोस् तु धार्ष्णिकं क्षत्रं रणदृष्टं बभूव ह । करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः । सहस्रं क्षत्रियगणो विक्रान्तः संबभूव ह ॥
units.english: Dhrishnu's son Dharshtaka and Ranadhrishta became known as Kshatra. And Karusha's sons were the Kshatrya Kārushas, dreadful in battle. In this way a thousand mighty powerful Kshatryas were born, descendant of Bharata.

units.sanskrit: नाभागारिष्टपुत्राश् च क्षत्रिया वैश्यतां गताः ॥
units.english: The sons of Nābhāgarishtha, although Kshatryas by birth, came by the status of Vaishyas.

units.sanskrit: प्रांशोर् एको ऽभवत् पुत्रः प्रजापतिर् इति श्रुतः । नरिष्यन्तस्य दायादो राजा दण्डधरो दमः । शर्यातेर् मिथुनं चासीद् आनर्तो नाम विश्रुतः । पुत्रः कन्या सुकन्या च या पत्नी च्यवनस्य ह ॥
units.english: Prāngshu had one son celebrated by the name of Sharyati. Narishwanta's son was the powerful Danda. Saryāti had a twin son and daughter. The son was named Anartta and the daughter Sukanya became the wife of Chyavana.

units.sanskrit: आनर्तस्य तु दायादो रेवो नाम महाद्युतिः । आनर्तविषयश् चासीत् पुरी चासीत् कुशस्थली ॥
units.english: Anartta's successor was the highly effulgent Reva –. His city Kusasthali was in the province of Anartta.

units.sanskrit: रेवस्य रैवतः पुत्रः ककुद्मी नाम धार्मिकः । ज्येष्ठः पुत्रशतस्यासीद् राज्यं प्राप्य कुशस्थलीम् ॥
units.english: Reva's son Raivata passed by the name of Kukudmi and was pious. Having obtained the kingdom of Kusasthali he became the father of a hundred sons.

units.sanskrit: स कन्यासहितः श्रुत्वा गान्धर्वं ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तिके । मुहूर्तभूतं देवस्य मर्त्यं बहुयुगं प्रभो ॥
units.english: He, along with his daughter, received from Brahmā instructions in music. And lord, many a Yuga passed away to him like a moment.

units.sanskrit: आजगाम युवैवाथ स्वां पुरीं यादवैर् वृताम् । कृतां द्वारवतीं नाम्ना बहुद्वारां मनोरमाम् । भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकैर् गुप्तां वासुदेवपुरोगमैः ॥
units.english: He then, in his youthful state, returned to his own city filled with Yādavas –. The city of Dwaravati, charming with many damsels, was protected by the descendants of Bhoja and Vrishni races headed by Vasudeva.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तद् रैवतो ज्ञात्वा यथातत्त्वम् अरिंदम । कन्यां तां बलदेवाय सुव्रतां नाम रेवतीम् ॥ दत्त्वा जगाम शिखरं मेरोस् तपसि संश्रितः । रेमे रामो ऽपि धर्मात्मा रेवत्या सहितः सुखी ॥
units.english: slayer of foes, then informed of all these details Raivata conferred upon Baladeva that vow-observing maiden by name Revati. Having given away his daughter he repaired to the summit of the mount Sumeru for carrying on hard austerities. Rāma too lived happily in the company of Revati.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच कथं बहुयुगे काले समतीते द्विजर्षभ । न जरा रेवतीं प्राप्ता रैवतं च ककुद्मिनम् ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— foremost of the twice-born, why were not Revati and Revata's son Kukudmi, visited by decrepitude although they lived for many years.

units.sanskrit: मेरुं गतस्य वा तस्य शार्यातेः संततिः कथम् । स्थिता पृथिव्याम् अद्यापि श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
units.english: Why does Saryāti's grandson, even after his retirement to Meru, still live in this world? wish to hear all this in sooth.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच न जरा क्षुत्पिपासे वा न मृत्युर् भरतर्षभ । ककुद्मिनस् तु तं लोकं रैवतस्य गतस्य ह । हता पुण्यजनैस् तात राक्षसैः सा कुशस्थली ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— sinless one, foremost of Bharatas, there is neither decrepitude, hunger, thirst, death, nor the change of seasons in the region of Brahmā. After the departure of Revata's son Kukudmi, his city Kushasthali was destroyed by demons and goblins.

units.sanskrit: तस्य भ्रातृशतं त्व् आसीद् धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः । तद् वध्यमानं रक्षोभिर् दिशः प्राक्रमद् अच्युता ॥
units.english: That high-souled and pious king had a hundred brothers. When the Rākshasas began to carry on the work of destruction they fled away in various directions.

units.sanskrit: विद्रुतस्यच राजेन्द्र तस्य भ्रातृशतस्य वै । तेषां तु ते भयाक्रान्तः क्षत्रियास् तत्र तत्र ह । क्षत्रिया भरतश्रेष्ठ दिक्षु सर्वासु धार्मिकाः । सर्वशः सर्वगहनं प्रविष्टाः कुरुनन्दन ॥
units.english: king of kings, when after their escape all the hundred brothers settled in various parts the Kshatriyas thereof were stricken with fear, king, their families extended to all those countries and are known as Sharyātas. foremost of Bharatas, in all the quarters those pious Kshatriyas reside; descendant of Kurus, amongst them many entered into mountainous regions.

units.sanskrit: नाभागस्य तु पुत्रौ द्वौ वैश्यौ ब्राह्मणतां गतौ । करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥
units.english: The two sons of Nabhāgāristha, although born of a Vaishya mother, attained to the status of a Brāhmana. The sons of Karusha, Kshatriyas dreadful in battle, passed by the name of Kārushas.

units.sanskrit: प्रांशोर् एको ऽभवत् पुत्रः प्रजापतिरिति श्रुतः । पृषध्रो हिंसयित्वा तु गुरोर् गां जनमेजय । शापाच् छूद्रत्वम् आपन्नो नवैते परिकीर्तिताः ॥ वैवस्वतस्य तनया मनोर् वैभरतर्षभ । क्षुवतस् तु मनोस् तात इक्ष्वाकुर् अभवत् सुतः । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्व् आसीद् इक्ष्वाकोर् भूरिदक्षिणम् ॥
units.english: Only one son of Prāngshu is mentioned by the name of Prajapati. Janamejaya, having killed the cow of his preceptor, Prishata is said to have come by the birth of a Sudra. fore most of Bhāratas, have thus given an account of the nine sons of Manu Vaivaswata –. When Manu sneezed there came out from his nostril a son by name Ikshāwku. He had a hundred sons who gave away profuse gifts.

units.sanskrit: तेषां विकुक्षिर् ज्येष्ठस् तु विकुक्षित्वाद् अयोधताम् । प्राप्तः परमधर्मज्ञ सो ऽयोध्याधिपतिः प्रभुः ॥
units.english: The eldest of them Vikukshi, on account of his huge abdomen, could not make a warrior and so that pious king reigned as the lord of Ayodhya.

units.sanskrit: शकुनिप्रमुखास् तस्य पुत्राः पञ्चशतं स्मृताः । उत्तरापथदेशस्य रक्षितारो विशां पते ॥ चत्वारिंशद् अथास्टौ च दक्षिणस्यां तथा दिशि । इक्ष्वाकुस् तु विकुक्षिं वै अष्टकायाम् अथादिशत् । मांसम् आनय श्राद्धार्थं मृगान् हत्वा महाबल । श्राद्धकर्मणि चोद्दिष्टे अकृते श्राद्धकर्मणि । भक्षयित्वा शशं तात शशादो मृगयां गतः ॥
units.english: He had fifty excellent sons headed by Sakuni. They all reigned, king, protecting the province of Uttarapatha. king, thirty-eight sons headed by Shashāda protected the southern quarter. On an Ashtaka day Ikshwāku commanded Vikukshi by saying you of great strength, do you bring meat for the Srāddha after killing deer. Having taken the meat of a hare before the performance of the Srāddha for which it was collected he returned from hunting with the name of Shashāda.

units.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुणा परित्यक्तो वसिष्ठवचनात् प्रभुः । इक्ष्वाकौ संस्थिते तात शशादः पुरम् आवसत् ॥
units.english: He was forsaken by Ikshwāku at the words of Vashishtha. After the demise of Ikshwāku Shashāda began to live in the city of Ayodhya.

units.sanskrit: अयोधस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान् । इन्द्रस्य वृषभूतस्य ककुत्स्थो ऽजयतासुरान् । अनेनास् तु ककुत्स्थस्य पृथुर् आनेनसः स्मृतः ॥
units.english: Shashāda's son was the powerful Kakutstha. Seated on the hump of Indra in the guise of a bull he defeated the Asuras in the days of yore in battle and accordingly he was called Kakutstha. Kakustha's son was Anenā and his son was Prithu –.

units.sanskrit: विष्टराश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस् तस्माद् आर्द्रस् त्व् अजायत । आर्द्रस्य युवनाश्वस् तु श्रावस्तस् तस्य चात्मजस् ॥
units.english: Prithu's son was Vishtarāshwa and from him was born Adra. Adra’s son was Yuvanāshwa and his son was Shrāva.

units.sanskrit: जज्ञे श्रावस्तको राजा श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता । श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महीपतिः ॥
units.english: The king Shrāva made a city by the name of Shrāvasti. And his son was highly illustrious Vrihadāshwa.

units.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वः सुतस् तस्य ट्राजा परमधार्मिकः । यः स धुन्धुवधाद् राजा धुन्धुमारत्वम् आगतः ॥
units.english: His son was the highly pious king Kuvalashwa, who, by killing the demon Dhundhu, came by the name of king Dhundhumāra.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच धुन्धोर् वधम् अहं ब्रह्मञ् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः । वैशंपायन उवाच बृहदश्वस्य पुत्राणां शतम् उत्तमधन्विनाम् । सर्वे विद्यासु निष्णाता बलवन्तो दुरासदाः । बभूवाथ पिता राज्ये कुवलाश्वं न्ययोजयत् ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— Brahman, wish to hear the true account of the destruction of Dhundhu for which Kuvalashwa came by the name of Dhundhumāra. Vaishampāyana said:—Kuvalāshwa had a hundred sons all skillful archers; they were all well-educated, powerful irrepressible and pious and performed sacrifices and gave away profuse gifts. Kuvalāshwa installed his son Vrihadāshwa in the kingdom –.

units.sanskrit: पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस् तु वनं राजा समाविशत् । उत्तङ्क उवाच भवता रक्षणं कार्यं तत् तावत् कर्तुम् अर्हसि । निरुद्विग्नस् तपश् चर्तुं न हि शक्नोमि पार्थिव ॥
units.english: Having made over the charge of his kingdom to his son he repaired to the forest. But the saint Uttanka prevented him from doing that. He said:— king, it behoves you to protect your subjects; you should not carry on penances, relieved of all anxiety for the state.

units.sanskrit: त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन् रक्ष्यमाणामहात्मना । भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: king, high-souled as you are, the earth should be protected by you. Setting aside all cares you should not enter into woods.

units.sanskrit: ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र धर्मः क्व चन दृश्यते । प्रजानां पालने यो वै पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः । रक्षितव्याः प्रजा राज्ञा तास् त्वं रक्षितुम् अर्हसि । ममाश्रमसमीपे वै समेषु मरुधन्वसु । समुद्रो वालुकापूर्ण उज्जानक इति स्मृतः ॥
units.english: It is seen that great virtue consists in protecting the subjects, but not so, in repairing to the forest Such is upheld to be the duty of a king and even the former saintly kings used to protect their subjects. Therefore, you should look after your subjects. On the even ground near my hermitage, all desert and with little water, there is a tract full of the sands of the ocean called Ujjānaka.

units.sanskrit: देवतानाम् अवध्यश् च महाकायो महाबलः । अन्तर्भूमिगतस् तत्र वालुकान्तर्हितो महान् ॥
units.english: There entered into the ground full of sand a huge-bodied and highly powerful demon whom it was beyond the power of the gods even to destroy.

units.sanskrit: राक्षसस्य मधोः पुत्रो धुन्धुर् नाम सुदारुणः । शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम् ॥ संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते स निःश्वासं विमुञ्चति । आदित्यपथम् आवृत्य सप्ताहं भूमिकम्पनम् ॥ सविस्फुलिङ्गं साङ्गारं सधूमम् अतिदारुणम् । तेन तात न शक्नोमि तस्मिन् स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे ॥
units.english: That son of the Rakshasa, Madhu, also passed by the name of the huge Asura, Dhundhu. Resorting to dreadful penances, he is lying there for the destruction of men -. When he breathes after the expiration of a year the earth trembles with her mountains, forest and wood. The heavy dust, raised by his breath, obstructs the path of the sun—the earth-quake continues for one week—and there comes out smoke with scintillations of fire and cinders. At that time, my child, cannot live at my hermitage -.

units.sanskrit: तं वारय महाकायं लोकानां हितकाम्यया । लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्व् अद्य तस्मिन् विनिहते त्वया ॥
units.english: Therefore, for the behoof of mankind, do you slay that huge-bodied demon. On the destruction of that demon people will be at ease.

units.sanskrit: त्वं हि तस्य वधायैकः समर्थः पृथिवीपते । विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मह्यं पूर्वं ततो ऽनध । यस् तं महासुरंरौद्रं हनिष्यति महाबलम् । न हि धुन्धुर् महातेजास् तेजसाल्पेन शक्यते । निर्दग्धुं पृथिवीपाल चिरं युगशतैर् अपि । वीर्यं हि सुमहत् तस्य देवैर् अपि दुरासदम् ॥
units.english: king, you alone are competent to kill him. sinless one, in the previous Yuga Vishnu conferred a boon on me. You will welcome his energy with a boon who will kill that dreadful and highly powerful great Asura. king, even in a hundred celestial years trifling energy cannot consume that highly powerful Dhundhu. Great is his energy which even the gods cannot with difficulty overcome .

units.sanskrit: स एवम् उक्तो राजर्षिर् उत्तङ्केन महात्मना । कुवलाश्वं सुतं प्रादात् तस्मै धुन्धुनिबर्हणे ॥
units.english: Thus accosted by the high-souled Uttanka the royal saint despatched his son Kuvalāshwa for suppressing Dhundhu.

units.sanskrit: भगवन् न्यस्तशस्त्रो ऽहम् अयं तु तनयो मम । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारो न संशयः ॥
units.english: He is my son, and forsooth, foremost of the twice-born, he will destroy Dhundhu and acquire the name of Dhundhumāra .

units.sanskrit: स तं व्यादिश्य तनयं राजर्षिर् धुन्धुनिग्रहे । जगाम पर्वतायैव तपसे संशितव्रतः ॥
units.english: Having ordered his son for the destruction of Dhundhu, the self-controlled royal saint went to the mountain for carrying on penances.

units.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वस् तु पुत्राणां शतेन सह पार्तिवः । तम् आविशत् तदा विष्णुर् भगवांस् तेजसा प्रभुः । उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगाद् वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
units.english: king, Kuvalāshwa, with his hundred sons and the ascetic, issued out to destroy Dhundhu. For the behoof of mankind and at the behest of Uttanka the Lord Divine Vishnu entered into him by his own energy.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महान् अभूत् । एष श्रीमान् नृपसुतो धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति ॥ दिव्यैर् माल्यैश् च तं देवाः समन्तात् समवाकिरन् । देवदुन्दुभयश् चैव प्रणेदुर् भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: After his departure a terrible sound was heard in the sky. This graceful prince will be Dhundhamara . Then the celestials engarlanded him with heavenly garlands. The celestial bugles were also sounded, foremost of Bharatas.

units.sanskrit: नारायणेन कौरव्य तेजसाप्यायितस् तदा । बभूव स महातेजा भूयो बलसमन्वितः ॥ तस्य पुत्रैः खनद्भिस् तु वालुकान्तर्हितस् तदा । धुन्धुर् आसादितो राजन् दिशम् आवृत्य पश्चिमाम् ॥
units.english: Having gone there, that best of victors, the energetic Kuvalāshwa made his sons dig up the un-ending sandy ocean. descendant of Kuru, being invigorated by Nārāyana’s energy he became highly powerful and energetic. Digging up the sandy ocean his sons, king, found out Dhundhu, lying in the west.

units.sanskrit: मुखजेनाग्निना क्रोधाल् लोकान् उद्वर्तयन्न् इव । वारि सुस्राव वेगेन महोदधिर् इवोदये । सोमस्य भरतश्रेष्ठ धारोर्मिकलिलो महान् ॥
units.english: He seemed, as if, to have burnt down the quarters in anger with fire coming out of his mouth. foremost of Bharatas, as the ocean swells up with the rise of the moon, so by the movement of that demon mighty torrents of water began to flow.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतं दग्धं त्रिभिर् ऊनं तु रक्षसा ॥
units.english: Excepting three the hundred sons of that king were consumed by that Rākshasa –.

units.sanskrit: ततः स राजा कौरव्य राक्षसं तं महाबलम् । आससाद महातेजा धुन्धुं धुन्धुविनाशनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, descendant of Kuru, the highly energetic king Dhundhumāra confronted the highly powerful Rākshasa Dhundhu.

units.sanskrit: तस्य वारिमयं वेगम् आपीय स नराधिपः । योगी योगेन वह्निं च शमयाम् आस वारिणा ॥
units.english: Then having drunk up, by his Yoga power, his Rakshasa's watery energy the ascetic king quenched the fire with water.

units.sanskrit: उत्तङ्कस् तु वरं प्रादात् तस्मै राज्ञे महात्मने । ददतश् चाक्षयं वित्तं शत्रुभिश् चापराजयम् ॥ धर्मे रतिं च सततं स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम् । पुत्राणां चाक्षयांल् लोकान् स्वर्गे ये रक्षसा हताः ॥
units.english: Then having slain with his strength that demon of the water the king proved himself successful to Uttanka. Uttanka too conferred a boon on the high souled king—via endless riches, victory over his enemies, inclination to virtue and eternal habitation in heaven, as well as the attainment to the eternal region of those of his sons who were killed by the Rākshasa –.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रास् त्रयः शिष्टा दृढाश्वो ज्येष्ठ उच्यते । दण्डाश्वकपिलाश्वौ तु कुमारौ तु कनीयसौ ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Of his three surviving sons Dridhāshwa is spoken of as the eldest; Chandrāshwa and Kapilāshwa were the two younger sons.

units.sanskrit: धौन्धुमारिर् दृढाश्वस् तु हर्यश्वस् तस्य चात्मजः । हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भो ऽभूत् क्षत्रधर्मरतः सदा ॥
units.english: Haryashwa was the son of Dhundhumāra's son Dridhāshwa. His son was Nikumbhu always observant of the duties of the Kshatryas.

units.sanskrit: संहताश्वो निकुम्भस्य सुतो रणविशारदः । अकृशाश्वः कृशाश्वश् च संहताश्वसुतौ नृप ॥
units.english: Nikumbhu's son was Sanghatāshwa, well-versed in the art of warfare. king, Sanghatāshwa had two sons Krishāshwa and Akrishāshwa.

units.sanskrit: तस्य हैमवती कन्या सतां मता दृषद्वती । विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रश् चापि प्रसेनजित् ॥
units.english: Himalaya's daughter Drishadvati, respected by the good and celebrated in the three worlds, was his spouse.

units.sanskrit: लेभे प्रसेनजिद् भार्यां गौरीं नाम पतिव्रताम् । अभिशप्ता तु सा भर्त्रा नदी सा बाहुदा कृता ॥
units.english: Her son was Prasenajit Prasenajit got a wife by name Gouri ever devoted to her husband. Cursed by her husband she became a river by name Vāhudā.

units.sanskrit: मान्धाता युवनाश्वस्य त्रिलोकविजयी नृपः ॥
units.english: His son was the emperor Yuvanāshwa whose son was Māndhātā, the victor of the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: तस्य चैत्ररथी भार्या शशबिन्दोः सुताभवत् । साध्वी बिन्दुमती नाम रूपेणासदृशी भुवि । पतिव्रता च ज्येष्ठा च भ्रातॄणाम् अयुतस्य सा ॥
units.english: His wife was Chaitrarathi the daughter of Shashavindhu—her another name was the chaste Vindumati unequalled in beauty in the world. She was chaste and the eldest of ten million brothers.

units.sanskrit: तस्याम् उत्पादयाम् आस मान्धाता द्वौ सुतौ नृप । पुरुकुत्ससुतस् त्व् आसीत् त्रसद्दस्युर् महीपतिः । तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् राजा सुधन्वा रिपुमर्दनः । राज्ञस् त्रिधन्वनस् त्व् आसीद् विद्वांस् त्रय्यारुणः प्रभुः । तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारो ऽभून् महाबलः ॥ येन भार्या हृता पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहा परस्य वै ॥ बाल्यात् कामाच् च मोहाच् च संहर्षाच् चापलेन च । यथा कुमारेण कृतं राजन् कर्म विगर्हितम् । अधर्मशङ्कुना तेन राजा त्रय्यारुणो ऽत्यजत् । तम् अधर्मेण संयुक्तं पितासूर्यारुणो जहौ । पितरं सो ऽब्रवीत् त्यक्तः क्व गच्छामीति वै मुहुः । पिता त्व् एनम् अथोवाच श्वपाकैः सह वर्तय । नाहं पुत्रेण पुत्रार्थी त्वयाद्य कुलपांसन ॥
units.english: king, Māndhātā begat on her two sons—the pious Purukutsa and the virtuous Muchukunda. Purukutsa's son was the emperor Trāsadasyu –. He begat a son on Narmadā by name Sambhuta whose son was the king Sudhanwā. Sudhanwā's son was Tridhanwā, the represser of foes; the educated powerful king Trayyāruna was Tridhanwā's son. His highly powerful son, of vicious understanding, by name Satyavrata, put obstacles to the nuptial mantras. On account of his childishness, fickleness, lust, ignorance and joy he took as his wife the duly wedded spouse of another man. Out of lust he stole away the daughter of another citizen. Pierced by the dart of iniquity and worked up with anger therefore the king Trayyāruna renounced him saying. Go to rack and ruin. Forsaken by his sire he again and again said to him Where shall go? –. The father then said to him Go and live with the Chandalas. you who have sullied your family, do not like to be the father of a son like you .

units.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तः स निराक्रामन् नगराद् वचनात् पितुः । न च तं वारयाम् आस वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः ॥ स तु सत्यव्रतस् तात श्वपाकावसथान्तिके । पित्रा त्यक्तो ऽवसद् वीरः पिताप्य् अस्य वनं ययौ ॥ परित्यागात् कुमारस्य नावर्षत् पाकशासनः ॥ यदा द्वादश वर्षाणि तेन नष्टाभवत् प्रजा । दारांस् तु तस्य विषये विश्वामित्रो महातपाः । तस्य पत्नी गले बद्ध्वा मध्यमं पुत्रम् औरसम् । शेषस्य भरणार्थाय व्यक्रीणाद् गोशतेन वै ॥
units.english: Thus spoken to by his father he issued out of the city. The omniscient Rishi Vasishtha did not prevent him however child, thus forsaken by his father the heroic Satyavrata repaired to where the Chandalas were living. His father too left for the forest. On account of his iniquity the chastiser of Pakā Indra, did not pour rain in his kingdom for twelve long years. Having made over the kingdom to his wives the great ascetic Viswāmitra carried on hard penances near the sea. Having tied a rope round the neck of his own begotten second son his wife sold him for a hundred coins for the maintenance of the remaining sons.

units.sanskrit: तं तु बद्धं गले दृष्ट्वा विक्रीयन्तं नृपात्मजः । सत्यव्रतो महाबाहुर् भरणं तस्य चाकरोत् । विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्ट्यर्थम् अनुकम्पार्थम् एव च ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, when he saw the ascetic's son thus bound for sale the pious prince released him. For encompassing Viswāmitra's pleasure and for his favour the mighty-armed Satyavrata maintained his sons.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभवद् गालवो नाम गलबन्धान् महातपाः । महर्षिः कौशिकस् तात तेन वीरेण मोक्षितः ॥
units.english: On account of his being bound by the neck the great ascetic passed by the name of Gālava. And that great saint Kausika was released by that heroic king.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच सत्यव्रतस् तु भक्त्या च कृपया च प्रतिज्ञया । विश्वामित्रकलत्रं तद् बभार विनये स्थितः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus on account of his Bhakti, mercy and promise Satyavrata, ever stationed in humility, took charge of Vishwāmitra's offspring.

units.sanskrit: हत्वा मृगान् वराहांश् च महिषांश् च वनेचरान् । विश्वामित्राश्रमाभ्याशे मांसं तद् अवबन्धत ॥
units.english: Having killed wild deer, bear and buffaloes he used to keep meat tied to the trees near the hermitage of Vishwāmitra.

units.sanskrit: उपांशुव्रतम् आस्थाय दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम् । पितुर् नियोगाद् अवसत् तस्मिन् वनगते नृपे ॥
units.english: After the king had left for the forest he, taking the vow of not taking another’s wife, passed twelve years at the behest of his sire as a probationer.

units.sanskrit: अयोध्यां चैव राष्ट्रं च तथैवान्तःपुरं मुनिः । याज्योपाध्यायसंयोगाद् वसिष्ठः पर्यरक्षत ॥
units.english: On account of his being the royal priest the ascetic Vashishtha protected the city of Ayodhyā and the kingdom.

units.sanskrit: वसिष्ठे ऽभ्यधिकं मन्युं धारयाम् आस नित्यदा ॥ पित्रा तु तं तदा राष्ट्रात् परित्य्क्तं प्रियं सुतम् । न वारयाम् आस मुनिर् वसिष्ठः कारणेन हि ॥
units.english: Satyavrata too, on account of his childishness and future greatness, foolishly got greatly enraged with Vashishtha. king, when his father renounced his own son Satyavrata, Vashishtha, for some reason, did not prevent him.

units.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात् सप्तमे पदे । न च सत्यव्रतस् तस्माद् धृतवान् सप्तमे पदे ॥
units.english: By proceeding seven footsteps all the nuptial mantras are annulled. Satyavrata, however, could not hear those muttering prayers.

units.sanskrit: जानन् धर्मं वसिष्ठस् तु न मां त्रातीति भारत । सत्यव्रतस् तदा रोषं वसिष्ठे मनसाकरोत् ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, thinking although Vashishtha is pious still he is not saving me Satyavrata got highly enraged with him.

units.sanskrit: न च सत्यव्रतस् तस्य तम् उपांशुम् अबुध्यत ॥
units.english: Thinking well however the great Vashishtha did not prevent him then; but Satyavrata could not understand his intention.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् अपरितोषो यः पितुर् आसीन् महात्मनः । तेन द्वादश वर्षाणि नावर्षत् पाकशासनः ॥ तेन त्व् इदानीं वहता दीक्षां तां दुर्वहां भुवि । न तं वसिष्ठो भगवान् पित्रा त्यक्तं न्यवारयत् । अभिषेक्ष्याम्य् अहं पुत्रम् अस्येत्य् एवं मतिर् मुनेः ॥
units.english: His high-souled sire was not satisfied with him and therefore the slayer of Pāka did not send showers for twelve years. By carrying on those hard austerities now on earth he is releasing his family from that sin. When he was forsaken by his father Vashishtha did not prevent him because the ascetic had in view of placing his Satyavrata's son on the throne.

units.sanskrit: स तु द्वादश वर्षाणि दीक्षाम् ताम् उद्वहन् बली । उपांशुव्रतम् आस्थाय महत् सत्यव्रतोनृप । अविद्यमाने मांसे तु वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः । दशधर्मगतो राजा जघान जनमेजय ॥ मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्तः श्रान्तः क्रुद्धो बुभुक्षितः । त च मांसं स्वयं चैव विश्वामित्रस्य चात्मजान् । भोजयाम् आस तच् छ्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो ऽप्य् अस्य चुक्रुधे ॥
units.english: Carrying on hard austerities for twelve years, one day the powerful prince Satyavrata, stricken with anger, ignorance, labour and hunger, for not finding meat, saw the high-souled Vashishtha's milch-cow conferring the grant of all desires -. Janamejaya, possessed by drunkenness, madness, exhaustion, anger, hunger, hastiness, cowardice, avarice and lust he killed that cow. He himself took the meat and made Vishwāmitra's children partake of it. Hearing it Vashishtha was enraged. The revered Rishi, worked up with anger, then said to the prince.

units.sanskrit: पातयेयम् अहं क्रूर तव शङ्कुम् अयस्मयम् । यदि ते द्वाव् इमौ शङ्कू न स्यातां वै कृतौ पुनः ॥
units.english: wicked man, discharge at you this javelin of sin; if you had not two other javelins of sin stuck to you forsooth would not have discharged it.

units.sanskrit: पितुश् चापरितोषेण गुरोर् दोग्ध्रीवधेन च । अप्रोक्षितोपयोगाच् च त्रिविधस् ते व्यतिक्रमः ॥
units.english: You have committed threefold transgressions, namely the incurring of your father's displeasure, the killing of your preceptor's milch-cow and the eating of forbidden meat.

units.sanskrit: त्रिशङ्कुर् इति होवाच त्रिशङ्कुस् तेन स स्मृतः ॥ विश्वामित्रस् तु दाराणाम् आगतो भरणे कृते । तेन तस्मै वरं प्रादान् मुनिः प्रीतस् त्रिशङ्कवे । छन्द्यमानो वरेणाथ गुरुं वव्रे नृपात्मजः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—The incurring of his father's displeasure, the killing of his preceptor's cow and the eating of forbidden meat formed as it were three javelins to him and therefore he was called Trishankhu. After his return Vishwāmitra found his wife and children looked after by him and pleased accordingly the ascetic conferred a boon on Trishankhu.

units.sanskrit: सशरीरो व्रजे स्वर्गम् इत्य् एवं याचितो मुनिः । अनावृष्टिभये तस्मिन् गते द्वादशवार्षिके । अभिषिच्य च राज्ये च याजयाम् आस तं मुनिः । मिषतां देवतानां च वसिष्ठस्य च कौशिकः ॥
units.english: When that ascetic was about to confer a boon on him the prince begged of him the boon of going bodily to heaven. Then the fear of draught, extending over twelve years, was gone and the ascetic, having installed him on the throne, began to act as his priest. The all-powerful son of Kushika took him bodily to heaven in the presence of all the gods and the great saint Vashishtha.

units.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यरथा नाम पत्नी केकयवंशजा । कुमारं जनयाम् आस हरिश्चन्द्रम् अकल्मषम् ॥
units.english: He had a wife by name Satyarathā born in the race of Kekayas. He begat on her the sinless prince Harishchandra.

units.sanskrit: स वै राजा हरिश्चन्द्रस् त्रैशङ्कव इति स्मृतः । आहर्ता राजसूयस्य स सम्राड् इति विश्रुतः ॥
units.english: The king Harishchandra was called Traishankava. Having celebrated a a Rajasuya sacrifice he became the Lord Paramount.

units.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस्य तु सुतो रोहितो नाम विश्रुतः । येनेदं रोहितपुरं कारितंराज्यसिद्धये ॥ कृत्वा राज्यं स राजर्षिः पालयित्वा तथा प्रजाः । संसारासारतां ज्ञात्वा द्विजेभ्यस् तत् पुरं ददौ । हरितो रोहितस्याथ चञ्चुर् हारीत उच्यते । विजयश् च सुदेवश् च चञ्चुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । जेता क्षत्रस्य सर्वस्य विजयस् तेन स स्मृतः ॥ रुरुकस् तनयस् तस्य राजधर्मार्थकोविदः । रोहितस्य वृकः पुत्रो वृकाद् बाहुस् तु जज्ञिवान् ॥
units.english: Harishchandra had a powerful son by name Rohita by whom, for the advancement of his kingdom, the city of Rohitapura was founded. Having governed his kingdom and the subjects and been convinced of the worthlessness of the world the royal saint Rohita gave away that city unto the Brāhmanas. Rohita’s son was Harita, whose son was Chanchu who had two sons, by name Vijaya and Sudeva. Vijaya defeated all the Kshatryas and therefore he got that name. His son was Ruruka who was virtuous-souled and studied the Vedas. Ruruka's son was Vrika and of him was born Vahu.

units.sanskrit: शकैर् यवनकाम्बोजैः पारदैः पह्लवैः सह । हेहयास् तालजङ्घाश् च निरस्यन्ति स्म तं नृपम् । सगरस् तु सुतो बाहोर् जज्ञे सह गरेण वै । और्वस्याश्रमम् आसाद्य भार्गवेणाभिरक्षितः ॥
units.english: Haihaya, Talajangha and other Kshatriya clans accompanied by Shaka, Javana, Kāmvoja, Pārada Palhava and other clans discomfitted that king for he was not greatly virtuous even in golden age –. Vāhu's son was born with poison and therefore he was called Sagara. Coming to the hermitage of Aurva he was protected by Bhārgava.

units.sanskrit: जिगाय पृथिवीं हत्वा तालजङ्घान् सहेहयान् ॥ शकानां पह्लवानां च धर्मं निरसद् अच्युतः । क्षत्रियाणां कुरुश्रेष्ठाः पारदानां च धर्मवित् ॥
units.english: foremost of Kurus, having obtained a fiery weapon from Bhārgava the pious king Sagara, endued with great strength, slew all the Haihayas and Talajanghas, conquered all the world and put down the religious practices of Shaka, Palhava and Pārada Kshatryas –.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच कथं स सगरो जातो गरेणैव सहाच्युतः । किमर्थं च शकादीनां क्षत्रियाणां महौजसाम् ॥ धर्मं कुलोचितं क्रुद्धो राजा निरसद् अच्युतः । एतन् मे सर्वम् आचक्ष्व विस्तरेण तपोधन ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:—Why was the powerful king Sagara born with poison? And why did he, worked up with anger, put down the religious practices of Shakas and other highly powerful Kshatriya clans as laid down by their respective orders. And why was he not injured by poison? Describe all this at length, great ascetic -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच बाहोर् व्यसनिनस् तात हृतं राज्यम् अभूत् किल । कातिसर्पा माहिषिकाः पारदाष्टङ्कणाः शकाः । एते ह्य् अपि गणाः पञ्च हेहयार्थे पराक्रमन् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— king, when Vāhu grew addicted to vice, Haihaya, with Tālajānghas and Shakas spoliated his territories. Yavanas, Pāradas, Kāmbhojas, Palhavas and Shakas—these five classes of Mlechhas displayed their prowess for Haihaya.

units.sanskrit: हृतराज्यस् तदा राजा स वै बाहुर् वनं ययौ । पत्न्या चानुगतो दुःखी वने प्राणान् अवासृजत् ॥
units.english: Deprived of his kingdom, the king Vāhu retired into a forest life. Followed by his wife he gave up his life there in great misery.

units.sanskrit: और्वेण जानतात्मानं प्रजावन्तं निवारिता । पत्नी तु यादवी तस्य सगर्भा पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात् । सपत्न्या च गरस् तस्या दत्तः पूर्वम् अभूत् किल ॥ सा तु भर्तुश् चितां कृत्वा वने ताम् अभ्यरोहत । तस्याश्रमे च तं गर्भं गरेणैव सहाच्युतम् । व्यजायत महाबाहुं सगरं नाम पार्थिवम् ॥
units.english: His wife of the Yadu race was at that time enciente and she followed her husband whose other wife had administered poison unto her before her departure. When she, making a funeral pyre for her husband in that forest, got upon it Aurva, born in the family of Bhrigu, out of compassion, prevented her. In his hermitage she gave birth to the highly powerful and mighty-armed king Sagara together with poison.

units.sanskrit: और्वस् तु जातकर्मादी तस्य कृत्वा महात्मनः । अध्याप्य वेदशास्त्राणि ततो ऽस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत् । आग्नेयं तं महाभागाम् अमरैर् अपि दुःसहम् ॥
units.english: Having performed all the rites consequent upon the birth of that high-souled king Aurva taught him the Vedas and then gave him at last the fiery weapon which even the immortals cannot withstand.

units.sanskrit: स तेनास्त्रबलेनाजौ बलेन च समन्वितः । हेहयान् निजघानाशु क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशून् इव । आजहार च लोकेषु कीर्तिं कीर्तिमतां वरः ॥
units.english: Gifted with great strength he, by dint of the prowess of that weapon, in no time destroyed the Haihayas like unto enraged Rudra slaying the beasts. That foremost of the illustrious kings spread his own fame in the world -.

units.sanskrit: ततः शकान् स यवनान् काम्बोजान् पारदांस् तथा । ते वध्यमाना वीरेण सगरेण महात्मना । वसिष्ठं शरणं गत्वा प्रणिपेतुर् मनीषिणम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon he made up his mind for extirpating the race of the Shakas, Kāmbhojas and Palhavas. When about to be slain by the high-souled hero, they, seeking refuge with the intelligent Vasishtha, bowed unto him.

units.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस् त्व् अथ तान् दृष्ट्वा समयेन महाद्युतिः । सगरः स्वां प्रतिज्ञां च गुरोर् वाक्यं निशम्य च । धर्मं जघान तेषां वै वेषान्यात्वं चकार ह ॥
units.english: Seeing them arrived in proper time the highly effulgent Vasishtha promised them security and prevented Sagara. Considering his own promise and the words of his preceptor Sagara violated their religious practices and made them change their dress.

units.sanskrit: अर्धं शकानां शिरसो मुण्डयित्वा व्यसर्जयत् । यवनानां शिरः सर्वं काम्बोजानां तथैव च ॥
units.english: Having made the Shakas shave half of their heads he dismissed them. He made the Yavanas and Kāmbhojas shave their entire head.

units.sanskrit: पारदा मुक्तकेशास् तु पह्लवाः श्मश्रुधारिणः । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः कृतास् तेन महात्मना ॥ शका यवनकाम्बोजाः पारदाश् च विशां पते । कोलिसर्पा माहिषका दर्वाश् चोलाः सकेरलाः ॥
units.english: Pāradas used to have their hairs dishevelled and Palhavas kept beards. They were prohibited from studying the Vedas, and offering oblation to fire by the high-souled Sagara. my child, Shakas, Yavanas, Kāmbhojas, Paradas, Kolasapyas, Mahishas, Dārvas, Cholas and Keralas were all Kshatriyas.
