units.sanskrit: वसिष्ठवचनाद् राजन् सगरेण महात्मना ॥
units.english: king, at the words of Vasishtha their religious practices were put down by the high-souled Sagara -.

units.sanskrit: खशास् तु षाराश् चीनाश् च मद्राः किष्कन्धकास् तथा । कौन्तलाश् च तथा वङ्गाः शाल्वाः कौङ्कणकास् तथा । स धर्मविजयी राजा विजित्येमां वसुंधराम् । तस्य चारयतः सो ऽश्वः समुद्रे पूर्वदक्षिणे । वेलासमीपे ऽपहृतो भूमिं चैव प्रवेशितः । स तं देशं तदा पुत्रैः खानयाम् आस पार्थिवः ॥
units.english: Having conquered the entire earth consisting of the provinces of Khasa, Tukhāra, China, Madra, Kishkindhaka, Kountala, Banga, Shālwa, Konkashaka and others, that king, who had put down other religious forms, entered upon the performance of Bājapeya sacrifice and let loose a horse –. The horse, while it was roaming near the bank of the south eastern ocean, was pilfered and made to enter into the earth. Then the king had that portion of the country dug by his sons.

units.sanskrit: आसेदुस् ते ततस् तत्र खन्यमाने महार्णवे । तम् आदिपुरुषं देवं हरिं कृष्णं प्रजापतिम् । तस्य चक्षुःसमुत्थेन तेजसा प्रतिबुध्यतः । दग्धाः सर्वे महाराज चत्वारस् त्व् अवशेषिताः ॥
units.english: When that mighty ocean was thus dug up they arrived at a place where the prime deity, the Patriarch Hari, the best of male beings, in the shape of Kapila, was sleeping –. great king, when he awoke all the sons of Sagara, with the exception of four, were all consumed by the fire coming out of his eyes.

units.sanskrit: बर्हकेतुः सुकेतुश् च तथा भारद्रथो नृपः । शूरः पञ्चजनश् चैव तस्य वंशकरा नृपा ॥
units.english: king, they were Varhaketu, Suketu, Dharmarātha and the heroic Panchajana—they perpetuated the race of Sagara.

units.sanskrit: प्रादाच् च तस्मै भगवान् हरिर् नारायणो वरम् । सगराय महाराज । पुत्रं समुद्रं च विभुः स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम् ॥ पुत्राणां चाक्षयांल् लोकांस् तस्य येचक्षुषा हताः । समुद्रश् चार्घ्यम् आदाय ववन्दे तं महीपतिम् । सागरत्वं च लेभे स कर्मणा तेन तस्य ह ॥
units.english: The Omniscient Hari Nārāyana conferred on him many boons viz. —unending family, the eternal glory of the Ikshwāku family, the birth of the ocean as his son, eternal habitation in heaven, and the ascension into the eternal region of those of his sons who had been consumed by the fiery looks of Kapila –. Thereupon the ocean worshipped that king with Arghya, and for this it obtained the appellation of Sāgara.

units.sanskrit: तं चाश्वमेधिकं सो ऽश्वं समुद्राद् उपलब्धवान् । पुत्राणां च सहस्राणि षष्टिस् तस्येति नः श्रुतम् ॥ जनमेजय उवाच सगरस्यात्मजा वीराः कथं जाता महाबलाः । विक्रान्ताः षष्टिसाहस्रा विधिना केन वा द्विज ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच ज्येष्ठाविदर्भदुहिता केशिनी नाम विश्रुता । कनीयसी तु या तस्य पत्नी परमधर्मिणी । अरिष्टनेमिदुहिता रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । और्वस् ताभ्यां वरं प्रादात् तन् निबोध नराधिप ॥
units.english: He obtained from the ocean that horse destined for the Aswamedha sacrifice. The highly illustrious king performed a hundred horse sacrifices and we have heard that he had sixty thousand sons. Janamejaya said:—By what observance, twice-born one, did the sixty thousand heroic and powerful sons of Sagara attain to greatness? Vaishampāyana said:—Sagara had two wives whose sons had been consumed by ascetic observances. The oldest of them, the daughter of the king of Vidarbha, was celebrated by the name Keshini. His youngest wife was the pious daughter of Arishthanemi, who was unequalled on earth in beauty. Hear, king, what boons Aurva conferred upon them.

units.sanskrit: षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि गृह्णात्व् एका तरस्विनाम् । एकं वंशधरं त्व् एका यथेष्टं वरयत्व् इति ॥
units.english: He wanted one of them to take sixty thousand sons and the other to pray for one son only after her heart who will perpetuate the race.

units.sanskrit: तत्रैका जगृहे पुत्रांल् लुब्धा शूरान् बहूंस् तथा । एकं वंशधरं त्व् एका तथेत्य् आह ततो मुनिः ॥
units.english: Of them she, who was avaricious, prayed for many mighty sons -. The other prayed for only one son, who will keep up the prestige of the family. The ascetic conferred on her the same boon.

units.sanskrit: केशिन्य् असूत सगराद् असमञ्जसमात्मजम् । राजा पञ्चजनो नाम बभूव सुमहाबलः । इतरा सुषुवे तुम्बं बीजपूर्णाम् इति श्रुतिः ॥
units.english: Sagara begat on Keshini a son named Asmanjā. That highly powerful king also passed by the name of Panchajana. The other, as the rumour is, gave birth to a long gourd consisting of seeds.

units.sanskrit: तत्र षष्टिसहस्राणि गर्भास् ते तिलसंमिताः । घृतपूर्णेषु कुम्भेषु तान् गर्भान् निदधुस् ततः । धात्रीश् चैकैकशः प्रादात् तावतीः पोषणे नृप ॥
units.english: Therein lay like corns sixty thousand embryos. They grew up duly in proper time. The father threw those embryos into vessels full of clarified butter and appointed equal number of nurses to look after them.

units.sanskrit: ततो दशसु मासेषु समुत्तस्थुर् यथाक्रमम् । कुमारास् ते यथाकालं सगरप्रीतिवर्धनाः ॥ षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि तस्यैवम् अभवन् नृप । तेषां नारायणं तेजः प्रविष्टानां महात्मनाम् । एकः पञ्चजनो नाम पुत्रो राजा बभूव ह ॥
units.english: When ten months were complete thence came out with ease and in proper time those sons of Sagara enhancing his delight. In this way, king, there originated from bottle gourd the sixty thousand sons of Sagara. When they were consumed by Nārāyana’s energy one of them only survived namely, Panchajana who became the king.

units.sanskrit: सुतः पञ्चजनस्यासीद् अंशुमान् नाम वीर्यवान् । दिलीपस् तस्य तनयः खट्वाङ्ग इति विश्रुतः ॥
units.english: Panchajana’s son was the energetic Angsumān. His son Dilipa also passed by the name of Khattānga.

units.sanskrit: येन स्वर्गाद् इहागत्य मुहूर्तं प्राप्य जीवितम् । त्रयो ऽभिसंधिता लोका बुद्ध्या सत्येन चानघ ॥
units.english: Coming down to this earth from heaven and taking birth there he, within a moment, ransacked the three worlds by virtue of his intelligence and truthfulness, sinless one.

units.sanskrit: दिलीपस्य तु दायादो महाराजो भगीरथः । यः स गङ्गां सरिच्छ्रेष्ठाम् अवातारयत प्रभुः । कीर्तिमान् स महाभागः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः । समुद्रम् आनयच् चैनां दुहितृत्वे त्व् अकल्पयत् ॥
units.english: Dilipa's son was the great king Bhagiratha who, powerful as he was, brought down the best of rivers Gangā. That noble and illustrious king, equal to Sakra in prowess, brought her to the ocean and then considered her as his daughter.

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् भागीरथी गङ्गा कथ्यते वंशचिन्तकैः । भगीरथसुतो राजा श्रुत इत्य् अभिविश्रुतः । नाभागस् तु श्रुतस्यासीत् पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः ॥ अम्बरीषस् तु नाभागिः सिन्धुद्वीपपिताभवत् । अयुताजित्सुतस् त्व् आसीद् ऋतपर्णो महायशाः । दिव्याक्षहृदयज्ञो वै राजा नलसखो बली ॥
units.english: Therefore by the Rishis who keep account of families she has been styled Bhāgirathi. Bhagiratha's son was the celebrated king Shruta. The highly pious Nābhāga was Shruta's son Nābhāga's son was Ambarisha who was the father of Sindhudwipa, whose son was the powerful Ayutajit. The illustrious Rituparna was Ayutajit's son. He was powerful, well-versed in the game of celestial dice and a friend of king Nala.

units.sanskrit: सुदासस् तस्य तनयो राजा इन्द्रसखो ऽभवत् । सुदासस्य सुतस् त्व् आसीत् सौदासो नाम पार्थिवः । ख्यातः कल्माषपादो वै नाम्ना मित्रसहो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: The king Artaparni was Rituparna's son, whose son was the king Sudāsa who became the friend of Indra. The king Soudāsa was Sudāsa's son. He was celebrated by the name of Kalmashapāda and was greatly attached to his friends.

units.sanskrit: कल्माषपादस्य सुतः सर्वकर्मेति विश्रुतः । अनरण्यस् तु पुत्रो ऽभूद् विश्रुतः सर्वकर्मणः ॥
units.english: Kalmāshapāda's son was known by the name of Sarvakarmā whose son was the celebrated Anaranya.

units.sanskrit: अनरण्यसुतो निघ्नो निघ्नपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । अनमित्रो रघुश् चैव पार्थिवर्षभसत्तमौ ॥
units.english: Anaranya's son was Nighna who had two sons, both leading kings, by name Anamitra and Raghu.

units.sanskrit: अनमित्रस् तु धर्मात्मा विद्वान् दुलिदुहो ऽभवत् । दिलीपस् तस्य तनयो रामस्य प्रपितामहः । दीर्घबाहुर् दिलीपस्य रघुर् नाम्नाभवत् सुतः ॥
units.english: Anamitra's son was the educated and pious Duliduho. His son was Dilipa, the grandfather of Rāma. Dilipa's son was the large-armed Raghu.

units.sanskrit: अयोध्यायांमहाराज रघुर् आसीन् महाबलः । अजस् तु राघुतो जज्ञे तथा दशरथो ऽप्य् अजात् । रामो दशरथाज् जज्ञे धर्मारामो महायशाः ॥
units.english: The highly powerful king Raghu reigned in Ayodhya. Aja was born of Raghu and Aja's son was Dasharatha whose son was the virtuous-souled and illustrious Rāma.

units.sanskrit: रामस्य तनयो जज्ञे कुश इत्य् अभिविश्रुतः । अतिथिस् तु कुशाज् जज्ञे निषधस् तस्य चात्मजः ॥
units.english: Rāma's son passed by the name of Kusha whose son was Atithi and whose son was Nishadha.

units.sanskrit: निषधस्य नलः पुत्रो नभः पुत्रो नलस्य तु । क्षेमधन्वसुतस् त्व् आसीद् देवानीकः प्रतापवान् । आसीद् अहीनगुर् नाम देवानीकात्मजः प्रभुः । सुधन्वनः सुतश् चैव ततोजज्ञे नलो नृप । वज्रनाभः सुतस् तस्य उक्थस्य च महात्मनः । शङ्खस् तस्य सुतो विद्वान् ध्युषिताश्व इति श्रुतः । पुष्पस् तस्य सुतो विद्वान् अर्थसिद्धिस् तु तत्सुतः ॥
units.english: Nishadhas son was Nala whose son was Nabha. Nabha's son was Pundarika whose son passed by the name of Kshemadhanwā. Kshemadhanwā's son was the powerful Devānika whose son was the great Ahinagu. Ahinagu's good son was the king Sudhanwā, as whose son was born the king Anala. Anala's son was the virtuous Uktha, the son of which high souled king was Vajranābha. His son Shankha was celebrated for his great learning and passed by the name of Dhyushitāshwa. His son was the learned Pushpa, whose son was Arthasiddhi.

units.sanskrit: अग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रस् तु शीघ्रस्य तु मरुः सुतः ॥
units.english: His son was Sudarshana, whose son was Shighra and whose son was Maru.

units.sanskrit: मरुस् तु योगम् आस्थाय कलापद्वीपम् आस्थितः । तस्यासीद् विश्रुतवतः पुत्रो राजा बृहद्बलः । नलौ द्वाव् एव विख्यातौ पुराणे भरतर्षभ । वीरसेनात्मजश् चैव यश् चेक्ष्वाकुकुलोद्वहः ॥
units.english: Maru practised Yoga in the island of Kala. His son was the illustrious king Vrihadvala. foremost of Bharatas, in Purāna, there are two kings celebrated by the name of Nala. Of them one was the son of Veerasena and the other was a descendant of Ikshwāku.

units.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवाः प्राधान्येनेह कीर्तिताः । एते विवस्वतो वंशे राजानो भूरितेजसः ॥
units.english: have thus described to you in order of precedence the leading members of the Ikshwāku race. These kings, of immeasurable energy, belonged to the solar dynasty.

units.sanskrit: पठन् सम्यग् इमां सृष्टिम् आदित्यस्य विवस्वतः । श्राद्धदेवस्य देवस्य प्रजानां पुष्टिदस्य च । प्रजानान् एति सायुज्यम् आदित्यस्य विवस्वतः ॥
units.english: By reading the account of creation by the illustrious Srādhadeva Adityā who confers nourishment upon creatures a man gets offspring, attains to the same status with the sun, is freed from sins and haughtiness and obtains longevity -.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच कथं वै श्राद्धदेवत्वम् आदित्यस्य विवस्वतः । श्रोतुम् इच्छामि विप्राग्र्य श्राद्धस्य च परं विधं । पितॄणाम् आदिसर्गं च क एते पितरः स्मृताः ॥ एवं च श्रुतम् अस्माभिः कथ्यमानं द्विजातिभिः । स्वर्गस्थाः पितरो न्ये स्म देवानाम् अपि देवताः । इति देवविदः प्राहुर् एतद् इच्छामि वेदितुं ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:—How did the illustrious Aditya become the presiding deity of Srāddhas? What is the most excellent mode of performing them? wish to hear all this, Vipra. What is the origin of the Pitris and who are they? We have heard from the conversation of the Brāhmanas that the Pitris ancestral manes, stationed in heaven, are even the gods of the gods. This is said by those well read in the Vedas. therefore wish to know this -.

units.sanskrit: यावन्तश् च गणाः प्रोक्ता यच् च तेषां परं बलम् । यथा च कृतम् अस्माभिः श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् ॥
units.english: wish to hear of the most excellent creation of Pitris, their various orders, their great strength, how are they propitiated by the Srāddhas performed by us, and how they, delighted, shower benedictions on us -.

units.sanskrit: प्रीताश् च पितरो येन श्रेयसा योजयन्ति हि । एतद् वै श्रोतुम् इच्छामि पितॄणां सर्गम् उत्तमम् ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच मार्कण्डेयेन कथितं भीष्माय परिपृच्छते ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— will now describe to you the most excellent creation of the Pitris; how they are propitiated by Srāddhas performed by us and how they, being pleased, pour blessings on us. Mārkandeya described this when he was accosted by Bhishma.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एव पुरा प्रश्नं यन् मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥ तत् ते नुपूर्व्या वक्ष्यामि भीष्मेणोदाहृतं यथा । युधिष्ठिर उवाच पुष्टिकामेन धर्मज्ञ कथं पुष्टिर् अवाप्यते । भीष्म उवाच श्राद्धैः प्रीणाति हि पितॄन् सर्वकामफलैस् तु यः । तत्परः प्रयतः श्राद्धी प्रेत्य चेह च मोदते ॥ पितरो धर्मकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य चाभिभो । पुष्टिकामस्य पुष्टिं च प्रयच्छन्ति युधिष्ठिर ॥ युधिश्ठिर उवाच वर्तन्ते पितरः स्वर्गे केषांचिन् नरके पुनः । प्राणिनां नियतं ह्य् उक्तम् कर्मजं फलम् उच्यते ॥
units.english: The question, that you have asked me, was put to Bhishma by the pious king Yudhisthira when the former was lying on the bed of arrows -. Yudhisthira said:— you conversant with virtue, how people, seeking nourishment, get it? By doing what do they not grieve wish to hear this. Bhishma said:— Yudhishthira, he, who propitiates the departed manes by the performance of Srāddhas that secure all desired for objects, who always performs them with a concentrated mind, attains to delight both in this world and in the next. The Pitris confer virtue on him who seeks it, children on him who wants them and nourishment on him who desires for it –. Yudhisthira said:—The departed manes of some persons live in heaven, and those of others live in hell. The fruits of Karma, it is said, eternally exist with people.

units.sanskrit: पितुः पितामहं चैव त्रिषु पिण्डेशु नित्यदा ॥
units.english: Persons, in expectation of fruits, perform Srāddhas for their father, grand-father, and great-grand-father.

units.sanskrit: तानि श्राद्धानि दत्तानि कथं गच्छन्त्य् अथो पितॄन् । कथं च शक्तास् ते दातुं निरयस्थाः फलं पुनः । के वा ते पितरो न्ये स्म कान् यजामो वयं पुनः ॥
units.english: How those offerings reach the ancestral manes –? How can they, while living in hell, grant them the fruits thereof? Who are those ancestral manes Who else are others? To whom do we offer our offerings ? We have heard that even the gods, in the celestial region, dedicate offerings to the ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: एतद् इच्छाम्य् अहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महाद्युते ॥
units.english: wish to hear all this at length you of great effulgence.

units.sanskrit: स भवान् कथयत्व् एनां कथाम् अमितबुद्धिमान् । यथा दत्तं पितॄणां वै तारणायेह कल्पते ॥
units.english: You are endued with immeasurable intelligence, do you describe to me, how by making gifts to the ancestral manes we are released from worldly trammels.

units.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथातत्त्वम् अरिंदम । ये च ते पितरो न्ये स्म यान् यजामो वयं पुनः । श्राद्धकाले मम पितुर् मया पिण्डः समुद्यतः । तं पिता मम हस्तेन भित्त्वा भूमिम् अयाचत ॥
units.english: Bhishma said:— slayer of foes, shall describe to you what have heard on this subject from my deceased father—who are those ancestral manes and who are others to whom we dedicate our offerings. When on the occasion of my father's Srāddha was about to offer him Pinda my father, rending assunder the earth, begged it of me with his hand.

units.sanskrit: हस्ताभरणपूर्णेन केयूरभरितेन च । रक्ताङ्गुलितलेनाथ यथा दृष्टः पुरा मया ॥
units.english: His arm was adorned with bracelet and other ornaments—his fingers and palm were as red as had seen them before.

units.sanskrit: कुशेष्व् एव तदा पिण्डं दत्तवान् अविचारयन् ॥
units.english: Thinking that no such practice is seen in Kalpa offered the Pinda at the Kusa grass, without any consideration.

units.sanskrit: ततः पिता मे सुप्रीतो वाचा मधुरया तदा । उवाच भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रीयमाणो मयानघ ॥
units.english: sinless one, then my father delightedly said to me in sweet accents:— foremost of Bharatas, have been blessed with a son like you, both in this world and the next-a good son, pious and learned as you are -.

units.sanskrit: त्वया दायादवान् अस्मि कृतार्थो मुत्र चेह च । सत्पुत्रेण त्वया पुत्र धर्मज्ञेन विपश्चिता ॥
units.english: You are also of firm vows, sinless one; with a view to lay down the religious practices of people, issued this command.

units.sanskrit: यथा चतुर्थं धर्मस्य रक्षिता लभते फलम् । पापस्य हि तथा मूढः फलं प्राप्नोत्य् अरक्षिता । प्रमाणं यद् धि कुरुते धर्माचारेषु पार्थिवः । त्वया च भरतश्रेष्ठ वेदधर्माश् च शाश्वताः । कृताः प्रमाणं प्रीतिश् च मम निर्वर्तितातुला ॥
units.english: As a man, observing the religious practices, is entitled to a fourth part of the virtue thereof, so a stupid person, transgressing them, is visited by one fourth of the sin consequent thereon. The subjects follow the example set by the king in religious practices. foremost of Bharatas, you have observed the practices laid down in the eternal Vedas and incomparable is my satisfaction therefore.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् तवाहं सुप्रीतः प्रीत्या वरम् अनुत्तमम् । ददानि त्वं प्रतीच्छस्व त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम् ॥
units.english: Greatly pleased with you will confer upon you a most excellent boon—do you pray for it which it is hard to get in the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: न ते प्रभविता मृत्युर् यावज् जीवितुम् इच्छसि । किं वा ते प्रार्थितं भूयो ददानि वरम् उत्तमम् । तद् ब्रूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ यत् ते मनसि वर्तते ॥
units.english: As long as you will wish to live Death will not be able to extend his influence on you. When you will permit him he will overpower you then only. foremost of Bharatas, if there is any other boon which you wish to pray for, tell me and shall grant it.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तवन्तं तम् अहम् अभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । अब्रुवं कृतकृत्यो हं प्रसन्ने त्वयि सत्तम ॥
units.english: On my father saying this,, saluting him with folded hands, said most exalted person, with your being propitiated have achieved all my objects.

units.sanskrit: यदि त्व् अनुग्रहं भूयस् त्वत्तो र्हामि महाद्युते । प्रश्नम् इच्छाम्य् अहं किंचिद् व्याहृतं भवता स्वयम् ॥
units.english: you of great effulgence, if am again entitled to a favour, wish to put a question which desire you to answer yourself.

units.sanskrit: स माम् उवाच धर्मात्मा ब्रूहि भीष्म यद् इच्छसि । छेत्तास्मि संशयं तात यन् मां पृच्छसि भारत ॥
units.english: My virtuous-souled father then said to me Bhishma, tell me whatever you like. Bhārata, will remove your doubt about what you will ask me.

units.sanskrit: अपृच्छं तम् अहं तात तत्रान्तर्हितम् एव च । गतं सुकृतिनां लोकं जातकौतूहलस् तदा ॥
units.english: Filled with curiosity asked my father who had repaired to the region of the performers of good deeds and who then disappeared from that place.

units.sanskrit: श्रूयन्ते पितरो देवा देवानाम् अपि देवताः । कथं च दत्तम् अस्माभिः श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् । लोकान्तरगतांस् तात किं नु श्राद्धस्य वै फलम् ॥ कान् यजन्ति स्म लोका वै सदेवनरदानवाः । सयक्षोरगगन्धर्वाः सकिंनरमहोरगाः । अत्र मे संशयस् तीव्रः कौतूहलम् अतीव च । एतच् छ्रुत्वा वचस् तस्य भीष्मस्योवाच वै पिता । शंतनुर् उवाच संक्षेपेणैव ते वक्ष्ये यन् मां पृच्छसि भारत । पितॄणां कारणं श्राद्धे फलं दत्तस्य चानघ । आदिदेवसुतास् तात पितरो दिवि देवताः । तान् यजन्ति स्म लोका वै सदेवनरदानवाः । सयक्षरक्षोगन्धर्वाः सकिंनरमहोरगाः ॥ जगत् सदेवगन्धर्वम् इति ब्रह्मानुशासनम् ॥ तान् यजस्व महाभागाञ् श्राद्धी श्राद्धैर् अतन्द्रितः । ते ते श्रेयो विधास्यन्ति सर्वकामफलप्रदाः ॥
units.english: Bhishma said:— have heard that the ancestral manes are the gods of the gods. Are they the gods or they are others to whom we offer our adoration ? How the Pindas offered at Srāddhas propitiate the Pitris who have gone to the other world? What are the fruits of a Srāddha ? To whom the people, accompanied by the gods, Dānavas, Yākshas, Rākshasas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and huge serpents, dedicate their offerings ? you conversant with virtue, consider you as omniscient— have grave doubts in this and great is my curiosity—do you explain it to me. Hearing these words of Bhishma his father said. Shantanu said:—Hear, sinless descendant of Bharata, will describe in brief the origin of the Pitris and the fruits of Srāddhas. Do you hear with a concentrated mind the object of performing Srāddhas for the Pitris. The sons of the Prime Deity are known in heaven as Pitris –. The gods, Asuras, men, Yakshas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and huge serpents, dedicate offerings to them. Propitiated by Srāddhas they please the world with the gods and the Gandharvas—such is the command of Brahmā. Therefore, great one, worship them with excellent Srāddhas. They grant all desired-for objects and they will encompass your well-being.

units.sanskrit: त्वयैवाराध्यमानास् ते नामगोत्रादिकीर्तनैः । अस्मान् आप्याययिष्यन्ति स्वर्गस्थान् अपि भारत ॥
units.english: When you will worship them by reciting their names and families, we also, Bharata, will be welcomed by them in heaven.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयस् तु ते शेषम् एतत् सर्वं वदिष्यति । एष वै पितृभक्तश् च विदितात्मा च भार्गवः ॥ उपस्थितश् च श्राद्धे द्य ममैवानुग्रहाय वै । एनं पृच्छ महाभागम् इत्य् उक्त्वान्तरधीयत ॥
units.english: Markandeya will explain to you the remaining portion. descendant of Bharata, this ascetic, devoted to his father and having a knowledge of atman, is present to-day at the Srāddha for extending his favour unto me. Ask him, great one, about this. Saying this he disappeared –.

units.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच ततो हं तस्य वचनान् मार्कण्डेयं समाहितः । प्रश्नं तम् एवान्वपृच्छं यन् मे पृष्टः पुरा पिता ॥
units.english: Bhishma said:—Thereupon at the words of my father put to Markandeya with attention the same question which had put to my father before.

units.sanskrit: स माम् उवाच धर्मात्मा मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः । भीष्म वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वेन शृणुष्व प्रयतो नघ ॥
units.english: The great and virtuous ascetic Markandeya too said to me:— sinless Bhishma, hear with attention, will describe everything.

units.sanskrit: मयापि हि प्रसादाद् वै दीर्घायुष्ट्वं पितुः प्रभो । पितृभक्त्यैव लब्धं च प्राग्लोके परमं यशः ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:— have attained longevity by my father's favour. For my devotion to my father, attained great fame in the world in the days of yore.

units.sanskrit: सो हं युगस्य पर्यन्ते बहुवर्षसहस्रिके । अधिरुह्य गिरिं मेरुं तपो तप्यं सुदुश्चरम् ॥
units.english: At the termination of the cycle extending over many thousand years, carried on hard penances on the mount Sumeru.

units.sanskrit: ततः कदाचित् पश्यामि दिवं प्रज्वाल्य तेजसा । विमानं महद् आयान्तम् उत्तरेण गिरेस् तदा ॥
units.english: Thereupon one day espied a huge car coming from the north of the mountain and lighting the heaven with its lustre.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषम् अग्नाव् अग्निम् इवाहितम् ॥
units.english: Therein, a vehicle in the midst of fire, saw a person measuring a thumb effulgent like fire or the Sun.

units.sanskrit: सो हं तस्मै नमस् कृत्वा प्रणम्य शिरसा प्रभुम् । संनिविष्टं विमानस्थं पाद्यार्घ्याभ्यां अपूजयम् ॥
units.english: Saluting that lord with my head touching the ground worshipped him, lying in the vehicle, with arghya and water for washing feet.

units.sanskrit: अपृच्छं चैव दुर्धर्षं विद्याम त्वाम् कथं प्रभो । दैवतं ह्य् असि देवानाम् इति मे वर्तते मतिः ॥ स माम् उवाच धर्मात्मा स्मयमान इवानघ । न ते तपः सुचरितं येन मां नावबुध्यसे ॥
units.english: asked that unthought-of person. How can know thee, lord –? Methinks thou hast originated from ascetic energy endued with the qualities of Nārāyana. Thou art the god of gods. Sinless one, that virtuous-souled one as if surprisingly said to me: You have not practised well hard penances, so you cannot recognize me.

units.sanskrit: रूपेण न मया कश्चिद् दृष्टपूर्वः पुमान् क्वचित् ॥
units.english: Within a moment he assumed another most excellent form, the like of which had not seen before.

units.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच विद्धि मां ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं मानसं पूर्वजं प्रभो । तपोवीर्यात् समुत्पन्नं नारायणगुणात्मकम् ॥
units.english: Sanatkumar said:—Know me as the first mind-begotten son of the all-powerful Brahmā. From ascetic energy have been born with the essential characteristics of Nārāyana.

units.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार इति यः श्रुतो वेदेषु वै पुरा । सो स्मि भार्गव भद्रं ते कं कामं करवाणि ते ॥ ये त्व् अन्ये ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा यवीयांसस् तु ते मम । भ्रातरः सप्त दुर्धर्षा येषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
units.english: am that Sanatkumar who had been celebrated in the Vedas in the days of yore. Bhārgava, may good betide you and what desire of yours shall fulfill ? The other seven irrepressible sons of Brahmā are my younger brothers. Their families have been established on this earth.

units.sanskrit: क्रतुर् वसिष्ठः पुलहः पुलस्त्यो त्रिस् तथाङ्गिराः । मरीचिस् तु तथा विद्वान् देवगन्धर्वसेविताः । त्रींल् लोकाण् धारयन्तीमान् देवदानवपूजिताः ॥
units.english: They are Kretu, Vasishtha, Pulaha, Pulastya, Atri, Angira, and the learned Marichi—the gods and Gandharvas worship them also. Those ascetics, worshipped of the gods and Dānavas, are upholding the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: वयं तु यतिधर्माण आरोप्यात्मानम् आत्मनि । प्रजाधर्मं च कामं च वर्तयामो महामुने ॥ यथोत्पन्नस् तथैवाहं कुमार इति विद्धि माम् । तस्मात् सनत्कुमारेति नामैतन् मे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ मद्भक्त्या ते तपश् चीर्णं मम दर्शनकाङ्क्षया । एष दृष्टो सि भवता कं कामं करवाणि ते ॥ इत्य् उक्तवन्तं तम् अहं प्रत्यवोचं सनातनम् । अनुज्ञातो भगवता प्रीयता तेन भारत ॥ ततो हम् अर्थम् एतं वै तम् अपृच्छं सनातनम् । पृष्टः पितॄणां सर्गं च फलं श्राद्धस्य चानघ । चिच्छेद संशयं भीष्म स तु देवेश्वरो मम ॥
units.english: am leading the life of a Yatin. Having controlled my ownself and my passions was born, great Muni, and am still living so. Know me as an unmarried person. And therefore have obtained the appellation of Sanatkumar –. Out of devotion to me, you have been carrying on hard penances to behold me. Therefore have come to you, tell me what desire of yours can fulfill. On his saying this and commanded by that all-powerful deity who was pleased with me, replied to that eternal god, descendant of Bharata, sinless one, then accosted the ever-existent deity regarding the origin of the Pitris and the fruits of Srāddhas. Bhishma, that foremost of gods has removed all my doubts.

units.sanskrit: स माम् उवाच प्रीतात्मा कथान्ते बहुवार्षिके । रमे त्वयाहं विप्रर्षे शृणु सर्वं यथातथम् ॥
units.english: After holding conversation for many years that virtuous-souled deity said to me:— Brāhmana saint, have been pleased with your question, hear from me all in due order.

units.sanskrit: देवान् असृजत ब्रह्मा मां यक्ष्यन्तीति भार्गव । तम् उत्सृज्य तदात्मानम् अयजंस् ते फलार्थिनः ॥
units.english: descendant of Bhrigu, Brahmā created all the gods, thinking that they would dedicate offerings to him. But leading aside they began to perform sacrifices in expectation of fruits.

units.sanskrit: ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा मूढा नष्टसंज्ञा विचेतसः । न स्म किंचित् प्रजानन्ति ततो लोको व्यमुह्यत ॥
units.english: Then imprecated by Brahmā, the inhabitants of heaven lost all sense and consciousness. They could not understand any thing and the entire world was bewildered.

units.sanskrit: अनुग्रहाय लोकानां ततस् तान् अब्रवीत् प्रभुः ॥ प्रायश्चित्तं चरध्वं वै व्यभिचारो हि वः कृतः । पुत्रांश् च परिपृच्छध्वं ततो ज्ञानम् अवाप्स्यथ ॥
units.english: Then prostrating themselves before the Grand-Father Brahmā they again prayed to him for the behoof of the world. There upon he Brahmā said to them :—You should undergo a penance for you have committed a transgression. Do ye accost your sons and you will come by true knowledge .

units.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तक्रियार्थं ते पुत्रान् पप्रच्छुर् आर्तवत् । तेभ्यस् ते प्रयतात्मानः शशंसुर् तनयास् तदा ॥
units.english: Thereupon for the purpose of going through a penance they, in great misery, asked their sons, who, self-controlled as they were, communicated to them the truth.

units.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तानि धर्मज्ञा वाङ्मनःकर्मजानि वै । शंसन्ति कुशला नित्यं चक्षुष्मन्तो हि तत्त्वतः ॥
units.english: Persons conversant with religious practices lay down penances for sins committed by words, deeds and thoughts and they daily perform them.

units.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तार्थतत्त्वज्ञा लब्धसंज्ञा दिवौकसः । गम्यतां पुत्रकाश् चेति पुत्रैर् उक्ताश् च ते तदा ॥ अभिशप्तास् तु ते देवाः पुत्रवाक्येन तेन वै । ततस् तान् अब्रवीद् देवो यूयं वै ब्रह्मवादिनः । तस्माद् यद् उक्ता यूयं तैस् तत् तथा न तद् अन्यथा ॥
units.english: Then informed of the true import of Prāyaschitta penance the gods regained their consciousness and were accosted by the sons, saying Go ye sons. Thus cursed and reviled the gods, at the words of sons, approached the grand-father Brahmā to have their doubts removed. The Deity Brahmā then said to them:—Ye are all Brahmavādins. So what they have said will come to pass and it will not be otherwise.

units.sanskrit: यूयं शरीरकर्तारस् तेषां देवा भविष्यथ । ते तु ज्ञानप्रदातारः पितरो वो न संशयः ॥
units.english: gods, ye have given them the body and they have given ye the knowledge and are undoubtedly your fathers.

units.sanskrit: देवाश् च पितरश् चैव तद् बुध्यध्वं दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: Ye are gods and they are the Pitris and undoubtedly you are their fathers and they are yours.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते पुनर् आगम्य पुत्रान् ऊचुर् दिवौकसः । ब्रह्मणा छिन्नसंदेहाः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon the dwellers of heaven returned and said to the sons:—Our doubts have been snapped by Brahmā and so we shall be loving towards each other.

units.sanskrit: यूयं वै पितरो स्माकं यैर् वयं प्रतिबोधिताः । धर्मज्ञाः कश् च वः कामः को वरो वः प्रदीयताम् । यद् उक्तं चैव युष्माभिस् तत् तथा न तद् अन्यथा ॥
units.english: Since ye, being conversant with religious merit, have conferred upon us knowledge, you are our fathers. Tell us what do you seek and what boons may we confer upon you. What you have said will forsooth prove true and not be otherwise.

units.sanskrit: उक्ताश् च यस्माद् युष्माभिः पुत्रका इति वै वयम् । यो निष्ट्वा च पितॄन् श्राद्धैः क्रियाः काश्चित् करिष्यति । राक्षसा दानवा नागाः फलं प्राप्स्यन्ति तस्य तत् ॥
units.english: Since you have addressed us as sons undoubtedly you will be our fathers. The Rakshasas, Dānavas and Nāgas will be entitled to the fruits of an action which a man will perform without propitiating the Pitris with the performance of Srāddhas.

units.sanskrit: श्राद्धैर् आप्यायिताश् चैव पितरः सोमम् अव्ययम् । आप्याय्यमानं युष्माभिर् वर्धयिष्यन्ति नित्यदा ॥
units.english: Being propitiated by Srāddhas the Pitris will propitiate the eternal. And being propitiated by you, they will continue flourishing every day.

units.sanskrit: श्राद्धैर् आप्यायितः सोमो लोकम् आप्याययिष्यति । समुद्रपर्वतवनं जंगमाजंगमैर् वृतम् ॥
units.english: Being propitiated by Srāddha the Moon will afford delight to all the worlds consisting of oceans, mountains, forests and all creatures both mobile and immobile.

units.sanskrit: तेभ्यः पुष्टिं प्रजाश् चैव दास्यन्ति पितरः सदा ॥
units.english: The Pitris will always confer nourishment and progeny upon those men, who desirous of nourishment, will perform Srāddhas.

units.sanskrit: श्राद्धे च ये प्रदास्यन्ति त्रीन् पिण्डान् नामगोत्रतः । सर्वत्र वर्तमानांस् तान् पितरः सपितामहाः । भावयिष्यन्ति सततं श्राद्धदानेन पूजिताः ॥
units.english: Being propitiated with oblations afforded at Srāddhas, the Pitris with the Omnipresent Grand-Father will advance the prosperity of those who will offer three Pindas uttering their names and Gotras at the time of Srāddha.

units.sanskrit: एवम् आज्ञा कृता पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । इति तद् वचनं सत्यं भवत्व् अद्य दिवौकसः । पुत्राश् च पितरश् चैव वयं सर्वे परस्परम् ॥
units.english: This order was formerly announced by Parameshthi Brahmā. Let his words prove true to-day, gods, and we are now respectively fathers and sons.

units.sanskrit: त एते पितरो देवा देवाश् च पितरस् तथा । अन्योन्यपितरो ह्य् एते देवाश् च पितरश् च ह ॥ सनत्कुमारेण पुनः पृष्टवान् देवम् अव्ययम् ॥ संदेहम् अमरश्रेष्ठं भगवन्तम् अरिंदम । निबोध तन् मे गाङ्गेय निखिलं सर्वम् आदितः ॥ कियन्तो वै पितृगणाः कस्मिंल् लोके च ते गणाः । वर्तन्ति देवप्रवरा देवानां सोमवर्धनाः ॥ सनत्कुमार उवाच सप्तैते जपतां श्रेष्ठ स्वर्गे पितृगणाः स्मृताः । चत्वारो मूर्तिमन्तो वै त्रय एषां अमूर्तयः ॥
units.english: Sanatkumar said:—Those Pitris are the gods and the gods are the gods, and they are respectively each other's fathers. Markandeya said:—Hear from me everything from the very beginning, son of Ganga, of my doubts which again referred to that reverend eternal deity Sanatkumar the foremost of immortals after having been addressed by that effulgent god of gods -. What is the number of those ancestral manes and in what region are they stationed? And where do live the leading gods who derive nourishment from Soma juice? Sanatkumar said:— foremost of those who perform sacrifices, it is laid down in Scriptures, that there are seven ancestral manes who all live in heaven. Of them four are with forms and three without them.

units.sanskrit: तेषां लोकं विसर्गं च कीर्तयिष्यामि तच् छृणु । प्रभावं च महत्त्वं च विस्तरेण तपोधन ॥
units.english: you having asceticism for your wealth, hear, will describe at length their region, creation, prowess and greatness.

units.sanskrit: धर्ममूर्तिधरास् तेषां त्रयो ये परमा गणाः । तेषां नामानि लोकांश् च कीर्तयिष्यामि तच् छृणु ॥
units.english: Of them the most excellent three assumed the form of Dharma virtue. Hear, shall describe their names and regions.

units.sanskrit: लोकाः सनातना नाम यत्र तिष्ठन्ति भास्वराः । अमूर्तयः पितृगणास् ते वै पुत्राः प्रजापतेः ॥
units.english: The regions, where the effulgent and formless ancestral manes, the sons of Prajāpati live, are designated as eternal.

units.sanskrit: विराजस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ वैराजा इति विश्रुताः । यजन्ति तान् देवगणा विधिदृष्टेन कर्मना ॥ एते वै योगविभ्रष्टा लोकान् प्राप्य सनातनान् । पुनर् युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥
units.english: foremost of the twice-born, the region of Virāja is known by the name of Vairāja. The celestials adore them with ceremonies laid down in Scriptures. These Brahmavādins, when they deviate from the paths of Yoga come down to Sanatana eternal regions and after the expiration of a thousand yugas they take their birth.

units.sanskrit: ते प्राप्य तां स्मृतिं भूयः सांख्ययोगम् अनुत्तमम् । यान्ति योगगतिं सिद्धाः पुनर् आवृत्तिदुर्लभाम् ॥
units.english: Then obtaining again the recollection of the most excellent Sānkhya Yoga and securing the consummate development of their powers they again attain to that Yoga state which it is so hard to acquire.

units.sanskrit: एते स्म पितरस् तात योगिनां योगवर्धनाः । आप्याययन्ति ये पूर्वं सोमं योगबलेन वै ॥
units.english: my child, they are the Pitris who enhance the ascetic powers of the Yogins and they, by their Yoga, propitiated Soma in the days of yore.

units.sanskrit: तस्माच् छ्राद्धानि देयानि योगिनां द्विजसत्तम । एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः सोमपानां अनुत्तमः ॥
units.english: Therefore Srāddhas should be performed particularly for the Yogins. This is the first creation of the high-souled drinkers of Soma.

units.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या मेना नाम महागिरेः । पत्नी हिमवतः श्रेष्ठा यस्या मैनाक उच्यते ॥
units.english: Their mind-begotten daughter Mena was the first wife of the mountain chief Himalaya. Her son was called Maināka.

units.sanskrit: मैनाकस्य सुतः श्रीमान् क्रौञ्चो नाम महागिरिः । पर्वतप्रवरः शुभ्रो नानारत्नसमाचितः ॥
units.english: His son was the effulgent great mountain Krauncha. This best of mountains was white and abounded in various sorts of jewels.

units.sanskrit: तिस्रः कन्यास् तु मेनायां जनयाम् आस शैलराट् । अपर्णाम् एकपर्णां च तृतीयाम् एकपाटलाम् ॥
units.english: The mountain-king begat on Mena three daughters, namely, Aparna, Ekaparnā—and the third was Ekapatāla.

units.sanskrit: तपश् चरन्त्यः सुमहद् दुश्चरं देवदानवैः । लोकान् संतापयाम् आसुस् तास् तिस्रः स्थाणुजंगमान् ॥
units.english: Having carried on hard austerities, which even the Gods and Dānavas cannot practise with difficulty, those three daughters disturbed all the worlds consisting of mobile and immobile creatures.

units.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधम् एकपर्णा तु पाटलं चैकपाटला । एका तत्र निराहारा तां माता प्रत्यषेधयत् । उ मा इति निषेधन्ती मातृस्नेहेन दुःखिता ॥
units.english: Ekaparnā used to live upon one leaf only and Ekapātala used to live upon one Patala flower only. And when Aparnā divorced from food began to carry on hard austerities, her mother, stricken with sorrow, consequent upon her motherly affection, prevented her, saying .

units.sanskrit: सा तथोक्ता तया मात्रा देवी दुष्चरचारिणी । उमेत्य् एवाभवत् ख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु सुन्दरी ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by her mother, that fair goddess, carrying on hard penances, became celebrated in the three worlds by the name of Uma.

units.sanskrit: तथैव नाम्ना तेनेह विश्रुता योगधर्मिणी । एतत् तु त्रिकुमारीकं जगत् स्थास्यति भार्गव । तपःशरीराः सर्वास् तास् तिस्रो योगबलान्विताः । सर्वाश् च ब्रह्मवादिन्यः सर्वाश् चैवोर्ध्वरेतसः ॥
units.english: She also became celebrated by the name of Yogadharmin. Bhargava, this world consisting of three maidens shall for ever exist. All the three were endued with yoga energy and bodies perfected by hard austerities. They were all conversant with the knowledge of Brahman and had controlled their carnal desires.

units.sanskrit: उमा तासां वरिष्ठा च ज्येष्ठा च वरवर्णिनी । महायोगबलोपेता महादेवम् उपस्थिता ॥
units.english: The beautiful Umā was the eldest and foremost of them. Gifted with great yoga powers she approached the Great Deity Siva.

units.sanskrit: असितस्यैकपर्णा तु देवलस्य महात्मनः । पत्नी दत्ता महाब्रह्मन् योगाचार्याय धीमते ॥
units.english: Ekaparnā was given away as a wife unto the high-souled, intelligent and the great Yogin and preceptor, the black Devala.

units.sanskrit: जैगीषव्यस्य तु तथा विद्धि ताम् एकपाटलाम् । एते चापि महाभागे योगाचार्याव् उपस्थिते ॥
units.english: Know Ekapātala as the wife of Jaigishavya. Those two noble maidens approached those two preceptors of yoga.

units.sanskrit: लोकाः सोमपदा नाम मरीचेर् यत्र वै सुताः । पितरो दिवि वर्तन्ते देवास् तान् भावयन्त्य् उत । अग्निष्वात्ता इति ख्याताः सर्व एवामितौजसः ॥
units.english: The celestials offer watery oblations for all those regions of Somayagins that are called Somapadā and where dwell the sons and ancestral manes of the Patriarch Marichi. They all pass by the name of Agnisvatta and are gifted with immeasurable energy.

units.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या अच्छोदा नाम निम्नगा । अच्छोदं नाम तद् दिव्यं सरो यस्याः समुत्थितम् ॥
units.english: They have a mind-born daughter by name Achhodā who travels underneath. From that river has sprung a lake by the name of Achhoda.

units.sanskrit: तया न दृष्टपूर्वास् ते पितरस् तु कदाचन । अप्यमूर्तान् अथ पितॄन् सा ददर्श शुचिस्मिता । संभूता मानसी तेषां पितॄन् स्वान् नाभिजानती । व्रीडिता तेन दुःखेन बभूव वरवर्णिनी । सा दृष्ट्वा पितरं वव्रे वसुं नामान्तरिक्षगम् । नाम्ना वसुम् इति ख्यातम् आयोः पुत्रं यशस्विनम् ॥
units.english: She had never seen her ancestral manes before. That one of beautiful smiles thou saw her bodiless ancestral manes. She was begotten of their mind and did not know her. For this misfortune that beautiful damsel was greatly ashamed. Beholding the ancestral mane Vasu, the illustrious son of Ayu by the name of Amāvasu, who was passing through the etherial region in a car along with the Apsarā Adrikā, she thought of him first –.

units.sanskrit: सा तेन व्यभिचारेण मनसः कामचारिणी । पितरं प्रार्थयित्वान्यं योगभ्रष्टा पपात ह ॥
units.english: On account of her this frailty, that she thought of another and not her own father, that one capable of assuming forms of her will lost her Yoga power and fell down.

units.sanskrit: त्रीण्य् अपश्यद् विमानानि पतमाना दिवश् च्युता । त्रसरेणुप्रमाणानि सापश्यत् तेषु तान् पितॄन् ॥
units.english: When she fell down from the celestial region she behold three cars of the size of Esarenu and espied in them her ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: सुसूक्ष्मान् अपरिव्यक्तान् अग्नीन् अग्निष्व् इवाहितान् । त्रायध्वं इत्य् उवाचार्ता पतन्ती तान् अवाक्शिराः ॥ तैर् उक्ता सा तु मा भैषीर् इति व्योम्नि व्यवस्थिता । ततः प्रसादयाम् आस स्वान् पितॄन् दीनया गिरा ॥
units.english: They looked exceedingly subtle, indistinct and like fire offered into clarified butter. While she was in distress and falling down with her head downwards she exclaimed Save me. The ancestral manes stationed on the cars said to their girl who was in the etherial region do not fear. Then with purely words she began to propitiate the ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: ऊचुस् ते पितरः कन्यां भ्रष्टैश्वर्यां व्यतिक्रमात् । भ्रष्टैश्वर्या स्वदोषेण पतसि त्वं शुचिस्मिते ॥
units.english: The ancestral manes then said to that girl who was divested of all her merits on account of this transgression:— thou of pure smiles, for thy own folly, thou hast been divested of all thy merits.

units.sanskrit: यैः क्रियन्ते हि कर्माणि शरीरैर् दिवि दैवतैः । तैर् एव तत्कर्मफलं प्राप्नुवन्तीह देवताः ॥
units.english: The celestials attain, in heaven, to the fruits of their actions which they perform with their bodies in this world.

units.sanskrit: सद्यः फलन्ति कर्माणि देवत्वे प्रेत्य मानुषे । यानि कर्माणि देवत्वे तानि सन्त्य् एव मानुषे । तस्मात् त्वं तपसः पुत्रि प्रेत्येह प्राप्स्यसे फलम् ॥
units.english: Sometimes the celestials, by their mere determination attain to the fruits of their actions but mankind reap them only when they repair to the next world. Therefore, daughter, by practising hard austerities in this world thou shalt reap the fruits thereof in the next.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्ता पितृभिः सा तु पितॄन् स्वान् संप्रसादयत् । ध्यात्वा प्रसादं ते चक्रुस् तस्याः सर्वे ऽनुकम्पया ॥
units.english: Thus accosted by her own Pitris the maiden began propitiating them. Then realising the truth in their own minds, they all, out of compassion, became pleased with her.

units.sanskrit: अवश्यंभाविनं ज्ञात्वा ते ऽर्थम् ऊचुस् ततश् च ताम् । तस्य राज्ञो वसोः कन्या त्वम् अपत्यं भविष्यसि । उत्पन्नस्य पृथिव्यां तु मानुषेषु महात्मनः । कन्यैव भूत्वा लोकान् स्वान् पुनः प्राप्स्यसि दुर्लभान् ॥
units.english: Knowing that all this is inevitable they asked that maiden to act in that way and said to her:—Thou shalt be born as the daughter of the high-souled king Vasu who is born on earth among men. Being born as his daughter thou shalt again attain to thy own regions which it is so hard to gain -.

units.sanskrit: पराशरस्य दायादं त्वं विप्रं जनयिष्यसि । स वेदम् एकं ब्रह्मर्षिश् चतुर्धा विभजिष्यति ॥
units.english: Thou shalt give birth to the illustrious son of Parāshara. That great Brāhmana saint shall divide the one Veda into four parts.

units.sanskrit: महाभिषस्य पुत्रौ च शंतनोः कीर्तिवर्धनौ । विचित्रवीर्यं धर्मज्ञं तथा चित्राङ्गदं प्रभुम् ॥ एतान् उत्पाद्य पुत्रांस् त्वं पुनर् लोकान् अवाप्स्यसि । व्यतिक्रमात् पितॄणां च जन्म प्राप्स्यसि कुत्सितम् ॥
units.english: Two sons, the illustrious and pious Vichitravirya and Chitrangada, will be born unto the king Shāntanu, who was in another birth the king Mahābhisha. Having given birth to these sons thou shalt again attain to thy own regions. On account of thy transgressions towards thy ancestral manes thou shalt come by these inferior births -.

units.sanskrit: तस्यैव राज्ञस् त्वं कन्या अद्रिकायां भविष्यसि । अष्टाविंशे भवित्री त्वं द्वापरे मत्स्ययोनिजा ॥
units.english: Thou shalt be begotten as his daughter by this king on his wife Adrikā. In the eighteenth Dwāpara cycle thou shalt be born as a fish.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु दासेयी जाता सत्यवती तदा । मत्स्ययोनौ अनुपमा राज्ञस् तस्य वसोः सुता ॥
units.english: Thus spoken to by her ancestral manes that maiden was born in Dasha family as Satyavati. First born as a fish she became the daughter of the king Vasu.

units.sanskrit: बैभ्राजा नाम ते लोका दिवि भान्ति सुदर्शनाः । यत्र बर्हिषदो नाम पितरो दिवि विष्रुताः ॥
units.english: The picturesque region Vaibhrāja, where dwell the Pitris celebrated in heaven as Varhishadas, is situate in Dyuloka.

units.sanskrit: तान् दानवगणाः सर्वे यक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसाः । नागाः सर्पाः सुपर्णाश् च भावयन्त्य् अमितौजसः ॥
units.english: The highly effulgent celestials, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Rakshasas, Nāgas, Sarpas serpents, Suparnas birds offer oblations for the attainment of those regions.

units.sanskrit: एते पुत्रा महात्मानः पुलस्त्यस्य प्रजापतेः । महात्मानो महाभागास् तेजोयुक्तास् तपस्विनः ॥
units.english: They are the offspring of the high-souled Patriarch Pulastya. They were all great, highly meritorious, energetic and used to carry on ascetic observances.

units.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या पीवरी नाम विश्रुता । योगा च योगपत्नी च योगमाता तथैव च । भवित्री द्वापरं प्राप्य युगं धर्मभृतां वरा ॥ पराशरकुलोद्भूतः शुको नाम महातपाः । भविष्यति युगे तस्मिन् महायोगी द्विजर्षभः । व्यासाद् अरण्यां संभूतो विधूमो ऽग्निर् इव ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: Their mind-born daughter was known as Pivari. She was herself a great ascetic, the wife of an ascetic, and the mother of an ascetic –. you foremost of the pious, at the commencement of Dwāpara Yuga, the great ascetic and Yogin Suka, the foremost of Brāhmanas born in the race of Parashara, will take birth in that Yuga. He will be begotten by Vyasa on Arani like fire divested of smoke –.

units.sanskrit: स तस्यां पितृकन्यायां पीवर्यां जनयिष्यति । कन्यां पुत्रांश् च चतुरो योगाचार्यान् महाबलान् ॥
units.english: He will beget on that daughter of the ancestral manes four sons, viz, the highly powerful Yoga-teacher Krishna, Goura, Prabhu and Shambhu, and a daughter by name Kritwā, who will be the mother of Brahmadatta and the queen of king Anuha –.

units.sanskrit: आदित्यकिरणोपेतम् अपुनर् मार्गम् आस्थितः । आदित्यरश्मिभिः पीतो ह्य् अपुनर् वारम् एष्यति । यत् तत् पदम् अनुद्विग्नम् अव्ययं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् । अमूर्तिमन्तः पितरो धर्ममूर्तिधरा मुने । कथा यत्र समुत्पन्ना वृष्ण्यन्धककुलान्वया ॥
units.english: Having begotten these vow-observing teachers of Yoga and listened to various forms of religion from his own sire Vyasa, the immeasurably intelligent, pious and ascetic Rishi Suka repaired to the region from where no one returns—the eternal, undecaying region of Brahman shorn of all troubles, where reside the shape-less Pitris in the form of virtue, and where has originated this theme of Vrishnis and Andhakas –.

units.sanskrit: सुकाला नाम पितरो वसिष्ठस्य प्रजापतेः । निरता देवलोकेषु ज्योतिर्भासिषु भार्गव । सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु द्विजास् तान् भावयन्त्य् उत ॥ तेषां वै मानसी कन्या गौर् नाम दिवि विश्रुता । तवैव वंशे या दत्ता शुकस्य महिषी द्विज ॥ एकशृङ्गा इति ख्याता साध्यानां कीर्तिवर्धनी । मरीचिगर्भान् सा लोकान् समावृत्य व्यवस्थिता ॥ ये त्व् अथाङ्गिरसः पुत्राः साध्यैः संवर्धिताः पुरा । उपहूताः स्मृतास् ते वै पितरो भास्वरा दिवि । तान् क्षत्रियगणास् तात भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः ॥
units.english: The ancestral manes of the Patriarch Vasishtha, known as Sukātas, live eternally in heaven and the region lighted by the effulgence that grants the consummation of all desires. The Brāhmanas always offer them oblations. Their mind born daughter is known as Go in the region of celestials, who will be given in marriage to your family and be the other beloved wife of Suka. The Sādhyas have a well-known daughter, ever enhancing their fame, by name Ekashringā. She lives in the regions effulgent like the rays of the Sun. The Kshatriyas, who wish to reap the fruits of their actions, propitiate the sons of Angiras, who had formerly been rendered prosperous by Sāddhyas.

units.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या यशोदा नाम विश्रुता । राजर्षेर् जननी तात दिलीपस्य महात्मनः ॥ तस्य यज्ञे पुरा गीता गाथाः प्रीतैर् महर्षिभिः । तदा देवयुगे तात वाजिमेधे महामखे ॥
units.english: Their mind-born daughter is known as Yashodā –. She was the wife of Vishwamahata, daughter-in-law of Vriddhasharmā and the mother of the high-souled royal saint Dilipa. my son, formerly in the cycle of gods, at the great horse-sacrifice of the king Dilipa the great saints chanted various themes with joy.

units.sanskrit: अग्नेर् जन्म तथा श्रुत्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः । दिलीपं यजमानं ये पश्यन्ति सुसमाहिताः । सुस्वधा नाम पितरः कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । समुत्पन्नस्य पुलहान् महात्मानो द्विजर्षभाः ॥
units.english: Hearing of the birth of Agni fire-god from some descendant of Shandili, those men, who will behold the truthful and high-souled performer of sacrifices Dilipa, will conquer the celestial region. The ancestral manes of the Patriarch Karddama, Sudhanwās by name, came into being from the noble Brāhmana Pulaha.

units.sanskrit: लोकेषु दिवि वर्तन्ते कामगेषु विहंगमाः । तांस् तु वैश्यगणास् तात भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः ॥
units.english: They, gifted with etherial movements, are living in the regions where the dwellers move about of their own will. The Vaishyas who wish to reap the fruits of their actions, offer oblations unto them.

units.sanskrit: तेषां वै मानसी कन्या विरजा नाम विश्रुता । ययातेर् जननी ब्रह्मन् महिषी नहुषस्य च ॥ त्रय एते गणाः प्रोक्ताश् चतुर्थं तु निबोध मे । उत्पन्ना ये स्वधायां तु सोमपा वै कवेः सुताः ॥ हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुताः शूद्रास् तान् भावयन्त्य् उत । मानसा नाम ते लोका यत्र वर्तन्ति ते दिवि ॥
units.english: Their mind-born daughter is celebrated by the name of Viraja. Brahman, she will be the mother of Yayati and the wife of Nahusha. Thus have described to you the three orders: hear from me of the fourth order. The drinkers of Soma juice, who were begotten on Swadhā the daughter of Kavi, were the offspring of Hiranyagarbha. The Sudras encompass their gratification. The etherial region where they dwell is called Mānasa.

units.sanskrit: तेषां वै मानसी कन्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा । या भावयति भूतानि दक्षिणापथगामिनी । पुरुकुत्सस्य सा भार्या त्रसद्दस्युश् च तत्सुतः । तेषाम् अथाभ्युपगमान् मनुस् तात युगे युगे । प्रवर्तयति श्राद्धानि नष्टे धर्मे प्रजापतिः ॥ पितॄणाम् आदिसर्गेण सर्वेषां द्विजसत्तम । तस्माद् एनं स्वधर्मेण श्राद्धदेवं वदन्ति वै ॥
units.english: Their mind-born daughter is Narmadā the foremost of streams. Traversing the southern way she is purifying the creatures. She is the wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trāsadasyu. The ancestral manes are to be adored—and when this is neglected at various cycles the Patriarch Manu introduces the performance of Srāddha in their honour. foremost of the twice-born, of all the ancestral manes Yama was first born and he protected all created beings by his own virtue. Therefore he is designated in the Vedas as Srāddhadeva.

units.sanskrit: सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रम् अथ वा रजतान्वितम् । दत्तं स्वधां पुरोधाय श्राद्धे प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् ॥
units.english: When after reciting the mystic formulae, oblation is offered in silver or silver-plated vessels to the ancestral manes it encompasses their gratification.

units.sanskrit: सोमस्याप्यायनं कृत्वा वह्नेर् वैवस्वतस्य च । उदगायनम् अप्य् अग्नाव् अग्न्यभावे ऽप्सु वा पुनः ॥
units.english: Having first propitiated Yama the son of Vivaswān and then Soma, one should offer oblation unto fire; and in the absence of fire unto water.

units.sanskrit: पितॄन् प्रीणाति यो भक्त्या पितरः प्रीणयन्ति तम् । यच्छन्ति पितरः पुष्टिं प्रजाश् च विपुलास् तथा । देवकार्याद् अपि मुने पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते । देवतानां हि पितरः पूर्वम् आप्यायनं स्मृतम् ॥
units.english: The ancestral manes are pleased with him who reverentially brings about their gratification, and confer upon him nourishment, innumerable offspring, wealth and all other desired-for objects. ascetic, the worship of the ancestral manes is preferred to that of the celestials –. It is ordained by scriptures that before the celestials the ancestral manes should be gratified.

units.sanskrit: शीघ्रप्रसादा ह्य् अक्रोधा लोकस्याप्यायनं परम् । स्थिरप्रसादाश् च सदा तान् नमस्यस्व भार्गव ॥ पितृभक्तो ऽसि विप्रर्षे सद्भक्तश् च न संशयः । श्रेयस् ते ऽद्य विधास्यामि प्रत्यक्षं कुरु तत् स्वयम् ॥
units.english: The latter are easily pleased, freed from anger and they confer the most excellent gratification on men. descendant of Bhrigu, the gratification of ancestral manes is ever constant. Therefore do thou bow unto them. Thou art ever devoted unto thy ancestral manes and specially unto me. shall do what conduces to thy well-being. Do thou witness it thyself.

units.sanskrit: चक्षुर् दिव्यं सविज्ञानं प्रदिशामि च ते ऽनघ । गतिम् एताम् अप्रमत्तो मार्कण्डेय निशामय ॥
units.english: sinless one, shall confer on thee celestial vision together with discriminative knowledge. Listen attentively, Markandeya, to the means thereof.

units.sanskrit: न हि योगगतिर् दिव्या न पितॄणां परा गतिः । त्वद्विधेनापि सिद्धेन दृश्यते मांसचक्षुषा ॥
units.english: This is not the Yoga state of the celestials but the most excellent state of the celestials. Such persons of consummate ascetic powers behold me with their own eyes.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा स देवेशो माम् उपस्थितम् अग्रतः । चक्षुर् दत्त्वा सविज्ञानं देवानाम् अपि दुर्लभम् । जगाम गतिम् इष्टां वै द्वितीयो ऽग्निर् इव ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: Having thus spoken to me who was present before him and conferred upon me celestial vision together with discriminative knowledge, which even the celestials can with difficulty acquire, the Lord of celestials Sanatkumar repaired to his wished-for region like the second burning fire –.

units.sanskrit: तन् निबोध कुरुश्रेष्ठ यन् मयासीन् निशामितम् । प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य दुर्ज्ञेयं भुवि मानुषैः ॥
units.english: foremost of Kurus, hear now, what had heard, by the favour of that God—things above the comprehension of men in this world.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच आसन् पूर्वयुगे तात भरद्वाजात्मजा द्विजाः । योगधर्मम् अनुप्राप्य भ्रष्टा दुश्चरितेन वै ॥ अपभ्रंशम् अनुप्राप्ता योगधर्मापचारिणः । महतस् तमसः पारे मानसस्य विसंज्ञिताः ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:— my child, in the previous Yuga, the Brāhmanas, the sons of Bharadwāja, although carrying on Yoga practices, were polluted by their transgressions. On account of their degradation consequent upon the violation of Yoga practices they will remain in an unconscious state on the other side of the huge lake called Mānasa.

units.sanskrit: तम् एवार्थम् अनुध्यान्तो नष्टम् अप्स्व् इव मोहिताः । अप्राप्य योगं ते सर्वे संयुक्ताः कालधर्मणा ॥
units.english: Stupified by the thought that the transgressions they had committed had been washed away and having failed to attain to the state of union with Brahman they became invested with the characteristics of time.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते योगविभ्रष्टा देवेषु सुचिरोषिताः । जाताः कौशिकदायादाः कुरुक्षेत्रे नरर्षभ ॥
units.english: And although they had deviated from the path of Yoga, they lived for a long time in the land of celestials. They will be born in the land of Kurus as foremost of men, the sons of Kushika.

units.sanskrit: हिंसया विचरिष्यन्तो धर्मं पितृकृतेन वै । ततस् ते पुनर् आजातिं भ्रष्टाः प्राप्स्यन्ति कुत्सितां ॥
units.english: They will carry on religious practices by slaying creatures for the ancestral manes. And again being thus degraded they will come by the most inferior birth.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पितृप्रसादेन पूर्वजातिकृतेन च । स्मृतिर् उत्पत्स्यते प्राप्य तां तां जातिं जुगुप्सिताम् ॥
units.english: On account of the favour of ancestral manes and their pristine birth they will have recollection of those inferior births.

units.sanskrit: ते धर्मचारिणो नित्यं भविष्यन्ति समाहिताः । ब्राह्मण्यं प्रतिलप्स्यन्ति ततो भूयः स्वकर्मणा ॥ ततश् च योगं प्राप्स्यन्ति पूर्वजातिकृतं पुनः । एवं धर्मे च ते बुद्धिर् भविष्यति पुनः पुनः । योगधर्मे च निरतः प्राप्स्यसे सिद्धिम् उत्तमाम् ॥
units.english: They will be of controlled minds and always carry on religious practices. And again by their own Karma they will acquire the status of Brāhmanas. They will then acquire the knowledge of unification of the human soul with the divine soul on account of their pristine birth. And then having attained perfection again they will acquire the eternal region. Thus you will repeatedly pay attention towards religion and acquire a most consummate mastery of Yoga.

units.sanskrit: योगो हि दुर्लभो नित्यम् अल्पप्रज्ञैः कदाचन । लब्ध्वापि नाशयन्त्य् एनं व्यसनैः कटुतामिताः ॥
units.english: It is very difficult for men of limited understanding to acquire mastery of Yoga. If they happen to acquire it, that even is destroyed on account of their being contaminated by vices.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा योगं योगो वै दुर्लभो भुवि ॥
units.english: Those who commit iniquities and torture their elders also lose their Yoga.

units.sanskrit: प्रशान्ताश् च जितक्रोधा मानाहंकारवर्जिताः । कल्याणभाजनं ये तु ते भवन्ति यतव्रताः ॥
units.english: Persons of quiescent souls, who have mastered anger, who are shorn of egotism and pride and who are observant of vows, are crowned with blessings.

units.sanskrit: एवंविधास् तु ते तात ब्राह्मणा ह्य् अभवंस् तदा । ध्यानाध्ययनयुक्ताश् च शान्ते वर्त्मनि संस्थिताः । शान्तिं ते परमाम् आशु लभन्ते नात्र संशयः । तस्मात् त्वम् अपि धर्मज्ञ योगधर्मपरो भव । वरिष्ठं सर्वधर्माणां तं समाचर भार्गव ॥
units.english: Such were the Brāhmanas of that period -. They used to remember their follies consequent upon their mistakes, engage in study and meditation and walk in the path of peace There is no other religious rite, you conversant with religion, superior to Yoga. It reigns supreme over all other religious observances. Practise it therefore, descendant of Bhrigu.

units.sanskrit: कालस्य परिणामेन लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः । तत्परः प्रयतः श्राद्धी योगधर्मम् अवाप्स्यसि । इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
units.english: With the advancement of years, one, who lives upon restricted diet, who has mastered his senses and who is respectful, acquires Yoga. Having said this the reverend Sanatkumāra disappeared therefrom.

units.sanskrit: उपासतश् च देवेशं वर्षाण्य् अष्टादशैव मे ॥ प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य न ग्लानिर् अभवत् तदा । न क्षुत्पिपासे कालं वा जानामि स्म तदानघ । पश्चाच् छिष्यसकाशात् तु कालः संविदितो मम ॥
units.english: Eighteen years appeared to me as one day. Having worshipped that lord of deities for eighteen years, by the grace of that divine person, did not suffer any pain. sinless one, did not feel then hunger and thirst nor the progress of time. Afterwards learnt about time from my disciple.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तस्मिन्न् अन्तर्हिते देवे वचनात् तस्य वै विभो । चक्षुर् दिव्यं सविज्ञानं प्रादुर् आसीन् ममानघ ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:—After the disappearance of that deity and according to the words of that lord, acquired discriminative knowledge along with celestial vision.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽहं तान् अपश्यं वै ब्राह्मणान् कौशिकात्मजान् । आपगेय कुरुक्षेत्रे यान् उवाच विभुर् मम ॥
units.english: Thereupon, son of Gangā, saw at Kurukshetra, all those Brāhmanas, the descendants of Koushika of whom that lord Sanatkumār spoke to me.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तो ऽभवद् राजा यस् तेषां सप्तमो द्विजः । पितृवर्तीति विख्यातो नाम्ना शीलेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Of them the seventh Brāhmana became the king Brahmadatta. By his name, character and action he also became celebrated by the name Pitridatta.

units.sanskrit: शुकस्य कन्या कृत्वी तं जनयाम् आस पार्थिवम् । अणुहात् पार्थिवश्रेष्ठात् काम्पिल्ये नगरोत्तमे ॥
units.english: In an excellent city by name Kāmpilya, the foremost of kings Anuha begat that monarch on Suka's daughter Kritvi.

units.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच यथोवाच महाभागो मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः । युधिष्ठिर उवाच अणुहः कस्य वै पुत्रः कस्मिन् काले बभूव ह । राजा धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो यस्य पुत्रो महायशाः ॥ ब्रह्मदत्तो नरपतिः किंवीर्यश् च बभूव ह । कथं च सप्तमस् तेषां संबभूव नराधिपः ॥
units.english: Bhishma said:— king, hear shall describe the family of that king as recounted by the highly regenerate great Rishi Mārkandeya. Yudhisthira said:—Whose son was Anuha, the foremost of the pious? In what age was he born? How powerful was he? Whose son was the highly illustrious king Brahmadatta? How did the seventh Brāhmana become a king -? Certainly the self-controlled, omnipotent sage Suka, respected by all the world, did not give away his illustrious daughter Kritvi to an effeminate person.

units.sanskrit: एतद् इच्छाम्य् अहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महाद्युते । ब्रह्मदत्तस्य चरितं तद् भवान् वक्तुम् अर्हति ॥
units.english: thou of great effulgence, wish to hear at length the account of Brahmadatta; it behoves thee to describe it.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयेन कथितास् तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे ॥
units.english: Do thou describe unto me how the Brāhmanas, mentioned by Mārkandeya, are living in the world.

units.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच प्रतीपस्य स राजर्षे तुल्यकालो नराधिपः । पितामहस्य मे राजन् बभूवेति मया श्रुतम् ॥
units.english: Bhishma said:— have heard that this king Brahmadatta was contemporary of my grand-father the royal saint Pratipa.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तो महाराजो योगी राजर्षिसत्तमः । रुतज्ञः सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥
units.english: The noble ascetic Brahmadatta, the foremost of royal saints, was grateful unto all creatures and engaged in their well-being.

units.sanskrit: सखा हि गालवो यस्य योगाचार्यो महायशाः । शिक्षां उत्पाद्य तपसा क्रमो येन प्रवर्तितः । कण्डरीकश् च योगात्मा तस्यैव सचिवो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: He made that division of the Vedas which is called Sikshā by means of his Tapas and instituted an order of study. The highly illustrious teacher of Yoga, Gālava, was his friend and the ascetic Kandarik was his minister.

units.sanskrit: जात्यन्तरेषु सर्वेषु सहायाः सर्व एव ते । सप्तजातिषु सप्तैव बभूवुर् अमितौजसः । यथोवाच महातेजा मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः ॥
units.english: In another birth they all help each other. As narrated by the noble and great ascetic Mārkandeya they, in the seventh birth, were all gifted with unlimited energy.

units.sanskrit: तस्य वंशम् अहं राजन् कीर्तयिष्यामि तच् छृणु । ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पौराणं पौरवस्य महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Hear, king, shall describe to you the ancient family of the high-souled king Brahmadatta born in the race of Puru.

units.sanskrit: बृहत्क्षत्रस्य दायादः सुहोत्रो नाम धार्मिकः । सुहोत्रस्यापि दायादो हस्ती नाम बभूव ह । तेनेदं निर्मितं पूर्वं पुरं वै हस्तिनापुरम् ॥
units.english: The pious son of Vrihatkshetra was celebrated by the name of Suhotra. Suhotra's son was known by the name of Hasti. By him in the days of yore the most excellent city of Hastināpur was founded.

units.sanskrit: हस्तिनश् चापि दायादास् त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः । अजमीढो द्विमीढश् च पुरमीढस् तथैव च । आसीद् बृहदिषोः पुत्रो बृहद्धर्मेति विश्रुतः । बृहद्धर्मेति विख्यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः ॥
units.english: Hasti had three highly pious sons. Of them the eldest was Ajāmida, the second Dwimida and the youngest Paramida. Ajāmida begat on Dhumini the king Vrihadishu whose son was the highly illustrious Vrihaddhanu. His son Vrihadbharma was known as a highly pious king.

units.sanskrit: सत्यजित् तस्य तनयो विश्वजित् तस्य चात्मजः । पुत्राः सेनजितश् चासंश् चत्वारो लोकसंमताः । रुचिरः श्वेतकाश्यश् च महिम्नारस् तथैव च । रुचिरस्य तु दायादः पृथुषेणो महायशाः । पृथुषेणस्य पारस् तु पारान् नीपो ऽथ जज्ञिवान् ॥
units.english: His son was Satyajit whose son was Viswajit. His son was the king Senajit who had four sons celebrated in the world. Ruchira, Swetaketu, Mahim nāra and Vatsa, the king of Avanti—these were his four sons. Ruchira's son was the highly illustrious Prithusena whose son was Pāra, from whom was born Neepa.

units.sanskrit: नीपस्यैकशतं तात पुत्राणाम् अमितौजसाम् । महारथानां राजेन्द्र शूराणां बाहुशालिनाम् । नीपा इति समाख्याता राजानः सर्व एव ते ॥
units.english: Neepa had a hundred sons who all were of unlimited energy, mighty car-warriors, heroic and powerful. All these kings were known by the name of Neepa.

units.sanskrit: काम्पिल्ये समरो नाम स चेष्टसमरो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: The illustrious descendant of those Neepas was known as Samara in the Province of Kāmpilya.

units.sanskrit: समरस्य पुरः पारः सदश्व इति ते त्रयः । पुत्राः परमधर्मज्ञाः पारपुत्रः पृथुर् बभौ ॥ पृथोस् तु सुकृतो नाम सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा । विभ्राजस्य तु पुत्रो ऽभूद् अणुहो नाम पार्थिवः । बभौ शुकस्य जामाता कृत्वीभर्ता महायशाः ॥
units.english: Samara had three sons—Para, Pāra and Sadashwa, who were all greatly pious. Para's son was Prithu. Prithu's son was Sukrita, who, by good actions, was endued with all accomplishments. His son was Vibhrāja. His son was the king Anuha. He was the illustrious son-in-law of Suka and the husband of Kritvi.

units.sanskrit: पुत्रो ऽणुहस्य राजर्षिर् ब्रह्मदत्तो ऽभवत् प्रभुः । योगात्मा तस्य तनयो विष्वक्सेनः परंतपः ॥
units.english: Anuha's son was the royal saint Brahmadatta. His son was the ascetic Viswaksena, the subduer of foes.

units.sanskrit: विभ्राजः पुनर् आजातः सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा । ब्रह्मदत्तस्य तनयो विष्वक्सेन इति श्रुतः ॥
units.english: By his own actions Vibhrāja was again born as the son of Brahmadatta. He had another son by the name of Sarvasena.

units.sanskrit: चक्षुषी तस्य निर्भिन्ने पक्षिण्या पूजनीयया । सुचिरोषितया राजन् ब्रह्मदत्तस्य वेश्मनि । विष्वक्सेनस्य पुत्रो ऽभूद् दण्डसेनो महीपतिः । भल्लाटश् च कुमारो ऽभूद् राधेयेन हतः पुरा ॥ दण्डसेनात्मजः शूरो महात्मा कुलवर्धनः । भल्लाटपुत्रो दुर्बुद्धिर् अभवज् जनमेजयः ॥
units.english: His eyes, king, were torn by a sparrow known by the name of Pujanyā worshipful that lived in the house of Brahmadatta for a long time. Brahmadatta had an other highly powerful son by the name of Viswaksena. His son was the king Dandasena. His son was Bhattata who was formerly killed by Karna. This son of Dandasena was heroic and perpetuated his race. Yudhishthira, Bhattata's son was evil-minded.

units.sanskrit: स तेषाम् अभवद् राजा नीपानाम् अन्तकृन् नृपः । उग्रायुधेन यस्यार्थे सर्वे नीपा विनाशिताः ॥
units.english: king, he brought about the fall of the house of Neepas. For him all the Neepas were destroyed by Ugrayudha. have killed Ugrāyudha, in battle, on account of his being elated with pride.

units.sanskrit: दर्पान्वितो दर्परुचिः सततं चानये रतः ॥
units.english: He was proud and took delight in haughtiness and sinful ways.

units.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उग्रायुधः कस्य सुतः कस्मिन् वंशे ऽथ जज्ञिवान् । भीष्म उवाच अजमीढस्य दायादो विद्वान् राजा यवीनरः । धृतिमांस् तस्य पुत्रस् तु तस्य सत्यधृतिः सुतः ॥
units.english: Yudhisthira said:—Whose son was Ugrayudha? And in whose family was he born? For what did you kill him? Tell me all this. Bhishma said:—Ajamida's son was the learned king Yavinara. His son was Dhritimān whose son was Satyadhriti.

units.sanskrit: आसीत् सुधर्मणः पुत्रः सार्वभौमः प्रजेश्वरः । सार्वभौम इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां एकराट् तदा ॥
units.english: His son was the powerful Dridanemi whose son was the king Sudharmā. His son was the king Sārvabhouma. He was the only Lord Paramount of the world and was therefore called Sārvabhouma.

units.sanskrit: तस्यान्ववाये महति महान् पौरवनन्दनः । महतश् चापि पुत्रस् तु नाम्ना रुक्मरथः स्मृतः ॥
units.english: In his family was born Mahān, the descendant of Puru. Mahān's son was known as the king Rukmaratha.

units.sanskrit: पुत्रो रुक्मरथस्यापि सुपार्श्वो नाम पार्थिवः । जज्ञे संनतिमान् राजा संनतिर् नाम वीर्यवान् ॥ तस्य वै संनतेः पुत्रः कार्तो नाम महाबलः । शिष्यो हिरण्यनाभस्य कौसल्यस्य महात्मनः । चतुर्विंशतिधा तेन प्रोक्तास् ताः सामसंहिताः । स्मृतास् ते प्राच्यसामानः कार्ता नाम्ना तु सामगाः ॥
units.english: His son was the king Supārshwa, whose son was the pious Sumati. His son was the virtuous-souled and powerful Sannati. His son was the valiant king Krita. He was the disciple of the high-souled Hiranyanābha. By him the Sanhita of the Sāma Veda has been sung in twenty-four ways. For this reason the western Saman and the chanters thereof are known under the appellation of Kārti.

units.sanskrit: कार्तिर् उग्रायुधः सो ऽथ वीरः पौरवनन्दनः । बभूव येन विक्रम्य पृषतस्य पितामहः । नीपो नाम महाराज पाञ्चालाधिपतिर् हतः ॥
units.english: Krita’s son was the heroic Ugrayudha, born in the race of Puru. By displaying his prowess he slew the highly energetic king of Pānchala, Neepa by name, the grand-father of Prishata.

units.sanskrit: क्षेम्यात् सुवीरो नृपतिः सुवीरात् तु नृपंजयः । नृपंजयाद् बहुरथ इत्य् एते पौरवाः स्मृताः । स चाप्य् उग्रायुधस् तात दुर्बुद्धिर् वैरकृत् सदा । राजकन्यां जहाराथ मुनिपत्नीप्रधर्षकः । स दर्पपूर्णो हत्वाजौ नीपान् अन्यांश् च पार्थिवान् । उग्रायुधस्य राजेन्द्र दूतो ऽभ्येत्य वयो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ अद्य त्वं जननीं भीष्म गन्धकालीं यशस्विनीं । स्त्रीरत्नं मम भार्यार्थे प्रयच्छ कुरुपुंगव ॥ त्वया राज्ये च ते स्थितिम् । प्रदास्यामि यथाकामम् अहं वै रत्नभाग् भुवि ॥
units.english: Ugrāyudha's son was the highly illustrious king Kshemya, whose son was Suvira and whose son was Nripanjaya. From Nripanjaya was born Vahuratha—all these kings are called Pauravas. my son, Ugrayudha grew highly vicious. Having burnt down all the Neepas he brought about their extinction. Slaying all the Neepas and other kings he was filled with pride. After the death of my father he told me many sinful words. king, while was lying down on earth encircled by my courtiers Ugrāyudha's messenger came to me and said:— foremost of Kurus, do thou give me thy illustrious mother Gandhakāli, the jewel of a female, as my wife –. Forsooth shall confer upon thee a prosperous kingdom and riches. have acquired jewels, according to my desire, on earth.

units.sanskrit: राष्ट्रस्येच्छसि चेत् स्वस्ति प्राणानां वा कुलस्य वा । शासने मम तिष्ठस्व न हि ते शान्तिर् अन्यथा ॥ अधः प्रस्तारशयने शयानस् तेन चोदितः । दूतान्तरितम् एतद् वै वाक्यम् अग्निशिखोपमम् ॥ शरीरं मे ऽदहत् तस्य वाक्यं चैतद् दुरात्मनः । ततो ऽहं तस्य दुर्बुद्धेर् विज्ञाय मतम् अच्युत । विचित्रवीर्यं बालं च मदपाश्रयम् एव च । दृष्ट्वा क्रोधपरीतात्मा युद्धायैव मनो दधे ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, by merely hearing of this my effulgent and irrepressible discus or at the very sight of it the enemies fly away from the field of battle. If dost thou seek thy kingdom, life and the well-being of thy family, obey my command or else thou shalt have no peace. heard these words resembling the flames of fire from the messenger despatched by him while was lying down on earth on a Kuçā bed. undeteriorating one, thus informed of the desire of that vicious-minded one, ordered my commander-in-chief to undertake a war. As Vichitravirja was a boy and under my protection, was filled with rage and made up my mind for engaging in a war.

units.sanskrit: निगृहीतस् तदाहं तु सचिवैर् मन्त्रकोविदैः । ऋत्विग्भिर् देवकल्पैश् च सुहृद्भिर् नरपुंगव ॥ स्निग्धैश् च शास्त्रविद्भिश् च संयुगस्य निवर्तने । मन्त्रिण ऊचुः प्रवृत्तचक्रः पापो ऽसौ त्वं चाशौचगतः प्रभो । न चैष प्रथमः कल्पो युद्धं नाम कदाचन ॥
units.english: But, sinless one, all my ministers, well-versed in counsels, the god-like Ritwikas, well-meaning friends and companions well-read in scriptures, all requested me to desist and pointed out sound reasonings too –. The ministers said:— lord, this vicious-souled Ugrāvudha is carrying on the work of devastation and thou, too, art impure. So thou shouldst not undertake a war as thy first work.

units.sanskrit: ते वयं साम पूर्वं वै दानं भेदं तथैव च । प्रयोक्ष्यामस् ततः शुद्धो दैवतान्य् अभिवाद्य च ॥ कृतस्वस्त्ययनो विप्रैर् हुत्वाग्नीन् वाच्य च द्विजान् । ब्राह्मणैर् अभ्यनुज्ञातः प्रयास्यसि जयाय वै ॥
units.english: We shall first resort to the expedients of conciliation, gifts and sowing dissension. And afterwards when thou shalt be pure, thou shouldst bow unto the gods, make the Brāhmanas perform benedictorv rites and then having saluted them and obtained their permission, thou shouldst set out for victory –.

units.sanskrit: अस्त्राणि न प्रयोज्यानि न प्रवेश्यश् च संगरः । आशौचे वर्तमानेन वृद्धानाम् इति शासनम् ॥
units.english: It has been laid down by the elderly sages that a man, when he is in mourning, should not take up a weapon or enter into a contract.

units.sanskrit: सामदानादिभिः पूर्वम् अपि भेदेन वा ततः । तं हनिष्यसि विक्रम्य शम्बरं मघवान् इव ॥
units.english: First thou shouldst try the expedient of conciliation and gift and then try to sow dissension. And afterwards thou shouldst slay him, manifesting thy prowess, as Indra killed the demon Samvara.

units.sanskrit: प्राज्ञानां वचनं काले वृद्धानां च विशेषतः । श्रोतव्यम् इति तच् छ्रुत्वा निवृत्तो ऽस्मि नराधिप ॥
units.english: king, the words of the elderly sages should be obeyed in proper time. Hearing this desisted from fightlng.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तैः स क्रमः सर्वः प्रयुक्तः शास्त्रकोविदैः । तस्मिन् काले कुरुश्रेष्ठ कर्म चारब्धम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon those ministers, well-versed in counsels, tried all the expedients. foremost of Kurus, at that time the most excellent work began.

units.sanskrit: स सामादिभिर् अप्य् आदाव् उपायैः शास्त्रचिन्तकैः । अनुनीयमानो दुर्बुद्धिर् अनुनेतुं न शक्यते ॥
units.english: Although solicited by the expedients of conciliation and others settled upon by the sages that wicked-minded one was not won over.

units.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तं तस्य तच् चक्रम् अधर्मनिरतस्य वै । परदाराभिलाषेण सद्यस् तात निवर्तितम् ॥
units.english: Though the discus of that sinful one was set in motion, it immediately stopped on account of his longing for others wives.

units.sanskrit: न त्व् अहं तस्य जाने वै निवृत्तं चक्रम् उत्तमम् । हतं स्वकर्मणा तत् तु पूर्वं सद्भिश् च निन्दितम् ॥
units.english: did not perceive then that his most excellent discus had stopped, which, spoken ill of by the pious, had been rendered abortive by its own action.

units.sanskrit: कृतशौचः शरावापी रथी निष्क्रम्य वै पुरात् । कृतस्वस्त्ययनो विप्रैः प्रायोधयम् अहं रिपुम् ॥
units.english: Then being purified and having benedictorv rites performed by the Brāhmanas, set out from the city in a car with my bow and arrows and engaged in a fight with my enemy.

units.sanskrit: ततः संसर्गम् आगम्य बलेनास्त्रबलेन च । त्र्यहम् उन्मत्तवद् युद्धं देवासुरम् इवाभवत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon encountering the army strengthened by weapons there took place a mad fight which lasted for three days like that between the gods and demons.

units.sanskrit: स मयास्त्रप्रतापेन निर्दग्धो रणमूर्धनि । पपाताभिमुखः शूरस् त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् अरिंदम ॥
units.english: When the battle raged to its highest pitch, that hero, consumed completely by the might of my weapons, gave up his ghost and fell down with his face downwards.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तात काम्पिल्यात् पृषतो ऽभ्ययात् । हते नीपेश्वरे चैव हते चोग्रायुधे नृपे ॥ आहिच्छत्रं स्वकं राज्यं पित्र्यं प्राप्य महाद्युतिः । द्रुपदस्य पिता राजन् ममैवानुमते तदा ॥
units.english: In the meantime, my son, Prishata started for the province of Kāmpilya. On the king Neepa and Ugrayudha being slain that highly effulgent one obtained his ancestral kingdom Ahichhatra. king, he was the father of king Drupada and an ally of mine –.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽभूद् द्रुपदो राजा द्रोणस् तेन निराकृतः । ततो ऽर्जुनेन तरसा निर्जित्य द्रुपदं रणे । अहिच्छत्रं सकाम्पिल्यं द्रोणायाथापवर्जितम् ॥ प्रतिगृह्य ततो द्रोण उभयं जयतां वरः । काम्पिल्यं द्रुपदायैव प्रायच्छद् विदितं तव ॥ एष ते द्रुपदस्यादौ ब्रह्मदत्तस्य चैव ह । वंशः कार्त्स्न्येन वै प्रोक्तो वीरस्योग्रायुधस्य च ॥
units.english: Afterwards having defeated Drupada by force in battle, Arjuna conferred the province of Kāmpilya together with that of Ahichchatra on Drona. Having accepted both the kingdom, Drona, the foremost of victors, gave away Kāmpilya to Drupada. have thus described to you in detail the race of Brahmadatta, the ancestor of Drupada and that of the hero Ugrāyudha. Brahmadatta was greatly attached to that female companion. And she every evening used to pick up with her beaks two ambrosial fruits for the prince Sarvasena and her young one.

units.sanskrit: अतस् ते वर्तयिष्ये ऽहम् इतिहासं पुरातनम् । गीतं सनत्कुमारेण मार्कण्डेयाय पृच्छते ॥
units.english: That desire of mine is now frustrated with your death. He who neglects this duty goes without any doubt to the hell Kumbhipāka.

units.sanskrit: श्राद्धस्य फलम् उद्दिश्य नियतं सुकृतस्य च । तन्निबोध महाराज सप्तजातिषु भारत ॥
units.english: Hear shall recount the themes narrated by the preceptor Sukra. Remembering this, example, king, they bring about the entire extermination of their enemies .

units.sanskrit: सगालवस्य चरितं कण्डरीकस्य चैव ह । ब्रह्मदत्ततृतीयानां योगिनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥
units.english: He brings about our destruction as a river destroys a tree. have thus king, described to you, what took place formerly between Pujanyā and the king Brahmadatta.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच श्राद्धे प्रतिष्ठितो लोकः श्राद्धाद् योगः प्रवर्तते । हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि श्राद्धस्य फलम् उत्तमम् । ब्रह्मदत्तेन यत् प्राप्तं सप्तजातिषु भारत ॥ तत एव हि धर्मस्य बुद्धिर् निर्वर्तते शनैः । पीडयाप्य् अथ धर्मस्य कृते श्राद्धे पुरानघ ॥ यत् प्राप्तं ब्राह्मणैः पूर्वं तन् निबोध नरोत्तम । ततो ऽहं नातिधर्मिष्ठान् कुरुक्षेत्रे पितृव्रतान् । सनत्कुमारनिर्दिष्टान् अपश्यं सप्त वै द्विजान् ॥
units.english: highly intelligent one, Yudhisthira, shall describe to you the ancient history of Srādha as accosted by you which was recounted by Sanatkumar in response to a question from Mārkandeya -. Markandeya said:—The people perform Srādha and even the Yogins do the same. So shall describe to you its most excellent fruit. descendant of Bharata, religious knowledge gradually evolved from what Brahmadatta had obtained in his seventh birth. you of great intellect shorn of sins, hear what in the days of yore the Brāhmanas obtained by performing Srādhas to the neglect of religion. my son, saw with my celestial vision at the field of Kurukshetra the seven impious Brāhmanas engaged in performing religious rites for ancestral manes as pointed out by Sanatkumār.

units.sanskrit: वाग्दुष्टः क्रोधनो हिंस्रः पिशुनः कविर् एव च । खसृमः पितृवर्ती च नामभिः कर्मभिस् तथा ॥
units.english: Vāgdustha, Krodhana, Hingsra, Pishuna, Kavi, Khasrima and Pitrivarti—these seven Brāhmanas, by name and action, were the sons of Koushika and the disciples of Garga.

units.sanskrit: पितर्य् उपरते सर्वे व्रतवन्तस् तदाभवन् ॥ नियोगात् ते गुरोस् तस्य गां दोग्ध्रीं समकालयन् । समानवत्सां कपिलां सर्वे न्यायागतां तदा ॥
units.english: When after imprecating a curse their father left the house, they, taking the vow of celibacy, began to live in the house of Garga –. Once on a time at the command of their preceptor they all went to the forest to tend the milch-cow Kapilā with its calf that had been obtained fairly.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पथि क्षुधार्तानां बाल्यान् मोहाच् च भारत । न चाशक्यन्त ते ताभ्यां तदा वारयितुं द्विजाः ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, being stricken with hunger on the way they cherished the sinful desire of killing the cow. Kavi and Khasrima, however, did not wish it then and they two could not prevent the other Brāhmanas.

units.sanskrit: पितृवर्ती तु यस् तेषां नित्यं श्राद्धाह्निको द्विजः । स सर्वान् अब्रवीद् भ्रातॄन् कोपाद् धर्मसमन्वितः ॥ यद्य् अवश्यं प्रकर्तव्या पितॄन् उद्दिश्य साध्व् इमां । प्रकुर्वीमहि गां सम्यक् सर्व एव समाहिताः ॥
units.english: Of these the Brāhmana Pitrivarti, who used to perform daily Srādha and other evening rites and abide by virtuous ways, said in anger to his brothers :—If you are all bent upon slaying this cow then we all, with our minds controlled, dedicate it to the ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एषा च गौर् धर्मं प्राप्स्यते नात्र संशयः । पितॄन् अभ्यर्च्य धर्मेण नाधर्मो ऽस्मिन् भविष्यति ॥ तथेत्य् उक्त्वा च ते सर्वे प्रोक्षयित्वा च गां ततः । पितृभ्यः कल्पयित्वैनाम् उपयुज्यन्त भारत ॥
units.english: By this, even this cow will acquire virtue no doubt. And if we perform a pious rite for our ancestral manes we shall not commit an iniquity. Thereupon, descendant of Bharata, they all, having agreed to this, killed the cow and having dedicated it to the ancestral manes, took its meat.

units.sanskrit: उपयुज्य च गां सर्वे गुरोस् तस्य न्यवेदयत् । शार्दूलेन हता धेनुर् वत्सो ऽयं गृह्यताम् इति । आर्जवात् स तु वत्सं तं प्रतिजग्राह वै द्विजः ॥ मिथ्योपचर्य ते तं तु गुरुम् अन्यायतो द्विजाः । कालेन समयुज्यन्त सर्व एवायुषः क्षये ॥ ते वै हिंस्रतया क्रूरा अनार्यत्वाद् गुरोस् तदा । उग्रा हिंसाविहाराश् च सप्ताजायन्त सोदराः । लुब्धकस्यात्मजास् तात बलवन्तो मनस्विनः ॥
units.english: Having taken the meat of the cow they all said to their preceptor:—The cow has been killed by a tiger and here is her calf. Out of simplicity the Brāhmana took the calf. Having imposed on their preceptor by a false story all those Brāhmanas, on the expiration of their lease of life, met with death. On account of their that sinful conduct towards their preceptor and for the destruction of the cow, they, possessed by envy, ruthlessness and anger, were born as the sons of a hunter. They were all strong and liberal-minded.

units.sanskrit: पितॄन् अभ्यर्च्य धर्मेण प्रोक्षयित्वा च गां तदा । स्मृतिः प्रत्यवमर्शश् च तेषां जात्यन्तरे ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: On account of their duly worshipping the ancestral manes and killing the cow they carried with them the knowledge of their pristine birth and actions.

units.sanskrit: जाता व्याधा दशार्णेषु सप्त धर्मविचक्षणाः । स्वधर्मनिरताः सर्वे लोभानृतविवर्जिताः ॥
units.english: Those learned seven Brāhmanas were born as hunters in the province of Dashārna -. They were all intent upon performing their own duties, were truthful and shorn of avarice.

units.sanskrit: तावन् मात्रं प्रकुर्वन्ति यावता प्राणधारणम् । शेषं धर्मपराः कालम् अनुध्यान्ति स्वकर्म तत् ॥
