units.english: They used to work only for the time that was necessary to keep their body and soul together. The rest of the time they used to spend in meditation.

units.sanskrit: नामधेयानि चाप्य् एषाम् इमान्य् आसन् नराधिप । निर्वैरो निर्वृतः क्षान्तो निर्मन्युः कृतिर् एव च । वैधसो मातृवर्ती च व्याधाः परमधार्मिकाः ॥ तैर् एवम् उषितैस् तात हिंसाधर्मपरैर् वने । माता च पूजिता वृद्धा पिता च परितोषितः ॥ यदा माता पिता चैव संयुक्तौ कालधर्मणा । तदा धनूंषि ते त्यक्त्वा वने प्राणान् अवासृजन् ॥ शुभेन कर्मणा तेन जाता जातिस्मरा मृगाः । त्रासोद्वेगेन संविग्ना रम्ये कालंजरे गिरौ ॥ उन्मुखो नित्यवित्रस्तः स्तब्धकर्णो विलोचनः । पण्डितो घस्मरो नादी नामभिस् ते ऽभवन् मृगाः ॥
units.english: Their names, king, were respectively Nirvaira, Nivirta, Kshanta, Nirmangu, Kriti, Vaighasa and Mātrivarti. They were all very highly pious hunters –. Thus living and performing the duties of a hunter they worshipped and satisfied their old parents. When in time their parents died, they, leaving aside their bows and arrows, renounced their lives in the forest. By those pious actions they, in the next birth, became deer carrying with them the recollection of their pristine birth. Because they used to strike terror and slay the deer they, filled with fear, were born in the beautiful Kālanjara mountain as deer, named Unmakha, Nityavitrasta, Stabdhakarna, Vilochana, Pandit, Ghasmar and Nādi –.

units.sanskrit: तम् एवार्थम् अनुध्यान्तो जातिस्मरणसंभवम् । ते सर्वे शुभकर्माणः सधर्माणो वनेचराः । मरुं साध्य जहुः प्राणांल् लघ्वाहारास् तपस्विनः ॥
units.english: Recollecting their former birth and species they used to roam in the forest. They were all of subdued minds, peaceful, unmarried and used to perform good works and observe the same religious rites. Leading the life of ascetics and taking a small quantity of food they gave up their lives in a desert.

units.sanskrit: तथैवाद्यापि दृश्यन्ते गिरौ कालञ्जरे ऽच्युत ॥
units.english: king, descendant of Bharata, even now in the desert attached to the Kālanjāra mountain their footsteps are seen.

units.sanskrit: कर्मणा तेन ते तात शुभेनाशुभवर्जिताः । शुभाच् छुभतरां योनिं चक्रवाकत्वम् आगताः ॥
units.english: By those pious actions, my son, they were divested of all evils—and they were born in a more auspicious species, namely that of Chakravākas.

units.sanskrit: शुभे देशे सरिद्द्वीपे सप्तैवासञ् जलौकसः । निःस्पृहो निर्ममः क्षान्तो निर्द्वंद्वो निष्परिग्रहः । ते ब्रह्मचारिणः सर्वे शकुना धर्मचारिणः । निराहारा जहुः प्राणांस् तपोयुक्ताः सरित्तटे ॥ अथ ते सोदरा जाता हंसा मानसचारिणः । जातिस्मराः सुसंबद्धाः सप्तैव ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥
units.english: Leading a life of celibacy those pious ascetics were born in the holy island of Shara as seven water-fowls. Their names were Nispriha, Nirmama, Kshānta, Nirdanda, Nisparigraha, Nivritti and Nivrita. Those pious Chakravakas were all Brahmachārins. Abstaining from food and carrying on hard austerities they died on the bank of a river. Those seven brothers have become these ganders ranging at will. These are the seven intelligent Brahmachārins carrying the recollection of their pristine birth.

units.sanskrit: विप्रयोनौ यतो मोहान् मिथ्योपचरितो गुरुः । तिर्यग्योनौ ततो जाताः संसारे परिबभ्रमुः ॥
units.english: Because born as Brāhmanas they, by false words, imposed on their preceptor, they are now born as birds moving about in the world.

units.sanskrit: यदा तु पितृकार्यार्थः कृतः स्वार्थे व्यवस्थितैः । ततो ज्ञानं च जातिं च ते हि प्रापुर् गुणोत्तरम् । सुमना मुनिः सुवाक् शुद्धः पञ्चमश् छिद्रदर्शनः । सुनेत्रश् च स्वतन्त्रश् च शकुना नामतः स्मृताः ॥
units.english: And because though for their selfish ends they worshipped their ancestral manes they have obtained a knowledge of their previous birth. These ganders are respectively named Sumanā, Suchivāk, Sudha, Panchama, Chinnadarshana, Sunetra and Swatantra.

units.sanskrit: पञ्चमः पञ्चिकस् तत्र सप्तजातिष्व् अजायत । षष्ठस् तु कण्डरीको ऽभूद् ब्रह्मदत्तस् तु सप्तमः ॥
units.english: Of them the fifth came by the name of Pānchika in his seventh birth, the sixth by that of Pandarika, and the seventh by that of Brahmadatta.

units.sanskrit: तेषां तु तपसा तेन सप्तजातिकृतेन वै । योगस्य चाभिनिर्वृत्त्या प्रतिभानाच् च शोभनात् ॥ पूर्वजातिषु यद् ब्रह्म श्रुतं गुरुकुलेषु वै । तथैव तत्स्थितं ब्रह्म संसारेष्व् अपि वर्तताम् ॥
units.english: On account of the hard austerities performed by them in seven births, of the Yoga practices carried on by them and of their good Karma they listened to the recitation of the Vedic hymns in their first birth in the house of their preceptor. In consequence thereof their inclination remained pure though they lived in the world, –.

units.sanskrit: ते ब्रह्मचारिणः सर्वे विहङ्गाः कामचारिणः । योगधर्मम् अनुध्यान्तो विहरन्ति स्म तत्र ह ॥
units.english: All these Brahmachārins had the knowledge of Brahman; and having been engaged in meditation they lived there.

units.sanskrit: नीपानाम् ईश्वरो राजा विभ्राजः पौरवान्वयः ॥ विभ्राजमानो वपुषा प्रभावेन समन्वितः । श्रीमान् अन्तःपुरवृतो वनं तत् प्रविवेश ह ॥
units.english: While all those birds were living together there, the highly prosperous, all-powerful and the effulgent king Vibhrāja, the head of Neepas, born in the race of Puru, along with the females of his house, came to that forest –.

units.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्रश् चक्रवाकस् तु स्पृहयाम् आस तं नृपम् । दृष्ट्वायान्तं श्रियोपेतं भवेयम् अहम् ईदृशः ॥
units.english: Beholding that prosperous king the bird Swatantra was possessed by envy and wished to become so. He thought:—If have done any good deed and practised Tapas, forsooth shall become such a king.

units.sanskrit: खिन्नो ह्य् अस्म्य् उपवासेन तपसा निष्फलेन च ॥
units.english: have been greatly emaciated by hard-austerities yielding no fruits nor happiness.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततस् तं चक्रवाकौ द्वाव् ऊचतुः सहचारिणौ । आवां ते सचिवौ स्यावस् तव प्रियहितैषिणौ ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:—Thereupon his comrades the other two Chakravākas said to him:—We shall be your ministers ever doing you good.

units.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा च तस्यासीत् तदा योगात्मनो मतिः । एवं ते समयं चक्रुः सुवाक्तं प्रत्यभाषत ॥
units.english: Having said So be it his mind was engaged in Yoga. After they had entered into this contract Shuchivāk said to them.

units.sanskrit: यस्मात् कामप्रधानस् त्वं योगधर्मम् अपास्य वै । अवरं वरं प्रार्थयसे तस्माद् वाक्यं निबोध मे ॥
units.english: While deviating from the path of a Yogin and possessed by desire you pray for such a boon, hear what have got to say in this matter.

units.sanskrit: राजा त्वं भविता तात काम्पिल्ये नगरोत्तमे । भविष्यतः सखायौ च द्वाव् इमौ सचिवौ तव ॥
units.english: Undoubtedly you will become the king of Kāmpilya and these two will be your ministers.

units.sanskrit: शप्त्वा तान् अभिभाष्याथ चत्वारश् चक्रुर् अण्डजाः । तांस् त्रीन् अभीप्सतो राज्यं व्यभिचारप्रधर्षितान् ॥ शप्ताः खगास् त्रयस् ते तु योगभ्रष्टा विचेतसः । तान् अयाचन्त चतुरस् त्रयस् ते सहचारिणः ॥
units.english: With these words the four ganders imprecated a curse on the other three. And on account of their falling off from Yoga consequent upon their praying for a kingdom they did not converse with those three. Losing their Yoga acquirements and having their senses bewildered the cursed ganders prayed to their comrades for relief.

units.sanskrit: तेषां प्रसादं चक्रुस् ते अथैतान् सुमनाब्रवीत् । सर्वेषाम् एव वचनात् प्रसादानुगतं तदा ॥
units.english: They were propitiated and Sumanā, as the spokesman of all, communicated to them the following words of grace.

units.sanskrit: अन्तवान् भविता शापो युष्माकं नात्र संशयः । इतश् च्युताश् च मानुष्यं प्राप्य योगम् अवाप्स्यथ ॥
units.english: Undoubtedly there will be an end of your curse. Freed from this birth you will be again born as men and practise Yoga.

units.sanskrit: सर्वसत्त्वरुतज्ञश् च स्वतन्त्रो ऽयं भविष्यति । पितृप्रसादो ह्य् अस्माभिर् अस्य प्राप्तः कृतेन वै ॥
units.english: Swatantra will be able to understand the sound of all animals. By his counsels we have secured the favour of the ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: अस्माकं ज्ञानसंयोगः सर्वेषां योगसाधनः ॥
units.english: On account of our dedicating the cow to the ancestral manes after killing we have all acquired knowledge and been practising Yoga.

units.sanskrit: इदं च वाक्यसंदर्भ+ +श्लोकम् एकम् उदाहृतम् । पुरुषान्तरितं श्रुत्वा ततो योगम् अवाप्स्यथ ॥
units.english: Hearing this only sloka, containing the story of those seven men, recited one shall acquire most excellent Yoga.

units.sanskrit: ते योगधर्मनिरताः सप्त मानसचारिणः । पद्मगर्भो ऽरविन्दाक्षः क्षीरगर्भः सुलोचनः । ऊरुबिन्दुः सुबिन्दुश् च हैमगर्भस् तु सप्तमः । राजा विभ्राजमानस् तु वपुषा तद् वनं तदा । चचारान्तःपुरवृतो नन्दनं मघवान् इव ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:—Those seven ganders, ever practising Yoga and ranging in the Mānasa lake, namely Padmagarbha, Aravindaksha, Kshiragarbha, Sulochana, Uruvindu, Suvindu and Hemagarbha, used always to live upon air and water and nourish their body –. At that time shining in the grace of his person and surrounded by his female companions the king was ranging in that forest like the king of celestials in the pleasure garden of Nandana.

units.sanskrit: स तान् अबुध्यत् खचरान् योगधर्मात्मकान् बुधः । निर्वेदाच् च तम् एवार्थम् अनुध्यात्वा पुरं ययौ ॥
units.english: By their earnestness and other external marks the king perceived that those birds were Yogins. Then out of shame and thinking upon it he returned to his own city.

units.sanskrit: अणुहो नाम तस्यासीत् पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः । अणुधर्मरतिर् नित्यम् अणुहो ऽध्यगमत् पदम् ॥
units.english: He had a highly pious son by name Anuha. He had his eye on the minutest details of morality and accordingly became the Defender of Faith.

units.sanskrit: प्रादात् कन्यां शुकस् तस्मै कृत्वीं पूजितलक्षणाम् । सत्त्वशीलगुणोपेतां योगधर्मरतां सदा ॥
units.english: Sukha conferred upon him his accomplished and worshipful daughter Kritvi gifted with all auspicious marks and endued with the quality of goodness.

units.sanskrit: सा ह्य् उद्दिष्टा पुरा भीष्म पितृकन्या मणीषिणा । सनत्कुमारेण तदा संनिधौ मम शोभना ॥
units.english: Bhishma, formerly Sanatkumār mentioned that beautiful damsel to me as Pivari, the daughter of the ancestral manes Vahirshadas.

units.sanskrit: सत्यधर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठा दुर्विज्ञेयाकृतात्मभिः । योगा च योगपत्नी च योगमाता तथैव च । यथा ते कथितं पूर्वं पितृसर्गेषु वै मया ॥
units.english: She was the foremost of the truthful, beyond the comprehension of persons of uncontrolled mind, was herself an ascetic, the wife of a Yogin and the mother of a Yogin. had described this to you before while giving an account of the ancestral manes.

units.sanskrit: विभ्राजस् त्व् अणुहं राज्ये स्थापयित्वा नरेश्वरः । आमन्त्र्य पौरान् प्रीतात्मा ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्य च । प्रायात् सरस् तपश् चर्तुं यत्र ते सहचारिणः ॥ त्यक्त्वा कामांस् तपस् तेपे सरसस् तस्य पार्ष्वतः ॥ तस्य संकल्प आसीच् च तेषाम् अन्यतरस्य वै । पुत्रत्वं प्राप्य योगेन युज्येयम् इति भारत ॥
units.english: Having placed Anuha on the throne, welcomed the citizens with a delighted heart and made the Brāhmanas perform the benedictory rite the king Vibhrāja repaired to the Mānasa lake, where the ganders were ranging, for carrying on hard austerities –. Having renounced all desires, abstained from food and living on air only he began to practise penances on one side of that lake. descendant of Bharata, his resolution was that he might become the son of one of them and thus acquire Yoga.

units.sanskrit: कृत्वाभिसंधिं तपसा महता स समन्वितः । सरस् तच् च कुरुश्रेष्ठ वैभ्राजम् इति शब्दितम् ॥ यत्र ते शकुना राजंश् चत्वारो योगधर्मिणः । योगभ्रष्टास् त्रयश् चैव देहन्यासकृतो ऽभवन् ॥
units.english: Having made this resolution he began to carry on hard austerities and shone there like the sun. foremost of Kurus, on account of its being rendered brilliant by Vibhrāja that forest, where the four ascetic ganders and the other three who had deviated from the path of Yoga gave up their lives, became celebrated by the name Vaibhrāja –.

units.sanskrit: काम्पिल्ये नगरे ते तु ब्रह्मदत्तपुरोगमाः । जाताः सप्त महात्मानः सर्वे विगतकल्मषाः । स्मृतिमन्तो ऽत्र चत्वारस् त्रयस् तु परिमोहिताः ॥
units.english: Being freed from sins those seven high-souled men born as birds were born in the city of Kāmpilya under the names of Brahmadatta and others. Amongst them four, by knowledge, meditation and asceticism, mastered the holy Vedas and Vedangas and had a good memory. The other three remained in ignorance.

units.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्रस् त्व् अणुहाज् जज्ञे ब्रह्मदत्तो महायशाः । यथास्यासीत् पक्षिभावे संकल्पः पूर्वचिन्तितः ॥ ज्ञानध्यानतपःपूता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः । छिद्रदर्शी सुनेत्रश् च तथा बाभ्रव्यवत्सयोः । जातौ श्रोत्रियदायादौ वेदवेदाङ्गपारगौ ॥
units.english: Swatantra was born as the highly illustrious son of Anuha by the name of Brahmadatta. According to his resolution in the previous birth as a bird he was endued with knowledge, meditation and Tapas and mastered the Vedas and Vedangas. Chitradarshi and Sunetra were born as Srotrya Brāhmanas, well read in the Vedas with all their auxiliaries, in the races Vābhravya and Vatsa.

units.sanskrit: सखायौ ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पूर्वजातिसहोषितौ । पाञ्चालः पञ्चमस् तत्र कण्डरीकस् तथापरः ॥
units.english: For having lived with him in the previous birth they became helpmates to Brahmadatta. The others were born as Pānchāla, Pinchika and Kandarika.

units.sanskrit: पाञ्चालो बह्वृचस् त्व् आसीद् आचार्यत्वं चकार ह । द्विवेदः कण्डरीकस् तु छन्दोगो ऽध्वर्युर् एव च ॥
units.english: Of them Pānchāla was well versed in the Rig Veda and accordingly performed the duties of a preceptor. Kandarika was well read in the other two Vedas and acted as Chhandoga and Adhvaryu.

units.sanskrit: सर्वसत्त्वरुतज्ञश् च राजासीद् अणुहात्मजः । पाञ्चालकण्डरीकाभ्यां तस्य संविद् अभूत् तदा ॥
units.english: Anuha's son, the king Brahmadatta, was conversant with the voice of all animals. He was a great friend of Pānchala and Kandarika.

units.sanskrit: ते ग्राम्यधर्मनिरताः कामस्य वशवर्तिनः । पूर्वजातिकृतेनासन् धर्मकामार्थकोविदाः ॥
units.english: Although they were addicted to vulgar pleasures they, on account of their pristine good deeds, were conversant with morality, temporal profit and desires.

units.sanskrit: अणुहस् तु नृपश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मदत्तम् अकल्मषम् । अभिषिच्य तदा राज्ये परां गतिम् अवाप्तवान् ॥
units.english: Having installed the sinless Brahmadatta on the throne the foremost of ascetic kings, Anuha attained to the most excellent state.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तस्य भार्या तु देवलस्यात्मजाभवत् । असितस्य योगदुर्धर्षा संनतिर् नाम भारत ॥ ताम् एकभावसंयुक्तां लेभे कन्याम् अनुत्तमाम् । संनतिं संनतिमतीं देवलाद् योगधर्मिणीम् ॥
units.english: Brahmadatta's wife, who was the daughter of Devala, was a great female anchorite. Her name was Sunnati. Thus from Devala Brahmadatta obtained his daughter the high-minded ascetic Sunnati who was of the same temperament with him.

units.sanskrit: उपयेमे विधानेन ब्रह्मदत्तो नराधिपः । शेषास् तु चक्रवाका वै काम्पिल्ये सहचारिणः । ते जाताः श्रोत्रियकुले सुदरिद्रे सहोदराः ॥ धृतिर् महामना विद्वांस् तत्त्वदर्शी च नामतः । तेषां संविदथोत्पन्ना पूर्वजातिकृता तदा । आमन्त्र्य पितरं तात पिता तान् अब्रवीत् तदा । अधर्म एष युष्माकं यन् मां त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यथ ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, in his seventh birth Panchika was the fifth, Kandarika the sixth and Brahmadatta the seventh. The remaining ganders were born as brothers in a poor Srotrya family in the city of Kāmpilya –. Their names were Dhritimān, Sumanā, Vidvān and Tatwadarshi. They were well read in the Vedas and gifted with keen observation. They were all endowed with the recollection of their pristine birth. When after having attained to the consummation of Yoga practices and welcomed their father they were about to depart he said to them Verily by your renouncing me you will commit a mighty iniquity.

units.sanskrit: कामान् अभीप्सितान् सर्वान् मम कृत्वाद्य पुत्रकाः । शुश्रूषाम् अप्रयुक्त्वा च कथं वै गन्तुम् अर्हथ ॥
units.english: How can you all depart, without removing my poverty and satisfying the other duties of a son viz—the spreading of progeny, the performing of Srāddha at Gya, and attending upon me in my old age -.

units.sanskrit: ते तम् ऊचुर् द्विजाः सर्वे पितरं पुनर् एव हि । इमं श्लोकं महार्थं त्वं राजानं सहमन्त्रिणम् । श्रावयेथाः समागम्य ब्रह्मदत्तम् अकल्मषम् ॥ प्रीतात्मा दास्यति स ते ग्रामान् भोगांश् च पुष्कलान् । एतावद् उक्त्वा ते सर्वे पूजयित्वा च तं गुरुं । योगधर्मम् अनुप्राप्य परमां निर्वृतिं ययुः ॥
units.english: The twice-born ones again said to their father:—We will make arrangements by which you will live. Do you go to the sinless king Brahmadatta and recite before him and his minister the Sloka pregnant with great import. He will then, with great joy, confer upon you many villages and desired-for objects. Therefore father, go there. Having said this and worshipped their father they attained to beatitude as the result of the practices of Yoga.

units.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ब्रह्मदत्तस्य तनयः स वैभ्राजस् त्व् अजायत । योगात्मा तपसा युक्तो विष्वक्सेन इति श्रुतः ॥
units.english: Markandeya said:—One of those ganders Vaibhrāja, an ascetic and anchorite as he was, was born as the son of Brahmadatta by name Viswaksena.

units.sanskrit: कदाचिद् ब्रह्मदत्तस् तु भार्यया सहितो वने । विजहार प्रहृष्टात्मा यथा शच्या शतक्रतुः ॥
units.english: Once on a time Brahmadatta was sporting delightedly in a forest in the company of his wife like Indra in the company of Sachi.

units.sanskrit: ततः पिपीलिकरुतं स शुश्राव नराधिपः । कामिनीं कामिनस् तस्य याचतः क्रोशतो भृशम् ॥ श्रुत्वा तु याच्यमानां तां क्रुद्धां सूक्ष्मां पिपीलिकाम् । ततः सा संनतिर् दीना व्रीडिता दीनचेतना । प्रसाद्यमाना भर्त्रा सा तम् उवाच शुचिस्मिता । त्वयावहसिता राजन् नाहं जीवितुम् उत्सहे ॥
units.english: Thereupon the king heard the noise made by an ant who was soliciting a female-ant and displaying his displeasure. Hearing that the poor female ant was expressing her disgust at the request of her husband Brahmadatta laughed aloud. Thereat his wife Saunati was stricken with sorrow and shame. That beautiful damsel had been abstaining from food for a long time. When her husband attempted to please her, that one of pure smiles said king, while you laughed at me do not like to live.

units.sanskrit: स तत्कारणम् आचख्यौ न च सा श्रद्दधाति तत् । उवाच चैनं कुपिता नैष भावो ऽस्ति पार्थिव ॥
units.english: The king however communicated to her the cause of his laughter but she placed no confidence in his words but rather said in anger This is not within the power of a man.

units.sanskrit: को वै पिपीलिकरुतं मानुषो वेत्तुम् अर्हति । ऋते देवप्रसादाद् वै पूर्वजातिकृतेन वा । तपःफलेन वा राजन् विद्यया वा नराधिप ॥ यद्य् एष वै प्रभावस् ते सर्वसत्त्वरुतज्ञता । प्राणान् वापि परित्यक्ष्ये राजन् सत्येन ते शपे ॥
units.english: What man can decipher the sound of an ant save by the favour of the Providence or by the good deeds of his pristine birth ? king, if by virtue of Tapas or any other knowledge you have acquired the power of understanding the sound of animals, then by some means create confidence in me by which may know it. Otherwise, king, shall renounce my life. do swear truly -.

units.sanskrit: तत् तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा महिष्याः परुषं विभो । स राजा परमापन्नो देवश्रेष्ठम् अगात् तदा । शरण्यं सर्वभूतेशं भक्त्या नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥
units.english: Hearing those harsh words of the queen the highly illustrious king Brahmadatta was greatly distressed. He then reverentially sought the protection of the Omnipotent Nārāyana, the lord of all the worlds.

units.sanskrit: समाहितो निराहारः षड्रात्रेण महायशाः । ददर्श दर्शने राजा देवं नारायणं हरिम् ॥
units.english: Having controlled his senses and abstaining from food the highly illustrious king, within six nights, saw the Omnipotent Deity Nārāyana.

units.sanskrit: उवाच चैनं भगवान् सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः । ब्रह्मदत्त प्रभाते त्वं कल्याणं समवाप्स्यसि । इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
units.english: The Lord, compassionate unto all creatures, said to him -. Brahmadatta, after the night has passed away you will attain to well-being. Having said this the lord disappeared there from #.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्णां तु पिता यो ऽसौ ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् । स राजानम् अथान्विच्छत् सहमन्त्रिणम् अच्युतम् । न ददर्शान्तरं चापि श्लोकं श्रावयितुं तदा ॥
units.english: Having learnt a Sloka from his sons the father, of those four high-souled Brāhmanas, considered himself blessed. He then desired to go to the King and his Minister. Going there, he however found no opportunity of reciting the sloka to them.

units.sanskrit: अथ राजा शिरःस्नातो लब्ध्वा नारायणाद् वरम् । प्रविवेश पुरीं प्रीतो रथम् आरुह्य काञ्चनम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon having bathed in the tank and obtained the boon from Nārāyana, he, delightedly ascending a golden chariot, entered the city.

units.sanskrit: तस्य रश्मीन् अगृह्णाच् च कण्डरीको द्विजर्षभः । इदम् अन्तरम् इत्य् एव ततः स ब्राह्मणस् तदा । श्रावयाम् आस राजानं श्लोकं तं सचिवौ च तौ ॥
units.english: Kandarikā, the foremost of the twice-born, acted as his charioteer and Pānchala held the chowries. Considering that to be a favourable moment the Brāhmana recited the sloka before the King and the two ministers.

units.sanskrit: सप्त व्याधा दशार्णेषु मृगाः कालंजरे गिरौ । हंसाः सरसि मानसे । ते स्म जाताः कुरुक्षेत्रे ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः । प्रस्थिता दूरम् अध्वानं । चक्रवाकाः सरिद् द्वीपे यूयं तेभ्यो ऽवसीदथ ॥
units.english: Having been born as seven hunters in the Province of Dashārna they were, in their next birth, born as deer on the Kalanjara mountain,—and then they were born as Chakravākas in the island of Shara. Then they were born as ganders in the Mānasa lake. And at last they were born in Kurukshetra as Brāhmanas well read in the Vedas. Amongst them the four, that where born of a good family, have gone to a distant region. You, deviating from the path of Yoga, are sinking –.

units.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा मोहम् अगमद् ब्रह्मदत्तस् तदानघ । सचिवौ चास्य पाञ्चालः कण्डरीकश् च भारत ॥ दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर् अस्वस्थाः पौराश् चागन्तवश् च ह ॥ मुहूर्ताद् इव राजा स सह ताभ्यां रथे स्थितः । प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां प्रत्यागच्छद् अरिंदम ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, hearing this the king Brahmadatta was stupified, and the reins of the horses and chowries slipped off respectively from the hands of Kandarika and Pānchāla. Seeing this the citizens and friends were all greatly agitated –. Having waited for a moment with his two ministers on the car the king, after regaining his consciousness, returned to the palace.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते तत् सरः स्मृत्वा योगं तम् उपलभ्य च । ब्राःमणं विपुलैर् अर्थैर् भोगैश् च समयोजयन् ॥
units.english: Thereupon recollecting the tank mentioned and regaining the Yoga power practised in the previous birth he honored the Brāhmana with various enjoyable things and chariots.

units.sanskrit: अभिषिच्य स्वराज्ये तु विष्वक्सेनम् अरिंदमम् । जगाम ब्रह्मदत्तो ऽथ सदारो वनम् एव ह ॥
units.english: Then placing on the throne his son Viswaksena, the subduer of enemies, Brahmadatta retired to a forest with his wife.

units.sanskrit: अथैनं संनतिर् धीरा देवलस्य सुता तदा । उवाच परमप्रीता योगाद् वनगतं नृपम् ॥ जानन्त्या त्वं महाराज पिपीलिकरुतज्ञताम् । चोदितः क्रोधम् उद्दिश्य सक्तः कामेषु वै मया ॥
units.english: After the king had gone to the forest for practising Yoga Devala's daughter, the good-natured Sunnati said with great delight to the king :— monarch, you can understand the sound of the ants and still you are addicted to sexual desires; therefore in great anger wanted to work you up.

units.sanskrit: इतो वयं गमिष्यामो गतिम् इष्टाम् अनुत्तमाम् । तव चान्तर्हितो योगस् ततः संस्मारितो मया ॥
units.english: From this birth we must attain to the most excellent state. You had deviated from the practice of Yoga and accordingly reminded you of it.

units.sanskrit: स राजा परमप्रीतः पत्न्याः श्रुत्वा वचस् तदा । प्राप्य योगं वनाद् एव गतिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम् ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of his wife the king was highly pleased. And having acquired Yoga power he attained to a state which it is very difficult to obtain.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्य योगगतिं सिद्धो विशुद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Having purified himself by his own actions and acquired the most excellent Sankhya Yoga he attained to a consummate state.

units.sanskrit: क्रमं प्रणीय पाञ्चालः शिक्षाम् उत्पाद्य केवलाम् । योगाचार्यगतिं प्राप यशश् चाग्र्यं महातपाः ॥ एवम् एतत् पुरा वृत्तं मम प्रत्यक्षम् अच्युत । तद् धारयस्व गाङ्गेय श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे ततः ॥
units.english: Having instituted only Sikshā and laid down the order of the Vedas the great ascetic Pānchālya acquired renown and the status of a Yoga preceptor. son of Gangā, all this happened in the days of yore before my very eyes. Meditate on this and you will meet with well-being.

units.sanskrit: ये चान्ये धारयिष्यन्ति तेषां चरितम् उत्तमम् । तिर्यग्योनिषु ते जातु न भविष्यन्ति कर्हिचित् ॥ श्रुत्वा चेदम् उपाख्यानं महार्थं महतां गतिम् । योगधर्मो हृदि सदा परिवर्तेत भारत ॥ ततो मनोगतिं याति सिद्धानां भुवि दुर्लभाम् ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच एवम् एतत् पुरा गीतं मार्कण्डेयेन धीमता । श्राद्धस्य फलम् उद्दिश्य सोमस्याप्यायनाय वै ॥
units.english: Others also, who will meditate on this most excellent account, will never be visited by inferior births. descendant of Bharata, listening to this highly momentous history, one has his mind always bent on practising Yoga. He, who will meditate on this, shall always enjoy peace and gradually attain to the pure state of a Yogin which it is difficult to acquire in this world. Vaishampāyana said:—In order to propagate the practice of Yoga the intelligent Mārkandeya thus spoke in the days of yore by way of describing the fruits of a Srāddha.

units.sanskrit: सोमो हि भगवान् देवो लोकस्याप्यायनं परम् । वृष्णिवंशप्रसङ्गेन तस्य वंशं निबोध मे ॥
units.english: The Divine Soma confers nourishment on all creatures. Therefore hear from me an account of the lunar family while describing the family of Vrishnis.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच पिता सोमस्य वै राजञ् जज्ञे ऽत्रिर् भगवान् ऋषिः । तत्रात्रिः सर्वलोकानां तस्थौ स्वविनयैर् वृतः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभान्य् एव चचार ह ॥
units.english: Vaisampayana said:— king, Soma's father the Divine Rishi Atri was the mind-begotten son of Brahmā when, in the days of yore, he grew desirous of creating progeny. Atri, with all his sons, began to do good unto all creatures, by his words, mind and action.

units.sanskrit: अनुत्तमं नाम तपो येन तप्तं महत् पुरा । त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानीति हि नः श्रुतम् ॥
units.english: That innocent, highly effulgent and virtuous-souled Rishi, of firm vows, formerly pratised, with his arms raised, the most excellent penance of silence for three thousand celestial years. This we have heard –.

units.sanskrit: ततोर्ध्वरेतसस् तस्य स्थितस्यानिमिषस्य हि । सोमत्वं तनुर् आपेदे महाबुद्धस्य भारत ॥ ऊर्ध्वम् आचक्रमे तस्य सोमत्वं भावितात्मनः । नेत्राभ्यां वारि सुस्राव दशधा द्योतयद् दिशः ॥ तं गर्भं दशधा दृष्ट्वा दश देव्यो दधुस् ततः । समेत्य धारयाम् आसुर् न च ताः तम् अशक्नुवन् ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, when that Rishi, having controlled his senses, began to practise penances steadfastly his person assumed the mild lustre of the moon. This moon-like lustre, of the person of that one of controlled senses, soon spread over the sky. Then from his eyes tears began to trickle down and flood the ten quarters. Thereupon the ten goddesses delightedly conceived in ten different ways. Though they all did it unitedly they however could not keep it.

units.sanskrit: स ताभ्यः सहसैवाथ दिग्भ्यो गर्भः प्रभान्वितः । पपात भासयंल् लोकाञ् शीतांशुः सर्वभावनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the effulgent, all-protecting moon in the embryo fell down lighting up all the quarters.

units.sanskrit: यदा न धारणे शक्तास् तस्य गर्भस्य ता दिशः । ततस् ताभिः सहैवाशु निपतात वसुंधराम् ॥
units.english: When the quarters could not bear this conception any more the embryo, along with them, fell down on earth.

units.sanskrit: पतितं सोमम् आलोक्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । रथम् आरोपयाम् आस लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥ स हि वेदमयस् तात धर्मात्मा सत्यसंगरः । युक्तो वाजिसहस्रेण सितेनेति हि नः श्रुतम् ॥
units.english: Beholding the moon thus fallen Brahmā, the grand-father of all, got on his chariot for doing good unto all people That chariot was made of the Vedas; its form was virtue and it carried Brahmā; thousands of Mantra horses wore yoked to it; this we have heard.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् निपतिते देवाः पुत्रे ऽत्रेः परमात्मनि । तुष्टुवुर् ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः सप्त ये श्रुताः ॥
units.english: When that great soul, the son of Atri, came down on earth, all the deities and the seven mind-begotten sons of Brahmā began to chant his glories.

units.sanskrit: तथैवाङ्गिरसस् तत्र भृगोर् एवात्मजैः सह । ऋग्भिर् यजुर्भिः सामभिर् अथर्वाङ्गिरसैर् अपि ॥
units.english: In the same way, my child, Angira's sons and Bhrigu with his sons began to hymn his glories with Rik and Yayush Mantras.

units.sanskrit: तस्य संस्तूयमानस्य तेजः सोमस्य भास्वतः । आप्यायमानं लोकांस् त्रीन् भावयाम् आस सर्वतः ॥
units.english: Having his glories thus chanted by the Rishis the effulgent moon had his increasing lustre stationed in a circular form in the sky. It fully lighted up the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: स तेन रथमुख्येन सागरान्तां वसुंधराम् । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो ऽतियशाश् चकाराभिप्रदक्षिणाम् ॥ तस्य यच् च्यावितं तेजः पृथिवीम् अन्वपद्यत । ताभिऋ धार्यो ह्य् अयं लोकः प्रजाश् चैव चतुर्विधाः । पोष्टा हि भगवान् सोमो जगतो जगतीपते ॥
units.english: In his that most excellent chariot the highly illustrious moon circumambulated, for twenty-one times, the world bounded by the sea. His lustre, that melted down on earth on account of the motion of his car, became plants that shone in their effulgence. king, those plants conduce to the nourishment of the gods, ancestral manes, men, beasts, birds, reptiles and other creatures; the moon is thus the nourisher of the universe.

units.sanskrit: स लब्धतेजा भगवान् संस्तवैः स्वैश् च कर्मभिः । तपस् तेपे महाभाग पद्मानां दशतीर् दश ॥
units.english: great one, having acquired lustre through his own deeds and the chanting of his glories by the Rishis the divine moon carried on hard austerities for one thousand Padma years.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णा या देव्यो धारयन्त्य् आत्मना जगत् । निधिस् तासाम् अभूद् देवः प्रख्यातः स्वेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: The moon was the asylum of all those silvery goddesses in the shape of water who upheld the universe. He became celebrated by his own actions.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तस्मै ददौ राज्यं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः । बीजौषधीनां विप्राणाम् अपां च जनमेजय ॥ त्रींल् लोकान् भावयाम् आस स्वभासा भास्वतां वरः ॥ सप्तविंशतिम् इन्दोस् तु दाक्षायण्यो महाव्रताः । ददौ प्राचेतसो दक्षो नक्षत्राणीति या विदुः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, Janamejaya, Brahmā, the foremost of those conversant with the Vedas, conferred upon him the sovereignty over seeds, plants, the Brāhmanas and water. After his installation on the throne, monarch, the lord of rays lighted up the three worlds with his rays. Daksha had twenty-seven daughters of great vows. People knew them as stars. Pracheta's son Daksha conferred them all on him.

units.sanskrit: स तत् प्राप्य महद् राज्यं सोमः सोमवतां वरः । समाजह्रे राजसूयं सहस्रशतदक्षिणम् ॥
units.english: Having obtained that great kingdom the moon, the lord of ancestral manes, made arrangements for a Rajsuya sacrifice in which ten million kine were given away as presents.

units.sanskrit: होतास्य भगवान् अत्रिर् अध्वर्युर् भगवान् भृगुः । हिरण्यगर्भश् चोद्गाता ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मात्वम् एयिवान् ॥ सदस्यस् तत्र भगवान् हरिर् नारायणः प्रभुः । दक्षिणाम् अददात् सोमस् त्रींल् लोकान् इति नः श्रुतम् । तेभ्यो ब्रह्मर्षिमुख्येभ्यः सदस्येभ्यश् च भारत ॥ सिनीवाली कुहूश् चैव द्युतिः पुष्टिः प्रभा वसुः । कीर्तिर् धृतिश् च लक्ष्मीश् च नव देव्यः सिषेविरे ॥ तं मूर्ध्न्य् उपाघ्राय तदा सोमो धाता प्रजापतिः । विरराजाति राजेन्द्रो दशधा भावयन् दिशः ॥ तस्य तत् प्राप्य दुष्प्राप्यम् ऐश्वर्यं मुनिसत्कृतम् । विबभ्राम मतिस् तात विनयाद् अनयाहृता ॥
units.english: The divine Atri was the Hota thereof, Bhrigu Adhvaryu Hiranyagarbha, Udgata and Brahmā himself was Brahma. And the Divine Nārāyana, surrounded by Sanatkumār and other Prime Rishis, became the member thereof. descendant of Bharata, we have heard that the Divine Soma conferred presents on the leading Brāhmana saints and all other Rishis of the three worlds who had assembled there. Sinivāli, Kuhu, Dyuti, Pushti, Prabhā, Vasu, Dhriti, Kirti and Lakshmi, these nine goddesses attended upon him. Having bathed after the termination of the Yagna the foremost of kings, the moon, worshipped of all the gods and Rishis, began steadily to light up the ten quarters. my child, having been honored by the sages and acquired prosperity which it is very difficult to obtain his mind began to deviate from humility. And accordingly sullied by immorality he lost all control over himself.

units.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेः स वै भार्यां तारां नाम यशस्विनीम् । जहार तरसा सर्वान् अवमत्याङ्गिरःसुतान् ॥
units.english: Having disregarded Vrihaspati, the son of Angiras, the moon by force carried away his illustrious wife Tārā.

units.sanskrit: स याच्यमानो देवैश् च तथा देवर्षिभिः सह । स संरब्धस् तदा तस्मिन् देवाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः । उशना तस्य जग्राह पार्ष्णिम् अङ्गिरसस् तदा । तेन स्नेहेन भगवान् रुद्रस् तस्य बृहस्पतेः । पार्ष्णिग्राहो ऽभवद् देवः प्रगृह्याजगवं धनुः ॥
units.english: And albeit solicited by the gods and Rishis he did not return her. Vrihaspati, the the preceptor of the gods, was accordingly enraged with him. Ushanā Suka began to protect his sides. The illustrious deity Rudra was formerly a disciple of Vrihaspati's father. Out of reverence for him he Rudra protected his rear, taking his Ajagava bow in his hands –.

units.sanskrit: तेन ब्रह्मशिरो नाम परमास्त्रं महात्मना । उद्दिश्य देवान् उत्सृष्टं येनैषां नाशितं यशः ॥
units.english: terrible battle, destructive of the gods and demons on account of Tārā, was fought at the place where the high-souled Siva discharged his mighty weapon Brahmasiras—for the destruction of the demons and where their glory was accordingly destroyed –.

units.sanskrit: देवानां दानवानां च लोकक्षयकरं महत् ॥ तत्र शिष्टास् तु ये देवास् तुषिताश् चैव ये भारत । ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुर् आदिदेवं पितामहम् ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, in that battle the gods, well read in the precepts of religion who had sided Vrishaspati, and the deities Tushitas, who belonged to Soma's party who had stolen away his preceptor's wife, sought refuge with the Prime Deity the Eternal Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: ततो निवार्योशनसं तं वै रुद्रं च शंकरम् । ददाव् अङ्गिरसे तारां स्वयम् एव पितामहः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the Grand-father himself came there, prevented Sukra and Sankara to fight and gave back Tārā to Vrihaspati.

units.sanskrit: ताम् अन्तःप्रसवां दृष्ट्वा विप्रः प्राह बृहस्पतिः । मदीयायां न ते योनौ गर्भो धार्यः कथं चन ॥
units.english: Beholding Tārā enciente Vrihaspati said to her:—You must not give birth to this child at my house.

units.sanskrit: अयोनाव् असृजत्तं तु कुमारं दस्युहन्तमम् । इषीकास्तम्बम् आसाद्य ज्वलन्तम् इव पावकम् ॥ जातमात्रः स भगवान् देवानाम् आक्षिपद् वपुः । ततः संशयम् आपन्नास् ताराम् अकथयन् सुराः ॥ सत्यं ब्रूहि सुतः कस्य सोमस्याथ बृहस्पतेः । पृच्छ्यमाना यदा देवैर् नाह सा साध्व् असाधु वा । कुमारो मातरं प्राह कुपितो ऽलीकलज्जया । तं निवार्य ततो ब्रह्मा तारां पप्रच्छ संशयम् । यद् अत्र तथ्यं तद् ब्रूहि तारे कस्य सुतो ह्य् अयम् ॥
units.english: She then gave birth to a son, the destroyer of robbers, effulgent like a burning flame, on a bundle of fibrous sticks. As soon as he was born that beautiful boy overclouded the beauty of the celestials. Filled with suspicion accordingly the deities enquired of Tārā saying Who is he? Tell us truly if he is Vrihaspati’s son or Soma’s. When she was thus questioned by the gods she could give no reply out of shame —. Thereupon her son, the slayer of robbers, was about to imprecate a curse on her. Preventing him Brahmā himself asked Tārā for the solution of the doubt. Tell us, Tātā, what the truth is.

units.sanskrit: सोमस्येति महात्मानं कुमारं दस्युहन्तमम् ॥ तं मूर्ध्न्य् उपाघ्राय तदा सोमो धाता प्रजापतिः । बुध इत्य् अकरोन् नाम तस्य पुत्रस्य धीमतः । प्रतिकूलं च गगने समभ्युत्तिष्ठते बुधः ॥ उत्पादयाम् आस तदा पुत्रं वै राजपुत्रिका । उर्वश्यां जज्ञिरे यस्य पुत्राः सप्त महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Whose son is he? Thereupon with folded hands she said to the Lord Brahmā, the conferrer of boons:—He is Soma's. Then his father the Patriarch Soma smelt the crown of his high-souled son, the destroyer of robbers –. The intelligent Soma named his son Budha. He always rises in the sky in a hostile direction Budha begat a son on Vairāja's daughter Ilā. His son was the great king Pururava. He begat on Urvashi seven high-souled sons.

units.sanskrit: प्रसह्य धर्षितस् तत्र विवशो राजयक्ष्मणा । ततो यक्ष्माभिभूतस् तु सोमः प्रक्षीणमण्डः । जगाम शरणायाथ पितरं सो ऽत्रिम् एव च ॥
units.english: On account of his arrogance the Moon was attacked with consumption. On account of his thus being subject to this disease his orbit suffered decrease. He then sought refuge with his father Atri.

units.sanskrit: तस्य तत् पापशमनं चकारात्रिर् महायशाः । स राजयक्ष्मणा मुक्तः श्रिया जज्वाल सर्वशः ॥ एतत् सोमस्य ते जन्म कीर्तितं कीर्तिवर्धनम् । वंशम् अस्य महाराज कीर्त्यमानम् अतः शृणु ॥
units.english: The great ascetic Atri released him from his sins. And accordingly freed from consumption he again shone in his effulgence. monarch, have thus described to you, the account of the birth of the Moon enhancing glory. shall now describe his family.

units.sanskrit: धन्यम् आयुष्यम् आरोग्यं पुण्यं संकल्पसाधकम् । सोमस्य जन्म श्रुत्वैव सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
units.english: On hearing of the story of the birth of the Moon ever giving blessedness, freedom from diseases, long life and progeny one is freed from all his sins.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच बुधस्य तु महाराज विद्वान् पुत्रः पुरूरवाः । तेजस्वी दानशीलश् च यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः ॥ ब्रह्मवादी पराक्रान्तः शत्रुभिर् युधि दुर्जयः । आहर्ता चाग्निहोत्रस्य यज्ञानां च दिवो महीम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:— great king, Budha's son Pururava was learned, energetic, and charitably disposed. He performed many sacrifices and gave away many presents. He was conversant with the knowledge of Brahman and powerful and the enemies could not defeat him in battle. That king kept up perpetual fire in his house and celebrated many sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: सत्यवादी पुण्यमतिः काम्यः संवृतमैथुनः । अतीव त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसाप्रतिमः सदा ॥
units.english: He was truthful, pious and highly handsome. He had an entire control over his sexual appetites. At that time there was none in the three worlds equal to him in glory.

units.sanskrit: तं ब्रह्मवादिनं क्षान्तं धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम् । उर्वशी वरयाम् आस हित्वा मानं यशस्विनी ॥
units.english: Having cast off her pride the illustrious Urvashi selected, as her lord, that forgiving and pious king conversant with the knowledge of Brahman.

units.sanskrit: तया सहावसद् राजा दश वर्षाणि पञ्च च । पञ्च षट् सप्त चाष्टौ च दश चाष्टौ च भारत ॥
units.english: That king ruled over the sacred province of Prāyaga, so highly spoken of by the great Rishis. His seven sons were all high-souled and like the sons of the gods born in the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: वने चैत्ररथे रम्ये तथा मन्दाकिनीतटे । अलकायां विशालायां नन्दने च वनोत्तमे ॥
units.english: That damsel, of beautiful smiles, was like a mother to that pair of lambs. When the second was carried away the damsel said to the son of Ilā.

units.sanskrit: उत्तरान् स कुरून् प्राप्य मनोररथफलद्रुमान् । गन्धमादनपादेषु मेरुशृङ्गे तथोत्तरे ॥
units.english: In the meantime the Gandharvas created lightnings. When the king was going out of the place lighted up by lightnings she, all on a sudden, saw him naked.

units.sanskrit: आयोः पुत्राश् तथा पञ्च सर्वे वीरा महारथाः । स्वर्भानुतनयायां च प्रभायां जज्ञिरे नृप । नहुषः प्रथमं जज्ञे वृद्धशर्मा ततः परम् । दम्भो रजिर् अनेनाश् च त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः ॥ रजिः पुत्रशतानीह जनयाम् आस पञ्च वै । राजेयम् इति विख्यातं क्षत्रम् इन्द्रभयावहम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:— king, Ayu had five sons who were all heroic and mighty car-warriors. They were begotten on Swarbhānu's daughter. Of them Nahusha was born first and next to him Vriddhasharmā. Afterwards Rambha, Raji and Anena were born; they were all well-known in the three worlds. Raji begat five hundred sons who were known on earth by the name of Rājeyas. Those Kshatriyas made even Indra terrified.

units.sanskrit: देवाश् चैवासुराश् चैव पितामहम् अथाब्रुवन् ॥ आवयोर् भगवन् युद्धे विजेता को भविष्यति । ब्रूहि नः सर्वभूतेश श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे वचः ॥
units.english: When the terrible battle, between the gods and demons, came to pass they went to the Grandfather and said lord of all the gods, say who amongst us will be crowned with victory. We wish to hear it from you -.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच येषाम् अर्थाय संग्रामे रजिर् आत्तायुधः प्रभुः । योत्स्यते ते विजेष्यन्ति त्रींल् लोकान् नात्र संशयः ॥
units.english: Brahma said:—Forsooth they will conquer the three worlds on whose behalf the king Raji will take up arms in battle.

units.sanskrit: यतो रजिर् धृतिस् तत्र श्रीश् च तत्र यतो धृतिः । यतो धृतिश् च श्रीश् चैव धर्मस् तत्र जयस् तथा ॥
units.english: Wherever Raji is, there is forbearance; and wherever forbearance reigns there is prosperity. And wherever forbearance and prosperity are there exist morality and victory.

units.sanskrit: ते देवा दानवाः प्रीता देवेनोक्ता रजेर् जये । अभ्ययुर् जयम् इच्छन्तो वृण्वाना भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: foremost of Bharatas, pleased with what they heard from the Grandfather, the gods and demons, with a view to gain victory, went to Raji for making him their commander.

units.sanskrit: स हि स्वर्भानुदौहित्रः प्रभायां समपद्यत । राजा परमतेजस्वी सोमवंशविवर्धनः ॥
units.english: Raji was the grandson of Swarbhānu and was begotten on his daughter Prabhā. That highly powerful king multiplied the race of Soma.

units.sanskrit: ते हृष्टमनसः सर्वे रजिं दैतेयदानवाः । ऊचुर् अस्मज्जयाय त्वं गृहाण वरकार्मुकम् ॥ अथोवाच रजिस् तत्र तयोर् वैदेवदैत्ययोः । स्वार्थज्ञः स्वार्थम् उद्दिश्य यशः स्वं च प्रकाशयन् । रजिर् उवाच यदि देवगणान् सर्वाञ् जित्वा शक्रपुरोगमान् । इन्द्रो भवामि धर्मेण ततो योत्स्यामि संयुगे ॥
units.english: The gods and demons, all with delighted minds, said to Raji:—Do you, for accomplishing own victory, take up a most excellent bow and arrows . Then identifying his own interest with that of theirs and displaying his own glory the king Raji said to the gods and demons. Indra and gods, shall then only engage in fight if can attain to the dignity of Indra after vanquishing the demons in battle.

units.sanskrit: देवाः प्रथमतोभूयः प्रतीयुर् हृष्टमानसाः । एवं यथेष्टं नृपते कामः संपद्यतां तव ॥
units.english: The gods were at first delighted and said, king, whatever you wish it will be; your desire shall be fulfilled.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सुरगणानां तु वाक्यं राजा रजिस् तदा । दानवा दर्पपूर्णास् तु स्वार्थम् एवानुगम्य ह । अस्माकम् इन्द्रः प्रह्रादो यस्यार्थे विजयामहे ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of the gods the king Raji said to the leading Asuras what he had spoken to the gods. Thinking it conducive to their own interest the haughty Dānavas, with great indignation, replied to that king. Pralhāda is our lord for whom we seek victory.

units.sanskrit: अस्मिंस् तु समये राजंस् तिष्ठेथा देवचोदितः । स तथेति ब्रुवन्न् एव देवैर् अप्य् अभिचोदितः । भविष्यसीन्द्रो जित्वैव देवैर् उक्तस् स पार्थिवः । जघान दानवान् सर्वान् ये वध्या वज्रपाणिना ॥
units.english: foremost of kings, fulfill the contract that you have made with the gods for obtaining the kingdom. Having said 'so be it he was appointed by the gods their commander. Then entering upon the contract that he would become Indra the king slew all the Dānavas whom the wielder of thunderbolt could not kill.

units.sanskrit: स विप्रनष्टां देवानां परमश्रीः श्रियं वशी । निहत्य दानवान् सर्वान् आजहार रजिः प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Having brought about the destruction of all the Dānavas the highly beautiful, powerful and self-controlled king Raji regained the lost prosperity of the gods.

units.sanskrit: ततो रजिं महावीर्यं देवैः सह शतक्रतुः । इन्द्रो ऽसि तात भूतानां सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः । यस्याहम् इन्द्रः पुत्रस् ते ख्यातिं यास्यामि कर्मभिः ॥
units.english: Then Satakratu, with all the gods, said to Raji am Raji’s son. He again addressed him saying:—Forsooth you have become the lord of all creatures, sire,, Indra, have become your son and shall gain renown by this action –.

units.sanskrit: स तु शक्रवचः श्रुत्वा वञ्चितस् तेन मायया । तथेत्य् एवाब्रवीद् राजा प्रीयमाणः शतक्रतुम् ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Satakratu and having been imposed on by his Māyā the king Raji delightedly said to the king of gods Let it be so.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तु देवैः सदृशो दिवं प्राप्ते महीपतौ । दायाद्यम् इन्द्राद् आजह्रुर् आचारात् तनया रजेः ॥ तानि पुत्रशतान्य् अस्य तद् वै स्थानं शतक्रतोः । समाक्रामन्त बहुधा स्वर्गलोकं त्रिविष्टपम् ॥ ततो बहुतिथे काले समतीते महाबलः । हृतराज्यो ऽब्रवीच् छक्रो हृतभागो बृहस्पतिम् ॥ बदरीफलमात्रं वै पुरोडाशं विधत्स्व मे । ब्रह्मर्षे येन तिष्ठेयं तेजसाप्यायितः सदा ॥
units.english: After the ascension to heaven of that god-like king his sons took away from the lord of gods his celestial kingdom following the practice that ancestral properties should be equally distributed amongst all the sons. Raji's five hundred sons simultaneously attacked Trivisthapa and the celestial kingdom of Indra. After the lapse of many years the king of gods, being deprived of his kingdom and share in the sacrificial offerings, grew very feeble. He then said to Vrihaspati Brahmarshi, do thou arrange for me clarified butter of the weight of a Jujube fruit so that may live on its strength –.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् कृशो ऽहं विमना हृतराज्यो हृताशनः । हतौजा दुर्बलो मूढो रजिपुत्रैः कृतो विभो ॥
units.english: lord, having snatched away my kingdom from me the sons of the king Raji have made me emaciated, absent-minded, shorn of seat and energy, weak and stupid.

units.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर् उवाच यद्य् एवं चोदितः शक्र त्वया स्यां पूर्वम् एव हि । नाभविष्यत् त्वत्प्रियार्थम् अकर्तव्यं मयानघ ॥
units.english: Vrihaspati said:— sinless one, if you had said this to me before would not have been required to do an unfair work for your well-being.

units.sanskrit: प्रयतिष्यामि देवेन्द्र त्वत्प्रियार्थं न संशयः । यथा भागं च राज्यं च न चिरात् प्रतिलप्स्यसे । तथा तात करिष्यामि मा ते भूद् विक्लवं मनः ॥
units.english: shall however, king of gods, surely strive to do you good and you will soon regain your kingdom and due share of the sacrificial offerings. my child, will make arrangements for this and let not your mind be possessed by stupefaction.

units.sanskrit: ततः कर्म चकारास्य तेजसो वर्धनं तदा । तेषां च बुद्धिसंमोहम् अकरोद् ऋषिसत्तमः ॥
units.english: He then did something for increasing the energy of the king of gods. The foremost of the twice-born then brought about the derangement of their Raji's sons understanding.

units.sanskrit: नास्तिवादार्थशास्त्रंहि धर्मविद्वेषणं परम् । परमं तर्कशास्त्राणाम् असतां तन् मनोनुगम् । न हि धर्मप्रधानानां रोचते वै कथान्तरे ॥
units.english: For this purpose he wrote a treatise on atheism, the best of all works on Tarka, dealing with attacks against religion and much liked by the impious. Those, who regard religion as the supreme end of life, do not like this system –.

units.sanskrit: ते तद् बृहस्पतिकृतं शास्त्रं श्रुत्वाल्पचेतसः । पूर्वोक्तधर्मशास्त्राणाम् अभवन् द्वेषिणः सदा ॥ प्रचक्रुर् न्यायरहितं तन्मतं बहु मेनिरे । तेनाधर्मेण ते पापाः सर्व एव क्षयं गताः ॥ त्रैलोक्यराज्यं शक्रस् तु प्राप्य दुष्प्रापम् एव च । बृहस्पतिप्रसादाद् धि परां निर्वृतिम् अभ्यगात् । ते यदा स्म सुसंमूढा रागोन्मत्ता विधर्मिणः । ब्रह्मद्विषश् च संवृत्ता हतवीर्यपराक्रमाः ॥
units.english: Listening to the contents of that treatise written by Vrihaspati the ignorant sons of Raji began expressing their disgust at the previous works on Dharma sāstra. They began respecting highly that atheistical system of their preceptor. By this irreligious act those sinners met with destruction. Having gained, by the favour of Vrishapati, the kingdom of the three worlds which it is so hard to acquire the king of gods was highly pleased. The sons of the king Raji grew foolish, maddened with anger and irreligious. They began to hate the Brāhmanas and were shorn of energy and prowess.

units.sanskrit: ततो लेभे सुरैश्वर्यम् इन्द्रः स्थानं तथोत्तमम् । हत्वा रजिसुतान् सर्वान् कामक्रोधपरायणान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon slaying those sons of Raji possessed by anger and lust the king of the celestials regained his prosperity and kingdom -.

units.sanskrit: य इदं च्यावनं स्थानात् प्रतिष्ठां च शतक्रतोः । शृणुयाद् धारयेद् वापि न स दौरात्म्यम् आप्नुयात् ॥
units.english: He, who listens to or meditates on the account of the loss of kingdom by the king of gods and of the restitution of his prestige, is never visited by any oppression.

units.sanskrit: रजेः पञ्च शतान्य् आसन् पुत्राणाम् अमितौजसाम् । देवैर् अभ्यर्थितो दैत्यान् हत्वेन्द्रायाददाद् दिवम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Rambhā had no issue. shall describe the progeny of Anenā. Sahadeva's son was the virtuous-souled Nadina whose son was Jagatsena whose son was Satkriti.

units.sanskrit: इन्द्रस् तस्मै पुनर् हत्वा गृहीत्वा चरणौ रजेः । पितर्य् उपरते पुत्रा याचमानाय नो ददुः । गुरुणा हूयमाने ऽग्नौ बलभित् तनयान् रजेः ।
units.english: Kshatravriddha's son was the highly illustrious Sunahotra. Gritsamada's son was Shunaka, whose offspring, the Saunakas, were Brāhmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras. Shāla's son was Arshnisena whose son was Sutapa.

units.sanskrit: तेनासौ मोक्षम् आस्थाय ब्रह्मभूतो ऽभवन् मुनिः ॥
units.english: Having acquired final liberation he was united with Brahman.

units.sanskrit: तेषां ययातिः पञ्चानां विजित्य वसुधाम् इमाम् । देवयानीम् उशनसः सुतां भार्याम् अवाप ह । शर्मिष्ठाम् आसुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः ॥
units.english: Of the other five Yayāti conquered this world. He espoused Sukrācharya's daughter Devayani as well as Sharmisthā the daughter of an Asura by name Vrishaparva.

units.sanskrit: यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत । द्रुह्युं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी ॥ तस्य शक्रो ददौ प्रीतो रथं परमभास्वरम् । असङ्गं काञ्चनं दिव्यं दिव्यैः परमवाजिभिः । युक्तं मनोजवैः शुभ्रैर् येन भार्यां समुद्वहत् ॥
units.english: Devayāni gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu and Vrishaparva's daughter Sharmishthā to Drahyu, Anu, and Puru. Being pleased Sakra gave him a highly effulgent, celestial, golden chariot going every where without any interruption. White celestial and excellent horses, fleet like the mind, were yoked to it.

units.sanskrit: स तेन रथमुख्येन षड्रात्रेणाजयन् महीम् । ययातिर् युधि दुर्धर्षस् तथा देवान् सवासवान् ॥ स रथः पौरवाणां तु सर्वेषाम् अभवत् तदा । यावत् तव सनामा वै पौरवो जनमेजय ॥
units.english: By that chariot he used to accomplish every work. Ascending that car, Yayāti, irrepressible in battle, within six nights conquered the entire earth and even the gods with Vāsava -. That car was in the possession of the Pauravas till Sunāmā was born, Janamejaya.

units.sanskrit: कुरोः पौत्रस्य राज्ये तु राज्ञः पारिक्षितस्य ह । गर्गस्य हि सुतं बालं स राजा जनमेजयः । वाक्क्रूरं हिंसयाम् आस ब्रह्महत्याम् अवाप सः ॥
units.english: Kuru's son the king Parikshit lost that car by the imprecation of the intelligent Gārgya. Janamejaya, that king slew the harsh-speeched boy of Gārgya and accordingly he was guilty of the crime of Brahmanicide.

units.sanskrit: स लोहगन्धी राजर्षिः परिधावन्न् इतस् ततः । पौरजानपदैस् त्यक्तो न लेभे शर्म कर्हिचित् ॥
units.english: With a stench all about his body that royal saint moved about hither and thither. Then cast off both by the citizens and villagers he could not enjoy happiness anywhere.

units.sanskrit: ततः स दुःखसंतप्तो नालभत् संविदं क्व चित् । इन्द्रोतं शौनकं राजा शरणं प्रत्यपद्यत ॥ याजयाम् आस चेन्द्रोतः शौनको जनमेजय । स लोहगन्धो व्यनशत् तस्यावभृथम् एत्य ह ॥ स च दिव्यो रथो राजन् वसोश् चेदिपतेस् तदा । दत्तः शक्रेण तुष्टेन लेभे तस्माद् बृहद्रथः ॥
units.english: Thereupon stricken with grief he could not find relief anywhere. He then sought refuge with the ascetic Indrota born in the race of Shounaka. Indrota then undertook the celebration of a horse-sacrifice for purifying that king. When he bathed after the termination of a Yajna, that stench disappeared from his body. Then king, the lord of gods, with pleasure, gave away that celestial car to Vasu the king of Chedis; from him Vrihadratha acquired it.

units.sanskrit: ततो हत्वा जरासंधं भीमस् तं रथम् उत्तमम् । प्रददौ वासुदेवाय प्रीत्या कौरवनन्दन ॥
units.english: From him that car gradually passed into the hands of Jarāsandha. Thereupon slaying Jarāsandha Bhima, the descendant of Kuru, delightedly conferred that most excellent car on Vāsudeva.

units.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपां ययातिस् तु जित्वा पृथ्वीं ससागराम् । दिशि दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां तुर्वसुं मतिमान् नृपः । प्रतीच्याम् उत्तरस्यां तु द्रुह्युं चानुंच नाहुषः ॥ दिशि पूर्वोत्तरस्यां तु यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत् । मध्ये पूरुं च राजानम् अभ्यषिञ्चत् स नाहुषः ॥
units.english: Having conquered the earth consisting of seven insular continents with its oceans Yayāti divided it amongst his sons. Nahusha's son installed Turvasa as the king of the south-eastern quarter, Anu and Druhya as the kings of the northern and eastern divisions respectively, the eldest Yadu as the king of the north-east, and Puru as the king of the Central division.

units.sanskrit: तैर् इयं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपत्तना । यथाप्रदेशम् अद्यापि धर्मेण परिपाल्यते । प्रजास् तेषां पुरस्तात् तु वक्ष्यामि नृपसत्तम ॥ धनुर् न्यस्य पृषत्कांश् च पञ्चभिः पुरुषर्षभैः । जिगाय पृथिवीं सर्वां सप्तद्वीपवतीं नृपः । परवान् अभवद् राजा भारम् आवेश्य बन्धुषु ॥ प्रीतिमान् अभवद् राजा ययातिर् अपराजितः ॥
units.english: Even now they are righteously ruling over the earth consisting of seven insular continents and various cities in their respective provinces. foremost of kings, shall afterwards describe their progeny –. Having been thus blessed with five sons and conferred upon them his bows, arrows and the charge of the kingdom, the foremost of men, that king Yayāti was possessed by decrepitude. Divested of weapons when that ever victorious king cast his eyes on the earth he felt joy.

units.sanskrit: एवं विभज्य पृथिवीं ययातिर् यदुम् अब्रवीत् । जरां मे प्रतिगृह्णीष्व पुत्र कृत्यान्तरेण वै ॥
units.english: Having thus divided the earth he said to Yadu –:—Retiring from thy office, my son, do thou take this decrepitude of mine upon thee.

units.sanskrit: तरुणस् तव रूपेण चरेयं पृथिवीम् इमाम् । जरां त्वयि समाधाय तं यदुः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥
units.english: Making over my decrepitude to thee and being gifted with thy youth and beauty shall range over the earth. Whereto Yadu replied :— have promised to give alms to a Brāhmana.

units.sanskrit: नोत्सहे जरया स्थातुम् अन्तरा प्राप्तया तव । अनपाकृत्य तां राजन् न ग्रहीष्यामि ते जराम् ॥
units.english: It has not been decided as yet. Without ascertaining this cannot accept your decrepitude.

units.sanskrit: जराया बहवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिताः । तस्माज् जरां न ते राजन् ग्रहीतुम् अहम् उत्सहे ॥
units.english: There are many inconveniences regarding food and drink in decrepitude. Therefore, king, do not like to take your decrepitude on me.

units.sanskrit: सन्ति ते बहवः पुत्रा मत्तः प्रियतरा नृप । प्रतिग्रहीतुं धर्मज्ञ पुत्रम् अन्यं वृणीष्व वै ॥
units.english: king, you have many other sons who are more beloved than. Therefore, pious king, command any other son of yours to take your decrepitude.

units.sanskrit: स एवम् उक्तो यदुना राजा कोपसमन्वितः । उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो ययातिर् गर्हयन् सुतम् ॥ क आश्रमस् तवान्यो ऽस्ति को वा धर्मो विधीयते । माम् अनादृत्य दुर्बुद्धे यद् अहं तव देशिकः ॥ एवम् उक्त्वा यदुं तात शशापैनं स मन्युमान् । स तुर्वसुं स द्रुह्युं च अनुं च भरतर्षभ । एवम् एवाब्रवीद् राजा प्रत्याख्यातश् च तैर् अपि ॥
units.english: Thus accosted by Yadu the king was filled with anger. Then blaming his son Yayāti, the foremost of speakers, said :— you of vicious intellect, disregarding me who am your preceptor and who have given you education, whom else can you seek and what religion can you follow? Having addressed Yadu thus in anger he imprecated a curse on him, saying, foolish wight, your sons will be deprived of their kingdom. That king, the foremost of Bharatas, likewise requested Turvasu, Drahyu and Anu and was equally dishonoured by them all.

units.sanskrit: यथा ते कथितं पूर्वं मया राजर्षिसत्तम ॥
units.english: Being enraged that ever victorious Yayāti cursed them all as had described to you before, foremost of the royal saints.

units.sanskrit: एवं शप्त्वा सुतान् सर्वांश् चतुरः पूरुपूर्वजान् । तद् एव वचनं राजा पूरुम् अप्य् आह भारत ॥
units.english: Having thus cursed his four sons who preceded Puru the king said to him, descendant of Bharata.

units.sanskrit: तरुणस् तव रूपेण चरेयं पृथिवीम् इमाम् । जरां त्वयि समाधाय त्वं पूरो यदि मन्यसे ॥
units.english: Puru, if you agree, shall transfer this my decrepitude to you and being invested with your beauty and youth shall roam over this world.

units.sanskrit: स जरां प्रतिजग्राह पितुः पूरुः प्रतापवान् । ययातिर् अपि रूपेण पूरोः पर्यचरन् महीम् ॥
units.english: His powerful son Puru accepted his decrepitude. Yayāti too, endued with Puru's beauty, ranged over the earth.

units.sanskrit: स मार्गमाणः कामानाम् अन्तं भरतसत्तम । विश्वाच्या सहितो रेमे वने चैत्ररथे प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Seeing the termination of pleasures, foremost of Bharatas, that lord lived in the Chaitraratha forest with Vishrāvyā.

units.sanskrit: ततः पूरोः सकाशाद् वै स्वां जरां प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
units.english: When he was satiated with enjoyments the king came to Puru and took back from him his decrepitude.

units.sanskrit: तत्र गाथा महाराज शृणु गीता ययातिना । याभिः प्रत्याहरेत् कामान् सर्वशो ऽङ्गानि कूर्मवत् ॥ स सुखी धृतिमान् धन्यः परत्रेह च मोदते । न जातु कामः कामानाम् उपभोगेन शाम्यति । यत् पृथिव्यां व्रीहियवं हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः । नालम् एकस्य तत् सर्वम् इति मत्वा शमं व्रजेत् ॥
units.english: Hear, great king, the songs sung there by Yayāti. Hearing them a man withdraws himself from pleasures as a tortoise draws in its limbs. Desire is never satiated with the enjoy ment of its object. It rather assumes proportions like a fire when clarified butter is thrown into it. Rice, barley, gold, animals and women, that are on earth, are not sufficient to afford satisfaction to one man.

units.sanskrit: यदा भावं न कुरुते सर्वभूतेषु पापकम् । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥
units.english: Seeing this even men are not brought to their senses. When a man does not commit injury to any creature even by his action, thought and words, he is unified with Brahman.

units.sanskrit: यदान्येभ्यो न बिभेति यदा चास्मान् न बिभ्यति । यदा नेच्छति न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥
units.english: When a man is not afraid of another, when no one is afraid of him, when he cherishes no desire or malice he is unified with Brahman.

units.sanskrit: या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर् या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः । यो ऽसौप्राणान्तिको रोगस् तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम् ॥
units.english: Verily does he attain to happiness when a man relinquishes thirst, which wicked people can never cast off, which does not wear out even when a man is possessed by decrepitude and which is like a fatal malady.

units.sanskrit: धनाशा जीविताशा च जीर्यतो ऽपि न जीर्यति ॥
units.english: When a man is worn out with age his hairs and teeth fall off but the desire for life and wealth never disappears.

units.sanskrit: यच् च कामसुखं लोके यच् च दिव्यं महत् सुखम् । तृष्णाक्षयसुखस्यैते नार्हतः षोडशीं कलाम् । एवम् उक्त्वा स राजर्षिः सदारः प्राविशद् वनम् । कालेन महता चापि चचार विपुलं तपः ॥
units.english: Whatever pleasure is there in this world derivable from the satisfaction of sensual appetites, whatever great heavenly pleasure is there none of them is equal to the one sixteenth of the pleasure derived from the extinction of desire. Having said this the royal saint Yayāti retired into the forest with his wife and for many long years he carried on hard austerities.

units.sanskrit: भृगुतुङ्गे तपश् चीर्त्वा तपसो ऽन्ते महायशाः । अनश्नन् देहम् उत्सृज्य सदारः स्वर्गम् आप्तवान् ॥
units.english: Having carried on his penances on the Bhrigu hill that great ascetic, renouncing his body, attained to heaven with his wife.

units.sanskrit: तस्य वंशे महाराज पञ्च राजर्षिसत्तमाः । यैर् व्याप्ता पृथिवी सर्वा सूर्यस्येव गभस्तिभिः ॥
units.english: great king, in his family five royal saints were born. By them the whole earth was occupied as by the rays of the sun.

units.sanskrit: यदोस् तु शृणु राजर्षे वंशं राजर्षिसत्कृतम् । यत्र नारायणो जज्ञे हरिर् वृष्णिकुलोद्वहः ॥ स्वस्थः प्रजावान् आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमांश् च भवेन् नरः । जनमेजय उवाच पूरोर् वंशम् अहं ब्रह्मञ् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च तद् भवान् वक्तुम् अर्हति ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच वृष्णिवंशप्रसङ्गेन स्वं वंशं पूर्वम् एव हि । शृणु पूरोर् महाराज वंशम् अग्रे महात्मनः । हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि पूरोर् वंशम् अनुत्तमम् । द्रुह्योश्चानोर् यदोश् चैव तुर्वसोश् च परंतप ॥
units.english: Hear now of the family of Yadu honored by all the royal saints. In his family Nārāyana Hari, the perpetuator of Vrishni race, took his birth, king, he, who listens to the sacred biography of the king Yāyāti or reads it, acquires health, offspring, long life and renown. Janamejaya said:— Brahman, wish to hear truly and separately of the families of Puru, Drahyu, Anu, Yadu, and Turvasu. Do you describe them at length from the very beginning while describing the race of Vrishnis –. Vaishampāyana said:— king, hear first of your own family, the brave Puru race, from the very beginning in which you have been born. king, shall describe to you the most excellent family of Puru as well as those of Drahyu, Anu, Yadu and Turvasu.

units.sanskrit: पूरोः प्रवीरः पुत्रो ऽभून् मनस्युस् तस्य चात्मजः । राजा चाभयदो नाम मनस्योर् अभवत् सुतः ॥ सुधन्वनः सुबाहुस् तु रौद्राश्वस् तस्य चात्मजः ॥ संपातिस् तस्य चात्मजः । संपातेस् तु रहस्याती । रौद्राश्वस्य दशार्णेयुः कृकणेयुस् तथैव च । दशाप्सरसि सूनवः । कक्षेयुः स्थण्डिलेयुश् च संनतेयुस् तथैव च ॥ ऋचेयुश् च जलेयुश् च स्थलेयुश् च महाबलः । भद्रा शूद्रा च मद्रा च मलदा मलहा तथा । खला बला च राजेन्द्र तलदा सुरथापि च । तथा गोपबला च स्त्री रत्नकूटा च ता दश ॥
units.english: Janamejaya, Puru's son was a highly powerful king; his son was Prachinvān who conquered the eastern quarter. Prachinvāna's son was Pravira whose son was Manasyu. His son was the king Abhayada whose son was the king Sudhanwā. His son was Vahugava whose son was Shamyāti -. His son was Rahaswati whose son was Roudrāshwa. The latter had ten sons and daughters. The sons were respectively named Dashārneyu, Krikaneyu, Kaksheyu, Sthandileshu, Saunateshu, Richeyu, Sthaleyu, the highly illustrious Jalayeu, Dhaneyu and Vaneyu. The daughters were named Rudrā, Shudra, Bhadrā, Shaladā, Maladā, Khalā, Chalā, Valadā, Suratha and Gochapata. These ten daughters defeated, with their beauty, Urvashi and other jems of women -.

units.sanskrit: ऋषिर् जातो ऽत्रिवंशे च तासां भर्ता प्रभाकरः । रुद्रायां जनयाम् आस सोमं पुत्रं यशस्विनम् ॥
units.english: The Rishi Prabhākara, born in the race of Atri, was their husband. He begat on Rudrā his illustrious son, Soma.

units.sanskrit: स्वर्भानुना हते सूर्ये पतमाने दिवो महीम् । तमोभिभूते लोके च प्रभा येन प्रवर्तिता ॥
units.english: When defeated by Rāhu the sun falls down on earth, and when the whole world is accordingly enveloped with darkness he spreads his rays all over.

units.sanskrit: स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्व् इति चोक्तो वै पतमानो दिवाकरः । वचनात् तस्य विप्रर्षेर् न पपात दिवो महीम् ॥
units.english: When that sage said May good betide you the sun, according to his words, did not fall from the sky.

units.sanskrit: अत्रिश्रेष्ठानि गोत्राणि यश् चकार महातपाः । यज्ञेष्व् अत्रिधनं चैव सुरैर् यस्य प्रवर्तितम् ॥
units.english: The great ascetic Atri was the founder of great families. At his sacrifice even the celestials carried the riches.

units.sanskrit: स तासु जनयाम् आस पुत्रिकासु सनामकान् । दश पुत्रान् महात्मानस् तपस्य् उग्रे रतान् सदा ॥
units.english: This high-souled Rishi begat on the ten daughters of Roudrāshwa ten sons ever engaged in carrying on hard penances.

units.sanskrit: ते तु गोत्रकरा राजन्न् ऋषयो वेदपारगाः । स्वस्त्यात्रेया इति ख्याताः किं त्व् अत्रिधनवर्जिताः ॥
units.english: king, those Rishis, who had mastered the Vedas, were the founders of families. They passed by the name of Swastatreya. But Atri had no money.

units.sanskrit: कक्षेयुतनयास् त्व् आसंस् त्रय एव महारथाः । सभानरश् चाक्षुषश् च परमेक्षुस् तथैव च ॥
units.english: Kasheyu had three sons who were all mighty car-warriors—they were Subhānava, Chākshusa and Parmekshu.

units.sanskrit: सभानरस्य पुत्रस् तु विद्वान् कालानलो नृपः । सृञ्जयस्याभवत् पुत्रो वीरो राजा पुरंजयः । जनमेजयस्य राजर्षेर् महासालो ऽभवत् सुतः । देवेषु स परिज्ञातः प्रतिष्ठितयशास् तथा ॥
units.english: The learned king Kālānala was Subhanavā's son. His son was the pious Srinjaya. The heroic king Puranjaya was Srinjaya's son. king, Janamejaya was Puranjaya's son. The royal saint Mahāshāla was Janamejaya's son. He was well-read in the Vedas and renowned on earth.

units.sanskrit: महामना नाम सुतो महासालस्य धार्मिकः । जज्ञे वीरः सुरगणैः पूजितः स महामनाः ॥ महामनास् तु पुत्रौ द्वौ जनयाम् आस भारत । उशीनरं च धर्मज्ञं तितिक्षुं च महाबलम् ॥ उशीनरस्य पत्न्यस् तु पञ्च राजर्षिवंशजाः । नृगा कृमी नवा दर्वा पञ्चमी च दृषद्वती ॥
units.english: The pious Mahāmanā was Mahāshāla's son. He was heroic, liberal-minded and honoured of all gods. descendant of Bharata, Mahāmanā begat two sons, the pious Ushinara and Titikshu, endued with great strength. Ushinara had five wives born in the families of royal saints—Nrigā, Krimi, Navā, Darvi and Drisadvati.

units.sanskrit: उशीनरस्य पुत्रास् तु पञ्च तासु कुलोद्वहाः । तपसा चैव महता जाता वृद्धस्य चात्मजाः ॥ नृगायास् तु नृगः पुत्रः कृम्याः कृमिर् अजायत । नवायास् तु नवः पुत्रो दर्वायाः सुव्रतो ऽभवत् ॥ शिबेस् तु शिबयस् तात यौधेयास् तु नृगस्य ह ॥ नवस्य नवराष्ट्रं तु कृमेस् तु कृमिला पुरी । सुव्रतस्य तथाम्बष्ठा तितिक्षोस् तु प्रजाः शृणु ॥ शिबिपुत्रान् निबोध मे ॥ शिबेश् च पुत्राश् चत्वारो वीरा वै लोकविश्रुताः । वृषदर्भः सुवीरश् च कैकेयो मद्रकस् तथा ॥
units.english: He begat on those wives five sons who perpetuated his race. By carrying on hard austerities he got all those sons in his old age, descendant of Bharata. Nrigā's son was Nriga, Krimi's son was Krima, Navā's son was Nava, Darvi’s son was Suvrata and from Drisadvati was born the king Sivi. Sivi's sons passed by the name of Sivis, and Nrigā's sons by that of Youdheyas –, Nava's capital was Navarāshtra and that of Krimi was Krimita; whereas the metropolis of Suvrata was celebrated by the name of Amvastha. Hear from me the names of Sivi's sons. He had four sons who were famous in the three worlds for their heroism. They were Drishadarbha, Saviria, Kaikaya and Madrapā.

units.sanskrit: तेषां जनपदाः स्फीताः कैकेया मद्रकास् तथा । वृषदर्भाः सुवीराश् च । तितिक्षुर् अभवद् राजा पूर्वस्यां दिशि भारत । उषद्रथो महाबाहुस् तस्य फेनः सुतो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Their prosperous cities passed by the names of Kaikeya, Madrapa and others. Vrishadarbha and others were all very heroic. Hear now the names of the sons of Titikshu. scion of the Bharata race, Titikshu's son Ushadratha was the king of the eastern division.

units.sanskrit: फेनात् तु सुतपा जज्ञे जज्ञे सुतपसः सुतः । बलिर् मानुषयोनौ तु स राजा काञ्चनेषुधिः ॥
units.english: His son was Phena whose son was Sutapa from whom Bali was born. That demon king was born as man. He had a golden quiver –.

units.sanskrit: महायोगी स तु बलिर् बभूव नृपतिः पुरा । पुत्रान् उत्पादयाम् आस पञ्च वंशकरान् भुवि ॥
units.english: The king Bali was a great ascetic in the days of yore. He begat five sons in the world who multiplied his progeny.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गः प्रथमतो जज्ञे वङ्गः सुह्मस् तथैव च । पुण्ड्रः कलिङ्गश् च तथा बालेयं क्षत्रम् उच्यते । बालेया ब्राह्मणाश् चैव तस्य वंशकरा भुवि ॥
units.english: Of them Anga was born first. Then were born Banga and Sumha. Next to them were born Pundra and Kalinga. These were the Kshatriya sons of Bali. Brāhmana descendants of Bali also flourished on this earth.

units.sanskrit: बलेस् तु ब्रह्मणा दत्तो वरः प्रीतेन भारत । महायोगित्वम् आयुश् च कल्पस्य परिमाणतः । संग्रामे चाप्य् अजेयत्वं धर्मे चैव प्रधानताम् । त्रैलोक्यदर्शनं चापि प्राधान्यं प्रसवे तथा । चतुरो नियतान् वर्णांस् त्वं च स्थापयितेति ह ॥ इत्य् उक्तो विभुना राजा बलिः शान्तिं परां ययौ । तस्य ते तनयाः सर्वे क्षेत्रजामुनिपुंगवाः । संभूता दीर्घतपसः सुदेष्णायां महौजसः । बलिस् तान् अभिषिच्ये ह पञ्च पुत्रान् अकल्मषान् ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, being pleased Brahmā confered on him several boons –. They were—the dignity of a great ascetic, a long life extending over a Kalpa, invincibleness in a battle, leadership of a religious order, the vision of three worlds, supremacy in issuing commands, an insight into the subtleties of religion and matchlessness in strength –. The king Bali was then addressed by Brahmā saying You will always be a defender of the four castes in this world. Thereat he attained to a great equanimity of mind. Bali led a life of celibacy and accordingly the highly powerful and leading ascetic Dirghatamā begat on his wife Sudeshnā all those Kshetraja sons—the foremost of Munis. Having installed his five sinless sons on the throne Bali thought himself blessed.

units.sanskrit: कृतार्थः सो ऽपि योगात्मा योगम् आश्रित्य स प्रभुः । कालेन महता राजन् स्वं च स्थानम् उपागमत् ॥ तेषां जनपदाः पञ्च वङ्गाङ्गाः सुह्मकास् तथा । कलिङ्गाः पुण्ड्रकाश् चैव प्रजास् त्व् अङ्गस्य मे शृणु ॥
units.english: Thereupon practising Yoga that great ascetic, irrepressible unto all, began to wait for time. After a long time, king, he returned to his own region –. His sons had five provinces, namely Anga, Banga, Sumha, Kalinga and Pundraka. Hear now of the sons of Anga.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गपुत्रो महान् आसीद् राजेन्द्रो दधिवाहनः । दधिवाहनपुत्रस् तु राजा दिविरथस् तथा ॥
units.english: The great emperor Dadhivāhana was Anga's son. His son was the king Diviratha.

units.sanskrit: विद्वान् धर्मरथो नाम तस्य चित्ररथः सुतः ॥
units.english: His son was the learned king Dharmaratha equal to Indra in prowess. His son was Chitraratha.

units.sanskrit: तेन धर्मरथेनाथ तदा विष्णुपदे गिरौ । यजता सह शक्रेण सोमः पीतो महात्मना ॥
units.english: Having celebrated a Yajna on the mount Vishnupada the high-souled Chitraratha drank Soma juice with the king of gods.

units.sanskrit: अथ चित्ररथस्यापि पुत्रो दशरथो ऽभवत् । लोमपाद इति ख्यातो यस्य शान्ता सुताभवत् ॥
units.english: Chitraratha's son was Dasharatha who passed by the name of Lomapada whose daughter was Shantā.

units.sanskrit: तस्य दाशरथिर् वीरश् चतुरङ्गो महायशाः । ऋष्यशृङ्गप्रभावेन जज्ञे कुलविवर्धनः ॥
units.english: By Rishyasringa's favour he got a highly illustrious and heroic son by name Chaturanga who perpetuated his race.

units.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गस्य पुत्रस् तु पृथुलाक्ष इति स्मृतः । पृथुलाक्षसुतो राजा चम्पो नाम महायशाः । चम्पस्य तु पुरी चम्पा या पूर्वं मालिनी बभौ ॥
units.english: Chaturanga's son passed by the name of Prithulāksha whose son was the highly illustrious king Champa. Champa's capital was Champā which formerly passed by the name of Mālini.

units.sanskrit: पूर्णभद्रप्रसादेन हर्यङ्गो ऽस्य सुतो ऽभवत् । ततो विभाण्डकस् तस्य वारणं शत्रुवारणम् । अवतारयाम् आस महीं मन्त्रैर् वाहनम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: By the favour of the ascetic Purnabhadra Haryanga was born as his son. Thereupon Vibhāndaka's son, the ascetic Rishyasringa, brought down, by virtue of incantation, Indra's elephant Airāvata to carry him in this world.

units.sanskrit: हर्यङ्गस्य सुतः कर्णो विकर्णस् तस्य चात्मजः । नाम्ना जयद्रथं नाम यस्माद् दृढरथो नृपः ॥ आसीद् दृढरथस्यापि विश्वजिज् जनमेजय । दायादस् तस्य कर्णस् तु । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्व् आसीद् अङ्गानां कुलवर्धनम् ॥
units.english: Haryanga's son was the king Bhadraratha whose son was the king Vrihadkarmā. His son was Vrihadarbha from whom was born Vrihan manā, who begat the heroic king Jayadratha whose son was Dridaratha. Janamejaya, Dridaratha's son was Viswajita -. His son was Karna whose son was Vikarna. He had a hundred sons who multiplied the race of Anga.

units.sanskrit: बृहद्दर्भसुतो यस् तु राजा नाम्नाबृहन्मनाः । तस्य पत्नीद्वयम् चासीच् चैद्यस्यैते सुते शुभे । यशोदेवी च सत्त्वी च ताभ्यां वंशः स भिध्यते ॥
units.english: Vrihadarbha's son Vrihanmanā had two wives in the two beautiful daughters of Chaidya. They were Yashodevi and Satvi who divided the family –.

units.sanskrit: जयद्रथस् तु राजेन्द्र यशोदेव्यां व्यजायत । ब्रह्मक्षत्रोत्तरः सत्त्व्यां विजयो नाम विश्रुतः ॥ विजयस्य धृतिः पुत्रस् तस्य पुत्रो धृतव्रतः । धृतव्रतस्य पुत्रस् तु सत्यकर्मा महाव्रतः ॥
units.english: king, Jayadratha was born of Yashodevi. And from Satvi was born the celebrated king Vijaya, who by his equanimity of mind and other qualities was superior to the Brāhmanas and by heroism and other accomplishments was superior to the Kshatriyas. Vijaya's son was Dhriti whose son was Dhritavrata. His son was the highly illustrious Satyakarma.

units.sanskrit: यः कर्णं प्रतिजग्राह ततः कर्णस् तु सूतजः ॥
units.english: His son was the mighty car-warrior Suta who adopted Karna as his son. It is therefore Karna was called the son of a charioteer.

units.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं कर्णं प्रति महाबलम् । कर्णस्य वृषसेनस् तु वृषस् तस्यात्मजः स्मृतः । एते ऽङ्गवंशजाः सर्वे राजानः कीर्तिता मया । सत्यव्रता महात्मानः प्रजावन्तो महारथाः ॥
units.english: The family of the highly powerful Karna has thus been described. Karna’s son was Vrishasena whose son was Vrisha. have thus described to you the truthful and noble kings of the Anga family who had all many sons and were mighty car-warriors.

units.sanskrit: ऋचेयोस् तु महाराज रौद्राश्वतनयस्य वै । शृणु वंशम् अनुप्रोक्तं यत्र जातो ऽसि पार्थिव ॥
units.english: king, hear now of the family of Roudrāswa's son Richeyu in which you have been born.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच अनाधृष्यस् तु राजर्षिर् ऋचेयुश् चैकराट् स्मृतः । ऋचेयोर् ज्वलना नाम भार्या वै तक्षकात्मजा । ऋचेयुतनयो राजन् मतिनारो महीपतिः । मतिनारसुताश् चासंस् त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः ॥ तंसुरोघो ऽप्रतिरथः सुबाहुश् चैव धार्मिकः । गौरी कन्या चविख्याता मान्धातृजननी शुभा । सर्वे वेदव्रतस्नाता ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः ॥ सर्वेकृतास्त्रा बलिनः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः । पुत्रो ऽप्रतिरथस्यासीत् कण्वः समभवन् नृपः । मेधातिथिः सुतस् तस्य यस्मात् काण्वो ऽभवद् द्विजः । इला नाम तु यस्यासीत् कन्या वै जनमेजय । ब्रह्मवादिन्य् अधित्री च तंसुस् ताम् अध्यगच्छत ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—The invincible king Richeyu had none to equal him. His wife was Ivalanā, the daughter of Takshaka. That saintly queen gave birth to the saintly emperor Matināra. He had three highly pious sons. Of them the first was Tangsu, the second Pratiratha and the youngest was Suvāhu. He had another well-known daughter by name Gouri who was the mother of Māndhāta. They were all well-read in the Vedas, conversant with the knowledge of Brahman, truthful, well-versed in the use of arms, powerful and skillful in war-fare. king, Pratiratha's son was Kanwa whose son was Medhātithi. From him the twice-born ones derived the family of Kānyāyana. Janamejaya, he had a daughter by name Ilini. Tangsu, far more powerful than even the Brahmavādins, espoused her.

units.sanskrit: तंसोः सुरौघो राजर्षिर् धर्मनेत्रो महायशाः । ब्रह्मवादी पराक्रान्तस् तस्य भार्योपदानवी ॥
units.english: His son was the royal saint Surodha, who propagated religion, was Brahmavādhin, powerful and heroic.

units.sanskrit: ततश् चोत्पादयाम् आस चतुरः पुरुनन्दनान् । दुःषन्तम् अथ सुःषन्तं प्रवीरम् अनघं तथा ॥
units.english: His wife was Upadānavi. She had four warrior sons. They were Dushmanta, Sushvanta, Pravira and Anagha.

units.sanskrit: दुःषन्तस्य तु दायादो भरतो नाम वीर्यवान् । स सर्वदमनो नाम नागायुतबलो महान् ॥
units.english: The heroic Bharata was Dushmanta's son. In his boyhood he passed by the name of Sarvadamana, was high-souled and gifted with the strength of ten million elephants.

units.sanskrit: शकुन्तलायां भरतो यस्य नाम्ना स्थ भारताः ॥
units.english: Noble Dushmanta begat on Sakuntalā a son by name Bharata who became Lord Paramount. From him you have all derived the name of Bhāratas.

units.sanskrit: दुःषन्तं प्रति राजाणं वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी । माता भस्त्रा पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः । भरस्व पुत्रं दुःषन्त मावमंस्थाः शकुन्तलाम् ॥
units.english: voice from heaven spoke to the king Dushmanta. The mother is only a leathern case. The son belongs to the father. He takes after him by whom he is begotten. Dushmanta, take care of your son and do not disregard Sakuntalā.

units.sanskrit: रेतोधाः पुत्र उन्नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात् । त्वं चास्य धाता गर्भस्य सत्यम् आह शकुन्तला । भरतस्य विनष्टेषु तनयेषु महीपतेः । मातॄणां तात कोपेण यथा ते कथितं तदा ॥ बृहस्पतेर् अङ्गिरसः पुत्रो राजन् महामुनिः । अयाजयद् भरद्वाजो महद्भिः क्रतुभिर् विभुः ॥
units.english: king, a son, born of a portion of the father, releases him from the abode of Death. Through you she has conceived. Sakuntalā has spoken the truth. As described by me before when the sons of the king Bharata were all destroyed by the anger of their mother, the great ascetic Bharadwaja, the son of Angira's son Vrihaspati, was chosen as a son of Bharata by Marutas, the presiding deities of Yajnas –. This instance, of the Marutas assigning this duty to the intelligent Bharadwāja on behalf of Bharata, is often cited.

units.sanskrit: धर्मसंक्रमणं चापि मरुद्भिर् भरताय वै । पूर्वं तु वितथे तस्य कृते वै पुत्रजन्मनि । ततो ऽथ वितथो नाम भरद्वाजात् सुतो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Bharadwāja honored the Marutas with sacrifices. When the power of procreating sons was withdrawn from Bharata, Bharadwāja begat a son whose name was Vitatha. When his grandson Vitatha was born Bharata repaired to heaven -.

units.sanskrit: वितथं चाभिषिच्याथ भरद्वाजो वनं ययौ । स चापि वितथः पुत्राञ् जनयाम् आस पञ्च वै । सुहोत्रं सुतहोतारं गयं गर्गं तथैव च ॥
units.english: Thereupon placing Vitatha on the throne Bharadwāja retired into woods. He again begat five sons-Suhotra, Suhota, Gaya, Garga and the high-souled Kapila.

units.sanskrit: काशिकश् च महासत्त्वस् तथा गृत्समतिः प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Suhotra had two sons –, the highly powerful Kāshika and the king Gritsamati.

units.sanskrit: तथा गृत्समतेः पुत्रा ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया विशः । काश्यस्य काशयो राजन् पुत्रो दीर्घतपास् तथा ॥
units.english: The latter had sons amongst the Brāhmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisyas. Kāshika's sons were Kāsheya and Dirghatapā; by the latter the learned Dhanwantari was begotten.

units.sanskrit: अथा केतुमतः पुत्रो वीरो भीमरथः स्मृतः । दिवोदास इति ख्यातः सर्वरक्षःप्रणाशनः ॥
units.english: Dhanwantari's son passed by the name of Ketumān. His son was the heroic king Bhimaratha. His son was the celebrated king of Bārānashi by name Divodāsa who slew all the Rākshasas –.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु पुरीं वाराणसीं नृपः । शून्यां निवेशयाम् आस क्षेमको नाम राक्षसः ॥ शप्ता हि सा मतिमता निकुम्भेन महात्मना । शून्या वर्षसहस्रं वै भवित्रीति नरर्षभ ॥
units.english: At this time, king, a Rākshasa, by name Kshemaka, depopulated the city of Bārānashi for the high-souled and intelligent Nikumbha imprecated a curse against that city saying that it would be without any inhabitants for one thousand years.

units.sanskrit: तस्यां तु शप्तमात्रायां दिवोदासः प्रजेश्वरः । विषयान्ते पुरीं रम्यां गोमत्यां संन्यवेशयत् ॥
units.english: As soon as this curse was pronounced against the city of Barānāshi the king Divodāsa laid a most beautiful city on the bank of Gomati –.

units.sanskrit: भद्रश्रेण्यस्य पूर्वं तु पुरी वाराणसीभवत् । भद्रश्रेण्यस्य पुत्राणां शतम् उत्तमधन्विनाम् । हत्वा निवेशयाम् आस दिवोदासः प्रजेश्वरः ॥
units.english: Formerly the city of Bārānashi was in the possession of the ascetic king Bhadrasenya born in the race of Yadu. Having slain his hundred sons who were all excellent bowmen the king Divodāsa laid out his kingdom there -.

units.sanskrit: दिवोदासस्य पुत्रस् तु वीरो राजा प्रतर्दनः । प्रतर्दनस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ वत्सो भार्गव एव च ॥
units.english: The heroic king Pratardanna was Divodāsa's son. He had two sons, Vatsa and Bharga.

units.sanskrit: अलर्को राजपुत्रश् च राजा संनतिमान् भुवि । हेहयस्य तु दायाद्यं हृतवान् वै महीपतिः ॥ आजह्रे पितृदायाद्यं दिवोदासहृतं बलात् । दिवोदासेन बालो हि घृणया स विसर्जितः ॥
units.english: Vatsa's son was Alarka from whom Sannatimān was born. Bhadrasenya's son, the high-souled Durdama was adopted by Haihaya as his son. He regained his ancestral kingdom that was forcibly invaded by Divodāsa. He was out of mercy spared by Divodāsa, who thought him a mere child –.

units.sanskrit: अष्टारथो नाम नृपः सुतो भीमरथस्य वै । तेन पुत्रेषु बालेषु प्रहृतं तस्य भारत । वैरस्यान्तं महाराज क्षत्रियेण विधित्सता ॥
