units.sanskrit: भ्रातृत्वान् मर्षयाम्य् एष स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु व्रजाम्य् अहम् । कृत्यं न मे द्वारकया न त्वया न च वृष्णिभिः ॥
units.english: forgive you because you are my brother. May you farewell. go away. have nothing to do with you or other Vrishnis of Dwarkā.

units.sanskrit: प्रविवेश ततो रामो मिथिलाम् अरिमर्दनः । सर्वकामैर् उपचितैर् मैथिलेनाभिपूजितः ॥
units.english: Thereupon Rāma, the subduer of enemies, entered the city of Mithilā. He was then honored with all becoming presents after his heart by the king of Mithilā.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु बभ्रुर् मतिमतां वरः । नानारूपान् क्रतून् सर्वान् आजहार निरर्गलान् ॥
units.english: In the interval the most intelligent Vabhru began to collect various articles for the performance of sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: दीक्षामयं स कवचं रक्षार्थं प्रविवेश ह । स्यमन्तककृते प्राज्ञो गांदीपुत्रो महायशाः ॥
units.english: The highly illustrious son of Gāndini, on account of the jewel Swyamantaka, entered into the initiation-like coat of mail for protecting himself.

units.sanskrit: षष्टिं वर्षाणि धर्मात्मा यज्ञेषु विनियोजयत् ॥
units.english: He devoted most excellent jewels and various other articles to the performance of sacrifices for sixty thousand years.

units.sanskrit: अक्रूरयज्ञा इति ते ख्यातास् तस्य महात्मनः । बह्वन्नदक्षिणाः सर्वे सर्वकामप्रदायिनः ॥
units.english: That sacrifice, of the high-souled Akrura consisting of food and various presents, was called the Akrura Yajna.

units.sanskrit: अथ दुर्योधनो राजा गत्वा स मिथिलां प्रभुः । गदाशिक्षां ततो दिव्यां बलभद्राद् अवाप्तवान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon repairing to the city of Mithilā the king Duryodhana received from Balabhadra the most excellent instructions in the use of clubs.

units.sanskrit: प्रसाद्य तु ततो रामो वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथैः । आनीतो द्वारकाम् एव कृष्णेन च महात्मना ॥
units.english: Thereupon propitiating Balarāma all the mighty car warriors of the Vrishni race and the high-souled Krishna brought him back to the city of Dwarkā.

units.sanskrit: अक्रूरस् त्व् अन्धकैः सार्धम् अपायाद् भरतर्षभ । हत्वा सत्राजितं युद्धे सहबन्धुं महाबली ॥
units.english: Slaying the highly powerful Satrājit in battle with all his friends Krishna, in feat of dissension amongst his kinsmen, neglected him Akrura.

units.sanskrit: अपयाते तदाक्रूरे नावर्षत् पाकशासनः ॥
units.english: After the departure of Akrura Pākashasana did not pour rain –.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादयाम् आसुर् अक्रूरं कुकुरान्धकाः ॥
units.english: When the whole country was devastated by draught the Kukuras and Andhakas began to propitiate Akrura.

units.sanskrit: पुनर् द्वारवतीं प्राप्ते तस्मिन् दानपतौ ततः । प्रववर्ष सहस्राक्षः कच्छे जलनिधेस् तदा ॥
units.english: When the liberal Akrura returned to Dwarkā the thousand-eyed Indra began to discharge showers on the bank of the ocean.

units.sanskrit: अक्रूरः प्रददौ धीमान् प्रीत्यर्थं कुरुनन्दन ॥
units.english: foremost of Kurus, in order to please Krishna the intelligent Akrura gave him in marriage his sister Sushilā.

units.sanskrit: सभामध्यगतं प्राह तम् अक्रूरं जनार्दनः ॥ यत् तद् रत्नं मणिवरं तव हस्तगतं विभो । तत् प्रयच्छस्व मानार्ह मयि मानार्यकं कृथाः ॥
units.english: Guessing by his riches and liberality that Swyamantaka was with Akrura, Janarddana said to him in the midst of an assembly lord, the jewel is in thy possession. Do thou give it to me. giver of honors; do not cheat me.

units.sanskrit: षष्टिवर्षगते काले यद् रोषो ऽभूत् तदा मम । स संरूढो ऽसकृत्प्राप्तस् ततः कालात्ययो महान् ॥
units.english: sinless one, the anger, that possessed me sixty years before, is now enkindled all on a sudden. long time has elapsed. Give me the Jewel therefore –.

units.sanskrit: ततः कृष्णस्य वचनात् सर्वसात्वतसंसदि । प्रददौ तं मणिं बभ्रुर् अक्लेशेन महामतिः ॥
units.english: Thereupon at the words of Krishna the high-minded Akrura, without experiencing the least pain, gave him the jewel in the midst of the assembled Sātwatas.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तम् आर्यवत्प्राप्तं बभ्रोर् हस्ताद् अरिंदमः । ददौ हृष्टमनाः कृष्णस् तं मणिं बभ्रवे पुनः ॥
units.english: Receiving from Akrura the jewel who gave it away with all simplicity, Hari, the repressor of enemies, returned it to him with a delighted heart.

units.sanskrit: स कृष्णहस्तात् संप्राप्य मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम् । प्रादुर्भावः पुराणेषु विष्णोर् अमिततेजसः । सतां कथयतां एव वाराह इति नः श्रुतम् । न जाने तस्य चरितं विधिं नैव च विस्तरम् । न कर्मगुणसंतानं न हेतुं न मनीषितम् । यज्ञार्थं समवेतानां मिषतां च द्विजन्मनाम् । महावराहचरितं कृष्णद्वैपायनेरितम् । यथा नारायणो ब्रह्मन् वाराहं रूपम् आस्थितः । दंष्ट्रया गां समुद्रस्थां उज्जहारारिसूदनः । या चास्य प्रकृतिर् ब्रह्मंस् तां च व्याख्यातुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: Obtaining the jewel from Krishna's hands and placing it on his breast, Akrura shone there like the sun. Janamejaya said:— Brahman, the sages describe in the Puranas, the incarnations of Vishnu of unlimited energy We have heard from them that the Lord incarnated himself as a boar. But we do not know fully his history, his commands, his deeds, his accomplishments, his objects, his conduct and prowess when he assumed before this form –. We have heard that Krishna Dwaipāyana described this great boar-incarnation before the twice-born ones when they assembled at a sacrifice, Brahman, have heard how Madhusudana, incarnating himself as a boar, saved with his tusks, the earth sunk in the ocean. Brahman, now wish to hear at length the various deeds performed by the intelligent Hari the slayer of enemies in his boar and various other incarnations. You alone are capable of describing in order the various deeds of the lord and his character, Brahman.

units.sanskrit: कथं च भगवान् विष्णुः सुरेशो ऽरिनिषूदनः । वसुदेवकुले धीमान् वासुदेवत्वम् आगतः ॥ अमरैर् आवृतं पुण्यं पुण्यकृद्भिर् अलंकृतम् । देवलोकं समुत्सृज्य मर्त्यलोकम् इहागतः ॥
units.english: Why did the lord Vishnu, the king of the celestials and the slayer of his enemies, take his birth as Vāsudeva in Vasudeva's family ? Why did He, leaving the land of gods, abounding with immortals and pious men, come down on earth ? Why did He, who is the king of gods and men and from whom the earth has emanated, convert his celestial body into a human form.

units.sanskrit: यो ऽन्तकाले जगत् पीत्वा कृत्वा तोयमयं वपुः । लोकम् एकार्णवं चक्रे दृश्यादृश्येन वर्त्मना ॥
units.english: He, at the time of the universal dissolution, drank up the earth and assumed the form of water. He then converted the whole earth into one sheet of water.

units.sanskrit: विषाणाग्रेण वसुधाम् उज्जहारारिसूदनः ॥ यः पुरा पुरुहूतार्थे त्रैलोक्यम् इदम् अव्ययम् । ददौ जित्वा वसुमतीं सुराणां सुरसत्तमः ॥
units.english: He assumed in the days of yore the form of a boar and saved the earth with his tusks. Having vanquished the Asuras on behalf of Puruhuta that foremost of gods conferred upon the celestials the three worlds in the days of yore.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वदैत्यो महावीर्यो हिरण्यकशिपुर् हतः ॥
units.english: Assuming the form of a man-lion he killed the prime Daitya the highly energetic Hiranyakasipu.

units.sanskrit: यः पुरा ह्य् अनलो भूत्वा और्वः संवर्तको विभुः । पातालस्थो ऽर्णवगतं पपौ तोयमयं हविः ॥
units.english: Assuming the form of the submarine fire Samvartaka the lord, in the days of yore, drank the watery oblations of the submarine region.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रचरणं ब्रह्मन् सहस्रांशुं सहस्रशः । सहस्रशिरसं देवं यम् आहुर् वै युगे युगे ॥
units.english: Brahman, in various thousands of Yugas that Lord appeared with a thousand heads, a thousand eyes and a thousand feet.

units.sanskrit: नाभ्यरण्यां समुत्पन्नं यस्य पैतामहं गृहम् । एकार्णवगते लोके तत् पङ्कजम् अपङ्कजम् ॥
units.english: When the whole world was converted into one sheet of water, when the entire mobile and immobile creations were destroyed there sprang from his navel a lotus on which Brahmā Grand-father rested.

units.sanskrit: येन ते निहता दैत्याः संग्रामे तारकामये । सर्वदेवमयं कृत्वा सर्वायुधधरं वपुः । गरुडस्थेन चोत्सिक्तः कालनेमिर् निपातितः ॥ निर्जितश् च महादैत्यस् तारकश् च महासुरः । उत्तरान्ते समुद्रस्य क्षीरोदस्यामृतोदधेः । यः शेते शाश्वतं योगम् आस्थाय तिमिरं महत् ॥
units.english: In the encounter with Tāraka, he, assuming a form consisting of all gods and holding all weapons, slew the demons. Seated on Garuda and assuming a huge proportion he killed the great demon Kālanemi and vanquished the great Asura Taraka. Being engaged in eternal Yoga and resorting to his illusive energy he lay on the northern side of the ocean of milk from which came out ambrosia.

units.sanskrit: सुरारणिर् गर्भम् अधत्त दिव्यं तपःप्रकर्षाद् अदितिः पुराणम् । शक्रं च यो दैत्यगणावरुद्धं गर्भावसाने नकृशं चकार ॥
units.english: On account of the consummation of her hard austerities Aditi conceived that celestial ancient Purusha who was like the churning rod of the celestials. Coming out of her womb as a dwarf he satisfied the desire of Indra who had been confined by the demons.

units.sanskrit: पदानि यो लोकपदानि कृत्वा चकार दैत्यान् सलिलाशयस्थान् । कृत्वा च देवांस् त्रिदिवस्य देवांश् चक्रे सुरेशं पुरुहूतम् एव ॥ पात्राणि दक्षिणा दीक्षा चमसोलूखलानि च । गार्हपत्येन विधिना अन्वाहार्येण कर्मणा । अग्निम् आहवनीयं च वेदीं चैव कुशान् स्रुवम् ॥ प्रोक्षणीयं ध्रुवां चैव आवभृथ्यं तथैव च । अरांस् त्रीणि च यश् चक्रे हव्यकव्यप्रदान् मखे ॥ भागार्थे यज्ञविधिना योगज्ञो यज्ञकर्मणि ॥ यूपान् समित् स्रुचं सोमं पवित्रं परिधीन् अपि । यज्ञियानि च द्रव्याणि यज्ञांश् च चयनानलान् । सदस्यान्य् अजमानांश् च मेधादींश् च क्रतूत्तमान् ॥ सृष्टा लोकास् त्रयो ऽनन्ता येनानन्त्येन वर्त्मना ॥ सर्वभूतगुणस्रष्टा सर्वभूतगुणात्मकः । नृणाम् इन्द्रियपूर्वेण योगेन रमते च यः । गतागताभ्यां यो नेता तत्रेह च विधीश्वरः ॥
units.english: Placing his feet in all the worlds he placed all the demons in the water. And making the gods playful in heaven he conferred upon Indra the kingdom of gods. He laid down the rules of Gārhapatya and Anwāharya works, created the various articles of sacrifice such as Dakshina, Diksha, Chamasa and Ulukhula, created the fire where oblations could be offered, made the sacrificial altar, Kusha, Sruva, Prokshaniya, and Dhruva created the three sorts of ambrosia beneficial to the bath after the celebration of a sacrifice, made the twice born ones offer Havya and Kavya, and the celestials to partake of the former and the ancestral manes of the latter. After the lines laid down by Parameshthi Brahmā He, in the days of yore, by various sacrificial Mantras, made divisions of Yupas, Samidhas, Srukas, Soma, the sacred Paridhri, and of various other sacrificial articles, of the room for placing sacrificial fire of the members, of Yajamānas and a classification of Medha and other excellent sacrifices. By his endless actions these three worlds had been created by Him before. He is the creator of all the elements and Gunas and identical with them all. By introducing birth and death amongst mankind he makes them move about in the universe. He sports everywhere in the shape of an animal. He is the lord of the universe.

units.sanskrit: यो गतिर् धर्मयुक्तानाम् अगतिः पापकर्मणाम् । चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य प्रभवश् चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता ॥ चातुर्विद्यस्य यो वेत्ता चातुराश्रम्यसंश्रयः । दिगन्तरो नभोभूतो वायुर् वायुविभावनः ॥
units.english: He is the refuge of the pious and he only punishes the wicked. He is the origin of the four Varnas and the protector of the four Hotras. He is the master of the four-fold knowledge and the preserver of the four Asramas. He is identical with the various directions, with the sky, with the air, fire and water.

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यद्वयं ज्योतिर् योगीशः क्षणदातनुः । यः परं श्रूयते ज्योतिर् यः परं श्रूयते तपः ॥ यः परं प्राह परतः परं यः परमात्मवान् । नारायणपरा वेदा नारायणपराः क्रियाः । नारायणपरं सत्यं नारायणपरं तपः । नारायणपरो मोक्षो नारायणपरं परम् । आदित्यादिस् तु यो दिव्यो यश् च दैत्यान्तको विभुः ॥
units.english: He is identical with the sun, the moon and the rays. He is the lord of Yogins and He only brings about the termination of the night. He is identical with the most excellent lustre and tapas of which we hear. The sages designate him as the thread that connects all the souls; and the whole universe is His form. The Vedas and all the works exist in Nārāyana. Nārāyana is the greatest virtue and is the most most excellent condition. Truth exists in Nārayanā and Tapas exists in Him Salvation exists in Nārāyana and Nārāyana is the most excellent refuge. He is the Aditya and other gods and he is the slayer of demons.

units.sanskrit: युगान्तेष्व् अन्तको यश् च यश् च लोकान्तकान्तकः । सेतुर् यो लोकसेतूनां मेध्यो यो मेध्यकर्मणाम् ॥
units.english: He is the death unto the regent of the dead who destroys all. He is the lord of Manu and others who have instituted various orders of honour amongst mankind and he is more sacred than Ganga and others, who purify the mankind.

units.sanskrit: वेद्यो यो वेदविदुषां प्रभुर् यः प्रभवात्मनाम् । सोमभूतश् च भूतानाम् अग्निभूतो ऽग्निवर्चसाम् ॥
units.english: He is the object of learning unto those who are conversant with the Vedas; he is the lord of the self-controlled Rishis; he is more handsome than all handsome objects, he is like fire unto those who are endued with fire-like effulgence.

units.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां मनोभूतस् तपोभूतस् तपस्विनाम् । विनयो नयवृत्तानां तेजस् तेजस्विनाम् अपि ॥ सर्गकारश् च सर्गाणां लोकहेतुर् अनुत्तमः । विग्रहो विग्रहार्हाणां गतिर् गतिमताम् अपि ॥
units.english: He is the mind of men, the ascetic energy of the ascetics, the morality of those who are strict moralists, the energy of the energetic, the creator of all creations and the most excellent origin of all the worlds. He is the idol ef those who seek the idols and he is the motion of those who are endued with it.

units.sanskrit: आकाशप्रभवो वायुर् वायुप्राणो हुताशनः । देवा हुताशनप्राणाः प्राणो ऽग्नेर् मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Ether is the origin of air and air is the life of fire. The vital power of the gods is fire and the life of fire is Madhusudana.

units.sanskrit: रसाद् वै शोणितं भवति शोणितान् मांसम् उच्यते । मांसात् तु मेदसो जन्म मेदसो ऽस्थि निरुच्यते ॥ अस्थ्नो मज्जा समभवन् मज्जायाः शुक्रसंभवः । शुक्राद् नर्भः समभवद् रसमूलेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Blood is engendered by juice and by blood is created flesh. From flesh originates fat and from fat originate the bones and from the bones originate the veins and from veins originates the seminal fluid. And the seminal fluid is the instrument of conception. By the process of action at the root of which is the juice all this is created.

units.sanskrit: तत्रापां प्रथमो भागः स सौम्यो राशिर् उच्यते । गर्भोष्मसंभवो ज्ञेयो द्वितीयो राशिर् उच्यते ॥
units.english: Of them the water is the first portion therefore it is called Soumya. The second ingredient is the fire in the womb.

units.sanskrit: शुक्रं सोमात्मकं विद्याद् आर्तवं पावकात्मकम् । भावौ रसानुगाव् एतौ वीर्यं च शशिपावकौ ॥
units.english: Thus the seminal fluid, indential with fire, is also made of blood. Thus the essence of all juice, the seminal fluid, is created by an excess of cough and blood is created by an excess of billious matter.

units.sanskrit: कफवर्गे भवेच् छुक्रं पित्तवर्गे च शोणितम् । देहस्य मध्ये हृदयं स्थानं तु मनसः स्मृतम् । नाभिकण्ठान्तरस्थस् तु तत्र देवो हुताशनः ॥
units.english: The seat of cough is the heart and the seat of bile is the navel. The heart, which is in the body, is known as the seat of the mind. The fire exists as hunger behind the cavity of the navel.

units.sanskrit: मनः प्रजापतिर् ज्ञेयः कफः सोमो विभाव्यते । पित्तम् अग्निः स्मृतस् त्व् एवम् अग्नीषोममयं जगत् ॥
units.english: Mind is known as Prajāpati Brahmā, the cough as Soma and the bile as Agni fire-god. Thus the whole world is identical with fire –.

units.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तिते गर्भे वर्तिते ऽर्बुदसंनिभे । वायुः प्रवेशनं चक्रे संगतः परमात्मना ॥ ततो ऽङ्गानि विसृजति बिभर्ति परिवर्तयन् । स पञ्चधा शरीरस्थो भिद्यते वर्धते पुनः । प्राणापानौ समानश् च उदानो व्यान एव च ॥
units.english: When a conception, as is the formation of a cloud, takes place, the air, accompanied by Paramātman, enters there. It then creates the various limbs and nourishes them. The vital air, inside the body, divides itself into five and gradually assumes proportions. The five vital airs are Prāna, Apāna, Samāna, Udāna, and Vyāna.

units.sanskrit: प्राणो ऽस्य प्रथमं स्थानं वर्धयन् परिवर्तते । अपानः पश्चिमं कायम् उदानोर्ध्वं शरीरिणः ॥
units.english: Prāna nourishes the most important portion of the body namely, the heart. Apāna nourishes the lower portion of the body up to the feet. Udāna nourishes the breast and the upper portion of the body.

units.sanskrit: व्यानो व्यायच्छते येन समानः संनिवर्तते । भूतावाप्तिस् ततस् तस्य जायतेन्द्रियगोचरा ॥
units.english: The vital air, by which works, requiring great strength, are performed, is called Vyāna. After the distribution of the vital airs the creatures acquire the knowledge of the earth through their senses.

units.sanskrit: पृथिवी वायुर् आकाशम् आपो ज्योतिश् च पञ्चमम् । तस्येन्द्रियाणि शिष्टानि स्वं स्वं योगं प्रचक्रिरे ॥ पार्थिवं देहम् आहुस् तु प्राणात्मानं च मारुतम् । छिद्राण्य् आकाशयोनीनि जलस्रावः प्रवर्तते ॥ ज्योतिश् चक्षुषि तेजश् च तेषां यन्तृ मनः स्मृतम् । ग्राम्याश् च विषयाश् चैव यस्य वीर्यात् प्रवर्तिताः ॥
units.english: Earth, air, ether, water and light, are converted into senses. And then they occupy their respective portions in the body and perform their respective functions. The hardest portion of the body is the transformation of the earth. The vital air is the metamorphosis of the air; all the holes originate from ether; the liquid portion is but water; the eye is the form of light and the mind, which is the energy of the five elements, is the lord of the senses. It is the mind, that, by its energy, makes the senses perceive their respective objects –.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एतान् पुरुषः सर्वान् सृजंल् लोकान् सनातनान् । नैधने ऽस्मिन् कथं लोके नरत्वं विष्णुर् आगतः ॥
units.english: Having thus created the ever-existing worlds why did the Great Purusha take his birth as a man in this mortal world ? This is my doubt, this is what surprises me.

units.sanskrit: कथं गतिर् गतिमताम् आपन्नो मानुषीं तनुम् ॥ श्रुतो मे स्वस्य वंशस्य पूर्वजानां च संभवः । श्रोतुम् इच्छामि विष्णोस् तु वृष्णीनां च यथाक्रमम् ॥
units.english: Brahman, why did He, who is the energy of mankind, take his birth as a man ? have heard an account of my own family as well as of those of my ancestors. wish now to hear in due order of the families of Vishnu and Vrishnis.

units.sanskrit: आश्चर्यं परमं विष्णुर् देवैर् दैत्यैश् च कथ्यते । विष्णोर् उत्पत्तिम् आश्चर्यं ममाचक्ष्व महामुने ॥
units.english: That Vishnu is a great wonder is said by the gods and demons. Do you, great Muni, describe to me the wondrous origin of Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: प्रख्यातबलवीर्यस्य विष्णोर् अमिततेजसः । कर्मणाश्चर्यभूतस्य विष्णोस् तत्त्वम् इहोच्यताम् ॥
units.english: Do you describe to me truly the wonderful and delightful account of the highly energetic Vishnu of well-known deeds and prowess who surprised the whole world by his actions.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच प्रश्नभारो महांस् तात त्वयोक्तः शार्ङ्गधन्वनि । यथाशक्ति तु वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां वैष्णवं यशः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:— my child, the question that you have put regarding Hari, the holder of Sranga bow, is indeed very great. Listen, shall still describe the glory of Vishnu as much as lies in my power.

units.sanskrit: हन्त विष्णोः समस्तास् त्वं शृणु दिव्याः प्रवृत्तयः ॥
units.english: Fortunately for you that our mind is bent upon listening to Vishnu's prowess. Hear, shall describe the celestial origin of the lord.

units.sanskrit: आहुर् वेदविदो विप्रा यं यज्ञं शाश्वतं विभुम् ॥ तस्य विष्णोः सुरेशस्य श्रीवत्साङ्कस्य धीमतः । प्रादुर्भावसहस्राणि समतीतान्य् अनेकशः । यत् पृच्छसि महाराज दिव्यां पुण्यां कथां शुभाम् । किमर्थं भगवान् विष्णुर् वसुदेवकुले ऽभवत् ॥ सुरेशो रिपुसूदनः । देवलोकं समुत्सृज्य । हितार्थं सुरमर्त्यानां लोकानां प्रभवाय च । बहुशः सर्वभूतात्मा प्रादुर्भवति कार्यतः । प्रादुर्भावांश् च वक्ष्यामि पुण्यान् देवगुणैर् युतान् ॥ छान्दसीभिर् उदाराभिः श्रुतिभिः समलंकृतान् । शुचिः प्रयतवाग् भूत्वा निबोध जनमेजय । इदं पुराणं परमं पुण्यं वेदैश् च संमितम् । हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि विष्णोर् दिव्यां कथां शृणु । यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर् भवति भारत । धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय तदा संभवति प्रभुः । तस्य ह्य् एका महाराज मूर्तिर् भवति सत्तम । नित्यं दिविष्ठा या राजंस् तपश् चरति दुश्चरम् । द्वितीया चास्य शयने निद्रायोगम् उपाययौ । प्रजासंहारसर्गार्थं किम् अध्यात्मविचिन्तकम् । सुप्त्वा युगसहस्रं स प्रादुर्भवति कार्यवान् । पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु देवदेवो जगत्पतिः ॥ पितामहो लोकपालाश् चन्द्रादित्यौ हुताशनः । ब्रह्मा च कपिलश् चैव परमेष्ठी तथैव च । देवाः सप्तर्षयश् चैव त्र्यम्बकश् च महायशाः ॥
units.english: That intelligent Lord of gods, Vishnu, having the mystic mark of Srivātsa on his breast, incarnated himself in thousands of forms. And thousands of his incarnations shall take place in future, Brahmā has said this -. great king, shall describe at length, as accosted by you, the sacred and celestial theme, why the Divine lord Vishnu, the king of gods and the slayer of his enemies, took his birth leaving the celestial region, in the race of Vasudeva. For encompassing the well-being of the gods and men and the prosperity of all the worlds, the Soul of all, for a great work of his own, went through various incarnations –. shall describe the sacred and celestial incarnations of the Lord fraught with many virtues that have been recorded in metres and great Srutis. Purifying yourself and controlling your speech, listen to them, Janamejaya. This highly sacred Purāna is equal to the Vedas. Hear, shall describe this celestial story of Vishnu. Bharata, whenever virtue suffers deterioration the Lord, for establishing it, incarnates Himself. great king, he had one form partaking of the quality of goodness. In this form He is constantly practising hard austerities in Heaven. His second form is possessed by yoga sleep for bringing about the destruction of creatures; and from this sleep originate persons of misconceived spiritual culture. Having slept for a thousand yugas He again appears for work. And after the completion of a thousand yugas, the god of gods, the lord of the universe, Vishnu, the Grandfather Brahmā, the Regents of all the worlds, the moon, the sun, the fire, Brahma, Kapila, Paramesthi, the gods, the seven Rishis, the highly illustrious, three-eyed god Siva, the air, the oceans and the mountains exist in His form –.

units.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारश् च महानुभावो मनुर् महात्मा भगवान् प्रजाकरः । पुराणदेवो ऽथ पुराणि चक्रे प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरतुल्यतेजाः ॥
units.english: The great Sanatkumar and the high-souled Manu, the father of creation also exist in His form. That ancient Lord, effulgent like the fire, has created all the forms.

units.sanskrit: नष्टे देवासुरनरे प्रनष्टोरगराक्षसे ॥ योद्धुकामौ सुदुर्धर्षौ दानवौ मधुकैटभौ । हतौ प्रभवता तेन तयोर् दत्त्वामितं वरम् ॥ पुरा कमलनाभस्य स्वपतः सागराम्भसि । पुष्करे यत्र संभूता देवाः सर्षिगणाः पुरा ॥ पुराणं कथ्यते यत्र वेदश्रुतिसमाहितम् ॥
units.english: After the destruction of all creatures mobile and immobile, after the destruction of the gods and demons, serpents and Rakshasas that highly powerful Purusha killed the two irrepressible Dānavas, Madhu and Kaitava in the midst of the ocean and conferred upon them the boon of final liberation -. While in the days of yore the lotus-navelled Lord lay in the water of the ocean there sprang from His navel the gods and the Rishis. This is the Lotus incarnation of the Lord as recorded in the Vedas and Srutis.

units.sanskrit: यत्र विष्णुः सुरश्रेष्ठो वाराहं रूपम् आस्थितः ॥ महीं सागरपर्यन्तां सशैलवनकाननाम् । वेदपादो यूपदंष्ट्रः क्रतुदन्तश् चितीमुखः । अग्निजिह्वो दर्भलोमा ब्रह्मशीर्षो महातपाः ॥ अहोरात्रेक्षणो दिव्यो वेदाङ्गश्रुतिभूषणः । आज्यनासः स्रुवस् तुण्डः सामघोषस्वनो महान् ॥
units.english: Next the Boar incarnation of the Lord is recorded in Srutis, where Vishnu, the foremost of the celestials, assumed the form of a boar and raised up the earth with her forests and mountains, with His tusks sunk in the all-spreading ocean. The four Vedas were his feet, the sacrificial altar was his tusk, the sacrifices were his teeth, the funeral pile was his mouth, the fire was his tongue, and the Darbhas were the hairs of his body. The great ascetic Brahmā was his head, the days and nights were the eyes of that eldest Purusha, the various divisions of the Vedas were the ornaments of his ears, the progenitors were his nose, the chanting of the Sama Veda was his great voice.

units.sanskrit: धर्मसत्यमयः श्रीमान् क्रमविक्रमसत्कृतः । प्रायश्चित्तनखो धीरः पशुजानुर् महावृषः ॥
units.english: He was identical with virtue and truth. Penance was his nostril; dreadful beasts were his nails and he had long arms.

units.sanskrit: उद्गात्रान्त्रो होमलिङ्गः फलबीजमहौषधिः । वाय्वन्तरात्मा मन्त्रस्फिग् विकृतः सोमशोणितः ॥
units.english: The air was his soul, the mantra was his hip, the sanctified Soma juice was his blood, the sacrificial altars were his shoulders.

units.sanskrit: वेदिस्कन्धो हविर्गन्धो हव्यकव्यातिवेगवान् । प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमान् नानादीक्षाभिर् आचितः ॥ दक्षिणाहृदयो योगी महासत्रमयो महान् । महीं सागरपर्यन्तां सशैलवनकाननाम् । एकार्णवजले भ्रष्टाम् एकार्णवगतिः प्रभुः ॥ सद्यो जगाम निर्वाणं मेदिनी तस्य धारणात् । चकार च नमस्कारं तस्मै देवाय वेधसे । सहस्रशीर्षो देवादिश् चकार जगतीं पुनः ॥ एवं यज्ञवराहेण भूत्वा भूतहितार्थिना । उद्धृता पृथिवी देवी सागराम्बुधरा पुरा ॥ वाराह एष कथितो नारसिंहम् अतः शृणु । यत्र भूत्वा मृगेन्द्रेण हिरण्यकशिपुर् हतः ॥
units.english: Havi was his smell, Havy and Kavya were his energies, Nagvangsha was his body. He was effulgent and sanctified by various forms of initiation. Dakshinā or gift was his heart. He was ascetic and great and the recitation of the Vedic hymns was the ornament of his lips. The great heroes, who stand in the way of virtue, were his ornaments. The various metres were his motion. The sacred Upanishad was his seat. The image of his wife was his help and he was tall like the summit of the mount Meru. This thousand-headed Prime Deity re-established the earth –. Thus in the days of yore for encompassing the well-being of creatures the Lord, assuming the shape of a sacrificial boar, raised up the earth from the water of the ocean. This is an account of the boar incarnation. Listen now to an account of His man-lion incarnation where assuming the form of a lion he killed Hiranyakashipu.

units.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन् सुरारिर् बलदर्पितः । दैत्यानाम् आदिपुरुषश् चकार तप उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: king, in the days of yore in the golden age, the first of the Daityas born, Hiranyakesipu, an enemy of the gods, practised most excellent penances.

units.sanskrit: दश वर्शसहस्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च । जलोपवासस् तस्यासीत् स्थानमौनदृढव्रतः ॥
units.english: Observing the vow of silence and steadfastly carrying it on he alone, placed in the midst of water, spent eleven thousand and five hundred years.

units.sanskrit: ततः शमदमाभ्यां च ब्रह्मचर्येण चानघ । ब्रह्मा प्रीतमनास् तस्य तपसा नियमेन च ॥
units.english: sinless one, thereupon Brahmā was pleased with his self-control, equanimity of mind, asceticism and observance of rules and the vow of celibacy.

units.sanskrit: आदित्यैर् वसुभिः साध्यैर् मरुद्भिर् दैवतैः सह । रुद्रैर् विश्वसहायैश् च यक्षराक्षसकिंनरैः ॥ दिशाभिर् विदिशाभिश् च नदीभिः सागरैस् तथा । नक्षत्रैश् च मुहूर्तैश् च खेचरैश् च महाग्रहैः ॥ देवर्षिभिस् तपोवृद्धैः सिद्धैः सप्तर्षिभिस् तथा । ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो दैत्यं वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥ प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव भक्तस्य तपसानेन सुव्रत । वरं वरय भद्रं ते यथेष्टं कामम् आप्नुहि ॥
units.english: great king then the lord of all, the divine self-sprung Brahmā, the foremost of all, having the knowledge of Brahman, himself, in his effulgent and sun like car drawn by swans, came to him encircled by all the Adityas, Vasus, Sādhyas, Maruds, gods, Rudras, Viswas, Yakshas, Rakshas, Kinnaras, rivers, oceans, stars, Muhurthas, creatures ranging in the sky, planets, celestial saints, old ascetic Siddhas, the seven Rishis, the great royal saints and Apsaras. He then said to the Daitya:— you of firm vows, you are a disciple of mine. have been pleased with your asceticism. Pray for a boon; may you fare well and acquire your wished-for objects –.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुर् उवाच न देवासुरगन्धर्वा न यक्षोरगराक्ष्साः । न मानुषाः पिशाचा वा हन्युर् मां देवसत्तम ॥ ऋषयो वा न मां शापैः क्रुद्धा लोकपितामह । यो मां नाशयितुं शक्तः स मे मृत्युर् भविष्यति । भवेयम् अहम् एवार्कः सोमो वायुर् हुताशनः । सलिलं चान्तरिक्षं च नक्षत्राणि दिशो दश ॥ अहं क्रोधश् च कामश् च वरुणो वासवो यमः । एवम् उक्तस् तु दैत्येन स्वयंभुर् भगवांस् तदा । उवाच दैत्यराजं तं प्रहसन् नृपसत्तम । सर्वान् कामान् इमांस् तात प्राप्स्यसि त्वं न संशयः ॥
units.english: Hiranyakasipu said;— grand-father, pray for this boon, that the gods, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Nāgas, Rakshasas, men and goblins may not by any means kill me and that the Rishis, when enraged, may not imprecate a curse on me, and that the weapons, mountains, trees, dry or wet articles or any other things may not bring about my destruction. Let him alone be my destroyer who will be able, with his servants and army, to kill me only with the strokes of his arms. , myself, shall be the moon, the sun, the air, the fire, air, ether, the stars, the ten quarters, desire, anger, Varuna, Vāsava, Yama, the lord of riches and Yaksha, the king of Kimpurushas -. Thus addressed by the king of Daityas, emperor, the self-sprung Deity smilingly said;— my child, confer upon you these most wonderful and celestial boons. Undoubtedly you will attain to all your desired-for objects –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु भगवाञ् जगामाकाशम् एव ह । वैराजं ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम् ॥
units.english: Having said this the divine grand-father repaired, by the etherial region, to his habitation Vairaja resorted to by the Brāhmana saints.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा देवा वरं तं च दत्तं सलिलयोनिना । विभुं विज्ञापयाम् आसुर् देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः । ततो देवाश् च नागाश् च गन्धर्वा मुनयस् तथा । वरप्रदानं श्रुत्वैव पितामहम् उपस्थिताः ॥
units.english: Hearing that the water-sprung deity, the foremost of the celestials, had conferred this celestial boon on Daitya-king Hiranyakasipu, the gods, headed by Indra, communicated it to the Creator. Hearing of this conferring of the boons the Devas, the Nāgas, the Gandharvas and the Munis appeared before the grand-father –.

units.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः वरदानेन भगवन् वधिष्यति स नो ऽसुरः । स्रष्टा च हव्यकव्यानाम् अव्यक्तः प्रकृतिर् ध्रुवः ॥ ततो लोकहितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा देवः प्रजापतिः । प्रोवाच भगवान् वाक्यं सर्वान् देवगणांस् तदा ॥
units.english: The Gods said— lord, by this boon the Asura will oppress us. Be thou propitiated and concert a measure for his destruction. Hearing those words beneficial unto all the lord Prajapati, the omniscient, self-sprung Deity, the invisible and immortal creator of Havy, Kavya and all other creatures said to the gods –.

units.sanskrit: अवश्यं त्रिदशास् तेन प्राप्तव्यं तपसः फलम् । तपसो ऽन्ते ऽस्य भगवान् वधं विष्णुः करिष्यति ॥
units.english: Forsooth he must attain to the fruits of his asceticism. After he enjoys them the lord Vishnu will kill him.

units.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं पङ्कजजन्मनः । स्वानि स्थानानि दिव्यानि जग्मुस् ते वै मुदा युताः ॥
units.english: Hearing these words from the lotus-sprung Deity all the gods, filled with delight, repaired to their respective celestial habitations –.

units.sanskrit: लब्धमात्रे वरे चापि सर्वाः सो ऽबाधत प्रजाः । हिरण्यकशिपुर् दैत्यो वरदानेन दर्पितः ॥
units.english: As soon as he obtained the boon the Daitya Hiranyakasipu, elated with the pride thereof, began oppressing all the creatures.

units.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु महाभागान् मुनीन् वै संशितव्रतान् । सत्यधर्मरतान् दान्तान् पुरा धर्षितवांस् तु सः ॥
units.english: He first of all carried his work of oppression on the great, truthful and self-controlled Munis of firm vows living in the hermitages.

units.sanskrit: देवांस् त्रिभुवनस्थांश् च पराजित्य महासुरः । त्रैलोक्यं वशम् आनीय स्वर्गे वसति दानवः ॥ यज्ञियान् अकरोद् दैत्यान् अयज्ञीयाश् च देवताः ॥ आदित्याश् च ततः साध्या विश्वे ऽथ वसवस् तथा । शरण्यं शरणं विष्णुम् उपतस्थुर् महाबलम् ॥ देवं ब्रह्ममयं यज्ञं ब्रह्मदेवं सनातनम् । भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य प्रभुं लोकनमस्कृतम् । नारायणं विभुः देवाः शरण्यं शरण्यं गताः ॥ त्रायस्व नो ऽद्य देवेश हिरण्यकशिपोर् वधात् । त्वं हि न परमो देवस् त्वं हि न परमो गुरुः । त्वं हि नः परमो धाता ब्रह्मादीनां सुरोत्तम ॥
units.english: Having vanquished all the gods of the three worlds and having brought them all under subjection the Daitya Hiranyakasipu lived in the celestial region. As long as he, elated with pride, lived in the celestial region the gods could not partake of the sacrificial offerings and the Daityas were entitled thereto. Thereupon the Adityas, Viswas and Vasus sought refuge with the highly powerful Nārāyana Vishnu, the lord of protection, who is Brahman identical with the gods and sacrifices, who is the presiding god of the Brāhmanas, who is eternal, the present and past and future and who is omniscient and adored of all the worlds –. The Gods said:—. king of gods, foremost of the celestials, do thou save us from the fear of Hiranyakasipu. Thou art the Supreme Lord of us all and of Brahmā and others. Thou art our Great God and Great Preceptor.

units.sanskrit: उत्फुल्लाम्बुजपत्राक्ष शत्रुपक्षभयावह । क्षयाय दितिवंशस्य शरणं त्वं भवस्व नः ॥
units.english: thou having eyes like the full-blown lotuses, thou the destroyer of enemies, do thou become our help for bringing about the destruction of the demons –.

units.sanskrit: विष्णुर् उवाच भयं त्यजध्वम् अमरा अभयं वो ददाम्य् अहम् । तथैव त्रिदिवं देवाः प्रतिपद्यत माचिरम् ॥
units.english: Vishnu said:— ye immortals, do ye renounce your fear. promise you safety. gods, you will, in no time, acquire as before the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: अवध्यम् अमरेन्द्राणां दानवेन्द्रं निहन्मि तम् ॥
units.english: will slay this king of Dānavas, elated with pride, who is unslayable even by the immortals –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा स भगवान् विसृज्य त्रिदशेश्वरान् । हिरण्यकशिपो राजन्न् आजगाम हरिः सभाम् ॥ सभां हिरण्यकशिपोर् जगाम हरिर् ईश्वरः । जीमूतघनसंकाशो जीमूतघननिस्वनः । जीमूतघनदीप्तौजा जीमूत इव वेगवान् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this and left the company of the king of gods and others the Lord Hari assumed the form of a half-lion and a half-man. Having pressed his one palm against another Hari, in his man-lion form, repaired to the court of Hiranyakasipu –. His colour was like that of clouds and his voice was like the muttering thereof. He also became effulgent and fleet like a cloud.

units.sanskrit: दैत्यं सो ऽतिबलं दृप्तं दृप्तशार्दूलविक्रमम् । दृप्तैर् दैत्यगणैर् गुप्तं हतवान् एकपाणिना ॥
units.english: He, with his own hand, killed the highly powerful and proud Daitya, gifted with the prowess of a tiger and protected by the mighty Daityas.

units.sanskrit: नृसिंह एष कथितो भूयो ऽयं वामनो ऽपरः । बलेर् बलवतो यज्ञे बलिना विष्णुना पुरा । विक्रमैस् त्रिभिर् अक्षोभ्याः क्षोभितास् ते महासुराः ॥
units.english: This is the man-lion incarnation. Next is that of a dwarf. Assuming this form destructive of the Daityas in the days of yore the powerful Vishnu, with his three foot steps, assailed the Asuras in the sacrifice of Bali –.

units.sanskrit: प्रमथ्य सर्वान्दैतेयान् पादहस्ततलैस् ततः । रूपं कृत्वा महाभींअं जहाराशु स मेदिनीम् ॥
units.english: Assuming a highly dreadful form and grinding them all with his hands and feet the Lord immediately freed the earth of the demons.

units.sanskrit: तस्य विक्रमतो भूमिं चन्द्रादित्यौ स्तनान्तरे । नभः प्रक्रममाणस्य नाभ्यां किल समास्थितौ ॥
units.english: When he placed his foot-step on the earth, the sun, and the moon remained on his breast, and when he placed his foot-step in the sky they lay in his navel.

units.sanskrit: परमाक्रममाणस्य जानुभ्यां तौ व्यवस्थितौ । विष्णोर् अमितवीर्यस्य वदन्त्य् एवं द्विजातयः ॥ हृत्वा स मेदिनीं कृत्स्नां हत्वा चासुरपुंगवान् । ददौ शक्राय वसुधां विष्णुर् बलवतां वरः ॥ एष ते वामनो नाम प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः । वेदविद्भिर् द्विजैर् एतत् कथ्यते वैष्णवं यशः ॥ भूयो भूतात्मनो विष्णोः प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः । तेन नष्टेषु देवेषु प्रक्रियासु मखेषु च । चातुर्वर्ण्ये च संकीर्णे धर्मे शिथिलतां गते ॥ अभिवर्धति चाधर्मे सत्ये नष्टे ऽनृते स्थिते । प्रजासु शीर्यमाणासु धर्मे चाकुलतां गते ॥ तेन हेहयराजस्य कार्तवीर्यस्य धीमतः । वरदेन वरो दत्तो दत्तात्रेयेण धीमता ॥ एतद् बाहुद्वयं यत् ते तत् ते मम कृते नृप । पालयिष्यसि कृत्स्नां च वसुधां वसुधेश्वर । दुर्निरीक्ष्यो ऽरिवृन्दानां युद्धस्थश् च भविष्यसि ॥
units.english: And when he placed his foot-step on a better place than all these they lay on the knees of the highly powerful Vishnu. This has been related by the twice-born ones. Having thus slain all the leading Asuras the Lord Vishnu, the foremost of all the gods, saved the earth and conferred the celestial kingdom on the king of gods. Thus have described the dwarf incarnation of the Great Vishnu. The Brāhmanas, well-read in the Vedas, describe it as the glorious conduct of Vishnu. The Great Vishnu, the soul of all, next incarnated himself as the highly forgiving Dattātreya. When the gods disappeared, the religious works, sacrifices and the four castes suffered deterioration, when truth was lost and untruth flourished, when all the creatures were about to perish, when virtue was on the verge of extinction the Lord re-established the four Vedas with sacrifices as well as the four castes -. The boon-giving, intelligent Dattātreya conferred a boon on the Haihaya king Kārtavirya, saying:– king, these your two arms, by the power of my boon, shall be thousand-fold. lord of the earth, you will rule over the entire earth and be conversant with virtue. Your enemies shall not be able to look at you -.

units.sanskrit: एष ते वैष्णवः श्रीमान् प्रादुर्भावो ऽद्भुतः शुभः । कथितो वै महाराज यथाश्रुतम् अरिंदम । भूयश् च जामदग्न्यो ऽयं प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः ॥
units.english: slayer of enemies, emperor, as heard by me, have described to you the most wonderful and auspicious incarnation of Vishnu. The Great Lord next incarnated himself as Jāmadagni.

units.sanskrit: यत्र बाहुसहस्रेण विस्मितं दुर्जयं रणे । रामो ऽर्जुनम् अनीकस्थं जघान नृपतिं प्रभुः ॥
units.english: In this incarnation Rāma killed in battle Arjuna in the midst of his irrepressible army who were filled with wonder at his thousand arms.

units.sanskrit: रथस्थं पार्थिवं रामः पातयित्वार्जुनं भुवि । धर्षयित्वा यथाकामं क्रोशमानं च मेघवत् ॥ कृत्स्नं बाहुसहस्रं च चिच्छेद भृगुनन्दनः । कीर्णा क्षत्रियकोटीभिर् मेरुमन्दरभूषणा । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी तेन निःक्षत्रिया कृता ॥
units.english: Having brought the king Arjuna on earth from his car and assailed that king roaring like clouds with all his kinsmen, Bhrigu's son Rāma chopped off his thousand arms with his sword -. The earth, adorned with the mountains Meru and Mandara, contained Kotis of Kshatryas. He divested the earth of the Kshatryas for twenty one times.

units.sanskrit: कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां चैव भार्गवः सुमहातपाः । सर्वपापविनाशाय वाजिमेधेन चेष्टवान् ॥
units.english: Having divested the earth of the Kshatriyas the great ascetic son of Bhrigu undertook the celebration of a horse-sacrifice for the expiation of all his sins.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् यज्ञे महादाने दक्षिणां भृगुनन्दनः । मारीचाय ददौ प्रीतः कश्यपाय वसुंधराम् ॥
units.english: In that sacrifice consisting of profuse gifts Bhrigu's son, with great delight, made a gift of the earth to Marichi's son Kashyapa.

units.sanskrit: वारुणांस् तुरगाञ् शुभ्रान् रथं च रथिनां वरः । हिरण्यम् अक्षयं धेनूर् गजेन्द्रांश् च महामतिः । चरमाणस् तपो दीप्तं जामदग्न्यः पुनः पुनः । तिष्ठते देववच् छ्रीमान् महेन्द्रे पर्वतोत्तमे ॥
units.english: In that horse sacrifice the highly liberal and illustrious Rāma, the foremost of car-warriors, made presents of quick-coursing horses, cars, endless gold, kine and elephants. Even now practising hard austerities, Bhrigu's son, effulgent like a celestial, is living on the most excellent mountain Mahendra.

units.sanskrit: एष विष्णोः सुरेशस्य शाश्वतस्याव्ययस्य च । जामदग्न्य इति ख्यातः प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः ॥
units.english: This is the account of the Jāmadagni incarnation of the great and intelligent Vishnu, the foremost of gods, bearing the mystic mark of Srivatsa on his breast.

units.sanskrit: कृत्वात्मानं महाबाहुश् चतुर्धा प्रभुर् ईश्वरः । लोके राम इति ख्यातस् तेजसा भास्करोपमः ॥
units.english: In the twenty fourth Yuga, sending Viswāmitra before him and dividing himself into four parts the mighty-armed Lord Isvara became celebrated in the world as the king Dasaratha's son Rāma.

units.sanskrit: प्रसादनार्थं लोकस्य रक्षसां निग्रहाय च । धर्मस्य च विवृद्ध्यर्थं जज्ञे तत्र महायशाः । तम् अप्य् आहुर् मनुष्येन्द्रं सर्वभूतपतेस् तनुम् ॥
units.english: For extending his favour to the world, for destroying the Rākshasas and increasing virtue the highly illustrious Lord was thus born. The sages designate that king of men as the body of the masters of Bhutas.

units.sanskrit: तस्मै दत्तानि चास्त्राणि विश्वामित्रेण धीमता । वधार्थं देवशत्रूणां दुर्धराणि सुरैर् अपि ॥ यज्ञविघ्नकरौ येन मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । मारीचश् च सुबाहुश् च बलेन बलिनां वरौ । निहतौ च निराशौ च कृतौ तेन महात्मना ॥ वर्तमाने मखे येन जनकस्य महात्मनः । यः समाः सर्वधर्मज्ञश् चतुर्दश वने ऽवसत् । लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामः सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥
units.english: Viswamitra instructed that intelligent one in the use of various weapons for the destruction of the enemies of the gods who were irrepressible even unto them and who put obstacles in the sacrifices of the self-controlled ascetics. On their behalf that high-souled prince the foremost of the strong killed the two Rakshasas Mārichi and Suvāhu –. Formerly in the sacrifice of the high-souled Janaka, he, easily out of sport, snapped the bow of Hara. Living in the forest for fourteen years in the company of Lakshmana Rāghava, ever engaged in the well-being of all creatures and conversant with all the forms of religion, carried on austerities for fourteen years.

units.sanskrit: रूपिणी यस्य पार्श्वस्था सीतेति प्रथिता जनैः । पूर्वोचितत्वाद्या लक्ष्मीर् भर्तारम् अनुगच्छति ॥
units.english: The beautiful Sitā, well-known in the world used to remain by his side always. She was the Lakshmi known before and followed her husband.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्दश वने तप्त्वा तपो वर्षाणि राघवः । जनस्थाने वसन् कार्यं त्रिदशानां चकार सः ॥
units.english: Rāghava practised these hard penances for fourteen years. Lakshmana followed the foot-steps of Sita and remained there as his servant.

units.sanskrit: विराधं च कबन्धं च राक्षसौ भीमविक्रमौ । जघान पुरुषव्याघ्रौ गन्धर्वौ शापविक्षतौ ॥
units.english: There were two Rākshasas, Virādha and Kavandha of dreadful prowess. They became so by the imprecation of a Gandharva.

units.sanskrit: हुताशनार्कांशुतडित्प्रकाशैः प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः । सुरेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यसारैः शरैः शरीरेषु वियोजितौ बलात् ॥
units.english: Discharging at them burning arrows effulgent like the fire, the rays of the sun or lightning, strong as the thunder-bolt of Indra, and the feathers whereof were made of gold Rāma killed them both -.

units.sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्य कृते येन वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः । वाली विनिहतः संख्ये सुग्रीवश् चाभिषेचितः ॥
units.english: On behalf of Sugriva the highly-powerful Rāma killed Bali in battle and installed Sugriva on the throne.

units.sanskrit: देवासुरगणानां हि यक्षराक्षसपक्षिणाम् । यत्रावध्यं राक्षसेन्द्रं रावणं युधि दुर्जयम् ॥ गुप्तं राक्षसकोटीभिर् नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् । त्रैलोक्यरावणं क्रूरं राक्षसं राक्षसेश्वरम् ॥
units.english: The gods, the Asuras, the Rakshasas and the Pisacas were not capable of slaying Rāvana. He was difficult of being vanquished by any in the battle-field. Rāvana, having the hue of a collection of red collyrium, had millions of Rākshasas as his guards. The three worlds were terrorized by him.

units.sanskrit: दुर्जरं दुर्धरं दृप्तं शार्दूलसमविक्रमम् । दुर्निरीक्ष्यं सुरगणैर् वरदानेन दर्पितम् ॥
units.english: He was invincible, irrepressible, proud and powerful like a tiger. Even the celestials could not look at him and he was elated with pride on account of the boon.

units.sanskrit: जघान सचिवैः सार्धं ससैन्यं रावणं युधि । महाभ्रघनसंकाशं महाकायं महाबलम् ॥
units.english: He, assisted by his ministers, killed in battle this highly powerful and huge bodied Rāvana, the king of Rakshasas, resembling a massive cloud, along with his army -.

units.sanskrit: सभ्रातृपुत्रसचिवं ससैन्यं क्रूरनिश्चयम् । रावणं निजघानाशु रामो भूतपतिः पुरा ॥
units.english: In the days of yore, Rāma killed Rāvana the son of Pulastya, with his brothers, sons, ministers and army, who was a confirmed villain, committed a great iniquity and was invincible in battle.

units.sanskrit: मधोश् च तनयो दृप्तो लवणो नाम दानवः । हतो मधुवने भीमो वरदत्तो महासुरः । समरे युद्धशौण्डेन तथान्ये चापि राक्षसाः ॥
units.english: Madhu's son the great Asura Lavana, a heroic Dānava, who was elated with pride on account of the boon conferred on him, was killed in battle in the forest of Madhu, by Rāma, who was an expert in battle. Other Rākshasas were also slain by him -.

units.sanskrit: एतानि कृत्वा कर्माणि रामो धर्मभृतां वरः । दशाश्वमेधाञ् जारूथ्यान् आजहार निरर्गलान् ॥
units.english: Having performed these feats Rāma, the foremost of the pious, collected continually materials for the celebration of ten horse sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: नाश्रूयन्ताशुभा वाचो नाकुलं मारुतो ववौ । न वित्तहरणं चासीद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
units.english: During Rāma's regeme, not a single inauspicious sound was heard, hostile winds did not blow and no body lost his property.

units.sanskrit: सर्वम् आसीज् जगद्दान्तं रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
units.english: No widows bewailed, nobody met with misfortune and the whole world enjoyed peace during Rāma's rule.

units.sanskrit: न प्राणिनां भयं चासीज् जलानलविघातजम् । न च स्म वृद्धा बालानां प्रेतकार्याणि कुर्वते ॥
units.english: Creatures had no fear from the obstruction of water and air and the aged people had not to perform the obsequial rites of the boys.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्म पर्यच्चरत् क्षत्रं विशः क्षत्रम् अनुव्रताः । शूद्राश् चैव हि वर्णांस् त्रीञ् शुश्रूषन्त्य् अनहंकृताः ॥
units.english: The Kshatriyas used to serve the Brāhmanas, the Vaisyas used to follow the Kshatriyas, and the Sudras, divested of pride, used to serve the three superior castes.

units.sanskrit: नार्यो नात्यचरन् भर्तॄन् भार्यां नात्यचरत् पतिः । सर्वम् आसीज् जगद्दान्तं निर्दस्युर् अभवन् मही । राम एको ऽभवद् भर्ता रामः पालयिताभवत् ॥
units.english: The women never disregarded their husbands, and the husbands never ill-treated their wives. The whole world was in peace, and freed from robbers. Rāma alone was the lord and protector of all –.

units.sanskrit: आसन् वर्षसहस्राणि तथा पुत्रसहस्रिणः । अरोगाः प्राणिनश् चासन् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
units.english: During Rāma's rule people lived for a thousand years and had a thousand sons and no creature suffered from any disease.

units.sanskrit: देवतानाम् ऋषीणां च मनुष्याणां च सर्वशः । गाथा अप्य् अत्र गायन्ति ये पुराणविदो जनाः । रामे निबद्धास् तत्त्वार्था माहात्म्यं तस्य धीमतः ॥
units.english: During Rama's rule, the gods, the Rishis and men assembled together in the world. Persons, well-read in the Puranas who consider Rāma as the source of all truths, have sung this hymn in honor of that intelligent one.

units.sanskrit: श्यामो युवा लोहिताक्षो दीप्तास्यो मितभाषिता । आजानबाहुः सुमुखः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः ॥
units.english: Ratha, the king of Ayodhyā, had a green hue, black eyes, nectarine speech, a shining face, arms extending up to the knees, a beautiful countenance and leonine shoulders.

units.sanskrit: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च । ऋक्सामयजुषां घोषो ज्याघोषश् च महात्मनः । अव्युच्छिन्नो ऽभवद् राष्ट्रे दीयतां भुज्यताम् इति ॥
units.english: He ruled for eleven thousand years. In the kingdom of that high-souled king were continually heard the chanting of the Rig, Yajush and Sama Vedas, the twang of bows and the utterances make gifts and eat –.

units.sanskrit: सत्त्ववान् गुणसंपन्नो दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा । अति सूर्यं च चन्द्रं च रामो दाशरथिर् बभौ ॥
units.english: The energetic and accomplished son of Dasaratha, Rāma, shining in his own effulgence, surpassed even the sun in his lustre.

units.sanskrit: ईजे क्रतुशतैः पुण्यैः समाप्तवरदाक्षिणैः । हित्वायोध्यां दिवं यातो राघवो ऽसौमहाबलः ॥
units.english: Having celebrated hundreds of holy sacrifices with perfect and most excellent gifts the highly powerful Raghava left Ayodhya and repaired to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एष महाबाहूर् इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः । रावणं सगणं हत्वा दिवम् आचक्रमे प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Having thus brought about the destruction of Rāvana with all his kinsmen, the omniscient and mighty-armed Rāma, the descendant of Ikshāku, returned to the region of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: अपरः केशवस्यायं प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः । विख्यातो माथुरे कल्पे सर्वलोकहिताय वै ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said;—In the Māthura Kalpa the high-souled Keshava, for the behoof of mankind, went through this incarnation which have been, at present, describing.

units.sanskrit: यत्र साल्वं च कंसं च मैन्दं द्विविदम् एव च । अरिष्टं वृषभं केशिं पूतनां दैत्यदारिकाम् ॥
units.english: In this incarnation the powerful lord slew Salwa, Mainda, Dwivida, Kansa, Aristha, Vrishabha, Keshi, the demoness Putanā, the elephant Kuvalayapida, Chānura, Musthi and other demons in human forms -.

units.sanskrit: छिन्नं बाहुसहस्रं च बाणस्याद्भुतकर्मणः । नरकश् च हतः संख्ये यवनश् च महाबलः ॥
units.english: By Him of wonderful deeds the thousand arms of Vāna were chopped off. The Asura, Naraka and highly powerful Yavana were slain by him, in battle.

units.sanskrit: हृतानि च महीपानां सर्वरत्नानि तेजसा । दुराचाराश् च निहताः पार्थिवा ये महीतले ॥
units.english: He carried away by force all the jewels of the kings. And all the wicked kings of the earth were slain, by him.

units.sanskrit: नवमे द्वापरे विष्णुर् अष्टाविंशे पुराभवत् । वेदव्यासस् तदा जज्ञे जातूकर्ण्यपुरःसरः । एको वेदश् चतुर्धा तु कृतस् तेन महात्मना । जनितो भारतो वंशः सत्यवत्याः सुतेन च । एते लोकहितार्थाय प्रादुर्भावा महात्मनः । अतीताः कथिता राजन् कथ्यन्ते चाप्य् अनागताः । कल्की विष्णुयशा नाम भूयश् चोत्पत्स्यते प्रभुः ॥ ... संभलग्रामको द्विजः । दशमो भाव्यसंपन्नो याज्ञवल्क्यपुरःसरः । क्षपयित्वा च तान् सर्वान् भाविनार्थेन चोदितान् । गङ्गायमुनयोर् मध्ये निष्ठां प्राप्स्यति सानुगः । ततः काले व्यतीते तु सामात्ये सहसैनिके । नृपेष्व् अथ प्रनष्तेषु तदा त्व् अप्रग्रहाः प्रजाः ॥
units.english: After the expiration of the ninth incarnation of the Dwapara Yuga included within the eighteenth Mahāyuga, the lord Vishnu, having sent beforehand Jātukarna, took his birth as Veda-Vyasa. The one Veda was divided into four by that high-souled one. This Vyasa, the son of Satyavati, procreated the race of Bharatas. king these incarnations, of the Lord, undertaken for the behoof of mankind, have been described. shall now present an account of the future incarnations. The Lord again, for the well-being of mankind, will appear as Kalki in the house of a Brāhmana by name Vishnuyashas in the village of Sambhala. After the expiration of the tenth incarnation He will send Yajnavalka before Him and then engage in a discussion with the followers of Buddhism, who believe in the transcient science, who always praise the present and speak ill of the sacrifices. After defeating them he will disappear at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamuna with his followers. When all the families will be ruined, when all the kings, with their ministers and soldiers will be destroyed there will be none to look after the people.

units.sanskrit: क्षणेन निर्वृते चैव हत्वा चान्योन्यम् आहवे । परस्परहृतस्वाश् च निराक्रन्दाः सुदुःखिताः । अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानां पृथिवीं विचरिष्यति । मानुषः स तु संजज्ञे देवस्याग्रस्य धीमतः । गात्रेण वै चन्द्रमसः पूर्णे कलियुगे ऽभवत् । तं तं कालं च कार्यं च तं तथोद्देशकारिणम् । एते चान्ये च बहवो दिव्या देवगुणैर् युताः । प्रादुर्भावाः पुराणेषु गीयन्ते ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥
units.english: When they will all be killed by internal dessensions and when their riches will be pilfered by one another, they will begin to weep, being stricken with grief. Thus assailed by misfortune at the end of the Kaliyuga all the creatures will meet with destruction along with the Yuga itself –. After the termination of the Kali Yuga the Satya Yuga will again appear in due order. This is the outcome of the natural sequence and there can no perversion of it. These and various other celestial incarnations, consisting of gods, have been recorded in the Puranas by the Rishis conversant with the knowledge of Brahman.

units.sanskrit: एतदुद्देशमात्रेण प्रादुर्भावानुकीर्तनम् । कीर्तितं कीर्तनीयस्य सर्वलोकगुरोः प्रभोः ॥
units.english: have only given an outline of the incarnations of the Lord the preceptor of all the worlds, by the chanting of which even the gods are charmed and in which exist all the Srutis and Puranas -.

units.sanskrit: प्रीयन्ते पितरस् तस्य प्रादुर्भावानुकीर्तनात् । विष्णोर् अमितवीर्यस्य यः शृणोति कृताञ्जलिः ॥
units.english: The ancestral manes of the person are delighted who, with folded palms, listens to or recites the incarnations of Vishnu of unlimited power.

units.sanskrit: एतास् तु योगेश्वरयोगमायाः श्रुत्वा नरो मुच्यति सर्वपापैः । ऋद्धिं समृद्धिं विपुलांश् च भोगान् प्राप्नोति शीघ्रं भगवत्प्रसादात् ॥
units.english: If a man listens to the illusive sports of this Lord of Yoga he is freed from all his sins and acquires, by the favour of the Lord, virtue, prosperity, ascetic wealth and various objects of enjoyment -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच विश्वत्वं शृणु मे विष्णोर् हरित्वं च कृते युगे । वैकुण्ठत्वं च देवेषु कृष्णत्वं मानुषेषु च ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said;—Listen, king, duly to the dignity of Vishnu as Viswa the lord of protection to that of Hari in the Satya Yuga, to that of Vaikunta amongst the gods, to that of Krishna amongst men, to that of Iswara, and to the motive of his various actions past and future –.

units.sanskrit: अव्यक्तो व्यक्तलिङ्गस्थो य एष भगवान् प्रभुः । नारायणो ह्य् अनन्तात्मा प्रभवो ऽव्यय एव च ॥
units.english: Although invisible the lord assumed forms at various periods. Narāyana is the cause of all creations and is eternal.

units.sanskrit: एष नारायणो भूत्वा हरिर् आसीत् सनातनः । ब्रह्मा शक्रश् च सोमश् च धर्मः शुक्रो बृहस्पतिः ॥
units.english: This Nārāyana assumed the form of Hari in the Krita Yuga. Brahmā, Indra, the moon, Dharma, Sukra and Vrihaspati are all the forms of Nārāyana.

units.sanskrit: अदितेर् अपि पुत्रत्वम् एत्य यादवनन्दनः । एष विष्णुर् इति ख्यात इन्द्राद् अवरजो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Yadu's son Vishnu became the son of Aditi and passed by the name of king Indrāvaraja.

units.sanskrit: प्रसादजं ह्य् अस्य विभोर् अदित्यां पुत्रजन्म तत् । वधार्थं सुरशत्रूणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् ॥
units.english: For encompassing the destruction of the Daityas, Dānavas and Rākshasas, the enemies of the celestials, Nārāyana, out of favour, became the son of Aditi.

units.sanskrit: प्रधानात्मा पुरा ह्य् एष ब्रह्माणम् असृजत् प्रभुः । सो ऽसृजत् पूर्वपुरुषः पुराकल्पे प्रजापतीन् ॥
units.english: This Supreme Soul created Brahmā in the days of yore. And that Prime Purusha, in the first Kalpa, created all the Prajāpatis.

units.sanskrit: ते तन्वानास् तनूस् तत्र ब्रह्मवंशान् अनुत्तमान् । तेभ्यो ऽभवन् महात्मभ्यो बहुधा ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् ॥
units.english: They, assuming various forms, became the founders of many most excellent Brāhmana families. From these high-souled ones emanated, the eternal Veda consisting of various branches.

units.sanskrit: एतद् आश्चर्यभूतस्य विष्णोः कर्मानुकीर्तनम् । कीर्तितं कीर्तनीयस्य कीर्त्यमानं निबोध मे ॥
units.english: have thus recounted the names of the wonderful Vishnu. Now hear from me the subject that is worthy of being recounted.

units.sanskrit: वृत्ते वृत्रवधे तात वर्तमाने कृते युगे । आसीत् त्रैलोक्यविख्यातः संग्रामस् तारकामयः ॥
units.english: After the Asura Vitra had been slain and even when Satya Yuga was not over there took, place the world-renowned war with Tāraka.

units.sanskrit: तत्र स्म दानवा घोराः सर्वे संग्रामदर्पिताः । घ्नन्ति देवान् सगन्धर्वान् सयक्षोरगचारणान् ॥ ते वध्यमाना विमुखाः क्षीणप्रहरणा रणे । त्रातारं मनसा जग्मुर् देवं नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥
units.english: Being elated with success in war and assisted by the Gandharvas, Yakshas, Uragas, and Rākshasas the dreadful Dānavas engaged in an onslaught of the gods,. When all the weapons were destroyed in battle, they were about to be killed by the Dānavas. Accordingly being baffled they sought refuge with the omniscient, Lord Nārāyana, the God of protection.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे मेघा निर्वाणाङ्गारवर्चसः । सार्कचन्द्रग्रहगणं छादयन्तो नभस्तलम् ॥
units.english: In the meantime were heard the dreadful mutterings of clouds pouring, showers of embers that covered the sky with, the-sun, moon and planets and that were accompanied by lightnings.

units.sanskrit: अन्योन्यवेगाभिहताः प्रववुः सप्त मारुताः ॥
units.english: And seven kinds of wind were driven against one another –.

units.sanskrit: दीप्ततोयाशनीपातैर् वज्रवेगानलानिलैः । ररास घोरैर् उत्पातैर् दह्यमानम् इवाम्बरम् ॥
units.english: Assailed by boiling water currents, the fall of lightnings and the winds, endued with the velocity of lightnings, and as if being consumed by them the earth began to emit terrible sounds.

units.sanskrit: पेतुर् उल्कासहस्राणि पेतुर् आकाशगान्य् अपि । न्युब्जानि च विमानानि प्रपतन्त्य् उत्पतन्ति च ॥ चतुर्युगान्तपर्याये लोकानां यद्भयं भवेत् । तमसा निष्प्रभं सर्वं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन । तिमिरौघपरिक्षिप्ता न रेजुश् च दिषो दश ॥ विवेश रूपिणी काली कालमेघावगुण्ठिता । द्यौर् न भात्य् अभिभूतार्का घोरेण तमसा वृता ॥
units.english: Thousands of fire-brands fell down from the sky. Cars began to fall down and go up. Beholding those portends the people were stricken with fear as they become at the termination of the four Yugas –. The whole world was enveloped with darkness and nothing was visible. The ten cardinal points, being covered with darkness, did not became visible. It appeared as if the incarnate form of the night of the dark half of the month was veiled by the cloud of dissolution. The sun being overclouded the whole sky was enveloped with darkness.

units.sanskrit: वपुः संदर्शयाम् आस दिव्यं कृष्णवपुर् हरिः ॥
units.english: Dispersing these clouds together with darkness the Divine black-hued Hari displayed his celestial form.

units.sanskrit: तेजसा वपुषा चैव कृष्णं कृष्णम् इवाचलम् ॥ दीप्तपीताम्बरधरं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् । धूमान्धकारवपुषं युगान्ताग्निम् इवोत्थितम् ॥
units.english: His body was dark-hued like a cloud and his hairs were black like collyrium. In his dark form Krishna appeared like a dark mountain. He put on a burning yellow raiment and was bedecked with gold. It appeared as if a body, enveloped with the darkness of smoke, arose like the fire of dissolution.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्द्विगुणपीनांसां किरीटच्छन्नमूर्धजम् । चामीकरकरासक्तम् आयुधैर् उपशोभितम् ॥
units.english: His shoulders had grown eightfold, his heads were covered with head-gears and his fists were adorned with golden weapons.

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रार्ककिरणोपेतं गिरिकूटम् इवोच्छ्रितम् । नन्दकानन्दितकरं शराशीविषधारिणम् ॥
units.english: His hand was delighted with a sword by name Nandaka which was immoveable like a mountain stricken with the rays of the sun and the moon and which was tied to a waist-cloth of the hue of Menas stone.

units.sanskrit: शक्तिचित्रं हलोदग्रं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । विष्णुशैलं क्षमामूलं श्रीवृक्षं शार्ङ्गशृङ्गिणम् ॥
units.english: He held mace, thunderbolt, a ploughshare, a conch, a discus and a club in his hands. Vishnu was like a mountain of which the base was forgiveness and the tree was Sree. He held the Sranga bow in his hand.

units.sanskrit: हर्यश्वरथसंयुक्ते सुपर्णध्वजशोभिते । चन्द्रार्कचक्ररचिते मन्दराक्षधृतान्तरे ॥ अनन्तरश्मिसंयुक्ते दुर्दर्शे मेरुकूबरे । तारकाचित्रकुसुमे ग्रहनक्षत्रवन्धुरे ॥
units.english: He was seated on a car to which were yoked yellow-hued horses, on which were hoisted flags having the emblem of Garuda painted on them, which had the effulgence of the moon, had beautiful wheels, of which Mandara mountain was the axle, and the serpent Ananta was the rein. It had Meru and Kuvera on it, was filled with stars and planets and adorned with variegated flowers.

units.sanskrit: भयेष्व् अभयदं व्योम्नि देवा दैत्यपराजिताः । ददृशुस् ते स्थितं देवं दिव्यलोकमये रथे ॥
units.english: That lord of gods, who always gives protection, was seen seated in the sky on an effulgent celestial car by the gods defeated by the Daityas at a time when they were stricken with fear –.

units.sanskrit: ते कृताञ्जलयः सर्वे देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः । जयशब्दं पुरस्कृत्य शरण्यं शरणं गताः ॥
units.english: All the gods, headed by Indra, at first sent up a shout of exclamation and then sought refuge with the lord to whom all resort for shelter.

units.sanskrit: स तेषां तां गिरं श्रुत्वा विष्णुर् दयितदैवतः । मनश् चक्रे विनाशाय दानवानां महामृधे ॥
units.english: Hearing this loud exclamation the kind Deity Vishnu made up his mind for destroying the gods in that great encounter.

units.sanskrit: उवाच देवताः सर्वाः सप्रतिज्ञम् इदं वचः ॥ शान्तिं व्रजत भद्रं वो मा भैष्ट मरुतां गणाः । जिता मे दानवाः सर्वे त्रैलोक्यं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥
units.english: Stationed in the pure sky, Vishnu, that foremost of gods, promised to the celestials, saying, ye Maruts, may you fare well, do not fear. Be at ease. have defeated the Dānavas. Do ye take back the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: ते तस्य सत्यसंधस्य विष्णोर् वाक्येन तोषिताः । देवाः प्रीतिं परां जग्मुः प्राप्येवामृतम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Thus welcomed by the words of the truthful Hari the gods attained to that supreme delight which they enjoyed when they obtained ambrosia out of the ocean –.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तमः संह्रियते विनेशुश् च बलाहकाः । प्रववुश् च शिवा वाताः प्रसन्नाश् च दिशो दश ॥
units.english: Thereupon the darkness was removed and the cranes emitted cries. Auspicious winds blew and the ten directions were cleared up.

units.sanskrit: सुप्रभाणि च ज्योतिंषि चन्द्रं चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणम् । दीप्तिमन्ति च तेजांसि चक्रुर् अर्कं प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
units.english: Shinning stars began to circumambulate the moon, and other luminous bodies began to move round the sun.

units.sanskrit: न विग्रहं ग्रहाश् चक्रुः प्रसेदुश् चापि सिन्धवः । विरजस्का बभुर् मार्गा नाकमार्गादयस् त्रयः ॥
units.english: The planets did not oppose one another and all the rivers grew delightful. Etherial and celestial roads appeared beautiful –.

units.sanskrit: यथार्थम् ऊहुः सरितो नापि चुक्षुभिरे ऽर्णवाः । आसञ् शुभानीन्द्रियाणि नराणाम् अन्तरात्मसु ॥
units.english: The rivers began to flow quietly and the oceans did not suffer any agitation. The internal organs of men worked well.

units.sanskrit: महर्षयो वीतशोका वेदानुच्चैर् अधीयिरे । प्रीत्या परमया युक्ता देवदेवस्य भूपतेः । विष्णोर् दत्तप्रतिज्ञस्य श्रुत्वारिनिधने गिरम् ॥
units.english: The great saints were shorn of grief and began to chant the Vedic hymns. Hearing the promise of the Lord that he would slay all the enemies in battle the fire began to eat sweet and nourishing oblations.

units.sanskrit: गिरं ते दानवान् उग्रान् मेनिरे निहतान् युधि । वैशंपायन उवाच ततो भयं विष्णुमयं श्रुत्वा दैतेयदानवाः । उद्योगं विपुलं चक्रुर् युद्धाय युधि दुर्जयाः ॥ चतुश्चक्रं सुवपुषं सुकल्पितमहायुधम् ॥ किंकिणीजालनिर्घोषं द्वीपिचर्मपरिष्कृतम् । रचितं रत्नजालैश् च हेमजालैश् च शोभितम् ॥ ईहामृगगणाकीर्णं पक्षिभिश् च विराजितम् । दिव्यास्त्रतूणीरधरं पयोधरनिनादितम् ॥ स्वक्षं रथवरोदारं सूपस्थम् अगमोपमम् । गदापरिघसंपूर्णं मूर्तिमन्तम् इवार्णवम् ॥ हेमकेयूरवलयं स्वर्णकुण्डलकूबरम् । सपताकध्वजोदग्रं सादित्यम् इव मन्दरम् ॥ गजेन्द्राम्भोदवपुषं क्वचित् केसरवर्चसम् । युक्तम् ऋक्षसहस्रेण सहस्राम्बुदनादितम् ॥
units.english: Sacrifices were duly undertaken and the minds of men were delighted –. Vaishampayana said:— sinless one, thereupon, hearing of the fear from Vishnu, the Daityas and Dānavas, irrepressible in battle, began to make preparations for war on a great scale. Being desirous of a battle the Dānava Maya ascended a golden car as the sun rises over the mount Meru. It had four strong wheels twelve hundred cubits in circumference, could go anywhere, contained many huge weapons, was filled with the tinkling of small bells, was matted with leopard skins, adorned with jewels and gold, artificial figures of animals and various collections of birds, contained many celestial weapons and quivers, had the sound like the muttering of clouds, had beautiful axles, was the best of the most excellent cars, was filled with beautiful nests, and mountain-like clubs. It was huge like the very ocean itself, and its joints were adorned with golden Keyuras and bracelets. Its poles were made of gold and it was adorned with huge pennons and flags. It looked like the mount Mandāra when the sun rises over it, like the prince of elephants and the ocean. It contained thousands of bears and the sound of its wheels was like the roaring of the ocean.

units.sanskrit: दीप्तम् आकाशगं दिव्यं रथं पररथारुजम् । तारस् तु क्रोषविस्तारम् आयसं वाहयन् रथम् । शैलोत्करिमसंकाशं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् ॥ काललोहाष्टचरणं लोहेषायुगकूबरम् । तिमिरोद्गारिकिरणं गर्जन्तम् इव तोयदम् ॥
units.english: It was effulgent, could course in the sky and strike the cars of the enemies. The Dānava Tāra got upon a most excellent iron car. It was two miles in dimension, was huge like a collection of mountains, was black like red collyrium and was made of strong and well seasoned iron. It had eight wheels, axles and poles and was dark like an ember. Its sound was like the roaring of an ocean and its windows were covered with iron nets.

units.sanskrit: प्रासैः पाशैश् च विततैर् अवसक्तैश् च मुद्गरैः । शोभितं त्रासनीयैश् च तोमरैः सपरश्वधैः ॥
units.english: It contained iron Parighas, Kshepanyas, clubs, Prāsas, maces, various other wooden weapons, Tomaras and Parashwadas.

units.sanskrit: उद्यतं द्विषतां हेतोर् द्वितीयम् इव मन्दरम् । युक्तं खरसहस्रेण सो ऽध्यारोहद् रथोत्तमम् ॥
units.english: It was a dread to the enemies and was drawn by a thousand of mules huge like the mount Mandara.

units.sanskrit: विरोचनस् तु संक्रुद्धो गदापाणिर् अवस्थितः । प्रमुखे तस्य सैन्यस्य दीप्तशृङ्ग इवाचलः ॥
units.english: On its flag there was an emblem of a crow -. Being highly enraged and taking up a club Virochana stood before the army like a mountain with shining summits.

units.sanskrit: युक्तं हयसहस्रेण हयग्रीवस् तु दानवः । व्यायतं बहुसहस्रं धनुर् विस्फारयन् महत् । वराहः प्रमुखे तस्थौ सावरोह इवाचलः ॥ क्षरस् तु विक्षरन् दर्पान् नेत्राभ्यां रोषजं जलम् । त्वष्टा त्व् अष्टादशहयं यानम् आस्थाय दानवः । व्यूहितो दानवैर् व्यूहैः परिचक्राम वीर्यवान् ॥
units.english: The Dānava Hayagriva, the repressor of the hostile armies, began to drive a car drawn by a thousand steeds. Stretching his huge bow, many thousand cubits in dimension, the Dānava Vāraha stood before the army like a fig tree covered with its branches, Shedding tears of anger out of haughtiness and with his lips and teeth trembling the Dānava Khara stood for the battle. Ascending a car drawn by twelve horses and surrounded by Dānava Vyuhas the energetic Aristha began to move about in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: श्वेतशैलप्रतीकाशो युद्धायाभिमुखः स्थितः ॥
units.english: Adorned with golden ear-rings, Viprachitti's son Swetā stood before the battle-field like a white mountain.

units.sanskrit: अरिष्टो बलिपुत्रस् तु वरिष्ठो ऽद्रिशिलायुधः । युद्धायातिष्ठद् आयस्तो धराधर इवापरः ॥
units.english: Armed with most excellent weapons made of stone and being tired thereby Bati's son Aristha stood there for battle like a mountain.

units.sanskrit: किशोरस् त्व् अतिसंहर्षात् किशोर इव चोदितः । अभवद् दैत्यसैन्यस्य मध्ये रविर् इवोदितः ॥
units.english: Dānava, by name Kishora, resembling a young charger in pride, appeared like the sun in the midst of the Daitya army.

units.sanskrit: स्वर्भानुरास्ययोधी तु दशनौष्ठेक्षणायुधः । प्रमुखे देवसेनाय रराज गिरिसंनिभः । हसंस् तिष्ठति दैत्यानां प्रमुखे सुमुखो ग्रहः ॥
units.english: Being dressed with a long raiment resembling a cloud the Dānava Lamva appeared in the midst of the Daitya Vyuhas like the sun possessed by Rāhu. Taking up weapons in the shape of teeth, lips and eyes the huge-bodied and terrible warrior Sharbhānu smilingly stood before the Daityas.

units.sanskrit: अन्ये हयगता भान्ति नागस्कन्धगताः परे । केचित् खरोष्ट्रयातारः केचित् तोयदवाहनाः । नानापक्षिगताः केचित् केचित् पवनवाहनाः ॥
units.english: Some shone on the horses and others on the elephants. Some sat on the lions and tigers and others on boars and bears. Some rode the asses and camels and others rode the clouds. And others rode on various birds and some the winds.

units.sanskrit: पत्तिनस् त्व् अपरे दैत्या भीषणा विकृताननाः । एकपादा द्विपादाश् च ननृतुर् युद्धकङ्क्षिणः ॥ प्रक्ष्वेडमाना बहवः स्फोटयन्तश् च दानवाः । दृप्तशार्दूलनिर्घोषा नेदुर् दानवपुंगवाः ॥
units.english: Other Daitya proceeded on foot. Some Daityas, with dreadful faces, some with one foot and some with two feet began to dance for battle. Some began to strike their arms. Thus the leading Dānavas began to roar there like proud tigers. The Daityas, expert in the use of bows, began to assail the gods with fierce clubs, Parighas and their Parigha-like arms.

units.sanskrit: प्रासैः पाशैश् च खड्गैश् च तोमराङ्कुशपट्टिसैः । चिक्रीडुस् ते शतघ्नीभिः शितधारैश् च मुद्गरैः ॥
units.english: And sporting with maces, Prāshas, clubs hooks, swords, Sataghnies, sharpened daggers, excellent iron Parighas and discuses they delighted the soldiers –.

units.sanskrit: काङ्क्षन्तो विजयं युद्धे दानवा युद्धदुर्मदाः । एवं तद् दानवं सैन्यं सर्वं युद्धमदोत्कटम् । देवान् अभिमुखं तस्थौ मेघानीकम् इवोद्धतम् ॥ तदद्भुतं दैत्यसहस्रगाढं वाय्वग्नितोयाम्बुदशैलकल्पम् । बलं रणौघाभ्युदयाभ्युदीर्णं युयुत्सयोन्मत्तम् इवाबभासे ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच श्रुतस् ते दैत्यसैन्यस्य विस्तरस् तात विग्रहे । सुराणां सर्वसैन्यस्य विस्तरं वैष्णवं शृणु ॥
units.english: The Dānavas, irrepressible in battle, desired for victory. Thus the Dānavas, proud of their various weapons, confronted the gods like rising clouds. That Daitya army, consisting of thousands of Dānavas, resembling the air, the fire, the cloud and the mountain and filled with war-like speed and advancement, was maddened with desire for battle. Vaishampayana said:— my child, you have thus heard of the arrangement of the Daitya army in the war between the gods and demons. Hear, now of an account of the arrangement of the army of the gods as well as that of Vishnu's army.

units.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च महाबलौ । सबलाः सानुगाश् चैव संनह्यन्त यथाक्रमम् ॥ पुरुहूतस् तु पुरतो लोकपालः सहस्रदृक् । सव्ये चास्य रथः पार्श्वे पक्षिप्रवरवेगवान् । सुचारुचक्रचरणो हेमवज्रपरिष्कृतः ॥
units.english: The Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras and the two highly powerful Aswinis took charge of their respective soldiers and attendants. The commander of the whole celestial army, the thousand-eyed Patriarch Pākashāna sat on his elephant Airavata in front of the army. On his left was kept in readiness a car, quick coursing like Garuda, with beautiful wheels and adorned with gold and diamonds -.

units.sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वयक्षौघैर् अनुयातः सहस्रशः । दीप्तिमद्भिः सदस्यैश् च ब्रह्मर्षिभिर् अभिष्टुतः ॥
units.english: Thousands of gods and Gandharvas and Yakshas followed him. And the effulgent Brāhmana saints, members of his court, began to chant his glories.

units.sanskrit: वज्रविस्फूर्जितोद्धूतैर् विद्युदिन्द्रायुधार्पितैः । गुप्तो बलाहकगणैः पर्वतैर् इव कामगैः ॥ यम् आरूढः स भगवान् पर्येति मघवान् गजम् । हविर् धानेषु गायन्ति विप्रा मखमुखे स्थिताः ॥
units.english: Protected by Valāhakas, carrying weapons, accompanied by lightnings produced by the hurling of Indra's thunder-bolt and resembling mountains moving about at will, the Divine Maghavān began to proceed on his elephant. The Vipras, who live at a place where Havi is kept in Soma's sacrifice, sing his glories -.

units.sanskrit: स्वर्गे शक्रानुयातेषु देवतूर्यानुनादिषु । इन्द्रं समुपनृत्यन्ति शतशो ह्य् अप्सरोगणाः ॥
units.english: When the king of gods repaired to the celestial region bugles were sounded. Thousands of Apsaras began to dance before him.

units.sanskrit: केतुना वंशराजेन भ्राजमानो यथा रविः । युक्तो हयसहस्रेण मनोमारुतरंहसा ॥
units.english: As the sun shines, protected by Ketu, born in his own family so that chariot, protected by Mātali, appeared beautiful. That car, drawn by a thousand horses, was fleet like the mind or the air.

units.sanskrit: कृत्स्नः परिवृतो मेरुर् भास्करस्येव तेजसा ॥ यमस् तु दण्डम् उद्यम्य कालयुक्तं च मुद्गरम् । तस्थौ सुरगणानीके दैत्यान् नादेन भीषयन् ॥
units.english: It appeared as if the mount Meru was enveloped with the rays of the sun -. Raising up his rod and mace and terrifying the Daityas Yama stood in the midst of the celestial army. Varuna, with the mace in his hand, also stood there in the midst of the army of gods.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्भिः सागरैर् गुप्तो लेलिहद्भिश् च पन्नगैः । शङ्खमुक्ताङ्गदधरो बिभ्रत् तोयमयं वपुः ॥
units.english: He was surrounded by four oceans and Pannagas. His person was full of water and he was adorned with conch, jems and Angadas.

units.sanskrit: कालपाशान् समाविध्य हयैः शशिकरोपमैः । वाय्वीरितजलोद्गारैः कुर्वंल् लीलाः सहस्रशः ॥
units.english: He always used to roam with the noose of Kāla in his hand. He made thousands of sports with the horses resembling the rays of the moon and waves agitated by the wind.

units.sanskrit: पाण्डुरोद्धूतवसनः प्रवालरुचिराङ्गदः । मणिश्यामोत्तमवपुर् हारभारार्पितोदरः ॥
units.english: His raiment was black and he put on beautiful Angadas made of corals. His person had the hue of sapphire and a necklace hung round his neck.

units.sanskrit: युद्धवेलाम् अभिलषन् भिन्नवेल इवार्णवः ॥
units.english: He stood there in expectation of the battle as the ocean becomes agitated when it is separated from its bank –.

units.sanskrit: यक्षराक्षससैन्येन गुह्यकानां गणैर् अपि । मणिश्यामोत्तमवपुः कुबेरो नरवाहनः । राजराजेश्वरः श्रीमान् गदापाणिर् अदृश्यत ॥ विमानयोधी धनदो विमाने पुष्पके स्थितः । स राजराजः शुशुभे युद्धार्थी नरवाहनः । प्रेक्षमाणः शिवसखः साक्षाद् इव शिवः स्वयम् ॥
units.english: Kuvera, having a body dark-blue like sapphire, and men to carry him, was seen there along with the Yakshas, Rākshasas and Guhyakas. That lord of riches, that king of kings, was armed with conch, Padma and a club. That graceful king of riches was stationed in his car Pushpaka. That king of kings, that friend of Siva, that lord having men to carry him, appeared there for battle like the very Siva himself.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वं पक्षं सहस्राक्षः पितृराजस् तु दक्षिणम् । वरुणः पश्चिमं पक्षम् उत्तरं नरवाहनः ॥
units.english: The thousand-eyed Indra protected the eastern wing of the celestial army, Yama, the king of the ancestral manes, protected the southern wing, Varuna, the western wing and Kuvera, the northern wing.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्षु युक्ताश् चत्वारो लोकपाला बलोत्कटाः । स्वां स्वां दिशं ररक्षुस् ते तस्य देवबलस्य ह ॥
units.english: The four Regents of the quarters, dreadful in battle, protected the four sides of the celestial army and kept a vigilant watch over their respective quarters.

units.sanskrit: सूर्यः सप्ताश्वयुक्तेन रथेनाम्बरगामिना । श्रिया जाज्वल्यमानेन दीप्यमानैश् च रश्मिभिः ॥ उदयास्तगचक्रेण मेरुपर्यन्तगामिना । त्रिदिवद्वारचित्रेण तपता लोकम् अव्ययम् ॥ सहस्ररश्मियुक्तेन भ्राजमानेन तेजसा । सोमः श्वेतहयो भाति स्यन्दने शीतरश्मिवान् । हिमतोयप्रपूर्णाभिर् भाभिर् आप्लावयञ् जगत् ॥ शशच्छायाङ्किततनुं नैशस्य तमसः क्षयम् ॥ ज्योतिषाम् ईरणं व्योम्नि रसानां रसनं प्रभुम् । ओषधीनां परित्राणं निधानम् अमृतस्य च ॥ जगतः प्रथमं भागं सौम्यं शैत्यमयं रसम् । ददृशुर् दानवाः सोमं हिमप्रहरणं स्थितम् ॥
units.english: The sun shone there burning in his own effulgent rays, on his car, drawn by seven horses that course in the welkin, Shining in his own effulgence of thousand rays, and ascending the car in which he, conferring heat on all the eternal regions, goes to the rising and setting mountains, the Dwādashātma lord of rays began to move about in the midst of the celestials –. Delighting the universe with his cool and watery rays the moon, of cool rays, shone on his car drawn by white horses. The Danavas saw, in the battle-field, Soma, of cool rays who is the presiding deity of the Brāhmanas, is encircled by the stars, whose body is marked by the shadow of the earth, who dispells the nocturnal darkness, who is the lord of all luminous bodies in the sky, who is the source of all the juices, who is the lord and protector of all the plants, who is the source of nectar, who is the first source of food to the world, who is identical with gentle and cool juice and who distributes dews –.

units.sanskrit: यः प्राणः सर्वभूतानां पञ्चधा भिद्यते नृषु । सप्तस्कन्धगतो लोकांस् त्रीन् दधार चचार च ॥
units.english: He is the life of all creatures and lives in man as five vital airs; and being divided into seven it is sustaining the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile creations.

units.sanskrit: यम् आहुर् अग्नेर् यन्तारं सर्वप्रभवम् ईश्वरम् । सप्तस्वरगता यस्य योनिर् गीभिर् उदीर्यते ॥
units.english: People call him the charioteer of fire and he is the cause and, lord of all. The source of his origin is the seven musical notes which are used in singing.

units.sanskrit: यं वदन्त्य् उत्तमं भूतं यं वदन्त्य् अशरीरिणम् । यम् आहुर् आकाशगमं शीघ्रगं शब्दयोनिनम् ॥
units.english: He is called the most excellent element and is bodiless. He courses in the sky, goes very quickly and has sound for his origin –.

units.sanskrit: मरुतो देवगन्धर्वा विद्याधरगणैः सह । चिक्रीडुर् असिभिः शुभ्रैर् निर्मुक्तैर् इव पन्नगैः ॥ यक्षैश् च सुमहाभोगैः पन्नगैर् गरुडैर् अपि । पर्वतास् तु शिलाशृङ्गैः शतशाखैश् च पादपैः । उपतस्थुः सुरगणान् प्रहर्तुं दानवं बलम् ॥ विचित्रपत्रवसनं धातुमन्तम् इवाचलम् ॥ तीक्ष्णतुण्डोग्रनखरं चलत्पक्षसमाकुलम् । स्फीतक्रोडावलम्बेन शीतांशुसमतेजसा । तम् अन्वयुर् देवगणा मुनयश् च समाहिताः । गीर्भिः परममन्त्राभिस् तुष्टुवुश् च गदाधरम् ॥
units.english: The Maruts, accompanied by the Devas, Gandharvas and Vidyadharas, began to sport there with unsheathed swords white as the serpents. Pouring, in anger, deadly venom the leading serpents became as it were the arrows of the gods, and began, with their mouths open, to range in the sky. All the mountains appeared before the gods to grind the Dānavas with their rocky summits and with trees consisting of hundreds of branches. He remained easily in the sky with his two beautifully painted wings like two clouds with rain-bow at the time of the universal dissolution. He was dreadful in the enemy's camp adorned with red, dark and yellow flags. The gods followed him in battle. The great ascetics sang the glories of Gadādhara with excellent hymns –.

units.sanskrit: तद् वैश्रवणसुश्लिष्टं वैवस्वतपुरःसरम् । वारिराजपरिक्षिप्तं देवराजविराजितम् ॥ चन्द्रप्रभाभिर् विमलं युद्धाय समवस्थितम् । ययौ हितं देवपथं दीप्तभास्करतेजसम् । स्वस्त्य् अस्तु देवेभ्य इति स्तुवंस् तत्राङ्गिराब्रवीत् । स्वस्त्य् अस्त्व् इति स्तुवंस् तत्र देवान् आङ्गिरसो ऽब्रवीत् । ताभ्यां बलाभ्यां संजज्ञे तुमुलो विग्रहस् तदा । सुराणाम् असुराणां च परस्परजयैषिणाम् ॥
units.english: Assisted by Kuvera, headed by Vivaswan's son Yama, encircled by Varuna the king of water, presided over by the king of gods, beautified by the rays of the moon, strengthened by the war-like gods, accompanied by the sounds of the wind, rendered brilliant by fire, and enveloped with Jishnu, Prahishnu, Bhrājishnu, and Vishnu energies the celestial army stood wonderfully for the battle. Angiras prayed for the well-being of the gods and Sukra, the preceptor of the Daityas, prayed for their well-being –. Thereupon there took place a terrible encounter between the armies of the gods and demons desirous of vanquishing each other.

units.sanskrit: दानवा दैवतैः सार्धं नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः । समीयुर् युध्यमाना वै पर्वता इव पर्वतैः ॥ तत्सुरासुरसंयुक्तं युद्धम् अत्यद्भुतं बभौ । धर्माधर्मसमायुक्तं दर्पेण विनयेन च ॥ ततो रथैः प्रज्वलितैर् वाहनैश् च प्रचोदितैः । उत्पतद्भिश् च गगनं सासिहस्तैः समन्ततः ॥
units.english: Armed with various weapons the Dānavas fought with the gods as if the mountains were fighting with the mountains. Thus there took place a wonderful encounter between the gods and demons, with fairness and unfairness, humility and pride. Then there fell on all sides from the sky cars drawn by quick-coursing horses, and soldiers with swords in their hands. Maces were scattered all over.

units.sanskrit: चापैर् विस्फार्यमाणैश् च पात्यमानैश् च मुद्गरैः ॥ तद् युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं देवदानवसंकुलम् । जगतस् त्रासजननं युगसंवर्तकोपमम् ॥
