units.english: With these and arrows, full drawn bows and clubs that war, of the gods and demons, grew exceedingly terrible. It created terror all over the world and assumed a dreadful form like the whirling clouds at the hour of the universal dissolution –.

units.sanskrit: दानवाः समरे जघ्नुर् देवान् इन्द्रपुरोगमान् ॥ ते वध्यमाना बलिभिर् दानवैर् जितकाशिभिः । विषण्णमनसो देवा जग्मुर् आर्तिं महामृधे ॥
units.english: Throwing with their hands Parighas and stones the Dānavas began to assail Indra and the other gods in battle. In that great encounter the gods were greatly assailed by the highly powerful Dānavas with whom appeared all the signs of success and their faces grew pale.

units.sanskrit: ते ऽस्त्रजालैः प्रमथिताः परिघैर् भिन्नमस्तकाः । भिन्नोरस्का दितिसुतैर् वेमू रक्तं व्रणैर् बहु ॥
units.english: They were grinded by the network of weapons of Diti's sons; their heads were cut off by their Parighas, their bodies were mutilated and the wounds made copious discharges of blood.

units.sanskrit: संदिताः पाशजालैश् च निर्यत्नाश् च शरैः कृताः । प्रविष्टा दानवीं मायां न शेकुस् ते विचेष्टितुम् ॥
units.english: Being fettered by the nooses of the Danavas, wounded by their arrows and possessed by the illusions of their women the gods stood motionless.

units.sanskrit: तत्स्तम्भितम् इवाभाति निष्प्राणसदृशाकृति । बलं सुराणाम् असुरैर् निष्प्रयत्नायुधं कृतम् ॥
units.english: They were stupified and showed no signs of life. The Asuras made the celestial army inert so that they could not use their weapons.

units.sanskrit: मायापाशान्विकर्षंश् च छिन्दन् वज्रेण ताञ् शरान् । शक्रो दैत्यबलं घोरं विवेश बहुलोचनः ॥ स दैत्यान् प्रमुखे हत्वा तद्दानवबलं महत् । तामसेनास्त्रजालेन तमोभूतम् अथाकरोत् ॥
units.english: Throwing away the nooses of illusion of the Dānavas, withstanding and cutting off their arrows with his thunder-bolt the thousand-eyed king of gods entered into the dreadful army of the Dānavas. Having slain all the Daityas who were stationed in front with his dark weapons he covered the entire demon-army with darkness.

units.sanskrit: ते ऽन्योन्यं नावबुध्यन्त देवान् वा वाहनानि वा । घोरेण तमसाविष्टाः पुरुहूतस्य तेजसा ॥
units.english: Being thus enshrouded with darkness through the energy of the king of gods they could not make any distinction between the gods and demons.

units.sanskrit: मायापाशैर् विमुक्तास् तु यत्नवन्तः सुरोत्तमाः । वपूंषि दैत्यसंघानां तमोभूतान्य् अपातयन् ॥
units.english: Thereupon being freed from the nooses of illusion and being very careful the gods began to slay the Dānavas who were overpowered with darkness.

units.sanskrit: अपध्वस्ता विसंज्ञाश् च तमसा नीलवर्चसः । पेतुस् ते दानवगणाश् छिन्नपक्षा इवाचलाः ॥
units.english: Thereat being assailed, bereft of consciousness and dark-hued on account of the darkness, the Dānavas began to fall down like mountains having their wings cut off –.

units.sanskrit: तद्घनीभूतदैत्येन्द्रम् अन्धकारम् इवार्णवम् । दानवं देवसदनं तमोभूतम् इवाबभौ ॥
units.english: Then the palace, of the king of Dānavas, consisting of cloud-like demons and resembling an ocean stricken with darkness, appeared as the very form of darkness itself.

units.sanskrit: तदासृजन्महामायां मयस् तां तामसीं दहन् । युगान्तोद्द्योतजननीं सृष्टाम् और्वेण वह्निना ॥
units.english: Thereupon consuming that illusion of darkness the Dānava Maya created a highly dreadful illusion of forest-fire resembling the fire of dissolution.

units.sanskrit: सा ददाह तमः सर्वं माया मयविकल्पिता । दैत्याश् चादित्यवपुषः सद्य उत्तस्थुर् आहवे ॥ मायाम् और्वीं समासाद्य दह्यमाना दिवौकसः । ते दह्यमाना और्वेण तेजसा भ्रष्टतेजसः । शशंसुर् वज्रिणे देवाः संतप्ताः शरणैषिणः ॥
units.english: When that illusion, created by Maya, destroyed all darkness, the Daityas, assuming forms, effulgent like the sun, again appeared in that battle-field -. Being consumed by the illusory forest-fire the gods appeared before Soma lying on the dews. Having their lustre destroyed by the forest-fire and been consumed thereby the gods, stricken with grief and seeking refuge, communicated it to their king the holder of thunder-bolt.

units.sanskrit: संतप्ते मायया सैन्ये दह्यमाने च दानवैः । चोदितो देवराजेन वरुणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: When the celestial soldiers were assailed by the illusion of Maya and consumed by the Dānavas, Varuna, commanded by the king of gods, thus said –.

units.sanskrit: पुरा ब्रह्मर्षिजः शक्र तपस् तेपे सुदारुणम् । और्वः पूर्वं स तेजस्वी सदृशो ब्रह्मणो गुणैः ॥
units.english: Varuna said:— king of gods, in the days of yore, the energetic Urva, the son of the Brāhmana saint Bhrigu, adorned with accomplishments like those of Brahmā, practised hard austerities.

units.sanskrit: तं तपन्तम् इवादित्यं तपसा जगद् अव्ययम् । उपतस्थुर् मुनिगणा देवा देवर्षिभिः सह ॥
units.english: Like the eternal sun he assailed the whole world with his penances. The Brāhmana saints, with the gods and ascetics, appeared before him –.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुश् चैव दानवो दावनेश्वरः । तम् ऊचुर् ब्रह्मॠषयो वचनं धर्मसंहितम् । ऋषिवंशेषु भगवञ्श् छिन्नमूलम् इदं कुलम् ॥ एकस् त्वम् अनपत्यश् च गोत्रापत्यं न वर्तते । कौमारं व्रतम् आस्थाय क्लेशम् एवानुवर्तसे ॥
units.english: The Dānava-king Hiranyakasipu communicated it to that highly energetic Rishi. The Brāhmana saints then addressed to him the following sacred words; This family, of the Rishis, is about to be extinct now, since, you, being alone and having no issue, are not thinking of perpetuating your race. Adopting a life of celibacy you are practising these hard penances –.

units.sanskrit: बहूनि विप्र गोत्राणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । एकदेहानि तिष्ठन्ति विविक्तानि विना प्रजाः ॥
units.english: Many familes of self-controlled Rishis, are on the verge of extinction on account of the absence of of any offspring. Only one body exists.

units.sanskrit: धरत्सूत्सन्नभूतेषु तेषु ते नास्ति कारणम् । भवांस् तु तपसा श्रेष्ठः प्रजापतिसमद्युतिः ॥
units.english: If all these families disappear for want of descendants there is no chance of their being multiplied. You are the foremost of ascetics and are effulgent like Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: तत्प्रवर्तस्व वंशाय वर्धयात्मानम् आत्मना । आदधत् स्वोर्जितं तेजो द्वितीयां कुरु वै तनुम् ॥
units.english: Therefore think of multiplying your race and you yourself multiply yourself. Devote your great energy and produce your second body.

units.sanskrit: स एवम् उक्तो मुनिभिर् मुनिर् मनसि ताडितः । जगर्हे तान् ऋषिगणान् वचनं चेदम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by the Rishis and having his mind agitated that self-controlled ascetic blamed them and said.

units.sanskrit: यथायं शाश्वतो धर्मो मुनीनां विहितः पुरा । आर्षं वै सेवतां कर्म वन्यमूलफलाशिनः ॥
units.english: This had been laid down in the days of yore as the eternal duty of the Munis living in the forest on roots and following the religion of the Aryans.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मयोनौ प्रसूतस्य ब्राह्मणस्यात्मवर्तिनः । ब्रह्मचर्यं सुचरितं ब्रह्माणम् अपि चालयेत् ॥
units.english: The well-practised vow of celibacy of the Brāhmanas, born from Brahmā, agitated even Brahmā himself.

units.sanskrit: द्विजानां वृत्तयस् तिस्रो ये गृहाश्रमवासिनः । अस्माकं तु वनं वृत्तिर् वन्याश्रमनिवासिनाम् ॥ अब्भक्षा वायुभक्षाश् च दन्तोलूखलिनस् तथा । अश्मकुट्टा दशतपाः पञ्चसप्ततपाश् च ये ॥ एते तपसि तिष्ठन्तो व्रतैर् अपि सुदुष्चरैः । ब्रह्मचर्याद् ब्राह्मणस्य ब्राह्मणत्वं विधीयते । एवम् आहुः परे लोके ब्रह्मचर्यविदो जनाः ॥ ब्रह्मचर्ये स्थितं धैर्यं ब्रह्मचर्ये स्थितं तपः । ये स्थिता ब्रह्मचर्येण ब्राह्मणा दिवि ते स्थिताः ॥
units.english: To officiate as priests, to teach and to accept fees are the three-fold duties of the Brāhmanas living as house-holders. To live in the forest is our duty who, observing the vow of celibacy live in hermitage -. Practising hard penances and giving preference to chastity in thought, words and deeds, the Munis, living on water, those living on air, the Dantolukhalikas, Ashmakuttas, Dashanapās, and Panchatapās, attain to the most excellent state -. Through this chastity in thought, words and deeds the Brāhmanas attain to their Brāhmanahood. The Brahmavādins, living in the most excellent region, have recorded this. Patience resides in Brahmacharyya, asceticism exists in Brahmacharyya and those Brāhmanas, who practise it, attain to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: नास्ति योगं विना सिद्धिर् नास्ति सिद्धिं विना यशः । नास्ति लोके यशोमूलं ब्रह्मचर्यात् परं तपः ॥ यो निगृह्येन्द्रियग्रामं भूतग्रामं च पञ्चकम् । ब्रह्मचर्यं समाधत्ते किम् अतः परमं तपः ॥ अयोगे केशधरणम् असंकल्पे व्रतक्रिया । ब्रह्मचर्यं च चर्या च त्रयं स्याद् दम्भसंज्ञितम् ॥ क्व दाराः क्व च संयोगः क्व च भावविपर्ययः । स्मरणं सुन्दरीणां च मनसो विकृतिः पुरा । तस्याम् उत्पत्तिम् आसाद्य तस्यां बीजं क आवेहत् । सृजध्वं मानसान् पुत्रान् प्राजापत्येन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Without Siddhi, there is no yoga, and without yoga there is no fame. There is no other glorious asceticism in this world than Brahmacharyya. Having subdued the five elements and five organs of sense one should practise Brahmacharyya. What other greater Tapas is there than Brahmacharyya ? The shaving of the hairs in the absence of yoga which the Sanyasins are bound to practise, the observance of the difficult Chandrāyana vow for pleasing the people in the absence of determination to go to the next world, the practice of religion in the absence of Brahmacharyya—these three are designated as Dambha. When Brahmā created his mind-begotten progeny where had he his wife and where was his co-habitation and where was the agitation of his mind ? You, self-controlled Rishis, have a great ascetic energy. Therefore create your mind-born progeny by your patriarchal works.

units.sanskrit: मनसा निर्मिता योनिर् आधातव्या तपस्विना । न दारयोगं बीजं वा व्रतमुक्तं तपस्विनाम् ॥
units.english: The ascetics should procreate progeny through their mind-born source. They should not marry and beget children on their wives.

units.sanskrit: यद् इदं लुप्तधर्मार्थं युष्माभिर् इह निर्भयैः । व्याहृतं सद्भिर् अत्यर्थम् असद्भिर् इव मे मतम् ॥
units.english: What you have said, being yourselves all pious men, about the different religious practices, appears to me as thoroughly immoral.

units.sanskrit: वपुर् दीप्तान्तरात्मानम् एष कृत्वा मनोमयम् । दारयोगं विना स्रक्ष्ये पुत्रम् आत्मतनूरुहम् ॥ एवम् आत्मानम् आत्मा मे द्वितीयं जनयिष्यति । ऊर्वस् तु तपसाविष्टो निवेश्योरुं हुताशने । ममन्थैकेन दर्भेण सुतस्य प्रभवारणिम् ॥
units.english: By this my effulgent body consisting of soul and identical with mind, shall pro-create a son, begotten of my body, without espousing a wife. By the forest, regulations shall create, out of this body of mine, a second body capable of consuming the creatures. Thereupon being engaged in Tapas and placing his thigh into the fire Urva began to churn an Arani, capable of giving a son, with a Darbha.

units.sanskrit: तस्योरुं सहसा भित्त्वा ज्वालामाली निरिन्धनः । जगतो दहनाकाङ्क्षी पुत्रो ऽग्निः समपद्यत ॥
units.english: Thereupon all on a sudden enveloped with flames there came out the fire in the shape of a son desirous of consuming the universe -.

units.sanskrit: ऊर्वस्योरुं विनिर्मिद्य और्वो नामान्तको ऽनलः । दिधक्षन्न् इव लोकांस् त्रीञ् जज्ञे परमकोपनः ॥
units.english: Riving the thigh of Urva there came into being the all-ending and the wrathful fire Aurva as if desirous of consuming the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: उत्पन्नमात्रश् चोवाच पितरं दीप्तया गिरा । क्षुधा मे बाधते तात जगद् धक्ष्ये त्यजस्व माम् ॥
units.english: As soon as he was born, he said to his father in burning words:— father, am stricken with hunger. Leave me, shall eat up the whole world .

units.sanskrit: त्रिदिवारोहिभिर् ज्वालैर् जृम्भमाणो दिशो दश । निर्दहन् सर्वभूतानि ववृधे सो ऽन्तको ऽनलः ॥
units.english: At that time yawning with flames that had gone up to the celestial region the all-ending fire completely consumed the ten quarters and all the elements and thus increased itself.

units.sanskrit: सर्वलोकपतिः प्रभुः । आजगाम मुनिर् यत्र व्यसृजत् पुत्रम् उत्तमम् । स ददर्शोरुम् ऊर्वस्य दीप्यमानं सुताग्निना । और्वकोपाग्निसंतप्तांल् लोकांश् च ऋषिभिः सह । तम् उवाच ततो ब्रह्मा । पुत्रेदं धार्यतां तेजो लोकानां क्रियतां दया ॥
units.english: In the meantime the Lord Brahmā, the master of all creatures, went where that Muni begat that most excellent son. He saw there the worlds along with the Rishis blazing up with the thigh-begotten fiery son of Urva and assailed by Aurva's fire of anger. Thereupon honouring the Rishi Urva Brahmā said to him:—Bear this energy of your son out of compassion for the world.

units.sanskrit: अस्यापत्यस्य ते विप्र करिष्ये साह्यम् उत्तमम् । वासं चास्य प्रदास्यामि प्राशनं चामृतोपमम् । तथ्यम् एतन् मम वचः शृणु त्वं वदतां वर ॥
units.english: Vipra, shall confer upon this son of yours the most excellent virtue of patience. And shall bestow on him the best of habitations and nectarine food. Hear these my truthful words, foremost of speakers.

units.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽस्म्य् अनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि यन् मे ऽद्य भगवाञ् शिशोः । मतिम् एतां ददातीह परमानुग्रहाय वै ॥
units.english: have received a great favour since the Lord has conferred a great grace on my child and given him this inclination.

units.sanskrit: भगवंस् तर्पितः पुत्रः कैर् हव्यैः प्राप्स्यते सुखम् ॥ कुत्र वास्य निवासः स्याद् भोजनं च किमात्मकम् । विधास्यति भवान् अस्य वीर्यतुल्यं महौजसः ॥
units.english: How will this my son, when he will attain to the desirable youth, acquire happiness on being honoured with Havyas? Where will be his house and what will be his food? What sort of food will you arrange for this highly powerful one commensurate with his strength –.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच वडवामुखे ऽस्य वसतिः समुद्रे वै भविष्यति । मम योनिर् जलं विप्र तच् च मे तोयपं मुखम् ॥
units.english: Brahma said:—This boy will live in the mouth of the ocean resembling that of a mare. Vipra, am born of water, so his body will be made of water.

units.sanskrit: तत्राहम् आसे निरतः पिबन् वारिमयं हवैः । तद्धविस् तव पुत्रस्य विसृजाम्य् आलयं च तत् ॥
units.english: Always living on watery food live in the water. shall give your son this food. Let him bring it.

units.sanskrit: ततो युगान्ते भूतानाम् एष चाहं च सुव्रत । सहितौ विचरिष्यावो निष्प्राणनकराव् इह ॥
units.english: you of firm vows, at the time of the termination of a yuga this fire will consume all the worlds. United with him shall repeatedly eat up the worlds.

units.sanskrit: एषो ऽग्निर् अन्तकालस्य सलिलाशी मया कृतः । दहनः सर्वभूतानां सदेवासुररक्षसाम् ॥
units.english: This fire has been made by me to live upon the water of dissolution. He will consume all the creatures with the gods, Asuras and Rākshasas.

units.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति सो ऽप्य् अग्निः संवृतज्वालमण्डलः । प्रविवेशार्णवमुखं निक्षिप्य पितरि प्रभाम् ॥
units.english: Saying So be it, and casting off his effulgence before his father Aurva, enveloped with consecrated flames of fire, entered into the mouth of the ocean.

units.sanskrit: प्रतियातस् ततो ब्रह्मा ते च सर्वे महर्षयः । और्वस्याग्नेः प्रभावज्ञाः स्वां स्वां गतिम् उपाश्रिताः ॥
units.english: Thereupon Brahmā and other great Rishis returned to their respective habitations. And being informed of the power of Aurva fire they resorted to their respective courses.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुर् दृष्ट्वा तद् अद्भुतम् अपूजयत् । और्वं प्रणतसर्वाङ्गो वाक्यं चेदम् उवाच ह ॥ भगवन्न् अद्भुतम् इदं निर्वृत्तं लोकसाक्षिकम् । तपसा ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ परितुष्टः पितामहः ॥
units.english: Beholding the wondrous affair Hiranyakasipu, placing all his limbs on the ground, worshipped Urva and said the following words Reverend Sir, wonderful is this affair that has been witnessed by all the worlds. foremost of Munis, the grand-father has been pleased with your penances.

units.sanskrit: अहं तु तव पुत्रस्य तव चैव महाव्रत । भृत्य इत्य् अवगन्तव्यः श्लाघ्यो ऽस्मि यदि कर्मणा ॥ तं मा पश्य समापन्नं तवैवाराधने रतम् । यत् सीदेयं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तवैव स्यात्पराजयः ॥
units.english: you of great vows, if am worthy of being praised for my actions know me as your and your son's servant. Behold me as engaged in worshipping you. If meet with discomfiture, foremost of Munis, it will be your defeat.

units.sanskrit: ऊर्व उवाच धन्यो ऽस्म्य् अनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि यस्य ते ऽहं गुरुर् मतः । नास्ति ते तपसानेन भयम् अद्येह सुव्रत ॥
units.english: Urva said:— have been also blessed and honored since you have accepted me as your preceptor. you of firm vows, you have no longer any fear of ascetic observances.

units.sanskrit: इमां च मायां गृह्णीष्व मम पुत्रेण निर्मिताम् । निरिन्धनाम् अग्निमयीं दुःस्पर्शां पावकैर् अपि ॥
units.english: Do you take this fiery illusion which even the fires, without fuels that have been created my son, cannot easily touch.

units.sanskrit: एषा ते स्वस्य वंशस्य वशगारिविनिग्रहे । रक्षिष्यत्य् आत्मपक्षं च परांश् च प्रदहिष्यति ॥
units.english: This illusion will help you in killing the enemies of your family; it will protect your own army and consume the enemies.

units.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति तां गृह्य प्रणम्य मुनिपुंगवम् । जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टः कृतार्थो दानवेश्वरः ॥
units.english: Saying may it be so’ and saluting that foremost of Munis Hiranyakasipu, the king of Dānavas, was pleased and returned to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: सैषा दुर्विषहा माया देवैर् अपि दुरासदा । और्वेण निर्मिता पूर्वं पावकेनोर्वसूनुना ॥
units.english: Varuna said:—This is that illusion, which the deities cannot bear, and that had been created in the days of yore by Urva's son Aurva.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तु व्युत्थिते दैत्ये निर्वीयैषा न संशयः । शापो ह्य् अस्याः पुरा दत्तः सृष्टा येनैव तेजसा ॥ यद्य् एषा प्रतिहन्तव्या कर्तव्यो भगवान् सुखी । दीयतां मे सखा शक्र तोययोनिर् निशाकरः । तेनाहं सह संगम्य यादोभिश् च समाहितः । मायाम् एतां हनिष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादान् न संशयः ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच एवम् अस्त्व् इति संहृष्टः शक्रस् त्रिदशवर्धनः । संदिदेशाग्रतः सोमं युद्धाय शिशिरायुधम् ॥ गच्छ सोम सहायत्वं कुरु पाशधरस्य वै । असुराणां विनाशाय जयार्थं च दिवौकसाम् ॥
units.english: With the death of that Daitya it has undoubtedly been shorn of its power. It had been imprecated with a curse in the days of yore by him who had created it If we can strike against this illusion the king of gods will be happy. Give me, Sakra, my friend Nishakara the moon who is born of water. Being united with him and Yados and controlling my senses, shall by your favour, undoubtedly destroy this illusion. Vaishampayana said:—Saying so be it the king of gods, the multiplier of the deities, delightedly, first of all, sent for Soma in battle, who had the dews for his weapons. Sakra said;— Sudhākara, proceed for the destruction of the demons and for accomplishing the victory of the gods and help the holder of noose.

units.sanskrit: त्वम् अप्रतिमवीर्यश् च ज्योतिषां चेश्वरेश्वरः । त्वन्मयं सर्वलोकानां रसं रसविदो विदुः ॥
units.english: You are gifted with incomparable energy, the lord of all the luminous bodies, the lord of even the sun. The persons, who have a knowledge of the juices, consider you as identical with all the juices.

units.sanskrit: क्षयवृद्धिस् तव व्यक्ता सागरे खे च मण्डले । परिवर्तस्य् अहोरात्रं कालं जगति योजयन् ॥
units.english: Increase and decrease are manifest in the ocean and your orbit. Attaching time to the universe you are creating days and nights.

units.sanskrit: लोकच्छायामयं लक्ष्म तवाङ्के शशसंस्थितम् । न विदुः सोम देवाश् च ये च नक्षत्रयोगिनः ॥
units.english: The shadow of the earth, resembling a hair, exists in your body. The Somadevas even, who are born of the stars, do not know this.

units.sanskrit: त्वम् आदित्यपथाद् ऊर्ध्वं ज्योतिषां चोपरि स्थितः । तमः प्रोत्सार्य वपुषा भासयस्य् अखिलं जगत् ॥
units.english: You exist above the road of the sun and other luminous bodies. Dispelling darkness with your own body and rays you light up the world.

units.sanskrit: श्वेतभानुर् हिमतनुर् ज्योतिषाम् अधिपः शशी । अब्दकृत् कालयोगात्मा ईज्यो यज्ञरसो ऽव्ययः ॥ ओषधीशः क्रियायोनिर् अब्जयोनिर् अनुष्णभाक् । शीतांशुर् अमृताधारश् चपलः श्वेतवाहनः ॥
units.english: You are of white rays and cool body, the master of the luminous bodies, have a hare on your lap, the ivisible soul of the time, are worshipped in sacrifices, the juice of the sacrifices, eternal, the king of plants, the source of action, water-born, of cool rays, the mine of ambrosia, fickle and have white horses.

units.sanskrit: त्वं कान्तिः कान्तवपुषां त्वं सोमः सोमवृत्तिनाम् । तद् गच्छ त्वं सहानेन वरुणेन वरूथिना । शमयस्वासुरीं मायां यया दह्याम संयुगे ॥
units.english: You are the grace of the beautiful beings, the Soma of the Somadevas and the most beautiful in all the worlds. You dispell darkness and are the king of rays Do you accompany Varuna and his army and destroy the demonaic illusion by which we have been burnt down in battle -.

units.sanskrit: सोम उवाच यन् मा वदसि युद्धार्थे देवराज वरप्रद । एतान् मच्छीतनिर्दग्धान् पश्यस्व हिमवेष्टितान् । विमायान् विमदांश् चैव दैत्यसंघान् महाहवे ॥
units.english: Soma said:— lord of the universe, king of gods, shall do what you have asked me for the battle. pour the dews which can dispell the demonaic illusion. Behold in this great encounter the Dānavas consumed with my cold, covered with dues, divested of their illusive powers and haughtiness.

units.sanskrit: वेष्टयन्ति स्म तान् घोरान् दैत्यान् मेघगणा इव ॥ तौ पाशशुक्लांशुधरौ वरुणेन्दू महारणे । जघ्नतुर् हिमपातैश् च पाशपातैश् च दानवान् ॥ द्वाव् अम्बुनाथौ समरे तौ पाशहिमयोधिनौ । मृधे चेरतुर् अम्भोभिः क्षुब्धाव् इव महार्णवौ ॥ ताभ्याम् आप्लावितं सैन्यं तद् दानवम् अदृश्यत । जगत्संवर्तकाम्भोदैः प्रवृत्तैर् इव संवृतम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Like unto masses of clouds the smoky showers of dues, discharged by the moon, enveloped all the dreadful Dānavas. With the pouring of dews and strokes of nooses, Varuna, the holder of noose and the moon of white rays began to slay the demons in that great battle. Pouring water in the battle-field and fighting with the noose and cold those two lords of water began to range like two swelling oceans. As the world is enveloped with Pravartaka cloud discharging copious showers of rain at the time of the universal dissolution so that Danava army was covered with water by Varuna and Soma.

units.sanskrit: तां मायां शमयाम् आस्तां देवौ दैतेयनिर्मिताम् ॥
units.english: Taking up the rays and the noose the moon and Varuna destroyed the illusion of the Daitya.

units.sanskrit: शीतांशुजलनिर्दग्धाः पाशैश् च प्रसिता मृधे । न शेकुश् चलितुं दैत्या विशिरस्का इवाद्रयः ॥ शीतांशुनिहतास् ते तु पेतुर् दैत्या हिमार्दिताः । हिमप्लावितसर्वाङ्गा निरुष्माण इवाग्रयः ॥ मयो ददर्श मायावी दानवान् दिवि दानवः ॥
units.english: Being exhausted with cold water and fettered by the noose the Daityas, like mountains bereft of their peaks, became extremely inactive. Being slain by the moon, crushed down by cold and having their bodies covered with dews those Daityas began to fall down like extinguished fire. The various cars of the demons, shorn of lustre, began to fall down and go up in the sky. The Dānava Maya again displayed another huge illusion before the Dānavas who had been covered with dews and bound down with the noose.

units.sanskrit: स शिलाजालविततां गण्डशैलाट्टहासिनीम् । पादपोत्कटकूटाग्रां कन्दराकीर्णकाननाम् ॥
units.english: It was covered with stones, and rocks. Its peaks were covered with huge trees, its caves were filled with trees and it was infested with lions, tigers and elephants.

units.sanskrit: साश्मशब्दैः शिलावर्षैः प्रपतद्भिश् च पादपैः । निजघ्ने देवसंघांस् तान् दानवांश् चाप्य् अजीवयत् ॥
units.english: It abounded in deer emitting cries and trees shaken by the wind –. With a downpour of rocks and trees that mountainous illusion slew the gods and revived the Dānavas.

units.sanskrit: नैशाकरी वारुणी च माये ऽन्तर्दधतुस् ततः । अश्मभिश् चायसघनैः किरद्देवगणान् रणे ॥
units.english: Thereupon the illusion, created by the moon and Varuna, was dispelled and Maya's illusion covered the gods in the battle-field with iron clouds and rocks.

units.sanskrit: साश्मसंघातविषमा द्रुमपर्वतसंकटा । अभवद् द्यौर् असंहार्या पृथिवी पर्वतैर् इव ॥
units.english: The earth, already uneven with the collection of mountains and filled with trees, was so thickly covered with mountains that any one could hardly traverse it.

units.sanskrit: नानाहतो ऽश्मभिः कश्चिच् छिलाभिश् चाप्य् अताडितः । नानिरुद्धो द्रुमगणैर् देवो ऽदृश्यत संयुगे ॥
units.english: Some gods were wounded with rocks, some were assailed with stones and some were hemmed in with trees in that battle. Excepting the holder of club Vishnu all the celestial soldiers lost their bows and had their weapons broken.

units.sanskrit: तद् असंस्रस्तधनुषं भग्नप्रहरणाविलम् । स हि युद्धगतः श्रीमान् ईशो न स्म व्यकम्पत । सहिष्णुत्वाज् जगत्स्वामी न चुक्रोध गदाधरः ॥
units.english: And they all became inactive. But that beautiful lord of the universe, Gadhādhara, although stationed in the battle, was not the least agitated or worked up with anger on account of his patience.

units.sanskrit: कालज्ञः कालमेघाभः समीक्षन् कालम् आहवे । देवासुरविमर्दं स द्रष्टुकामो जनार्दनः ॥ ततो भगवतादिष्टौ रणे पावकमारुतौ । मायाया मयसृष्टायाः प्रवृद्धायाः शमाय वै । ततः प्रवृद्धाव् अन्योन्यं प्रवृद्धज्वालवेगिनौ । चोदितौ विष्णुवाक्येन तौ मायाम् अपकर्षताम् ॥
units.english: In order to witness the assailing of the gods and demons, Jānārddana, conversant with the knowledge of proper time, resembling the cloud that appears at the time of the universal dissolution, waited for the proper hour in the battle-field. Thereupon in the battle-field he ordered the fire and air to destroy the illusion created by Maya. Being united with each other and increased the increasing fire of flames and air, at the command of Vishnu, destroyed that illusion.

units.sanskrit: ताभ्याम् उद्भ्रान्तमेघाभ्यां प्रवृद्धाभ्यां महामृधे । दग्धा सा पार्वती माया भस्मभूता ननाश ह ॥ दैत्यसेनां ददहतुर् युगान्तेष्व् इव मूर्च्छितौ ॥ वायुः प्रधावितस् तत्र पश्चाद् अग्निश् च मारुतात् । दानवानां विमानेषु विमानेषु समन्ततः ॥ वातस्कन्धापविद्धेषु कृतकर्मणि पावके । मायावधे विनिर्वृत्ते स्तूयमाने गदाधरे ॥ निष्प्रयत्नेषु दैत्येषु त्रैलोक्ये मुक्तबन्धने । संप्रहृष्टेषु देवेषु साधु साध्व् इति सर्वशः ॥
units.english: By that increasing fire of wild course and the air that mountainous illusion was consumed and destroyed in that great battle. The air, assisted by fire, increased like that at the time of the universal dissolution. And the fire assisted by air consumed the army of demons. As soon as the wind blew the fire followed it; it appeared as if the fire and air were sporting in the midst of the army of demons. When all the Dānavas were consumed and their cars began to fall down, when the fire was successful in accomplishing its work, when the cars desisted from slaying the demons falling down an all sides quickly like the air, when the Daityas grew inactive and the three worlds were freed from bonds, the gods delightedly sent up from all sides shouts of victory –.

units.sanskrit: जये दशशताक्षस्य मयस्य च पराजये । दिक्षु सर्वासु शुद्धासु प्रवृत्ते धर्मसंस्तरे ॥
units.english: When the thousand-eyed god achieved victory and the demon Maya met with discomfiture all the quarters became clear and the religious performances began to extend.

units.sanskrit: अपावृते चन्द्रपथे स्वयनस्थे दिवाकरे । प्रकृतिस्थेषु लोकेषु नृषु चारित्रबन्धुषु ॥
units.english: The path of the moon was cleared up, the sun was placed in its course, all the elements were restored to their natural orders and men, fond of good conduct, were at ease.

units.sanskrit: विराजमाना देवास् तु ततो मुनिगणैः सह । अभिन्नबन्धने मृत्यौ हूयमाने हुताशने । यज्ञशोभिषु देवेषु स्वर्गार्थं दर्शयत्सु च ॥
units.english: The Regent of the dead began to carry on his work without any distinction, oblations were offered to fire, the gods were entitled to partake of their portions in the sacrificial offerings and find out the utility of the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: लोकपालेषु सर्वेषु दिक्षु संयानवर्तिषु । भावे तपसि शुद्धानाम् अभावे पापकर्मणाम् ॥
units.english: The regents, of the quarters, began to range in their respective provinces, pure persons, intent on carrying on Tapas, began to flourish and there was absence of impious men.

units.sanskrit: देवपक्षे प्रमुदिते दैत्यपक्षे विषीदति । त्रिपादविग्रहे धर्मे अधर्मे पादविग्रहे ॥
units.english: The partizans of the gods were delighted and those of the Daityas were depressed. Virtue assumed the form of three legs and vice that of one leg.

units.sanskrit: अपावृते महाद्वारे वर्तमाने च सत्पथे । स्वधर्मस्थेषु वर्णेषु लोके ऽस्मिन्न् आश्रमेषु च ॥
units.english: The great gate was kept open and ways to morality came into being and all the Ashramas and Varnas of the world began to observe their own duties.

units.sanskrit: गीयमानासु गाथासु देवसंस्तवनादिषु । प्रशान्तकल्मषे लोके शान्ते तमसि दारुणे ॥ अग्निमारुतयोस् तस्मिन् वृत्ते संग्रामकर्मणि । तन्मया विमला लोकास् ताभ्यां जयकृतक्रियाः ॥
units.english: The wandering kings began to protect their own subjects, and hymns, in praise of the gods, were sung. All the sins were removed, dreadful pride was pacified and that battle of the fire and air was brought to a close. People accorded superiority to them because they accomplished the victory.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वदेवभयं श्रुत्वा मारुताग्निभयं महत् । कालनेमिर् इति ख्यातो दानवः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥
units.english: Hearing of the fear of the air and fire entertained by the Asuras, the well-known Dānava, by name Kālanemi, appeared in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: भास्कराकारमुकुटः शिञ्जिताभरणाङ्गदः । मन्दरोत्कीर्णसंकाशो महारजतसंवृतः ॥
units.english: His crown was adorned with crests effulgent like the sun; he was adorned with Angada and his hundred arms were bedecked with hundred silvery weapons huge as the mount Mandāra.

units.sanskrit: शतप्रहरणोदग्रः शतबाहुः शताननः । शतशीर्षः स्थितः श्रीमाञ् शतशृङ्ग इवाचलः । कक्षे महति संवृद्धो निदाघ इव पावकः ॥
units.english: He had a hundred faces and a hundred heads. That beautiful demon appeared there like a mountain with a hundred peaks –. He shone there like an increasing fire on a heap of grass in the summer season.

units.sanskrit: धूम्रकेशो हरिश्मश्रुर् दंष्ट्रालौष्ठपुटाननः । त्रैलोक्यान्तरविस्तारि धारयन् विपुलं वपुः ॥
units.english: His hairs were smoky, his beards were green; he had huge teeth and his face was adorned with lips. He was living in the intervening space of the three worlds with a huge body of very great dimension.

units.sanskrit: ईरयन् मुखनिःश्वासैर् वृष्टिमन्तो बलाहकान् ॥ तिर्यगायतरक्ताक्षं मन्दरोदग्रवक्षसम् । दिधक्षन्तम् इवायान्तं सर्वान् देवगणान् मृधे ॥ तर्जयन्तं सुरगणांश् छादयन्तं दिशो दश । संवर्तकाले तृषितं दृप्तं मृत्युम् इवोत्थितम् ॥
units.english: With his hands he was raising up the sky, with his feet he was throwing away the mountains, and with his breath he was dissipating the clouds surcharged with watery contents –. That Dānava, of expansive and red eyes looking awry, and powerful like Indra, was as if consuming and roaring at the gods and covering the ten quarters. They saw that Dānava approach like the proud and hungry Death at the time of the universal dissolution -.

units.sanskrit: लम्बाभरणपूर्णेन किंचिच् चलितवर्मणा ॥ उच्छ्रितेनाग्रहस्तेन दक्षिणेन वपुष्मता । दानवान् देवनिहतान् उत्तिष्ठत इति ब्रुवन् ॥
units.english: Raising up the fingers of his right band having a beautiful palm, elevated, adorned with well-polished finger-protectors, covered with garlands and high like moving mountains that Dānava was, as if, saying raise up the slain demons -.

units.sanskrit: तं कालनेमिं समरे द्विषतां कालसंमितम् । वीक्षन्ति स्म सुराः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तलोचनाः ॥
units.english: The celestials, stricken with fear, saw in the battle Kālanemi, like Death himself unto his enemies.

units.sanskrit: तं स्म वीक्षन्ति भूतानि क्रमन्तं कालनेमिनम् । त्रिविक्रमे विक्रमन्तं नारायणम् इवापरम् ॥ सोच्छ्रयन् प्रथमं पादं मारुताघूर्णिताम्बरम् । स मयेनासुरेन्द्रेण परिष्वक्तः क्रमन् रणे । कालनेमिर् बभौ दैत्यः सविष्णुर् इव मन्दरः ॥
units.english: Creatures saw that Kālanemi proceed like the second Nārāyana of three foot-steps. Raising up his front foot and having his raiment shaken by the wind that demon, striking terror to the gods, came to the battle-field. United with the Asura king Maya Kālanemi began to proceed in battle. They appeared like Indra and Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: अथ प्रविव्यथुर् देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः । दृष्ट्वा कालम् इवायान्तं कालनेमिं भयावहम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding the dreadful Kālanemi approach like death himself all the gods were filled with anxiety.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच दानवानां तु पिप्रीषुः कालनेमिः स दानवः । व्यवर्धत महातेजास् तपान्ते जलदो यथा ॥ तं त्रैलोयान्तरगतं दृष्ट्वा ते दानवेश्वराः । उत्तस्थुर् अपरिश्रान्ताः प्राप्येवामृतम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—In order to welcome the Dānavas the highly powerful great Asura Kālanemi assumed proportions like clouds in the end of summer. As by acquiring most excellent ambrosia, people are relieved of their exhaustion so the leading Danavas, on beholding Kālanemi living in the intervening space of the three worlds, rose up as if they had never been tired.

units.sanskrit: तारकामयसंग्रामे सततं जितकाशिनः । रेजुर् आयोधनगता दानवा युद्धकङ्क्षिणः ॥
units.english: Then the terrified Dānavas, headed by Maya and Tāra, irrepressible in battle, who always wished victory in Tāraka's battle, shone there in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: प्रेक्षतां चाभवत् प्रीतिर् दानवं कालनेमिनम् ॥
units.english: Beholding Kālanemi all those Dānavas, throwing weapons and entering into Vyuhas, were greatly delighted.

units.sanskrit: ये तु तत्र मयस्यासन् मुख्या युद्धपुरःसराः । तेऽपि सर्वे भयं त्यक्त्वा हृष्टा योद्धुम् उपस्थिताः ॥
units.english: Of them, the principal soldiers of Maya, who were well-skilled in fighting, cast off fear and delightedly appeared there for battle.

units.sanskrit: मयस् तारो वराहश् च हयग्रीवश् च वीर्यवान् । विप्रचित्तिसुतः श्वेतः खरलम्बाव् उभाव् अपि ॥ अरिष्टो बलिपुत्रश् च किशोराष्ट्रौ तथैव च । स्वर्भानुश् चामरप्रख्यो वक्त्रयोधी महासुरः ॥
units.english: Maya, Tāra, Varaha, the powerful Hayagriva, Viprachitti's sons Sweta, Khera and Lamva, Bali's son Arishtha, Kishora, Ushtra, the immortal-like Sharbhānu and the great Asura Vakrayodhi, who were all experts in the use of weapons, were devoted to the practice of Tapas, and skilled in fighting, appeared before Kalanemi the foremost of them all.

units.sanskrit: दोर्भिश् चायतपीनाभिः प्रासैः पाशैश् च मुद्गरैः । सर्पैर् लेलिह्यमानैश् च विसर्पद्भिश् च सायकैः ॥ वज्रैः प्रहरणीयैश् च दीप्यद्भिश् चापि तोमरैः । विकोशैश् चासिभिस् तीक्ष्णैः शूलैश् च शितनिर्मलैः ॥
units.english: Taking up huge clubs, axes, death-like maces, Kshepanyas, huge rocks, stones, Pattishas, Vindipālas, Parighas made of best steel, dreadful Ghātanis, Sataghnis, Yugas, Yantras, Argalas, Prāsas, nooses, serpents, swords, thunder-bolts, blazing Tomaras, unsheathed daggers and sharpened weapons and having their minds worked up with zeal, they, taking Kālanemi before them, stood in front of the battle-field –.

units.sanskrit: सा दीप्तशस्त्रप्रवरा दैत्यानां शुशुभे चमूः । देवतानाम् अपि चमूर् मुमुदे शक्रपालिता । दीप्ता शीतोष्णतेजोभ्यां चन्द्रभास्करतेजसा ॥
units.english: That Daitya army, adorned with many excellent shining weapons, shone there like the cloudy sky bespangled with stars. Emblazoned with the cool and hot rays of the moon and the sun, the celestial army, reared by the king of gods, also shone there.

units.sanskrit: तोयदाविद्धवसना ग्रहनक्षत्रहासिनी ॥ यमेन्द्रवरुणैर् गुप्ता धनदेन च धीमता । संप्रदीप्ताग्निपवना नारायणपरायणा ॥ सा समुद्रौघसदृशी दिव्या देवमहाचमूः । रराजास्त्रवती भीमा यक्षगन्धर्वशालिनी ॥
units.english: There appeared that beautiful and great army of gods consisting of dreadful Yakshas and Rākshasas, fleet as the wind, having the stars for the steamers, the clouds for their raiments, abounding in smiling stars and planets, protected by Indra, Varuna and the intelligent Kuvera, the king of riches, accompanied by the fire and air, devoted to Nārāyana, gifted with the velocity of the ocean, and adorned with celestial weapons –.

units.sanskrit: तयोश् चम्वोस् तदानीं तु बभूव स समागमः । द्वावापृथिव्योः संयोगो यथा स्याद् युगपर्यये ॥
units.english: As at the revolution of cycles heaven and earth are united so the celestial and demon armies met with each other.

units.sanskrit: तद्युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं देवदानवसंकुलम् । क्षमापराक्रममयं दर्पस्य विनयस्य च ॥
units.english: That encounter, between the gods and demons displaying humility and pride, forgiveness and prowess, grew exceedingly dreadful.

units.sanskrit: निश्चक्रमुर् बलाभ्यां तु ताभ्यां भीमाः सुरासुराः । ताभ्यां बलाभ्यां संहृष्टाश् चेरुस् ते देवदानवाः । वनाभ्यां पार्वतीयाभ्यां पुष्पिताभ्यां यथा गजाः ॥
units.english: As the swollen rivers generally issue out of the oceans so the dreadful gods and Asuras came out of both the armies. As the elephants come out of two mountainous forests covered with flowers so issuing out of both the armies the hosts of the gods and demons began delightedly to range there.

units.sanskrit: समाजघ्नुस् ततो भेरीः शङ्खान् दध्मुश् च नैकशः । स द्यां दिवं भुवं चैव दिशश् च समपूरयत् ॥
units.english: They confronted each other and repeatedly blew their conches and bugles. That sound filled the heaven, earth and all the quarters.

units.sanskrit: ज्याघाततलनिर्घोषो धनुषां कूजितानि च । दुंदुभीनां च निनदा दैत्यम् अन्तर्दधुः स्वनम् ॥ ते ऽन्योन्यम् अभिसंपेतुः पातयन्तः परस्परम् । देवतास् त्व् अशनीर् घोराः परिघांश् चोत्तमायसान् । ससर्जुर् आजौ निस्त्रिंशान् गदा गुर्वीश् च दानवाः ॥
units.english: The sound, of the bow-strings against the palms, the twang of the bows and the sound of the bugles rose above the noise of the Daityas. The gods and demons felled and confronted one another. Some broke the arms of others with their own. The gods began to throw, in battle, dreadful thunder-bolts and excellent Ayasas and Parighas and the Dānavas began to discharge Gurvis, clubs and Nistringshas.

units.sanskrit: परिपेतुर् भृशं केचिन् न्युब्जाः केचिच् च जज्ञिरे ॥
units.english: Some fell down with their limbs mutilated by the strokes of clubs and with their bodies bent down.

units.sanskrit: ततो रथैः सतुरगैर् विमानैश् चाशुगामिभिः । समीयुस् ते सुसंरब्धा रोषाद् अन्योन्यम् आहवे ॥
units.english: Thereupon worked up with anger, some on cars, some on horse back and some on quick-coursing chariots, ran towards one another in the battle.

units.sanskrit: संवर्तमानाः समरे विवर्तन्तस् तथापरे । रथा रथैर् निरुध्यन्ते पदाताश् च पदातिभिः ॥
units.english: Some stood in the battle-field and some fled away. The car-warriors were obstructed by cars and the infantry were obstructed by the foot-soldiers.

units.sanskrit: तेषां रथानां तुमुलः स शब्दः शब्दवाहिनाम् । बभञ्जिरे रथान् केचित् केचित् संमृदिता रथैः । संबाधम् एके संप्राप्य न शेकुश् चलितुं रथाः ॥
units.english: The sound, of the wheels of those cars, grew terrible like the muttering of clouds in the sky. Some broke down the cars, some hurled chariots against chariots and some could not proceed unitedly in the midst of that collection of cars.

units.sanskrit: अन्योन्यम् अन्ये समरे दोर्भ्याम् उत्क्षिप्य दर्पिताः । संह्रादमानाभरणा जघ्नुस् तत्रासिचर्मिणः ॥ अस्त्रैर् अन्ये विनिर्भिन्ना रक्तं वेमुर् हता युधि । क्षरज्जलानां सदृशा जलदानां समागमे ॥
units.english: Striking one another with their arms and sending up shouts, warriors, armed with swords and leathern coats of mail and elated with pride, began to proceed in battle. Some, mutilated and wounded by weapons in battle, began to vomit blood like clouds discharging water in the rains.

units.sanskrit: तदस्त्रशस्त्रग्रथितं क्षिप्तोत्क्षिप्तगदाविलम् । देवदानवसंक्षुब्धं संकुलं युद्धम् आबभौ ॥ तद्दानवमहामेघं देवायुधविराजितम् । एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे क्रुद्धः कालनेमिः स दानवः । व्यवर्धत समुद्रौघैः पूर्यमाण इवाम्बुदः ॥
units.english: Filled with those weapons and clubs thrown up and down that encounter of the gods and demons looked exceedingly terrible there. That unfair day of the encounter set in there with celestial weapons for the lightnings, the downpour of arrows for showers and the Dānavas for the massive clouds. In the mean time the great Asura Kālanemi, being worked up with anger, began to increase his body like clouds filled with water by the waves of the ocean.

units.sanskrit: तस्य विद्युच्चलापीडाः प्रदीप्ताशनिवर्षिणः । गात्रान् नागशिरःप्रख्या विनिष्पेतुर् बलाहकाः ॥
units.english: The Valāhakas, consisting of flickering flames like the lightnings, discharging thunder-bolts and huge like the mountains, were crushed down as soon as they fell on his body.

units.sanskrit: क्रोधान् निःश्वसतस् तस्य भ्रूभेदस्वेदवर्षिणः । साग्निनिष्पेषपवना मुखान् निश्चेरुर् अर्चिषः ॥
units.english: When he breathed in anger and sweated on account of the frowning of his eyebrows there came out of his mouth scintillations of fire, accompanied by lightning and air.

units.sanskrit: तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वं च गगने ववृधुस् तस्य बाहवः । पञ्चास्याः कृष्णवपुषो लेलिहन्त इवोरगाः ॥
units.english: His arms began to grow up straight and awry to the sky. It appeared as if the five-hooded black serpents were repeatedly licking their bodies.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽस्त्रजालैर् बहुविधैर् धनुर्भिः परिघैर् अपि । दिव्यम् आकाशम् आवव्रे पर्वतैर् उच्छ्रितैर् इव ॥
units.english: That Dānava enshrouded the sky with various weapons, bows and Parighas high as the mountains.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽनिलोद्धूतवसनस् तस्थौ संग्राममूर्धनि । संध्यातपग्रस्तशिखः साक्षान् मेरुर् इवाचलः ॥
units.english: Wearing a raiment shaken by the wind Kālanemi stood in front of the battle-field like the second Sumeru filled with flames and covered by the rays of the setting sun.

units.sanskrit: ऊरुवेगप्रतिक्षिप्तैः शैलशृङ्गाग्रपादपैः । अपातयद् देवगणान् वज्रेणेव महागिरीन् ॥
units.english: As the king of gods fells down the huge mountains with his thunder-bolt so did he knock down the gods with the mountain peaks and huge trees uprooted by the strokes of his thighs.

units.sanskrit: बहुभिः शस्त्रनिस्त्रिंशैश् च्छिन्नभिन्नशिरोरसः । न शेकुश् चलितुं देवाः कालनेमिहता युधि ॥
units.english: Having been wounded by Kālanemi in battle and having their heads and breasts mutilated by diverse weapons and swords the gods could not move about.

units.sanskrit: मुष्टिभिर् निहताः केचित् केचिद् धि विदलीकृताः । यक्षगन्धर्वपतगाः पेतुः सह महोरगैः ॥
units.english: Some, killed by the stroke of his foot and others grinded by him, fell down with the leading Yakshas, Gandharvas and the great Uragas arranged in Vyuhas.

units.sanskrit: तेन वित्रासिता देवाः समरे कालनेमिना । न शेकुर् यत्नवन्तो ऽपि यत्नं कर्तुं विचेतसः ॥
units.english: Thus terrorized by Kālanemi in battle the gods, bereft of consciousness, could not set forth their exertions although they were capable of doing it.

units.sanskrit: तेन शक्रः सहस्राक्षः संदितः शरबन्धनैः । ऐरावतगतः संख्ये चलितुं न शशाक ह ॥
units.english: Being fettered by him with arrows, the thousand-eyed Sakra, seated on his elephant Airāvata, could not move about in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽतीव प्रकुर्वीत आपो वसुर् अमित्रहा । कालनेमिं जघानाजौ शक्त्या गुह इवापरः ॥
units.english: In that battle the demon Kālanemi constrained Varuna, resembling a watering cloud and effulgent like the waterless ocean, desist from displaying any feats and deprived him of his noose.

units.sanskrit: रणे वैश्रवणस् तेन परिघैः कामरूपिभिः । विलपंल् लोकपालेशस् त्याजितो धनदक्रियाम् ॥
units.english: Bewailing in the battle-field the Patriarch Vaishravana, the king of riches, was rendered, by him through illusory weapons, inactive in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: यमः सर्वहरस् तेन मृत्युप्रहरणो रणे । याम्याम् अवस्थाम् अमरो नीतः स्वां दिशम् आविशत् ॥
units.english: Yama, who spreads death and destroys everything, was deprived of his consciousness by Kālanemi and fled to his own quarter.

units.sanskrit: स लोकपालान् उत्साद्य हृत्वा तेषां च कर्म तत् । दिक्षु सर्वासु देहं स्वं चतुर्धा विदधे तदा ॥
units.english: Having thus assailed the Patriarchs and protecting their respective quarters Kālanemi divided, then his body, into four parts.

units.sanskrit: स नक्षत्रपथं गत्वा दिव्यं स्वर्भानुदर्शितम् । जहार लक्ष्मीं सोमस्य तं चास्य विषयं महत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon repairing to the celestial road of stars pointed out by Sharbhānu that demon took, by force, the grace of the moon and his great object.

units.sanskrit: चालयामास दीप्तांशुं स्वर्गद्वारात् स भास्करम् । सायनं चास्य विषयं जहार दिनकर्म च ॥
units.english: Proceeding to the celestial region he began to direct the sun of burning rays and then occupied for himself his object Sayana and his daily duties.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽग्निं देवमुखे दृष्ट्वा चकारात्ममुखेशयम् । वायुं च तरसा जित्वा चकारात्मवशानुगम् ॥
units.english: Beholding fire in the mouth of the gods Kālanemi placed it in his own and having vanquished the air by his own strength kept it under his subjection.

units.sanskrit: स समुद्रान् समानीय सर्वाश् च सरितो बलात् । चकारात्मवशे वीर्याद् देहभूताश् च सिन्धवः ॥ आपः स वशगाः कृत्वा दिविजाताश् च भूमिजाः । स्थापयाम् आस जगतीं सुगुप्तां धरणीधरैः ॥ स स्वयंभूर् इवाभाति महाभूतपतिर् महान् । सर्वलोकमयो दैत्यः सर्वलोकभयावहः ॥
units.english: Having brought the rivers from the ocean by his own strength and power that demon kept them under his own control and all the seas remained there like his body. Having brought under his subjection all the rivers born in heaven and earth Kālanemi established the world well protected by the mountains. That Daitya, identical with all the worlds and a terror unto all creatures, shone there like the self-born Deity the master of all the elemental deities.

units.sanskrit: स लोकपालैकवपुश् चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहात्मवान् । पावकानिलसंघातो रराज युधि दानवः ॥
units.english: That Dānava, the one body of all the Lokpākas, indentical with the sun, moon and the planets and resembling the fire and air, began to move about in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: पारमेष्ठ्ये स्थितः स्थाने लोकानां प्रभवाप्यये । तं तुष्टुवुर् दैत्यगणा देवा इव पितामहम् ॥
units.english: When that Daitya occupied the position of Paramesthi, the source of the origin and destruction of all the worlds the demons began to chant his glories as the gods hymn the glories of the grand-father Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच पञ्च तं नाभ्यवर्तन्त विपरीतेन कर्मणा । वेदो धर्मः क्षमा सत्यं श्रीश् च नारायणाश्रया ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—On account of his irreligious actions the Vedas, virtue, forgiveness, truth and the prosperity of Narayana, these five did not follow him Kālanemi.

units.sanskrit: स तेषाम् अनुपस्थानात् सक्रोधो दानवेश्वरः । वैष्णवं पदम् अन्विच्छन् ययौ नारायणान्तिकम् ॥
units.english: Owing to the absence of the Veda and others that king of Dānavas approached Nārāyana in order to attain to his dignity.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्श सुपर्णस्थं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । दानवानां विनाशाय भ्रामयन्तं गदां शुभाम् ॥
units.english: He saw him there seated on Suparna with conch, discus and club in his hands. He was whirling a beautiful mace for the destruction of the Dānavas.

units.sanskrit: सजलाम्भोदसदृशं विद्युत्सदृशवाससम् । स्वारूढं स्वर्णपत्राढ्यं शिखिनं काश्यपं खगम् ॥
units.english: That god, having the hue of a cloud surcharged with water and wearing a raiment resembling lighting, was seated at ease on the bird the son of Kashyapa, gifted with golden wings and a tuft of down on the forepart of head.

units.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दैत्यविनाशाय रणे स्वस्थम् अवस्थितम् । दानवो विष्णुम् अक्षोभ्यं बभाषे क्षुब्धमानसः ॥
units.english: Beholding the irrepressible Vishnu stationed in battle for the destruction of the demons, Kālanemi, with a heavy heart, said:—.

units.sanskrit: अयं स रिपुर् अस्माकं पूर्वेषां दानवर्षिणाम् । अर्णवावासिनश् चैव मधोर् वै कैटभस्य च ॥ येन नः संयुगेष्व् अद्य बहवो दानवा हताः ॥ अयं स निर्घृणो युद्धे स्त्रीबालनिरपत्रपः । येन दानवनारीणां सीमन्तोद्धरणं कृतम् ॥
units.english: This is our most dreadful enemy. He is the enemy of our Dānava forefathers and that of Madhu and Kaitava living in the ocean. He has slain many of our forest-born Daityas. This man, armed with weapons, is highly ruthless in battle and extremely shameless like a boy. He had the hairs of the Dānava women shaved –.

units.sanskrit: अयं स विष्णुर् देवानां वैकुण्ठश् च दिवौकसाम् । अनन्तो भोगिनाम् अप्सु स्वयंभूश् च स्वयंभुवः ॥ अयं स नाथो देवानाम् अस्माभिर् विप्रकृष्यताम् । अस्य क्रोधं समासाद्य हिरण्यकशिपुर् हतः ॥
units.english: He is the Vishnu of the gods, the Vaikuntha of the celestials, the Ananta of the serpents living in the water and the Creator of the creators himself. He is the worshipful of the gods and is ever engaged in doing us wrong. Incurring his displeasure Hiranyakasipu was slain.

units.sanskrit: अस्य च्छायां समाश्रित्य देवा मखमुखे स्थिताः । आज्यं महर्षिभिर् दत्तम् अश्नुवन्ति त्रिधा हुतम् ॥
units.english: Following him the gods are entitled to the best portion of the sacrificial offerings and three-fold oblations are offered to fire by the great saints.

units.sanskrit: अयं स निधने हेतुः सर्वेषां दैतवद्विषाम् । अयं स किल युद्धेषु सुरार्थे त्यक्तजीवितः । सवितुस् तेजसा तुल्यं चक्रं क्षिपति शत्रुषु ॥
units.english: He is the instrument of the death of all those who are inimical towards the gods. Risking his life even for the gods it is he who hurls his discus, effulgent like the sun, at the enemies in battle.

units.sanskrit: अयं स कालो दैत्यानां कालभूते मयि स्थिते । अतिक्रान्तस्य कालस्य फलं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः ॥
units.english: This wicked-minded one is like the death unto the Daityas. Myself, resembling the very Kala himself, living, he will soon meet with inevitable death.

units.sanskrit: दिष्ट्येदानीं समक्षं मे विष्णुर् एष समागतः । अद्य मद्बाणनिष्पिष्टो मय्य् एव प्रणमिष्यति ॥ इमं नारायणं हत्वा दानवानां भयावहम् ॥ क्षिप्रम् एव वधिष्यामि रणे नारायणं शैरैः । जात्यन्तरगतो ह्य् एष मृधे बाधति दानवान् ॥
units.english: By a mere accident Vishnu has appeared before me to-day. Being grinded by me in battle he will be humiliated before me. Having slain in battle this Nārāyana, the source of fear unto the Dānavas shall worship to-day my predecessors. shall soon kill also the followers of Nārāyana. Even when born again he oppresses the Dāvanas.

units.sanskrit: एषो ऽन्तकः पुरा भूत्वा पद्मनाभ इति स्मृतः । जघानैकार्णवे घोरे ताव् उभौ मधुकैटभौ ॥ विनिवेश्य स्वके ऊरौ निहतौ दानवेश्वरौ । द्विधाभूतं वपुः कृत्वा सिंहार्धं नरसंस्थितम् । पितरं मे जघानैको हिरण्यकशिपुं पुरा ॥
units.english: In the days of yore this Ananta again became celebrated by the name of Padmanābha lotus-navelled. When the whole universe was converted into one sheet of water, he, placing the two Dānavas, Madhu and Kaitava within his knee-joints, killed them. Dividing his own body into two and assuming the form of a man-lion he, in the days of yore, killed my father Hiranyakasipu.

units.sanskrit: शुभं गर्भम् अधत्तैनम् अदितिर् देवतारणिः । यज्ञकाले बलेर् यो वै कृत्वा वामनरूपताम् । त्रींल् लोकांश् च जहारैष क्रममाणस् त्रिभिः क्रमैः ॥
units.english: Auspiciously did Aditi, the mother of gods, conceive him who, assuming the form of a dwarf at the sacrifice of the king Bali, occupied the three worlds with his foot-steps and then killed him.

units.sanskrit: भूयस् त्व् इदानीं समरे संप्राप्ते तारकामये । मया सह समागम्य सदेवो विनशिष्यति ॥
units.english: Now encountering me again in this war of Tāraka, he along with the gods, will meet with death .

units.sanskrit: स एवम् उक्त्वा बहुधा क्षिपन् नारायणं रणे । वाग्भिर् अप्रतिरूपाभिर् युद्धम् एवाभ्यरोचयत् ॥ क्षिप्यमाणो ऽसुरेन्द्रेण य चुकोप गदाधरः । क्षमाबलेन मनसा सस्मितं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥ हतस् त्वं दर्पजैर् दोषैः क्षमां यो ऽतीत्य भाषसे ॥ अधमस् त्वं मम मतो धिग् एतत् तव वाग्बलम् । न तत्र पुरुषाः सन्ति यत्र गर्जन्ति योषितः ॥
units.english: Thus villifying Nārāyana in the field of battle in various unbecoming words Kālanemi expressed his desire for fighting. Although censured by the king of Asuras Gadādhara Vishnu was not angry on account of his extraordinary forgiveness. Rather smilingly he said. Daitya, limited is thy strength, still out of anger thou art villifying me. Since thou hast transgressed forgiveness, thou shalt be slain by thy own fault. Wretched thou art indeed and fie on thy vaunting words. Men do not live where the females roar.

units.sanskrit: अहं त्वां दैत्य पश्यामि पूर्वेषां मार्गगामिनम् । प्रजापतिकृतं सेतुं को भित्त्वा स्वस्तिमान् व्रजेत् ॥
units.english: Daitya, see thou shalt follow the footsteps of thy predecessors. Disregarding the orders instituted by Prajapati who can be at ease?.

units.sanskrit: अद्य त्वां नाशयिष्यामि देवव्याघातकारिणम् । स्वेषु स्वेषु च स्थानेषु स्थापयिष्यामि देवताः ॥
units.english: shall slay thee to-day who hast disturbed the gods. And shall again place the celestials in their respective positions.

units.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवति वाक्यं तु मृधे श्रीवत्सधारिणि । जहास दानवः क्रोधाद् धस्तांश् चक्रे च सायुधान् ॥
units.english: After Nārāyana, bearing the mystic mark of Srivatsa on his breast, had said this in the battle-field, the Dānava took up the weapons in anger and began to smile.

units.sanskrit: स बाहुशतम् उद्यम्य सर्वास्त्रग्रहणं रणे । क्रोधाद् रुधिररक्ताक्षो विष्णोर् वक्षस्य् अताडयत् ॥
units.english: Uplifting his hundred arms capable of handling all the weapons, he, with eyes reddened with anger, struck at the breast of Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: दानवाश् चापि समरे मयतारपुरोगमाः । स ताड्यमानो ऽतिबलैर् दैत्यैः सर्वायुधोद्यतैः । न चचाल हरिर् युद्धे ऽकम्प्यमान इवाचलः ॥
units.english: The other Dānavas, headed by Maya and Tāra, ran towards Vishnu. Although assailed by the highly powerful Daityas armed with various weapons the lord Nārāyana remained unshaken in the battle like a mountain.

units.sanskrit: संसक्तश् च सुपर्णेन कालनेमिर् महासुरः । सर्वप्राणेन महतीं गदाम् उद्यम्य बाहुभिः । मुमोच ज्वलितां घोरां संरब्धो गरुडोपरि ॥
units.english: Being engaged in a conflict with Suparna and taking up, with all his strength, a huge and dreadful club burning with the concussion of arms, the highly enraged great Asura Kālanemi hurled it at Garuda.

units.sanskrit: कर्मणा तेन दैत्यस्य विष्णुर् विस्मयम् आगमत् । येन तस्य सुपर्णस्य पतिता मूर्ध्नि सा गदा ॥ तदागमत् पदा भूमिं पक्षी व्यथितविग्रहः । लोष्टैः सर्ष्टिशिलाभिश् च वज्रप्रहरणैस् ततः । जघ्नुस् ते समरे विष्णुं गोपालं च महारणे । भ्रमन्तं घूर्णमानं च स्तुतिं देवाः प्रचक्रिरे । जय देव महाबाहो मधुकैटभनाशन । हिरण्यकशिपोर् वक्षो नखलाङ्गलदारण । उत्तस्थौ च रणाद् विष्णुर् अमरैः संस्तुतः पुरा । हतं विष्णुं समाज्ञाय शङ्खं दध्मौ स दानवः । मृदङ्गांश् च त्रिधा तत्र वादयन्तो महासुराः । तालाश्रयाश् च ननृतुर् महोत्सव इवाबभौ । सुपर्णं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा क्षतं च वपुर् आत्मनः । क्रोधात् संरक्तनयनो वैकुण्ठश् चक्रमाददे ॥
units.english: Even Vishnu was filled with wonder seeing that feat of the Daitya. When that club fell on the head of Suparna, that king of birds, with a wounded body, fell down on earth. Thereupon in that great encounter the Dānavas began to strike Vishnu and Garuda with clods of earth, stones and thunder bolts. When Nārāyana moved about in the battle field the gods chanted his glories. Glory unto thee, thou of great arms, destroyer of Madhu and Kaitava. With thy nails thou didst tear off Hiranyakasipu. Thus eulogised by the deities Nārāyana rose up from the battle-field. Considering Vishnu slain the king of Dānavas blew his conch. The great Asuras began to play on the three sorts of Mridangas and dance in accompaniment with the music. It appeared that a great festivity was taking place at that time. Beholding Suparna wounded and his own body unscathed, Vaikuntha, with eyes reddened in anger, took up his discus –.

units.sanskrit: व्यवर्धत च वेगेन सुपर्णेन समं विभुः । भुजाश् चास्य व्यवर्धन्त व्याप्नुवन्तो दिशो दश ॥
units.english: The lord then grew highly impetuous along with Suparna. His arms multiplied covering the ten quarters.

units.sanskrit: स दिशः प्रदिशश् चैव खं च गां चैव पूरयन् । ववृधे स पुनर् लोकान् क्रान्तुकाम इवौजसा ॥
units.english: Filling up all the quarters, the etherial region and the earth he increased his energy as if being desirous of attacking again all the worlds.

units.sanskrit: ऋषयः सह गन्धर्वैस् तुष्टुवुर् मधुसूदनम् ॥ नमो ऽस्तु देवदेवेश शङ्खचक्रगदाधर । विष्णो कृष्ण हृषीकेश जहि दैत्यं महाबलम् । नमस् तुभ्यं विरूपाक्ष शंकरस्य जगत्पते । पाहि नः सकलान् अस्माञ् जहि दैत्यं महाबलम् । स द्यां किरीटेन लिखन् साभ्रम् अम्बरम् अम्बरैः । पद्भ्याम् आक्रम्य वसुधां दिशः प्रच्छाद्य बाहुभिः ॥
units.english: The Rishis, along with the Gandharvas, began to chant the glories of Madhusudana who had then assumed a huge proportion in the sky for the victory of the gods. The Lord covered the celestial region with his Kiritin, the sky and the clouds, with his raiment, the earth with his feet and all the quarters with his arms. Thereupon worked up with anger Gadādhara, taking up his discus capable of performing unparalleled feats and effulgent like the sun, destroyed with it, by virtue of his own energy, the effulgence of the Dānavas in battle and chopped off the arms of Kālanemi.

units.sanskrit: स सूर्यकरतुल्याभं सहस्रारम् अरिक्षयम् । दीप्ताग्निसदृशं घोरं दर्शनीयं सुदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: It was dreadful like the burning fire of a thousand flames resembling the rays of the sun and at the same time beautiful and covered with golden wheels.

units.sanskrit: मेदोस्थिमज्जारुधिरैः सिक्तं दानवसंभवैः ॥
units.english: It was strong like a thunder-bolt, dreadful and besmeared with the blood, fat and bones of the Dānavas.

units.sanskrit: अद्वितीयं प्रहारेषु क्षुरपर्यन्तमण्डलम् । स्रग्दाममालाविततं कामगं कामरूपिणम् ॥
units.english: It had none to equal it in the matter of striking, was sharpened like a razor, could go any where and could assume any form at will.

units.sanskrit: स्वयं स्वयंभुवा सृष्टं भयदं सर्वविद्विषाम् । महर्षिरोषैर् आविष्टं नित्यम् आहवदर्पितम् ॥
units.english: It was made by the Self-born himself, was a terror to the enemies, possessed by the anger of the great Rishis and was haughty in the battle field.

units.sanskrit: क्षेपणाद्यस्य मुह्यन्ति लोकाः सस्थाणुजंगमाः । क्रव्यादानि च भूतानि तृप्तिं यान्ति महामृधे ॥
units.english: When it is thrown, all the creatures, mobile and immobile, are stupified and creatures, living on flesh, derive greatest satisfaction –.

units.sanskrit: तच् च वक्त्रशतं घोरं साग्निचूर्णाट्टहासि यत् । तस्य दैत्यस्य चक्रेण प्रममाथ बलाद् धरिः ॥
units.english: Then with his strength Hari began to grind the hundred dreadful faces of that demon with wild laughs like the grinding of fire.

units.sanskrit: स च्छिन्नबाहुर् विशिरा न प्राकम्पत दानवः । कबन्धावस्थितः संख्ये विशाख इव पादपः ॥
units.english: Although his arms were chopped off and his heads were cut off the Dānava did not tremble the least in the battle and stood there like a tree shorn of all its branches.

units.sanskrit: तं वितत्य महापक्षौ वायोः कृत्वा समं जवम् । उरसा पातयाम् आस गरुडः कालनेमिनम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon spreading his two huge wings and assuming the velocity of the wind Garuda, with the stroke of his breast, felled down Kālanemi.

units.sanskrit: स तस्य देहो विमुखो विशाखः खात् परिभ्रमन् । निपपात दिवं त्यक्त्वा क्षोभयन् धरणीतलम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon rolling and leaving the celestial region his body, shorn of heads and arms, fell down on earth from the sky –.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् निपतिते दैत्ये देवाः सर्षिगणास् तदा । साधु साध्व् इति वैकुण्ठं समेताः प्रत्यपूजयन् ॥
units.english: When that Daitya was killed the Rishis, together with the gods, began to praise Vaikuntha saying Well done! Well done!.

units.sanskrit: अपरे ये तु दैत्या वै युद्धे दृष्टपराक्रमाः । ते सर्वे बाहुभिर् व्याप्ता न शेकुश् चलितुं रणे ॥
units.english: The other Daityas, who were witnessing his prowess in battle, were hemmed in by the arms of Vishnu and could not move in the field.

units.sanskrit: कांश्चित् केशेषु जग्राह कांश्चित् कण्ठे न्यपीडयत् । ते गदाचक्रनिर्दग्धा गतसत्त्वा गतासवः । गगनाद् भ्रष्टसर्वाङ्गा निपेतुर् धरणीतले ॥ तेषु सर्वेषु दैत्येषु हतेषु पुरुषोत्तमः । तस्थौ शक्रप्रियं कृत्वा कृतकर्मा गदाधरः ॥
units.english: The Lord held some Daityas by the hair, held some by the throat, wounded some on the face and took up some by the waist. Entirely destroyed by the club and discus and deprived of their energy and life they fell down on earth from the sky. After all the Daityas had been slain, that foremost of Purushas Gadadhara, scoring success, stood there doing good to the king of gods.

units.sanskrit: तं देशम् आजगामाशु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ॥ सर्वैर् ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सार्धं गन्धर्वैः साप्सरोगणैः । देवदेवो हरिं देवं पूजयन् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: After the termination of that dreadful war with Tāraka where many had been grinded the grand-father of all, Brahmā speedily came there along with all the Brāhmana saints, Gandharvas and Apsarās. Worshipping Hari the god of gods said –.

units.sanskrit: कृतं देव महत्कर्म सुराणां शल्यम् उद्धृतम् । वधेनानेन दैत्यानां वयं च परितोषिताः ॥
units.english: Brahma said:— lord, thou hast accomplished a great work; the dart of the celestials has been uprooted. By the destruction of the Daityas we have been pleased.

units.sanskrit: यो ऽयं त्वया हतो विष्णो कालनेमिर् महासुरः । त्वम् एको ऽस्य मृधे हन्ता नान्यः कश्चन विद्यते ॥
units.english: Thou alone art the only destroyer of this Kālanemi whom thou hast just slain in battle. Save thee there is none else who could kill him.

units.sanskrit: एष देवान् परिभवंल् लोकांश् च सचराचरान् । ऋषीणां कदनं कृत्वा माम् अपि प्रतिगर्जति ॥
units.english: Vanquishing the gods and all the creatures mobile and immobile this Dānava used to assail the Rishis; even he used to roar at me.

units.sanskrit: तद् अनेन तवोग्रेण परितुष्टो ऽस्मि कर्मणा । यद् अयं कालतुल्याभः कालनेमिर् निपातितः ॥
units.english: Therefore by this thy powerful feat have been greatly pleased, since thou hast destroyed this death-like Kālanemi.

units.sanskrit: तदागच्छस्व भद्रं ते गच्छाम दिवम् उत्तमम् । ब्रह्मर्षयस् त्वां तत्रस्थाः प्रतीक्षन्ते सदोगताः ॥
units.english: Mayst thou fare well; let us now repair to the most excellent celestial region, where the Brāhmana saints, the members of thy court, are waiting for thee.

units.sanskrit: अहं महर्षयश् चैव तत्र त्वां वदतां वर । विधिवच् चार्चयिष्यन्ति गीर्भिर् दिव्याभिर् अच्युत । किं चाहं तव दास्यामि वरं वरभृतां वर । सुरेष्व् अपि सदैत्येषु वराणां वरदो भवान् ॥
units.english: Achyuta, foremost of speakers, shall worship thee there along with the Maharshis with heavenly hymns. thou the foremost of boon givers, although thou dost confer boons on the celestials and Daityas shall bestow one on thee.

units.sanskrit: निर्यातयैतत् त्रैलोक्यं स्फीतं निहतकण्टकम् । अस्मिन्न् एव मृधे विष्णो शक्राय सुमहात्मने ॥
units.english: Nārāyana, in this war thou hast freed the three worlds of the thorns and therefore do thou now confer upon the high-souled Sakra the prosperous kingdom over the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो भगवता ब्रह्मणा हरिर् ईश्वरः । देवाञ् शक्रमुखान् सर्वान् उवाच शुभया गिरा ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by the Divine Brahmā, the Lord Hari said to Indra and other gods in auspicious words.

units.sanskrit: श्रवणावहितैर् देवैः पुरस्कृत्य पुरंदरम् ॥
units.english: Listen attentively, all ye gods headed by Purandara, who have assembled here.

units.sanskrit: अस्मिन् नः समरे सर्वे कालनेमिमुखा हताः । दानवा विक्रमोपेताः शक्राद् अपि महत्तराः ॥
units.english: We have slain, in this battle, many powerful Danavas, Kalnemi and others, who are superior even to the king of gods himself.

units.sanskrit: वैरोचनिश् च दैत्येन्द्रः स्वर्भानुश् च महाग्रहः ॥ तद् इष्टां भजतां शक्रो दिशं वरुण एव च । याम्यां यमः पालयताम् उत्तरां च धनाधिपः ॥
units.english: In this terrible encounter came out both Virochana's son Bali and the huge-bodied Rāhu. Let now the king of gods and Varuna repair to their wished-for regions. Let Yama occupy the south and the king of riches protect the north.

units.sanskrit: ऋक्षैः सह यथायोगं कालं चरतु चन्द्रमाः । अब्दं ह्य् ऋतुमुखं सूर्यो भजताम् अयनैः सह ॥
units.english: As before let the noon be united with the stars in proper season. Let the sun, being united with equinoctial points, distribute the seasons all through the year.

units.sanskrit: आज्यभागाः प्रवर्तन्तां सदस्यैर् अभिपूजिताः । हूयन्ताम् अग्नयो विप्रैर् वेददृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Let sacrifices be duly undertaken honoured by the ascetic courtiers and let the Vipras, according to the rituals laid down in the Vedas, offer oblations to fire.

units.sanskrit: देवाश् च बलिहोमेन स्वाध्यायेन महर्षयः । श्राद्धेन पितरश् चैव तृप्तिं यान्तु यथासुखम् ॥
units.english: Let the gods attain gratification from Vali oblations, the Maharshis from the chanting of the Vedas and the ancestral manes from the performance of Srādhas as before.

units.sanskrit: वायुश् चरतु मार्गस्थस् त्रिधा दीप्यतु पावकः । त्रयो वर्णाश् च लोकांस् त्रींस् तर्पयन्त्व् आत्मजैर् गुणैः ॥
units.english: Let the wind blow in its own course, let the fire be enkindled in its three-fold forms, and let the three Varnas, by their natural qualities, bring about the gratification of the world.

units.sanskrit: क्रतवः संप्रवर्तन्तां दीक्षणीयैर् द्विजातिभिः । दक्षिणाश् चापि वर्तन्तां यथोक्तं सर्वसत्रिणाम् ॥
units.english: Let sacrifices be undertaken by the Brāhmanas who are worthy of performing initiatory rites and let all the proper sacrificial gifts be distributed.

units.sanskrit: गाश् च सूर्यो रसान् सोमो वायुः प्राणांश् च प्राणिषु । तर्पयन्तः प्रवर्तन्तां शिवैः सौम्यैश् च कर्मभिः ॥
units.english: Let the sun afford gratification to all the eyes and let the moon afford delight to all the juices and let the air delight the vital breaths of all creatures, and let them all undertake good and auspicious works.

units.sanskrit: यथावद् अनुपूर्वेण महेन्द्र सलिलोद्वहाः । त्रैलोक्यमातरः सर्वाः सागरं यान्तु निम्नगाः ॥
units.english: Let the rivers, carrying water from the huge mountains and, the mother of the three worlds, gradually in proper order, proceed to the ocean.

units.sanskrit: दैत्येभ्यस् त्यज्यतां भीतिः शान्तिं व्रजत देवताः । स्वस्ति वो ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ॥
units.english: Let the gods cast off all fear of the Dānavas and let them enjoy peace. May you fare well, ye gods, repair to the eternal region of Brahmā.

units.sanskrit: स्वगृहे स्वर्गलोके वा संग्रामे वा विशेषतः । विस्रम्भो वो न गन्तव्यो नित्यं क्षुद्रा हि दानवाः ॥
units.english: Do not live always confidently in your celestial region and specially in the battle-field for the demons are highly deceitful.

units.sanskrit: छिद्रेषु प्रहरन्त्य् एते न चैषां संस्थितिर् ध्रुवा । अहं तु दुष्टभावानां युष्मासु सुदुरात्मनाम् । असम्यग् वर्तमानानां मोहं दास्यामि देवताः । यदा च सुदुराधर्षं दानवेभ्यो भयं भवेत् । तदा समुपगम्याशु विधास्ये वस् ततो ऽभयम् । एवम् उक्त्वा सुरगणान् विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । जगाम ब्रह्मणा सार्धं ब्रह्मलोकं महायशाः ॥
units.english: They strike people as soon as they find a weak point. This order of the world is not permanent. You are all gentle and simple and your mind always moves in innocent matters. gods, bring about the stupefaction of all these wicked demons who cherish a desire of injuring you. Whenever you will cherish a dreadful fear of the Dānavas will immediately come and promise you safety. Having thus addressed the gods the highly illustrious Nārāyana, having truth for his prowess, repaired with Brahmā to his own region.

units.sanskrit: एतद् आश्चर्यम् अभवत् संग्रामे तारकामये । दानवानां च विष्णोश् च यन् मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥
units.english: This was the wonderful encounter, of which you asked, of Nārayana and the Dānavas in the war of which Tāraka was the root.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच शृणु नारायणस्यादौ विस्तरेण प्रवृत्तयः । कामं तस्य गतिः सूक्ष्मा देवैर् अपि दुरानुगा । यत् तु शक्ष्याम्य् अहं वक्तुं तन् मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hear now at length of the deeds of Nārāyana before you listen to how he sported with Brahmā after repairing to his region. His course is very subtle according to his desire which even the gods cannot know. Hear, king, what shall relate.

units.sanskrit: एष लोकमयो देवो लोकाश् चैतन् मयास्त्रयः । एष देवमयश् चैव देवाश् चैतन् मया दिवि ॥
units.english: This Lord Nārāyana is identical with the three worlds and the three worlds too are also permeated by him. He is identical with the gods in heaven and they too are identical with him.

units.sanskrit: अस्य पारं न पश्यन्ति बहवः पारतन्त्रिणः । एष पारं परं चैव लोकानां वेद माधवः ॥
units.english: Many persons, desirous of going to the other end of the world, cannot see his end. This Mādhava is the end of all.

units.sanskrit: शृणु वै यत् तदा वृत्तं ब्रह्मलोके पुरातनम् ॥ स गत्वा ब्रह्मणो लोकं दृष्ट्वा पैतामहं पदम् । ववन्दे तान् ऋषीन् सर्वान् विष्णुर् आर्षेण कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Hear of an account of his deeds in the Brahmaloka in the days of yore whose true form is hidden by the senses as if with darkness and whom the gods seek, Repairing to the region of Brahmā and beholding the dignity of the Grand-Father Vishnu honored all the Rishis with works sanctioned by the Vedas.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽग्निं प्राक् सवने दृष्ट्वा हूयमानं महर्षिभिः । अवन्दत महातेजाः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं विधिम् ॥
units.english: Having performed the rites of the first part of the day the highly energetic Vishnu came to the fire where oblations were being offered in the morning by the great Rishis.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्श मखेष्व् आज्यैर् इज्यमानं महर्षिभिः । भागं यज्ञियम् अश्नानं स्वदेहम् अपरं स्थितम् ॥
units.english: He saw his own body most excellently placed in the midst of the sacrifice, worshipped with oblations by the great Rishis and eating his own share of the sacrificial offerings.

units.sanskrit: अभिवाद्याभिवाद्यानाम् ऋषीणां ब्रह्मवर्चसाम् । परिचक्राम सो ऽचिन्त्यो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ॥
units.english: Having saluted the worshipful Rishis of Brahma energy Nārāyana, who is beyond the comprehension of thought, began to range in the eternal Brahma region.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्शोच्छ्रितान् यूपांश् चषालाग्रविभूषितान् । मखेषु च ब्रह्मर्षिभिः शतशः कृतलक्षणान् ॥
units.english: Walking there in the sacrifice he saw hundreds of sacrificial posts adorned with the tops of Chashālas and marked by the Brāhmana saints.

units.sanskrit: आज्यधूमं समाघ्राय शृण्वन् वेदान् द्विजेरितान् । यज्ञैर् इज्यन्तम् आत्मानम् पश्यंस् तत्र चचार ह ॥
units.english: Smelling the smoke of oblations, hearing the sound of the chanting of the Vedas by the twice-born ones, and beholding his own self worshipped in the shape of a sacrifice he began to range there.

units.sanskrit: तम् ऊचुर् ऋषयो देवाः सदस्याः सदसि स्थिताः । अर्घ्योद्यतभुजाः सर्वे पवित्रान् तरिताननाः ॥ स्वागतं ते सुरश्रेष्ठ पद्मनाभ महाद्युते । नमो ऽस्तु ते हृषीकेश मधुकैटभसूदन । दामोदर नमस् ते ऽस्तु पद्मपत्रायतेक्षण ॥
units.english: Taking the sacred grass and Arghya in their hands the courtier deities and the Rishis said to him :—Whatever power exists in the gods it emanates from Nārāyana and whatever is undertaken by the deities that also proceeds from Madhusudana. As curd is produced from milk and clarified butter from curd so when the body and senses are agitated by virtue of meditation the world originates from Janārddana.

units.sanskrit: प्रभुस् त्वं सर्वदेवानां लोकानां प्रभुर् अव्ययः । त्वं यज्ञस् त्वं वषट्कारस् त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् । इदं यज्ञियम् आतिथ्यं मन्त्रतः प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥
units.english: As the great soul is comprehended by the senses and the five great elements so Hari is comprehended by the gods, the Vedas and all the worlds. This independent and highly sacred Nārāyana, who is the thread of the worlds and who confers fruits of sacrifices on those who perform them, is worshipped with Mantras like Mantra itself.

units.sanskrit: त्वम् अस्य यज्ञपूतस्य पात्रं पाद्यस्य पावनः । अतिथिस् त्वं हि मन्त्रोक्तः स दृष्टः सततं मतः ॥
units.english: Thou art the sacred vessel of this water sanctified in the sacrifice. Thou wert always known as the guest mentioned in the Mantras and hast now become visible.

units.sanskrit: त्वयि योद्धु गते विष्णो न प्रावर्तन्त नः क्रियाः । अवैष्णवस्य यज्ञस्य न हि कर्म विधीयते ॥
units.english: Nārāyana, after thy departure to the battle-field, our works were not undertaken, for a sacrifice, without Vishnu, is never sanctioned.

units.sanskrit: सदक्षिणस्य यज्ञस्य त्वत्प्रसूतं फलं भवेत् । यद्य् आत्मानम् इहास्माभिर् इज्यमानं निरीक्षसे ॥ एवम् अस्त्व् इति तान् विप्रान् भगवान् प्रत्यपूजयत् । मुमुदे ब्रह्मलोकस्थो ब्रह्मैव हि पितामहः ॥
units.english: To-day we will acquire the fruit of the sacrifice celebrated with presents. Thou art beholding thyself worshipped by us all. Saying So be it the Lord, in return, worshipped the Brāhmanas. The Grand-father Brahmā who was in his region, was delighted thereat.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ऋषिभिः पूजितस् तैस् तु विवेश हरिर् ईश्वरः । पौराणं ब्रह्मसदनं दिव्यं नारायणाश्रमम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Having been thus worshipped by the Rishis the Lord entered into the celestial habitation of Brahmā, the hermitage of Nārāyana as described in the Puranas.

units.sanskrit: स तत्र विविशे हृष्टस् तान् आमन्त्र्य सदोगतान् । प्रणम्य चादिदेवाय ब्रह्मणे पद्मयोनये ॥
units.english: Having honored delightedly all those Rishis and bowed unto the Prime Deity the Lotus-sprung Brahmā he entered into the region mentioned before.

units.sanskrit: स्वेन नाम्ना परिज्ञातं स तं नारायणाश्रमम् । प्रविशन्न् एव भगवान् आयुधानि व्यसर्जयत् ॥ स तत्राम्बुपतिप्रख्यं ददर्शालयम् आत्मनः । संवर्तकाम्बुदोपेतं नक्षत्रस्थानसंकुलम् । तिमिरौघपरिक्षिप्तम् अप्रधृष्यं सुरासुरैः ॥
units.english: Having entered the Narayana hermitage which was so named after Him the Lord left off all his weapons. He saw there his own abode resembling an ocean, filled with the gods and the immortal Rishis. That abode was covered with Samvartaka and other clouds, enshrouded with the darkness of the starry region and was beyond the reach of the gods and demons.

units.sanskrit: न तत्र विषयो वायोर् नेन्दोर् नापि विवस्वतः । वपुषा पद्मनाभस्य स देशस् तेजसा वृतः ॥
units.english: There the winds do not blow and the sun and the moon do not shine. It was enveloped with the effulgence of the body of the Lotus-navelled Deity.

units.sanskrit: स तत्र प्रविशन्न् एव जटाभारं समुद्वहन् । स सहस्रशिरा भूत्वा शयनायोपचक्रमे ॥
units.english: Entering there, carrying matted locks and being thousand-headed the Lord began to make arrangements for lying down.

units.sanskrit: उपतस्थे महात्मानं निद्रा तं कालरूपिणी ॥ विश्वस्य जगतः प्रभुम् । स शिश्ये शयने दिव्ये समुद्राम्भोदशीतले । हरिर् एकार्णवोक्तेन व्रतेन व्रतिनां वरः ॥
units.english: The death-like sleep, having dark eyes and being informed of the last days of men, appeared before that high-sould deity. On account of his acquiring a mastery over his senses, Hari, the foremost of those observant of vows, laid himself on a celestial bed cool like the water of the Ocean.

units.sanskrit: उपासां चक्रिरे विष्णुं देवाः सर्षिगणास् तदा ॥
units.english: The Rishis and the Gods began to worship the great Omnipotent Vishnu, thus gone to sleep for the creation of the universe.

units.sanskrit: तस्य सुप्तस्य शुशुभे नाभिमध्यात् समुत्थितम् । आद्यस्य सदनं पद्मं ब्रह्मणः सूर्यसंनिभम् ॥
units.english: When he was asleep there sprang from his navel a lotus, highly effulgent like the sun intended for the seat of the Patriarch Brahmā, who is both the beginning and the end.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रपत्रं वर्णाढ्यं सुकुमारं विभूषितम् । ब्रह्मसूत्रोद्यतकरः स्वपन्न् एव महामुनिः । आवर्तयति लोकानां सर्वेषां कालपर्ययम् ॥ विवृतात् तस्य वदनान् निःश्वासपवनेरिताः । प्रजानां पङ्क्तयो ह्य् ओघैर् निष्पतन्ति विशन्ति च ॥
units.english: That lotus had a thousand petals, a beautiful hue, was tender and well-adorned. Raising up his hand which is the thread of the pristine desire the great Muni Brahmā whirls the wheel of the changes of all the worlds brought about by time. From his mouth the Patriarchs come out shaken by the wind of his breath. Sometimes they fall down and sometimes they go up.

units.sanskrit: ते सृष्टाः प्राणिनाम् ओघा विभक्ता ब्रह्मणा स्वयम् । चतुर्धा स्वां गतिं जग्मुः कृतान्तोक्तेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: Human beings, thus created by him, are again divided by Brahmā into four orders. And then by performing works laid down in the Vedas they reach their respective goals.

units.sanskrit: न तं वेद स्वयं ब्रह्मा नापि ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽव्ययाः । विष्णुं निद्रामयं योगं प्रविष्टं तमसावृतम् ॥
units.english: Even Brahmā himself and the immortal Rishis cannot understand Vishnu, thus engaged in the Yoga of sleep and covered with Tamas.

units.sanskrit: ते तु ब्रह्मर्षयः सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमाः । न विदुस् तं क्वचित् सुप्तं क्वचिद् आसीनम् आसने ॥
units.english: Those Brāhmana saints, headed by the Grand-father, cannot find out when Nārāyana is asleep and when he does sit up on his bed.

units.sanskrit: जागर्ति को ऽत्र कः शेते कः श्वसन् कश् च नेङ्गते । को भोगवान् को द्युतिमान् कृष्णात् कृष्णतरश् च कः ॥ विमृशन्ति स्म तं देवं दिव्याभिर् उपपत्तिभिः । न चैनं शेकुर् अन्वेष्टुं कर्मतो जन्मतो ऽपि वा ॥
units.english: Who is awake in this body? Who is asleep? Who, being capable, does not perform a work? Who enjoys the various objects of pleasure? Who is effulgent? And who is subtler than the subtle itself ? By the various arguments laid down in Srutis the Rishis seek to find out His existence. By birth or action none can find Him out.

units.sanskrit: कथाभिस् तत्प्रदिष्टाभिर् ये तस्य चरितं विदुः । पुराणं तं पुराणेषु ऋषयः संप्रचक्षते ॥
units.english: The ancient Rishis have sung his glories in the Purānas and his history can be known by the songs composed by him.

units.sanskrit: श्रूयते चास्य चरितं देवेष्व् अपि पुरातनम् । महापुराणात् प्रभृति परं तस्य न विद्यते ॥
units.english: His ancient history is also heard amongst the gods. After the great Purānas there exists no other record of his doings.

units.sanskrit: यच् चास्य वेद वेदो ऽपि चरितं स्वप्रभावजम् । तेनेमाः श्रुतयो व्याप्ता वैदिका लौकिकाश् च याः ॥ भवकाले भवत्य् एष लोकानां भूतभावनः । दानवानाम् अभावाय जागर्ति मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: All the Srutis, relating to the Vedas and the customs and practices of mankind, are filled with an account of the prowess of that god of gods. The Lord, the origin of all creatures, appears at the time of the creation of all the worlds. And Madhusudana remains awake for the destruction of the Dānavas.

units.sanskrit: यदैनं वीक्षितुं देवा न शेकुः सुप्तम् अच्युतम् । ततः स्वपिति घर्मान्ते जागर्ति जलदक्षये ॥
units.english: When this immortal Purusha goes to sleep even the gods cannot look at him. He goes to sleep at the end of the summer and awakes after the termination of the rains.

units.sanskrit: स हि यज्ञाश् च वेदाश् च यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वशः । या तु यज्ञगतिः प्रोक्ता स एष पुरुषोत्तमः । तस्मिन् सुप्ते न वर्तन्ते मन्त्रपूताः क्रतुक्रियाः । शरत्प्रवृत्तयज्ञो हि जागर्ति मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: He is identical with the Vedas, the sacrifices and various other supplementary rites. This foremost of Purushas is the course of the sacrifices that has been described. When he falls asleep all the sacrifices, sanctified by Mantras, are brought to a close. And Madhusudana rises up when the autumnal sacrifices are undertaken.

units.sanskrit: वैष्णवं कर्म कुर्वाणः सुप्ते विष्णौ पुरंदरः ॥
units.english: When Vishnu goes to sleep, Purandara, the lord of waters, performs all his duties and pours water.

units.sanskrit: या ह्य् एषा गह्वरी माया निद्रेति जगति स्थिता । अकस्माद् द्वेषिणी घोरा कालरात्रिर् महीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: The illusion of darkness, sleep, that exists in the world and that is like a night of death to the kings, brings ruination upon them who kill one another by fighting.

units.sanskrit: अस्यास् तनुस् तमोद्वारा निशादिवसनाशिनी । जीवितार्धहरी घोरा सर्वप्राणभृतां भुवि ॥ नैतया कश्चिद् आविष्टो जृम्भमाणो मुहुर् मुहुः । शक्तः प्रसहितुं वेगं मज्जन्न् इव महार्णवे ॥ नैशा भवति लोकस्य निद्रा सर्वस्य लौकिकी ॥ स्वप्नान्ते क्षीयते ह्य् एषा प्रायशो भुवि देहिनाम् । मृत्युकाले च भूतानां प्राणान् नाशयते भृशम् ॥
units.english: By its body of darkness it destroys the nights and days. And this dreadful illusion pilfers half of the life of all creatures in the world. Being possessed by this sleep and yawning repeatedly some people cannot bear its power as if they are almost drowned in a vast ocean. This sleep, engendered by the food or toil of the mortals in this world, does not conduce to the well-being of all. It grows enfeebled after the termination of the dream of creatures in this world; and this, at the time of their death, destroys all their vital airs.

units.sanskrit: देवेष्व् अपि दधारैनां नान्यो नारायणाद् ऋते । सखी सर्वहरस्यैषा माया विष्णुशरीरजा ॥
units.english: Amongst the gods, none, but Nārāyana, can withstand the power of this sleep. This Māyā or illusion is the female companion, begotten by his own body, of Vishnu who destroys all.
