units.sanskrit: सैषा नारायणमुखे दृष्टा कमललोचना । लोकान् अल्पेन कालेन भजते भूतमोहिनी ॥ एवम् एषा हितार्थाय लोकानां कृष्णवर्त्मना । ध्रियते सेवनीयेन पतिनेव पतिव्रता ॥
units.english: That one, of lotus eyes, was seen on the face of Nārāyanā. This one, who stupifies all the creatures, eats up all the worlds in no time. For the behoof of mankind she is kept by Vishnu. She is adored of all as a chaste lady serves her husband.

units.sanskrit: स तया निद्रया छन्नस् तस्मिन् नारायणाश्रमे । शेते स्म हि तदा विष्णुर् मोहयञ् जगद् अव्ययः ॥
units.english: Being possessed by this sleep and having stupified the eternal world the Lord Vishnu slept in the Nārāyana hermitage.

units.sanskrit: तस्य वर्षसहस्राणि शयानस्य महात्मनः । जग्मुः कृतयुगं चैव त्रेता चैव युगोत्तमम् ॥
units.english: When that high-souled deity was thus asleep thousands of years passed away with the most excellent of cycles Satya and Tretā.

units.sanskrit: स तु द्वापरपर्यन्ते दृष्ट्वा लोकान् सुदुःखितान् । प्राबुध्यत महातेजाः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः ॥
units.english: That highly effulgent deity awoke at the close of the Dwāpara Yuga, when the great saints, on witnessing the distress of mankind, began to chant his glories.

units.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः जहीहि निद्रां सहजां भुक्तपूर्वाम् इव स्रजम् । इमे ते ब्रह्मणा सार्धं देवा दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
units.english: The Rishis said:— lord, do thou cast off this sleep begotten of thy own self as a garland, already enjoyed, is left off. All the gods, along with Brahmā, are waiting to see thee.

units.sanskrit: इमे त्वां ब्रह्मविदुषो ब्रह्मसंस्तववादिनः । वर्धयन्ति हृषीकेश ऋषयः संशितव्रताः ॥
units.english: Hrishikesha, all these self-controlled Rishis, well-versed in the knowledge of Brahman, and in singing His glories, are welcoming thee.

units.sanskrit: शृणु विष्णो शुभां वाचं भूव्योमाग्न्यनिलाम्भसाम् ॥
units.english: Vishnu, hear the auspicious words of these Rishis who are identical with the five elements, namely, the earth, ether, fire, air and water.

units.sanskrit: इमे त्वा सप्त मुनयः सहिता मुनिमण्डलैः । स्तुवन्ति देव दिव्याभिर् गेयाभिर् गीर्भिर् अञ्जसा ॥
units.english: gods, the seven Rishis, along with all these saints, are chanting with celestial and becoming hymns thy glories.

units.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ शतपत्राक्ष पद्मनाभ महाद्युते । कारणं किंचिद् उत्पन्नं देवानां कार्यगौरवात् ॥
units.english: Rise up, thou of great effulgence, thou having a navel of a lotus of a hundred petals, some important work of the gods requires thee.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच स संक्षिप्य जगत् सर्वं तिमिरौघं विदारयन् । उदतिष्ठद् धृषीकेशः श्रिया परमया ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having lessened the quantity of water and dispelled darkness Hrishikesha rose up shining in his great beauty.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्श सुरान् सर्वान् समेतान् सपितामहान् । विवक्षतः प्रक्षुभिताञ् जगदर्थे समागतान् ॥
units.english: He saw there all the gods assembled along with the Grand-Father, greatly aggrieved for the world and desirous of speaking something to him.

units.sanskrit: तान् उवाच हरिर् देवान् निद्राविश्रान्तलोचनः । तत्त्वदृष्टार्थया वाचा धर्महेत्वर्थयुक्तया ॥
units.english: The Lord Nārāyana, with eyes relieved of exhaustion by sleep, addressed to them words fraught with sound reasoning and far-sightedness.

units.sanskrit: कुतो वो विग्रहो देवाः कुतो वो भयम् आगतम् । कस्य वा केन वा कार्यं किं वा मयि न वर्तते ॥ न खल्व् अकुशलं लोके वर्तते दानवोत्थितम् । नृणाम् आयासजननं शीघ्रम् इच्छामि वेदितुम् ॥
units.english: Vishnu said:—Where have you got your quarrel, gods? From whom does your fear proceed? Who feels a necessity and for what? And haw can help you ? Has any calamity befallen the world through the Dānavas? Have men met with any misfortune on account of their weakness? wish to know all this without any delay.

units.sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मविदां मध्ये विहाय शयनोत्तमम् । वैशंपायन उवाच तच् छ्रुत्वा विष्णुगदितं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । उवाच परमं वाक्यं हितं सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥
units.english: Having renounced my most excellent bed stand amongst the Brahmavādins for encompassing your well-being. What can do for you ? Vaishampayana said:—Hearing these words of Vishnu, Brahmā, the Grand-Father of all, gave vent to words fraught with the well-being of gods.

units.sanskrit: नास्ति किंचिद् भयं विष्णो सुराणाम् असुरान्तक । येषां भवान् अभयदः कर्णधारो रणे रणे ॥
units.english: There is no fear, from the Asuras, of the gods whom you give protection by becoming their leader in various battles.

units.sanskrit: शक्रे जयति देवेशे त्वयि चासुरसूदने । धर्मे प्रयतमानानां मानवानां कुतो भयम् ॥ सत्ये धर्मे च निरता मानवा विगतज्वराः । नाकालधर्मणा मृत्युः शक्नोति प्रसमीक्षितुम् ॥
units.english: When you yourself, the slayer of your enemies, and the king of gods, are crowned with victory, what fear do men, engaged in religious observances, cherish ? Truthful and pious men are always freed from ills. Death cannot prematurely visit the pious.

units.sanskrit: षड्भागम् उपयुञ्जाना न भेदं कुर्वते मिथः ॥
units.english: Enjoying their sixth portion, the kings, the foremost of men, do not fear one another.

units.sanskrit: ते प्रजानां शुभकराः करदैर् अविगर्हिताः । अकरैर् विप्रयुक्तार्थाः कोशम् आपूरयन् सदा ॥
units.english: Doing good to their subjects and realizing duly tributes from their tributary kings without being blamed by them, they fill up their treasuries with wealth.

units.sanskrit: अतीक्ष्णद् अण्डाश् चतुरो वर्णाञ् जुगुपुर् अञ्जसा ॥ नोद्वेजनीया भूतानां सचिवैः साधु पूजिताः । चतुरङ्गबलैर् युक्ताः षड्गुणान् उपयुञ्जते ॥ धनुर्वेदपराः सर्वे सर्वे वेदेषु निष्ठिताः । यजन्ति च यथाकालं यज्ञैर् विपुलदक्षिणैः ॥
units.english: Meting out mild punishment and being forbearing they govern their respective prosperous provinces and protect the four Varnas. Without creating disturbance amongst their subjects and being adored well by their ministers and protected by the four divisions of army they are enjoying the six means. They are all well-versed in the science of archery, observant of the Vedic rites and they all worship the gods with sacrifices accompanied by profuse gifts.

units.sanskrit: वेदान् अधीत्य दीक्षाभिर् महर्षीन् ब्रह्मचर्यया । श्राद्धैश् च मेध्यैः शतशस् तर्पयन्ति पितामहान् ॥
units.english: Having performed the ceremony of initiation and studied the Vedas they propitiate the great saints with chastity in thought, words and deeds and the ancestral manes, hundreds of times, with holy Srāddhas.

units.sanskrit: वैदिकं लौकिकं चैव धर्मशास्त्रोक्तम् एव च ॥
units.english: There is no such object in the world, Vedic, customary, and scriptural that is not known to them.

units.sanskrit: ते परावरदृष्टार्था महर्षिसमतेजसः । भूयः कृतयुगं कर्तुम् उत्सहन्ते नराधिपाः ॥
units.english: Believing in the great Brahman, all those kings, effulgent like the great Rishis, are endeavouring to bring back the golden age.

units.sanskrit: तेषाम् एव प्रभावेन शिवं वर्षति वासवः । यथार्थं च ववुर् वाता विरजस्का दिशो दश ॥ निर्मलं चाभवद् व्योम ... । निरुत्पाता च वसुधा सुप्रचाराश् च वै ग्रहाः । चन्द्रमाश् च सनक्षत्रः सौम्यं चरति योगतः ॥ अनुलोमकरः सूर्यो अयने द्वे चचार ह । हव्यैश् च विविधैस् तृप्तः शुभगन्धो हुताशनः ॥
units.english: By their power Vāsava is pouring good showers, and the winds, with dust removed, are duly blowing in the ten quarters. The earth is freed of all the evil portends and the planets are ranging at ease in the sky. United with the stars the moon is beautifully moving about in the sky. The sun, that produces regular successions, is moving in its two paths. Being propitiated by various oblations the fire has become sweet scented.

units.sanskrit: एवं सम्यक्प्रवृत्तेषु निवृत्तेष्व् अपराधतः । तर्पयत्सु महीं कृत्स्नां नृणां कालभयं कुतः ॥
units.english: The sacrifices being thus duly undertaken and multiplied the entire world is propitiated and men cherish no fear of death.

units.sanskrit: तेषां ज्वलितकीर्तीनाम् अन्योन्यम् अनुवर्तिनाम् । राज्ञां बलैर् बलवतां पीड्यते वसुधातलम् ॥ सेयं भारपरिश्रान्ता पीड्यमाना नराधिपैः । पृथिवी समनुप्राप्ता नौर् इवासन्न् अविप्लवा ॥
units.english: The earth has been oppressed by the power of those powerful kings of brilliant fame following one another. The earth, exhausted with this weight and assailed by the kings, has come before us like a boat on the verge of being drowned. Oppressed by the kings resembling the fire of dissolution and having the mountains shaken and the oceans agitated the earth is repeatedly perspiring.

units.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां वपुर्भिश् च तेजसा च बलेन च । पुरे पुरे नरपतिः कोटिसंख्यैर् बलैर् वृतः । राष्ट्रे राष्ट्रे च बहवो ग्रामाः शतसहस्रशः ॥ भूमिपानां सहस्रैश् च तेषां च बलिनां बलैः । सेयं निरामिषं कृत्वा निश्चेष्टं कालम् अग्रतः । प्राप्ता ममालयं विष्णो भवांश् चास्याः परा गतिः ॥
units.english: With the body, energy, strength and the extensive territories of the Kshatriyas the earth is ever enjoying peace. In every city the king is surrounded by ten millions of soldiers; in every kingdom, hundreds and thousands of villages are growing prosperous and the earth has been completely covered with thousands of kings, their powerful army and millions of villages -. Placing before her the Time, freed of all diseases and being shorn of energy the Earth has come to my house. Vishnu, thou art her most excellent refuge.

units.sanskrit: कर्मभूमिर् इहस्थानां भूमिर् एषा व्यथां गता । यथा न सीदेत् तत्कार्यं जगत्य् एषा हि शाश्वती ॥
units.english: This Earth, the land of human actions, has been greatly assailed. It behoves thee to do that by which the eternal Earth, the stay of the universe, may not suffer deterioration.

units.sanskrit: अस्या हि पीडने दोषो महान् स्यान् मधुसूदन । क्रियालोपश् च लोकानां दूषितं च जगद् भवेत् ॥
units.english: Madhusudana, great is the iniquity in oppressing her, since on her being assailed all the works of the humanity will come to a close and the universe will fare ill.

units.sanskrit: श्राम्यते व्यक्तम् एवेयं पार्थिवौघप्रपीडिता । सहजां या क्षमां त्यक्त्वा चलत्वम् अचला गता ॥
units.english: Being oppressed by the kings the earth has become evidently exhausted. Renouncing her firmness and natural forbearance she has grown impatient.

units.sanskrit: तद् अस्याः श्रुतवन्तः स्म तच् चापि भवता श्रुतम् । भारावतरणार्थं हि मन्त्रयामस् त्वया सह ॥
units.english: We have heard her history. Thou hast listened to it also. We shall therefore consult with thee for relieving her of her load.

units.sanskrit: सत्पथे हि स्थिताः सर्वे राजानो राष्ट्रवर्धनाः । नराणां च त्रयो वर्णा ब्राह्मणान् अनुयायिनः ॥
units.english: Wending righteous ways all these kings are multiplying their territories. Amongst men the three other Varna are following the Brāhmanas.

units.sanskrit: सर्वं सत्यमयं वाक्यं वर्णा धर्मपरास् तथा । सर्वे वेदपरा विप्राः सर्वे विप्रपरा नराः ॥
units.english: All the words are truthful, all the Varnas are observing their respective duties, all the Brāhmanas are studying the Vedas and all other men are devoted to Brāhmanas.

units.sanskrit: एवं जगति वर्तन्ते मनुष्या धर्मकारणात् । यथा धर्मवधो न स्यात् तथा मन्त्रः प्रवर्तताम् ॥ सतां गतिर् इयं नान्या धर्मश् चास्याः सुसाधनम् । राज्ञां चैव वधः कार्यो धरण्या भारनिर्णये ॥
units.english: Thus exist men in the world who are the instruments of righteousness. Let such practices be observed by which virtue may not suffer deterioration. This earth is the goal of the pious and none else. Virtue is the most excellent object they should endeavour to secure. Therefore to relieve the earth of her burden it is meet to destroy the kings.

units.sanskrit: तदागच्छ महाभाग सह वै मन्त्रकारणात् । व्रजाम मेरुशिखरं पुरस्कृत्य वसुंधराम् ॥
units.english: Therefore, great one, come with us to hold a consultation. With the earth before us let us go to the summit of the mount Meru –.

units.sanskrit: एतावद् उक्त्वा राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । पृथिव्या सह विश्वात्मा विरराम महाद्युतिः । वैशंपायन उवाच बाढम् इत्य् एव सह तैर् दुर्दिनाम्भोदनिस्वनः । स जतामण्डलं कृष्णं बिभ्रत् कृष्णवपुर् हरिः ॥ स चास्योरसि विस्तीर्णे रोमाञ्चोद्गतराजिमान् । श्रीवत्सो राजते श्रीमान् स्तनद्वयमुखाञ्चितः ॥
units.english: Having said this, foremost of kings, the self-controlled Grand Father of all, Brahmā, of great effulgence, began to take rest with the earth. Vaishampayana said:—Saying 'so be it the Lord, having the hue of a cloud and voice like its muttering in an unfair day, went away with the gods like a mountain covered with clouds. At that time Hari, having a dark-blue person, put on shining matted locks crested with jems and pearls like a cloud with the moon. On his spacious breast, the hairs whereof stood erect, there was the mystic mark of Srivatsa.

units.sanskrit: हरिः सो ऽभवद् आलक्ष्यः ससंध्याभ्र इवाचलः ॥ तं व्रजन्तं सुपर्णेन पद्मयोनिगतानुगम् । अनुजग्मुः सुराः सर्वे तद्गतासक्तचक्षुषः ॥ नातिदीर्घेण कालेन ते गता रत्नपर्वतम् । ददृशुर् देवतास् तत्र स्वां सभां कामरूपिणीम् ॥
units.english: Wearing two pieces of yellow raiment that eternal Hari, the preceptor of the world, looked like a mountain covered with evening clouds. When he began to proceed on the back of Garuda the Lotus-born Deity Brahmā and the gods, having their eyes fixed on him, began to follow him. Having reached the jewelled mountain in no time they saw the assembly hall built after their own hearts.

units.sanskrit: मेरोः शिखरविन्यस्तां संसक्तां सूर्यवर्चसा । काञ्चनस्तम्भचरणां वज्रसंघाततोरणाम् ॥
units.english: It was built on the summit of the mount Sumeru, and was effulgent like the sun. Its pillars were made of gold and its gateways were crested with diamonds.

units.sanskrit: मनोनिर्माणचित्राढ्यां विमानाकुलमालिनीम् । रत्नजालान्तरवतीं कामगां रत्नभूषिताम् ॥ कॢप्तरत्नसमाकीर्णां सर्वर्तुकुसुमोत्कटाम् । देवमायाधरां दिव्यां निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ॥
units.english: It contained diverse paintings on account of its being constructed by the mind and hundreds of cars. Its windows were covered with the jewelled nets. It could go any where at will and was embellished with jems. It was filled with many sorts of jewels and flowers made of various metals. That celestial assembly hall, filled with celestial illusion, was constructed by Viswakarmān –.

units.sanskrit: यथानिदेशं त्रिदशा विविशुस् ते सभां शुभाम् ॥ ते निषेदुर् यथोक्तेषु विमानेष्व् आसनेषु च । भद्रासनेषु पीठेषु कुथास्व् आस्तरणेषु च ॥
units.english: All the gods, with delighted minds, sat duly on the seats properly assigned to each of them, in that auspicious assembly hall. They sat on cars, seats, Bhadrāsanas, Pithas, and seats of Kutha.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रभञ्जनो वायुर् ब्रह्मणा साधु चोदितः । मा शब्द इति सर्वत्र प्रचक्राम सभां शुभाम् ॥ निःशब्दे स्तिमिते तस्मिन् समाजे त्रिदिवौकसाम् । त्वया धार्या त्व् अहं देव त्वया वै धार्यते जगत् । त्वं धारयसि भूतानि भुवनं त्वं बिभर्षि च ॥
units.english: Thereupon at the command of Brahmā, the wind Prabhanjana began to patrol on all sides of the assembly hall so that there might not arise any sound. When everything was silent and calm in that assembly of the gods the Earth plaintively began to address them in piteous accounts. The Earth said:— god, do thou uphold me. By thee the whole universe has been sustained. Thou art protecting the creatures and three worlds.

units.sanskrit: यत् त्वया धार्यते किंचित् तेजसा च बलेन च । ततस् तव प्रसादेन मया पश्चात् तु धार्यते ॥
units.english: Whatever thou dost sustain by thy energy and strength, do afterwards hold it by thy favour.

units.sanskrit: त्वया धृतं धारयामि नाधृतं धारयाम्य् अहम् । न हि तद् विद्यते भूतं यत् त्वया नानुधार्यते ॥
units.english: Whatever thou dost hold do hold it and whatever thou dost not sustain too do not keep it. There is no element in the universe which thou canst not sustain.

units.sanskrit: त्वम् एव कुरुषे देव नारायण युगे युगे । महाभारावतरणं जगतो हितकाम्यया ॥
units.english: lord Nārāyana, at various cycles thou dost relieve me of my burthen for the behoof of the world.

units.sanskrit: तवैव तेजसा क्रान्तां रसातलतलं गताम् । त्रायस्व मां सुरश्रेष्ठ तवैव शरणं गताम् ॥
units.english: Being possessed by thy energy have gone to the region underneath. foremost of gods, am at thy mercy. Do thou save me.

units.sanskrit: दानवैः पीड्यमानाहं राक्षसैश् च दुरात्मभिः । त्वाम् एव शरणं नित्यम् उपयास्ये सनातनम् ॥ तावन् मे ऽस्ति भयं भूयो यावन् न त्वां ककुद्मिनम् । शरणं यामि मनसा शतशो ह्य् उपलक्षये । अहम् आदौ पुरानेन संक्षिप्ता पद्मयोनिना । मां च बध्वा कृतौ पूर्वं मृङ्मयौ द्वौ महासुरौ ॥
units.english: have been assailed by the wicked Dānavas and Rākshasas. Thou art my eternal saviour and am always at thy mercy. know it for hundred times that as long as shall not seek refuge with Nārāyana who relieves me of all loads so long shall be under the influence of a mighty fear. Before agriculture, merchandise and other means of livelihood were instituted by the lotus-sprung Brahmā, in the days of yore, was reduced in dimension. Binding me two great Asuras, made of earth, were born before.

units.sanskrit: कर्णस्रोतोद्भवौ तौ हि विष्णोर् अस्य महात्मनः । महार्णवे प्रस्वपतः काष्ठकुड्यसमौ स्थितौ ॥
units.english: While this high-souled Vishnu was sleeping in the mighty deep they originated from the dirt of his ears and remained like two logs of wood.

units.sanskrit: तौ दिवं छादयन्तौ तु ववृधाते महासुरौ ॥
units.english: Thereupon covering the sky those two great Asuras began to grow up.

units.sanskrit: वायुप्राणौ तु तौ गृह्य ब्रह्मा परिमृश्यञ् शनैः । एकं मृदुतरं मेने कठिनं वेद चापरम् ॥
units.english: Brahma gradually touched them both who were gifted with vital breaths. One of them appeared to be soft and the other hard.

units.sanskrit: नामनी तु तयोश् चक्रे स विभुः सलिलोद्भवः । मृदुस् त्व् अयं मधुर् नाम कठिनः कैटभो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: The water-born Lord Brahmā then gave them names. The one, who was soft, was named Madhu and the other, who was hard, was called Kaitava.

units.sanskrit: तौ दैत्यौ कृतनामानौ चेरतुर् बलदर्पितौ । सर्वम् एकार्णवं लोकं योद्धुकामौ सुनिर्भयौ ॥
units.english: When those two Daityas were thus named they, elated with the pride of their strength and being fearless, began to range in the world converted into one sheet of water, seeking battle.

units.sanskrit: ताव् आगतौ समालोक्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । रोचयाम् आस वसतिं गुह्यां ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः ॥ ताव् उभौ जलगर्भस्थौ नारायणपितामहौ । बहून् वर्षगणान् अप्सु शयानौ न चकम्पतुः ॥
units.english: Beholding them thus approach Brahmā, the grand-father of all, disappeared in the water of the universal ocean. The four-mouthed grand-father desired to live secretly in the lotus sprung from the navel of the lotus-navelled Vishnu. When Nārāyana’s grand-sons, Madhu and Kaitava thus lived in the water, they, living there for many long years, were not the least agitated.

units.sanskrit: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य ताव् उभौ मधुकैटभौ । दृष्ट्वा ताव् असुरौ घोरौ महान्तौ युद्धदुर्मदौ । ब्रह्मणा ताडितो विष्णुः पद्मनालेन वै पुरा । उत्पपाताशु शयनात् पद्मनाभो महाद्युतिः ॥ तद् युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं तयोस् तस्य च वै तदा । एकार्णवे तदा लोके त्रैलोक्ये जलतां गते ॥
units.english: Thereupon after many years, those two demons, Madhu and Kaitava, came where Brahmā was stationed. Beholding those two dreadful, huge-bodied and irrepressible Dānavas, Brahmā, with the stalk of the lotus, disturbed Nārāyana. Thereat the highly-effulgent lotus-navelled Deity rose up from his bed. At that time the three worlds were covered with water and so in that one sheet of water there took place a terrible encounter between Nārāyana and Madhu and Kaitava.

units.sanskrit: तद् अभूत् तुमुलं युद्धं वर्षसंख्याः सहस्रशः । न च ताव् असुरौ युद्धे तदा श्रमम् अवापतुः ॥
units.english: That dreadful battle continued for thousand years and those two Dānavas did not experience least exhaustion in the encounter.

units.sanskrit: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य तौ दैत्यौ युद्धदुर्मदौ । ऊचतुः प्रीतमनसौ देवं नारायणं हरिं ॥
units.english: After a long time those two Dānavas, dreadful in battle, with a delighted heart, said to the Lord Nārāyana.

units.sanskrit: प्रीतौ स्वस् तव युद्धेन श्लाघ्यस् त्वं मृत्युर् आहवे । आवां जहि न यत्रोर्वी जलेन समभिप्लुता ॥
units.english: We have been greatly pleased with fighting with thee. Thou art our most desirable death. Do thou bring about our destruction at a place on earth which is not filled with water -.

units.sanskrit: हतौ च तव पुत्रत्वं प्राप्नुयावः सुरोत्तम । सो ह्य् आवां युधि निर्जेता तस्यावां विहितौ सुतौ ॥ स हि गृह्य मृधे दैत्यौ दोर्भ्यां तौ समपीडयत् । जन्मतुर् निधनं चापि ताव् उभौ मधुकैटभौ ॥
units.english: foremost of gods, slain by thee we shall become thy sons who vanquishes us in battle. Catching these two demons with his arms in battle Nārāyana assailed them. Thereat Madhu and Kaitava met with death. Thus killed those two Dāityas were saturated with water.

units.sanskrit: ताव् उभाव् आप्लुतौ तोये वपुर्भ्याम् एकतां गतौ । मेदसा तज्जलं व्याप्तं ताभ्यां अन्तर्दधे तदा । नारायणश् च भगवान् असृजत् स पुनः प्रजाः ॥
units.english: Their two bodies were then fused into one. And then churned by the waves of the water they began to discharge fat. The water was covered with fat. sinless one, thereupon they disappeared and the Lord Nārāyana again engaged in the work of creation -.

units.sanskrit: दैत्ययोर् मेदसा छन्ना मेदिनीति ततः स्मृता । प्रभावात् पद्मनाभस्य शाश्वती च नृणां कृता ॥
units.english: On account of my being covered with the fat of the demons Madhu and Kaitava have passed by the name of Medini. have become the eternal universe by the power of the lotus-navelled deity.

units.sanskrit: वराहेण पुनर् भूत्वा मार्कण्डेयस्य पश्यतः । विषाणेनाहम् एकेन तोयमध्यात् समुद्धृता ॥
units.english: Again assuming the form of a boar in the presence of the Muni Mārkandeya the Lord raised me up from the water with one tusk.

units.sanskrit: बलेः सकाशाद् दैत्यस्य विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ॥
units.english: Again at another time before your fiery presence the powerful Vishnu released me from the Daitya chief Bali.

units.sanskrit: सांप्रतं खिद्यमानाहम् एनम् एव गदाधरम् । अनाथा जगतो नाथं शरण्यं शरणं गता ॥ अक्षत्राणां गुरुः सोमो मम नारायणो गुरुः ॥
units.english: Now being oppressed and having none to protect me have sought refuge with the Lord of the universe Gadādhara who is ever fond of his votaries. Fire is the cause of gold, the sun is the cause of stars and so Nārāyana is my support.

units.sanskrit: यद् अहं धारयाम्य् एका जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् । मया धृतं धारयते सर्वम् एतद् गदाधरः ॥
units.english: am alone holding this universe consisting of mobile and immobile creations. And Gādadhara is supporting all these held by me.

units.sanskrit: जामदग्न्येन रामेण भारावतरणेप्सया । रोषात् त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो ऽहं क्षत्रियैर् विप्रयोजिता ॥
units.english: Desirous of relieving me of my burden Jamadagni's son Rāma, out of anger, divested me, for twenty-one times, of the Kshatriyas.

units.sanskrit: सास्मि वेद्याम् समारोप्य तर्पिता नृपशोणितैः । भार्गवेण पितुः श्राद्धे कश्यपाय निवेदिता ॥
units.english: Raising up a pillar of victory, Bhrigu's son Rāma propitiated me with royal blood at the obsequial rites of his father and then communicated it to Kashyapa.

units.sanskrit: मांसमेदोस्थिदुर्गन्धा दिग्धा क्षत्रियशोणितैः । रजस्वलेव युवतिः कश्यपं समुपस्थिता ॥
units.english: Filled with a bad stench coming out of fat, flesh and bones and saturated with the blood of the Kshatriyas appeared before Kashyapa like a youthful damsel in her course.

units.sanskrit: स मां ब्रह्मर्षिर् अप्य् आह किम् उर्वि त्वम् अवाङ्मुखी । वीरपत्नीव्रतम् इदं वीरपत्नि निषेवसे ॥
units.english: The Brāhmana saint Kashyapa then said to me:— earth, why art thou so depressed? Why dost thou, being the wife of a hero, observe the vow of humiliation.

units.sanskrit: साहं विज्ञापितवती कश्यपं लोकभावनम् । पतयो मे हता ब्रह्मन् भार्गवेण महात्मना ॥
units.english: Thereat said to Kashyapa, the Patriarch of the world:— Brāhman, the great Bhārgava has killed all my husbands.

units.sanskrit: साहं विहीना विक्रान्तैः क्षत्रियैः शस्त्रवृत्तिभिः । विधवा शून्यनगरा न धारयितुम् उत्सहे ॥
units.english: have been divested of all the powerful Kshatriyas who live on arms, and have lost my husband. do not wish to carry on me empty cities.

units.sanskrit: तन् मह्यं दीयतां भर्ता भगवंस् त्वत्समो नृपः । रक्षेत् सग्रामनगरां यो मां सागरमालिनीम् ॥ स श्रुत्वा भगवान् वाक्यं बाढम् इत्य् अब्रवीत् प्रभुः । ततो मां मानवेन्द्राय मनवे संप्रयच्छत ॥
units.english: Therefore, Reverend Sir, confer upon me such a king as will be able to protect me abounding in villages and cities and engarlanded by oceans. Hearing my words the Omnipotent Lord said Let it be so. Thereupon he gave me away to Manu, the king of men.

units.sanskrit: सा मनुप्रभवं पुण्यं प्राप्येक्ष्वाकुकुलं महत् । विपुलेनास्मि कालेन पार्थिवात् पार्थिवं गता ॥
units.english: Thereupon obtaining the god-like kings of the Ikshāku race, originating from Manu,, under the influence of powerful time, passed from the hands of one king to those of another.

units.sanskrit: एवं दत्तास्मि मनवे मानवेन्द्राय धीमते । भुक्ता राजकुलैश् चापि महर्षिकुलसंमितैः ॥
units.english: When the Lord bestowed me upon the intelligent Manu, the king of men, many kings, born in the families of great saints, ruled over me.

units.sanskrit: बहवः क्षत्रियाः शूरा मां जित्वा दिवम् आश्रिताः । ते स्म कालवशं प्राप्य मय्य् एव प्रलयं गताः ॥
units.english: Having conquered me many heroic Kshatriyas have gone to the celestial region. Under the influence of time they have disappeared in me.

units.sanskrit: मत्कृते विग्रहा लोके वृत्ते वर्तन्त एव च । क्षत्रियाणां बलवतां संग्रामेष्व् अनिवर्तिनाम् ॥
units.english: The powerful Kshatriyas, ever victorious in battle, fought for me in this world with one another and they have been still fighting even now.

units.sanskrit: एतद् युष्मत्प्रवृत्तेन दैवेन परिणामिता । जगद्धितार्थं कुरुत राज्ञां हेतुं रणक्षये ॥ यद्य् अस्ति मयि कारुण्यं भारशैथिल्यकारणात् । एकश् चक्रधरः श्रीमान् अभयं मे प्रयच्छतु ॥
units.english: This is the end of destiny despatched by thee. If thou hast commisseration for me, if thou dost wish to relieve me of my burden do thou organise a war for the destruction of the kings for the behoof of the world. May the beautiful holder of discus alone grant me protection –.

units.sanskrit: यम् अहं भारसंतप्ता संप्राप्ता शरणैषिणी । भारो यद्य् अवरोप्तव्यो विष्णुर् एष ब्रवीतु माम् ॥
units.english: May Nārāyana command me to whom have come for help oppressed with a load, if he thinks proper to relieve me of it.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ते श्रुत्वा पृथिवीवाक्यं सर्व एव दिवौकसः । शरीरकर्ता लोकानां त्वं हि लोकस्य चेश्वरः ॥ क्षिप्रम् आज्ञापय विभो कथम् अंशः प्रयुज्यताम् । कथम् अंशावतरणं कुर्मः सर्वे पितामह । अन्तरिक्षगता ये च पृथिव्यां ये च पार्थिवाः ॥ सदस्यानां च विप्राणां पार्थिवानां कुलेषु च । सुराणाम् एककार्याणां श्रुत्वैतन् निश्चितं महत् । देवैः परिवृतः प्राह वाक्यं लोकपितामहः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thereupon hearing the words of the earth and thinking minutely on her object the gods said to the grand-father. Lord, thou hast created the bodies of all creatures. Thou art the lord of all the worlds. Do thou therefore relieve the earth of her load. grand-father, how shall we send down our portions? Let us create bodies, not born of any woman, in the family of those kings who range in the sky, in that of the kings who tread the earth and in that of courtier Brāhmanas and other princes -. Hearing this great resolution of the gods assembled together for one common cause the grand-father of all, eulogised by the celestials, said to them.

units.sanskrit: रोचते मे सुरश्रेष्ठा युष्माकम् अपि निश्चयः । सृजध्वं स्वशरीरांशांस् तेजसात्मसमान् भुवि ॥
units.english: ye leading celestials, like very much your resolution. Do you create portions of your body on earth with your energy.

units.sanskrit: सर्व एव सुरश्रेष्ठास् तेजोभिर् अवरोहत । भावयन्तो भुवं देवीं लब्ध्वा त्रिभुवनश्रियम् ॥
units.english: Ye are all leading celestials, do ye, with your energy, descend on earth. And acquiring the prosperity of the three worlds do you relieve the earth of her burden.

units.sanskrit: पार्थिवे भारते वंशे पूर्वम् एव विजानता । पृथिव्यां संभवम् इमं श्रूयतां यन् मया कृतम् ॥
units.english: Listen to what did in the days of yore for removing the load of her burden when was informed of it.

units.sanskrit: समुद्रे ऽहं सुराः पूर्वे वेलाम् आसाद्य पश्चिमाम् । आसे सार्धं तनूजेन कश्यपेन महात्मना ॥
units.english: In the days of yore was seated on the western bank of the eastern ocean along with my grand-son the great Kashyapa.

units.sanskrit: कथाभिः पूर्ववृत्ताभिर् लोकवेदानुगामिभिः । इतिवृत्तैश् च बहुभिः पुराणप्रभवैर् गुणैः ॥
units.english: was describing various themes relating to the Vedas described before, as well as many other episodes of the Purānas.

units.sanskrit: कुर्वतस् तु कथास् तास् ताः समुद्रः सह गङ्गया । यादोगणविचित्रेण संछन्नस् तोयवाससा ॥ शङ्खमुक्तामलतनुः प्रवालमणिभूषणः । युक्तश् चन्द्रमसा पूर्णः साभ्रगम्भीरनिस्वनः ॥
units.english: While was thus discoursing, you all, accompanied by Maruts and the ocean and Gangā in their forms, came to me. With rushing waves, clad in a variegated raiment of acquatic animals, with a body shining with shells and pearls, adorned with corals and jewels, accompanied by the moon and roaring like a cloud surcharged with water, the ocean, as if vanquishing me, came to its bank.

units.sanskrit: तं च देशं व्यवसितः समुद्रो ऽद्भिर् विमर्दितुम् । उक्तः संरब्धया वाचा शान्तो ऽसीति ततो मया ॥
units.english: And throwing up its salt waters he greatly distressed that place –. When the ocean was about to assail that place with his water said to him in angry words be quiet.

units.sanskrit: शान्तो ऽसीत्य् उक्तमात्रस् तु तनुत्वं सागरो गतः । संहतोर्मितरङ्गौघः स्थितो राजश्रिया ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: No sooner said be quiet than he assumed a form. And with all his waves stilled he shone there in right regal grace.

units.sanskrit: भूयश् चैव मया शप्तः समुद्रः सह गङ्गया । सकारणां मतिं कृत्वा युष्माकं हितकाम्यया ॥ यस्मात् त्वं राजतुल्येन वपुषा समुपस्थितः । गच्छार्णव महीपालो राजैव त्वं भविष्यसि ॥
units.english: Desirous of encompassing your well-being and relieving the earth of her burden imprecated a curse on the ocean and Gangā, saying ocean, since you have come in a regal form, go, you will be a king.

units.sanskrit: भविष्यसि नृणां भर्ता भारतानां कुलोद्वहः ॥
units.english: Performing many feats with your own power on earth, you will be born in the race of the great Bharata and be a protector of men.

units.sanskrit: शान्तो ऽसीति मयोक्तस् त्वं यच् चासि तनुतां गतः । सुतनुर् यशसा लोके शंतनुस् त्वं भविष्यसि ॥
units.english: Although impatient you assumed a form as soon as asked you to be quiet. Therefore gifted with a beautiful person you will be celebrated on earth by the name of Shāntanu.

units.sanskrit: इयम् अप्य् आगता गङ्गा तवार्थे वरवर्णिनी । रूपिणी वै सरिच् छ्रेष्ठा तत्र त्वाम् उपयास्यति ॥
units.english: And this foremost of rivers, Gangā, of unblemished limbs and expansive eyes, will go to you in a beautiful form -.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तस् तु मां क्रुद्धः सो ऽभिगम्याऋणवो ऽब्रवीत् । मां प्रभो देवदेवेश किमर्थं शप्तवान् असि ॥
units.english: When said this, the ocean, being depressed at heart, looked at me. He said Lord, god of gods, why dost thou imprecate a curse on me? always obey thy commands.

units.sanskrit: अहं तव विधेयात्मा त्वत्कृतस् त्वत्परायणः । अशपो ऽसदृशैर् वाक्यैर् आत्मजं मां किम् आत्मना ॥
units.english: have been made by thee and am always under thy protection. am therefore thy son. Why hast thou then cursed me in unbecoming words? –.

units.sanskrit: भगवंस् त्वत्प्रसादेन वेगात् पर्वणि वर्धितः । यद्य् अहं चलितो ब्रह्मन् को ऽत्र दोषो ममात्मनः ॥
units.english: lord, by thy favour, my waves increased with the tides and so was agitated. Brāhman, how am to blame for this?.

units.sanskrit: उद्धूतैश् च महावातैः प्रवृद्धैश् च बलाहकैः । पर्वणा चेन्दुयुक्तेन त्रिभिः क्षुब्धो ऽस्मि कारणैः ॥ एवं यद्य् अपराद्धो ऽहं कारणैस् त्वत्प्रवर्तितैः । क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि मे ब्रह्मञ् शापो ऽयं विनिवर्त्यताम् ॥ एवं मयि निरालम्बे शापाच् छिथिलतां गते । कारुण्यं कुरु देवेश प्रमाणं यद्य् अवेक्षसे ॥
units.english: If during that time thou hast been touched by water thrown up by the wind, what reason is there for thy imprecating a curse on me ? was agitated by three-fold instruments namely the blowing wind, the increasing cloud and Parva accompanied by the moon. Brahman, if have committed any offence for these three instruments set to work by thee it behoves thee to forgive me and let there be an end of this curse. If dost thou find any evidence, lord of gods, do thou show me mercy who have been depressed by a curse for no offence of mine.

units.sanskrit: अस्याश् च देव गङ्गाया गां गतायास् तवाज्ञया । मद्दोषात् समदोषायाः प्रसादं कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥ तम् अहं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा महार्णवम् अथाब्रुवम् । अकारणज्ञं देवानां त्रस्तं शापानिलेरितम् ॥
units.english: lord, by thy command, this Gangā will descend on earth. am guilty but thou shouldst show mercy on this innocent one. Thereupon said in sweet accents to the great ocean who had been terrified and moved by the curse of the gods who were innocent of the cause thereof.

units.sanskrit: शान्तिं व्रज न भेतव्यं प्रसन्नो ऽस्मि महामते । शापे ऽस्मिन् सरितां नाथ भविष्यं शृणु कारणम् ॥
units.english: you of great mind, lord of rivers, be thou at ease, do not fear, have been propitiated with thee, Listen now to the future object of this imprecation –.

units.sanskrit: त्वं गच्छ भारते वंशे स्वदेहं स्वेन तेजसा । महोदधे महीपालस् तत्र राजश्रिया वृतः । पालयंश् चतुरो वर्णान् रंस्यसे सलिलेश्वर ॥
units.english: lord, renouncing this thy ocean body, go to the race of Bharata. Then, great ocean, great king, you will be enveloped with regal grace. There, lord of waters, you will govern the four Varnas and be pleased –.

units.sanskrit: इयं च त्वां सरिच् छ्रेष्ठा बिभ्रती मानुषीं तनुम् । तत् कालरमणीयाङ्गी गङ्गा परिचरिष्यति ॥
units.english: And assuming, a beautiful form of a woman, this Gangā, the foremost of rivers, will serve you.

units.sanskrit: अनया सह जाह्नव्या मोदमानो ममाज्ञया । इमं सलिलसंक्लेदं विस्मरिष्यसि सागर ॥
units.english: Sporting with Jānhavi, by my command you will not experience human miseries. ocean, be you soon united with Gangā in wed-lock and carry out my command.

units.sanskrit: वसवः प्रच्युताः स्वर्गात् प्रविष्टाश् च रसातलम् । तेषाम् उत्पादनार्थाय त्वं मया विनियोजितः ॥
units.english: Exiled from the celestial region the Vasus have entered the Rasātala. appoint you for procreating them.

units.sanskrit: अष्टौ ताञ् जाह्नवीगर्भान् अपत्यार्थं ददाम्य् अहम् । विभावसोस् तुल्यगुणान् सुराणां प्रीतिवर्धनान् ॥
units.english: Let Jānhavi, for having offspring, conceive those eight Vasus who are effulgent like fire and increase the joy of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: उत्पाद्य त्वं वसूञ् शीघ्रं कृत्वा कुरुकुलं महत् । प्रवेष्टासि तनुं त्यक्त्वा पुनः सागर सागरीम् ॥
units.english: Having procreated the Vasus, multiplied the Kuru race and cast off your human body, you will, in no time, assume your ocean body.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एतन् मया पूर्वं हितार्थं वः सुरोत्तमाः । भविष्यं पश्यता भारं पृथिव्याः पार्थिवात्मकम् ॥
units.english: foremost of gods, thus in the days yore beholding the future burden of the earth, sowed the seeds of Shāntanu's race for your well-being in which have been born the Vasus who live in the celestial region –.

units.sanskrit: अद्यापि भुवि गाङ्गेयस् तत्रैव वसुर् अष्टमः । सप्तेमे वसवः प्राप्ताः स एकः परिलम्बते ॥ द्वितीयायां स्त्रियां सृष्टा द्वितीया शंतनोस् तनुः । विचित्रवीर्यो द्युतिमान् आसीद् राजा प्रतापवान् ॥
units.english: Even now in the celestial region exists Gangā's son Bhishma as the eighth Vasu. The seven other Vasus have repaired to their respective regions and only Vishnu is now living. The king Shāntanu begat on his second wife the highly effulgent and powerful king Vichitravirya.

units.sanskrit: वैचित्रवीर्यौ द्वाव् एव पार्थिवौ भुवि सांप्रतम् । पाण्डुश् च धृतराष्ट्रश् च विख्यातौ पुरुषर्षभौ ॥
units.english: The two sons of Vichitravirya were the two famous kings of the world Dhritarāstra and Pāndu, the two foremost of men.

units.sanskrit: तत्र पाण्डोः श्रिया जुष्टे द्वे भार्ये यौवनस्थिते । शुभे कुन्ती च माद्री च देवयोषोपमे भुवि ॥
units.english: Of them Pāndu had two beautiful and youthful wives. The first was named Kunti and the second was named Mādri. And both of them were like the wives of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्रस्य राज्ञस् तु भार्यैका तुल्यचारिणी । गान्धारी भुवि विख्याता भर्तुर् नित्यं व्रते स्थिता ॥
units.english: Dhritarāshtra had one wife, by name Gāndhāri, who, by stead-fastly serving her husband, became celebrated in the world.

units.sanskrit: अत्र वो ऽंशा विभज्यन्तां विपक्षः पक्ष एव च । पुत्राणां हि तयो राज्ञोर् भविता विग्रहो महान् ॥
units.english: Herein that house will be divided into two hostile parties and a terrible dissension will take place amongst the sons of those two kings.

units.sanskrit: तेषां विमर्दे दायाद्ये नृपाणां भविता क्षयः । युगान्तप्रतिमं चैव भविष्यति महद् भयम् ॥
units.english: On account of the internal dissensions of these kings all the royal families will be destroyed. terrible fear, like the hour of universal dissolution will then prevail.

units.sanskrit: सबलेषु नरेन्द्रेषु शातयत्स्व् इतरेतरम् । विविक्तपुरराष्ट्रौघा क्षितिः शैथिल्यम् एष्यति ॥
units.english: When all the kings, with their armies, will be slain by one another the cities and kingdoms will be shorn of their inhabitants and Earth will enjoy relief.

units.sanskrit: द्वापरस्य युगस्यान्ते मया दृष्टं पुरातने । क्षयं यास्यन्ति शस्त्रेण पार्थिवाः सह वाहनैः ॥
units.english: have read in the Puranas that in the end of the Dwāpara Yuga, all the kings, with their armies, will be destroyed by weapons.

units.sanskrit: तत्रावशिष्टान् मनुजान् सुप्तान् निशि विचेतसः । धक्ष्यते शंकरस्यांशः पावकेनास्त्रतेजसा ॥
units.english: Then Ashwathama, a portion incarnate of Sankara, with the fire of weapon, will consume the remnant of humanity in battle lying unconscious, at night, in sleep –.

units.sanskrit: अन्तकप्रतिमे तस्मिन् निवृत्ते क्रूरकर्मणि । समाप्तम् इदम् आख्यास्ये तृतीयं द्वापरं युगम् ॥
units.english: When that one of cruel deeds, the like of death himself, will desist, this story relating to the the Dwāpara Yuga, will come to a close.

units.sanskrit: महेश्वरांशे ऽपसृते ततो माहेश्वरं युगम् । तिष्यं प्रपत्स्यते पश्चाद् युगं दारुणमानुषम् ॥ अधर्मप्रायपुरुषं स्वल्पधर्मपरिग्रहम् । उत्सन्नसत्यसंयोगं वर्धितानृतसंचयम् ॥
units.english: When Ashwathāmā, a portion of Siva, will disappear, the dreadful Kali Yuga of Maheswara will set in. In this Yuga people will perpetrate many iniquities and there will flourish only a portion of virtue. Truth will disappear and falsehood will be stored up.

units.sanskrit: महेश्वरं कुमारं च द्वौ च देवौ समाश्रिताः । भविष्यन्ति नराः सर्वे लोके नस्थविरायुषः ॥
units.english: In this Yuga, people will worship only Maheswara and Skanda; old and long-lived men will not exist on the earth.

units.sanskrit: तद् एष निर्णयः श्रेष्ठः पृथिव्यां पार्थिवान्तकः । अंशावतरणं सर्वे सुराः कुरुत माचिरम् ॥ धर्मस्यांशो ऽथ कुन्त्यां वै माद्र्यां च विनियुज्यताम् । विग्रहस्य कलिर् मूलं गान्धार्यां विनियुज्यताम् ॥
units.english: have thus described the most excellent annihilation of the kings of this world. Therefore, ye celestials, descend on earth, without delay in your respective portions. Let Kunti and Madri conceive portions of Dharma and let Gandhāri conceive Kali the instrument of all dissensions.

units.sanskrit: एतौ पक्षौ भविष्यन्ति राजानः कालचोदिताः । जातरागाः पृथिव्यर्थे सर्वे संग्रामलालसाः ॥
units.english: These kings, urged on by destiny, will form two parties and being desirous of securing the earth, will seek a war. Let Earth, who upholds all the worlds, enter into her own native source.

units.sanskrit: सृष्टो ऽयं नैष्ठिको राज्ञाम् उपायो लोकविश्रुतः ॥
units.english: This sacred and well-known means of the kings is thus created.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा पितामहवचः सा जगाम यथागतम् । पृथिवी सह कालेन वधाय पृथिवीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of the Grand-father Earth with Kāla went away happily for encompassing the destruction of the kings.

units.sanskrit: देवान् अचोदयद् ब्रह्मा निग्रहार्थं सुरद्विषाम् । सनत्कुमारं साध्यांश् च देवांश् चाग्निपुरोगमान् । वरुणं च यमं चैव सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश् चैव रुद्रादित्यांस् तथाश्विनौ ॥
units.english: Thereupon Brahmā despatched the gods for slaying their enemies. The ancient Rishi Nara the Serpent Sesha, that upholds the earth, Sanatkumār, the Sadhyas, Agni, and other gods, Varuna, the Vasus, the sun, the moon, the Gandharvas, the Apsaras, the Rudras, the Viswas, the two Aswinis all descended on earth in their respective portions –.

units.sanskrit: यथा ते कथितं पूर्वम् अंशावतरणं मया ॥ अयोनिजा योनिजाश् च ते देवाः पृथिवीतले । दैत्यदानवहन्तारः संभूताः पुरुषेश्वराः । क्षीरिकावृक्षसंघाता वज्रसंहननास् तथा ॥ नागायुतबलाः केचित् केचिद् ओघबलान्विताः । गदापरिघशक्तीनां सहाः परिघबाहवः । गिरिशृङ्गप्रहर्तारः सर्वे परिघयोधिनः ॥ वृष्णिवंशे समुत्पन्नाः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । कुरुवंशे च देवास् ते पाञ्चालेषु च पार्थिवाः ॥
units.english: As described by me before the incarnations of the portions of gods, those foremost of Purushas were born, through women or otherwise, on earth as the destroyers of the Daityas and Dānavas. Some of them multiplied their families like fig-trees. And some of them were hard-bodied like thunder-bolts –. Some of them were endued with the strength of a million of elephants. Some of them were powerful like mighty currents and some were capable of handling clubs, Parighas and other weapons. All of them were capable of striking with the summits of the mountains. Hundreds and thousands of men, having arms like Parighas, were born in the race of Vrishnis. And the gods were born in the races of Kuru and Panchala as kings.

units.sanskrit: याज्ञिकानां समृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानां च योनिषु । सर्वास्त्रज्ञा महेष्वासा वेदव्रतपरायणाः ॥ सर्वर्द्धिगुणसंपन्ना यज्वानः पुण्यकर्ंइणः । आचालयेयुः शैलांस् ते क्रुद्धा भिन्द्युर् महीतलम् । उत्पतेयुर् अथाकाशं क्षोभयेयुर् महोदधिम् ॥
units.english: There were born in the prosperous family of Yadus and those of Brāhmanas many sacrificers of pious deeds, well read in the scriptures, mighty bow-men, observant of Vedic rituals and endued with prosperity and accomplishments –. Whenever angry they could shake the mountains, the rivers, the surface of the earth, rise up in the sky and agitate the mighty deep.

units.sanskrit: एवम् आदिश्य तान् ब्रह्मा भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः । नारायणे समावेश्य लोकाञ् शान्तिम् उपागमत् ॥
units.english: Having thus commanded the gods the Grand-father Brahmā, the master of present, past, and future, consigned all the worlds to Nārāyana and attained peace.

units.sanskrit: भूयः शृणु यथा विष्णुर् अवतीर्णो महीतलम् । प्रजानां वै हितार्थाय प्रभुः प्राणधनेश्वरः ॥ ययातिवंशजस्याथ वसुदेवस्य धीमतः । ज्वलिताग्निप्रतीकाशो बालार्कसदृशेक्षणः । चन्द्रांशुशुक्ले वसने वसानो रुक्मभूषणः । वीणां गृहीत्वा महतीं कक्षासक्तां सखीम् इव ॥ कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गो हेमयज्ञोपवीतवान् । दण्डी कमण्डलुधरः साक्षाच् छक्र इवापरः ॥
units.english: Listen again to what the Omnipotent Nārāyana, Vishnu, of sacred fame, the lord of wealth and life, did for the behoof of creatures after incarnating himself on earth and taking birth in the family of the intelligent Vasudeva, the descendant of Yayāti –. He was effulgent like fire, had eyes like the rising sun and had huge and all-spreading matted locks. He wore a raiment white like the rays of the moon and was adorned with golden ornaments. He carried a big Vina like a female companion always confined in room, had an antelope skin thrown on his body and a sacred thread made of gold. With a staff and Kamandalu in his hands he appeared like second Sakra.

units.sanskrit: भेत्ता जगति गुह्यानां विग्रहाणां ग्रहोपमः । महर्षिर् विग्रहरुचिर् विद्वान् गान्धर्ववेदवित् ॥
units.english: That great sage always used to pick up quarrels, was learned, well-read in Gandharva-Veda and was capable of deciphering the secret cause of dissensions in this world.

units.sanskrit: वैरिकेलिकिलो विप्रो ब्राह्मः कलिर् इवापरः । गाता चतुर्णां वेदानाम् उद्गाता प्रथमर्त्विजाम् ॥ देवगन्धर्वलोकानाम् आदिवक्ता महामुनिः । स नारदो ऽथ ब्रह्मर्षिर् ब्रह्मलोकचरो ऽव्ययः । स्थितो देवसभामध्ये संरब्धो विष्णुम् अब्रवीत् ॥ अनन्तवीर्यं देवेशं जगौ ब्रह्मपुरःसरम् ॥ यद् एतत् पार्थिवं क्षत्रं स्थितं त्वयि विधीश्वर । नृनारायणयुक्तो ऽयं कार्यार्थः प्रतिभाति मे ॥
units.english: That Brāhmana used to create enemies of his own accord and was like the second Kali himself. That great Muni was the first speaker in the land of gods and Gandharvas, was the chanter of the four Vedas and was the reciter of the first Rik. That immortal sage Nārada, ever ranging in the region of Brahmā, with a depressed heart said to Vishnu in the midst of the assembled gods. Nārāyana, useless have been the incarnations of the gods for the destruction of the kings -. lord of the celestial region, thyself existing here, this dissension of the kings will be productive of no fruit. Methinks their work cannot be accomplished without Nārāyana's Yoga.

units.sanskrit: न युक्तं जानता देव त्वया तत्त्वार्थदर्शिना । देवदेव पृथिव्यर्थे प्रयोक्तुं कार्यम् ईदृशम् ॥
units.english: god of gods, thou art wise and observant of the true essence of things. It has not been proper for thee to institute such a work for the earth.

units.sanskrit: त्वं हि चक्षुष्मतां चक्षुः श्लाघ्यः प्रभवतां प्रभुः । श्रेष्ठो योगवतां योगी गतिर् गतिमताम् अपि ॥
units.english: Thou art the vision of the eyes and the lord of the powerful. Thou art the foremost of the Yogins and the refuge of all.

units.sanskrit: देवभागान् गतान् दृष्ट्वा किं त्वं सर्वाग्रगो विभुः । वसुंधरायाः साह्यार्थम् अंशं स्वं नानुयुञ्जसे ॥
units.english: Beholding the incarnation of the gods on earth why didst not thou send, first of all, a portion of thy energy to relieve the earth of her burden?.

units.sanskrit: त्वया सनाथा देवांशास् त्वन्मयास् त्वत्प्रचोदिताः । जगत्यां संतरिष्यन्ति कार्यात् कार्यान्तरं गताः ॥
units.english: Making thee their help, and being identical with and guided by thee all the gods will swim on this earth from one action to another.

units.sanskrit: तद् अहं त्वरया विष्णो प्राप्तः सुरसभाम् इमाम् । तव संचोदनार्थं वै शृणु चाप्य् अत्र कारणम् ॥
units.english: have therefore hastened to the presence of these assembled gods to send thee, Vishnu; hear the reason thereof.

units.sanskrit: ये त्वया निहता दैत्याः संग्रामे तारकामये । तेषां शृणु गतिं विष्णो ये गताः पृथिवीतलम् ॥
units.english: Nārāyana, hear of the movements of those Daityas who, amongst many that had been slain by thee in the war of which Tārakā was the root, have gone to the face of the earth.

units.sanskrit: पूः पृथिव्यां समुदिता मथुरा नाम नामतः । निविष्टा यमुनातीरे स्फीता जनपदायुता ॥
units.english: There is a delightful city on the face of the earth by name Mathurā. It is situate on the bank of Yamunā and abounds in many prosperous, villages.

units.sanskrit: मधुर् नाम महान् आसीद् दानवो युधि दुर्जयः । तस्य स्म सुमहर्द्ध्यासीन् महापादपसंततम् । तस्य पुत्रो महान् आसील् लवणो नाम दानवः । लवणस् तस्य पुत्रो ऽभून् महाबलपराक्रमः । त्रासनः सर्वभूतानां बले महति तस्थिवान् ॥
units.english: There was a great Dānava, irrepressible in battle, by name Madhu. He was highly powerful and a terror to all creatures –. There was a vast and dreadful forest by name Madhu abounding in huge trees where he used to live formerly. The great Dānava Lavana was Madhu's son. He was gifted with profuse strength and was a terror to all creatures.

units.sanskrit: स तत्र दानवः क्रीडन् वर्षपूगान् अनेकशः । सदैवतगणांल् लोकान् उद्वासयति दर्पितः ॥
units.english: Sporting there for many years, that Dānava, elated with pride, terrorized all the gods and others.

units.sanskrit: अयोध्यायाम् अयोध्यायां रामे दाशरथौ स्थिते । राज्यं शासति धर्मज्ञे राक्षसानां भयावहे ॥ स दानवो बलश्लाघी घोरं वनम् उपाश्रितः । प्रेषयाम् आस रामाय दूतं परुषवादिनम् ॥ विषयासन्नभूतो ऽस्मि तव राम रिपुश् च सः । न च सामन्तम् इच्छन्ति राजानो बलदर्पितम् ॥
units.english: When the pious son of Dasharatha, Rāma, a terror to the Rākshasas, was ruling in Ayodhya, that Dānava, eulogised by all the Daityas, repaired to a dreadful forest. Lavana despatched to Rāma, a harsh-speeched emissary. He said Rāma, am living near your territory. The Dānava Lavana is your enemy. The kings do not wish to have a powerful enemy –.

units.sanskrit: राज्ञा राजव्रतस्थेन प्रजानां शुभम् इच्छता । जेतव्या रिपवः सर्वे स्फीतं विषयम् इच्छता ॥
units.english: king, who seeks the well-being of his subjects, observes his royal duties and wishes to multiply his territories and riches, should always defeat his enemies.

units.sanskrit: अभिषेकार्द्रकेशेन राज्ञा रञ्जनकाम्यया । जेतव्यानीन्द्रियाण्य् आदौ तज् जये हि ध्रुवो जयः ॥ सम्यग्वर्तितुकामस्य विशेषेण महीपतेः । नयानाम् उपदेशेन नास्ति लोकसमो गुरुः ॥
units.english: That king, desirous of pleasing his subjects, who has his hairs wet with the water of installation, should first of all conquer his senses, for mastery over senses is the sure victory, The king, who wishes to keep his position always intact and strong, should instruct his men in moral laws for there is no other preceptor like him to the people.

units.sanskrit: व्यसनेषु जघन्यस्य धर्ममध्यस्य धीमतः । बलज्येष्ठस्य नृपतेर् नास्ति सामन्तजं भयम् ॥
units.english: If when placed in the midst of dangers and vices, an intelligent king strengthens himself by his army he is not to entertain any fear of his enemies.

units.sanskrit: सहजैर् बध्यते सर्वः प्रवृद्धैर् इन्द्रियारिभिः । अमित्राणां प्रियकरैर् मोहैर् अधृतिर् ईश्वरः ॥
units.english: All men are killed by their senses, the powerful enemies born with them. An impatient king is slain by the false notion of good done to them by their enemies.

units.sanskrit: यत् त्वया स्त्रीकृते मोहात् सबलो रावणो हतः । नैतद् औपयिकं मन्ये महत् ते कर्म कुत्सितम् ॥
units.english: On account of your wife, you have, out of foolish attachment, killed Rāvana with his army. do not consider that sinful action of yours as great and becoming.

units.sanskrit: प्रहृतं राक्षसे नीचे नैष दृष्टः सतां विधिः ॥
units.english: Living in a forest and observing a vow you have killed a mean Rakshasa. Such a conduct is not seen in the pious.

units.sanskrit: सताम् अक्रोधजो धर्मः शुभां नयति सद्गतिम् । यत् त्वया निहतो मोहाद् दूषिताश् च वनौकसः ॥
units.english: Virtue, begotten of forbearance, takes the pious to an auspicious and righteous station. Out of ignorance you have killed Rāvana and honoured the forest ranging Vanaras.

units.sanskrit: स एव रावणो धन्यो यस् त्वया व्रतचारिणा । स्त्रीनिमित्तं हतो युद्धे ग्राम्यान् धर्मान् अवेक्षता ॥
units.english: Indeed Rāvana is blessed, since you, while observing a vow, killed him in battle for your wife, in pursance of the conduct of ordinary men.

units.sanskrit: यदि ते स हतः संख्ये दुर्बुद्धिर् अजितेन्द्रियः । युध्यस्वाद्य मया सार्धं मृधे यद्य् असि वीर्यवान् ॥ तस्य दूतस्य तच् छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तत्त्ववादिनः । धैर्याद् असंभ्रान्तवपुः सस्मितं राघवो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ असद् एतत् त्वया दूत कथितं तस्य गौरवात् । यद्य् अहं सत्पथे मूढो यदि वा रावणो हतः । यदि वा मे हृता भार्या तस्य का परिदेवना ॥ न वाङ्मात्रेण दुष्यन्ति साधवः सत्पथे स्थिताः । जागर्ति च यथा दैवं सदा सत्स्व् इतरेषु च ॥ कृतं दूतेन यत् कार्यं गच्छ त्वं दूत माचिरम् । नात्मश्लाघिषु नीचेषु प्रहरन्तीह मद्विधाः ॥
units.english: That wicked-minded Rāvana, who has not controlled his senses, has been killed by you in battle. You are therefore capable of fighting. Come and fight with me to-day. Hearing those words of that harsh-speeched emissary, Rāma, out of forbearance, smilingly said to him:— Emissary, what you have said, out of honor to that night-ranger, is unfair, since you have been blaming me and considering yourself at ease –. What is there to blame, if, wending the ways of righteousness, have been stupified, if Rāvana has been slain and my wife has been carried away, The virtuous, always following the ways of morality, do not blame others even with their words. As the God is always awake for the pious, He is equally so for the wicked, You have done what is the duty of a messenger. Go now and make no delay. Persons like me do not hurt the mean: who are fond of making too much of themselves.

units.sanskrit: अयं ममानुजो भ्राता शत्रुघ्नः शत्रुतापनः । तस्य दैत्यस्य दुर्बुद्धे मृधे प्रतिकरिष्यति ॥
units.english: Here is my younger brother Satrughna, the repressor of enemies in battle. He will wait for that wicked-minded demon.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः स दूतस् तु ययौ सौमित्रिणा सह । अनुज्ञातो नरेन्द्रेण राघवेण महात्मना ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by Rāma and commanded by that king that messenger set out with Satrughna.

units.sanskrit: स शीघ्रयानः संप्राप्तस् तद् दानववनं महत् । चक्रे निवेशं सौमित्रिर् वनान्ते युद्धलालसः ॥
units.english: Ascending upon a quick-coursing car, Sumitra's son Satrughna repaired to the huge forest of Madhu and desirous of entering into a battle pitched a tent there –.

units.sanskrit: ततो दूतस्य वचनात् स दैत्यः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः । जघने तद् वनं कृत्वा युद्धायाभिमुखः स्थितः ॥
units.english: Thereupon hearing the words of that messenger the demon Lavana was beside himself with anger. Leaving behind the Madhu forest he started for battle.

units.sanskrit: उभयोर् एव धृतयोः शूरयो रणमूर्धनि ॥ तौ शरैः साधुनिशितैर् अन्योन्यम् अभिजघ्नतुः । न च तौ युद्धवैमुख्यं श्रमं वाप्य् उपजग्मतुः ॥
units.english: Then there took place a terrible encounter between Satrughna and Lavana. They were both heroic and mighty bowmen. Both of them struck each other with sharpened arrows. None of them fled back from the battle-field and none of them felt himself tired -.

units.sanskrit: अथ सौमित्रिणा बाणैः पीडितो दानवो युधि । ततः स शूलरहितः पर्यहीयत दानवः ॥
units.english: Thereupon greatly assailed in battle by Satrughna's shafts the Dānava Lavana met with discomfiture for he had not his mace with him.

units.sanskrit: स गृहीत्वाङ्कुशं चैव देवैर् दत्तवरं रणे । कर्षणं सर्वभूतानां लवणो विररास ह ॥
units.english: Afterwards taking up a celestial Sankhusha, that was given to him as a boon and was capable of grinding all creatures, Lavana began to shout in the battle.

units.sanskrit: प्रवेशयितुम् आरब्धो लवणो राघवानुजम् । स रुक्मत्सरुम् उद्यम्य शत्रुघ्नः शत्रुतापनः । शिरश् चिच्छेद खड्गेन लवणस्य महामृधे ॥
units.english: He caught of hold Satrughna's turban with it and began to draw in Rāghava's younger brother. Thereat taking up a most excellent dagger having a golden handle Satrughna cut off with it Lavana's head in that great battle.

units.sanskrit: स हत्वा दानवं संख्ये सौमित्रिर् मित्रनन्दनः । तद् वनं तस्य दैत्यस्य चिच्छेदास्त्रेण बुद्धिमान् ॥
units.english: Having slain that demon Lavana in battle, that heroic son of Sumitra, who gives delight to his friends, cleared off his forest with his weapons.

units.sanskrit: छित्त्वा वनं स सौमित्रिर् निवेशम् अभिरोचयत् । भवाय तस्य देशस्य पुरीं परमधर्मवित् ॥
units.english: Having cleared that forest that pious son of Sumitrā, Satrughna, built a city there for the well-being of that province and desired to live there.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् मधुवनस्थाने मथुरा नाम सा पुरी । शत्रुघ्नेन पुरा सृष्टा हत्वा तं दानवं रणे ॥
units.english: Having killed, in the days of yore, the demon Lavana in Mudhu forest Setrughna built a city there by name Mathurā –.

units.sanskrit: सा पुरी परमोदारा साट्टप्राकारतोरणा । स्फीता राष्ट्रसमाकीर्णा समृद्धभवनाकुला ॥
units.english: That great city was adorned with walls, gate ways and doors. It contained many villages, high buildings and gardens.

units.sanskrit: उद्यानवनसंपन्ना सुसीमा सुप्रतिष्ठिता । चयाट्टालककेयूरा प्रासादवरकुण्डला । सुसंवृतद्वारमुखी चत्वरोद्गारहासिनी ॥
units.english: Its boundaries were well laid and it was beautifully built. The ditches were like the ornament that a woman uses round her waist. The buildings, made of stone and bricks, were like Keyuras. Beautiful palaces were like the ear-rings.

units.sanskrit: अरोगवीरपुरुषा हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुला । अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा यमुनातीरशोभिता ॥ पुण्यापणवती दुर्गा रत्नसंचयगर्विता । क्षेत्राणि रसवन्त्य् अस्याः काले देवश् च वर्षति ॥ तस्यां पुर्यां महावीर्यो राजा भोजकुलोद्वहः । उग्रसेन इति ख्यातो महासेनपराक्रमः ॥
units.english: It contained many healthy heroes, elephants, horses and cars. It resembled a crescent and was situate on the bank of Yamuna. It contained beautiful markets and was proud of her collection of jems. The fields there were full of corns. The king of gods Indra used to pour showers in proper season. Men and women there were always delightful. The highly powerful king Surasena, born in the race of Bhojas, reigned there. He was powerful like Mahāsena and was celebrated by the name of Ugrasena –.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रत्वम् आपन्नो यो ऽसौविष्णो त्वया हतः । कालनेमिर् महादैत्यः संग्रामे तारकामये ॥ कंसो नाम विशालाक्षो भोजवंशविवर्धनः । राजा पृथिव्यां विख्यातः सिंहविस्पष्टविक्रमः ॥
units.english: He whom thou hast killed, Vishnu, is his son. The Daitya, by name Kālanemi, whom thou didst slay in the battle of which Tāraka was the root, is born as Kansa, and is the scion of the Bhoja race. That king, who treads like a lion, is celebrated in the world –.

units.sanskrit: भयदः सर्वभूतानां सत्पथाद् बाह्यतां गतः ॥
units.english: He is a terror to all the kings of the world and a dread to all creatures. He is always beyond the path of righteousness.

units.sanskrit: दारुणाभिनिवेशेन दारुणेनान्तरात्मना । युक्तस् तेनैव दर्पेण प्रजानां लोमहर्षणः ॥
units.english: He is highly persevering and ruthless. He is so very haughty to his subjects that seeing him their hairs stand erect.

units.sanskrit: न राजधर्माभिरतो नात्मपक्षसुखावहः । नात्मराज्यप्रियकरश् चण्डः कररुचिः सदा ॥
units.english: He never observes his royal duties and is never a source of pleasure to his own men. He never does any good to his kingdom and behaves always like a tyrant.

units.sanskrit: स कंसस् तत्र संभूतस् त्वया युद्धे पराजितः । क्रव्यादो बाधते लोकान् आसुरेणान्तरात्मना ॥
units.english: He, who was vanquished by thee in Tāraka battle, is now born as Kansa in the Bhoja race. That one, living on meat, is oppressing all the worlds, with his demonaic heart.

units.sanskrit: केशी नाम हयो जातः स तस्यैव जघन्यजः ॥
units.english: He, who was like a horse and known by the name, Hayagriva, is born as Keshi the youngest brother of Kansa.

units.sanskrit: स दुष्टो हेषितपटुः केसरी निरवग्रहः । वृन्दावने वसत्य् एको नृणां मांसानि भक्षयन् ॥
units.english: That wicked bodiless demon with manes, neighing like a horse, is now living alone in Vrindāvana. He lives on human flesh.

units.sanskrit: अरिष्टो बलिपुत्रस् तु ककुद्मी वृषरूपधृक् । गवाम् अरित्वम् आपन्नः कामरूपी महासुरः ॥
units.english: Bali's son Aristha is born as the great Asura Kakudmi, capable of assuming forms of his own accord. Adopting the form of a bull he has become an enemy of the kine.

units.sanskrit: रिष्टो नाम दितेः पुत्रो वरिष्ठो दानवेषु यः । स कुञ्जरत्वम् आपन्नो दैत्यः कंसस्य वाहनः ॥
units.english: Diti's son Ristha, the foremost of Danavas, is born as Kansa's elephant.

units.sanskrit: लम्बो नामेति विख्यातो यो ऽसौदैत्येषु दर्पितः । शिखरो नाम बलवान् य आसीद् दानवर्षभः । खर इत्य् उच्यते दैत्यो धेनुकः सो ऽसुरोत्तमः । घोरं तालवनं दैत्यश् चरत्य् उत्सारयन् प्रजाः ॥ वराहश् च किशोरश् च ताव् उभौ दानवोत्तमौ । मल्लौ रङ्गगतौ तौ तु जातौ चाणूरमुष्टिकौ ॥ यौ तौ मयश् च तारश् च दानवौ दानवान्तक । प्राग्ज्योतिषे तौ भौमस्य नरकस्य पुरे रतौ ॥ एते दैत्या विनिहतास् त्वया विष्णो निराकृताः । मानुषं वपुर् आस्थाय बाधन्ते भुवि मानवान् ॥
units.english: That dreadful demon Lamva is born as Pralamva. He is living under a fig-tree by name Bhandara. That demon, who was known by the name of Khara, is born as the dreadful Asura Dhanuka. Living in the forest of palm-trees he is making a havoc of creatures. Those two foremost of Danavas, by name Varaha and Kishora, have been born as wrestlers Chanuka and Musthika who are always at the arena. Those two Danavas Maya and Tara, who were like death even to the demons, are now living in the city of Bhumi's son Naraka, by name Prāgyotish. Nārāyana, thou didst slay all these Danavas and divest them of their forms. Assuming human bodies they are now oppressing the people of the world.

units.sanskrit:
त्वत्कथाद्वेषिणः सर्वे त्वन्मयान् घ्नन्ति मानवान् । तव प्रसादात् तेषां वै दानवानां क्षयो भवेत् ॥
तव ते दिवि बिभ्यन्ति त्वत्तो बिभ्यन्ति सागरे ।
पृथिव्यां बिभ्यति त्वत्तो नान्यस्य तु कथंचन ॥
दुर्वृत्तस्य हतस्यापि त्वया नान्येन श्रीधर ।
दिवश् च्युतस्य दैत्यस्य गतिर् भवति मेदिनी ॥
व्युत्थितस्य तु मेदिन्यां हतस्य नृशरीरिणः । दुर्लभं स्वर्गगमनं त्वयि जाग्रति केशव ॥
तद् आगच्छ स्वयं विष्णो गच्छाव पृथिवीतलम् ।
दानवानां विनाशाय विसृजात्मानम् आत्मना ॥
मूर्तयो हि तवाव्यक्ता दृश्यादृश्याः सुरोत्तमैः । तासु सृष्टास् त्वया देवाः संभविष्यन्ति भूतले ॥
units.english: They oppose the chanting of thy name and destroy thy votaries. By thy favour only they will meet with destruction. In heaven they are afraid of thee, in ocean they are afraid of thee and even on earth they afraid of thee. There is no other source of fear to them. Sridhar, thou dost slay the wicked Dānavas; none else can accomplish their destruction. The Daityas, who are sent away from heaven, find refuge on earth. Keshava, thou being awake, it is difficult for that demon to go again to heaven, who, on his being slain in the celestial region, again rises up assuming a human body. Therefore, Nārāyana, do thou come to the world. We are also descending on earth. Do thou create your own self for the destruction of Dānavas. The forms of thine, which are not manifest, are both visible and invisible to the celestials. In those forms, the gods, created by thee, shall descend on earth.

units.sanskrit: तवावतरणे विष्णो कंसः स विनशिष्यति । सेत्स्यते च स कार्यार्थो यस्यार्थे भूमिर् आगता ॥
units.english: Vishnu, when thou shalt come down on earth, Kansa will not be able to reign and the object, for which the earth has come, will also be accomplished.

units.sanskrit: त्वं भारते कार्यगुरुस् त्वं चक्षुस् त्वं परायणः । तद् आगच्छ हृषीकेश क्षितौ ताञ् जहि दानवान् ॥
units.english: Thou art the preceptor of all works in the land of Bharata, thou art the eye of all and the supreme refuge. Therefore, Hrishikesha do thou come on earth and slay those wicked Dānavas .

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सस्मितं मधुसूदनः । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं वरेण्यः प्रभुर् ईश्वरः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing the words of Nārada the Lord Madhusudana, the master of gods, smilingly said in auspicious words :— Nārada, listen to a proper reply to all these words which you have addressed to me for the well-being of the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: विदिता देहिनो जाता मयैते भुवि दानवाः । जानामि कंसं संभूतम् उग्रसेनसुतं भुवि । केशिनं चापि जानामि दैत्यं तुरगविग्रहम् ॥ हस्तिनं चोत्पलापीडं मल्लौ चाणूरमुष्टिकौ । विदितो मे खरश् चैव प्रलम्बश् च महासुरः । सा च मे विदिता विप्र पूतना दुहिता बलेः ॥
units.english: It is known to me that all these Dānavas, assuming human forms, have been born on earth. know too that Kansa is born as the son of Ugrasena on earth. know also that Keshi is born as a horse. know also the elephant Kuvalayapida, the wrestlers Chānura and Mushthika and the demon Arishtha in the shape of a bull. Khara and the great Asura Pralamva are also known to me. Bali's daughter Putanā is also well known to me.

units.sanskrit: कालियं चापि जानामि यमुनाह्रदगोचरम् । विदितो मे जरासंधः स्थितो मूर्ध्नि महीक्षिताम् । प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरे चापि नरकं साधु तर्कये ॥
units.english: know also Kāliya who is living in the lake of Yamunā and who has entered there in fear of Vinatā's son. know also Jarāsandha who is the head of all kings; and the demon Naraka, who is living in the city of Prāgyotish, is also very well-known to me.

units.sanskrit: मानुषे पार्थिवे लोके मानुषत्वम् उपागतम् । दृप्तं बाहुसहस्रेण देवैर् अपि सुदुर्जयम् । मय्य् आसक्तां च जानामि भारतीं महतीं धुरम् । तच् च सर्वं विजानामि यथा स्थास्यन्ति ते नृपाः ॥
units.english: In the city of Shonitpura on earth Bāna is born as a man. That energetic and haughty demon, of thousand arms, is invincible even unto the gods. know also that the great charge of Bhāratvarsa lies with me -. know also how all these kings will disappear.

units.sanskrit: क्षयो भुवि मया दृष्टः शक्रलोके च सत्क्रिया । तेषां पुरुषदेहानाम् अपरावृत्तिवर्तिनाम् ॥
units.english: The destruction of those danavas, in human forms, who never come back from battle-field and the rejoicing of the region of Sakra has also been seen by me.

units.sanskrit: संप्रवेक्ष्याम्य् अहं योगम् आत्मनश् च परस्य च । संप्राप्य पार्थिवं लोकं मानुषत्वम् उपागतः ॥ कंसादींश् चापि तान् सर्वान् वधिष्यामि महासुरान् । तेन तेन विधानेन येन यः शान्तिम् एष्यति ॥
units.english: For myself and for others shall enter into Yoga. Going to the region of men and assuming a human form shall bring about the destruction of all those mighty demons headed by Kansa. shall slay him by that means by which he will enjoy peace –.

units.sanskrit: अनुप्रविश्य योगेन तास् ता हि गतयो मम । अमीषाम् अमरेन्द्राणां हन्तव्या रिपवो युधि ॥
units.english: By my Yoga shall resort to all these means. It is my incumbent duty to destroy all those enemies of the gods in battle.

units.sanskrit: जगत्यर्थे कृतो यो ऽयम् अंशोत्सर्गो महात्मभिः । सुरदेवर्षिगन्धर्वैर् एतच् चानुमतं मम ॥
units.english: shall kill the foes of all those great ones who have sacrificed themselves on behalf of the earth, of all those gods, Rishis and Gandharvas who have come down on earth at my behest.

units.sanskrit: विनिश्चयो हि प्राग् एव नारदायं कृतो मया । निवासं तु न मे ब्रह्मा विदधाति पितामहः ॥
units.english: Nārada, have already formed this resolution. Let the grand-father Brahmā make a house there for me.

units.sanskrit: यत्र देशे यथा जातो येन वेषेण वा वसन् । तान् अहं समरे हन्यां तन् मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
units.english: grand-father, do thou relate to me, how, born in what country and living in what house shall kill them .

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच नारायणेमं सिद्धार्थम् उपायं शृणु मे विभो । भुवि यस् ते जनयिता जननी च भविष्यति ॥ तांश् चासुरान् समुत्साद्य वंशं कृत्वात्मनो महत् । स्थापयिष्यसि मर्यादां नृणां तन् मे निशामय ॥
units.english: Brahma said:— lord, Nārāyana, hear from me of that key to success and who your parents will be on earth. In order to glorify their family you will be born in the race of Yādavas. Eradicating these Asuras for good and multiplying your great family you will establish the orders of mankind. Hear from me about this.

units.sanskrit: पुरा हि कश्यपो विष्णो वरुणस्य महात्मनः । जहार यज्ञिया गावः पयोदाश् च महामखे ॥
units.english: Nārāyana, in the days of yore, in the great sacrifice of the high-souled Varuna, Kashyapa stole away all the cows giving milk for the sacrifice.

units.sanskrit: अदितिः सुरभिश् चोभे द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्य तु । ततो मां वरुणो ऽभ्येत्य प्रणम्य शिरसानतः । उवाच भगवन् गावो गुरुणा मे हृता इति ॥
units.english: Kashyapa had two wives, Aditi and Surabhi who did not wish to accept the kine from Varuna. Thereupon coming to me and bowing with his head down Varuna said revered one, the preceptor has stolen away all my kine.

units.sanskrit: कृतकार्यो हि गास् तास् तु नानुजानाति मे गुरुः । अन्ववर्तत भार्ये द्वे अदितिं सुरभिं तथा ॥
units.english: Having accomplished his object, even, father, he has not ordered the return of those kine. He is under the control of his two wives Aditi and Surabhi.

units.sanskrit: मम ता ह्य् अक्षया गावो दिव्याः कामदुघा विभो । चरन्ति सगारान् सर्वान् रक्षिताः स्वेन तेजसा ॥
units.english: lord, all those my kine give heavenly and eternal milk whenever wished. Protected by their own power they range in the seas. They perpetually yeild milk like unto the ambrosia of gods.

units.sanskrit: कस् ता धर्षयितुं शक्तो मम गाः कश्यपाद् ऋते । प्रभुर् वा व्युत्थितो ब्रह्मन् गुरुर् वा यदि वेतरः । त्वया नियम्याः सर्वे वै त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः ॥ यदि प्रभवतां दण्डो लोके कार्यम् अजानताम् । न विद्यते लोकगुरो न स्युर् वै लोकसेतवः ॥
units.english: Save Kashyapa there is none else who can charm them. Brahmā, a master, a preceptor or whoever he may be if one goes astray thou dost control him. Thou art our supreme refuge. preceptor of the world, if punishment is not meted out to powerful persons who do not know their own work, then the order of the world will not exist.

units.sanskrit: यथा वास्तु तथा वास्तु कर्तव्ये भगवान् प्रभुः । मम गावः प्रतीयन्तां ततो गन्तास्मि सागरम् ॥ यस् ते ऽत्मा देवता गावो या गावः स त्वम् अव्ययम् । लोकानां त्वत्प्रवृत्तानाम् एकं गोब्राह्मणं स्मृतम् ॥
units.english: Thou art omnipotent and lord of all. Do thou give me my kine, will go then to the ocean. These kine are my soul—they are my endless strength. Of all thy creation the kine and the Brāhmanas are the eternal sources of energy.

units.sanskrit: त्रातव्याः प्रथमं गावस् त्रातास् त्रायन्ति ता द्विजान् । गोब्राह्मणपरित्राणात् परित्रातं जगद् भवेत् ॥ इत्य् अम्बुपतिना प्रोक्तो वरुणेनाहम् अच्युत । गवां कारणतत्त्वज्ञः कश्यपे शापम् उत्सृजम् ॥
units.english: First of all the kine should be saved. When they are saved they protect the Brāhmanas. The world is upheld by the protection of the kine and Brāhmanas. Achyuta, thus addressed by Varuna, the king of water, and being truly informed of the pilfering of the kine imprecated a curse on Kashyapa.

units.sanskrit: येनांशेन हृता गावः कश्यपेन महात्मना । स तेनांशेन जगतीं गत्वा गोपत्वम् एष्यति ॥
units.english: With that portion, in which the high-souled Kashyapa stole the kine, he will be born as a milkman on earth.

units.sanskrit: या च सा सुरभिर् नाम यादितिश् च सुरारणिः । ते ऽप्य् उभे तस्य वै भार्ये सह तेनैव यास्यतः ॥ ताभ्यां सह स गोपत्वे कश्यपो भुवि रंस्यते । तद् अस्य कश्यपस्यांशस् तेजसा कश्यपोपमः । वसुदेव इति ख्यातो गोषु तिष्ठति भूतले ॥ गिरिर् गोवर्धनो नाम मथुरायास् त्व् अदूरतः । तत्रासौ गोषु निरतः कंसस्य करदायकः ॥ तस्य भार्याद्वयं चैव अदितिः सुरभिस् तथा । देवकी रोहिणी चैव वसुदेवस्य धीमतः ॥ सुरभी रोहिणी देवी चादितिर् देवकी त्व् अभूत् । तत्रावतर लोकानां भवाय मधुसूदन । जयाशीर्वचनैस् त्व् एते वर्धयन्ति दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: His two wives Surabhi and Aditi, who are like pieces of wood for the birth of gods, will also go with him. Being born as a milkman with them he will live there happily. That portion of Kashyapa, equally powerful like himself, will pass by the name of Vasudeva and will live amongst the kine on earth. Near Mathurā there is a mountain by name Govardhana -. Paying tribute to Kansa he lives there being attached to kine. His two wives Aditi and Surabhi are born as the two wives of Vasudeva by name Devaki and Rohini. Being born there as a boy having all the characteristics of a milkman he there grew up as thou didst do before in thy form with three footsteps. Then covering thyself with the form of Yoga, Madhusudana, do thou go there for the well-being of the world. With exclamations of thy victory and benediction all these gods are welcoming thee.

units.sanskrit: देवकीं रोहिणीं चैव गर्भाभ्यां परितोषय ॥ गोपकन्यासहस्राणि रमयंश् चर मेदिनीम् ॥ गाश् च ते रक्षतो विष्णो वनानि परिधावतः । वनमालापरिक्षिप्तं धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति ते वपुः ॥
units.english: Descending on earth and taking thy birth from Rohini and Devaki do thou please them. Thousands of milk maids will also cover the earth -. Vishnu, when thou shalt range in the forest tending kine they will see thy beautiful form adorned with garlands of wild flowers.

units.sanskrit: विष्णो पद्मपलाशाक्ष गोपालवसतिं गते । बाले त्वयि महाबाहो लोको बालत्वम् एष्यति ॥
units.english: thou having eyes like lotus petals, large-armed Nārāyana, when thou wilt go as a boy to the villages of milkmen all people will become boys.

units.sanskrit: त्वद्भक्ताः पुण्डरीकाक्ष तव चित्तवशानुगाः । गोषु गोपा भविष्यन्ति सहायाः सततं तव । वने चारयतो गास् तु गोष्ठांश् च परिधावतः । मज्जतो यमुनायां च रतिम् आप्स्यन्ति ते त्वयि ॥
units.english: thou having lotus eyes, being milkmen with their minds devoted to thee all thy votaries will help thee; tending kine in the forest, running in pastures and bathing in the water of Yamunā they will acquire a great attachment for thee.

units.sanskrit: जीवितं वसुदेवस्य भविष्यति सुजीवितम् । यस् त्वया तात इत्य् उक्तः पुत्र इत्य् एव वक्ष्यति ॥
units.english: And Vasudeva's life will be a blessed one –. Thou wilt address him as thy father and he will address thee as his son.

units.sanskrit: का च धारयितुं शक्ता विष्णो त्वाम् अदितिं विना ॥ योगेनात्मसमुत्थेन त्वं गच्छ विजयाय वै । वयम् अप्य् आलयं स्वं गच्छामो मधुसूदन ॥ स देवान् अभ्यनुज्ञाय विविक्ते त्रिदिवालये । जगाम विष्णुः स्वं देशं क्षीरोदस्योत्तरां दिशम् ॥
units.english: Save Kashyapa whom else canst thou accept as thy father ? Vishnu, save Aditi who else can conceive thee? Therefore by thy self-begotten Yoga do thou proceed for victory, Madhusudana. We too repair to our respective habitations. Vaishampāyana said:—Having ordered the gods to repair to the celestial region the Lord Vishnu went to his own abode on the northern side of the ocean of milk.

units.sanskrit: तत्रैव पार्वती नाम गुहा मेरोः सुदुर्गमा । त्रिभिस् तस्यैव विक्रान्तैर् नित्यं पर्वसु पूजिता ॥
units.english: In this quarter there is a cave of the mount Sumeru difficult of being trodden, which is worshipped with his three foot-steps during the solistice.

units.sanskrit: पुराणं तत्र विन्यस्य देहं हरिर् उदारधीः । आत्मानं योजयाम् आस वसुदेवगृहे प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Having left there, in the cave, his old body the omnipotent and intelligent Hari despatched his soul to the house of Vasudeva.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायण उवाच ज्ञात्वा विष्णुं क्षितिगतं भागांश् च त्रिदिवौकसाम् । विनाशशंसी कंसस्य नारदो मथुरां ययौ ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Being informed of the descension of Vishnu and of the portions of other gods, the celestial saint Nārada repaired to the city of Mathurā to communicate the future death of Kansa.

units.sanskrit: प्रेषयाम् आस कंसस्य उग्रसेनसुतस्य वै ॥ स दूतः कथयाम् आस मुनेर् आगमनं नृपे । गत्वा तु त्वरितं राजन्न् उवाच मधुरेश्वरम् । स नारदस्यागमनं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः । स ददर्शातिथिं श्लाघ्यं देवर्षिं वीतकल्मषम् । तेजसा ज्वलनाकारं वपुषा सूर्यवर्चसम् ॥
units.english: Coming down from the celestial region and arriving at the garden of Mathurā, that foremost of Munis sent a messenger to Kansa, the son of Ugrasena. He communicated the arrival of the Muni at the garden. Hearing of the arrival of Nārada, that Asura, having lotus-like eyes, speedily went out of his city. He saw there his guest, the praiseworthy Brāhmana saint Nārada, shorn of all sins, powerful like the sun and effulgent like fire.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभिवाद्यर्षये तस्मै पूजां चक्रे यथाविधि । आसनं चाग्निवर्णाभं विसृज्योपजहार वै ॥
units.english: Having bowed unto him and worshipped him duly he brought for him a golden seat shining like fire.

units.sanskrit: निषसादासने तस्मिन् स वै शक्रसखो मुनिः । उवाच चोग्रसेनस्य सुतं परमकोपनम् ॥ पूजितो ऽहं त्वया वीर विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा । गते त्व् एवं मम वचः श्रूयतां गृह्यतां च वै ॥
units.english: That Muni, the friend of Sakra, sat on that seat –. He then said to the highly wrathful son of Ugrasena:— hero, you have duly worshipped me with works laid down in the scriptures. Hear now and accept what say.

units.sanskrit: अनुसृत्य दिवो लोकान् अहं ब्रह्मपुरोगमान् । गतः सूर्यसखं तात विपुलं मेरुपर्वतम् ॥
units.english: my son, ranging in Nandana and Chaitraratha gardens, in Brahmā and other celestial regions arrived at the great mount Sumeru, the friend of the sun –.

units.sanskrit: आप्लुतं मे सुतीर्थासु सरित्सु सह दैवतैः ॥
units.english: The gods also followed me.

units.sanskrit: दिव्यां त्रिपथगां दृष्ट्वा पुण्यां भागिरथीं नदीम् । दिव्या त्रिपथगा दृष्टा पुण्या भागीरथी नदी । दृष्टं मे ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम् । देवगन्धर्वनिर्घोषैर् अप्सरोभिश् च नादितम् ॥ सो ऽहं कदाचिद् देवानां समाजं मेरुमूर्धनि । संगृह्य वीणां संसक्ताम् अगच्छं ब्रह्मणः सभाम् ॥ सो ऽहं तत्र सितोष्णीषान् नानारत्नविभूषितान् । दिव्यासनगतान् देवान् अपश्यं सपितामहान् ॥
units.english: Having bathed in the holy water of all the sacred rivers saw the celestial Gangā of three courses and streams, who dissipates all sins as soon as she is recollected. Thereupon having bathed, in order, at all those sacred shrines saw Brahmā's palace, resorted to by the Brāhmana saints and filled with the music of the gods, Gandharvas and Apsaras -. Once on a time the Grand-Father held a meeting of the gods on the summit of the mount Sumeru. , too, taking up my Vinā, set to tune, came to that meeting of Brahmā and saw that the Grand-Father and the gods, adorned with white turbans and diverse jewels, and seated on celestial seats, were holding counsels –.

units.sanskrit: तत्रैषा देवकी या ते मथुरायां पितृष्वसा । अस्या गर्भो ऽष्टमः कंस स ते मृत्युर् भविष्यति ॥
units.english: great king, heard there that they, with their followers, were concerting dreadful measures for your destruction. The child, of the eighth conception of your youngest sister Devaki who lives in Mathurā, will be your death.

units.sanskrit: परं रहस्यं देवानां स ते मृत्युर् भविष्यति ॥ परतो ऽपि परस् त्व् एषां स्वयंभूश् च सवयंभुवाम् । ततस् ते तन् महद् भूतं दिव्यं न कथयाम्य् अहम् ॥ श्लाघ्यश् च स हि ते मृत्युर् भूतपूर्वश् च तं स्मर । यत्नश् च क्रियतां कंस गर्भस्थे यदि शक्यते ॥
units.english: hero, it has been ascertained that your death will proceed from that self-born Vishnu who is the stay of heaven, is the great mystery of the gods and is identical with all, Kansa, to meet with death at the hands of that god of Gods, as has been settled upon, is a matter of glory to you. Therefore remember him now. Try to destroy the conception of Devaki and enjoy all your wealth and articles of pleasure.

units.sanskrit: एषा मे त्वद्गता प्रीतिर् इत्यर्थं चाहम् आगतः । भुज्यन्तां सर्वकामार्थाः स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु व्रजाम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: love you very much and therefore have come here and described to you what took place on the summit of the mount Sumeru. ; now leave you.

units.sanskrit: भुज्यन्तां कंस कामाश् च । इत्य् उक्त्वा नारदे याते तस्य वाक्यं विचिन्तयन् । जहासोच्चैस् ततः कंसः पकाशदशनश् चिरम् ॥ सस्मितं चेव प्रोवाच भृत्यानाम् अग्रतः स्थितः । हास्यः खलु स सत्त्वेषु नारदो न विशारदः ॥
units.english: May you fare well –. Vaishampāyana said:—After Nārada had said this and gone away Kansa, meditating on his words, began to laugh aloud with his lips open, and smilingly said to his servants who were before him. Truly the gods make fun with Narada and he has no knowledge of things –.

units.sanskrit: नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यो देवैर् अपि सवासवैः । आहवस्थः शयानो वा प्रमतो मत्त एव वा ॥
units.english: Even when am seated on my throne, asleep, mad or intoxicated, the gods headed by Vāsava cannot terrify me the least.

units.sanskrit: को ऽस्ति यो मानुषे लोके मां क्षोभयितुम् उत्सहेत् ॥ अद्यप्रभृति भूतानाम् एष देवानुवर्तिनाम् । आज्ञाप्यतां हयः केशी प्रलम्बो धेनुकस् तथा । अरिष्टो वृषभश् चैव पूतना कालियस् तथा ॥
units.english: Who is there in the land of men who can dare make me angry? can even agitate the earth with these two my huge arms. From to-day shall greatly oppress men, beasts, birds and all other creatures who follow the gods. Do ye issue this command to Keshi, in the shape of a horse, Pralamva, Dhenuka, Aristha, in the form of a bull, Putanā, Kaliya and other demons.

units.sanskrit: प्रहरध्वं च सर्वेषु ये ऽस्माकं पक्षदूषकाः ॥ गर्भस्थानाम् अपि गतिर् विज्ञेया भुवि देहिनाम् । नारदेन हि गर्भेभ्यो भयं नः समुदाहृतम् ॥
units.english: Assuming diverse forms do ye range all over the world and destroy them whom you will find against me. Nārada has said that our fear proceeds from conception and therefore you should always be informed of the movements of all those who have been conceived by women.

units.sanskrit: मां च वो नाथम् आश्रित्य नास्ति देवकृतं भयम् ॥
units.english: When am your master you need not be afraid of any accidental calamity.

units.sanskrit: स तु केलिकिलो विप्रो भेदशीलश् च नारदः । सुश्लिष्टान् अपि लोकेषु भेदयंल् लभते रतिम् ॥ कण्डूयमानः सततं लोकान् अटति चञ्चलः । घटयानो नरेन्द्राणां तन्त्रीवैराणि चैव ह ॥
units.english: Narada is greatly fond of quarrels and is intent on creating dissensions. In order to set one against another that Brāhmana, with a restive mind, travels in all the worlds, creates dissensions even amongst men of highly quiet temparament and works out enmity amongst kings by various means –.

units.sanskrit: विवेश कंसो भवनं दह्यमानेन चेतसा ॥
units.english: Having vauntingly said this Kansa entered his own palace but his heart was burning with the fire of anger.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच सो आज्ञापयत संरब्धः सचिवान् आत्मनो हितान् । यत्ता भवत सर्वे वै देवक्या गरभकृन्तने ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thereupon worked up with anger Kansa said to all his well-meaning ministers:—Do ye always be on your guard for destroying the eight born children of Devaki.

units.sanskrit: मूलाद् एव हि हन्तव्यः सो ऽनर्थो यत्र संशयः ॥
units.english: The calamity, which we suspect, should be eradicated.
