units.sanskrit: देवकी च गृहे गुप्ता प्रच्छन्नैर् अभिरक्षिता । स्वैरं चरतु विस्रब्धा मद्बलैर् यत्नम् आस्थितैः ॥
units.english: Therefore from the very beginning destroy all the embryos of Devaki. Let Devaki, well guarded in the inner appartment by the warders, range there confidently.

units.sanskrit: मासान् वै पुष्पमासादीन् गणयन्तु मम स्त्रियः । परिणामे तु गर्भस्य शेषं ज्ञास्यामहे वयम् ॥
units.english: As soon as she will conceive, the women of my harem will count the months from the very first, and being informed of the time of delivery we will do what we think proper.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेवश् च संरक्ष्यः स्त्रीसनाथास्तु भूमिषु । अप्रमत्तैर् मम हितै रात्राव् अहनि चैव ह । स्त्रीभिर् वर्षवरैश् चैव वक्तव्यं न च कारणम् ॥
units.english: Let Vasudeva too be kept unconsciously day and night in the inner appartment by eunuchs and women engaged in my well being. Let no body disclose to him the secret.

units.sanskrit: एष मानुषको यत्नो मानुषैर् एव साध्यते । श्रूयतां येन दैवं हि मद्विधैः प्रतिहन्यते ॥
units.english: With these human efforts people should accomplish their objects. Hear how persons like me avert the course of destiny.

units.sanskrit: मन्त्रग्रामैः सुविहितैर् औषधैश् च सुयोजितैः । यत्नेन चानुकूलेन दैवम् अप्य् अनुवर्तते ॥
units.english: Even an adverse destiny is made propitious by well employed mantras, properly administered medicines, care and devotion.

units.sanskrit: एवं स यत्नवान् कंसो देवकीगर्भकृन्तने । भयेन मन्त्रयाम् आस श्रुतार्थो नारदात् स वै ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana continued:—Hearing from Nārada, the account of his death, Kansa, out of fear, began to hold counsels as to how he should destroy Devaki's embryo.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैव कंसराजस्य चेष्टितं जगतीपतिः । अन्तर्धानं गतो विष्णुश् चिन्तयाम् आस वीर्यवान् ॥ सप्तेमान् देवकीगर्भान् भोजपुत्रो वधिष्यति । अष्टमे च मया गर्भे कार्यम् आधानम् आत्मनः ॥ तस्य चिन्तयतस् त्व् एवं पातालम् अगमन् मनः । यत्र ते गर्भशयनाः षद्गर्भा नाम दानवाः ॥ विक्रान्तवपुषो दीप्तास् ते ऽमृतप्राशनोपमाः । अमरप्रतिमा युद्धे पुत्रा वै कालनेमिनः ॥
units.english: On the other hand, being informed of the portendous and dreadful efforts of Kansa while out of sight, the powerful Vishnu began to think Bhoja's descendant Kansa will destroy the first seven children of Devaki. In her eighth conception shall have to live in her womb. While thus meditating his mind flew where the Saragarbha Danavas, by name, Hansa, Suvikrātha, Damana, Ripunardana, and Krodhahartā were living in the water. These immortal-like Saragarbhas, the sons of Kālanemi, were powerful like the celestials, were of effulgent persons and experts in battle.

units.sanskrit: आर्यकं वै परित्यज्य हिरण्यकशिपुं पुरा । उपासां चक्रिरे दैत्याः पुरा लोकपितामहम् । तप्यमानास् तपस् तीव्रं जटामण्डलधारिणः ॥
units.english: Leaving their own grand-father Hiranyakasipu and wearing mantted locks those Saragarbha Daityas worshipped the Grand-father of all, Brahmā, with hard penances who, being pleased, conferred on them the following boon -.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच भो भो दानवशार्दूलास् तपसाहं सुतोषितः । ब्रूत वो यस्य यः कामः को वरो वः प्रदीयतां ॥ ते तु सर्वे समानार्था दैत्या ब्रह्माणम् अब्रुवन् । यदि नो भगवान् प्रीतः श्रूयतां नो वरो वरः ॥ अवध्याः स्याम भगवन् दैवतैः समहौरगैः । शापप्रहरणैश् चापि नियतैः परमर्षिभिः ॥ यक्षगन्धर्वपतिभिः सिद्धचारणमानवैः । मा भूद् वधो नो भगवन् ददासि यदि नो वरम् ॥ तान् उवाच ततो ब्रह्मा सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना । भवद्भिर् यद् इदं प्रोक्तं सर्वम् एतद् भविष्यति ॥ षड्गर्भाणां वरं दस्त्त्वा स्वयंभूस् त्रिदिवं गतः । ततो हिरण्यकशिपुः सरोषो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Brahma said:— ye foremost of Dānavas, have been greatly pleased with your ascetic austerities. Express to me clearly your wishes, shall grant them to you all. Encouraged by Brahmā's words the Daityas said lord, if thou art pleased with us do thou confer upon us this best of boons. Brahman, if thou art ready to confer upon us a boon, do thou grant us such a one as may render us unslayable by the gods, the huge Uragas, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Siddhas, Chāranas, men and by the great Rishis ever engaged in penances, whose weapons are their curses –. The Grand-father was greatly delighted at heart with their ascetic observances and therefore affectionately said to them:—What you have prayed for will all be accomplished. Having conferred this boon on Saragarbhas the self-born repaired to the celestial region. Thereupon Hiranyakasipu addressed them in angry words saying –.

units.sanskrit: माम् उत्सृज्य वरो यस्माद् वृतो वः पद्मसंभवात् । तस्माद् वस् त्याजितः स्नेहः शत्रुभूतांस् त्यजाम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: By your disregarding me and praying for a boon to the lotus-sprung Brahmā, you have become my enemies. therefore have no affection for you and forsake you all.

units.sanskrit: षड्गर्भा इति यो यं वः शब्दः पित्राभिवर्धितः । स एव वो गर्भगतान् पिता सर्वान् वधिष्यति ॥
units.english: That father, who has given you the high sounding name of Saragarbha, will kill you all while in embryo –.

units.sanskrit: षड् एव देवकीगर्भाः षद्गर्भा वै महासुराः । जगामाथ ततो विष्णुः पातालं यत्र ते शुराः । षड्गर्भाः संयताः सन्ति जलगर्भगृहेशयाः ॥ स ददर्श जले सुप्तान् षड्गर्भान् गर्भसंस्थितान् । स्वप्नरूपेण तेषां वै विष्णुर् देहान् अथाविशत् । प्राणेश्वरांश् च निष्कृष्य निद्रायै प्रददौ तदा ॥
units.english: ye great Asuras Saragarbhas, you all six will be born in order from Devaki and Kansa will kill you. Vaishampayana said:—Thereupon repairing to the nether region Vishnu arrived where Saragarbha Asuras, on account of the imprecation of Hiranyakasipu, were living in the womb of water. He saw them lying there possessed by death-like sleep –. Thereupon entering into the body of the Saragarbhas in a state of dream, Vishnu, having truth for his prowess, caught hold of their vital breaths and consigned them to the care of sleep.

units.sanskrit: षड्गर्भान् दानवोत्तमान् । सर्वप्राणेश्वरी चैव । षट्सु गर्भेषु देवक्या योजयस्व यथाक्रमम् ॥
units.english: He said sleep, by my command take the vital airs of all these leading Dānavas Saragarbhas and place them in order in the womb of Devaki -.

units.sanskrit: जातेष्व् एतेषु गर्भेषु नीतेषु च यमक्षयम् । कंसस्य विफले यत्ने देवक्याः सफले श्रमे ॥ प्रसादं ते करिष्यामि मत्प्रसादसमं भुवि । सप्तमो देवकीगर्भो यो ऽंशः सौम्यो ममाग्रजः । स संक्रामयितव्यस् ते सप्तमे मासि रोहिणीम् ॥
units.english: They will be born of her womb and proceed to the abode of Death. Kansa's efforts will be baffled and Devaki's labour will be crowned with success. will show you such a favour that like me you will be powerful on earth and adored of all creatures. Thereupon when my gentle portion will be conceived by Devaki in her seventh conception, take that eldest brother of mine in the seventh month and place him within Rohini's womb.

units.sanskrit: संकर्षणात् तु गर्भस्य स तु संकर्षणो युवा । भविष्यत्य् अग्रजो भ्राता मम शीतांशुदर्शनः ॥
units.english: On account of his thus being taken away from the womb, that moon-like elder brother of mine will pass, in his youth, by the name of Sangkarsana.

units.sanskrit: पतितो देवकीगर्भः सप्तमो ऽयं भयाद् इति । अष्टमे मयि गर्भस्थे कंसो यत्नं करिष्यति ॥
units.english: Thereupon thinking that Devaki has untimely given birth to a child out of fear in the seventh time Kansa will be very careful for the eighth time when will be in her womb.

units.sanskrit: या तु सा नन्दगोपस्य दयिता कंसगोपतेः । यशोदा नाम भद्रं ते भार्या गोपकुलोद्वहा ॥
units.english: goddess, may you fare-well; as being the ninth of our race, you will be conceived by Yashodā, the best of milk-women, the most beloved wife of Nanda the master of Kansa's kine.

units.sanskrit: तस्यास् त्वं नवमो ऽस्माकं कुले गर्भो भविष्यसि । नवम्याम् एव संजातो कृष्णपक्षस्य वै तिथौ ॥
units.english: You will be born on the ninth day of the dark half of the month –. sleep, highly dreadful is Kansa's rule.

units.sanskrit: अष्टमस्य तु मासस्य जाताव् आवां ततः समम् । अहं यशोदां यास्यामि त्वं देवि भज देवकीम् । आवयोर् गर्भव्यत्यासे कंसो गच्छतु मूढताम् ॥ ततस् त्वां गृह्य चरणे शिलायां निरसिष्यति । मच्छवीसदृशी कृष्णा संकर्षणसमानना । बिभ्रती विपुलान् बाहून् मम बाहूपमान् भुवि ॥
units.english: Therefore in the eighth month, we will be simultaneously born and exchanged by Vasudeva. will be taken to Yashodā and you will be taken to Devaki. By this our interchange Kansa will be stupified. Then taking you by the leg he will dash you against a stone; you will then at once go up to the sky and attain to your eternal region. goddess, there the effulgence of your face will be like that of Sangkarshana and your body will be dark-blue like mine and your arms will be as huge as those of mine.

units.sanskrit: शशिरश्मिप्रकाशेन हारेणोरसि राजता ॥ दिव्यकुण्डलपूर्णाभ्यां श्रवणाभ्यां विभूषिता । चन्द्रसापत्न्यभूतेन त्वं मुखेन विराजिता ॥ मुकुटेन त्रिचक्रेण केशबन्धेन शोभिता । भुजगाभोगनिर्घोषैर् बाहुभिः परिघोपमैः ॥
units.english: sleep, when armed with an uplifted mace of three heads, and with a dagger of golden handles, when with a cup full of wine and a clean lotus, when adorned with a blue raiment and a yellow cloth thrown round your breast, you will occupy the road of the celestials, your breast will adorned with a necklace shining like the rays of the moon, your two ears will be adorned with two celestial Kundalas and your countenance will shine like the moon -.

units.sanskrit: अङ्गजेन मयूराणाम् अङ्गदेन च भास्वता ॥ कीर्णा भूतगणैर् घोरैर् मन्निदेशानुवर्तिनी । कौमारं व्रतम् आस्थाय अत्रिदिवं त्वं गमिष्यसि ॥
units.english: goddess, adorned, at my command, with a wonderful crown and hair nets, with flags of peacock feather and Angadas, embellishing the ten quarters, with your dreadful arms resembling the serpents, encircled by terrible goblins and observing the vow of celibacy you will enter into the celestial region –.

units.sanskrit: तत्र त्वां शतदृक् शक्रो मत्प्रदिष्टेन कर्मणा । अभिषेकेण दिव्येन दैवतैः सह योक्ष्यते ॥
units.english: When you will reach the land of gods, the thousand-eyed Indra will confer upon you the dignity of a god by sprinkling you with water according to the rules laid down by me and accept you as his sister.

units.sanskrit: कुशिकस्य तु गोत्रेण कौशिकी त्वं भविष्यसि ॥
units.english: Having been adopted in the family of Kushika you will pass by the name of Koushika –.

units.sanskrit: स ते विन्ध्ये नगश्रेष्ठे स्थानं दास्यति शाश्वतम् । ततः स्थानसहस्रेऐस् त्वं पृथिवीं शोभयिष्यसि ॥ ततः सुम्भनिसुम्भौ अ दानवौ नगचार्तिणौ । तौ च कृत्वा मनसि मां सानुगौ नाशयिष्यसि ॥ त्रैलोक्यचारिणी सा त्वं भुवि सत्योपयाचिता । भविष्यसि महाभागे वरदा कामरूपिणी ॥
units.english: Afterwards when Vāsava will assign to you the mount Vindhyā for your habitation you will adorn the world with thousand provinces. On whomever on earth you will bestow a boon while ranging of your own accord in the three worlds, he will at once attain to the fruit thereof. goddess, there thinking of me in your mind, and starting with the goblins you will kill the two demons Shumbha and Nishumbha living in mountain, with all their attendants. sleep, you are greatly fond of an offering of meat.

units.sanskrit: तिथौ नवम्यां पूजां च प्राप्स्यसे सपशुक्रियाम् ॥
units.english: You will therefore, on a Navami, receive, on earth, worship accompanied by the sacrifice of beasts.

units.sanskrit: ये च त्वां मत्प्रभावज्ञाः प्रणमिष्यन्ति मानवाः । न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचित् पुत्रतो धनतो ऽपि वा ॥
units.english: Children or wealth, it will not be difficult to acquire any of these for him, who, amongst men cognizant of my prowess, will bow unto you.

units.sanskrit: कान्तारेष्व् अवसन्नानां म्गनानां च महार्णवे । दस्युभिर् वा निरुद्धानां त्वं गतिः परमा नृणाम् ॥
units.english: You will save them all from danger, those who will be tired in a huge forest, those who will be drowned in a mighty deep, those who will be attacked by robbers. auspicious lady, will not kill him who will propitiate you with devotion nor will he meet with ruin at my hands .

units.sanskrit: त्वं सिद्धिः श्रीर् धृतिः कीर्तिर् ह्रीर् विद्या संनतिर् मतिः । संध्या रात्रिः प्रभा निद्रा कालरात्रिस् तथैव च ॥
units.english: goddess, thou art the salvation, intelligence, glory, bashfulness, learning, advancement and inclination of all the worlds. Thou art identical with twilight, night, ray, sleep and the night of death.

units.sanskrit: अहम् अप्य् आत्मनो वृत्तिं विधास्ये गोषु गोपवत् । स्ववृद्ध्यर्थम् अहं चैव करिष्ये कंसघातनम् ॥
units.english: Stupifying Kansa thou shalt alone enjoy the world. And shall adopt the life of a milk-man amongst kine. For accomplishing my own work shall become Kansa's milk-man.

units.sanskrit: एवं तु तां समादिश्य गतो ऽन्तर्धानम् ईश्वरः । सा चापि तं नमस्कृत्य तथास्त्व् इति विनिर्गता ॥
units.english: Having thus addressed the goddess of sleep the lord disappeared and she too, saluting him, expressed her consent by saying, So be it.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच कृते गर्भविधाने तु देवकी देवतोपमा । जग्राह सप्त तान् गर्भान् यथावत् समुदाहृतान् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Under these arrangements the celestial-like Devaki conceived for seven times as described before.

units.sanskrit: षड्गर्भान् निःसृतान् कंसस् ताञ् जघान शिलातले । आपन्नं सप्तमं गर्भं सा निनायाथ रोहिणीम् ॥
units.english: Kansa killed the Sargarbhas by dashing them against a stone, as soon as they came out. The embryo of the seventh conception was transferred to Rohini.

units.sanskrit: निद्रया सहसाविष्टा पपात धरणीतले ॥ सा स्वप्नम् इव तं दृष्ट्वा गर्भं निःसृतम् आत्मनः । अपश्यन्ती च तं गर्भं मुहूर्तं व्यथिताभवत् ॥
units.english: Once on a time at the dead of night while Rohini was sleeping a sound sleep there took place a discharge of blood followed by an abortion. Rohini, in a dream, saw the falling of her embryo and when she awoke, a little after, she was greatly pained on not seeing it.

units.sanskrit: ताम् आह निद्रा संविग्नां नैशे तमसि रोहिणीम् । रोहिणीम् इव सोमस्य वसुदेवस्य रोहिणीम् ॥ कर्सणेनास्य गर्भस्य स्वगर्भे चाहितस्य वै । संकर्षणो नाम शुभे तव पुत्रो भविष्यति ॥
units.english: In that dark night Vasudeva's wife Rohini, resembling the moon, was worked up with great anxiety; thereat the goddess of sleep said to her. fair one, have extracted the embryo out of Devaki's womb and placed it in yours. Therefore this your son will be celebrated by the name of Sangkarshana.

units.sanskrit: सा तं पुत्रम् अवाप्यैव हृष्टा किंचिद् अवाङ्मुखी । विवेश रोहिणी वेश्म सुप्रभा रोहिणी यथा ॥
units.english: Obtaining that son she was pleased and with her head down she entered her own house like the beautiful wife of the moon.

units.sanskrit: तस्य गर्भस्य मार्गेण गर्भम् आधत्त देवकी । यदर्थं सप्त ते गर्भाः कंसेन विनिपातिताः ॥
units.english: When people grew anxious of instituting enquiries about the seventh conception of Devaki she conceived him for the eighth time for whom Kansa had killed her seven children.

units.sanskrit: स तत्र गर्भवसतिं वसत्य् आत्मेच्छया हरिः ॥
units.english: Kansa's servants began to watch it with great care wherein the Lord Hari was living of his own accord.

units.sanskrit: विष्णोः शरीरजां निद्रां विष्णोर् निर्देशकारिणीम् ॥
units.english: Yashodā too conceived the goddess of sleep, begotten of a portion of Vishnu's energy and intent on carrying out his command.

units.sanskrit: गर्भकाले त्व् असंपूर्णे अष्टमे मासि ते स्त्रियौ । देवकी च यशोदा च सुषुवाते समं तदा ॥
units.english: Before the period of conception was complete, in the eighth month both Devaki and Yashodā simultaneously gave birth to their children.

units.sanskrit: याम् एव रजनीं कृष्णो जज्ञे वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः । तुल्यकालं हि गर्भिण्यौ यशोदा देवकी तथा । देवक्य् अजनयद् विष्णुं यशोदा तां तु कन्यकाम् । जज्वलुश् चाग्नयः शान्ता जायमाने जनार्दने ॥ शिवाः संप्रववुर् वाताः प्रशान्तम् अभवद् रजः । ज्योतींसि च प्रकाशन्त जायमाने जनार्दने ॥
units.english: In the same night in which Krishna was born in the race of Vrishnis, Yashodā gave birth to her daughter. Vasudeva's wife Devaki and Nanda's wife Yashoda, both of them, conceived at the same time. In the auspicious midnight and in Abkijit Muhurtta, Devaki gave birth to Vishnu and Yashodā to that daughter. When Janārddana was born, the oceans were agitated, the pillars of the earth were shaken, the fires, that had been extinguished, began to burn, auspicious winds began to blow, the dust was removed and the luminous bodies manifested themselves –.

units.sanskrit: अभिजिन् नाम नक्षत्रं जयन्ती नाम शर्वरी । मुहूर्तो विजयो नाम यत्र जातो जनार्दनः ॥ अव्यक्तः शाश्वतः सूक्ष्मो हरिनारायणः प्रभुः । जायते भगवांस् तत्र नयनैर् मोहयञ् जगत् । अनाहता दुंदुभयो देवानां प्राणदन् दिवि । आकाशात् पुष्पवर्षं च ववर्ष त्रिदिवेश्वरः ॥
units.english: When the invisible, eternal and powerful Lord Hari of subtle soul, who encompasses the well-being of the world, was born, the night was Jayanti, the Nakshatra was Abhijit and Muhurtta was Vijaya. As soon as he was born he overpowered all the worlds with his looks. The celestial bugles began to produce sound without being struck and the king of gods showered flowers from the etherial region.

units.sanskrit: महर्षयः सगन्धर्वा उपतस्थुः सहाप्सराः ॥
units.english: The great saints, accompanied by the Gandharvas and Apsaras, chanted the glories of the slayer of Madhu in auspicious hymns.

units.sanskrit: जायमाने हृषीकेशे प्रहृष्टम् अभवज् जगत् । इन्द्रश् च त्रिदशैः सार्धं तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम् ॥
units.english: When Hrishikesha was born the whole universe was in an ecstacy of joy –. Indra too, along with the gods, eulogised the glories of Madhusudhana.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेवस् तु तं रात्रौ जातं पुत्रम् अधोक्षजम् । श्रीवत्सलक्षणं दृष्ट्वा युतं दिव्यैश् च लक्षणैः । मम पुत्रा हतास् तेन तव ज्येष्ठाम्बुजेक्षण ॥
units.english: Seeing, in that night, Vishnu born as his son, bearing the mystic mark of Srivasta and other signs of divinity Vasudeva said to him, lord, do thou withdraw this form of thine. thou having lotus-eyes, have been greatly terrified, on account of my sons, your elder brothers, being slain by Kansa and therefore speak thus –.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेववचः श्रुत्वा रूपं संहरद् अच्युतः । अनुज्ञाप्य पितृत्वेन नन्दगोपगृहं नय । यशोदाया गृहं भीतो विवेश सुतवत्सलः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing the words of Vasudeva the lord withdrew his form of four arms and addressing him as his father asked him to take him to the house of the milkman Nanda. Taking that boy, Vasudeva too, fond of his sons, speedily repaired to the house of Yashodā.

units.sanskrit: गृह्य तां दारिकां चापि देवकीशयने ऽन्यसत् ॥
units.english: Placing his son in her house against her knowledge he brought her daughter and placed her on Devaki's bedstead.

units.sanskrit: परिवर्ते कृते ताभ्यां गर्भाभ्यां भयविक्लवः । वसुदेवः कृतार्थो वै निर्जगाम निवेशनात् ॥
units.english: After the children had been exchanged Anakadundhubi Vasudeva, having accomplished his work and his mind filled with fear, issued out of his house and communicated to Ugrasena's son Kansa the birth of a beautiful daughter -.

units.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा त्वरितः कंसो रक्षिभिः सह वेगितः । आजगाम गृहद्वारं वसुदेवस्य वीर्यवान् ॥ स तत्र त्वरितो द्वारि किं जातम् इति चाब्रवीत् । ततो हाहाकृताः सर्वा देवकीप्रमुखाः स्त्रियः । उवाच देवकी दीना बाष्पविक्लवया गिरा । दृष्ट्वा कंसस् तु तां कन्याम् अहृष्यत मुदा युतः । हतैवैषा यदा कन्या जातेत्य् उक्त्वा वृथामतिः ॥
units.english: Hearing it the powerful Kansa quickly arrived at Vasudeva's door and enquired of him about what was born. He then ordered him to hand over the new born babe, and remonstrated with him severely -. Hearing this all the women of Devaki's family cried aloud and she, herself shedding tears, prayed humbly to him; lord, you have already killed my seven beautiful sons. have taken this new-born daughter for already slain. Do what you think proper. Seeing that girl and drawing her out the wicked-minded Kansa said:—While a daughter is born she is already killed.

units.sanskrit: सा गर्भशयने क्लिष्टा गर्भाम्बुक्लिन्नमूर्धजा । कंसस्य पुरतो न्यस्ता पृथिव्यां पृथिवीसमा ॥ पादे तां गृह्य पुरुषः समाविध्यावधूय च । जगामाकाशम् आविश्य दिव्यस्रगनुलेपना । हारशोभितसर्वाङ्गी मुकुटोज्ज्वलभूषिता । कन्यैव चाभवन् नित्यं दिव्या देवैर् अभिष्टुता ॥ नीलपीताम्बरधरा गजकुम्भोपमस्तनी । रथविस्तीर्णजघना चन्द्रवक्त्रा चतुर्भुजा ॥ विद्युद्विस्पष्टवर्णाभा बालार्कसदृशेक्षणा । पयोधरस्वनवती संध्येव सपयोधरा ॥
units.english: That girl, equal to the earth herself, who was wearied on account of her living in the womb and whose hairs were wet with the water thereof, was placed before him on the ground. Taking her with contempt by the legs and whirling her Kansa dashed her against a stone. Although thrown on a rock in derision, that girl, who is daily worshipped by the gods, was not crushed. On the other hand, casting off her human from and being adorned with celestial garlands, pastes, and a shining crown she, with dishevelled hairs and remonstrating with Kansa, rose up in the sky –. She was clad in a dark blue raiment, her breasts were rising, her hip was spacious like a car and she had four arms. Her colour was shining like lightning, her eyes were like the rising sun, and she was like a clouded evening.

units.sanskrit: सा वै निशि तमोग्रस्ते बभौ भूतगणाकुले । नृत्यती हसती चैव विपरीतेन भास्वती ॥ विहायसगता रौद्रा पपौ पानम् अनुत्तमम् । जहास च महाहासं कंसं च रुषिताब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: That dreadful girl, having a moon-like countenance, and roaring like a cloud, was surrounded by ghosts and goblins. Dancing and laughing in that dark night she rose up in the sky. Drinking most excellent wine and laughing aloud she, in anger, said to Kansa –.

units.sanskrit: कंस कंस विनाशाय यद् अहं घातिता त्वया । तस्मात् तवान्तकाले ऽहं कृष्यमाणस्य शत्रुणा । पाटयित्वा करैर् देहम् उष्णं पास्यामि शोणितम् ॥
units.english: Kansa, for thy own destruction thou hast whirled and dashed me against a rock. Therefore at the time of thy death when thy enemy will attack thee will tear off thy body with my hands and drink thy hot blood -.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा वचो घोरं सा यथेष्टेन वर्त्मना । खं सा देवालयं देवी सगणा विचचार ह ॥
units.english: Giving vent to these dreadful words, the goddess, by her own wished-for way, rose up in the sky; and encircled by her own followers and in that form she began to range in the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: सा कन्या ववृधे अत्र वृष्णिसद्मनि पूजिता । पुत्रवत् पाल्यमाना सा देवी देवाज्ञया तदा ॥
units.english: That girl, worshipped by Vrishnis, grew up there. By the command of their kings the gods brought her up like a child.

units.sanskrit: एकानंशां योगकन्यां रक्षार्थं केशवस्य तु ॥
units.english: That daughter, who was formerly created by Brahmā through his yoga, was born with the Lord for protecting Keshava.

units.sanskrit: देववद्दिव्यवपुषं कृष्णः संरक्षितो यया । तस्यां गतायां कंसस् तु तां मेने मृत्युम् आत्मनः । विविक्ते देवकीं चैव व्रीडितः प्रत्यभाषत ॥
units.english: The Yādāvas daily worship her, who in her celestial form, protected Krishna. After her departure Kansa took her for the instrument of his death. And being ashamed he secretly said to Devaki.

units.sanskrit: पितृष्वसः कृतो यत्नस् तव गर्भा हता मया । अन्यथैवान्यतो देवि मम मृत्युः समुत्थितः ॥
units.english: Kansa said:— Sister, have made endless attempts to escape the hand of death, and for this, have destroyed many of your children. Madam, my death has now come from another quarter.

units.sanskrit: नैराश्येन कृतो यत्नः स्वजने प्रहृतं मया । दैवं पुरुषकारेण न चातिक्रान्तवान् अहम् ॥
units.english: Alas! being ruthless, have, with care, slain my own kinsmen, but have not been able to supersede destiny by my manliness.

units.sanskrit: त्यज गर्भकृतां चिन्तां त्वम् इमां शोककारिकाम् । हेतुभूतस् त्व् अहं तेषां सति कालविपर्यये ॥
units.english: Under the influence of bad time, have been the instrument of their death. Therefore cast off your anxiety for the destruction of your embryos and your sorrow for the death of your sons.

units.sanskrit: काल एव नृणां शत्रुः कालश् च परिणामकः । कालो नयति सर्वं वै हेतुभूतश् च मद्विधः ॥
units.english: It is Time that is the enemy of all and brings about their destruction. It is Time that moves every thing. People, like me, are merely the instruments.

units.sanskrit: आगमिष्यन्ति वै देवि यथाभागम् उपद्रवः । इदं तु कष्टं यज् जन्तुः कर्ताहम् इति मन्यते । मा कार्षीः पुत्रजां चिन्तां विलापं शोकजं त्यज । एवंप्राया नृणां योनिर् नास्ति कालस्य संस्थितिः ॥
units.english: lady, calamities, the inevitable out-come of one’s own deeds, arrive of them selves in proper time. But pity it is that they think am the doer. Do not lament for your sons and renounce your grief. Such is the course of men and no body can undo the work of Time.

units.sanskrit: पतामि पादयोर् मूर्ध्ना पुत्रवत् तव देवकि । मद्गतस् त्यज्यतां रोषो जानाम्य् अपकृतं स्वयम् ॥
units.english: The mischiefs, that have done to you, are all present in my mind. throw myself at your feet like a son. Be not offended with me.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तवन्तं कंसं सा देवकी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । साश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना भर्तारम् अभिवीक्षती । देवक्य् उवाच ममाग्रतो हता गर्भा ये त्वया कालरूपिणा । कारणं त्वं न वै पुत्र कृतान्तो ह्य् अत्र कारणम् ॥ गर्भकृन्तनम् एतन् मे सहनीयं त्वया कृतम् । मूर्ध्ना पद्भ्यां निपतता स्वं च कर्म जुगुप्सता ॥ गर्भे ऽपि नियतो मृत्युर् बाल्ये ऽपि न निवर्तते । युवापि मृत्योर् वशगः स्थविरो मृत एव तु ॥
units.english: After Kansa had said this, the poor Devaki, with her face bathed in tears, and casting her looks upon her husband said—Rise up, my brother, rise up. And then she addressed to him the following. Devaki said:—Being like the veritable Death, you have killed, before my very eyes, all my children. You are not to blame for this. Death himself is the instrument hereof. forgive you for the sin that you have committed by destroying my children, since, touching my feet with your head you are repenting for your mis-deeds. Death, in old age and while in the womb, is however inevitable. And it is equally difficult to escape its hand even in boyhood and youth.

units.sanskrit: कालमूलम् इदं सर्वं हेतुभूतस् त्वम् एव हि । अजाते दर्शनं नास्ति यथा नास्ति तथैव सः । जातो ऽप्य् अजाततां याति विधात्रा यत्र नीयते ॥
units.english: This is all the work of Time; you are merely an instrument. One, who is not born, is not to be seen like air. One, who being born attains to the condition of one not born is to be considered as such.

units.sanskrit: तद् गच्छ पुत्र मा ते भून् मद्गतं मन्युकारणम् । मृत्युनापहृते पूर्वं शेषो हेतुः प्रवर्तते ॥
units.english: Therefore, go, my child, you are not the cause of my children's death. On account of various rites, pristine actions, the time of creation, the works of parents, people meet with death.

units.sanskrit: निशम्य देवकीवाक्यं स कंसः स्वम् निवेशनम् । प्रविवेश सुसंरब्धो दह्यमानेन चेतसा । वैशंपायन उवाच प्राग् एव वसुदेवस् तु व्रजे शुश्राव रोहिणीम् । स नन्दगोपं त्वरितः प्रोवाच शुभया गिरा । गच्छानया सह त्वं तु व्रजम् एव यशोदया ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Devaki, Kansa, worked up with anger and his heart consuming, entered his own house. His object being baffled he went there depressed and absent-minded –. Vaishampayana said:—Vasudeva had already heard of the son, more beautiful than the moon, given birth to by Rohini in the village of Vraja. He, without delay, said to the milkman Nanda, in sweet words Quickly go to Vraja with Yashodā.

units.sanskrit: तत्रेमौ दारकौ गत्वा जातकर्मादिभिर् गुणैः । योजयित्वा व्रजे तात संवर्धय यथासुखम् । रौहिणेयं च मे पुत्रं परिरक्ष शिशुं व्रजे ॥
units.english: Having performed the various rites consequent upon their birth do you happily bring up in Vraja those two boys -. Do you carefully protect in Vraja that son of mine whom Rohini has given birth to.

units.sanskrit: अहं वाच्यो भविष्यामि पितृपक्षेषु पुत्रिणाम् । यो ऽहम् एकस्य पुत्रस्य न पश्यामि शिशोर् मुखम् ॥
units.english: My name will then be mentioned as having a son in the list of the ancestral manes. Alas, have not been able to see the face of my only son.

units.sanskrit: ह्रियते हि बलात् प्रज्ञा प्राज्ञस्यापि सतो मम । अस्माद् धि मे भयं कंसान् निर्घृणाद् वै शिशोर् वधे ॥ विघ्ना हि बहवो लोके बालान् उत्त्रासयन्ति हि ॥ स च पुत्रो मम ज्यायान् कनीयांस् तव चाप्य् अयम् । वर्धमानाव् उभाव् एतौ समानवयसौ यथा । शोभेतां गोव्रजे तस्मिन् नन्दगोप तथा कुरु ॥
units.english: Although am wise this is stealing away my wisdom. specially fear this woked Kansa for he does not feel the least mercy when he kills the children. Besides various other dangers threaten the children in this world. My son is the eldest and your son is the youngest. The import of their names is also the same. Therefore bring them up with equal care. They are both of equal age.

units.sanskrit: न च वृन्दावने कार्यो गवां घोषः कदाचन । तत्रासौ वसति क्रूरो मांसभोजी दुरात्मवान् । तत्र वासे तु भेतव्यं केशिनः पापदर्शिनः ॥ गोष्ठेषु गोभ्यो वत्सेभ्यो रक्ष्यौ ते द्वाव् इमौ शिशू ॥ नन्दगोप गता रात्रिः शीघ्रयानो व्रजाशुगः । इमे त्वां त्वरयन्तीह पक्षिणः सव्यदक्षिणाः ॥
units.english: In their childhood, everybody takes his own way, becomes naughty and commits mistakes. Therefore train them with great care. Never make your cow-sheds in Vrindavana for there is every fear of the wicked Keshi, of various reptiles, insects and vultures. Protect those two boys against the cows and calves in the cow-shed -. Nanda, night is almost over. Go soon to Vraja. See, the birds in the south are also asking you to do so.

units.sanskrit: रहिते वसुदेवेन सो ऽनुज्ञातो महात्मना । यानं यशोदया सार्धम् आरुरोह मुदा युतः ॥
units.english: Hearing of this secret intelligence from the large-minded Vasudeva, Nanda was greatly pleased and ascended his conveyance along with Yashoda.

units.sanskrit: कुमारं स्कन्धवाह्यायां शिविकायां समाहितः । स जगाम विविक्तेन शीतानिलविसर्पिणा । बहूदकेन मार्गेन यमुनातीरशोभिना ॥ स ददर्श शिवे देशे गोवर्धननगोपगे । यमुनातीरसंबद्धं शीतमारुतसेवितम् ॥ विरतश्वापदं रम्यं लतावल्लीमहाद्रुमम् । गोभिस् तृणनिमग्नाभिः स्यन्दन्तीभिर् अलंकृतम् ॥ समप्रचारं च गवां समतीर्थजलाशयम् । विषाणस्कन्धघातैश् च वृषाणां घृष्टपादपम् ॥ भासामिपादानुसृतं श्येनैश् चामिषगृद्धिभिः । सृगालमृगसिंहैश् च वसामेदोशिभिर् वृतम् ॥
units.english: He placed the baby prince on a vehicle carried by men on their shoulders. He then proceeded by a road situate on the bank of Yamunā, sprinkled with profuse water and filled with cool air. Thus proceeding to some distance he saw Vraja, the charming village of cows, situated on the bank of Yamunā near the mount Govarddhana and filled with cool air. It was adorned with animals emitting sweet cries, huge trees covered with creepers, and kine, giving milk and grazing. That place was so beautifully level that the kine could range there at ease and the tanks there had all well-levelled stairs. The trees were scratched by the humps and horns of the bulls. Vultures, wild cats, falcons and other birds, who are fond of flesh and always follow them, and other beasts more powerful than they, such as jackals, leopards and lions always live there.

units.sanskrit: शार्दूलशब्दाभिरुतं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम् । स्वादुपुष्पफलं रम्यं पर्याप्ततृणसंस्तरम् ॥ गोव्रजं गोरुतशिवं गोपनारीभिर् आवृतम् । हम्भारवैश् च वत्सानां सर्वतः कृतनिस्वनम् ॥
units.english: That place, covered with profuse grass, was filled with birds of various species and the roaring of tigers, was well adorned with trees crested with sweet fruits and was resonant with the auspicious sound of kine, and calves. That charming village was filled with milk-maids –. The roads, for carriage, were spacious there.

units.sanskrit: सकटावर्तविपुलं कण्टकीवाटसंकुलम् । पर्यन्तेश्व् आवृतं वन्यैर् बृहद्भिः पतितैर् द्रुमैः ॥ वत्सानां रोपितैः कीलैर् दामभिश् च विभूषितम् । क्षमप्रचारबहुलं हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम् । दारकैर् दारिकाभिश् च परस्परसमाकुलम् । सार्गलद्वारगोवाटं मध्ये गोस्थानसंकुलम् । सर्पिषा पच्यमानेन सुरभीकृतमारुतम् ॥
units.english: It was covered with thorns and its outside was filled with fallen huge trees. All through the circumference there were stakes fixed on the ground an ropes for the calves; and it was filled with cow-dungs. The temples and cottages there were covered with grass. It was filled with the sound of churning. State officials, possessing all the signs of prosperity and well-developed and delighted persons always live there. The ground there was saturated with the leavings of curd and the drains were covered with moss and it was filled with the sound of the churning bangles of milk-women.

units.sanskrit: नीलपीताम्बराभिश् च तरुणीभिः समन्ततः । वन्यपुष्पावतंसाभिर् गोपकन्याभिर् आवृतम् ॥
units.english: The cow-sheds were all properly protected by well-shut doors; inside them were the houses for cows. It was filled with the play-grounds of milk-men and abounded in boys wearing feathers of crows.

units.sanskrit: सर्वास् ताश् चन्द्रवदना गोपनार्यः सुशोभनाः ॥ तासां नूपुरशब्देन मेखलानां स्वनेन च । स्वनन्तीनां च शब्देन मयूरा ननृतुस् तदा । शिरसा धृतकुम्भाभिर् बद्धैर् उद्ग्रथिताम्बरैः । यमुनातीरमार्गेण जलहारीभिर् आवृतम् ॥ स तत्र प्रविशन् हृष्टो गोव्रजं गोपनादितम् । प्रत्युद्गतो गोपवृद्धैः स्त्रीभिर् वृद्धाभिर् एव च । निवेशं रोचयामास परिवर्ते सुखाश्रये ॥ सा यत्र रोहिणी देवी वसुदेवसुखावहा । तत्र तं बालसूर्याभं कृष्णं गूढं न्यवेशयत् ॥
units.english: The youthful damsels of milk-men, clad in blue raiments, prepare clarified butter and accordingly there blows sweet-scented air. Having their heads adorned with garlands of wild flowers and their breasts covered with jackets, the milk-maids, with jars of milk on their heads, always walk about there. The road, on the bank of Yamunā, was also filled with milk-maids, carrying water. When the milk-man Nanda, with a delighted heart, entered by this way to his village there arose a great shout of joy amongst the men of his clan. The elderly milk men and women came out and received him in the city. He also went to that delightful place of his own accord. Thereupon going to the beloved wife of Vasudeva Rohiai, he placed there the mystic Purusha Krishna, resembling the rising sun –.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच तत्र तस्यासतः कालः सुमहान् अत्यवर्तत । ज्येष्ठः संकर्षणो नाम यवीयान् कृष्ण एव तु ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Without showing himself properly the Lord spent a considerable time as a milk-man in the village of Nanda. Of those two boys the eldest was named Sangkarshana and the youngest Krishna.

units.sanskrit: मेघकृष्णस् तु कृष्णो ऽभूद् देहान्तरगतो हरिः । व्यवर्धत गवां मध्ये सागरस्य इवाम्बुदः ॥
units.english: Incarnating himself as Krishna the Lord Hari, assuming the dark-blue hue of the cloud, grew up there in the midst of milk-men like a cloud in the ocean.

units.sanskrit: शकटस्य त्व् अधः सुप्तं कदाचित् पुत्रगृद्धिनी । यशोदा तं समुत्सृज्य जगाम यमुनां नदीम् ॥
units.english: One day while Krishna fell asleep under a carriage, Yashoda, fond of her sons, went to the river Yamunā leaving him there.

units.sanskrit: हास्यं कुर्वञ् शिशुः कृष्णो नेत्राभ्यां परिविभ्रमन् ॥
units.english: Thereupon to sport there like a child Krishna began to cry and throw up his arms.

units.sanskrit: स तत्रैकेन पादेन शकटं पर्यवर्तयत् । न्युब्जं पयोधराकाङ्क्षी चकार च रुरोद च ॥
units.english: Then raising up his legs he overturned the carriage with one of them. And then crawling on his legs he began to cry for milk –.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे प्राप्ता यशोदा शीघ्रगामिनी । स्नाता प्रस्नवदिग्धाङ्गी बद्धवत्सेव सौरभी ॥
units.english: In the meantime, Yashodā, having finished her bath and her person wetted with the milk of her breast like a milch cow, when its calf is tied, came there with her mind stricken with fear.

units.sanskrit: सा ददर्श विपर्यस्तं शकटं वायुना विना । हाहेति कृत्वा त्वरिता दारकं जगृहे तदा ॥
units.english: She saw there the carriage over turned without any wind. And then crying aloud she speedily took up her child.

units.sanskrit: न सा बुबोध तत् तेन शकटं परिवर्तितम् । स्वस्ति मे दारकायेति प्रीत्या भीता च साभवत् ॥ किं नु वक्ष्यति ते पुत्र पिता परमकोपनः । किं मे स्नानेन दुःस्नानं किं च मे गमने नदीम् । पर्यस्ते शकटे पुत्र या त्वा पश्याम्य् अपावृतम् ॥
units.english: She could not truly make out how the carriage was overturned; and then filled with fear she said to her boy my child, your father is highly wrathful. do not know what he will say when he will come to know of your sleeping under the carriage and of its being overturned. What is the use of my bathing? What business had to go to go the river. On account of this foolish act of mine saw you under the overturned carriage.

units.sanskrit: काषाये वाससी बिभ्रन् नन्दगोपो व्रजान्तिकम् ॥
units.english: Clad in a silken raiment Nanda had gone to the forest to tend his kine.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्श विपर्यस्तं भिन्नभाण्डघटीघटम् । अपास्तधूर्विभग्नाक्षं शकटं चक्रमालि वै ॥ भीतस् त्वरितम् आगम्य सहसा साश्रुलोचनः । अपि मे स्वस्ति पुत्रायेत्य् असकृद् वचनं वदन् ॥ पिबन्तं स्तनम् आलक्ष्य पुत्रं स्वस्थो ऽब्रवीत् पुनः । वृषयुद्धं विना केन पर्यस्तं शकटं मम ॥
units.english: When he returned to his own house in Vraja he saw the carriage upset. Its two wheels were raised up. The axles, the pitcher and the rod were all broken Seeing this he was greatly terrified and coming quickly with eyes full of tears he repeatedly asked Is my son all right?. When he saw his son sucking the breast of Yashodā he was relieved of his anxiety and asked how the carriage was upset without the fighting of the bulls.

units.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच यशोदा तं भीता गद्गदभाषिणी । न विजानाम्य् अहं केन शकटं पातितं भुवि ॥
units.english: Terrified and with a suppressed voice Yashoda replied: gentle one, do not know who has upset this carriage.

units.sanskrit: अहं गता नदीम् आर्य चैलप्रक्षालनार्थिनी । तयोः कथयतोर् एवम् अब्रुवंस् तत्र दारकाः । अनेन शिशुना यानम् एतत् पादेन पातितम् । नन्दगोपस् तु तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं ययौ । प्रहृष्टश् चैव भीतश् च किम् एतद् इति चिन्तयन् । न च ते श्रद्दधुर् गोपाः सर्वे मानुषबुद्धयः । आश्चर्यम् इति ते सर्वे विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः । स्वस्थाने शकटं चैव चक्रबन्धम् अकारयन् ॥
units.english: had been to the river to wash my cloth. When came back saw it overturned –. While they were thus talking, the boys, who were present there, said:—When we came here of our own accord we saw this boy upsetting the carriage with his feet. Hearing this the milkman Nanda was filled with great surprise –. Pleased and terrified he began to think how could this be. The other milkmen, having the ordinary intelligence of men, placed no confidence in the words of the boys. Filled with wonder and having their eyes expanded accordingly they replaced the carriage and tied its wheels.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच कस्यचित् त्व् अथ कालस्य सकुनीवेषधारिणी । धात्री कंसस्य भोजस्य पूतनेति परिश्रुता । प्रसार्य गोष्ठे निजरूपम् आश्रिता । वज्राहतो वृत्र इवापतन् नृप ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Once on a time in the mid-night, Kansa's nurse, the dreadful Putanā, creating the fear of life, went in the shape of a bird, capable of assuming forms at will, to village of milkmen, shaking her wings –. Entering, in the mid-night, into Vraja, roaring like a tiger, Putanā assumed the form of a woman.

units.sanskrit: निलिल्ये शकटाक्षे सा प्रस्नवोत्पीडवर्षिणी ॥ ददौ स्तनं च कृष्णाय तत्र सुप्तजने निशि । ननाद च महानादं पुनः पुनर् असौ हरिः । तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तास् ततो बुबुधिरे जनाः । स नन्दगोपो गोपाश् च यशोदा च सुविक्लवा ॥
units.english: And having her breast pressed by milk she lay down under the wheel of the carriage. When all the inhabitants of Vraja fell asleep she began to give milk to Krishna –. Thereupon drink ing up all her vital breaths together with her milk Krishna set up a terrible sound. She too, having her breast sundered, fell down earth. At that sound, Nanda, other milk-men and Yashodā awoke.

units.sanskrit: ते ताम् अपश्यन् पतितां विसंज्ञां विपयोधराम् । शकुनिं निहतां भूमौ वज्रेणेव विदारिताम् ॥
units.english: And they were all beside themselves with fear. They saw there Putanā lying down on the ground, bereft of her consciousness and breast, as if she had been crushed down by a thunder-bolt.

units.sanskrit: इदं किं न्व् इति संत्रस्ताः कस्येदं कर्म चेति च । नाध्यगच्छन्त च तदा हेतुं तत्र कदाचन । आश्चर्यम् आश्चर्यम् इति ब्रुवन्तो ऽनुययुर् गृहान् । गतेषु तेषु गोपेषु विस्मितेषु यथागृहम् । यशोदां नन्दगोपस् तु पप्रच्छागतसंभ्रमः ॥ को ऽयं विधिर् न जानामि विस्मयो मे महान् अयम् । पुत्रस्य मे भयं भीरु भीरुत्वं समुपागतम् ॥ यशोदा त्व् अब्रवीद् भीता नार्य जानामि किं न्व् इदम् ।
units.english: Exclaiming What is this? Who has done it? all the milkmen headed by Nanda stood around her. They however could not, by any means, find out the cause. Exclaiming repeatedly Wonder! Wonder! they went to their own houses. After the milkmen had gone away to their respective homes filled with wonder, Nanda respectfully said to Yashodā:— timid lady, have been struck with great wonder and have not been able to trace out its cause. What ever it may be, am really afraid. Is there any danger for my son –? Yashoda, too, stricken with fear, replied:— reverend Sir, was asleep with my son and was roused up by this terrible sound.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच काले गच्छति सौम्यौ तौ दारकौ कृतनामकौ । पञ्च संवत्सरान् प्राप्तौ शोभयानौ व्रजं मुहुः । कृष्णसंकर्षणौ चोभौ रिङ्गिनौ समपद्यताम् ॥ ताव् अन्योन्यगतौ बालौ बाल्याद् एवैकतां गतौ । एकमन्त्रधरौ कान्तौ बालचन्द्रार्कवर्चसौ ॥ एकनिर्माणनिर्युक्ताव् एकशय्यासनाशनौ । एककार्यान्तरगताव् एकदेहौ द्विधा कृतौ । एकचर्यौ महावीर्याव् एकस्य शिशुतां गतौ ॥ एकप्रमाणौ लोकानां देववृत्तान्तमानुषौ । कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गोपौ संवृत्तौ गोपदारकौ ॥
units.english: Hearing the reply of Yashodā, Nanda, together with his friends, was filled with surprise and anticipated fear from Kansa. Vaishampayana said:—As time went on those two boys, named Krishna and Sangkarshana, began to crawl on their legs. Those two beautiful boys, resembling the rising sun, the same person in two bodies, as if turned out by one mould, began to assume the same form, to lie down on the same bed, to live on the same food, and to put on the same dress. They thus sported there like boys –. Those two great energies, identical with the witness of the worlds, although of one body, assumed two human forms for the destruction of the demons and for accomplishing the only great work of the resuscitation of sacrifices. Although they were the protectors of the entire universe they were born, for this, as cow-herds -.

units.sanskrit: अन्योन्यकिरणग्रस्तौ चन्द्रसूर्याव् इवाम्बरे ॥
units.english: While they sported there they appeared like the sun and moon in the sky possessed by each other's rays.

units.sanskrit: विसर्पन्तौ तु सर्वत्र सर्पभोगभुजाव् उभौ । रेजतुः पांशुदिग्धाङ्गौ दृप्तौ कलभकाव् इव ॥ क्वचिद् भस्मप्रदिग्धाङ्गौ करीषप्रोक्षितौ क्वचित् । क्वचिज् जानुभिर् उद्धृष्टैः सर्पमाणौ विरेजतुः । क्रीडन्तौ वत्सशालासु शकृद्दिग्धाङ्गमूर्धजौ ॥ जनं च विप्र कुर्वाणौ हसन्तौ च क्वचित् क्वचित् ॥
units.english: Going every where, they, having arms like serpents, appeared like two proud young elephants covered with dust. And sometimes with their persons pasted with ashes and powdered cow-dung they shone like two princes of fire. Sometimes they used to walk on knees and enter cow-sheds and used to sport there with their persons and hairs covered with cow-dung. Sometimes committing mischiefs to the inhabitants of Vraja those two boys used to create the delight of their sire with their laughing.

units.sanskrit: तौ बालकौ ललितकौ मूर्धजव्याकुलेक्षणौ । रेजतुश् चन्द्रवदनौ दारकौ सुकुमारकौ ॥
units.english: Those two beautiful boys, of moon-like countenances, used to appear more charming when filled with curiosity and their locks disturbing their eyes.

units.sanskrit: अतिप्रसक्तौ तौ दृष्ट्वा सर्वव्रजविचारिणौ । नाशक्नुवद् वारयितुम् नन्दगोपः सुदुर्मदौ ॥
units.english: They grew exceedingly playful and naughty and used to walk all over Vraja. And Nanda could not by any means check them.

units.sanskrit: ततो यशोदा संक्रुद्धा कृष्णं कमललोचनम् । आनाय्य शकटीमूलं भर्त्सयन्ती पुनः पुनः ॥ दाम्ना चैवोदरे बद्ध्वा प्रत्यबन्धद् उदूखले । यदि शक्नोषि गच्छेति तम् उक्त्वा कर्म साकरोत् । शिशुलीलां ततः कुर्वन् कृष्णो विस्मापयन् व्रजम् । सो ऽङ्गणान् निःसृतः कृष्णः कर्षमाण उदूखलम् ॥ स यमाभ्याम् प्रवृद्धाभ्याम् अर्जुनाभ्यां चरन् वने । तत् तस्य कर्षतो बद्धम् तिर्यग् गतम् उदूखलम् । ताव् अर्जुनौ कृष्यमाणौ तेन बालेन रंहसा । समूलविटपौ भग्नौ स तु मध्ये जहास वै ॥
units.english: One day Yasoda, worked up with anger, brought the lotus-eyed Krishna near the carriage. And fastening a rope round his waist and tying it to a mortar she repeatedly remonstrating with him, said Go, if you are capable of doing it. Saying this she engaged in her work –. When Yashodā was engaged in her household works, Krishna, with a view to surprise the inhabitants of Vraja and play, issued out of the courtyard. Going out of the courtyard with that mortar Krishna went to the forest where the huge trees Yamala and Arjuna were. Placing that mortar between the two trees he began to drag it. For his thus dragging it the mortar was firmly fixed at the root of the trees. He then began to drag the trees Arjuna and Yamala. Being thus drawn by him with great force those two Arjuna trees were uprooted with their roots and branches.

units.sanskrit: निदर्शनार्थं गोपानां दिव्यं स्वबलम् आस्थितः । तद् दाम तस्य बालस्य प्रभावाद् अभवद् दृढम् ॥ यमुनातीरमार्गस्था गोप्यस् तं ददृशुः शिशुम् । क्रन्दन्त्यो विस्मयन्त्यश् च यशोदानिकटं ययुः ॥
units.english: In order to show this to the milk-men the Lord, resorting to his heavenly strength, began to laugh there. That rope, by his power, became stronger -. The milk-women, who were then going to the bank of the river Yamunā, saw the child in that condition and were filled with wonder. And weepingly they approached Yashodā.

units.sanskrit: तास् तु संभ्रान्तवदना यशोदाम् ऊचुर् अङ्गनाः । एह्य् आगच्छ यशोदेति संभ्रमे किं विलम्बसे ॥
units.english: The women, with sorry faces, said to her:—Tarry not a moment, Yashodā and come with us quickly.

units.sanskrit: ताव् एतौ तव पुत्रस्य पतिताव् उपरि द्रुमौ । पुत्रस्योपरि ताव् एतौ पतितौ ते महीरुहौ ॥
units.english: The two huge trees, that are being worshipped as gods on account of their granting objects of desire, have fallen on your son.

units.sanskrit: जहास मध्ये वृक्षाभ्यां तव पुत्रः स बालकः ॥
units.english: Being bound by a rope like a calf under the belly of the cow your boy is laughing between the two trees.

units.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ दुर्मेधे मूढे पण्डितमानिनि । पुत्रम् आनय जीवन्तुं मुक्तं मृत्युमुखाद् इव ॥
units.english: Get up and go, foolish woman. You think you are wise but you are stupid. Your son is alive as if he has been released from the mouth of Death.

units.sanskrit: सा भीता सहसोत्थाय हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वती । तं देशम् अगमद् यत्र पतितौ तौ महाद्रुमौ ॥
units.english: Hearing this she was stricken with fear and began to bewail. She then went where the two trees were uprooted.

units.sanskrit: ददर्श ताभ्यां सा मध्ये द्रुमाभ्याम् आत्मजं शिशुम् । जजल्पुर् जातसंभ्रान्ता सर्वे विस्मितचेतसः । केनेमौ पातितौ वृक्षौ घोषस्यैवाग्रपादपौ ॥ विना वातं विना वर्षं विद्युत्प्रपतनं विना । विना हस्तिकृतं दोषम् केनेमौ पातितौ द्रुमौ ॥ अहो बत न शोभेतां विमूलाव् अर्जुनाव् इमौ । इमौ निपतितौ भूमौ वितोयौ जलदाव् इव ॥ यदीमौ घोषरचितौ घोषकल्याणकारिणौ । नन्दगोप प्रसन्नौ ते द्रुमाव् एवंगताव् अपि । यत्र ते दारको मुक्तो विमूलाभ्याम् अविक्षतः ॥
units.english: She saw there her child placed between the two trees with the rope round his waist and dragging the mortar. All the milk-men and women, aged or youthful, of Vraja went there quickly to witness this wonderful scene. Those milk-men, who range in the forest, began to speak amongst themselves Who has uprooted these two huge trees as if forming the extent of our village ? There is no storm, no rain, no fall of thunderbolt and no mischief created by elephants. Then why have these two trees, all on a sudden, fallen down ? Alas! being felled down on the ground these two trees are shorn of beauty like clouds divested of water. Nanda, these two Arjuna trees are very favourably disposed towards you and bent upon doing you good. Although they are huge they have fallen in such a way saving your child that his body has not been wounded in the least –.

units.sanskrit: औत्पातिकम् इदं घोषे तृतीयं वर्तते त्व् इह । पूतनाया निपातश् च द्रुमयोः शकटस्य च ॥
units.english: Before this Putanā had been slain and the carriage broken. And this uprooting of the trees is the third portend in Vraja.

units.sanskrit: अस्मिन् स्थाने निवेशो ऽयं घोषस्यास्य न विद्यते । उत्पाता ह्य् अत्र दृश्यन्ते कथयन्तो नशोभनम् ॥ नन्दगोपस् तु सहसा मुक्त्वा कृष्णम् उदूखलात् । निवेश्य चाङ्के सुचिरं मृतं पुनर् इवागतम् ॥
units.english: It is not meet for the milkmen to live any longer in this village, for these portends do not auger well. foremost of Bharatas, while living amongst milk-men, although a mere boy, he performed all these wonderful feats. Vaishampayana said:—In this way, Krishna and Sangkarshana passed their childhood in Vraja and became seven years old.

units.sanskrit: नीलपीताम्बरधरौ पीतश्वेतानुलेपनौ । बभूवतुर् वत्सपालौ काकपक्षधराव् उभौ ॥
units.english: They used to put on dark-blue and yellow raiments, paste their persons with yellow and white paints and used to wear feathers of crows while tending kine.

units.sanskrit: गोपवीथ्यां सुमधुरं गायन्तौ कामरूपिणौ । शुशुभाते वनगतौ त्रिशीर्षाव् इव पन्नगौ ॥ मयूराङ्गदबाहू तौ बल्लवापीडधारिणौ । वनमालाकृतोरस्कौ द्रुमपोताव् इवोद्गतौ ॥
units.english: While gone to the forest those two beautiful boys used to play on Panāvas, the music of which is sweet to the ears, and shone there like three-hooded serpents. Sometimes putting peacock feathers on their ears, crowns of leaves on their heads and garlands of wild flowers on their breast they shone there like two growing trees.

units.sanskrit: सशिक्यतुम्बकरकौ गोपवेणौप्रवादकौ ॥ पर्णवाद्यसमायुक्तौ दध्योदनकरौ कृती । किंकिणीजालसंबद्धकटिदेशविभूषितौ ॥ कक्षकूटसमालम्बिशिक्यस्थधृतपायसौ । कालयन्तौ च दण्डेन वत्सान् वत्सौ दिशं प्रति ॥ गुल्मेषु मधुमाध्वीकं मार्गमाणावितस् ततः । अथ दामोदरः श्रीमान् संकर्षणम् उवाच ह । आर्य नास्मिन् वने शक्यं गोपालैः सह क्रीडितुम् ॥
units.english: Sometimes placing a crown of lotuses on their heads, converting a rope into a sacred thread and gourds with a string suspended, in their hands, they used to play on flutes. Sometimes sporting with one another, laughing and lying down on a bed of leaves they used to enjoy sleep. Thus leading the life of a cow-herd boy and moving about delightedly hither and thither like two young horses they beautified that forest. One day the beautiful Dāmodara said to Sangkarshana: Sir, by sporting everywhere in the forest we have well nigh spoilt it. We cannot play here any more with the cow-herd boys.

units.sanskrit: प्रक्षीणतृणकाष्ठं च गोपैर् मथितपादपम् ॥ गहनानीह यान्य् आसन् काननानि वनानि च । गोवातेष्व् अपि ये वृक्षाः परिवृत्तार्गलेषु च । सर्वे गोष्ठाग्निषु गताः क्षयम् अक्षयवर्चसः ॥
units.english: It has been divested of grass and twigs and the milk-men have up-rooted the trees. This beautiful forest has been destroyed by us. All the forests and woods, that were thick with trees, are now all looking blank like the sky. All these eternally beautiful trees, that were in the cow-sheds well-protected by walls and wooden bolts, have been destroyed by the fire of cow-sheds -.

units.sanskrit: तानि दूरावकृष्टानि मार्गितव्यानि भूमिषु ॥
units.english: The trees and grass, that were near us, have been all thrown away on the ground at a great distance.

units.sanskrit: अकर्मण्येषु वृक्षेषु स्थितविप्रस्थितद्विजम् ॥
units.english: Water, trees, groves and other resorts have now become scarce in this forest.

units.sanskrit: संवासस्यास्य महतो जनेनोत्सादितद्रुमम् । निरानन्दं निरास्वादं निष्प्रयोजनम् आरुतम् । निर्विहंगम् इदं शून्यं निर्व्यञ्जनम् इवाशनम् ॥
units.english: The trees have been destroyed by the people of this extensive village. The birds have fled away from the useless trees. This forest, divested of birds, has become disgusting like rice without curry and other vegetable dishes. Even the delightful winds do not blow here.

units.sanskrit: विक्रीयमाणैः कष्ठैश् च शाकैश् च वनसंभवैः । उत्सन्नसंचयतृणो घोषो ऽयं नगरायते ॥
units.english: Woods and vegetables, grown in the forest, are now being sold. The grass is all destroyed and this village has taken the appearance of a city.

units.sanskrit: शैलानां भूषणं घोषो घोषाणां भूषणं वनम् ।
units.english: The ornament of the mountain is the village of herdsmen, the forest is its ornament and the cows are the ornaments of the forest.

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् वनं नवतृणं गच्छन्तु धनिनो व्रजाः ॥ न द्वारबन्धावरणा न गृहक्षेत्रिणस् तथा । प्रशस्ता वै व्रजा लोके यथा वै चक्रचारिणः ॥
units.english: Let the wealthy inhabitants of Vraja repair to another forest filled with new trees and grass; when the extensive villages, of milkmen, are shut out by doors and when the fields are covered with houses they do not look beautiful like the Chakrachari birds.

units.sanskrit: शकृन्मूत्रेषु तेष्व् एव जातं क्षाररसायनम् । न तृणं भुञ्जते गावो नापि तत्पयसो हितम् ॥
units.english: When excrement and urine fall on grass its juice becomes poisonous. The cows do not like to graze on it and it is unwholesome for milk.

units.sanskrit: स्थलीप्रायासु रम्यासु नवासु वनराजिषु । चरामः सहिता गोभिः क्षिप्रं संवाह्यतां व्रजः ॥
units.english: We wish to range, with our kine, in the charming new woods which are almost like dry ground. Let this station of milk-men be also transferred there.

units.sanskrit: श्रूयते हि वनं रम्यं पर्याप्ततृणसंस्तरम् । नाम्ना वृन्दावनं नाम स्वादुवृक्षफलोदकम् ॥
units.english: have heard that there is a charming forest on the bank of Yamunā abounding in profuse grass, endued with all the virtues and freed of thorns and insects. It is named Vrindāvana. It is filled with fruits, water and Kadamba trees -.

units.sanskrit: स्निग्धशीतानिलवनं सर्वर्तुनिलयं शुभम् । गोपीनां सुखसंचारं चारुचित्रवनान्तरम् ॥
units.english: Cool winds always blow there in the forest as if it is an asylum of all the seasons. All the woods there are so very charming that the milk-men will be able to range there happily.

units.sanskrit: तस्य गोवर्धनो नाम नातिदूरे गिरिर् महान् । भ्राजते दीर्घशिखरो नन्दनस्येव मन्दरः ॥
units.english: Near it is the huge mountain Govardhana with a high summit like the mount Mandāra near the celestial garden Nandana.

units.sanskrit: मध्ये चास्य महाशाखो न्यग्रोधो योजनोच्छ्रितः । भाण्डीरो नाम शुशुभे नीलमेघ इवाम्बरे ॥
units.english: In the centre of that mountain there is a huge fig-tree, by name Bhāndira, consisting of high branches and extending over a yojana. It shone there like a dark-blue cloud in the sky.

units.sanskrit: मध्येन चास्य कालिन्दी सीमन्तमिव कुर्वती । प्रयाता नन्दनस्येव नलिनी सरितां वरा ॥
units.english: Like unto the river Nalini flowing in the garden of Nandana, Kālindi, the foremost of streams, passes through its middle as if forming a line for separating hairs on each side of the head.

units.sanskrit: तत्र गोवर्धनं चैव भाण्डीरं च वनस्पतिम् । कालिन्दीं च नदीं रम्यां द्रक्ष्यावश् चरतः सुखम् ॥ सुखं चरन्तं द्रक्ष्यावः कालिन्दीं च नदीं शुभाम् । तत्रायं वसतां घोषस् त्यज्यतां निर्गुणं वनम् । संवाहयाम भद्रं ते किंचिद् उत्पाद्य कारणम् ॥ एवं कथयतस् तस्य वासुदेवस्य धीमतः । प्रादुर्बभूवुः शतशो रक्तमांसवसाशनाः ॥
units.english: With great joy we will always behold there the mount Govardhana, the tree Bhāndira and the charming river Kālindi. Sir, mayst thou fare well. Leaving this forest which has no attractions do thou lay out there the station of milk-men. Let us now, creating some calamity, terrify the milk-men. While thus talking the intelligent Vasudeva engaged himself in a thought. From the hairs of his body there arose hundreds of wolves living on fat, blood and flesh.

units.sanskrit: वृकान् निष्पतितान् दृष्ट्वा गोषु वत्सेष्व् अथो नृषु । गोपीषु च यथाकामं व्रजे त्रासो ऽभवन् महान् ॥
units.english: As soon as they came out they ran in all directions as if it to devasstate the village Vraja. Beholding them fall upon calves, kine and their women the milk-men were stricken with great fear.

units.sanskrit: पञ्चाशत्षष्टिबद्धाश् च चत्वारिंशत् तथैव च । निश्चेरुस् तस्य गात्राद् धि श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणाः । कृष्णस्य कृष्णवदना गोपानां भयवर्धनाः ॥
units.english: Forming themselves into groups of five, ten, thirty, twenty and a hundred those dark-faced wolves, bearing the mystic mark of Srivatsa, that had come out of the body of Krishna, began to range there and increase the fear of milkmen.

units.sanskrit: भक्षयद्भिश् च तैर् वत्सांस् त्रासयद्भिश् च गोव्रजान् । निशि बालान् हरद्भिश् च वृकैर् उत्साद्यते व्रजः ॥
units.english: Thus striking terror to the entire land of milkmen, those wolves, eating up calves, stealing away the boys in the night, well nigh devastated it.

units.sanskrit: न वनं शक्यते गन्तुं न गाश् च परिरक्षितुम् । त्रस्ता ह्य् उद्विग्नमनसो गतास् तस्मिन् वने ऽवसन् । एवं वृकैर् उदीर्णैस् तु व्याघ्रतिल्यपराक्रमैः । व्रजो निष्पन्दचेष्टः स एकस्थानचरः कृतः ॥
units.english: None, then, dared enter into woods, tend his kine, fetch any thing from the forest and go to the river. In fact, stricken with fear and motionless, they, with an anxious mind, began to live there. Those wolves, powerful like tigers, created such a fear in the inhabitants of Vraja, that they were afraid of even moving their limbs or shaking their body.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ईतिं वृकानां दृष्ट्वा तु वर्धमानां दुरासदाम् । सस्त्रीपुंसो ऽथ घोषो वै समस्तो ऽमन्त्रयत् तदा ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Seeing the number of those irrepressible wolves, daily increased, all the men and women living in that village held a consultation amongst themselves :—It is not proper for us to live any more in this forest.

units.sanskrit: यच् छिवं च सुखाढ्यं च गवां चैव सुखावहम् ॥
units.english: Let us go to another great forest where we may live happily and the kine may range of their own accord.

units.sanskrit: अद्यैव किं चिरेण स्म व्रजामः सह गोधनैः । यावद् वृकैर् वधं घोरं न नः सर्वो व्रजो व्रजेत् ॥
units.english: Even today without any delay we will depart with our precious kine, before these dreadful wolves destroy the entire Vraja.

units.sanskrit: एषां धूम्रारुणाङ्गानां दंष्ट्रिणां मुखकर्षिणाम् । वृकाणां कृष्णवक्त्राणां बिभीमो निशि गर्जताम् ॥
units.english: These black-faced wolves, with tawny-coloured limbs, teeth and nails, set up a terrible roar in the night.

units.sanskrit: मम पुत्रो मम भ्राता मम वत्सो ऽथ गौर् मम । वृकैर् व्यापादितेत्य् एवं क्रन्दन्ति स्म गृहे गृहे ॥
units.english: My son, my brother, my calf, my cow have been eaten by the wolves. Such cries are heard in every house.

units.sanskrit: तासां रुदितशब्देन गवां हम्भारवेण च । व्रजस्योत्थापनं चक्रुर् घोषवृद्धाः समागताः ॥
units.english: Hearing the cries of the milk-women and the doleful noise of the kine, the assembled cow-herds wished to transfer, without any delay, their station.

units.sanskrit: तेषां मतम् अथाज्ञाय गन्तुं वृन्दावनं प्रति । व्रजस्य च निवेशाय गवां चैव सुखाय च ॥ वृन्दावननिवेशाय ज्ञात्वा तान् कृतनिश्चयान् । नन्दगोपो बृहद्वाक्यं बृहस्पतिर् इवाददे ॥ अद्यैव निश्चयप्राप्तिर् यदि गन्तव्यम् एव नः । ततो ऽवघुष्यत तदा घोषे तत्प्राकृतैर् नरैः । शीघ्रम् गावः प्रकाल्यन्तां युज्यन्तां शकटानि च ॥
units.english: Being informed of their desire to go to Vrindavana for fixing their station elsewhere for the well-being of the kine and finding them resolute in this matter, Nanda, like the preceptor of the gods, gave vent to the following weighty accents -:—If you are resolved upon going away even this very day, then ask the inhabitants of Vraja to get themselves ready without any delay. Thereupon the menials announced in the village, saying: This station will be transfared to Vrindāvana. Therefore collect your own cows and calves, get ready your carts and place your own vessels thereon –.

units.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा नन्दगोपस्य वचनं साधु भाषितम् । प्रयाह्य् उत्तिष्ठ गच्छामः किं शेषे याहि योजय । उत्तिष्ठति व्रजे तस्मिन् गोपकोलाहलो ह्य् अभूत् ॥ उत्तिष्ठमानः शुशुभे शकटीसंकटस् तु सः । गोपीनां गर्गरीभिश् च मूर्ध्नि चोत्तंसितैर् घटैः । निष्पपात व्रजात् पङ्क्तिस् तारापङ्क्तिर् इवाम्बरात् ॥ नीलपीतारुणैस् तासां वस्त्रैर् उद्ग्रथितोच्छ्रितैः । दामनीदामभारैश् च केचित् कायावलम्बिभिः । गोपा मार्गगता भान्ति सावरोहा इव द्रुमाः ॥ स व्रजो व्रजता भाति शकटौघेन भास्वता । ओघैः पवनविक्षिप्तैर् निष्पतद्भिर् इवार्णवः ॥
units.english: Hearing those well-meaning words of Nanda they all rose up for going away speedily. Then there was set up a tumult of Come; let us go: what is the delay? Make your carts ready. With busy cowherds and milk-women, with their innumerable carts ready that village assumed the appearance of a roaring ocean. The milk-women, with jars on their heads, and being arranged in rows, like stars coming out of the sky, issued out of Vraja. Having their breasts covered with blue, yellow, and shining jackets, those milk-women, while going on the road, appeared like a rain-bow. Carrying the load of ropes hanging on their body some milk-men imitated the beauty of trees covered with branches and leaves. The shining carts moving all around, that village of cowherds appeared like an ocean abounding in boats upset by the wind. Thus divested of all articles in no time and filled with crows it appeared like a desert.

units.sanskrit: ततः क्रमेण घोषः स प्राप्तो वृन्दावनं वनम् । निवेशं विपुलं चक्रे निवेशाय गवां हितम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon having gradually arrived at the forest of Vrindāvana, they, for the well-being of the kine, set up many extensive stations there.

units.sanskrit: शकटावर्तपर्यन्तं चन्द्रार्धाकारसंस्थितम् । मध्ये योजनविस्तारं तावद् द्विगुणम् आयतम् ॥
units.english: With roads laid out for carts and situate like a crescent that forest was one Yoyana in breadth and two in circumference.

units.sanskrit: निखातोच्छ्रितशाखाग्रैर् अभिगुप्तं समन्ततः ॥
units.english: It was protected on all sides with thorny creepers and trees, ditches and flying branches.

units.sanskrit: किलैर् आरोप्यमाणैश् च दामनीपाशपाशितैः । स्तम्भनीभिर् धृतैश् चापि शकटैः परिवर्तितैः ॥ नियोगपाशैर् आसक्तैर् गर्गरीस्तम्भमूर्धसु । छादनार्थं प्रकीर्णैश् च कटैस् तृणगृहैस् तथा ॥ शाखाविटङ्कैर् वृक्षाणां क्रियमाणैर् इतस् ततः । तोयम् उत्तारयन्तीभिः प्रोक्षन्तीभिश् च तद्वनम् । शाखाश् चाकर्षमाणाभिर् गोपीभिश् च समन्ततः ॥ युवभिः स्थविरैश् चैव गोपैर् व्यग्रकरैर् भृशम् । विशसद्भिः कुठारैश् च काष्ठान्य् अपि तरून् अपि ॥
units.english: It was beautified with charming posts and rods, with jars full of water for washing, stakes tied round with ropes and nooses, with upraised pillars, overturned carts, chords thrown upon the pillars of vessels, grass for covering the huts, sheds made of grass, with branches of trees, playing hither and thither and trees abounding in nests, cleansed cow-sheds, well-placed mortars, the burning fire placed in the west, and well stretched beds consisting of clothes and leather coatings –. Bringing water and removing the branches of the trees the milk-women began to cleanse the forest. Youthful and old milk-men with axes, began lightly to fell down the trees. This station of the milk-men, abounding in woods, charming habitations, sweet roots, fruits and water, appeared more beautiful.

units.sanskrit: रम्यं वननिवेशं वै स्वभिवृष्ट्यामृतोपमम् ॥ तास् तु कामदुघा गावः सर्वकालतृणं वनम् । वृन्दावनम् अनुप्राप्ता नन्दनोपमकाननम् ॥ पूर्वम् एव तु कृष्णेन गवां सत्कारकारिणा । वर्षतीवामृतं देवे तृणं तत्रव्यवर्धत ॥
units.english: While ranging in the forest before, Krishna, with a delighted heart, looked at that forest for the well-being of the kine. And so obtaining that forest of Vrindāvana, filled with the nests of various birds and resembling the garden of Nandana, all the cows, giving milk whenever milched, were highly pleased –. In the last month of the dreadful summer season, the king of gods used to pour there nectarine showers.

units.sanskrit: न तत्र वत्साः सीदन्ति न गावो नेतरे जनाः । यत्र तिष्ठति लोकानां भवाय मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: And accordingly the people there did not suffer from any disease and all the vegetables grew in profusion. The calves and ignorant people do not suffer any disease or meet with destruction where the Lord Madhusudana lives himself for the behoof of mankind –.

units.sanskrit: तास् तु गावः स घोषश् च स च संकर्षणो युवा । कृष्णेन विहितं वासं तम् अध्यासन्त निर्वृताः ॥
units.english: In this way the youthful Sangkarshana, the milk-men and the cows began to live there where Krishna thought of fixing the station.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच तौ तु वृन्दावनं प्राप्तौ वसुदेवसुताव् उभौ । चेरतुर् वत्सयूथानि चारयन्तौ सुनिर्वृत्तौ ॥ पूर्णस् तु घर्मसमयस् तयोस् तत्र वने सुखम् । गते तस्मिन् महाघर्मे रजःपूरैस् तिरोहितैः । ततः प्रावृद् अनुप्राप्ता मनसः कामदीपनी । बभूवादर्शनः सूर्यो भूमिश् चादर्शयत् तृणम् ॥ पतता मेघवातेन नवतोयानुकर्षिणा । संमार्जिततला भूमिर् यौवनस्थेव लक्ष्यते ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thus living in Vrindāvana the two highly beautiful sons of Vasudeva began to range there tending kine. Sporting with the milk-men and bathing in the river Yamunā they spent the summer there happily. Thereupon with the advent of the rainy season that creates desire in the mind of men, clouds, containing rainbow, began to discharge their watery contents. The sun was enshrouded by the scattering clouds drawing in new water. The ground was rendered invisible by the new grown grass. With her surface brushed by the new clouds the earth appeared like a youthful damsel.

units.sanskrit: नष्टदावाग्निधूमानि ववानि प्रचकाशिरे ॥ नृत्तव्यापारकालश् च मयूराणां कलापिनाम् । मदरक्ताः प्रवृत्ताश् च केकाः पटुरवाः कृताः ॥
units.english: Watered by the new showers, the forests and the forest-roads were divested of dust and filled with Sakragopas. This was the dancing season of the peacocks emitting sweet notes. And elated with passion they began to pour their Kekā notes.

units.sanskrit: नवप्रावृषि कान्तानां षट्पदाहारदायिनाम् । यौवनस्थं कदम्बानां नवाभ्रैर् भ्राजते वपुः ॥ हासितं कुटजैः फुल्लैः कदम्बैर् वासितं वनम् । त्रासितं जलदैर् उष्णं तोषिता वसुधा जलैः ॥
units.english: The clouds began to embellish the persons of the beautiful Kadamva flowers, that had attained their youth in the wonderful rainy season and which is the only food of the bees. The forest was scented with the fragrance of Kadamva flowers and rendered smiling by the Kutaja flowers. Its heat was destroyed by the clouds and the earth was satisfied by the showers of rain.

units.sanskrit: संतप्ता भास्करजलैर् अभितप्ता देवाग्निभिः । जलैर् बलाहकोत्सृष्टैर् उच्छ्वसन्तीव पर्वताः ॥
units.english: Being sprinkled with water by the clouds the mountains, that had been scorched by the rays of the sun and the forest were, as it were, emitting smokes.

units.sanskrit: महावातसमुद्धूतं महामेघगणार्पितम् । महीमहारजःपूरैस् तुल्यम् आपद्यते नभः ॥
units.english: With terrible winds and huge clouds rising in the sky the earth assumed the appearance of the city of a great king -.

units.sanskrit: क्वचित् कदम्बहासाढ्यं सिलिन्ध्राभरणं क्वचित् । संप्रदीप्तं इवाभाति फुल्लनीपद्रुमं वनम् ॥
units.english: Adorned hither and thither with Kadamba and plantain flowers, that forest, abounding in delightful Nipa trees, shone there like the burning fire.

units.sanskrit: पार्थिवं गन्धम् आघ्राय लोकः क्षुभितमानसः ॥ दृप्तसारङ्गनिनदैर् दर्दुर् अव्याहृतेन च । नवैश् च शिखिविक्रुष्टैर् एकवर्णा वसुंधरा ॥
units.english: Smelling the fragrance of the earth wet with the showers of Indra, and scattered by the wind the people were stricken with desire. The earth was filled with the notes of the maddened bees, the sound of the frogs and the wonderful Kekā notes of the peacocks.

units.sanskrit: भ्रमत्तूर्णमहावेगा वर्षप्राप्तमहारयाः । हर्यन्तस् तीरजान् वृक्सान् विस्तरां यान्ति निम्नगाः ॥
units.english: With their currents increased by the downpour of rain the rivers, expanding themselves, began to carry away the trees grown on their banks.

units.sanskrit: संततासारनिर्यत्नाः क्लिन्नपत्रोत्तरच्छदाः । न त्यजन्त्य् अगमाग्राणि श्रान्ता इव पतत्रिणः ॥
units.english: Stupified by the continuous showers and having their wings distressed, the birds, as if on account of their quiet nature, did not leave the branches of the trees.

units.sanskrit: तोयगम्भीरलम्बेषु प्रस्रवत्सु नदत्सु च । उदरेषु नवाभ्राणां मज्जतीव दिवाकरः ॥ पतता मेघवर्षेण यथानिम्नानुसारिणा । भान्त्यातिवृष्ट्या मातङ्गा गां गता इव तोयदाः ॥
units.english: The sun, as if, began to drown himself in the womb of the new clouds surcharged with water and filled with the noise of the falling torrents. The earth put on, as if, a garland of fresh grass. The huge trees, forming the land marks, were uprooted and every where was enveloped with water.

units.sanskrit: रौहिणेयो मिथः काले कृष्णं वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: And it was difficult, accordingly, to find out the paths.

units.sanskrit: गगने तव गात्राणां वर्णचोरान् समुत्थितान् ॥ कामिनां हृदयस्याशु निघ्नतस् तान् समन्ततः  । तव निद्राकरः कालस् तव गात्रोपमम् नभः । त्वम् इवाज्ञातवसतिं चन्द्रो वसति वार्षिकीम् ॥
units.english: The mountains, abounding in huge trees, were as it were, assailed by thunderbolts and their summits were being carried down by the torrents. The forest-land was filled with the torrents of rain flowing down and overflowing the banks of the lakes. Following the muttering of clouds, raising up their trunks and running to and fro during the rainy season the elephants looked like clouds coming down on earth. The sky is like your body. As you every year live secretly in this season so the moon is doing.

units.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदले काले भाति वृन्दावनं वनम् । संप्राप्ते दुर्दिने काले दुर्दिनं भाति वै नभः ॥
units.english: With the advent of the rains, the sky, covered with clouds, growing dark-blue on account of blue clouds and shining like the red-blue lotuses, is appearing more beautiful.

units.sanskrit: पश्य कृष्ण जलोदग्रैः कृष्णैर् उद्ग्रथितैर् घनैः । गोवर्धनो यथा रम्यो भाति गोवर्धनो गिरिः ॥
units.english: Behold, Krishna, the charming mountain Govardhana, covered with dark clouds surcharged with water, is giving a lie to its own name of bringing up kine.

units.sanskrit: पतितेनाम्भसा ह्य् एते समन्तान् मदतर्पिताः । भ्राजन्ते कृष्णसारङ्गाः काननेषु मुदान्विताः ॥
units.english: Greatly worked up with passion on account of the falling of the showers the black-bees are ranging happily all over the forest.

units.sanskrit: एतान्य् अम्बुप्रहृष्टानि हरितानि मृदूनि च । तृणानि शतपत्राक्ष पत्रैर् गूहन्ति मेदिनीम् ॥
units.english: you having lotus-like eyes, the highly tender green grass, vegetating profusely by the new water, are, as if, trying to cover the earth.

units.sanskrit: क्षरज्जलानां शैलानां वनानां च जलागमे । ससस्यानां च सीमानां न लक्ष्मीर् व्यतिरिच्यते ॥
units.english: This rainy season has not been able to increase the beauty of the mountain, abounding in fountains, that of the forest filled with water, and that of cultivated fields enveloped with corns.

units.sanskrit: शीघ्रवातसमुद्धूताः प्रोषितौत्सुक्यकारिणः । दामोदरोद्दामरवाः प्रागल्भ्यं यान्ति तोयदाः ॥
units.english: Dāmodara, driven by the quick-coursing winds, these clouds, with their dreadful mutterings, are increasing the desire of those living in foreign countries for returning home and are thus displaying shamelessness.

units.sanskrit: हरे हर्यश्वचापेन त्रिवर्णेन त्रिविक्रम । विबाणज्येन धनुषा तवेदं मध्यमं पदम् ॥
units.english: Hari, you of three foot-steps, behold, your second foot-step is embellished with rain-bow of three colors without arrows and string.

units.sanskrit: मेघैः शीतातपकरो विरश्मिर् इव रश्मिमान् ॥
units.english: In this month of Srāvana the sun is shorn of his beauty.

units.sanskrit: अव्यवच्छिन्नधारौघैः समुद्रौघनिभैर् घनैः ॥ नीपार्जुनकदम्बानां पृथिव्यां चाभिवृष्तयः । गन्धैः कोलाहला वान्ति वाता मदनदीपनाः ॥ संप्रवृत्तमहावर्षं लम्बमानमहाम्बुदम् । भात्य् अगाधम् अपर्यन्तं ससागरम् इवाम्बरम् ॥ धारानिर्मलनाराचं विद्युत् कवचनिर्मलम् । शक्रचापायुधधरं युद्धसज्जम् इवाम्बरम् ॥ शैलानां च वनानां च द्रुमाणां च वरानन । गजानीकैर् इवाकीर्णं सलिलोद्गारिभिर् घनैः । वर्णसारूप्यतां याति गगनं सागरस्य वै ॥ समुद्रोद्धूतजनिता लोलशाड्वलकम्पिनः । शीताह् सपृषतोद्गाराः कर्कशा वान्ति मारुताः ॥ निशासु सुप्तचन्द्रासु मुक्ततोयासु तोयदैः । मग्नसूर्यस्य नभसो नाभिभान्ति दिशो दश ॥ चेतनं पुष्करं कोशैः क्षुधाध्मातैः समन्ततः । संहतानां द्विरेफानां निवेशं यान्ति पङ्कयः । घर्मदोषपरित्यक्तं मेघतोयविभूषितम् । पश्य वृन्दावनं कृष्ण वनं चैत्ररथं यथा ॥
units.english: His scorching rays being cooled down by the clouds, he, although of thousand rays, appears to have none. The all-spreading clouds, agitated like the water of the ocean and accompanied by continuous showers, have, as it were, united the earth and sky. The torrents of rain flowing on earth, and the air, perfumed with the fragrance of Nipa, Arjuna and Kadamva flowers and capable of exciting passion, blowing with sound on high, the sky, covered with extensive and heavily showering clouds, is appearing like a deep and vast ocean –. Armed with effulgent Nārāchas in the shape of showers, having the cloud for his coat of mail, and the rain-bow for his bow, the sky is, as if, ready for battle. you of a beautiful countenance, covered with clouds, the mountains, forest and the tops of the trees are looking highly beautiful. Enveloped with clouds pouring down their watery contents and resembling an army of elephants the sky is imitating the color of the ocean. Blowing there with drops of water the dread ful blasts of winds, that shake the tender plants and destroy the gravity of the oceans, are oppressing all with cold. The moon disappearing from view in night after the sun-set, and the clouds continually discharging showers, no quarter of the sky, appears beautiful. Filled with passing clouds resembling leathern bags full of air, the sky appears moving like an animate object. What shall speak more, Krishna, see, Vrindavana, relieved of heat and adorned with showers, is looking beautiful like Chaitraratha garden.

units.sanskrit: एवं प्रावृङ्गुनान् सर्वाञ् श्रीमान् कृष्णस्य पूर्वजः । कथयन्न् एव बलवान् व्रजम् एव जगाम ह ॥
units.english: Thus describing the advantages of the rainy season, Krishna's elder brother, the beautiful Balarāma entered Vraja.

units.sanskrit: तौ रामयन्ताव् अन्योन्यं कृष्णसंकर्षणाव् उभौ । तत्कालं ज्ञातिभिः सार्धं चेरतुस् तौ महद् वनम् ॥
units.english: Pleasing each other Krishna and Sangkarshana began to range there in that vast forest in the company of their then kinsmen the cowherds -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच कदाचित् तु तदा कृष्णो विना संकर्षणं गुरुम् । चचार तद्वनवरं कामरूपी वराननः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—One day the lotus-eyed Krishna, having a dark-blue hue and a beautiful countenance, capable of assuming forms at will and wearing a feather of crow, without being united with Sangkarshana, began to range alone in that charming forest.

units.sanskrit: श्रीवत्सेनोरसा युक्तः शशाङ्क इव लक्ष्मणा ॥
units.english: Bearing the mystic mark of Srivatsa on his breast he shone there like the moon with the mark of a hare –.

units.sanskrit: पीते प्रीतिकरे नॄणां पद्मकिञ्जल्कसप्रभे । सूक्ष्मे वसानो वसने ससंध्य इव तोयदः ॥ वन्यव्यापारयुक्ताभ्यां व्यग्राभ्यां दण्डरज्जुभिः । भुजाभ्यां साधुवृत्ताभ्यां पूजिताभ्यां दिवौकसैः ॥
units.english: His arms, bedecked with Angadas and his tawny colored two little moving feet shone there like brilliant lotuses. His two pieces of yellow raiments, creating delight of the world and resembling the filaments of a lotus, shone there like the evening clouds. Ropes and rods were shining in his two plump and moving hands engaged in the work of tending kine and worshipped by the celestials.

units.sanskrit: सदृशं पुण्डरीकस्य गन्धेन कमलस्य च । रराज तस्य तद्बाल्ये रुचिरोष्ठपुटं मुखम् ॥ शिखाभिस् तस्य मुक्ताभी रराज मुखपङ्कजम् । वृत्तं षट्पदपङ्क्तीभिर् यथा स्यात् पद्ममण्डलम् ॥ तस्यार्जुनकदम्बाढ्या नीपकन्दलमालिनी । रराज माला शिरसि नक्षत्राणां यथा दिवि ॥ स तया मालया वीरः शुशुभे सर्वपुष्पया । मेघकालाम्बुदश्यामो नभस्य इव मूर्तिमान् ॥ क्वचिद् गायन् क्वचित् क्रीडंश् चञ्चूर्यंश् च क्वचित् क्वचित् । पर्णवाद्यं श्रुतिसुखं वादयानः क्वचिद् वने ॥
units.english: Charming fragrance, resembling that of a dark-blue lotus, was coming out from his beautiful and lotus-like mouth adorned with picturesque lips His countenance, embellished with dishevelled locks, was shining like a lotus encircled by black-bees. Garlands of new grown buds of Arjuna, Kadamba and Nipa flowers were shining on his head like a garland of stars in the sky. That hero, of dark-blue hue of the clouds of the rainy season, with a garland of the same colour around his neck, shone there like the month of Bhādra incarnate. The clean leaves, tied to the thread round his neck, shone there beautiful when shaken by the gentle breeze raised by peacock feathers. Thus ranging every day in the forest that youth used some where to sing, some where to sport and walk and some where to make, of his own accord, the charming music of of Parna and bugle for pleasing his kine.

units.sanskrit: गोकुले ऽम्बुधरश्यामश् चचार द्युतिमान् प्रभुः ॥ गोवर्धनस्य च गिरेः पर्णवाद्यं श्रुतेः सुखम् । रेमे च तत्र रम्यासु चित्रासु वनराजिषु । मेघनादप्रतिव्यूहैर् नादितासु समन्ततः ॥ शाड्वलच्छन्नमार्गासु शिलीन्ध्राभरणासु च । कन्दलामलदन्तीषु स्रवन्तीषु नवं जलम् ॥ केसराणां नवैर् गन्धैर् मदनिःश्वसितोपमैः । स कदाचिद् वने तस्मिन् गोभिः सह परिव्रजन् । ददर्श विपुलोदग्रं शाखिनं शाखिनां वरम् ॥
units.english: Ranging in that wonderful forest and fanned by the charming wind proceeding from the trees that powerful and effulgent Krishna, dark blue like cloud, attained to most excellent delight. It was resonant with the notes of peacocks, its caves were echoed with the muttering of clouds that excite lust in men, it was adorned with plantain trees and covered with new grown grass, twigs and lotuses. It abounded in many fountains and was fragrant with the filaments of lotuses like the treath of females expressing their desire –. While, ranging in that forest one day, along with his kine, he saw there a foremost of trees with high branches.

units.sanskrit: स्थितं धरण्यां मेघाभं निबिडं पत्रसंचयैः । गगनार्धोच्छ्रिताकारं पवनाभोगकारिणं ॥
units.english: Enveloped with thick leaves it was stationed on earth like a cloud. With its height it traversed half of the sky and if contained as it were the enjoyment of the wind.

units.sanskrit: नीलचित्राङ्गवर्णैश् च सेवितं बहुभिर् द्विजैः । फलैः प्रवालैश् च घनं सेन्द्रचापघनोपमम् ॥ भवनाकारविटपं लतापुष्पसुमण्डितम् । विशालमूलावततं पवनाम्भोदधारिणम् ॥ आधिपत्यम् इवान्येषां तस्य देशस्य शाखिनाम् । कुर्वाणं शुभकर्माणं तिरो वर्षन्तम् अव्ययम् ॥ न्यग्रोधं पर्वताकारं भाण्डीरं नाम नामतः । दृष्ट्वा तत्र मतिं चक्रे निवासाय दिवा प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Covered with fruits of blue and diverse other colors and resorted to by various birds it appeared like a cloud accompanied by rain-bow. The wind and cloud were as if simultaneously living in the trees resembling houses, adorned with creepers and flowers and bent down on account of their huge roots. As if by his pristine good deeds, that great tree, who could give protection against rain and the rays of the sun, was ruling over others there. Beholding this Bhāndiraka fig-tree resembling the summit of a mountain the sinless Lord Krishna desired to live there.

units.sanskrit: स तत्र वयसा तुल्यैर् वत्सपालैः सहानघः । रेमे वै दिवसं कृष्णः पुरा स्वर्गगतो यथा ॥
units.english: Thereupon engaged in sport there along with other cow-herd boys of his own age, as in the city of the celestials, he spent the day there.

units.sanskrit: तं क्रीडमाणं गोपालाः कृष्णं भाण्डीरवासिनम् । रमयन्ति स्म बहवो वन्यैः क्रीडनकैस् तदा ॥ गोपालाः कृष्णम् एवान्ये गायन्ति स्म रतिप्रियाः ॥ तेषां स गायताम् एव वादयामास वीर्यवान् । पर्णवाद्यान्तरे वेणुं तुम्बीवीणां च तत्र ह ॥
units.english: While Krishna began to sport there under Bhāndiraka tree the other cow-herds amused him with various wild plays. The milkmen began to sing there and the boys, fond of amusing, sang there many songs relating to Krishna. When they thus began to sing in accompaniment with the music of Panava, the powerful Krishna, too at times, played on his flute and Tumvi.

units.sanskrit: कदाचिच् चारयन्न् एव गाः स गोवृषभेक्षणः । जगाम यमुनातीरं लतालंकृतपादपम् ॥
units.english: One day while tending his kine, Krishna, having the eyes of a bull, repaired to the bank of Yamunā abounding in trees adorned with creepers.

units.sanskrit: तरंगापाङ्गकुटिलां वारिस्पर्शसुखानिलाम् । तां च पद्मोत्पलवतीं ददर्श यमुनां नदीम् ॥
units.english: He saw the delightful wind blowing on the water; and the foremost of rivers Yamunā, embellished with lilies and lotuses, was as if with her waves, casting her glances.

units.sanskrit: तोयवातोद्धतैर् वेगैर् अवनामितपादपाम् ॥ हंसकारण्डवोद्घुष्टां सारसैश् च विनादिताम् । जलजैः प्राणिभिः कीर्णां जलजैर् भूषितां गुणैः । जलजैः कुसुमैश् चित्रां जलजैर् हरितोदकाम् ॥ प्रस्थितस्रोतचरणां पुलिनश्रोणिमण्डलाम् । मीनाक्षिचपलां कान्तां कान्तशैवलमूर्धजाम् । तां समुद्रस्य महिषीं वीक्षमाणः समन्ततः । चचार रुचिरं कृष्णो यमुनाम् उपशोभयन् ॥
