units.english: All her landing stairs were well-levelled and her water was sweet; she had many lakes and her current was strong. And all the trees on her bank were shaken by the watery air. It was resonant with the notes of swans, Karandavas and Sārasas and resorted to by Chakravākas and other fowls that range in pairs Her water was filled with acquatic animals, was endued with all the good qualities, was variegated with various water-born flowers and was rendered yellow by water-born corals. The animals were agitating her water and her banks were filled with hermitages. Seeing this beautiful river Yamunā, the queen of the ocean, Krishna, as if to beautify her the more, was ranging there —.

units.sanskrit: तां चरन् स नदीं श्रेष्ठां ददर्श ह्रदम् उत्तमम् । दीर्घं योजनविस्तारं दुस्तरं त्रिदशैर् अपि ॥
units.english: Ranging thus he saw there a vast lake filled with deep water and resembling the sky crested with clouds. It extended over a Yojana and even the celestials could not cross it.

units.sanskrit: गम्भीरम् अक्षोभ्यजलं निष्कम्पम् इव सागरम् । अगाधेनाम्भसा पूर्णं मेघपूर्णम् इवाम्बरम् । दुःखोपसर्प्यं तीरेषु ससर्पैर् विपुलैर् बिलैः ॥
units.english: Its water was deep and motionless like that of the ocean. It was cast off by beasts, acquatic animals and water-fowls. There being many ponds with serpents on its bank, people, with very great difficulty, could traverse it.

units.sanskrit: विषारणिगतस्याग्नेर् धूमेन परिवेष्टितम् ॥
units.english: It was enveloped with smoke proceeding from poisonous trees.

units.sanskrit: उपभोगैः परित्यक्तं सद्भिस् त्रिषवणार्थिभिः । आकाशाद् अप्य् असंचार्यं खगैर् आकाशगोचरैः ॥ तृणेष्व् अपि पतत्स्व् अप्सु ज्वलन्तम् इव तेजसा । समन्ताद् योजनंसाग्रं तीरेष्व् अपि दुरासदम् ॥
units.english: The sages, desirous of performing three oblations in a day, could not enjoy its water. Even the birds could not range in the sky overhanging it and the grass burnt up in no time as soon as it fell into it. Even the gods could not approach that lake extending over a Yojana on all sides.

units.sanskrit: विषानलेन घोरेण ज्वालाप्रज्वलितं ह्रदम् । वज्रस्योत्तरतस् तस्य क्रोशमात्रे निरामये ॥ तं दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास कृष्णो वै विपुलं ह्रदम् । अगाधं द्योतमानं च कस्येदं सुमहद् ध्रदम् ॥ अस्मिन् स कालियो नाम कालाञ्जनचयोपमः । उरगाधिपतिः साक्षाद् ध्रदे वसति दारुनः ॥
units.english: And the trees there were being consumed by the dreadful poisonous fire –. Beholding in that province freed from all calamities, such a huge lake at a distance of a Krosa north of Vraja Krishna began to think. To whom does this huge and deep lake belong? Methinks that dreadful king of serpents Kalya, resembling a heap of collyrium of whom had heard before and who has left the ocean in fear of the king of birds Garuda, who feeds on serpents, is living here.

units.sanskrit: तेनेयं दूषिता सर्वा यमुना सागरंगमा । भयात् तस्योरगपतेर् नायं देशो निषेव्यते ॥
units.english: By him this Yamunā, flowing to the ocean, has been polluted –. And in fear of that king of serpents no one lives here.

units.sanskrit: सावरोहद्रुमं घोरं कीर्णं नानालताद्रुमैः ॥ रक्षितं सर्पराजस्य सचिवैर् वनवासिभिः । वनं निर्विषयाकारं विषान्नम् इव दुःस्पृशम् । शैवालमलिनैश् चापि वृक्षैः क्षुपलताकुलैः । कर्तव्यमार्गौ भ्राजेते ह्रदस्यास्य तटाव् उभौ ॥
units.english: Protected by the ministers of that serpent king, doing him good, this dreadful forest, filled with grass and various trees and creepers, has become unworthy of being resorted to like the sky and being touched like a poisonous food –. The banks, filled with corals, trees and creepers, are being protected by his attendants, doing him good. And two artificial roads are seen running over its two banks.

units.sanskrit: तद् अस्य सर्पराजस्य कर्तव्यो निग्रहो मया । यथेवं सरिदम्भोदा भवेच् छिवजलाशया ॥ अयं च सेव्यः कर्तव्यो ह्रदः शीतजलाश्रय । एतदर्थं च वासो ऽयम् व्रजे ऽस्मिन् गोपजन्म च । अमीषाम् उत्पथस्थानां शासनार्थं दुरात्मनाम् ॥
units.english: should, however, vanquish this king of serpents. should defeat the serpent in such a way as may render the water of lake useful to the inhabitants of Vraja, and so that delightful winds may blow here and the landing stairs may become worthy of use –. In order to vanquish these wicked ones always following the wrong ways have taken my birth as a milkman and am living amongst the cow-herds.

units.sanskrit: एतं कदम्बम् आरुह्य तद् एष शिशुलीलया । विनिपत्य ह्रदे घोरे दमयिष्यामि कालियम् ॥
units.english: Therefore sporting like a child shall climb this Kadamba tree, jump into the lake and vanquish Kalya. Doing this my superior power of arms will be known to all.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच सोपसृत्य नदीतीरं बद्ध्वा परिकरं दृढम् । कृष्णः कदम्बशिखराल् लम्बमानो ऽम्बुदाकृतिः । ह्रदमध्ये ऽकरोच् छब्दं निपतन्न् अम्बुजेक्षणः ॥ नीलोत्पलदलश्यामो ह्रदे तस्मिन् पपात ह । संप्राशिच्यत वेगेन भिद्यमान इवार्णवः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thinking thus Krishna repaired to the bank of the river. Tying his cloth firmly he, with delight, got upon the Kadamba tree. Climbing up to the top of the tree and emitting a leonine roar the cloud-hued and lotus-eyed Krishna jumped headlong down into the lake. That lake, of the river Yamunā, was agitated by his fall. And the water thereof overflowed on all sides like scattering clouds.

units.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन संक्षुब्धं तत्सर्पभवनं महत् । उत्तिष्ठद् उदकात् सर्पो रोषपर्याकुलेक्षणः ॥
units.english: The huge abode of the serpent Kālya was shaken by that sound. And the serpents, with their eyes reddened with anger, rose up from the water.

units.sanskrit: ततो रक्तान्तनयनः कालियः समदृश्यत ॥ पञ्चास्यः पावकोच्छ्वासश् चलज्जिह्वो ऽनलाननः । पृतुभिः पञ्चभिर् घोरैः शिरोभिः परिवारितः ॥
units.english: Thereupon was seen the king of serpents Kālya endued with the hue of clouds, having eyes reddened with ire, five hoods, a fiery countenance and tongue and effulgent like the flames of fire –. The entire lake was covered with his hood burning like fire and five huge and dreadful faces were seen above the water.

units.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रोताश् च भीतेव जगाम यमुना नदी । तस्य क्रोधाग्निपूर्णेन वक्त्रेणाभूच् च मारुतः ॥
units.english: When that king of serpents was burning in his energy and anger the water there appeared as if boiling and the river Yamunā, stricken with fear, flew in her opposite course.

units.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं ह्रदगतं क्रीडन्तं शिशुलीलया । सधूमाः पन्नगेन्द्रस्य मुखान् निश्चेरुर् अर्चिषः ॥
units.english: Beholding Krishna coming to the lake and sporting like a boy he had powerful winds issue out of his mouth filled with the fire of anger. Scintiliations of fire, accompanied by smoke, came out from the mouth of that king of serpents.

units.sanskrit: सृजता तेन रोषाग्निं समीपे तीरजा द्रुमाः । क्षणेन भस्मसान् नीता युगान्तप्रतिमेन वै ॥
units.english: All the huge trees, which were grown on the bank near him, were in no time consumed by the fire of anger discharged by that king of serpents, resembling the very incarnation of the end of a Yuga.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्राश् च दाराश् च भृत्याश् चान्ये महोरगाः । वमन्तः पावकं घोरं वक्त्रेभ्यो विषसंभवम् । प्रवेशितश् च तैः सर्पैः स कृष्णो भोगबन्धनम् । निर्यत्नचरणाकारस् तस्थौ गिरिर् इवाचलः ॥ ददंशुर् दशनैस् तीक्ष्णैर् विषोत्पीडजलाविलैः । ते कृष्णं सर्पपतयो न ममार च वीर्यवान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon his son Dāra and his servants, the other leading serpents of incomparable energy, came there vomitting the dreadful fire of venom accompanied by smokes -. Thereupon they made Krishna enter into a circle of their hoods. Having his hands and feet made incapable of putting forth any exertion he stood there motionless like a mountain. The leading serpents began to sprinkle Krishna with water vitiated by their teeth. The powerful Krishna however did not die.

units.sanskrit: क्रन्दमाना व्रजं जग्मुर् बाष्पसंदिग्धया गिरा ॥ एष मोहं गतः कृष्णो मग्नो वै कालियह्रदे । भक्ष्यते सर्पराजेन तद् आगच्छत माचिरम् ॥
units.english: In the meantime the cow-herd boys, filled with fear, returned weeping to Vraja and with suppressed voice said : Out of foolishness Krishna is drowned in the lake Kālya. The king of serpents is devouring him. Do ye all come without delay.

units.sanskrit: नन्दगोपाय वै क्षिप्रं बल्लवाय निवेद्यताम् । एष ते कृष्यते पुत्रः सर्पेणेति महाह्रदे ॥
units.english: Do ye speedily go and communicate to Nanda and his followers that Krishna is being dragged into the lake by the serpent.

units.sanskrit: नन्दगोपस् तु तच् छ्रुत्वा वज्रपातोपमं वचः । आर्तः स्खलितविक्रान्तस् तं जगाम ह्रदोत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Hearing those words like unto the fall of a thunderbolt the milk-man Nanda was greatly distressed with sorrow and speedily went to that most excellent lake.

units.sanskrit: सबालयुवतीवृद्धः स च संकर्षणो युवा । आक्रीडं पन्नगेन्द्रस्य जनस् तं समुपागमत् ॥ नन्दगोपमुखा गोपास् ते सर्वे साश्रुलोचनाः । केचित् तु कृष्ण हा हेति हा धिग् इत्य् अपरे पुनः । अपरे हा हताः स्मेति रुरुदुर् भृशदुःखिताः ॥ स्त्रियश् चैव यशोदां ताम् हा हतासीति चुक्रुशुः । या पश्यसि प्रियं पुत्रं सर्पराजवशंगतं । संदितं सर्पभोगेन कृष्यमाणं यथा मृगम् ॥
units.english: All the inhabitants of Vraja, accompanied by the youthful Sangkarshana, boys, old men and young ladies, arrived at the watery abode of that king of serpents. Having reached the the bank of that lake all the milkmen, headed by Nanda, stricken with shame, surprise and sorrow, began to bewail with their eyes full of tears. Some cried, exclaiming Oh, son! while others said Alas! woe to us! –. Whereas others, assailed greatly by fear, cried Alas! We are all slain! The women, crying aloud, said to Yashodā Alas! We are all killed. Behold your son brought under the control of the king of serpents. He is trembling there as if churned, like ambrosia, by the hood of the serpent –.

units.sanskrit: अश्मसारमयं नूनं हृदयं ते ऽभिलक्ष्यते । पुत्रं कथम् इमं दृष्ट्वा यशोदे नावदीर्यते ॥
units.english: Forsooth, your heart is made of stone, since it is not breaking assunder even beholding your son in this plight.

units.sanskrit: दुःखितं बत पश्यामो नन्दगोपं ह्रदान्तिके । न्यस्य पुत्रमुखे दृष्टिं निश्चेतनम् अवस्थितम् ॥
units.english: See, the milkman Nanda, filled with grief, is standing on the bank of the lake like one unconscious, fixing his look on the face of his son.

units.sanskrit: यशोदाम् अनुगच्छन्त्यः सर्पावासम् इमं ह्रदम् । प्रविशामो न यास्यामः सर्वा दामोदरं विना ॥
units.english: Following Yashodā we shall rather enter into this lake, the abode of the serpents. And still we will not return to Vraja without Dāmodara.

units.sanskrit: दिवसः को विना सूर्यं विना चन्द्रेण का निशा । विना वृषेण का गावो विना कृष्णेन को व्रजः । विना कृष्णं न यास्यामो विवत्सा इव धेनवः ॥
units.english: Without Krishna Vraja shall never appear beautiful like the day shorn of the sun, or the night shorn of the moon or the cow divorced from the bull. Separated from Krishna we shall not go there like a cow without her calf.

units.sanskrit: विलापं नन्दगोपस्य यशोदां रुदतीं तथा । एकभावशरीरज्ञ एकदेहो द्विधाकृतः । संकर्षणस् तु संक्रुद्धो बभाषे कृष्णम् अव्ययम् ॥ कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो गोपानां नन्दिवर्धन । इमे नो बान्धवास् तात त्वां मत्वा मानुषं प्रभो । परिदेवन्ति करुणम् सर्वे मानुषबुद्धयः ॥
units.english: Hearing the lamentations of the male and female inhabitants of Vraja, and of Nanda and the cries of Yashodā, Sangkarshana, who though of one mind, one body and one intelligence, was still a separate person, said in anger to Krishna –:— Krishna, thou of large-arms, thou who dost enhance the delight of the milkmen, do thou soon destroy this venomous serpent-king. my brother, my lord, all these our relations have human understandings and so they are bewailing for thee considering thee a human being.

units.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा रौहिणेयस्य वाक्यं संज्ञासमीरितम् । विक्रीड्यास्फोटयद् बाहू तद् भित्त्वा भोगबन्धनम् ॥
units.english: Hearing those wise words of Rohini's son, Krishna sportively raised up his arms and rose up snapping the fetters of the serpents.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पद्भ्यां अथाक्रम्य भोगराशिं जलोक्षितम् । तस्यारुरोह सहसा मध्यमं तन् महच् छिरः । सो ऽस्य मूर्ध्नि स्थितः कृष्णो ननर्त रुचिराङ्गदः ॥
units.english: And placing his feet on the hoods of the serpent-king that were above the water he got hold of his bead with his hands. Then rising up, by force, on his middle head, Krishna, who was adorned with a beautiful Angada, began to dance there.

units.sanskrit: मृद्यमानः स कृष्णेन श्रान्तमूर्धा भुजंगमः । अस्यैः सरुधिरोद्गारैः कातरं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Thus grinded by Krishna the hoods of that serpent-king became pale and blood came out therefrom. Kālya then with dreadful accents said to him.

units.sanskrit: अविज्ञानान् मया कृष्ण रोषो ऽयं संप्रदर्शितः । दमितो ऽहं हतविषो वशगस् ते वरानन ॥ शरणं त्वां प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि जीवितं मे प्रदीयताम् ॥ इत्य् उक्त्वा स शिरोभिस् तु कृष्णपादाव् अपूजयत् । पञ्चमूर्धानतं दृष्ट्वा सर्पं सर्पारिकेतनः । अक्रुद्ध एव भगवान् प्रत्युवाचोरगेश्वरम् ॥ गच्छार्णवजलं सर्प सपुत्रः सहबान्धवः ॥ यश् चेह भूयो दृश्येत स्थले वा यदि वा जले । तव भृत्यस् तनूजो वा क्षिप्रं वध्यः स मे भवेत् ॥
units.english: Krishna of a beautiful countenance, unwittingly did display anger against thee. But now have been vanquished and subdued by thee and my venom has been destroyed. Do thou give me my life and command me whom am to serve along with my wife, children and friends –. Beholding that five-hooded serpent-king and hearing his distressful words, the Lord Krishna, having the enemy of serpents as his carrier, replied like one having no anger :— serpent, do not wish to allow you to live in this water of Yamunā. Therefore repair to the ocean with your wife and kinsmen. After this whoever amongst your sons and servants shall be seen either in the water or on the land of this province he will be killed by me.

units.sanskrit: शिवं चास्य जलस्यास्तु त्वं च गच्छ महार्णवम् । स्थाने त्व् इह भवेद् दोषस् तवान्तकरणो महान् ॥
units.english: king of serpents, let this water prove wholesome unto all and yourself proceed to the mighty deep. If you remain here after this you will be visited by a great calamity that will bring about the termination of your life.

units.sanskrit: गरुदः पन्नगरिपुस् त्वयि न प्रहरिष्यति ॥
units.english: If Garuda, the enemy of serpents, behold in the ocean, my foot-marks on your head he will not kill you.

units.sanskrit: गृह्य मूर्ध्ना तु चरणौ कृष्णस्योरगपुंगवः । पश्यताम् एव गोपानां जगामादर्शनं ह्रदात् ॥
units.english: Thus accosted by the Lord that foremost of serpents Kalya, carrying on his head Krishna’s foot-marks, fled away stealthily from the lake in the very presence of the milk-men.

units.sanskrit: निर्जिते तु गते सर्पे कृष्णम् उत्तीर्य विष्ठितम् । विस्मितास् तुष्टुवुर् गोपाश् चक्रुश् चैव प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
units.english: After the king of serpents had thus fled away vanquished the Lord came out from the water and stood on the bank. Filled with surprise the milk-men chanted his glories and circumambulated him.

units.sanskrit: ऊचुः सर्वे सुसंप्रीता नन्दगोपं वनेचराः । धन्यो ऽस्य् अनुगृहीतो ऽसि यस्य ते पुत्र ईदृशः ॥
units.english: Thereupon those milk-men, living in the forest, delightedly said to Nanda: Indeed thou art fortunate and a favourite of the gods since your son is so very powerful.

units.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति गोपानां गवां घोषस्य चानघ । आपत्सु शरणं कृष्णः प्रभुश् चायतलोचनः ॥
units.english: From to-day, sinless one, the powerful Krishna, having large eyes, will be a refuge of the milk-men in their perils and a protector of the kine in the cow-shed.

units.sanskrit: जाता शिवजला सर्वा यमुना मुनिसेविता । सर्वैस् तीर्थैः सुखं गावो विचरिष्यन्ति नः सदा ॥
units.english: The water of the Yamunā has become everywhere delightful and wholesome. From now all our kine will happily range in every landing stair.

units.sanskrit: व्यक्तम् एव वयं गोपा वने यत् कृष्णम् ईदृशम् । एवं ते विस्मिताः सर्वे स्तुवन्तः कृष्णम् अव्ययम् । जग्मुर् गोपगणा घोषं देवाश् चैत्ररथं यथा ॥
units.english: Really we are milk-men for we have not been able to know Krishna truly in Vraja like fire covered with ashes. Thereupon eulogising the immortal Krishna the milk-men, filled with surprise, entered their hamlet like unto the celestials entering the Chitraratha garden.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच दमिते सर्पराजे तु कृष्णेन यमुनाह्रदे । तम् एव चेरतुर् देशम् सहितौ रामकेशवौ ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—After the king of serpents had been vanquished by Krishna in the lake of Yamunā Rāma and Keshava began to range there.

units.sanskrit: गिरिं गोवर्धनं रम्यं वसुदेवसुताव् उभौ ॥ गोवर्धनस्योत्तरतो यमुनातीरम् आश्रितम् । ददृशाते ऽथ तौ वीरौ रम्यं तालवनं महत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon going to the mountain Govarddhana along with their precious kine, those two heroic sens of Vasudeva beheld a huge forest of palm trees, situate, on its north, on the bank of Yamunā -.

units.sanskrit: तौ तालपर्णप्रतते रम्ये तालवने रतौ । चेरतुः परमप्रीतौ वृषपोताव् इवोद्गतौ ॥
units.english: They were greatly delighted at its sight and began to range in that charming forest of palm trees covered with palm leaves like two new grown plants.

units.sanskrit: दर्भप्रायस्थलीभूतः सुमहान् कृष्णमृत्तिकः ॥ तालैस् तैर् विपुलस्कन्धैर् उच्छ्रितैः श्यामपर्वभिः । फलाग्रशाखिभिर् भाति नागहस्तैर् इवोच्छ्रितैः ॥
units.english: It was well levelled, cool, coated with black earth and profuse grass and was freed from stones and clods of earth. Dark-blue and tall palm trees, with fruits and branches hanging, shone there like the trunks of elephants –.

units.sanskrit: तत्र दामोदरो वाक्यम् उवाच वदतां वरः । अहो तालफलैः पक्वैर् वासितेयं वनस्थली ॥ तालपक्वानि सहितौ पातयावो लघुक्रमौ ॥ यद्य् एषाम् ईदृशो गन्धो मधुरो घ्रानसंमतः । रसेनामृतकल्पेन भविष्यन्तीति मे मतिः ॥
units.english: While thus ranging Dāmodara, the foremost of speakers, said to Sangkarshana:— reverend sir, this forest-land is perfumed with the fragrance of ripe palm fruits. Let us both quickly pluck the sweet, ripe and dark-blue fruits. While its smell is so very sweet and pleasing to the odiferous organ it must undoubtedly be delicious like ambrosia. This is in short my conviction –.

units.sanskrit: दामोदरवचः श्रुत्वा रौहिणेयो हसन्न् इव । पातयंस् तालपक्वानि चालयाम् आस तांस् तरून् ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Dāmodara, Rohini’s son smilingly shook the trees with a view of felling down the fruits.

units.sanskrit: तत् तु तालवनं नॄणाम् असेव्यं दुरतिक्रमम् । निर्माणभूतम् इरिणं पुरुषादालयोपमम् ॥
units.english: Appearing like a desert, although very useful, that forest of palm trees was unworthy of being resorted to and traversed by men like a habitation of the Rākshasas.

units.sanskrit: दारुणो धेनुको नाम दैत्यो गर्दभरूपवान् । खरयूथेन महता वृतः समुपसेवते ॥ नृपक्षिश्वापदगणांस् त्रासयानः स दुर्मतिः ॥ तालशब्दं स तं श्रुत्वा संघुष्टं फलपातने । स्तब्धाक्षो हेषितपटुः खुरैर् निर्दारयन् महीम् ॥ आविद्धपुच्छो हृषितो व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः । आपतन्न् एव ददृशे रौहिणेयम् अवस्थितम् ॥ जघानोरसि दैत्यः स रौहिणेयं निरायुधम् ॥ ताभ्याम् एव स जग्राह पद्भ्यां तं दैत्यगर्दभम् । आवर्जितमुखस्कन्धं प्रैरयत् तालमूर्धनि ॥ स भग्नोरुकटिग्नीवो भग्नपृष्ठो दुराकृतिः । खरस् तालफलैः सार्धं पपात धरणीतले ॥ ज्ञातींस् तथापरांस् तस्य चिक्षेप तृणराजनि ॥ सा भूर् गर्दभदेहैश् च तालपक्वैश् च पातितैः । बभासे छन्नजलदा द्यौर् इवाव्यक्तशारदी ॥ तस्मिन् गर्दभदैतेय तु सानुगे विनिपातिते । रम्यं तालवनं तद्द् हि भूयो रम्यतरं बभौ ॥ विप्रमुक्तभयं शुभ्रं विविक्ताकारदर्शनम् । ततः प्रव्याहृताः सर्वे गोपा वननिवासिनः । वीतशोका वनं सर्वे चञ्चूर्यन्ते स्म ते सुखम् ॥ ततः सुखं प्रकीर्णासु गोषु नागेन्द्रविक्रमौ । द्रुमपर्णासने कृत्वा तौ यथार्हं निषिदतुः ॥
units.english: For encircled by a herd of mules that huge and dreadful demon Dhenuka used always to live there, in the shape of an ass. Terrifying men, beasts and birds there that wicked minded ass used to protect the forest of palm trees. Hearing the sound of the fall of palm fruits he grew exceedingly enraged and could not bear it like unto an elephant. Shaking his manes in anger, lifting up his tail in delight and scratching the earth with his hoof that Daitya, of motionless eyes and wide lips, followed the sound of palm fruits and arrived where the son of Rohini was –. Beholding under the palm tree that immortal son of Rohini resembling a flag in form, that Daitya-chief Khara, having the teeth for his weapon, all on a sudden bit him; and then turning back his face he struck his breast with his long legs – Then holding that demon in the shape of an ass by the legs and whirling his head and shoulders Sangkarshana threw him up on the top of the palm tree. He too, with his thighs, waist, neck and back mutilated and a disfigured form, fell down on earth along with palm fruits. Beholding that ass thus dead and shorn of beauty Baladeva threw up his other relations too on the top of the tree. At that time the ground there was covered with palm fruits and bodies of the asses and it shone there like the autumnal sky covered with clouds. Thus when that Daitya, in the form of an ass, was slain with all his followers that forest of palm trees assumed again a picturesque view. When that most excellent white forest of palm trees was shorn of fear the kine began to range there with great glee. And entering that forest the milkmen, rangers of woods, began to move about on all sides divested of sorrow and fear. Observing the kine roam on all sides at ease the two sons of Vasudeva, powerful like elephants, spread there seats of grass and sat down at ease.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच अथ तौ जातहर्षौ तु वसुदेवसुताव् उभौ । चारयन्तौ विवृद्धानि गोधनानि शुभाननौ । स्फीतसस्यप्ररूढानि वीक्षमाणौ वनानि च ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thereupon leaving off that forest of palm trees the two sons of Vasudeva again came to the Bhandira tree. Traversing that prosperous forest land and tending the ever increasing flock of kine those two beautiful subduers of enemies began to strike their arms and sing.

units.sanskrit: नामभिर् व्याहरन्तौ च सवत्सा गाः परंतपौ ॥
units.english: Sometimes they collected the trees and called the kine with their calves by names –.

units.sanskrit: निर्योगपाशैर् आसक्तौ स्कन्धाभ्याम् शुभलक्षणौ । वनमालाकृतोरस्कौ बालशृङ्गाव् इवर्षभौ ॥
units.english: They had ropes hanging on their shoulders and their breasts were adorned with garlands of auspicious wild flowers. And they looked like two bulls with new-grown horns.

units.sanskrit: सुवर्णाञ्जनवर्णाभाव् अन्योन्यसदृशाम्बरौ । महेन्द्रायुधसंसक्तौ शुक्लकृष्णाव् इवाम्बुदौ ॥
units.english: Having the hue of gold and powdered collyrium and clad in apparels of the same color with their respective persons, those two boys appeared like white and black clouds accompanied by rain-bow.

units.sanskrit: कुशाग्रकुसुमानां च कर्णपूरमनोरमौ । वनमार्गेषु कुर्वाणौ वन्यवेषधराव् उभौ ॥ गोवर्धनस्यानुचरौ वने सानुचरौ च तौ । चेरतुर् लोकसिद्धाभिः क्रीडाभिर् अपराजितौ ॥
units.english: Traversing the forest-ways along with their comrades, making beautiful ear-rings with the tips of Kuçā grass or flowers, and putting on wild dresses they sometimes sported on the mount Govardhana, sometimes in the forest and some times in the table-land. They thus engaged in a sport which was celebrated all over the world -.

units.sanskrit: ताव् एनं मानुषीं दीक्षां वहन्तौ सुरपूजितौ । तज्जातिगुणयुक्ताभिः क्रीडाभिश् चेरतुर् वनम् ॥
units.english: Thus following human conduct and engaging in a play introduced by milk-men they, who were worshipful even unto the celestials, began to range in the forest.

units.sanskrit: तौ तु भाण्डीरम् उचिते काले क्रीडानुवर्तिनौ । प्राप्तौ परमशाखाढ्यं न्यग्रोधं शाखिनां वरम् ॥
units.english: Thus sporting, they, within a short time, reached the Bhāndiraka fig-tree covered with growing branches—the best of the kind.

units.sanskrit: तत्र स्पन्दोलिकाभिश् च युद्धमार्गैश् च दंशितौ । युद्धमार्गैश् च विविधैर् गोपालैः सहिताव् उभौ । मुदितौ सिंहविक्रान्तौ यथाकामं विचेरतुः ॥
units.english: They, who were experts in fighting, began to play there with cradles, nets and stones. Those two heroes, powerful like lions, began to display there, in the company of cow-herd boys, of their own accord and with delight, many a martial feat.

units.sanskrit: तयो रमयतोर् एवं तल्लिप्सुर् असुरोत्तमः । प्रलम्बो ऽभ्यागमत् तेषां छिद्रान्वेषी तयोस् तदा ॥
units.english: While they were thus playing, the foremost of Asuras, by name Pralamva, came there with a view to kill them and began to find out their weak points.

units.sanskrit: गोपालवेषम् आस्थाय वन्यपुष्पविभूषितः । लोभयानः स तौ वीरौ हास्यैः क्रीडनकैस् तथा ॥
units.english: Assuming the form of a cow-herd and adorned with wild flowers that Asura began to tempt the two brothers with his play and smiles.

units.sanskrit: मानुषं वपुर् आस्थाय प्रलम्बो दानवोत्तमः ॥
units.english: Adopting a human form, although not born in the race of men that foremost of Dānavas, fearlessly joined their company.

units.sanskrit: प्रक्रीडिताश् च ते सर्वे सह तेनामरारिणा । गोपालवपुषं गोपा मन्यमानाः स्वबान्धवम् ॥
units.english: Considering him, who came there in the form of a milk-man, as their friend, those cow-herds began to play with that enemy of the immortals.

units.sanskrit: दृष्टिं परिदधे कृष्णे रौहिणेये च दारुणाम् ॥
units.english: Searching their weak points Pralamva too, who had assumed the guise of a milk-man, cast his dreadful looks at Krishna and Rohini's son.

units.sanskrit: अविषह्यं ततो मत्वा कृष्णम् अद्भुतविक्रमम्ः। रौहिणेयवधे यत्नम् अकरोद् दानवोत्तमः ॥
units.english: Then considering Krishna of wonderful prowess as irrepressible he gave him up and made up his mind for destroying Baladeva.

units.sanskrit: प्रक्रीडिताश् च ते सर्वे द्वौ द्वौ युगपद् उत्पतन् ॥
units.english: sinless one, at that time the Lord introduced a new of play of leaping in pairs. And all of them engaged in it.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णः श्रीदामसहितः पुप्लुवे गोपसूनुना । प्रद्रुता लङ्घयन्तो वै ते ऽन्योन्यं लघुविक्रमाः ॥ श्रीदामम् अजयत् कृष्णः प्रलम्बं रोहिणीसुतः । ते वाहयन्तस् त्व् अन्योन्यम् संहर्षात् सहसा द्रुताः । भाण्डीरस्कन्धम् उद्दिश्य मर्यादां पुनर् आगमन् ॥ संकर्षणं तु स्कन्धेन शीघ्रम् उत्क्षिप्य दानवः । द्रुतं जगाम विमुखः सचन्द्र इव तोयदः ॥ वहन् द्रुततरं प्रागाद् अवरोहणतः परम् । स भारम् असहंस् तस्य रौहिणेयस्य धीमतः । ववृधे सुमहाकायश् चन्द्राक्रान्त इवाम्बुदः ॥ स भाण्डीरवटप्रख्यं दग्धाञ्जनगिरिप्रभम् । पञ्चस्तबकयुक्तेन मुकुटेनार्कवर्चसा । दीप्यमानाननो दैत्यः सूर्याक्रान्त इवाम्बुदः ॥ महाननो महाग्रीवः उमहान् अन्तकोपमः । रौद्रः शकटचक्राक्षो नामयंस् चरणैः क्षितिम् ॥ धीरः प्रलम्बः प्रययौ तोयलम्ब इवाम्बुदः ॥ स जहारैव वेगेन रौहिणेयं महासुरः । सागरोपप्लवगतं कृत्स्नं लोकम् इवान्तकः ॥
units.english: Krishna jumped with another milk-boy by name Sridāma and Sangkarshana with Pralamva, sinless one. The other milk-boys, of inferior strength, began to leap with great force in the company of their comrades. Krishna defeated Sridāma and Rohini's son Pralamva and other boys were vanquished by those of Krishna’s party. Thereupon carrying on their shoulders the victorious those, who were vanquished, came delightedly and quickly to the root of the Bhāndiraka tree and soon reached their appointed quarter. And carrying on his shoulders Baladeva, the foremost of Dānavas, Pralamva, began to proceed quickly in an opposite direction like a cloud with the moon –. Being unable to carry the weight of the intelligent son of Rohini that huge-bodied demon increased his body like a cloud attacked by Sakra. Then that foremost of Danavas Pralamva displayed his own body huge as the Bhandiraka fig-tree and effulgent like a mountain of burnt collyrium. Then that huge-faced and huge-necked dreadful demon, having eyes like unto the wheels of a car, a head adorned with a sun-like coronet of five layers and resembling Death himself, shone like a cloud attacked by the sun. The earth sank under the weight of his feet -. As Death carries away men sunk in the waves of the ocean, so the great demon Pralamva, the foremost of heroes, adorned with long garlands and other ornaments and clad in a long raiment, carried away quickly and stealthily Rohini's son like a cloud surcharged with water.

units.sanskrit: ह्रियमाणः प्रलम्बेन स तु संकर्षणो युवा । उह्यमान इवैकेन कालमेघेन चन्द्रमाः ॥
units.english: While thus carried away by him Sangkarshana shone there like the moon in the sky carried by dreadful clouds –.

units.sanskrit: स संदिग्धम् इवात्मानं मेने संकर्षणस् तदा । दैत्यस्कन्धगतः श्रीमान् कृष्णं चेदम् उवाच ह ॥
units.english: Beholding himself on the shoulders of the demon the dreadful Sangkarshana began to cherish suspicions in his mind and said to Krishna.

units.sanskrit: ह्रिये ऽहं कृष्ण दैत्येन पर्वतोदग्रवर्चसा । प्रदर्शयित्वा महतीम् मायां मानुषरूपिणीम् ॥
units.english: Krishna, am being carried away by this Daitya huge like a mountain and clad in a coat of mail who has displayed a great illusion and assumed the form of a man.

units.sanskrit: प्रलम्बस्य प्रवृद्धस्य दर्पाद् द्विगुणवर्चसः ॥
units.english: This wicked-minded Pralamva has grown exceedingly in pride and his power has doubled itself. How shall vanquish him?

units.sanskrit: तम् आह सस्मितं कृष्णः साम्ना हर्षकलेन वै । अभिज्ञो रौहिणेयस्य वृत्तस्य च बलस्य च ॥
units.english: Krishna knew very well the character and strength of Rohini's son and therefore smilingly and quietly said to him in joyous words :– god, thou art identical with the universe and art subtler than the subtle.

units.sanskrit: अहो ऽयं मानुषो भावो व्यक्तम् एवानुगृह्यते । स्मरार्य तनुम् आत्मानम् लोकानां त्वं विपर्यये । अवगच्छात्मनात्मानम् समुद्राणां समागमे ॥ पुरातनानां देवानां ब्रह्मणः सलिलस्य च । आत्मवृत्तप्रवृत्तानि संस्मराद्यं च वै वपुः ॥
units.english: Thou art merely showing the conduct of a man. Do thou meditate thy own Nārāyana form at the time of the revolution of the worlds. Do thou now know of thy own true form and body which thou didst manifest at the time of the union of the ancient Rishis, powerful on account of their own faculties, of the oceans, Brahmā and water –.

units.sanskrit: शिरः खं ते जलं मूर्तिः क्षमा भूर् दहनो मुखम् । वायुर् लोकायुर् उच्छ्वासो मनःस्रष्टा मनुस् तव ॥
units.english: The sky is thy head, the water is thy form, the earth is thy forgiveness, the fire is thy mouth, the life of all the worlds is thy breath, the air is thy abode, and thy mind is the creator all.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षो विश्वात्मा शतजिह्वः शतोदरः । सहस्रपत्रनाभस् त्वं सहस्रांशुधरो ऽरिहा ॥
units.english: Thou art of thousand faces, thousand limbs, thousand feet, thousand eyes, thousand lotus-navels and thousand rays, and the slayer of thy enemies.

units.sanskrit: यत् त्वया दर्शितं लोके तत् पश्यन्ति दिवौकसः । यत् त्वया नोक्तपूर्वं हि कस् तद् अन्वेष्टुम् अर्हति ॥
units.english: The celestials behold what thou didst display before. None can find out what had not been said by thee before.

units.sanskrit: यद् वेदितव्यं लोके ऽस्मिंस् तत् त्वया समुदाहृतम् । विदितं यत् तवैकस्य देवा अपि न तद् विदुः ॥
units.english: Whatever is capable of being known in this world thou hast made them all known. All the celestials do not know what thou alone dost know.

units.sanskrit: आत्मजं ते वपुर् व्योम्नि न पश्यन्त्य् आत्मसंभवम् । यत् तु ते कृत्रिमं रूपं तद् अर्चन्ति दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: The deities see thy own natural etherial form and worship that artificial form of thine, begotten of thy own self which thou didst assume in the golden age.

units.sanskrit: दवैर् न दृष्टश् चान्तस् ते तेनानन्त इति स्मृत । त्वं हि सूक्ष्मो महान् एकः सूक्ष्मैर् अपि दुरासदः ॥
units.english: The gods can not see thy end and therefore thou dost pass by the appellation of Ananta. Thou art alone subtle and beyond the comprehension of the subtle.

units.sanskrit: त्वय्य् एव पर्वतस्तम्भा शाश्वती जगती स्थिता । अचला प्राणिनां योनिर् धारयत्य् अखिलं जगत् ॥ चतुःसागरभोगस् त्वं चातुर्वर्ण्यविभागवित् । चतुर्युगेशो लोकानां चातुर्होत्रफलाशनः ॥
units.english: god, thou art the pillar of this universe. And stationed in thee this world, the source of the origin of all creatures, is upholding all the regions. My body extends over the four oceans and thou hast instituted the division of the four Varnas. Thou art the lord of the four Yugas and the eater of the fruits of the four Hotras.

units.sanskrit: यथा त्वम् असि लोकानां तथाहं तच् च मे मतम् । उभाव् एकशरीरौ स्वो जगदर्थे द्विधा कृतौ ॥
units.english: Although we both are of one body, we have assumed two different forms for protecting the universe, mobile and immobile. As am the Lord of the universe so thou art.

units.sanskrit: अहं वा शाश्वतः कृष्णस् त्वं वा शेषः पुरातनः । लोकानां शाश्वतो देवस् त्वं हि शेषः सनातनः । आवयोर् देहमात्रेण द्विधेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
units.english: am the eternal Krishna and thou art the ancient Sesha. Thou art the ever-existent god Sesha of the world. The world is upheld by our body divided in twain.

units.sanskrit: अहं यः स भवान् एव यस् त्वं सो ऽहं सनातनः । द्वाव् एव विहितौ ह्य् आवाम् एकदेहौ महाबलौ ॥
units.english: am identical with thee and thou art at one with me. Both of us are highly powerful and of one body.

units.sanskrit: तदास्से मूढवत् किं त्वं प्राग् एनं जहि दानवम् । मूर्ध्नि देवरिपुं देव वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ॥
units.english: What is the use, God, of waiting like one having no sense? Do thou strike forcibly, with thy fist, firm as a thunder-bolt, the head of this Dānava, the enemy of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: संस्मारितः स कृष्णेन रौहिणेयः पुरातनम् । स बलेन तदा पूर्णस् त्रैलोक्यान्तरचारिणा ॥ बलेनायुज्यत तदा महतान्येन दीप्तिमान् । तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण कपालं तद् द्विधाभवत् । जानुद्भ्यां जगतीं चैव गतासुः स जगाम ह ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing those words of Krishna and recollecting the ancient history the mighty-armed son of Rohini was filled with his own strength pervading the three worlds and with his well-formed fist resembling a thunder-bolt struck the wicked Pralamva on the head -. His head, shorn of its fore part, entered into the body of the Danava and he too, divested of his life, touched the ground with his knees.

units.sanskrit: जगत्यां विनिकीर्णस्य तस्य रूपम् अभूत् तदा । प्रलम्बस्याम्बरस्थस्य मेघस्येव विदीर्यतः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, with his body out-stretched on the ground Pralamva looked like a cloud scattered on the sky.

units.sanskrit: तस्य भग्नोत्तमाङ्गस्य देहात् सुस्राव शोणितम् । बहुगैरिकसंयुक्तं शैलशृङ्गाद् इवोदकम् ॥
units.english: As streams of water, mixed with various minerals, come out of the summit of a mountain so blood came out of his body shorn of head.

units.sanskrit: स निहत्य प्रलम्बं तु संहृत्य बलम् आत्मनः । पर्यष्वजत कृष्णं वै रौहिणेयः प्रतापवान् ॥
units.english: Having thus slain Pralamva and withdrawn his own strength the powerful son of Rohini embraced Krishna.

units.sanskrit: तं तु कृष्णश् च गोपाश् च दिविस्थाश् च दिवौकसः । तुष्टुवुर् निहते दैत्ये जयाशीर्भिर् महाबलम् ॥ बलेनायं हतो दैत्यो बालेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । विचरन्त्य् अशरीरिण्यो वाचः सुरसमीरिताः । बलदेवेति नामस्य देवैश् चोक्तं दिवि स्थितैः ॥ बलं तु बलदेवस्य तदा भुवि जना विदुः । कर्मजं निहते दैत्ये देवैर् अपि दुरासदे ॥
units.english: Thereupon Krishna, along with the gods stationed in the sky and milkmen began to chant the glories of the highly powerful Baladeva with benedictory hymns bespeaking his victory. In the sky was heard an invisible voice of the celestials declaring This Daitya has been by force killed by a boy of unwearied actions. Thus on that Daitya, irrepressible unto the deities, being slain, the celestials, stationed in the sky, gave him the name Baladeva after his action. Therefore all the worlds call him by the name of Baladeva –.

units.sanskrit: तयोः प्रवृत्तयोर् एवं कृष्णस्य च बलस्य च । वने विचरतोर् मासौ व्यतियातौ स्म वार्षिकौ ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Thus ranging and sporting in the forest Krishna and Baladeva spent the two months of the rainy season.

units.sanskrit: व्रजम् आजग्मतुस् तौ तु व्रजे शुश्रुवतुस् तदा । प्राप्तं शक्रमहं वीरौ गोपांश् चोत्सवलालसान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon returning to Vraja those two heroic brothers heard that arrangements were being made for performing a Yajna in honor of Indra and that the milkmen were busily engaged in merriments.

units.sanskrit: कौतूहलाद् इदं वाक्यं कृष्णः प्रोवाच तत्र वै । को ऽयं शक्रमहो नाम येन वो हर्ष आगतः ॥
units.english: Seeing this, Krishna, filled with curiosity, asked What is that Sakra sacrifice for which you are all filled with delight? Amongst them an elderly milk-man replied:—Hear, why Indra's flag is worshipped.

units.sanskrit: देवानाम् ईश्वरः शक्रो मेघानां चारिसूदन । तेन संचोदिता मेघास् तस्यायुधविभूषिताः । तस्यैवाज्ञाकराः सस्यं जनयन्ति नवाम्बुभिः ॥
units.english: subduer of thy enemies, Indra, the king of the celestials and the lord of the world, is the master of clouds. For this reason from time immemorial and coming down from one family to another, this festival is being celebrated. Commanded by him and embellished by his bow the clouds produce corns with new showers of rain.

units.sanskrit: मेघस्य पयसो दाता पुरुहूतः पुरंदरः । संप्रहृष्टः स भगवान् प्रीणयत्य् अखिलं जगत् ॥
units.english: Pleased with witnessing this festival the Lord Purandara, the giver of clouds and water, and the partaker of many sacrifices, brings about the gratification of the entire world.

units.sanskrit: तेन संपादितं सस्यं वयम् अन्ये च मानवाः । देवो वर्षति लोकेषु ततः सस्यं प्रवर्तते । पृथिव्यां तर्पितायां च सामृतं लक्ष्यते जगत् ॥
units.english: We and other men live by the corns produced by him and the celestials are also gratified thereby. Corns grow up when the king of gods sends down showers. And when the earth is gratified with oblations the whole universe appears as if full of ambrosia.

units.sanskrit: क्षीरवत्य इमा गावो वत्सवत्यश् च निर्वृताः । तेन संवर्धिता गावस् तृणैः पुष्टाः सपुंगवाः ॥ नासस्या नातृणा गावो न बुभुक्षार्दितो जनः । दृश्यते यत्र दृश्यन्ते वृष्टिमन्तो बलाहकाः ॥
units.english: Fed by the grass produced by him the kine, with the bulls and calves, have attained to nourishment and easiness. Wherever the cloud, pouring down water, is seen, there is observed neither a piece of ground shorn of grass and corns nor an hungry animal.

units.sanskrit: दुदोह सवितुर् गा वै शक्रो दिव्याः पयस्वलाः । ताः क्षरन्ति नवं क्षीरं मेध्यं मेघौघधारितम् ॥
units.english: The nectarine rays, of the sun that are milched by the Lord Sakra, are discharged by the clouds in the form of ambrosia-like showers of rain.

units.sanskrit: वाय्वीरितं तु मेघेषु करोति निनदं महत् । जवेनावर्जितं चैव गर्जतीति जना विदुः ॥
units.english: The mighty leonine roar, announced by the air, which he emits with force from the clouds, is designated by the people as the muttering of clouds.

units.sanskrit: तस्य चैवोह्यमानस्य वातयुक्तैर् बलाहकैः । वज्राशनिसमाः शब्दा भवन्त्य् अगमभेदिनः ॥
units.english: The terrible sound, that he sends forth when carried by clouds accompanied by the wind, is heard like the clap of a thunder-bolt that shatters the mountains.

units.sanskrit: तज् जलं वज्रनिष्पेषैर् विमुञ्चति नभोगतम् । बहुभिः कामगैर् मेघैः शक्रो भृत्यैर् इवेश्वरः ॥
units.english: my child, as the great Lord Siva is encircled by the goblins, so Indra, surrounded by clouds coursing at will, and stationed in the sky, sends down showers accompanied by the clap of a thunder-bolt.

units.sanskrit: क्वचिच् छीकरमुक्ताभं कुर्वद्भिर् गगनं घनैः ॥ क्वचिद्भिन्नाञ्जनाकारैः क्वचिच्छीकरवर्षिभिः । एवम् एतत् पयो दुग्धं गोभिः सूर्यस्य वारिदः । पर्जन्यः सर्वलोकानां भवाय भुवि वर्षति ॥
units.english: Sometimes resembling an unfair day, sometimes resembling scattered gold, sometimes resembling collyrium and sometimes pouring water in drops the clouds paint the sky. Thus extracting water from the earth through the rays of the sun, Indra, the giver of water, sends it down again on earth for the behoof of all creatures –.

units.sanskrit: यस्मात् प्रावृड् इयं कृष्ण शक्रस्य भुवि भाविनी । महैः सुरेशम् अर्चन्ति वयम् अन्ये च मानवाः ॥
units.english: For these reasons Krishna, this rainy season has been fixed upon as the time for worshipping Indra. The kings and others men with delight worship Indra in the rainy season. We too do so .

units.sanskrit: गोपवृद्धस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा शक्रपरिग्रहे । प्रभावज्ञो ऽपि शक्रस्य वाक्यं दामोदरो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ वयं वनचरा गोप गोपा गोधनजीविनः । गावो ऽस्मद्दैवतं विद्धि गिरयश् च वनानि च ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing the words of the aged milk-men regarding the festivity of Indra, Dāmodara well-informed of Sakra's might, said to him. We are all milk-men who range in the forest. The precious kine constitute our subsistence. We should therefore worship the kine, the mountains and the forests.

units.sanskrit: कर्षकाणां कृषिर् वृत्तिः पण्यं विपणिजीविनाम् । अस्माकं गौः परा वृत्तिर् एतत् त्रैविध्यम् उच्यते । विद्यया यो यया युक्तस् तस्य सा दैवतं परम् ॥ सैव पूज्यार्चनीया च सैव तस्योपकारिणी । यो ऽन्यस्य फलम् अश्नानः करोत्य् अन्यस्य सत्क्रियाम् । द्वाव् अनर्थौ स लभते प्रेत्य चेह च मानवः ॥
units.english: Cultivation is the means of subsistence to the cultivators, merchandise is to the merchants and the cow is the best means of livelihood to us. This has been laid down by the scholars well-read in the three Vedas. The respective profession of each caste is their great God, is worshipful, adorable and beneficial unto them. He, who, benefitted by one, worships another, is visited by two fold calamities in this world, and in the next after death.

units.sanskrit: कृष्यन्ताः प्रथिताः सीमाः सीमान्तं श्रूयते वनम् । वनान्ता गिरयः सर्वे सा चास्माकं गतिर् ध्रुवा ॥ श्रूयन्ते गिरयश् चापि वने ऽस्मिन् कामरूपिणः । प्रविश्य तास् तास् तनवो रमन्ते स्वेषु सानुषु ॥
units.english: The fields are protected by cultivation, the forests are preserved by fields and the mountains are supported by forests and these mountains are our only refuge. have heard that the mountains, which exist in this forest, assume forms at their will. And adopting various shapes they sport in their table-lands –.

units.sanskrit: भूत्वा केसरिणः सिंहा व्याघ्राश् च नखिनां वराः । वनानि स्वानि रक्षन्ति त्रासयन्तो द्रुमच्छिदः ॥
units.english: Sometimes assuming the forms of tigers, the foremost of those having claws or those of lions adorned with manes, they frighten those who devastate the forest and thus protect their respective woods.

units.sanskrit: यदा चैषां विकुर्वन्ति ते वनालयजीविनः । घ्नन्ति तान् एव दुर्वृत्तान् पौरुषादेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: When tribes living in the forest or those obtaining their livelihood through it disfigure a wood, they, with their work of eating up manliness, destroy them in no time.

units.sanskrit: मन्त्रयज्ञपरा विप्राः सीतायज्ञाश् च कर्षकाः । गिरियज्ञा वयं गोपा इज्यो ऽस्माभिर् गिरिर् वने ॥ तन् मह्यं रोचते गोपा गिरियज्ञं वयं वने । कुर्मः कृत्वा सुखं स्थानं पादपे वाथ वा गिरौ ॥ तत्र हत्वा पशून् मेध्यान् वितत्यायतने कृते । सर्वघोषस्य संदोहः क्रियतां किं विचार्यते ॥
units.english: The Brāhmanas perform Yajnas wherein the Mantras play an important part, the cultivators should perform a sacrifice in honor of a furrow and we milk-men should celebrate one in honor of the mountains. Therefore we should worship the mountains in the forest. Methinks, therefore, milk-men, that engaged in celebrating a Yajna in honor of the mountains do ye engage in actions after your own hearts either at the foot of a tree or of a mountain. Digging wells and setting up sheds in that auspicious place and slaying beasts of sacrifice let the milk-men carry on their festivity. There is no need of holding a discussion over it.

units.sanskrit: गावो गिरिवरं सर्वास् ततो यान्तु वनं पुनः ॥
units.english: Circumambulating that best of mountains embellished with autumnal flowers the kine will again return to Vraja.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्ता किलेयं हि गवां स्वादुवीर्यतृणा गुणैः । शरत्प्रमुदिता रम्या गतमेघजलाशया ॥
units.english: Every one is filled with delight in this charming autumn shorn of clouds, endued with many virtues and abounding in delicious water affording satisfaction to the kine and in grass.

units.sanskrit: प्रियकैः पुष्पितैर् गौरं श्यामं बाणवनैः क्वचित् । कठोरतृणम् आभाति निर्मयूररुतं वनम् ॥
units.english: Somewhere rendered white by blossoming Pryaka flowers and somewhere made dark blue by Bānasanas the forest, abounding in full-grown grass and shorn of peacocks, is appearing greatly beautiful.

units.sanskrit: विवर्तन्ते जलधरा विमदा इव कुञ्जराः ॥
units.english: Clear clouds, shorn of water and lightnings, are moving in the sky like a herd of elephants.

units.sanskrit: विना च मेघनादेन निर्मयूररुतं वनम् । नद्यो बहुविधाकारा जलं स्वच्छं वहन्ति च । सितवर्णाम्बुदोष्णीषं हंसचामरवीजितम् । पूर्णचन्द्रामलच्छत्रं साभिषेकम् इवाम्बरम् ॥
units.english: The trees, enveloped with new grown foliage, are as if being pleased by the continual muttering of clouds drawing in new water. Having the white cloud for its head-gear, fanned by the swan-like chowries and with the full-moon for its umbrella the sky is shining like a newly installed king.

units.sanskrit: हंसैर् विहसितानीव सुमुत्कुष्टानि सारसैः । सर्वाणि तनुतां यान्ति जलानि जलदक्षये ॥
units.english: After the termination of the rainy season all the tanks and pools are as if smiling with the rows of swans. And as if filled with the cries of Sārasas, they are daily decreasing in size.

units.sanskrit: चक्रवाकस्तनतटाः पुलिनश्रोणिमण्डलाः । हंसलक्षणहासिन्यः पतिं यान्ति समुद्रगाः ॥
units.english: The rivers, flowing towards the ocean having the Chakravakas for their breast, the banks for their waist and the swans for their smiles, are as if going to their husbands.

units.sanskrit: कुमुदोत्फुल्लम् उदकं ताराभिश् चत्रम् अम्बरम् । समम् अभ्युत्स्मयन्तीव शर्वरीष्व् इतरेतरम् ॥
units.english: The water, beautified by the full blown lilies and the sky crested with stars, as if mock each other in the night.

units.sanskrit: मत्तक्रौञ्चावघुष्टेषु कलमापक्वपाण्डुषु । निर्विष्टरमणीयेषु वनेषु रमते मनः ॥ पुष्करिण्यस् तडागानि वाप्यश् च विकचोत्पलाः । श्रिया ज्वलत्पङ्कजानि ताम्राणि च सितानि च । उत्पलानि च नीलानि भेजिरे वारिजां श्रियम् ॥ मदं जहुः सितापाङ्गा मन्दं ववृधिरे ऽनिलाः । ऋतुपर्यायशिथिलैर् वृत्तनृत्तसमुज्झितैः । मयूराङ्गरुहैर् भूमिर् बहुनेत्रेव लक्ष्यते ॥
units.english: Beholding the highly charming forest resonant with the notes of Kraunchas and blued with the ripe Kalama paddy one attains to delight of mind. The tanks, pools, lakes and rivers and fields, embellished with blossoming trees, are appearing highly beautiful. Copper coloured and dark-blue lotuses are appearing in the beauty of new water. The peacocks are freed of haughtiness, the sky is divested of clouds, the oceans are full of water and the wind is gradually assuming proportions. The earth is appearing as if of many eyes by the feathers cast off by the peacocks after their dancing in the rainy season.

units.sanskrit: स्वपङ्कमलिनैस् तीरैः काशपुष्पलताकुलैः । हंससारसविन्यासैर् यमुना याति संयता ॥
units.english: With her banks full of mud and covered with Kāsa flowers and creepers and abounding in swans and Sārasas the river Yamunā is appearing highly beautiful.

units.sanskrit: सस्यादा जलजादाश् च मत्ता विरुरुवुः खगाः ॥ सिषिचुर् यानि जलदा जलेन जलदागमे । तानि शष्पाण्य् अबालानि कठिनत्वं गतानि वै ॥
units.english: Ranging in fields filled with corns ripened in proper season and in the forest, the birds, living on corns and water, are emitting notes in excitement. The tender corns, on which the clouds poured their watery contents in the rainy season, have grown hardened.

units.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा मेघमयं वासः शरद्गुणविदीपितः । एष वीतमले व्योम्नि हृष्टो वसति चन्द्रमाः ॥
units.english: Casting off his cloudy raiment and illumined by the autumn the moon is, as if, ranging with a delighted heart, in the clear sky.

units.sanskrit: क्षीरिण्यो द्विगुणं गावः प्रमत्ता द्विगुणं वृषाः । वनानां द्विगुणा लक्ष्मीः सस्यैर् गुणवती मही ॥
units.english: Now the kine have been yielding milk in double the quantity, the bulls have become two-fold maddened, the forest has become twice beautiful and the earth has become highly accomplished with corns.

units.sanskrit: ज्योतींषि घनमुक्तानि पद्मवन्ति जलानि च । मनांसि च मनुष्याणां प्रसादम् उपयान्ति वै ॥
units.english: The luminous bodies, divested of clouds, the water beautified with lotuses, and the mind of men are daily becoming delightful.

units.sanskrit: असृजत् सविता व्योम्नि निर्मुक्तजलदे भृशम् । शरत्प्रज्वलितं तेजस् तीक्ष्णरश्मिर् विशोषयन् ॥
units.english: Divested of clouds and shining in autumnal effulgence the sun, of powerful rays, is spreading its lustre on all sides and drawing the water.

units.sanskrit: नीराजयित्वा सैन्यानि निर्यान्ति विजिगीषवः । अन्योन्यराष्ट्राभिमुखाः पार्थिवाः पृथिवीक्षितः ॥
units.english: Having excited their respective armies the kings, the protectors of the world, desirous of achieving victory, are proceeding against one another.

units.sanskrit: बन्धुजीवाभिताम्रासु बद्धपङ्कवतीषु च । मनस् तिष्ठति कान्तासु चित्रासु वनराजिषु ॥
units.english: The variegated and charming woods, with the mud dried up and reddened by Vandhujiva flowers, are creating the delight of the mind.

units.sanskrit: वनेषु च विराजन्ते पादपा वनशोभिनः । असनाह् सप्तपर्णाश् च कोविदाराश् च पुष्पिताः ॥ इषुसाह्वा निकुम्भाश् च प्रियकाः स्वर्णकास् तथा । व्रजेपु च विशेषेण गर्गरोद्गारहासिषु । शरत्प्रकाशयोषेव गोष्ठेष्व् अटति रूपिणी ॥ नूनं त्रिदशलोकस्थं मेघकालसुखोषितम् । पतत्रिकेतनं देवं बोधयन्ति दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: The blossoming Asana, Saptaparna and Kānchana trees are beautifying the forest. Vānāsana, Dantivitapa, Pryaka Svarnaparna, and Ketaki trees have been covered with flowers and the she-owls and black-bees are moving about hither and thither. As if assuming the beauty of a harlot the autumnal season is walking in Vraja and cow-sheds filled with the sound of churning rods. The foremost of the celestials Vishnu, having the emblem of Garuda on his flag, was happily sleeping during the rainy season. The deities are now trying to awaken him.

units.sanskrit: नीलचन्द्रार्कवर्णैश् च रचितं बहुभिर् द्विजैः । फलैः प्रवालैश् च घनम् इन्द्रचापघनोपमम् । भवनाकारविटपं लतापरम् अमण्डितम् । विशालमूलावनतं पवनाभोगमण्डितम् । अर्चयाम गिरिं देवं गाश् चैव सविशेषतः ॥
units.english: ye milk-men, in this autumn abounding in beautiful corns, we will worship the foremost of mountains, resembling the abode of the wind-god, resorted to by white, red and blue birds, filled with fruits like clouds adorned with the bow of Indra, crested with groves of creepers and trees and adorned with expansive table-lands. We will, in particular, worship the kine –.

units.sanskrit: सावतंसैर् विषाणैश् च बर्हापीडैश् च दंशितैः । घण्टाभिश् च प्रलम्बाभिः पुष्पैः शारदिकैस् तथा ॥
units.english: Adorning the cows with ear-rings, horns, chaplets of peacock feathers, bells hanging around their necks and autumnal flowers, do ye worship them for your well-being.

units.sanskrit: शिवाय गावः पूज्यन्तां गिरियज्ञः प्रवर्तताम् । पूज्यन्तां त्रिदशैः शक्रो गिरिर् अस्माभिर् इज्यताम् ॥
units.english: And let the yajna, in honor of the mountain, be undertaken. We will celebrate a yajna in honor of the mountain as Sakra is worshipped by the celestials.

units.sanskrit: कारिष्यामि गोयज्ञं बलाद् अपि न संशयः । यदास्ति मयि वः प्रीतिर् यदि वा सुहृदो वयम् ॥
units.english: And forsooth we will compel you to perform the yajna for the cows. If you have any love for me, and if am your friend, then do ye all worship the kine.

units.sanskrit: गावो हि पूज्याः सततं सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः । स्यात् तु साम्ना भवेत् प्रीतिर् भवतां वैभवाय च । तत एतन् मम वचः क्रियताम् अविचारितम् ॥
units.english: Do not cherish any doubt in this. If you cherish these my conciliating words, you will meet with your well-being. Therefore without questioning its purpose do ye fulfill my words -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायण उवाच दामोदरवचः श्रुत्वा हृष्टास् ते गोषु जीविनः । तद्वाग् अमृतम् आख्यातं प्रत्यूचुर् अविशङ्कया ॥ तवैषा बाल महती गोपानां हर्षवर्धिनी । त्वं गतिस् त्वं रतिश् चैव त्वं वेत्ता त्वं परायणम् । भयेष्व् अभयदस् त्वं नस् त्वं चैव सुहृदां सुहृत् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing the words of Dāmodara the Gopas were greatly delighted; and being informed of the true import of his nectarine words they unhesitatingly replied : boy, we have been highly pleased seeing this thy understanding conducive to the multiplication of the kine and the well-being of the milk-men. Krishna, thou art our course, delight and refuge. Thou art the friend of our friends.

units.sanskrit: त्वत्कृते कृष्ण घोषो ऽयं क्षेमो मुदितगोकुलः । कृत्स्नो वसति शान्तारिर् यथा स्वर्गगतस् तथा ॥
units.english: By thy favour, this entire hamlet of milk-men the delightful Gokula has been shorn of her enemies. And filled with auspiciousness she is living with joy and happiness like the city of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति दिव्यैस् तैर् विक्रान्तैर् भुवि दुष्करैः । बोद्धव्याच् चाभिमानाच् च विस्मितानि मनांसि नः ॥
units.english: Witnessing these thy deeds worthy of being seen and which it is impossible for others to perform, beginning with thy birth and hearing thy haughty words our minds have been filled with surprise.

units.sanskrit: उत्तमस् त्वं च मर्त्येषु देवेष्व् इव पुरंदरः ॥
units.english: As Purandara is amongst the celestials so thou hast acquired supremacy amongst men by thy matchless strength, power, and fame.

units.sanskrit: उत्तमस् त्वं च मर्त्येषु देवेष्व् इव दिवाकरः । कान्त्या लक्ष्म्या प्रसादेन वदनेन स्मितेन च । उत्तमस् त्वं च मर्त्येषु देवेष्व् इव निशाकरः ॥
units.english: By thy fierce power and consummate effulgence thou hast acquired superiority amongst the mortals like unto the sun amongst the deities. As is the moon amongst the gods, so thou hast acquired prominence amongst men by thy grace, beauty, delightful countenance and smiles.

units.sanskrit: वेषेण वपुषा चैव बाल्येन चरितेन च । स्यात् ते शक्तिधरस् तुल्यो न तु कश्चन मानुषः ॥
units.english: In strength, energy, body, and feats performed in boyhood only Kārtikeya can equal thee. There is none to match thee amongst men.

units.sanskrit: कस् तल् लङ्घयितुं शक्तो वेलाम् इव महोदधेः ॥ स्थितः शक्रमहस् तात श्रीमान् गिरिमहस् त्व् अयम् । त्वत्प्रणीतो ऽद्य गोपानां गवां हेतोः प्रवर्तताम् ॥ भोजनान्य् उपकल्प्यन्तां पयसः पेशलानि च । कुम्भाश् च विनिवेश्यन्ताम् उदपानेषु शोभनाः । लेह्यस्य पायसस्यार्थे द्रोण्यश् च विपुलायताः ॥
units.english: As the great ocean cannot overleap its bank so who can disregard your proposal regarding the performance of a yajna in honor of the mountain ? Let now for the well-being of the kine and milkmen the Giri-yajana, instituted by thee, be undertaken by us in the place of the Indra-yajna. Let delightful viands of milk be prepared and let beautiful jars be placed at the drinking-place. Let spacious rivers and Dronis be filled with milk and take such a quantity of fried meat and various sorts of food and drink to the mountain that the Gopas may spend three nights –.

units.sanskrit: प्रवर्ततां च यज्ञो ऽयं सर्वगोपसुसंकुलः ॥
units.english: Let this yajna, consisting of all milkmen and abounding in the meat of buffalo and other beasts, be at once undertaken .

units.sanskrit: आनन्दजननो घोषो महान् मुदितगोकुलः । तूर्यप्रणादघोषैश् च वृषभाणां च गर्जितैः ॥ हम्भारवैश् च वत्सानां गोपानां हर्षवर्धनः । दधिह्रदो घृतावर्तः पयःकुल्यासमाकुलः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the entire village of milkmen was filled with glee along with the delighted kine. Then with the sound of trumpets, the roar of the bulls and the cries of the calves the Gopas were greatly rejoiced. Lakes of curd, whirlpools of clarified butter and rivers of milk were made there. heap of meat and a mountain-like collection of of boiled rice were taken to the mountain.

units.sanskrit: संप्रावर्तत यज्ञः स गिरेर् गोभिः समाकुलः । तुष्टगोपजनाकीर्णो गोपनारीमनोहरः ॥
units.english: Thus the Giri-Yajna was undertaken by all the milkmen there. There were present the delighted Gopas and the beautiful milk-women.

units.sanskrit: भक्ष्याणां राशयस् तत्र शतशश् चोपकल्पिताः । गन्धमाल्यैश् च विविधैर् धूपैर् उच्चावचैस् तथा । अथाधिश्रितपर्यन्ते पर्याप्ते यज्ञसंविधौ । यज्ञं गिरेस् तिथौ सौम्ये चक्रुर् गोपा द्विजैः सह ॥
units.english: Hundreds of eating-places were set up there. It abounded in garlands, various sorts of perfumeries and incense. Various articles of sacrifice were spread there duly. And thus in the auspicious hour the Gopas, along with the Brāhmanas, celebrated the Giri-Yajna –.

units.sanskrit: यजनान्ते तद् अन्नं तु तत् पयो दधि चोत्तमम् । मांसं च मायया कृष्णो गिरिर् भूत्वा समश्नुते ॥
units.english: After the termination of the yajna, Krishna, assuming, by his illusive energy, the form of a mountain, feasted on that most excellent rice, meat, curd and milk.

units.sanskrit: तर्पिताश् चापि विप्राग्र्यास् तुष्टाः संपूर्णभोजनाः । उत्तस्थुः प्रीतमनसः स्वस्ति वाच्य यथासुखम् ॥
units.english: The Brāhmanas too were pleased with eating there and all their desires were accomplished. And uttering there delightedly the verses of benediction they went away.

units.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा चावभृते कृष्णः पयः पीत्वा च कामतः । संतृप्तो ऽस्मीति दिव्येन रूपेण प्रजहास वै ॥
units.english: Assuming a celestial form and partaking of the food and drink after his own heart in that sacrifice the Lord Krishna smilingly said am satisfied.

units.sanskrit: तं गोपाः पर्वताकारं दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनम् । गिरिमूर्ध्नि स्थितं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं जग्मुः प्रधानतः ॥
units.english: Then beholding on the top of the hill Krishna in the form of a mountain embellished with celestial garlands and pastes, the leading Gopas, bowing, sought refuge with him.

units.sanskrit: भगवान् अपि तेनैव रूपेणाच् छादितः प्रभुः । सह तैः प्रणतो गोपैर् ववन्दात्मानम् आत्मना ॥
units.english: The omnipotent Lord Krishna, having his true form hidden by the mountain, himself adored his own self along with the bowing Gopas.

units.sanskrit: तम् ऊचुर् विस्मिता गोपा देवं गिरिवरे स्थितम् । भगवंस् त्वद्वशे युक्ता दासाः किं कुर्म किंकराः ॥ स उवाच ततो गोपान् गिरिः सुप्रभया गिरा । अद्यप्रभृति याज्यो ऽहं गोषु यद्य् अस्ति वो दया ॥ अहं वः प्रथमो देवः सर्वकामकरः शिवः । मम प्रभावाच् च गवाम् अयुतान्य् एव भोक्ष्यथ ॥
units.english: The Gopas, filled with surprise, said to that god stationed on the best of mountains:— lord, we are thy devoted servants, command us what we are to do. He replied to them in words originating from the mountain:—If you have compassion for the kine, engage in my worship from to-day. am your well-meaning first deity who grant all objects of desire and by my favour you have got, in your possession, ten millions of precious kine.

units.sanskrit: शिवस् च वो भविष्यामि मद्भक्तानां वने वने । रंस्ये च सह युष्माभिर् यथा दिविगतस् तथा ॥
units.english: If you all become my votaries, will encompass your well-being in the forest and enjoy, as in the celestial region, in your company.

units.sanskrit: ये चेमे प्रथिता गोपा नन्दगोपादयः स्थिताः । एषां प्रीतः प्रयच्छामि गोपानां विपुलं धनम् ॥
units.english: Being delighted will confer on Nanda and other leading Gopas immense wealth that is worthy of being acquired by milk-men.

units.sanskrit: पर्याप्नुवन्तु मां क्षिप्रं गावो वत्ससमाकुलाः । एवं मम परा प्रीतिर् भविष्यति न संशयः ॥
units.english: Let the cows along with their calves circumambulate me. will forsooth then attain to highest felicity.

units.sanskrit: ततो नीराजनार्थं वै वृन्दशो गोकुलानि च । परिवव्रुर् गिरिवरं सवृषाणि सहस्रशः ॥ ता गावः प्रस्नुता वत्सैः सापीडस्तबकाङ्गदाः । भक्तिच्छेदानुलिप्ताङ्गा रक्तपीतासिताम्बराः ॥ मयूरचित्राङ्गदिनो भुजैः प्रहरणावृतैः । मयूरपत्रवृन्तानां केशबन्धैः सुयोजितैः । बभ्राजुर् अधिकं गोपाः समवाये तदाद्भुते ॥
units.english: Thereupon to embellish that best of mountains the cows, with all the bulls, in flocks, encircled it. Thereupon with their horns adorned with garlands and be-decked with chaplets on their heads and flowery Angadas, numberless cows delightedly began to circumambulate it quickly. Having their limbs pasted with pastes of diverse colors and clad in red, crimson and yellow raiments the milk-men followed those cows in order to govern them. In that wonderful assembly shone there the milk-men adorned with peacock-feathered Angadas, and chords well arranged for tying their hairs and with weapons in their hands.

units.sanskrit: अन्ये वृषान् आरुरुहुर् नृत्यन्ति स्मापरे मुदा । कृष्णो ऽपि गोपस्थितो विवेश व्रजम् एव ह । गिरियज्ञप्रवृत्तेन तेनाश्चर्येण विस्मितः ॥
units.english: Some milk-men hastened to control the kine, some danced in joy and some rode the bulls. Thus in due order when that festivity terminated the incarnate god of the hill all on a sudden disappeared and Krishna, too, with the Gopas, returned to Vraja.

units.sanskrit: गोपाः सबालवृद्धा वै तुष्टुवुर् मुधुसूदनम्  । नृत्यं गीतं प्रकुर्वाणाः सहकृष्णा व्रजं ययुः । वैशंपायन उवाच महे प्रतिहते शक्रः सक्रोधस् त्रिदशेश्वरः । संवर्तकं नाम गणं तोयदानाम् अथाब्रवीत् ॥ भो बलाहकमातङ्गाः श्रूयतां मम भाषितम् । यदि वो मत्प्रियं कार्यं राजभक्तिपुरस्कृतम् ॥
units.english: Thus when the Giri-Yajna was instituted all the milk-men, boys and elderly people were filled with surprise, on witnessing that wonderful scene and began to chant the glories of Madhusudana –. Vaishampayana said:—While in this wise the festivity, in his honor, was suppressed, Sakra, the king of the celestials said to the clouds called Samvartaka :— ye clouds, and elephants, if you cherish any respect for your king and if you consider it as your duty to do what pleases me listen then to my words.

units.sanskrit: एते वृन्दावन गता दामोदरपरायणाः । नन्दगोपादयो गोपा विद्विषन्ति ममोत्सवम् ॥
units.english: All these inhabitants of Vrindāvana are attached to Dāmodara. Nanda and other Gopas have grown inimical towards my festival.

units.sanskrit: आजीवो यः परस् तेषां गोपत्वं च यतः स्मृतम् । ता गावः सप्तरात्रेण पीड्यन्तां वृष्टिमारुतैः ॥
units.english: Therefore within seven nights, distress, with rain and winds, the precious kine which constitute their life-long subsistence and for which they pass by the name of Gopas.

units.sanskrit: ऐरावतगतश् चाहम् स्वयम् एवाम्बु दारुणम् । स्रक्ष्यामि वृष्टिं वातं च वज्राशनिसमप्रभम् ॥
units.english: myself, stationed on my elephant Airavata, shall discharge dreadful rain, winds and showers effulgent like thunder and lightning.

units.sanskrit: भवद्भिश् चण्डवर्षेण चरता मारुतेन च । हतास् ताः सव्रजा गावस् त्यक्ष्यन्ति भुवि जीवितम् ॥
units.english: With dreadful showers and winds you will kill all the kine and the inhabitants of Vraja and leave them after they all kiss the ground.

units.sanskrit: प्रत्याहते वै कृष्णेन शासने पाकशासनः ॥
units.english: On account of his festival being put down by Krishna the powerful Pākashāsana thus issued his mandate to the clouds.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते जलदाः कृष्णा घोरनादा भयावहाः । आकाशं छादयामासुः सर्वतः पर्वतोपमाः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, the dreadful dark-blue clouds, resembling a mountain in size and muttering awfully, covered the sky on all sides.

units.sanskrit: विद्युत्संपातजननाः शक्रचापविभूषिताः । गजा इवान्ये संसक्ताः केचिन् मकरवर्चसः । नागा इवान्ये गगने चेरुर् जलदपुंगवाः ॥
units.english: Producing lightnings continually the clouds, adorned with the bow of Indra, enshrouded the welkin with darkness. Touching one another, all the clouds, some resembling the elephants, some the Makaras and some the serpents, began to move about in the sky.

units.sanskrit: दुर्दिनं विपुलं चक्रुश् छादयन्तो नभस् तलम् ॥
units.english: Coming in contact with one another the clouds, resembling a million of elephants, covered the sky and created a very unfair day.

units.sanskrit: नृहस्तनागहस्तानां वेणूनां चैव सर्वशः । स्थूलनागोरुहस्तानां सततं सर्वतोदिशम् । धाराभिस् तुल्यरूपाभिर् ववृषुस् ते बलाहकाः ॥
units.english: Showers of equal size, some resembling the hands of men, some the trunks of elephants and some bamboos the clouds began to pour down their watery contents.

units.sanskrit: समुद्रं मेनिरे तं हि खम् आरूढं नृचक्षुषः । दुर्विगाह्यम् अपर्यन्तम् अगाधं दुर्दिनं महत् ॥
units.english: People took that dreadful weather as a deep, unpassable and limitless ocean stationed in the sky.

units.sanskrit: न संपतन्ति खगमा दुद्रुवुर् मृगजातयः । पर्वताभेषु मेघेषु खे नदत्सु समन्ततः ॥
units.english: Hearing the dreadful mutterings of the mountain like clouds, the birds could not come out of their nests and the animals began to fly away on all sides.

units.sanskrit: अतिवृष्टेन लोकस्य विरूपम् अभवद् वपुः ॥ मेघौघैर् निष्प्रभाकारम् अदृश्यग्रहतारकम् । चन्द्रसूर्यांशुरहितं खं बभूवातिनिष्प्रभम् ॥
units.english: By the excessive showers discharged by the dreadful clouds resembling the hour of the universal dissolution the bodies of men grew discoloured. The planets and stars disappearing from view, the sky, shorn of the rays of the sun and the moon was divested of its lustre.

units.sanskrit: आबभौ सर्वतस् तत्र भूमिस् तोयमयी यथा ॥
units.english: With the continual showers of rain let off by the clouds the ground there assumed the form of a tank.

units.sanskrit: विनेदुर् बर्हिणस् तत्र स्तोककाल्परुताः खगाः । विवृद्धिं निम्नगा याताः प्लवगाः संप्लवं गताः ॥ गर्जितेन च मेघानां पर्जन्यनिनदेन च । तर्जितानीव कम्पन्ते तृणानि तरुभिः सह ॥
units.english: The peacocks began to cry aloud and the other birds began to emit their feeble notes. And the rivers, increasing their size, carried away the trees grown on their banks. As if remonstrated with by the mutterings of clouds and the clap of thunderbolts the grass and trees began to tremble there.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्तो ऽन्तकालो लोकानां प्राप्ता चैकार्णवा मही । इति गोपगणा वाक्यं व्याहरन्ति भयार्दिताः ॥
units.english: Beside themselves with fear the milk-men began to speak amongst themselves: We think the end of the world is at hand and the earth will be converted into one sheet of water.

units.sanskrit: तेनोत्पाताम्बुवर्षेण गावो विप्रहता भृशम् । हम्भारवैः क्रन्दमाना न चेलुः स्तम्भितोपमाः । निष्कम्पसक्थिश्रवणा निष्प्रयत्नखुराननाः । काश्चित् प्राणान् जहुः श्रान्ता निपेतुः काश्चिद् आतुराः । काश्चिद् आक्रम्य क्रोडेन वत्सांश् तिष्ठन्ति मातरः । गवां तत्कदनं दृष्ट्वा दुर्दिनागमजं भयम् । गोपांश् चासन्नवदनान् कोपं कृष्णः समादधे ॥ गाश् चापि परमातुराः । रोषताम्रेक्षणः श्रीमान् । आत्मानम् आत्मना वाक्यम् इदम् आह प्रियंवदः ॥
units.english: The cows were greatly distressed by that dreadful downpour of rain. And they stood motionless and began to cry aloud. Their body was soaked, thighs and feet were motionless, hoops and mouth inert, the hairs stood erect and their belly and udders grew lean. Some died out of exhaustion, some took to their heels in fear and some with their calves sank under frost. Some cows, of emaciated belly on account of hunger and wearied thighs, lay to sleep embracing their calves. The cows and calves, thus assailed by rain, fell down trembling and with poor and distressing countenance looked towards Krishna and cried Save us! Save us! Beholding this dreadful oppression over the cows on account of that inclemeny and the impending death of the Gopas the sweet-speeched Krishna was greatly worked up with anger. And meditating for a while he began to speak to himself –:— knew before that this will come to pass.

units.sanskrit: अद्याहम् इमम् उत्पाट्य सकाननवनं गिरिम् । कल्पयेयं गवां स्थानं वर्षत्राणाय दुर्धरम् ॥
units.english: However to protect them against this downpour of rain will uproot this best of mountains Govardhana containing forests and woods and convert it into an asylum for the kine.

units.sanskrit: अयं धृतो मया शैलो भूमीगृहनिभोपमः । त्रास्यन्ते सव्रजा गावो मद्वश्यश् च भविष्यति ॥
units.english: There is not a shadow of doubt that this mountain, a veritable planet on earth, when upheld by me, will be able to protect the kine and milk-men.

units.sanskrit: एवं स चिन्तयित्वा तु विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । इत्य् उक्त्वैकेन हस्तेन कृत्वा गोवर्धनाचलम् । दोर्भ्यां उत्पाटयामास कृष्णो गिरिर् इवापरः ॥ समूलविटपस्कन्धश् चचाल स महागिरिः । शिलाः प्रशिथिलाश् चेलुर् निष्पेतुश् च सपादपाः ॥
units.english: Thus meditating and displaying the strength of his arms Krishna, having truth for his prowess and resembling the best of mountains, uprooted that hill with his hands. Then that foremost of mountains, containing clouds, upheld by Krishna with his left hand, shone there like a house on account of its caves. When that mountain was uprooted the rocks, at its table-land, were shaken and the trees fell down.

units.sanskrit: गोमध्यस्थितगोविन्दो गोपान् रक्षन् सगोकुलान् ॥ दधार गोधनं विष्णुर् गोधरं च विलम्बयन् । चलत्प्रस्रवणैः पार्श्वैर् मेघौघैर् एकतां गतैः । भिद्यमानाश्मनिचयश् चचाल धरणीधरः ॥
units.english: And although that mountain was immoveable still, on account of Krishna's power, with its whirling summits, falling trees and trembling tops it went up to the sky. All the clouds, united, were pouring down their watery contents in its side. With their quick-coursing streams the rocks were loosened and the mountain too was continually agitated.

units.sanskrit: न मेघानां प्रवृष्टानां न शैलस्याश्मवर्षिणः । मेघैः शिखरसंधानैर् जलप्रस्रवणान्वितैः । मिश्रीकृत इवाभाति गिरिर् उद्दामबर्हिणः ॥
units.english: The milk-men however could not perceive the raining clouds, the rock-pouring mountain and the roaring wind. The clouds, attached to the mountain, coming in contact with the springs that best of mountains shone there as if bedecked with peacock feathers.

units.sanskrit: आप्लुतो ऽयं गिरिः पक्षैर् इति विद्याधरोरगाः । गन्धर्वऋषयश् चैव वाचो मुञ्चन्ति सुस्वराः ॥
units.english: Vidyadharas, Uragas, Gandharvas and Apsarās began to exclaim from all sides—Gifted with wings the mount Govardhana is flying up.

units.sanskrit: स कृष्णतलविन्यस्तो मुक्तमूलः क्षितेस् तलात् । रीतीर् निर्वर्तयामास काञ्चनाञ् जनराजतीः ॥
units.english: White, crimson and dark mineral substances began to trickle down from the earthen layer of that uprooted mountain containing a thousand of layers.

units.sanskrit: गिरिणा कम्प्यमानेन कम्पितानां तु शाखिनाम् । पुष्पम् उच्चावचं भूमौ व्यशीर्यत समन्ततः ॥ निःसृताः पृथुमूर्धानः स्वस्तिकार्धविभूषिताः । द्विजिह्वपतयः क्रुद्धाः खेचराः खे समन्ततः ॥ आर्तिं जग्मुः खगगणा वर्षेण च भयेन च । उत्पत्योत्पत्य गगनात् पुनः पेतुर् अवाङ्मुखाः ॥
units.english: Some of the summits of that best of mountain were slackened, some were shattered and the highly elevated ones entered into clouds. With the shaking of the mountains, the trees also shook, and their flowers fell down on all sides of the ground. The big-hooded serpents, having half of their body adorned, issued out of their holes and the birds began to fly up in the sky. Out of fear consequent upon the raising up of the mountain and of heavy downpour these sky rangers began continually to fly up and come down.

units.sanskrit: रेजुश् चारोषिताः सिंहाः सजला इव तोयदाः । गर्गरा इव मथ्यन्तो नेदुः शार्दूलपुंगवाः ॥
units.english: The lions in anger began to roar like clouds surcharged with water and the tigers like that of the churning rods.

units.sanskrit: व्यावृत्तदेहः स गिरी रम्य एवोपलक्ष्यते ॥ अभिवृष्टस्य तैर् मेघैस् तस्य रूपं बभूव ह । स्तम्भितस्येव रुद्रेण त्रिपुरस्य विहायसि ॥
units.english: Having its form metamorphosed that mountain, consisting of even, uneven and impassable places, appeared like another mountain. On account of the excessive downpour of showers it appeared like Tripura stupified by Rudra in in the sky.

units.sanskrit: बाहुदण्डेन कृष्णस्य विधृतं सुमहत् तदा । नीलाभ्रपटलच् छन्नं तद्गिरिच्छत्रम् आबभौ ॥
units.english: Upheld by the rod-like hand of Krishna that huge mountain, covered with dark-blue clouds, appeared there like an umbrella.

units.sanskrit: स्वप्नायमानो जलदैर् निमीलितगुहामुखः । बाहूपधाने कृष्णस्य प्रसुप्त इव खे गिरिः ॥
units.english: The muttering of the clouds making him dream, Govardhana slept there placing his cave-like face on the pillow of Krishna's arm.

units.sanskrit: निरालम्ब इवाभाति गिरिः स शिखरैर् वृतः ॥ पर्यस्तैर् घूर्णमानैश् च प्रचलद्भिश् च सानुभिः । सज्वराणीव शैलस्य वनानि शिखराणि च ॥
units.english: Having its summit covered with trees divested of the notes of the birds and soaked with the showers and shorn of the cries of peacocks, that mountain shone there like the sky. The summit and forest of that high mountain were as if possessed by fever on account of its table-lands shaking and trembling.

units.sanskrit: उत्तमाङ्गगतास् तस्य मेघाः पवनवाहनाः । त्वर्यमाणा महेन्द्रेण तोयं मुमुचुर् अक्षयम् ॥
units.english: Hastened by the king of gods and driven by the wind the clouds began to pour down before it continually their contents.

units.sanskrit: स लम्बमानः कृष्णस्य भुजाग्रे सघनो गिरिः । चक्रारूढ इवाभाति देशो नृपतिपीडितः ॥
units.english: Upheld by Krishna's hand that mountain, covered with clouds, appeared like a country marked with the signs of wheels when oppressed by a king.

units.sanskrit: पुरं पुरस्कृत्य यथा स्फीतो जनपदो महान् ॥
units.english: As a populous village places before it a city so the clouds stood encircling that mountain.

units.sanskrit: निवेश्य तं करे शैलं तुलयित्वा च सस्मितम् । प्रोवाच गोप्ता गोपानां प्रजापतिर् इव स्थितः ॥
units.english: For protecting the Gopas like unto Brahmā the Lord Krishna raised up that mountain and kept it on the tip of his finger. He then smilingly said.

units.sanskrit: एतद् देवैर् असंभाव्यं दिव्येन विधिना मया । कृतं गिरिगृहं गोपा निवातशरणं गवाम् ॥
units.english: By some heavenly means which is even beyond the comprehension of the gods have constructed this mountainous house, an asylum for the cows where no wind blows.

units.sanskrit: वातवर्षभयेनालं तत्त्राणं विहितं हि वः । क्षिप्रं विशन्तु यूथानि गवाम् इह हि शान्तये । निवातेषु च देशेषु निवसन्तु यथासुखम् । पञ्चक्रोशप्रमाणेन क्रौशैकं विस्तरो महान् । त्रैलोक्यम् अप्य् उत्सहते ग्रसितुं किं पुनर् व्रजम् ॥
units.english: Let the flocks of cows speedily enter into it and peacefully and happily live there where no violent wind blows. Do ye, of your own accord, make divisions of the room proportionate to your superiority of position and the number of flocks and put a stop to the downpour of showers. The big house, that have constructed by uprooting this hill extending over five Kos and one Kos in breadth, can even accommodate the three worlds, what to speak of Vraja -.

units.sanskrit: ततः किलकिलाशब्दो गवां हम्भारवाश्रितः । गोपानां तुमुलो जज्ञे मेघनादश् च बाह्यतः ॥ प्रविशन्ति ततो गावो गोपैर् यूथप्रकल्पिताः । कृष्णो ऽपि मूले शैलस्य शैलस्तम्भ इवोच्छ्रितः । दधारैकेन हस्तेन शैलं प्रियम् इवातिथिम् ॥
units.english: There arose a great tumult of the Gopas accompanied by the mutterings of clouds outside and the noise of the cows. And arranged in rows by the milk-men the kine entered into the huge cave of that best of mountains –. And standing at the foot of that mountain like a rising pillar of stone Krishna held that hill with one hand like a beloved guest.

units.sanskrit: ततो व्रजस्य भाण्डानि युक्तानि शकटानि च । विविशुर् वर्षभीतानि तद् गृहं गिरिनिर्मितम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon taking with them their carts and vessels the inhabitants of Vraja, afraid of rain, entered into that rocky house.

units.sanskrit: अतिदैवं तु कृष्णस्य दृष्ट्वा तत् कर्म वज्रभृत् । सप्तरात्रे तु निर्वृत्ते धरण्यां विगतोत्सवे । जगाम संवृतो मेघैर् वृत्रहा स्वर्गम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Beholding this superhuman feat of Krishna and finding his words falsified the powerful Satakratu asked the clouds to desist. And surrounded by clouds which deprived the earth of all festivities for seven nights he returned again to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: निवृत्ते सप्तरात्रे तु तिष्ये स्कन्ने शतक्रतौ । गताभ्रे विमले व्योम्नि दिवसे दीप्तभास्करे ॥
units.english: Thus after seven nights when the king of gods desisted and the sky was freed of clouds and become clear the sun rose in its full effulgence.

units.sanskrit: गावस् तेनैव मार्गेण परिजग्मुर् गतश्रमाः । कृष्णो ऽपि तं गिरिश्रेष्ठं स्वस्थाने स्थावरात्मवान् । प्रीतो निवेशयामास ध्रुवाय वरदो विभुः ॥
units.english: The cows and the milk-men returned to their respective quarters by the same road by which they had entered the cave. For the well-being of all the worlds the Lord Krishna, the giver of boons and identical with all the elements, established, with a delighted heart, that best of mountains.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच धृतं गोवर्धनं दृष्ट्वा परित्रातं च गोकुलम् । कृष्णस्य दर्शनं शक्रो रोचयामास विस्मितः ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Beholding the mount Govardhana thus held up and the kine saved Purandara, the king of the celestials, was filled with great surprise and felt a desire for seeing Krishna.

units.sanskrit: स निर्जलाम्बुदाकारं मत्तं मदजलोक्षितम् । आरुह्यैरावतं नागम् अजगाम महीतलम् ॥
units.english: And seated on his elephant Airavata with temporal juice trickling down and resembling a cloud without water he came down on earth.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णम् अक्लिष्टकर्माणं पुरुहूतः पुरंदरः ॥
units.english: Purandara saw Krishna, of unwearied actions, seated at the foot of the Govardhana hill.

units.sanskrit: तं दृश्य बालं महता तेजसा दीप्तम् अव्ययम् । गोपविषधरं विष्णुं परिजज्ञे पुरंदरः ॥
units.english: He saw there the immortal Vishnu, assuming the guise of a milk-man and shining in his great effulgence and attained to great delight.

units.sanskrit: तालस्तम्भवनश्यामं स तं श्रीवत्सलक्षणम् । पर्याप्तनयनः शक्रः सर्वैर् नेत्रैर् उदैक्षत ॥ दृष्ट्वा चैनं श्रिया जुष्टं मर्त्यलोके ऽमरोपमम् । सूपविष्टं शिलापृष्टे शक्रः स व्रीडितो ऽभवत् ॥ तस्योपविष्टस्य सुखम् पक्षाभ्यां पक्षिपुंगवः । अन्तर्धानगतश् छायाम् चकारोरगभोजनः ॥
units.english: Sakra, having many eyes, saw, with all his eyes, Krishna bearing the mystic mark of Srivatsa and resembling a dark-blue lotus in hue. Beholding him seated happily at the foot of the hill who was gifted with beauty and was like an immortal in the land of mortals Sakra was ashamed. Disappearing from view, that foremost of birds Garuda, feeding on serpents, was protecting him, seated at ease, against the rays of the sun with his wings.

units.sanskrit: उपतस्थे गजं हित्वा कृष्णं बलनिषूदनः ॥
units.english: Leaving behind his elephant, Indra, the slayer of Bala, approached Krishna who was playing in the forest being engaged in human actions.

units.sanskrit: स समीपगतस् तस्य दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः । रराज देवराजो वै वज्रपूर्णकरः प्रभुः ॥
units.english: His face was embellished with a crown effulgent like the sun that gives lustre to lightning, and with a pair of celestial ear-rings.

units.sanskrit: पञ्चस्तबकलम्बेन देवभूषणभूषितः ॥
units.english: His breast was adorned with a neck-lace of five layers of Padmakānta jewel constituting the ornament of the body.

units.sanskrit: नमस् ताभ्यस् तथा विष्णो सर्वाभ्यः सर्वकामद ॥ क्षन्तव्यं मम देवेश कृतं गोपालनन्दन । अथ दिव्येन मधुरम् व्याजहार स्वरेण तम् ॥ कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो ज्ञातीनां नन्दिवर्धन । अतिदैवं कृतं कर्म त्वया प्रीतिमता गवाम् ॥
units.english: Beholding Vāsudeva with his thousand eyes the powerful Vasava, the wielder of thunder-bolt, approached Upendra and looked more beautiful with his celestial garlands and pastes –. Then with his sweet voice, deep as the muttering of clouds that always issues commands to the deities, he said :— Krishna, thou of large arms, thou the enhancer of the delight of thy kinsmen, what, thou hast accomplished on thy being pleased with thy kine, is beyond the power of the gods.

units.sanskrit: मया सृष्टेषु मेघेषु युगान्तावर्तकारिषु । यत् त्वया रक्षिता गावस् तेनास्मि परितोषितः ॥
units.english: have been highly pleased with thy saving the kine from the clouds created by me which bring about the dissolution of the world.

units.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवेन योगेन यच् चायं पर्वतोत्तमः । धृतो वेश्म इवाकाशे को ह्य् एतेन न विस्मयेत् ॥ प्रतिषिद्धे मम महे मयेयं रुषितेन वै । अतिवृष्टिः कृता कृष्ण गवां वै सप्तरात्रिकी ॥
units.english: Whose mind is not filled with surprise on seeing thee hold up this best of mountains by thy own-begotten Yoga power like a house in the sky? Krishna, was enraged on account of the suppression of my sacrifice. And therefore sent down this excessive rain extending over seven nights and destructive of the kine which even the Devas and Dānavas cannot withstand.

units.sanskrit: अहो मे सुप्रियं कृष्ण यत् त्वं मानुषदेहवान् । समग्रं वैष्णवं तेजो विनिगूहसि रोषितः ॥
units.english: But thou hast, by thy own power, put down this terrible shower in my very presence –. am highly pleased, Krishna, for thy, in anger, settling the entire Vaishnava energy in thy human form.

units.sanskrit: साधितं देवतानां हि मन्ये ऽहं कार्यम् अव्ययम् । त्वयि मानुष्यम् आपन्ने युक्तेनैवं स्वतेजसा ॥
units.english: On account of thy being endued with thy own energy although in a human form, the work of the gods appears to have been well accomplished.

units.sanskrit: सेत्स्यते वीर कार्यार्थो न किंचित् परिहास्यते । देवानाम् यद् भवान् नेता सर्वकार्यपुरोगमः ॥
units.english: hero, while thou art at the head of all the works of the gods and their guide, forsooth, every thing will be accomplished and nothing will remain undone.

units.sanskrit: एकस् त्वम् असि लोकानां देवानां च सनातनः । द्वितीयं नानुपश्यामि धुरं यस् ते समुद्वहेत् ॥
