units.english: Thou art alone eternal amongst the gods and in all other worlds. do not see a second capable of carrying the weight thou hast held.

units.sanskrit: यथा हि पुंगवः श्रेष्ठो मग्ने धुरि नियुज्यते । एवं त्वम् असि देवानां मग्नानां द्विजवाहन ॥
units.english: As the best of wheels is placed before a pole so dost thou engage in relieving the distress of the gods sunk in an ocean of misery, thou having a bird for thy carrier.

units.sanskrit: त्वच्छरीरगतं कृष्ण जगत्प्रहरणं त्व् इदम् । स्वयं स्वयंभूर् भगवान् बुद्ध्याथ वयसापि वा । न त्वानुगन्तुं शक्तो वै पङ्गुर् द्रुतगतिं यथा ॥
units.english: Krishna, as gold is among the metals, so this universe, created by the Grand-father Brahmā exists, in thy body. As a cripple cannot follow one who runs fast so even the Lord, Self-sprung Brahma cannot follow thee in intelligence or age.

units.sanskrit: स्ताणुभ्यो हिमवाञ् श्रेष्ठो ह्रदानां वरुणालयः । गरुत्मान् पक्षिणां श्रेष्ठो देवतानां भवान् वरः ॥
units.english: As the Himalaya is amongst the mountains, as the great ocean is amongst the watery expanses, as Garuda is amongst the birds so thou art the foremost of the celestials.

units.sanskrit: नागानाम् उपरिष्टाद् भूः पृथिव्युपरि मानुषाः ॥ मनुष्यलोकाद् ऊर्ध्वं तु खगानां गतिर् उच्यते । आकाशस्योपरि रविर् द्वारं स्वर्गस्य भानुमान् ॥ देवलोकः परस् तस्माद् विमानगहनो महान् । यत्राहं कृष्ण देवानाम् ऐन्द्रे विनिहितः पदे ॥ तत्र सोमगतिश् चैव ज्योतिषां च महात्मनाम् ॥ स हि सर्वगतः कृष्ण महाकाशगतो महान् ॥ उपर्युपरि तत्रापि गतिस् तव तपोमयी । यां न विद्मो वयं सर्वे पृच्छन्तो ऽपि पितामहम् ॥ यां योगनिरता विष्णो भजन्ते ब्रह्मवादिनः । लोकस् त्व् अर्वाग् दुष्कृतिनां नागलोकस् तु दारुणः । खम् अस्थिराणां विषयो वायुना तुल्यवृत्तिनाम् । गतिः शमदमाढ्यानां स्वर्गः सुकृतकर्मणाम् ॥
units.english: Krishna, underneath all is the region of water; above it are afloat the pillars of the earth; above them is the region of man; above it is the etherial region; above it is the effulgent region of the sun constituting the gate of heaven; above it is the great region of the gods forming the abode of the celestials; here occupy the position of the king of gods; above it is the Brahmaloka where the Brahmarshis live and where move about the high-souled Soma moon and other luminous bodies. Above it is the Goloka stationed in the great etherial region. Krishna, Golaka is the foremost of all regions and is protected by the Sādhyas. There dost thou live carrying on Tapas which we cannot learn even when accosting the Grand-Father about it –. This earth is the region of actions for those who engage in them. Underneath it is the dreadful region of the iniquitous. The etherial region is the refuge of moving objects like the air and heaven is the excellent refuge of the pious endued with the qualities of self-control and forbearance.

units.sanskrit: ब्राह्मे तपसि युक्तानां ब्रह्मलोकः परा गतिः । गवाम् एव हि गोलोको दुरारोहा हि सा गतिः ॥
units.english: Those, who worship Brahmā, live in the Brahmaloka. Goloka is attainable only by the kine; even by hard austerities no one else can obtain it.

units.sanskrit: स तु लोकस् त्वया कृष्ण सीदमानः कृतात्मना । धृतो धृतिमता वीर निघ्नतोपद्रवं गवाम् ॥ तद् अहं समनुप्राप्तो गवां वाक्येन चोदितः । ब्रह्मनश् च महाभाग गौरवात् तव चागतः ॥ अहं भूतपतिः कृष्ण देवराजः पुरंदरः । अदितेर् गर्भपर्याये पूर्वजस् ते पुरातनः ॥
units.english: intelligent and heroic Krishna, in order to protect these kine, thou didst hold up the mount Govardhana and suppress the calamities sent down by me. Therefore at the request of the Grand Father and the cows and out of respect for thee have come here. Krishna, am the lord of Bhutas and of the gods and am Purandara. Being born of Aditi am thy elder brother.

units.sanskrit: तेजस् तेजस्विनश् चैव यत् ते दर्शितवान् अहम् । मेघरूपेण तत् सर्वं क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि मे विभो ॥
units.english: Do thou forgive me for displaying my own energy in the shape of clouds which is but the outcome of thy power.

units.sanskrit: एवं क्षान्तमनाः कृष्ण स्वेन सौम्येन तेजसा । ब्रह्मणः शृणु मे वाक्यं गवां च गजविक्रम ॥
units.english: Krishna of the gait of an elephant, be thou delighted now by thy own gentle energy and listen to the words given vent to by Brahmā and the cows.

units.sanskrit: आह त्वा भगवान् ब्रह्मा गावश् चाकाशगा दिवि । कर्मभिस् तोषिता दिव्यैस् तव संरक्षणादिभिः ॥
units.english: Pleased with thy heavenly deeds, hymning of their glories and with the work of protection the Lord Brahmā and the cows of the sky have communicated this unto thee.

units.sanskrit: भवता रक्षिता गावो गोभिर् लोकाश् च रक्षिताः । यद् वयं पुंगवैः सार्धं वर्धामः प्रसवैस् तथा ॥
units.english: Thyself protecting the great Goloka region and all the cows, our race, through the help of the bulls, will multiply itself.

units.sanskrit: कर्षकान् पुंगवैर् वाह्यैर् मेध्येन हविषा सुरान् । श्रियं शकृत्पवित्रेण तर्पयिष्याम कामगाः ॥
units.english: We all, coursing at our will, shall propitiate the cultivators with bulls, their beasts of burden, the celestials with the oblation of Havi and Sri with the profusely increasing corns.

units.sanskrit: तद् अस्माकं गुरुस् त्वं हि प्राणदश् च महाबल । अद्यप्रभृति नो राजा त्वम् इन्द्रो वै भविष्यसि ॥ तस्मात् त्वं काञ्चनैः पूर्णैर् दिव्यस्य पयसो घटैः । एभिस् त्वम् अभिषिच्यस्व मया हस्तावनामितैः ॥ अहं किलेन्द्रो देवानां त्वं गवाम् इन्द्रतां गतः । गोविन्द इति लोकास् त्वां स्तोष्यन्ति भुवि शाश्वतम् ॥
units.english: lord, thou of great strength, thou art our preceptor and saviour. Becoming our king and lord do thou sprinkle thy self to-day with this golden jar full of heavenly water brought by me with my own hands –. am the king of the celestials and thou hast, although eternal, become now the king of the cows. Therefore the people of this world will hymn thee as Govinda.

units.sanskrit: ममोपरि यथेन्द्रस् त्वम् स्थापितो गोभिर् ईश्वरः । उपेन्द्र इति कृष्ण त्वाम् गास्यन्ति दिवि देवताः ॥
units.english: As the dignity of Indra has been bestowed on me so thou art the king of cows. Krishna, the gods will celebrate thy name as Upendra.

units.sanskrit: ये चेमे वार्षिका मासाश् चत्वारो विहिता मम । वर्षार्धे च ध्वजो नित्यं ततः पूजाम् अवाप्स्यति । ममाम्बुप्रभवं दर्पं तदा त्यक्ष्यन्ति बर्हिनः ॥ अल्पवीर्यमदाश् चैव ये चान्ये मेघनादिनः । शान्तिं सर्वे गमिष्यन्ति जलकालविचारिणः ॥
units.english: Of the four months of my rainy season, confer the latter half constituting the autumn on thee. From to-day people will recognize the first two months as mine. After the termination of the rains they will take down my flag and thou shalt receive adoration. Shorn of excitement and emitting notes occasionally the peacocks will give up their pride begotten by my clouds. And all other creatures, ranging in my season and emitting notes at the view of clouds, will be silent –.

units.sanskrit: त्रिशङ्क्वगस्त्यचरिताम् आशां च विचरिष्यति । सहस्ररश्मिर् आदित्यस् तापयन् स्वेन तेजसा ॥
units.english: Agastya, the regent of the star Canopus, will range like a bird in the southern quarter and the sun, of thousand rays, will distress all with his own effulgence.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रवर्त्स्यते पुण्या शरत्सुप्तोत्थिते त्वयि । महेन्द्रश् चाप्य् उपेन्द्रश् च महीयेतां महीतले ॥ ये चावयोः स्थिता वृत्ते महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रसंज्ञिते । मानवाः प्रणमिष्यन्ति तेषां नास्त्य् अनयागमः ॥
units.english: And thus the sacred autumn will set in. Thou shalt then get up from thy bed. Men in this world and the immortals in the celestial region will worship me as Mahendra and thee as Upendra in the flag-staffs on the earth -. The man, who reciting the great and eternal theme of our conduct as Mahendra and Upendra, will bow unto us, will not be visited by any misery.

units.sanskrit: ततः शक्रस् तु तान् गृह्य घटान् दिव्यपयोधरान् । अभिषेकेण गोविन्दं योजयामास योगवित् ॥
units.english: Thereupon taking those jars full of heavenly water the king of gods, conversant with Yoga, sprinkled Govinda.

units.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तम् अभिषिच्यन्तं गावस् ताः सह यूथपैः । स्तनैः प्रस्नवसंयुक्तैः सिषिचुः कृष्णम् अव्ययम् ॥
units.english: Beholding the eternal Krishna thus annointed, the cows, stationed in the celestial region, along with the bulls, sprinkled him also with a downpour of their milk through clouds.

units.sanskrit: मेघाश् च दिवि मुक्ताभिः सामृताभिः समन्ततः । सिषिचुस् तोयधाराभिर् अभिषिच्यन्तम् अव्ययम् ॥
units.english: The clear clouds in the sky sprinkled him with nectarine showers. From trees fell down moon-like drops of water.

units.sanskrit: ववर्षुः पुष्पवर्षं च नेदुस् तूर्याणि चाम्बरे ॥
units.english: And from the sky the gods set up a leonine sound, made a downpour of flowers and blew the bugles –.

units.sanskrit: एते च मुनयः सर्वे सिद्धाश् च परमर्षयः । एकार्णवविमुक्तं च दधार वसुधा वपुः ॥
units.english: The Maharshis, who always follow mantras, chanted his glories with becoming verses and the body of the earth was separated from one all-extending ocean.

units.sanskrit: प्रसादं सागरा जग्मुर् ववुर् वाता जगद्धिताः । ईतयः प्रशमं जग्मुर् जग्मुर् निर्वैरतां नृपाः ॥
units.english: The seas grew delightful and the winds began to blow for bringing about the well-being of the world. And the sun and the moon accompanied by stars stood in their respective roads.

units.sanskrit: निर्वैराण्यभवंस् तात क्रूराण्य् अपि निसर्गतः । प्रवालपुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश् च पादपाः ॥
units.english: The kings were freed of their enemies and the calamity of excessive rain was pacified. And the trees were embellished with leaves and flowers of various colours.

units.sanskrit: मदं प्रसुस्रुवुर् नागा यातास् तोषं वने मृगाः । अलंकृता गात्ररुहैर् वातुभिर् भान्ति पर्वताः ॥
units.english: The deer grew delighted in the forest and the elephants began to yield temporal juice and the mountains shone with trees grown on them and with metals –.

units.sanskrit: देवलोकोपमो लोकस् तृप्तो ऽमृतसुतर्पितः । आसीत् कृष्णाभिषेके हि दिव्यस्वर्गरसोक्षितः ॥ अभिषिक्तं तु तं गोभिः शक्रो गोविन्दम् अव्ययम् । दिव्यशुक्लाम्बरधरम् देवराजो ऽब्रवीद् इदम् ॥
units.english: And the land of mortals was satisfied with ambrosia-like juice like unto the celestial region. Thus when the ceremony of the royal unction, of the Lord Krishna, accompanied by the nectarine showers coming down from the celestial region, was over the king of gods Purandara said to the eternal Govinda, wearing celestial garlands and installed in the sovereignty of the cows –.

units.sanskrit: एष मे प्रथमः कृष्ण नियोगो गोषु यः कृतः । श्रूयतामपरं चापि ममागमनकारणम् ॥
units.english: Krishna, the first work, of installing thee as the king of cows, is now over. Listen now to the next object of my coming here.

units.sanskrit: क्षिप्रं संसाध्यतां कंसः केशी च तुरगाधमः । अरिष्टश् च मदाविष्टो राजराज्यं ततः कुरु ॥
units.english: Slaying speedily Kansa, the wretch of a horse Keshi, and Aristha, always committing mischief do thou engage in governing thy own kingdom.

units.sanskrit: पितृष्वसरि जातस् ते ममांशो ऽहम् इव स्थितः । स ते रक्ष्यश् च मान्यश् च सख्ये च विनियुज्यताम् ॥
units.english: From thy father's sister, a portion of my energy is born as a son by name Arjuna. Contracting friendship with him do thou always protect him.

units.sanskrit: त्वद्वशे वर्तमानः स प्राप्स्यते विपुलं यशः ॥
units.english: Thou shalt favour him and he, too, acting on thy advice and following thee, will acquire great fame.

units.sanskrit: भारतस्य च वंशस्य स वरिष्ठो धनुर्धरः । भविष्यत्य् अनुरूपश् च त्वाम् ऋते न च रंस्यते ॥ भारतं त्वयि चासक्तं तस्मिंश् च पुरुषोत्तमे । उभाभ्याम् अपि संयोगे यास्यन्ति निधनं नृपाः ॥
units.english: He will be the foremost of bowmen among the descendants of Bharata and will take after thee. And without thy help he alone will never be pleased with his work. This future war of Bharata depends on him and thee the foremost of men. When you both will be united all the kings will be slain.

units.sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञातं च मे कृष्ण ऋषिमध्ये सुरेषु च । मम पुत्रो ऽर्जुनो नाम जातः कुन्त्यां कुरूद्वहः ॥
units.english: Krishna, have spoken to the gods and Rishis, that the son, begotten by me on Kunti, will be an adept in the use of weapons, the foremost of archers and the greatest of the Kurus.

units.sanskrit: तं प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति वै सर्वे राजानः शस्त्रयोधिनः ॥
units.english: All the warrior-kings will speak of his learning -.

units.sanskrit: अक्षौहिण्यश् च शूराणां राज्ञां संग्रामशालिनाम् । समरे राजधर्मेण योजयिष्यन्ति मृत्युना ॥
units.english: Ever abiding by the duties of a Kshatrya he alone will be able to kill one Akshouhini of kings skilled in fighting.

units.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्रचरितं मार्गं धनुषो लाघवेन च । नानुयास्यन्ति राजानो देवा वा त्वां विना प्रभो ॥
units.english: Save thee there is none among the kings or gods who will be able to weaken the power of his bow or follow the path of his weapons, lord.

units.sanskrit: स ते बन्धुः सहायश् च संग्रामेषु भविष्यति । तस्य योगो विधातव्यस् त्वया गोविन्द मत्कृते ॥
units.english: Govinda, he will be thy friend and help in battle. Therefore at my request, do thou instruct him in spiritual knowledge.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञाता त्वम् एव लोकानाम् अर्जुनस्य च नित्यशः ॥
units.english: Thou dost know well Arjuna and all the worlds.

units.sanskrit: त्वया हि नित्यं रक्ष्यः स आहवेषु महत्सु च । रक्षितस्य त्वया तस्य न मृत्युः प्रभविष्यति ॥
units.english: So thou shouldst always regard and take care of him as thou dost me. If thou dost protect him in the great battle Death will not be able to extend its influence over him.

units.sanskrit: अर्जुनं विद्धि मां कृष्ण मां चैवात्मानम् आत्मना । आत्मा ते ऽहं यथा शश्वत् तथैव तव सो ऽर्जुन ॥
units.english: Krishna, know Arjuna as me and me as identical with thy own self. As am at one with thee, so is Arjuna.

units.sanskrit: त्वया लोकान् इमाञ् जित्वा बलेर् हस्तात् त्रिभिः क्रमैः । देवतानां कृतो राजा पुरा ज्येष्ठक्रमाद् अहम् ॥
units.english: am thy elder brother and therefore thou didst, in the days of yore, acquiring the three worlds from Bali with thy three footsteps, install me in the sovereignty over the gods.

units.sanskrit: त्वां च सत्यमयं ज्ञात्वा सत्येष्टं सत्यविक्रमम् । सत्येनोपेत्य देवा वै योजयन्ति रिपुक्षये ॥
units.english: know thee as fond of truth, as having truth for thy prowess and as identical with truth. And because thou art bound to the gods by a promise they have engaged thee in this work of the destruction of their enemies.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽर्जुनो नाम मे पुत्रः पितुस् ते भगिनीसुतः । इह सौहृदतां यातु भूत्वा सहचरः पुरा ॥
units.english: Krishna, Arjuna, the son of thy father's sister, is my son. As he did become thy companion in the days of yore and so now he will contract friendship with thee.

units.sanskrit: तस्य ते युध्यतः कृष्ण स्वस्थाने ऽथ गृहे ऽपि वा । वोढव्या पुंगवेनेव धूः सर्वा रणवाहिनी ॥
units.english: Mādhava, as a bull carries a burden, so thou shalt always take care of him when either living in his house, your house or while fighting with the enemies in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: कंसे विनिहते कृष्ण त्वया भाव्यर्थदर्शिना । अभितस् तन् महद्युद्धं भविष्यति महीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: When Kansa will be slain by thee, ever observant of the real purpose of things there will take place a great war of the kings.

units.sanskrit: तत्र तेषां नृवीराणाम् अतिमानुषकर्मणाम् । विजयस्यार्जुनो भोक्ता यशसा त्वं तु योक्ष्यसे ॥
units.english: Arjuna will vanquish those heroic men of superhuman deeds and thou shalt adorn him with glory.

units.sanskrit: यद्य् अहं ते सुराश् चैव सत्यं च प्रियम् अच्युत ॥
units.english: Keshava, if truth, myself and the celestials are thy favourites thou shouldst carry out whatever have said.

units.sanskrit: शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णो गोविन्दतां गतः । प्रीतो ऽस्मि दर्शनाद् एव तव शक्र शचीपते । यत् त्वयाभिहितं चेदं न किंचित् परिहास्यते ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Sakra, Krishna, who had become a cow-keeper, with a delighted mind replied. lord of Sachi, am happy to see you. Nothing, of whatever you have said, will be left off.

units.sanskrit: जानामि भवतो भावं जानाम्य् अर्जुनसंभवम् । जाने पितृष्वसा दत्ता पाण्डोर् वसुमतीपतेः ॥ युधिष्ठिरं च जानामि कुमारं धर्मनिर्मितम् । भीमसेनं च जानामि वायोः संतानजां तनुम् ॥
units.english: Sakra, know your heart. It is not unknown to me that my father's sister has been given away to the high-souled Pandu and that she has given birth to Arjuna. know also the prince Yudhisthira begotten by Dharma. know Bhimasena, the multiplier of Vāyu's wind-god's race.

units.sanskrit: नकुलं सहदेवं च माद्र्याः कुक्षिभवाव् उभौ ॥
units.english: know also Nakula and Sahadeva begotten on Mādri by the two Aswinis -.

units.sanskrit: कानीनं चापि जानामि सवितुः प्रथमं सुतम् । पितृष्वसरि कर्णं वै प्रसूतं सूततां गतम् ॥
units.english: know also Karna, now known as a charioteer's son, begotten on my father's sister in her maidenhood by the Sun.

units.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्राश् च मे सर्वे विदिता युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । दुर्योधनमुखाः शक्र कौरवाणां महाबलाः । पाण्डोर् उपरमं चैव शापाशनिनिपातजम् ॥
units.english: That Pandu is dead on account of the thunder-like imprecation and that the sons of Dhiitarashtra are desirous of fighting are all known to me, king of gods, returning now to the city of the celestials increase their delight.

units.sanskrit: नार्जुनस्य रिपुः कश्चिन् ममाग्रे प्रभविष्यति ॥
units.english: No enemy will be able to trouble Arjuna when he will be before me.

units.sanskrit: अर्जुनार्थे च तान् सर्वान् पाण्डवान् अक्षतान् युधि । कुन्त्या निर्यातयिष्यामि निवृत्ते भारते मृधे ॥ भृत्यवत् तत् करिष्यामि तव स्नेहेन यन्त्रितः ॥ सत्यसंधस्य तच् छ्रुत्वा प्रियं प्रीतस्य भाषितम् । वैशंपायन उवाच गते शक्रे ततः कृष्णः पूज्यमानो व्रजौकसैः । गोवर्धनधरः श्रीमान् विवेश व्रजम् एव ह ॥ तं स्म वृद्धाभिनन्दन्ति ज्ञातयश् च सहोषिताः । धन्याः स्मो ऽनुगृहीताः स्मस् त्वद्धृतेन नगेन ह ॥ गावो वर्षभयात् तीर्णा वयं तीर्णा महाभयात् । तव प्रसादाद् गोविन्द देवतुल्य महाद्युते ॥
units.english: When the great war of Bhārata will come to its close, shall, on account of Arjuna, consign unscathed unto Kunti all the sons of Pandu. king of gods, am bound by affection and therefore shall accomplish like a servant what your son Arjuna will command me. Hearing these words of truthful Krishna, the king of gods returned to the city of the celestials. Vaishampayana said:—Thereupon after the departure of Sakra, the beautiful Krishna the holder of Gavardhana, entered Vraja honored by the inhabitants, thereof. The elderly Gopas and his kinsmen and comrades, assembled together, welcomed him and said. Govinda, we have been honored and favoured by thy conduct and as well as that of the best of mountains. Indeed thy prowess is like that of the celestials. By thy favour the kine have tided over the fear of excessive rain and we too have been relieved of the great fear.

units.sanskrit: धारणेनास्य शैलस्य विद्मस् त्वां कृष्णम् अव्ययम् ॥
units.english: Krishna, lord of kine, beholding thy superhuman feat of raising up the mountain we consider thee as a divinity.

units.sanskrit: कस् त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां वा महाबल । वसूनां वा किमर्थं च वसुदेवः पिता तव ॥ वने च बालक्रीडा ते जन्म चास्मासु गर्हितम् । लोकपालोपमश् चैव गास् त्वं किं परिरक्षसि ॥
units.english: thou of great strength, art thou Rudra, Marut, or one of the Vasus? Why hast thou taken thy birth as the son of Vasudeva ? Beholding this thy low birth amongst us, this thy prowess, sport and feat in thy boyhood our minds are filled with fear. We see, thou art like one of the Lokapālas.

units.sanskrit: देवो वा दानवो वा त्वम् यक्षो गन्धर्व एव वा । अस्माकं बान्धवो जातो यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते ॥
units.english: But why art thou, in thy wretched guise of a milk-man, engaged in sport with us and in protecting kine ? Art thou a Deva, a Dānava or a Gandharva now born as our friend? Whatever thou mayst be we bow unto thee.

units.sanskrit: केनचिद् यदि कार्येण वससि इह यदृच्छया । वयं तव अनुगाः सर्वे भवन्तं शरणं गताः ॥
units.english: If thou art present here, of thy own accord, for any work of thine, do thou consider us as thy dependants and votaries.

units.sanskrit: गोपानां वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णः पद्मनिभेक्षणः । प्रत्युवाच स्मितं कृत्वा ज्ञातीन् सर्वान् समागतान् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing the words of Gopas, the lotus-eyed Krishna, smiling a little, said to his assembled kinsmen:— Ye of dreadful prowess, let not the conviction, that you have all formed about me, take root in your hearts.

units.sanskrit: तथाहं नावगन्तव्यः स्वजातीयो ऽस्मि बान्धवः ॥
units.english: am one of your clan and a friend.

units.sanskrit: यदि त्व् अवश्यं श्रोतव्यः कालः संप्रतिपाल्यताम् । ततो भवन्तः श्रोष्यन्ति मां च द्रक्ष्यन्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
units.english: If however you are all bent upon hearing then wait you will soon listen to an account of my origin and see my true form.

units.sanskrit: यद्य् अहं भवतां श्लाघ्यो बान्धवो देवसप्रभः । परिज्ञानेन किं कार्यम् यद्य् एषो ऽनुग्रहो मम ॥
units.english: am one of your respected friends like unto a god. If you have any affection for me, do not wish to learn any thing more about me.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तास् तु ते गोपा वसुदेवसुतेन वै । बद्धमौना दिशः सर्वे भेजिरे पिहिताननाः ॥
units.english: Thus accosted by Vasudeva's son and covering their own faces and resorting to silence the milk-men went away in in various directions.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णस् तु यौवनं दृष्ट्वा निशि चन्द्रमसो नवम् । स करीषाङ्गरागासु व्रजरथ्यासु वीर्यवान् । वृषाणां जातरागाणां युद्धानि समयोजयत् ॥ वने स वीरो गाश् चैव जग्राह ग्राहवद् विभुः ॥ तास् तस्य वदनं कान्तं कान्ता गोपस्त्रियो निशि । पिबन्ति नयनाक्षेपैर् गां गतं शशिनं यथा ॥ हरितालार्द्रपीतेन कौशेयेन च भास्वता । भद्रवस्त्रेण वसितः कृष्णः कान्ततरो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding the charming autumnal night and the beautiful moon the powerful Krishna felt a desire of sporting. Sometimes he made the haughty bulls fight with one another in the roads of Vraja adorned with cow-dung pastes. He again set the powerful cow-herds against one another. He sometimes got hold of the kine in the forest like a crocodile. Sometimes thinking of his boyhood and bringing the youthful women of Gopas under his control at night he used to enjoy there. With their glances those Gopa women used to drink as if the ambrosia of his beautiful face who was like the moon come down on earth. Krishna was by nature beautiful but clad in a silken raiment of shining yellow colour he appeared more beautiful.

units.sanskrit: स बद्धाङ्गदनिर्यूहश् चित्रया वनमालया । शोभमानो हि गोविन्दः शोभयाम् आस तं व्रजम् ॥ नमो दामोदरायेति गोपकन्यास् तदाब्रुवन् । तास् तं पयोधरोत्तानैर् उरोभिः समपीडयन् । भ्रामिताक्षैश् च वदनैर् निरीक्षन्ते वराङ्गनाः ॥
units.english: Having his arms adorned with Angadas and bedecked with garlands of wild flowers Govinda beautified the entire Vraja. Filled with surprise at witnessing the wonderful conduct of that powerful being the beautiful Gopa women used to call him by the name of Dāmodara. And casting again and again their glances accompanied by various gestures they began to assail him with their rising breasts.

units.sanskrit: ता वार्यमानाः पितृभिर् भ्रातृभिर् मातृभिस् तथा । कृष्णं गोपाङ्गना रात्रौ मृगयन्ति रतिप्रियाः ॥
units.english: After a few days had passed away in this way the parents of those milk-women prevented them from doing so. Those damsels however, fond of amusements, used to hunt Krishna at night.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णलीलानुकारिण्यः कृष्णप्रणिहितेक्षणाः । कृष्णस्य गतिगामिन्यस् तरुण्यस् ता वराङ्गनाः ॥
units.english: Sometimes arranging themselves in rows and sometimes in circles they, singing hymns relating to Krishna's glories, used to satisfy him. And all of them appeared in pairs with Krishna.

units.sanskrit: वनेषु तालहस्ताग्रैः कुट्टयन्त्यस् तथापराः । चेरुर् वै चरितं तस्य कृष्णस्य व्रजयोषितः ॥
units.english: Casting loving glances at Krishna and following his course those youthful damsels of Vraja imitated all his sports.

units.sanskrit: तास् तस्य नृत्यं गीतं च विलासस्मितवीक्षितम् । मुदिताश् चानुकुर्वन्त्यः क्रीडन्ति व्रजयोषितः ॥
units.english: Sometimes striking their palms in the forest they used to imitate him and sometimes they used to take delight in imitating his songs and dances accompanied by lovely smiles and looks -.

units.sanskrit: व्रजं गताः सुखं चेरुर् दामोदरपरायणाः ॥
units.english: Singing sweet songs describing the profuse love for Krishna these beautiful women, devoted to Dāmodara, used to range at Pleasure in Vraja.

units.sanskrit: करीषपांसुदिग्धाङ्ग्यस् ताः कृष्णम् अनुवव्रिरे । रमयन्त्यो यथा नागं सप्रमोदाः करेणवः ॥
units.english: As she-elephants, covered with dust, enjoy with an infuriated elephant so those milk-women, their limbs covered all over with dust and cow-dung, used to sport with Krishna encircling him on all sides.

units.sanskrit:
मुखम् अस्यापरा वीक्ष्य तृषिता गोपकन्यकाः । रत्यन्तरगता रात्रौ पिबन्ति रतिलालसाः ॥ अलंकृताः सुमधुरं गायन्त्यो मधुविह्वलाः ॥ एवं स कृष्णो गोपीनां चक्रवालैर् अलंकृतः । शारदीषु सचन्द्रासु निशासु मुमुदे सुखी ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच प्रदोषार्धे कदाचित् तु कृष्णे रतिपरायणे । त्रासयन् समदो गोष्ठान् अरिष्टः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥ निर्वाणाङ्गारमेघाभस् तीक्ष्णशृङ्गोऽर्कलोचनः । क्षुरतीक्ष्णाग्रचरणः कालः काल इवापरः ॥ लेलिहानः सनिष्पेषं जिह्वयौष्ठौ पुनः पुनः ।
गर्विताविद्धलाङ्गूलः कठिनस्कन्धबन्धनः ॥ ककुदोदग्रनिर्माणः प्रमाणाद् दुरतिक्रमः । शकृन्मूत्रोपलिप्ताङ्गो गवाम् उद्वेजनो भृशम् ॥ महाकटिः स्थूलमुखो दृढजानुर् महोदरः ।
गवारोहेषु चपलस् तरुघातङ्किताननः । युद्धसञ्जविषाणाग्रो द्विषद्वृषभसूदनः ॥
दैत्यो वृषभरूपेण गोष्ठान् विपरिधावति ॥
पातयानो गवां गर्भान् दृप्तो गच्छत्य् अनार्तवम् । भजमानश् च चपलो गृष्टीः संप्रचचार ह ॥
एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु गवाः कृष्णसमीपगाः । त्रासयामास दुष्टात्मा वैवस्वत पथे स्थितः ॥ सेन्द्राशनिर् इवाम्भोदो नर्दमानो महावृषः ।
चकार निर्वृषं गोष्ठं निर्वत्सशिशुपुंगवम् ॥
तम् आराद् अभिधावन्तं नर्दमानं महावृषम् । तालशब्देन तं कृष्णः सिंहनादैश् च मोहयन् । अभ्यधावत गोविन्दो दैत्यं वृषभरूपिणम् ॥
स कृष्णं गोवृषो दृष्ट्वा हृष्टलाङ्गूललोचनः । रुषितस् तलशब्देन युद्धाकाङ्क्षी ननर्द ह ॥
तम् आपतन्तम् उद्वृत्तम् दृष्ट्वा वृषभदानवम् । तस्मात् स्थानान् न व्यचलत् कृष्णो गिरिर् इवाचलः ॥
units.english: Drinking repeatedly his ambrosia-like beauty with their eyes accompanied by side-long and smiling looks the Gopa-women, having antelope eyes, could not attain to the consummation of delight. When Damodara used to exclaim ! Alas! the damsels anxiously and delightedly used to listen to the words given vent to by him. Thus encircled by the milk-women Krishna used to sport, of his own accord, in the autumnal night adorned by the moon. Vaishampayana said:—One day in the first part of the night while Krishna was sporting, the dark-hued Dānava, Aristha by name, assuming the form of an infuriated bull and resembling Death himself, was seen there terrifying all the inmates of the cow-sheds. His body was like extinguished ember and cloud, his horns were sharpened, his eyes were effulgent like the sun, his feet were endued with sharpened hoops and his hump was extremely hard. He was repeatedly licking his lips with his tongue and moving his tail with pride. And for breaking down many palaces with his hump it became exceedingly hardened. Incapable of being repulsed on account of his own huge body, with his body covered with excreta and urine, that Dānava, of huge waist, fleshy mouth, hard knees and long abdomen, terrified all the cows with his skin hanging from his neck and horns -. That Daitya Aristha, of huge body, the slayer of inimical bulls and the injurer of the cows, assuming the form of a bull, was running about in the cow-sheds and pasture grounds. His face was marked with strokes against the trees and his horns were adorned as if for a fight -. He used to approach the kine, when big with their young ones and cause abortion and used to know them immediately after their delivery. Without fighting with the bulls and cows that irrepressible, and dreadful Daitya, always intent on striking them with his horns, could not derive pleasure in pasture grounds. Accidentally on that day, the proud bull, under the influence of Vaivaswān the regent of the departed, came before Keshava. Divesting the cow-sheds of bulls, calves and young bulls that one, elated with proud, used to assail the kine. At that time, that one of wicked soul, under influence of Vaivaswān, terrified the cows that were near Krishna roaring like a cloud accompanied by Indra's thunderbolt. Thereat striking his palms and setting up a leonine shout Govinda ran after him, increasing the anger of the demon in the shape of a bull. Beholding Krishna and enraged with the sound of the strokes of his palms against his arms, moving his tail and expanding his eyes in delight that bull issued out a shout expressing his desire for fight. Beholding that wicked demon of the form of a bull approach Krishna did not move out from where he stood and rather remain there firm like a mountain -.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णस्य निधनाकाङ्क्षी तूर्णम् अभ्युत्पपात ह ॥
units.english: With a view to slay Krishna, that bull too, raising up his face and aiming at his belly, came there quickly.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णः कृष्णाञ्जननिभं वृषं प्रति वृषोपमः ॥ स संसक्तस् तु कृष्णेन वृषेणेव महावृषः । ताव् अन्योन्याव् अरुद्धाङ्गौ युद्धे कृष्णवृषाव् उभौ । तस्य दर्पबलं हत्वा कृत्वा शृङ्गान्तरे पदम् । अपीडयद् अरिष्टस्य कण्ठं क्लिन्नम् इवाम्बरम् ॥
units.english: Vasudeva, resembling a bull, confronted that irrepressible and collyruim-like bull before him. As a bull faces a huge bull so Arishtha met Krishna and from his nostril came out foams with a sound. Thereupon Krishna and the bull confronting each other they appeared like two clouds, touching each other in the rains. Placing his feet on the space between the horns Krishna humiliated his pride and struck him at the neck resembling the sky.

units.sanskrit: शृङ्गं चास्य पुनः सव्यम् उत्पाट्य यमदण्डवत् । तेनैव प्राहरद् वक्त्रे स ममार भृशं हतः ॥
units.english: Then uprooting his left horn resembling the rod of Yama he struck him on the face with it; thereat that foremost of bulls breathed his last.

units.sanskrit: पपात रुधिरोद्गारी साम्बुधार इवाम्बुदः ॥
units.english: With his horns, head and shoulders shattered that demon fell down vomiting blood like a cloud sending down showers.

units.sanskrit: गोविन्देन हतं दृष्ट्वा दृप्तं वृषभदानवम् । साधु साध्व् इति भूतानि तत्कर्मास्याभितुष्टुवुः ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding the proud Dānava in the shape of a bull slain by Govinda all the people began to eulogise him exclaiming Well done! Well done!.

units.sanskrit: स चोपेन्द्रो वृषं हत्वा कान्तवक्त्रो निशामुखे । अरविन्दाभनयनः पुनर् एव रराज ह ॥
units.english: Slaying that bull demon in that moon light the lotus-eyed Upendra again engaged in sport.

units.sanskrit: ते ऽपि गोवृत्तयः सर्वे कृष्णं कमललोचनम् । उपासांचक्रिरे हृष्टाः स्वर्गे शक्रम् इवामराः ॥
units.english: Like the immortals adoring their king in the celestial region the Gopas began to worship delightedly the lotus-eyed Krishna.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच कृष्णं व्रजगतं श्रुत्वा वर्धमानम् इवानलम् । पूतनायां हतायां च कालिये च पराजिते । धेनुके प्रलयं नीते प्रलम्बे च निपातिते ॥ धृते गोवर्धने चैव विफले शक्रशासने । गोषु त्रातासु च तथा स्पृहणीयेन कर्मणा ॥ ककुद्मिनि हते ऽरिष्टे गोपेषु मुदितेषु च । अचिन्त्यं कर्म तच् छ्रुत्वा वर्धमानेषु शत्रुषु ॥ प्राप्तारिष्टम् इवात्मानं मेने स मथुरेश्वरः । विसंज्ञेन्द्रियभूतात्मा गतासुप्रतिमो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing that Krishna was advancing in power like fire in Vraja, Kansa, anticipating fear from him, was filled with anxiety. On Putana being slain, the two trees being dragged by the boy of no boy-like deeds, Kalya being vanquished, Dhenuka being killed, Pralamva being discomfitted, the mount Govardhana being raised up, Indra's commandment being disregarded, the kine being protected by enviable deeds and Kakudmi and Arishtha being destroyed the Gopas were filled with delight. Beholding these highly terrible portends indicating his impending death and these unthought of feats amongst his rising enemies Mathura's king Kansa considered himself as brought under the influence of death. And his organs and mind being deprived of consciousness he appeared like one dead -.

units.sanskrit: एतान् स यादवान् सर्वान् आभाष्य शृणुतेति च । उग्रसेनसुतो राजा प्रोवाच मथुरेश्वरः ॥ अदम्भवृत्तयः सर्वे गुरुकर्मसु चोद्यताः । राजमन्त्रधराः सर्वे सर्वे धनुषि पारगाः ॥ यशःप्रदीपा लोकानां वेदार्थानां विवक्षवः । आश्रमाणां निसर्गज्ञा वर्णानां क्रमपारगाः ॥ प्रवक्तारः सुनियता नेतारो नयदर्शिनः । भेत्तारः परराष्ट्राणां त्रातारः शरणार्थिनाम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon in the noiseless dead of night, Mathura's king Kansa, the son of Ugrasena of fierce commands, summoned his father and kinsmen to his city. Ye are all shorn of haughtiness and you have all lived properly in the families of your preceptors, ye are all therefore proficient in archery and capable of holding royal counsels. Besides ye are all like lamps of glory in all these worlds, conversant with the real purport of the Vedas, the true import of the Ashramas conditions of life, with the order of Varnas castes, the propounder of the beautiful rules of conduct, the leaders of the givers of laws, the conquerors of foreign kingdoms, and the protectors of those seeking refuge with you –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् अक्षतचारित्रैः श्रीमद्भिर् उदितोदितैः । द्यौर् अपि अनुगृहीता स्याद् भवद्भिः किं पुनर् मही ॥
units.english: You are all so very vivacious in your conversation and endued with such an unimpeachable character, what to speak of the earth even the celestial region may feel itself honored by your presence.

units.sanskrit: ऋषीणाम् इव वो वृत्तं प्रभावो मरुताम् इव । रुद्राणाम् इव वः क्रोधो दीप्तिर् अङ्गिरसाम् इव ॥
units.english: Your conduct resembles that of the Rishis, your power is like that of the Maruts, your anger is like that of Rudras and your effulgence is like that of the fire.

units.sanskrit: धृतं यदुकुलं वीरैर् भूतलं पर्वतैर् इव ॥ एवं भवत्सु युक्तेषु मम चित्तानुवर्तिषु । वर्धमानो ममानर्थो भवद्भिः किम् उपेक्षितः ॥ एष कृष्ण इति ख्यातो नन्दगोपसुतो व्रजे । अनमात्यस्य शून्यस्य चारान्धस्य ममैव तु । कारणान् नन्दगोपस्य स सुतो गोपितो गृहे ॥
units.english: As the earth is supported by the mountains so the decaying race of Yadus is upheld by you all, heroes of far-famed glory You all follow my will, why then are you at present disregarding the rising calamity of mine, ? Like unto a rising a cloud, Nanda Gopa's son, the celebrated Krishna of Vraja is about to strike at the root of the race. have lost my heart and four eyes and have no able ministers. And therefore that boy was kept secretly in Nanda Gopa's house.

units.sanskrit: उपेक्षित इव व्याधिः पूर्यमाण इवाम्बुदः । नदन्मेघ इवोष्णान्ते स दुरात्मा विवर्धते ॥
units.english: Like a malady disregarded, the swelling ocean and the roaring clouds of the rainy season that wicked-minded one is rising in power.

units.sanskrit: तस्य नाहं गतिं जाने न योगं न परायणम् । नन्दगोपस्य भवने जातस्याद्भुतकर्मणः ॥
units.english: have not been able to find out the means of subduing or to understand the movements of that boy of wonderful deeds born in Nanda Gopa's house.

units.sanskrit: किं तद्भूतं समुत्पन्नं देवापत्यं न विद्महे । अतिदेवैर् अमानुष्यैः कर्मभिः सो ऽनुमीयते ॥
units.english: That boy is either the offspring of a god or born of any other powerful being. however do not know any thing—but surmise so by his superhuman deeds which even the celestials can not perform.

units.sanskrit: स्तनपानेप्सुना पीता प्राणैः सह दुरासदा ॥ तथैव तेन बालेन पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया । समूलविटपौ भग्नौ सहजौ यमलार्जुनौ । यमुनायां ह्रदे नागः कालियो दमितस् तथा । नन्दगोपसुतो योगं कृत्वा च पुनर् उत्थितः ॥
units.english: While asleep in his infancy he drank up the life of Putanā going there in the form of a bird under the pretext of sucking her breast. Vanquished in no time in the lake of Yamuna, that Nāga Kalya, ranging in the region underneath, has disappeared. But Nanda's son, by his Yoga power, has risen up again.

units.sanskrit: धेनुकस् तालशिखरात् पातितो जीवितं विना । तस्याग्रजो महावीर्यो बलभद्रो दुरात्मवान् । प्रलम्बं यं मृधे देवा न शेकुर् अभिवीक्षितुम् । वासवस्योत्सवं भङ्क्त्वा वर्षं वासवरोषजम् । निर्जलं गोकुलं कृत्वा धृतो गोवर्धनो गिरिः ॥
units.english: Dropped down from the top of a palm tree Dhenuka has breathed his last. Pralamva too, whom even the gods could not surpass in battle, has been slain like an ordinary animal, by that powerful one with the strokes of his fist. Suppressing the festivity in honor of Indra, and putting a stop to excessive rain consequent upon his anger that boy held up the mount Govardhana for affording shelter to the kine.

units.sanskrit: हतस् त्व् अरिष्टो बलवान् विशृङ्गश् च कृतो व्रजे । अबालो बाल्यम् आस्थाय रमते बाललीलया ॥ प्रबन्धः कर्मणाम् एष तस्य गोव्रजवासिनः । भूतपूर्वश् च मे मृत्युः स नूनं पूर्वदैहिकः । क्व च गोपत्वम् अशुभं मानुष्यं मृत्युदुर्बलम् । क्व च देवप्रभावेन क्रीडितव्यं व्रजे मम ॥ अहो नीचेन वपुषा च्छादयित्वात्मनो वपुः । को ऽप्य् एष रमते देवः श्मशानस्थ इवानलः ॥ श्रूयते हि पुरा विष्णुः सुराणां कारणान्तरे । वामनेन तु रूपेण जहार पृथिवीम् इमाम् ॥ हतो हिरण्यकशिपुर् दानवानां पितामहः ॥ हत्वा तु दानवं संख्ये राजानं कृतवान् हरिः । अचिन्त्यं रूपम् आस्थाय श्वेतशैलस्य मूर्धनि । भवेन च्याविता दैत्याः पुरा तत् त्रिपुरं घ्नता ॥
units.english: The powerful Aristha, with his horns shattered, has been slain by him in Vraja. From the actions of that boy living in the village of milk-men it appears that he is not a boy, but assuming the false guise of a child, is sporting there merely. While he stands before me for a battle, forsooth, know that he is my Death—the destroyer of my former body –. There is a vast difference between the birth as a wretched milkman amongst men, weak for their death and his sporting in my cow-settlement with the power of a god. It appears to me as certain that a god, covering his own true form with a Gopa body, is sporting here like fire in the cremation ground. have heard that in the days of yore in order to accomplish the work of the celestials, Vishnu, assuming the form of a dwarf, took away the earth from Bali. At another time assuming the form of a lion that powerful Vishnu killed Hiranyakashipu the grand-father of the Dānavas. Assuming a form, surpassing the range of thought, Bhāva Siva the destroyer of Tripura killed all the Daityas on the Sweta mountain.

units.sanskrit: पालितो गुरुपुत्रेण भार्गवो ऽङ्गिरसेन वै । प्रविश्य चासुरीं मायाम् अनावृष्टिं चकार ह ॥
units.english: Being shaken off his promise by his preceptor Angira's son Kacha resorting to a frog's illusion Bhrigu's son Sukra caused a drought in the land of the Dānavas.

units.sanskrit: अनन्तः शाश्वतो देवः सहस्रवदनो ऽव्ययः । वाराहं रूपम् आस्थाय उज्जहारार्णवान् महीम् ॥
units.english: Assuming the form of a boar that thousand-headed eternal deity Vishnu raised up the earth from the great ocean.

units.sanskrit: सुराणाम् असुराणां च युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम् ॥ अमृतार्थे पुरा चापि देवदैत्यसमागमे । दधार मन्दरं विष्णुर् अकूपार इति श्रुतिः ॥ वपुर् वामनम् आस्थाय निन्दनीयं पुरा वपुः । त्रिभिः क्रमैस् तु त्रीलोकाञ् जहार त्रिदिवालयम् । चतुर्धा तेजसो भागं कृत्वा दाशरथे गृहे । स एव रामसंज्ञो वै रावणं व्यशसत् तदा ॥
units.english: When the gods and Asuras, assembled for churning for ambrosia, Vishnu, in the shape of a tortoise in the ocean, held up the Mandara mountain. And when there arose ambrosia he, assuming the form of a beautiful woman, created a highly terrible battle between the gods and demons. Assuming a wretched dwarf form in the days of yore he rescued the three worlds including the land of the celestials, with his three foot-steps from Bali. It was he, who having divided himself into four portions and taking his birth as Rāma in Dasharatha’s house, killed Ravana.

units.sanskrit: साधयत्य् आत्मनः कार्यं सुराणाम् अर्थसिद्धये ॥
units.english: For accomplishing the work of gods Vishnu assumes various forms and deceitfully does his own work.

units.sanskrit: तद् एष नूनं विष्णुर् वा शक्रो वा मरुतां वरः । मत्साधनेप्सया प्राप्तो नारदो मां यद् उक्तवान् ॥
units.english: Forsooth Vishnu, of whom Nārada spoke to me, or Sakra, the king of gods, has now come for bringing about my death.

units.sanskrit: अत्र मे शङ्कते बुद्धिर् वसुदेवं प्रति प्रभो । अस्य बुद्धिविशेषेण वयं कातरतां गताः ॥ अहं हि खट्वाङ्गवने नारदेन समागतः । द्वितीयं स हि मां विप्रः पुनर् एवाब्रवीद् वचः ॥
units.english: In this matter our fear proceeds from Vasudeva; this is even my firm conviction. By his sense we have been reduced to this strait. When met Nārada again in Khatwānga forest that Brāhmana said to me Kansa, Vasudeva, in the night, has baffled your great care regarding Devaki's child –.

units.sanskrit: तां यशोदासुतां विद्धि कृष्णं च वसुदेवजम् ॥
units.english: The daughter, whom you dashed against a stone in that night, is Yashodā's daughter and know Krishna as Vasudeva's son.

units.sanskrit: रात्रौ व्यावर्तिताव् एतौ गर्भौ तव वधाय वै । वसुदेवेन संधाय मित्ररूपेण शत्रुणा ॥
units.english: Vasudeva, your enemy in the guise of a friend, after due consultation, exchanged the children in night for bringing about your death.

units.sanskrit: सा तु कन्या यशोदाया विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे । हत्वा शुम्भनिशुम्भौ द्वौ दानवौ नगचारिणौ ॥
units.english: Having slain on the Vindhya mountain the two sky-ranging Dānavas, Shumbha and Nisumbha, that daughter of Yashoda, sprinkled by the gods, is being worshipped by the dreadful robbers and various animals.

units.sanskrit: कृताभिषेका वरदा भूतसंघनिषेविता । अर्च्यते दस्युभिर् घोरैर् महापशुबलिप्रिया ॥ सुरापिशितपूर्णाभ्यां कुम्भाभ्याम् उपशोभिता । मयूराङ्गदचित्रैश् च बर्हभारैश् च भूषिता ॥ दृप्तकुकुटसंनादं वनं वायसनादितम् । दिव्यभृङ्गारचमरैर् आदर्शैश् च विभूषितम् । देवतूर्यनिनादैश् च शतशः प्रतिनादितम् । रिपूणां त्रासजननी नित्यं तत्र मनोरमे । वसते परमप्रीता दैवतैर् अपि पूजिता ॥
units.english: She is fond of human and animal sacrifices and confers boon upon her worshippers after their hearts –. Embellished with two jars full of wine and blood and adorned with peacock-feathers she has made her own abode, by her own power, in the forest of the Vindhya range. It is filled with cries of proud cocks and crows, abounds in free birds and deer, echoes with the roars of lions, tigers and boars, is thick with trees and covered entirely with woods. The temple is filled with golden vases, chowries, mirrors and is resonant with the sound of thousands of trumpets. The beautiful goddess, the mother of fear unto the enemies, daily lives there with great delight and even the celestials adore her.

units.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अयं नन्दगोपस्य कृष्ण इत्य् उच्यते सुतः । अत्र मे नारदः प्राह सुमहत् कर्म कारणम् ॥
units.english: Nārada has said that the boy who is known as the son of Nanda Gopa, Krishna, will be the agent of many important deeds.

units.sanskrit: द्वितीयो वसुदेवाद् वै वासुदेवो भविष्यति । स हि ते सहजो मृत्युर् बान्धवश् च भविष्यति ॥
units.english: The second son that will be born of Vasudeva and pass by the name of Vāsudeva, that kinsman of yours will easily put you to death.

units.sanskrit: स एव वासुदेवो वै वसुदेवसुतो बली । बान्धवो धर्मतो मह्यं हृदयेनान्तको रिपुः ॥
units.english: He is Vasudeva, the powerful son of Vasudeva. Morally he is my kins-man, but at heart a dreadful enemy –.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेवस् तथैवायं सपुत्रः सहबान्धवः । च्छिनत्ति मम मूलानि भुङ्क्ते च मम पार्श्वतः ॥
units.english: As a crow, with its beaks fond of flesh, distresses the eyes of a man on whose head it sets its foot, so this Vasudeva, brought up by me in my house, along with his son, kinsmen and fruits, is trying to strike at the root of my family –.

units.sanskrit: भ्रूणहत्यापि संतार्या गोवधः स्त्रीवधो ऽपि वा । न कृतघ्नस्य लोको ऽस्ति बान्धवस्य विशेषतः ॥
units.english: man, after killing an embryo or a cow or a woman, can somehow save himself, but there is no region for an ungrateful person.

units.sanskrit: पतितानुगतं मार्गं निषेवत्य् अचिरेण सः । यः कृतघ्नो ऽनुबन्धेन प्रीतिं वहति दारुणाम् ॥
units.english: An ungrateful man, who for a selfish end, gives vent to sweet words which prove dangerous in the long run, wends the way of out-castes.

units.sanskrit: अपापे पापहृदयो यः पापम् अनुतिष्ठति ॥ स याति नरकं घोरं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् । अहं वा स्वजनः श्लाघ्यः स वा श्लाघ्यतरः सुतः । नियमैर् गुरुवृत्तेन त्वया बान्धवकाम्यया ॥
units.english: He, who having his mind bent on iniquity, injures an innocent man, is constrained to wend the way leading to hell. On account of our rules of conduct and accomplishments, we are worthy of praise to persons like you seeking friendship. And such sons are more worthy of praise.

units.sanskrit: हस्तिनां कलहे घोरे वधम् ऋच्छन्ति वीरुधः । युद्धव्युपरमे ते तु सहाश्नन्ति महावने ॥ बान्धवानाम् अपि तथा भेदकाले समुत्थिते । कलिस् त्वं हि विनाशाय मया पुष्टो विजानता । गच्छ गच्छ यथाकामं वसुदेव नराधम ॥
units.english: As by the dreadful fight of the elephants, trees are destroyed which, after the close of the combat, become their food, so when dissensions take place amongst kinsmen, either relatives or inferior arbitrators meet with destruction –. Vasudeva, while you are about to sow dissensions in this family, now understand forsooth that without knowing you fed you who are like death.

units.sanskrit: अमर्षी वैरशीलश् च सदा पापमतिः शठः ॥
units.english: foolish man, you are always angry by nature, fond of creating enemies, sinful and of false humility.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेव वृथावृद्ध यन् मया त्वं पुरस्कृतः ॥
units.english: It is you who have brought this Yadu race into a pitiable strait. Vasudeva, your old age is of no use.

units.sanskrit: श्वेतेन शिरसा वृद्धो नैव वर्षशती भवेत् । यस्य बुद्धिः परिणता स वै वृद्धतमो नृणाम् ॥
units.english: Unknowingly did reward you who, in his hundred years with all his hairs grey, do not become old ? He is aged in this world whose sense is ripe.

units.sanskrit: न तेन वृद्धो भवति येनास्य पलितं शिरः । त्वं तु कर्कशशीलश् च बुद्ध्या च न बहुश्रुतः । केवलं वयसा वृद्धो यथा शरदि तोयदः ॥
units.english: But he is not aged whose hairs are grey. You are of a harsh temper; your intellect is not ripe and you are merely old in age like an autumnal cloud.

units.sanskrit: किं च त्वं साधु जानीषे वसुदेव वृथामते । हते कंसे मम सुतो मथुरां पालयिष्यति ॥
units.english: vain Vasudeva, you have thought. On Kansa being slain my son will govern Mathura.

units.sanskrit: छिन्नाशस् त्वं वृथावृद्ध मिथ्या ह्य् एवं विचारितम् । जिजीविषुर् न स ह्य् अस्ति यो हि तिष्ठेन् ममाग्रतः ॥
units.english: Your hope is already frustrated, you who have uselessly grown old and your resolution is falsified. No, one who has the desire of living, will live before me.

units.sanskrit: प्रहर्तुकामो विश्वस्ते यस् त्वं स्वस्थेन चेतसा । तत् ते प्रतिकरिष्यामि पुत्रयोस् तव पश्यतः ॥
units.english: By this wicked mind you have thought of injuring me who have confided in you; will take steps against it in the presence of your two sons.

units.sanskrit: न मे वृद्धवधः कश्चिद् द्विजस्त्रीवध एव वा । कृतपूर्वः करिष्ये वा विशेषेण तु बान्धवे ॥
units.english: have never killed an old man, a Brāhmana, a woman, or any one specially amongst my kinsmen, and shall never do it.

units.sanskrit: इह त्वं जातसंवृद्धो मम पित्रा विवर्धितः । पितृष्वसुर् मे भर्ता च यदूनां प्रथमो गुरुः ॥
units.english: You are born here and have been brought up by my father. Besides you are my sister's husband and the first preceptor of the Yadus.

units.sanskrit: कुले महति विख्यातः प्रथिते चक्रवर्तिनाम् । गुर्वर्थं पूजितः सद्भिर् यदुभिर् धर्मबुद्धिभिः ॥
units.english: Born in the great family of the well-known Lords Paramount of the world you are being worshipped as a preceptor by the noble and religious Yādavas.

units.sanskrit: किं करिष्यामहे सर्वे सत्सु वक्तव्यतां गताः । यदूनां यूथमुख्यस्य यस्य ते वृत्तम् ईदृशम् ॥
units.english: Old man, what shall we do? For such a conduct of a leading Yadava like your self, all the members of the Yadu race have become the butt of peoples talk.

units.sanskrit: मद्वधो वा जयो वाथ वसुदेवस्य दुर्णयैः । त्वया हि मद्वधोपायं तर्कयानेन वै मृधे । अशाम्यं वैरम् उत्पन्नं मम कृष्णस्य चोभयोः । गच्छत्व् अयं दानपतिः क्षिप्रम् आनयितुं व्रजात् । नन्दगोपं च गोपांश् च करदान् मम शासनात् ॥ वाच्यश् च नन्दगोपो वै करम् आदाय वार्षिकम् । कृष्णसंकर्षणौ चैव वसुदेवसुताव् उभौ । द्रष्टुम् इच्छति वै कंसः सभृत्यः सपुरोहितः ॥
units.english: Vasudeva, if am dead or defeated, for your improper conduct, it will put the Yadavas to shame before the pious. By concerting this measure for my destruction you have made yourself an object of distrust and the Yādavas of redicule. What more, you have created such an enmity between me and Krishna that there will be no peace in the Yadu family unless one of us dies. Whatever it may be, giver of gifts, go to Vraja, at my command and bring these two boys, Nanda and other Gopas who pay tributes to me. Tell Nanda to come quickly to Mathura with his annual tribute along with other milk-men. Kansa, surrounded by his servants and priests, wants to see Krishna and Sangkarshana, the two sons of Vasudeva.

units.sanskrit: एतौ युद्धविदौ रङ्गे कालनिर्माणयोधिनौ । दृढप्रतिकृती चैव शृणोमि व्यायतोद्यमौ ॥
units.english: He has heard that, that both of them are of hard limbs, powerful, careful, clever in fighting and well up in holding a match in the arena.

units.sanskrit: अस्माकम् अपि मल्लौ द्वौ सज्जौ जयधृतोत्सवौ । ताभ्यां सह नियोत्स्येते तौ युद्धकुशलाव् उभौ ॥
units.english: Well-armed the two wrestlers of mine are rejoicing to combat with them. They are also experts in fighting and will match them.

units.sanskrit: द्रष्टव्यौ च मयावश्यं बालौ ताव् अमरोपमौ । पितृष्वसुः सुतौ मुख्यौ व्रजवासौ वनेचरौ ॥
units.english: Besides these two boys, ranging in the woods of Vraja, the two immortal-like best of warriors are my sister's sons and therefore should see them.

units.sanskrit: राजा धनुर्महं नाम कारयिष्यति वै सुखी ॥ यथाकामप्रदानाय भोज्याधिश्रयणाय च ॥ अक्रूर गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं ताव् आनय ममाज्ञया । संकर्षणं च कृष्णं च द्रष्टुं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
units.english: Tell the inhabitants of Vraja that the king, of his own accord, is celebrating a bow festivity. Therefore let them come with necessary milk, curd, butter, &c. , to cater the invited persons after their hearts and live at ease in the forest attached to the city. Akrura, am filled with curiosity to see Krishna and Sangkarshena. Do you go soon, bring them here and satisfy my command.

units.sanskrit: ताभ्याम् आगमने प्रीतिः परा मम कृता भवेत् । दृष्ट्वा तु तौ महावीर्यौ तद् विधास्यामि यद् धितम् ॥
units.english: If they come here shall attain to supreme delight. Beholding those two highly powerful boys shall engage in a work conducive to my well-being.

units.sanskrit: न गच्छेतां यथाकालं निग्राह्याव् अपि तौ मम ॥
units.english: If they do not come here at my behest shall subdue them in time.

units.sanskrit: सान्त्वम् एव तु बालेषु प्रधानं प्रथमो नयः । मधुरेणैव तौ मन्दौ स्वयम् एवानयाशु वै ॥ अक्रूर कुरु मे प्रीतिम् एतां परमदुर्लभाम् । यदि वा नोपजप्तो ऽसि वसुदेवेन सुव्रत ॥
units.english: Akrura, it is better to use conciliatory words first towards the boys. Do you soon bring them here with sweet words. you of firm vows, if you are not alienated from me by Vasudeva, do you accomplish this great work conducive to my pleasure.

units.sanskrit: तथा कर्तव्यम् एतद् धि यथा ताव् आगमिष्यतः । इत्य् उक्त्वा विररामैव कंसः स मधुरेश्वरः । एवम् आक्रुष्यमानस् तु वसुदेवो वसूपमः । वाक्शल्यैस् ताड्यमानस् तु कंसेनादीर्घदर्शिना । क्षमां मनसि संध्याय नोत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत ॥
units.english: Do that by which they may come here. Thus villified, Vasudeva, resembling a Vasu, resorting to gravity and patience, stood there motionless like an ocean. Assailed by foolish Kansa, with these shaft-like words, he, resorting to forgiveness, did not give any reply.

units.sanskrit: ये तु तं ददृशुस् तत्र क्षिप्यमाणम् अनेकशः । अक्रूरस् तु महातेजा जानन् दिव्येन चक्षुषा । जलम् दृष्ट्वेव तृषितः प्रेषितः प्रीतिमान् अभूत् ॥
units.english: Those, who saw him thus insulted at that time, all exclaimed, bending low their heads, Oh fie Oh fie!. With his celestial vision the liberal Akrura could know everything. And so he was filled with great delight like a thirsty man on seeing water.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् एव मुहूर्ते तु मथुरायाः स निर्ययौ । वैशंपायन उवाच क्षिप्तं यदुवृषं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते यदुपुंगवाः । अन्धस् त्व् अनाविग्नमना धैर्याद् अविकृतं वचः । प्रोवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठः समासात् कंसम् ओजसा ॥
units.english: And in order to see the lotus-eyed Krishna he left Mathura in that very moment -. Vaishampayana said:—Beholding Vasudeva thus insulted and covering their ears with their hands the leading Yādavas took him for one having his lease of life run out. Resorting to patience, although his mind was worked up with anxiety Andhaka, the foremost of speakers, addressed, mildly in the midst of that assembly, powerful words to Kansa.

units.sanskrit: अश्लाघ्यो मे मतः पुत्र तवायं वाक्परिश्रमः । अयुक्तो गर्हितः सद्भिर् बान्धवेषु विशेषतः ॥
units.english: my son, it is unworthy of you to give vent to such words. To use such words to relatives is considered unbecoming and culpable by the pious.

units.sanskrit: अयादवो यदि भवाञ् शृणु तावद् यद् उच्यते । न हि त्वां यादवा वीर बलात् कुर्वन्ति यादवम् ॥
units.english: hero, if you consider yourself as one, not born in the family of the Yadavas listen to what say. The Yādavas do not by force wish to regard you as one of them.

units.sanskrit: अश्लाघ्या वृष्णयः पुत्र येषां त्वम् अनुशासिता । इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो राजा विनिवृत्तः स्ववंशकृत् ॥
units.english: Rather a person like you becoming their master they have become censurable to all. What more, it appears, that the king Asamanja, of the Ikshaku race, has returned in your person.

units.sanskrit: भोजो वा यादवो वासि कंसो वासि यथा तथा । सहजं ते शिरस् तात जटी मुण्डो ऽपि वा भव ॥
units.english: my son, you may wear matted locks, may have your head shaved, may take any appellation, Bhoja, Yādava or Kansa, your head will remain in its natural shape.

units.sanskrit: दुर्जातीयेन येन त्वम् ईदृशो जनितः सुतः ॥
units.english: Cursed is that Ugrasena who has begotten a son like you, a wretch and curse of our family.

units.sanskrit: न चात्मनो गुणांस् तात प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः । परेणोक्ता गुणा गौण्यं यान्ति वेदार्तसंमिताः ॥
units.english: my son, the wise never make themselves a parade of their own accomplishments. The qualities, recognized by the Vedas, attain to fructification when spoken of by others.

units.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यदुवंशो ऽयं निन्दनीयो महीक्षिताम् । बालः कुलान्तकृन् मूढो येषां त्वम् अनुशासिता ॥
units.english: stupid boy, the destroyer of his race like you, becoming our king the family of Yadus has become degraded among the royal families of the world.

units.sanskrit: साधुस् त्वम् एभिर् वाक्यैश् च त्वया साध्व् इति भाषितैः । न वाचा साधितं कार्यम् आत्मा च विवृतः कृतः ॥
units.english: The vilifications, that you have given vent to, considering them as proper, have not been able to accomplish your object rather you have laid bare your character before the public by it.

units.sanskrit: गुरोर् अनवलिप्तस्य मान्यस्य महताम् अपि । क्षेपणं कः शुभं मन्येद् द्विजस्येव वधं कृतम् ॥ मान्याश् चैवाभिगम्याश् च वृद्धास् तात यथाग्रयः । धर्मस्य गतिर् अन्वेष्या मत्स्यस्य गतिर् अप्स्व् इव ॥
units.english: Will you consider the insulting of a highly worshipful innocent preceptor, like the destruction of a Brāhmana, as conducive to well-being ? my son, the aged ought to be adored and worshipped like fire for their anger can consume even the regions acquired by Yoga. Self-controlled and learned men, of advanced intellect, should enquire into the conduct of the people as they watch the movements of fish in water.

units.sanskrit: वाचा दुनोषि मर्मघ्न्या अमन्त्रोक्ता यथाहुतिः ॥
units.english: Like an oblation not consecrated by mantras you always pain the fire-like aged people with heart-rending words.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेवं च पुत्रार्थे यदि त्वं परिगर्हसे । तत्र मिथ्याप्रलापं ते निन्दामि कृपणं वचः ॥
units.english: You are remonstrating with Vasudeva for his son. We speak ill of your these useless and abominable words.

units.sanskrit: दारुणे ऽपि पिता पुत्रे नैव दारुणतां व्रजेत् । छादितो वसुदेवेन यदि पुत्रः शिशुस् तदा । मन्यसे यद्य् अकर्तव्यं पृच्छस्व पितरं स्वकम् ॥ गर्हता वसुदेवं च यदुवंशं च निन्दता । त्वया यादवपुत्राणां वैरजं विषम् अर्जितम् ॥
units.english: If a son becomes wicked the father is not so, rather he falls into many difficulties on account of his son. You might think that Vasudeva did not do his duty by hiding his own baby son. But ask your own father about it. Chiding Vasudeva and speaking ill of the Yadu race you have acquired poison consequent upon the enmity of the Yādavas.

units.sanskrit: अकर्तव्यं यदि कृतं वसुदेवेन पुत्रजम् । किमर्थम् उग्रसेनेन शिशुस् त्वं न विनाशितः ॥ पुन् नाम्नो नरकात् पुत्रो यस्मात् त्राता पितॄन् सदा । जात्या हि यादवः कृष्णः स च संकर्षणो युवा । त्वं चापि विधृतस् ताभ्यां जातवैरेण चेतसा ॥
units.english: If Vasudeva has acted unfairly by doing this for his son why did not Ugrasena kill you in your infancy ? Persons, conversant with moral laws, have given the name of Putra to a son because he saves the departed ancestors from falling into the hell of Put. From the very beginning of their birth you have been cherishing enmity towards the youthful Sankarshana and Krishna although born in the race of the Yādavas and they too consider you as their enemy.

units.sanskrit: उद्धूतानीह सर्वेषां यदूनां हृदयानि वै । वसुदेवे त्वया क्षिप्ते वासुदेवे च कोपिते ॥ कृष्णे च भवतो द्वेषाद् वसुदेवविगर्हणात् । शंसन्ति हीमानि भयं निमित्तान्य् अशुभानि ते ॥ सर्पाणां दर्शनं तीव्रं स्वप्नानां च निशाक्षये । पुर्या वैधव्यशंसीनि कारणैर् अनुमीमहे ॥ एष घोरो ग्रहः स्वातीम् उल्लिखन् खे गभस्तिभिः । वक्रम् अङ्गारकश् चक्रे व्याहरन्ति खरं द्विजाः ॥ बुधेन पश्चिमा संध्या व्याप्ता घोरेण तेजसा । वैश्वानरपथे शुक्रो ह्य् अतिचारं चचार ह ॥
units.english: On account of your chiding Vasudeva and exciting the anger of Vāsudeva the hearts of all the Yadavas are trembling. On account of your thus remonstrating with Vasudeva Krishna has become your enemy and therefore these evil omens are declaring your future fear. Evil dreams in the end of night and dreadful portends like the vision of of serpents are all declaring that this city will soon be a widow. Behold in the sky the dreadful planet Rahu, by his own effulgence, is possessing the star Swāti and is waiting in your tenth star Chitra. The dreadful planet Mangala is united with them in its oblique course. By its dreadful effulgence Budha has covered the western sky in the evening. And going beyond its course Sukra is ranging in the sky.

units.sanskrit: केतुना धूमकेतोस् तु नक्षत्राणि त्रयोदश । भरण्यादीनि भिन्नानि नानुयन्ति निशाकरम् । शिवा श्मशानान् निष्क्रम्य निःश्वासाङ्गारवर्षिणी । उभे संध्ये पुरीं घोरा पर्येति बहु वाशती ॥
units.english: Separated by the tail of Ketu Bharani and other twelve planets are following the moon. Encircled by a disc the dawn with its effulgence is obstructing the sun and the birds and animals are going in contrary directions with cries Crying continually and emitting ember-like breaths the dreadful jackals are coming out of the cremation-grounds and going towards the city both in the morning and evening.

units.sanskrit: उल्का निर्घातनादेन पपात धरणीतले । चलत्य् अपर्वणि मही गिरीणां शिखराणि च ॥
units.english: Fire-brands are falling on earth with a terrible sound and the earth and mountain summits are shaking all on a sudden.

units.sanskrit: ग्रस्तः स्वर्भानुना सूर्यो दिवा नक्तम् अजायत । धूमोत्पातैर् दिशो व्याप्ताः शुष्काशनिसमाहताः ॥
units.english: The sun being possessed by Rahu the day is appearing like a night and all the quarters are filled with portendous smoke and thunder-bolts.

units.sanskrit: प्रस्रवन्ति घना रक्तं साशनिस्तनयित्नवः । चलिता देवताः स्थानात् त्यजन्ति विहगा नगान् ॥
units.english: The thick clouds, accompanied by lightnings, are pouring down blood—the gods are being shaken off their stations and the birds are leaving their resting trees.

units.sanskrit: यानि राजविनाशाय दैवज्ञाः कथयन्ति हि । तानि सर्वाणि पश्यामो निमित्तान्य् अशुभानि वै ॥
units.english: What more, all the evil omens, described by the astrologers as indicating the future death of a king, have set in.

units.sanskrit: त्वं चापि स्वजनद्वेषी राजधर्मपराङ्मुखः । अनिमित्तागतक्रोधः संनिकृष्टभयो ह्य् असि ॥
units.english: You are always harmful towards your relatives, backward in observing your royal duties and wrathful for nothing. Therefore your death is imminent.

units.sanskrit: यस् त्वं देवोपमं वृद्धं वसुदेवम् धृतव्रतम् । मोहात् क्षिपसि दुर्बुद्धे कुतस् ते शान्तिर् आत्मनः ॥
units.english: When you have out of your foolishness insulted the aged and god-like Vasudeva resembling a Vasu, there is no peace for you.

units.sanskrit: त्वद्गतो यो हि नः स्नेहस् तं त्यजामो ऽद्य वै वयम् । अहितं स्वस्य वंशस्य न त्वां वयम् उपास्महे ॥
units.english: You are an enemy of our race. From to-day we drive away the love that we had for you. After this we shall not adore you even for a moment.

units.sanskrit: स हि दानपतिर् धन्यो यो द्रक्ष्यति वनेगतम् । पुण्डरीकपलाशाक्षं कृष्णम् अक्लिष्टकारिणम् ॥
units.english: That giver, of gifts among us, is blessed who will behold the lotus-eyed Krishna of unwearied actions now ranging in the forest.

units.sanskrit: छिन्नमूलो ह्य् अयं वंशो यदूनां त्वत्कृते कृतः । कृष्णो ज्ञातीन् समानाय्य स संधानं करिष्यति ॥
units.english: For you this Yadu race is uprooted. Krishna will again unite his own kinsmen.

units.sanskrit: कालसंपक्वविज्ञानो ब्रूहि त्वं यद् यद् इच्छसि ॥
units.english: Your sense has been entirely destroyed by Destiny. Speak whatever you like.

units.sanskrit: मह्यं तु रोचते कंस वसुदेवसहायवान् । गच्छ कृष्णस्य निलयं प्रीतिस् ते तेन रोचताम् ॥
units.english: Vasudeva will forgive you for all. Kansa, think it proper now that aided by Vasudeva, you should go to Krishna and ingratiate yourself to his good graces.

units.sanskrit: अन्धकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कंसः संरक्तलोचनः । किंचिद् अप्य् अब्रुवन् क्रोधाद् विवेश स्वं निवेशनम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampayana said:—Hearing the words of Andha ka, Kansa's eyes were reddened with anger. Without giving vent to a single word he entered into his own house.

units.sanskrit: ते च सर्वे यथावेश्म यादवाः श्रुतविस्तराः । जग्मुर् विगतसंकल्पाः कंसवैकृतशंसिनः ॥
units.english: Having their resolution thus frustrated, Yādavas, well-versed in Srutis, repaired to their respective habitations talking over the ill-conduct of Kansa.

units.sanskrit: अक्रूरो ऽपि यथाज्ञप्तः कृष्णदर्शनलालसः । जगाम रथमुख्येन मनसस् तुल्यगामिना ॥
units.english: Akrura too, as commanded, and desirous of seeing Krishna, set out for Mathura in an excellent car fleet like the mind.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णस्यापि निमित्तानि शुभान्य् अङ्गगतानि वै । पितृतुल्येन शंसन्ति बान्धवेन समागमम् ॥
units.english: Many good signs appeared on Krishna's limbs bespeaking of his union with a father-like relative.

units.sanskrit: प्राग् एव च नरेन्द्रेण माथुरेणौग्रसेनिना । केशिनः प्रेषितो दूतो वधायोपेन्द्रकारणात् ॥ स तु दूतवचः श्रुत्वा केशी क्लेशकरो नृणाम् । वृन्दावनगतो गोपान् बाधते स्म दुरासदः ॥ मानुषं मांसम् अश्नानः क्रुद्धो दुष्टपराक्रमः । निघ्नन् गा वै सगोपाला गवां पिशितभोजनः । तदरण्यं श्मशानाभं नृणाम् अस्थिभिर् आवृतम् । यत्रास्ते स हि दुष्टात्मा केशी तुरगदानवः ॥
units.english: Before Akrura's departure, Ugrasena's son king Kansa sent an emissary to Keshi for destroying Krishna. Hearing the words of the messenger, the irrepressible Keshi, always oppressing the people, at once went to Vrindāvana and began to torture the Gopas, Feeding upon human flesh in anger that dreadful and wicked demon, in the shape of a horse, began to assail all greatly. Killing the cows and cow-herds, that irrepressible Dānava began to feed on beef of his own accord. Wherever in the forest the vicious-souled Dānava Keshi lived it was filled with the dead bodies of men and appeared like a cremation ground.

units.sanskrit: खुरैर् दारयते भूमिम् वेगेनारुजते द्रुमान् । हेषितैः स्पर्धते वायुम् प्लुतैर् लङ्घ्यते नभः ॥
units.english: He used to scratch the earth with his hoofs, weaken the trees with his velocity, leap up into the sky and trifle at the wind with his neighing.

units.sanskrit: अतिप्रवृद्धो मत्तश् च दुष्टाश्वो वनगोचरः । आकम्पितसटो रौद्रः कंसस्य चरितानुगः ॥ इरिणं तद्वनं सर्वं तेन सौदासकर्मणा । कृतं तुरगदैत्येन सर्वान् गोपाञ् जिघांसता ॥ तेन दुष्टप्रचारेण दूषितं तद्वनं महत् । न नृभिर् गोधनैर् वापि सेव्यते वनवृत्तिभिः ॥
units.english: Thus shaking his manes and ranging in the forest, that highly proud, foolish and wicked demon, assuming the form of a horse, began to act there as desired by Kansa. Destroying the Gopas, that horse demon, of wicked deeds, made the forest empty. That wicked one so much vitiated the forest that the Gopas, who derive their sustenance through woods and the kine left it. With his mind worked up with pride he continually fed on human flesh so much so that the animals could not wend the forest roads.

units.sanskrit: मदाच् चलितवृत्तेन नृमांसान्य् अश्नता भृशम् ॥ नृशब्दानुसरः क्रुद्धः स कदाचिद् दिनागमे । जगाम घोषसंवासं चोदितः कालधर्मणा ॥ तं दृष्ट्वा दुद्रुवुर् गोपाः स्त्रियश् च शिशुभिः सह । क्रन्दमाना जगन्नाथम् कृष्णं नाथम् उपाश्रिताः ॥
units.english: Once during the day, following in anger the noise of men, that Daity, as if urged on by Destiny, arrived at the settlement of the milk-men. As soon as they saw him the Gopa-women, with their children, and the Gopas, setting up a cry, fled away to their master Krishna, the lord of the universe. Hearing the cries of the Gopas and of their women Krishna promised them safety and went out to meet Keshi.

units.sanskrit: दत्त्वाभयं तु कृष्णो वै केशिनं सो ऽभिदुद्रुवे ॥
units.english: Keshi, too, of powerful course, expanding his eyes and teeth and raising up his neck, ran towards Krishna with a great sound.

units.sanskrit: हेषमाणो जवोदग्रो गोविन्दाभिमुखो ययौ ॥
units.english: Seeing the horse-demon Keshi fall on him Govinda confronted him as a cloud approaches the moon.

units.sanskrit: जगताम् अभयदो ऽसि त्वं त्रायस्वास्मान् विशेषतः । कृष्ण तात न खल्व् एष सहसा ते हयाधमः । उपसर्प्यो भवान् बालः पापश् चैष दुरासदः ॥
units.english: Beholding Krishna at that time approach Keshi, the Gopas, endued with human sense, said to him for his well-being : child, Krishna, do thou not all on a sudden approach this wretch of a horse, for thou art a boy and that one of evil ways is beyond the power of all.

units.sanskrit: एष कंसस्य सहजः प्राणस् तात बहिश्चरः । उत्तमश् च हयेन्द्राणां दानवो ऽप्रतिमो युधि ॥ त्रासनः परसैन्यानां तुरगाणां महाबलः । गोपानां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा वदतां मधुसूदनः । केशिना सह युद्धाय मतिं चक्रे ऽरिसूदनः ॥
units.english: This highly powerful Dānava, peerless in battle, is born with Kansa, and is his life though ranging outward. He is a dread of the horses and soldiers, cannot be killed by any animal and the foremost of the sinful –. Hearing these words given vent to by the Gopas, Madhusudana, the slayer of his enemies cherished a desire of fighting with Keshi.

units.sanskrit: ततः सव्यं दक्षिणं च मण्डलानि परिभ्रमन् । पद्भ्याम् उभाभ्यां स हयः क्रोधेनारुजते द्रुमान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon turning reversely to the southern direction in anger that horse-demon began to break down the trees with his two feet.

units.sanskrit: मुखे लम्बसटे चास्य स्कन्धदेशे घनावृते । वलयो ऽभ्रतरंगाभाः सुस्रुवुः क्रोधजं जलम् ॥
units.english: Then from his long mouth, the thick manes on his neck and those falling on his forehead like streams of water began to trickle down drops of perspiration begotten by anger.

units.sanskrit: हिमकाले यथा व्योम्नि नीहारम् इव चन्द्रमाः ॥
units.english: As the moon pours down dews in the sky during the winter so from his mouth came out loams produced by the strokes of reins.

units.sanskrit: खुरोद्धरणमुक्तेन मधुरक्षोदपाण्डुना । रजसा स हयः कृष्णं चकारारुणमूर्धजम् ॥
units.english: Covered with yellowish dust resembling powdered Madhuka panic seed raised up by his horns Krishna's locks became tawny.

units.sanskrit: दन्तान् निर्दशमानस् तु केशी कृष्णम् उपाद्रवत् ॥
units.english: Trotting and leaping and riving the earth, Keshi, biting his teeth, ran towards Krishna.

units.sanskrit: पुनः पुनश् च स बली प्राहिणोत् पार्श्वतः खुरान् । कृष्णस्य दानवो घोरं प्रहारम् अमितौजसः । वक्त्रेण चास्य घोरेण तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रायुधेन वै । अदशद् बाहुविवरं कृष्णस्य रुषितो हयः ॥ स लम्बकेसरसटः कृष्णेन सह संगतः । रराज केशी मेघेन संसक्तः ख इवांशुमान् ॥
units.english: While engaged in fighting with Krishna, the powerful Dānava Keshi, the foremost of horses, struck him on the breast with his fore-feet, and wounded him, of unmitigated prowess, repeatedly with his hoofs –. Thereupon in anger, with his sharpened teeth, forming the weapons of his dreadful mouth he bit the upper part of Vāsudeva's arm. At that time fighting with Krishna, Keshi, with long manes, shone like the sun in sky united with clouds.

units.sanskrit: वेगेन वासुदेवस्य क्रोधाद् द्विगुणविक्रमः ॥ तस्योत्सिक्तस्य बलवान् कृष्णो ऽप्य् अमितविक्रमः । बाहुम् आभोगिनं कृत्वा मुखे क्रुद्धः समादधत् ॥
units.english: With his strength doubled by anger that powerful horse, with great motion, attempted to strike Krishna on the breast. Thereat, lengthening his arms, Krishna of great prowess, in anger caught hold of the mouth of that demon.

units.sanskrit: स तं बाहुम् अशक्तो वै खादितुं भोक्तुम् एव वा । विपाटिताभ्याम् ओष्ठाभ्याम् कटाभ्यां विदलीकृतः । अक्षिणी विकृते चक्रे विसृते मुक्तबन्धने ॥
units.english: Keshi could not therefore eat up or break down his arms. On the other hand, his teeth being uprooted and broken down he began to vomit foamy blood. His lips were shattered, his jaws were smashed, and his eyes were disfigured.

units.sanskrit: निरस्तहनुर् आविष्टः शोणितास्राविलेक्षणः । उत्कर्णो नष्टचेतास् तु स केशी बह्वचेष्टत ॥ उत्पत्य चासकृत् पादैः सकृन्मूत्रं समुत्सृजन् । स्विन्नार्द्रलोमा श्रान्तस् तु निर्यत्नचरणो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: His jaws were broken and his eyes were filled with blood. Raising up his ears in anger and having his mind agitated he set forth many an exertion. Jumping up again and again with his legs, he discharged urine and excreta, his hairs were soaked with perspiration and feet grew motionless.

units.sanskrit: केशिवक्त्रविलग्नस् तु कृष्णबाहुर् अशोभत । व्याभुग्न इव घर्मान्ते चन्द्रार्धकिरणैर् घनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon Krishna's arm, thrown round Keshi’s head, shone like a cloud stricken with the rays of the half-moon after the termination of the rainy season.

units.sanskrit: प्रभातावनतश् चन्द्रः श्रान्तो मेरुम् इवाश्रितः ॥ तस्य कृष्णभुजोद्धूताः केशिनो दशना मुखात् । केशिनो वक्त्रनिर्धूता विविधा दशना भुवि । पेतुः शरदि निस्तोयाः सिताभ्रावयवा इव ॥
units.english: With his limbs wearied out Keshi too, while engaged in a conflict with Krishna, appeared like the declining and exhausted moon on the mount Meru in the dawn. His teeth, uprooted by Krishna's hands, from his mouth fell down like white autumnal clouds shorn of water.

units.sanskrit: स तु केशी भृशं श्रान्तः कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । स पाटितो भुजेनाजौ कृष्णेन विकृताननः । केशी नदन् महानादं दानवो व्यथितस् तदा ॥
units.english: Thereupon when Keshi was greatly worn out with fatigue Krishna, stretching his hands a good deal, sundered him in twain. Thus smashed down by Krishna, the face of the Dānava Keshi became disfigured and he began to cry most plaintively.

units.sanskrit: विघूर्णमानः स्रस्ताङ्गो मुखाद् रुधिरम् उद्वमन् । भृशं व्यङ्गीकृतवपुर् निकृत्तार्ध इवाचलः ॥
units.english: All his limbs were shaken and shattered and blood came out of his mouth. He appeared there, accordingly, disfigured like a mountain, with a half of it being chopped off.

units.sanskrit: व्यादितास्यो महारौद्रः सो ऽसुरः कृष्णबाहुना । निपपात यथा कृत्तो नागो हि द्विदलीकृतः । बाहुना कृत्तदेहस्य केशिनो रूपम् आबभौ । पशोर् इव महाघोरं निहतस्य पिनाकिना ॥
units.english: Thus smothered by Krishna's hands and with his mouth expanded that highly dreadful Asura fell down like an elephant cut into two halves. The dreadful figure of Kehsi, mutilated by Krishna's hand, appeared like a beast slain by Rudra, with trident in his hand.

units.sanskrit: द्विपादपृष्ठपुच्छार्धे स्रवणैकाक्षिनासिके । केशिनस् ते द्विधा भूते द्वे अर्धे रेजतुः क्षितौ ॥
units.english: His body being sundered into two equal halves each portion bearing two legs, half of his back and tail, one eye and one nostril, remained on earth.

units.sanskrit: केशिदन्तक्षतश् चापि कृष्णस्य शुशुभे भुजः । तं हत्वा केशिनं युद्धे कल्पयित्वा च भागशः । कृष्णः पद्मपलाशाक्षो हसंस् तत्रैव तस्थिवान् ॥
units.english: Krishna's arms too, wounded by Keshi's teeth, shone like a growing palm tree in the forest scratched by an elephant's tusks. Having, in this wise, slain Keshi in the battle-field and divided his body into two parts the lotus-eyed Krishna stood there smiling.

units.sanskrit: तं हतं केशिनं दृष्ट्वा गोपा गोपस्त्रियश् च ताः । बभूवुर् मुदिताः सर्वे हतविघ्ना हतक्लमाः ॥
units.english: Beholding Keshi slain, the Gopas and their women, with all their troubles and weariness gone, were greatly delighted.

units.sanskrit: दामोदरं च श्रीमन्तम् यथास्थानं यथावयः । अभ्यनन्दन् प्रियैर् वाक्यैः पूजयन्तः पुनः पुनः ॥
units.english: And welcoming the beautiful Dāmodara according to their respective position and age they honored him again and again with sweet words.

units.sanskrit: अहो तात कृतं कर्म हतो ऽयं लोककण्टकः । दैत्यः क्षितिचरः कृष्ण हयरूपं समास्थितः ॥
units.english: The Gopas said:— child, Krishna, having slain the Daitya, assuming the form of a horse and ranging on earth—the thorn of people, thou hast performed an arduous work.

units.sanskrit: कृतं वृन्दावनं क्षेमं सेव्यं सर्वनृपक्षिणाम् । हता नो बहवो गोपा गावो वत्साश् च वत्सलाः । नैके चान्ये जनपदा हतानेन दुरात्मना ॥ एष संवर्तकं कर्तुम् उद्यतः किल पापकृत् । नैतस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं कश्चिच् छक्तो जिजीविषुः । अपि देवसमूहेषु किं पुनः पृथिवीतले ॥
units.english: On this vicious horse being slain by thee Vrindāvana is now full of auspiciousness and men, animals and birds are at ease. This vicious-minded one has destroyed many of our milk-men, cows fond of calves and villages. Perhaps divesting the worlds of men this sinful demon is about to bring about a universal dissolution for ranging himself at ease. Krishna, what to speak of mortal men, even amongst the celestials, one, desirous of living, cannot stand before him.

units.sanskrit: अथाहान्तर्हितो विप्रो नारदः खगमो मुनिः । प्रीतो ऽस्मि विष्णो देवेश कृष्ण कृष्णेति चासकृत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon the Brāhmana Nārada, disappearing from view in the sky, said Vishnu, god, Krishna, am pleased.

units.sanskrit: यद् इदं दुष्करं कर्म कृतं केशिजिघांसया । त्वय्य् एव केवलं युक्तम् त्रिदिवे त्र्यम्बके ऽपि वा ॥
units.english: The arduous work, that you have performed by destroying Krishna, is in thy power and in that of the three-eyed Deity Siva amongst the celestials.

units.sanskrit: अहं युद्धोत्सुकस् तात तर्पितेनान्तरात्मना । इदं नरहयं युद्धम् दर्ष्टुं स्वर्गाद् इहागतः ॥
units.english: my child, my mind is devoted to thee, and therefore desirous of witnessing this combat between a man and a horse have come here from the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: पूतनानिधनादीनि कर्माणि तव दृष्टवान् । अहं त्व् अनेन गोविन्द कर्मणा परितोषितः ॥
units.english: Govinda, beholding thy deeds as the destruction of Putanā &c. , and this thy present feat have been highly pleased.

units.sanskrit: हयस्यास्य महेन्द्रो ऽपि बिभेति बलसूदनः । कुर्वाणस्य वपुर् घोरम् केशिनो दुष्टचेतसः ॥
units.english: When this wicked-minded horse-demon Keshi used to increase his body, even Mahendra, the slayer of Bali, was stricken with fear.

units.sanskrit: यत् त्वया पाटितो द्वैधं भुजेनायतपर्वणा । एषो ऽस्य मृत्युर् अन्ताय विहितो विश्वयोनिना ॥ यस्मात् त्वया हतः केशी तस्मान् मच्छासनं शृणु । केशवो नाम नाम्ना त्वं ख्यातो लोके भविष्यसि ॥ स्वस्त्य् अस्तु भवतो लोके साधयाम्य् अहम् आशुगः । कृत्यशेषं च ते कार्यं शक्तस् त्वम् असि माचिरम् ॥ त्वयि कार्यान्तरगते नरा इव दिवौकसः । विडम्बयन्तः क्रीडन्ति लीलां त्वद्बलम् आश्रिताः ॥
units.english: With thy outstretched hands thou hast sundered him. This death was ordained for him by Brahmā, the root of the universe. Listen now to my declaration, Vishnu. Since thou hast slain Keshi, thou shalt pass by the name of Keshava in the world. May good betide thee, Keshava, shall soon depart. Thou hast many works still to accomplish and thou art capable of doing them. Do thou perform them therefore, without any delay. god, thyself being engaged in another work, other deities, dependant on thy power, are sporting like men imitating thy feats.

units.sanskrit: अभ्याशे वर्तते कालो भारतस्याहवोदधेः । हस्तप्राप्तानि युद्धानि राज्ञां त्रिदिवगामिनाम् ॥
units.english: The time for the mighty deep of the Bharata war, the battle of the kings, who are about to repair to the celestial region, is near at hand.

units.sanskrit: पन्थानः शोधिता व्योम्नि विमानारोहिणोर्ध्वगाः । अवकाशा विभज्यन्ते शक्रलोके महीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: Because the kings will repair to the region of Sakra, houses are being built for them there, the etherial roads are being cleared off and the cars are being embellished with pennons.

units.sanskrit: उग्रसेनसुते शान्ते पदस्थे त्वयि केशव । अभितस् तन् महद्युद्धं भविष्यति महीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: Keshava, when Ugrasena's son will be killed and thou wilt be in thy position this terrible and all-destroying war of kings will commence.

units.sanskrit: त्वां चाप्रतिमकर्माणं संश्रयिष्यन्ति पार्थिवाः । त्वयि राजासनस्थे हि राजश्रीं वहति प्रभो । श्रियं त्यक्ष्यन्ति राजानस् त्वत्प्रभावान् न संशयः ॥ एष मे कृष्ण संदेशः श्रुतिभिः ख्यातिम् एष्यसि । देवतानां दिविस्थानां जगतश् च जगत्पते ॥
units.english: Mādhava, unparalleled are thy deeds; therefore at the time of the war the Pāndavas will seek refuge with thee and thou too shalt espouse their cause. When thou shalt be on the royal throne, undoubtedly the kings will renounce their most excellent and auspicious prosperity, Krishna, lord of the universe, thus have communicated unto thee the intelligence of the gods living in the celestial region and of the universe. Although this history is recorded in Srutis it will become famous in the world.

units.sanskrit: दृष्टं मे भवतः कर्म दृष्टश् चासि मया प्रभो । कंसे भूयः समेष्यामि शासिते साधयाम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: lord, have witnessed thy deeds and have seen thee. now depart and shall return when Kansa will be slain.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु स तदा नारदः खं जगाम ह । नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवसंगीतयोगिनः । तथेति स समाभाष्य पुनर् गोपान् समासदत् । गोपान् कृष्णः समासाद्य व्रजम् एव विवेष ह ॥
units.english: Saying this Nārada wended the etherial way. And hearing the words of Nārada, proficient in celestial music, the Gopas too, along with Krishna, repaired to Vraja –. Having entered there that giver of gifts frequently enquired after Keshava, Rohini's son and Nanda Gopa -.

units.sanskrit: स नन्दगोपस्य गृहं वासाय वसुदोपमः । अवरुह्य ततो यानात् प्रविवेश महाबलः ॥
units.english: Thereupon coming down from the chariot that highly powerful and liberal prince, resembling a Vasu, entered Nanda's house.

units.sanskrit: प्रविशन्न् एव च द्वारि ददर्शादोहने गवाम् । वत्समध्ये स्थितं कृष्णं सवत्सम् इव गोवृषम् ॥
units.english: As soon as he entered the gate with his face full of joy and eyes full of tears he saw Krishna stationed at the milking-place in the midst of calves like a bull.

units.sanskrit: को ऽयं मत्सदृशो लोके दृष्टवान् यो ऽहम् ईश्वरम् । एहि केशव तातेति प्रव्याहरत धर्मवित् ॥ उत्तानशायिनं दृष्ट्वा पुनर् दृष्ट्वा श्रिया वृतम् । अव्यक्तयुवनं कृष्णम् अक्रूरः प्रशशंसे ह ॥ अयं स पुण्डरीकाक्षः सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमः । संपूर्णजलमेघाभः पर्वतप्रवराकृतिः ॥ मृधेष्व् अधर्षणीयेन सश्रीवत्सेन वक्षसा । द्विषन्निधनदक्षाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां साधु भूषितः ॥
units.english: Greatly delighted at seeing Krishna, the pious Akrura with heavy accents, said Come to me, Keshava. And beholding Vāsudeva, at the junction of boyhood and youth who lay on a fig-leaf at the time of the universal dissolution, and who assumed the form of a dwarf at the time of imposing on Bali, served by the prosperity of the three worlds, he praised him again and again and said within himself:—This is the lotus-eyed Krishna of the size of a huge mountain, resembling an ocean overflowed with water and endued with the prowess of a lion and tiger. Irrepressible in battle he has the mystic mark of Srivatsa on his breast and his well-adorned arms are like a ground where the enemies are being killed -.

units.sanskrit: मूर्तिमान् सरहस्यात्मा जगतो ऽग्र्यस्य भाजनम् । गोपवेषधरो विष्णुर् उदग्राग्रतनूरुहः ॥
units.english: He is the incarnation of Vishnu under the guise of a milk-man who is the first worshipful of the universe and whose form is Upanishad.

units.sanskrit: किरीटलाञ्च्छनेनापि शिरसा च्छत्रवर्चसा । हारार्हेण च पीनेन सुविस्तीर्णेन वक्षसा । द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां वृत्ताभ्याम् उपशोभितः ॥
