units.english: Then taking up his conch, discus, club and sword, he, along with Satyabhāmā, sat on Garuda's back and immediately started with Sakra. Before the very eyes of the leading Yadus, Keshava, assisted by the powerful Garuda, crossed the seven regions of the wind-gods and rose high up.

units.sanskrit: वारणेन्द्रगतः शक्रो गरुडस्थो जनार्दनः । विदूरस्थौ प्रकाशेते सूर्याचन्द्रमसाव् इव ॥
units.english: Then on account of the distance the king of gods, seated on the elephant chief and Janārddana, seated on Garuda, appeared like the sun and the moon.

units.sanskrit: अथान्तरिक्षे गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिश् च माधवः । समाधायेतिकर्तव्यं वासवो विबुधाधिपः । स्वम् एव भवनं प्रायात् कृष्णः प्राग्ज्योतिषं ययौ ॥
units.english: Thereupon the Gandharvas and Apsaras chanting their glories in the sky they gradually disappeared. Then advising as to what he should do Vāsava, the king of gods, repaired to his own abode and Krishna went to the city of Prāgyotish.

units.sanskrit: ततो भीमरवैर् मेघैर् बभ्रमुर् गगनेचराः । क्षणेन समनुप्राप्तो दिवम् आकाशगेन वै ॥
units.english: At that time struck by the flapping of Garuda's wings the wind blew in a contrary direction and the sky rangers were assailed by clouds of dreadful sound.

units.sanskrit: दूराद् एव च तान् दृष्ट्वा प्रययौ यत्र ते स्थिताः । अपश्यत् पर्वतद्वारि हस्त्यश्वरथवाहनम् । क्षुरान्तान् मौरवान् पाशान् षट्सहस्रान् ददर्श ह ॥
units.english: By the help of that sky-ranging bird Mādhava, in no time, reached his wished-for quarter, and seeing the gate-keepers from distance he went where they were. Arriving at the gate of the mount Mani he saw there elephants, horses, car-warriors and six-thousand nooses sharp like razors.

units.sanskrit: क्रोधाद् रुधिररक्ताक्षो मुरः कालान्तकप्रभः ॥ अभ्यधावत वेगेन शक्तिं गृह्य महासुरः । द्विधाच्छिनत् क्षुरप्रेण वासुदेवः स वीर्यवान् । शक्तिं चिच्छेद तत्रासौ विद्युत्पुञ्ज इव ज्वलन् ॥
units.english: Taking up his Sakti, adorned with diamond and gold, the great Asura Muru, resembling Death himself, ran toward him and hurled that huge weapon at him. Beholding that Sati, like unto a burning fire-brand about to fall Vasudeva took up gold feathered arrows. When the powerful Vāsudeva discharged that arrow burning like a lightning it cut that Sakti into twain.

units.sanskrit: पुनस् तु क्रोधरक्ताक्षो मुरुर् गृह्य महागदाम् । इन्द्राशनिर् इवेन्द्रेण विसृष्ट इव निस्वनः ॥
units.english: When that Sakti was sundered Muru, having his eyes reddened in anger, took up a huge club and discharged it as the king of gods hurls his thunder-bolt.

units.sanskrit: आकर्णमुक्तं चिक्षेप अर्धचन्द्रं सुरोत्तमः । मध्यदेशे तु चिच्छेद गदां तां रुक्मभूषिताम् । पुनश् चिच्छेद भल्लेन दानवस्य शिरो रणे । संछिद्य पाशान् सर्वांस् तान् मुरं हत्वा सहान्वयम् । शिलासंघान् अतिक्रम्य निसुन्दम् अवपोथयत् । ... भगवान् देवकीसुतः । अपश्यद् दानवं सैन्यं ... । हयग्रीवं च दितिजं तथान्यांश् चित्रयोधिनः । रोधयाम् आस तन् मार्गं स्वसैन्येन महाबलः ॥ निसुन्दो बलिनां श्रेष्ठो रथम् आरुह्य सत्वरम् । विव्याध दशभिर् बाणैर् निसुन्दो मधुसूदनम् । केशवश् चापि सप्तत्या विव्याध निशितैः शरैः । अप्राप्तांश् चान्तरिक्षे ताञ् शरांश् चिच्छेद माधवः ॥
units.english: Having drawn his crescent-shaped weapon to his ears Keshava, the foremost of gods, cut off with it, in the middle the golden club. And with a Bhalla he cut off the Dānava’s head -. Having thus slain Muru with his friends and cut off his nooses the Lord, Devaki's son, killed the highly powerful Rākshasa soldiers of Naraka. And crossing the mountain he saw the Dānava host consisting of Nisunda, Diti's son Hayagriva and the other heroes capable of fighting in many ways. Thereupon speedily getting upon his chariot and putting on a strong celestial golden armour, the highly powerful Nisunda, with his arms, obstructed Keshava's path. Thereupon he pierced the slayer of Keshi and Madhu with ten arrows who in return wounded him with seventy winged shafts and cut off the Dānāvā's arrow in the sky before they could approach him.

units.sanskrit: ते सर्वे सैनिकाः कृष्णं समन्तात् पर्यवारयन् । दृष्ट्वा तान् दानवान् सर्वान् सक्रोधो मधुसूदनः । ततो दिव्येन चास्त्रेण पार्जन्येन जनार्दनः । महता शरवर्षेण वारयाम् आस तद् बलम् ॥
units.english: Then his army completely surrounded Keshava. Although covered with the net-work of this arrows Janārddana, the foremost of gods, was highly enraged at seeing those Dānavas and withstood the Dāvnava army with a downpour of cloudy weapons and other arrows -.

units.sanskrit: पञ्चपञ्चशरैस् तेषु एकैकेन च तान् बहून् । पार्जन्यस्य प्रभावेण सर्वान् मर्मस्व् अताडयत् । दुद्रुवुर् भयसंत्रस्ता भग्नास् ते दानवा रणे ॥
units.english: Thereupon assailing all of them with five arrows each he pierced them to the very vitals with cloudy weapons. Filled with fear the Dānava army fled away from the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: स्वसैन्यं विद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा निश्चक्राम पुनर् मृधे । विसृजञ् शरवर्षाणि छादयाम् आस केशवम् ॥
units.english: Beholding his army thus flying away he again came to the battle –. And making a downpour of arrows he covered Keshava.

units.sanskrit: न विभाति रणे सूर्यो नापि व्योम दिशो दश । सावित्रं नाम दिव्यास्त्रं जग्राह पुरुषोत्तमः । तेन बाणेन तान् बाणांश् चिच्छेद समरे हरिः ॥
units.english: Neither the sun, the sky nor the ten quarters were visible. Thereupon taking up a divine weapon, by name Sāvitra, Hari, the foremost of Purushas, cut off his arrows in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: बाणैर् बाणांस् तु संछिद्य तस्य कृष्णो महाबलः । छत्रम् एकेन बाणेन रथेषां च त्रिभिः शरैः । पुनश् चिच्छेद तान् अश्वांश् चतुर्भिश् चतुरः शरैः ॥ सारथिं पञ्चभिर् बाणैर् ध्वजम् एकेन चिच्छिदे । ततः क्रुद्धो हृषीकेशस् तं जघान शिलीमुखैः । यः सहस्रसमास् त्व् एकः सर्वान् देवान् अपोथयत् ॥
units.english: Cutting off the arrows of the Dānavas with his own the highly powerful Krishna sundered his umbrella with one arrow and the pole of his car with three. And again destroying his four horses with four arrows he killed his charioteer with five and cut off his standard with one. Afterwards with a highly sharpened and whetted Bhalla, Krishna, the foremost of gods, cut off Nisunda's head who, alone, in the days of yore, had fought with the gods for a thousand years –.

units.sanskrit: निसुन्दं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हयग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । शिलां प्रगृह्य महतीं तोलयाम् आस दानवः ॥
units.english: Beholding Nisunda thus slain the foremost of Asuras, Hayagriva, effulgent like a mountain, took up a huge rock and vauntingly hurled it with great force.

units.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा दिव्यपार्जन्यम् अस्त्रम् अस्त्रविदां वरः ॥ दिव्यास्त्रेण शिलां विष्णुः सप्तधाकृत तेजसा । यथा देवासुरं युद्धम् अभवद् भरतर्षभ । नानाप्रहरणाकीर्णं तथा घोरम् अवर्तत ॥ ततः शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्तैर् नानावर्णैर् महाशरैः । गरुडस्थो महाबाहुर् निजघान महासुरान् ॥ महालाङ्गलनिर्भिन्नाः शरखङ्गनिपातिताः । विनेशुर् दानवास् तत्र समासाद्य जनार्दनम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon taking up his celestial cloudy weapon and discharging it Vishnu, the foremost of those conversant with the use of weapons, sundered the rock into seven and the stones fell down on earth. foremost of Bharatas, with huge arrows of diverse colors discharged off the Sranga bow there set in a dreadful battle, abounding in various weapons like that between the gods and demons. Thus seated on Garuda the mighty-armed Janārddana began to destroy the demons; what more, all the Dānavas, who approached Nārāyana, were wounded with the huge ploughshare and killed with arrows and swords.

units.sanskrit: केचिच् चक्राग्निनिर्दग्धा दानवाः पेतुर् अम्बरात् । संनिकर्षगताः केचिद् गतासुविकृताननाः ॥
units.english: Some, consumed by the fire of the discus, fell down from the sky, and some, coming near, gave up their ghost with grim-visaged countenance.

units.sanskrit: असृजञ् शरवर्षाणि वृष्टिमन्त इवाम्बुदाः । विकृताङ्गासुराः सर्वे कृष्णबाणप्रपीडिताः ॥
units.english: And although mutilated with the arrows of Krishna, some Asuras, capable of fighting in many ways, began to make a downpour of arrows like unto clouds discharging their watery contents.

units.sanskrit: शोणिताक्ताश् च दृश्यन्ते पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः । व्यद्रवन्त सुवित्रस्ता भग्नास्त्राश् चित्रयोधिनः ॥
units.english: Their persons were besmeared with blood like blossoming Kisgsuka trees and they, with their weapons broken and filled with fright, took to their heels –.

units.sanskrit: पुनश् च क्रोधरक्ताक्षो वायुवेगेन दानवः । दशव्यामोच्छ्रितं वृक्षं समारुह्य वनस्पतिम् । वृक्षम् उत्पाट्य वेगेन प्रतिगृह्याभ्यधावत ॥ चिक्षेप सुमहावृक्षं शिक्षया तु घनाकृतिः । वृक्षवेगानिलोद्धूतः शुश्रुवे सुमहास्वनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon with his eyes red hot in anger the Dānava Hayagriva again, with velocity of the wind, drew a tree ten fathoms high. Uprooting speedily that tree, the cloud-colored Hayagriva ran and hurled it with such a force by virtue of his training, that the huge sound, caused by the tree passing through air, was heard by every body.

units.sanskrit: ततः शरसहस्रेण त्वरमाणो जनार्दनः । नैकधा तं प्रचिच्छेद चित्रभक्तिनिभाकृतिम् ॥ विवेश सो ऽतिवेगेन हृदं भित्त्वा विनिर्गतः । तं जघान महाघोरं हयग्रीवं महासुरम् । अपारतेजा दुर्धर्षः सर्वयादवनन्दनः ॥
units.english: With a thousand arrows, Janārddana speedily and wonderfully cut that tree into many pieces and with one shaft struck Hayagriva on the breast. That arrow, burning like fire, with great force entered into the breast of the Dānava and came out piercing his very vitals –. The dreadful Janārddana, of unlimited prowess, the enhancer of the delight of the Yādavas, killed that highly powerful and irrepressible Hayagriva who alone formerly fought with the gods for one thousand years.

units.sanskrit: मध्ये लोहितगङ्गस्य भगवान् देवकीसुतः । अलकायां विरूपाक्षं पाप्मानं पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ अष्टौ शतसहस्राणि दानवानां परंतपः । अवधीन् नरकं कृष्णः कथं वद तपोधन । तं च पञ्चजनं घोरं नरकस्य महासुरम् ॥
units.english: Having thus slain the grim-visaged and the iniquitous Hayagriva in the province of Lohitanga in a city encircled by walls and killed eight hundred thousand Dānavas Devaki's son, the Lord, the foremost of Pursushas and the slayer of his enemie's, set out for the city of Pragyotish –. Having entered the shining city of Prāgyotish, the highly powerful Keshava, after many encounters, killed Naraka's follower, the great Asura Panchajana, and blew his conch Pānchjanya.

units.sanskrit: शुश्रुवे सुमहाशब्दः संवर्तनिनदो यथा ॥ श्रूयते त्रिषु लोकेषु भीमगम्भीरनिस्वनः । तं श्रुत्वा नरकश् चासीत् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ॥
units.english: That blare, grave as the muttering of clouds and that of the whirlpool, was heard every where all over the three worlds. Hearing that sound the eyes of the heroic Naraka were reddened with anger.

units.sanskrit: लोहचक्राष्टसंयुक्तं त्रिनल्वप्रतिमं रथम् ॥ रत्नकाञ्चनचित्राढ्यं वेदिकाभोगविस्तरम् ॥
units.english: And getting upon his celestial car he shone like the evening sun. It had eight iron wheels, was colored in gold and red paints, had spacious seats, had golden flags and pennons with golden standards.

units.sanskrit: हेमदण्डपताकाढ्यं वैदूर्यमणिकूबरम् ॥ युक्तम् अश्वसहस्रेण रथं पररथारुजम् । लोहजालैश् च संछन्नं चित्रभक्तिविराजितम् ॥
units.english: It had a pole set with diamonds and pearls, was drawn by a thousand horses, was covered with an iron net work, was filled with various weapons and made of gold. And he appeared highly beautiful with his white, and moon-like breast plate.

units.sanskrit: किरीटमूर्धार्कहुताशनाभः । कर्णौ तथा कुण्डलयोर् ज्वलन्तौ ॥
units.english: On his head shone a crown of sun-like lustre and his ears were shining with a pair of Kundalas –.

units.sanskrit: धूम्रवर्णा महाकाया रक्ताक्षा विकृताननाः । नानाकवचिनः सर्वे दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः ॥ खङ्गचर्मधराः केचित् केचित् तूणीरसंवृताः । निर्ययुर् नगराच् छूराः सुसंनद्धाः प्रहारिणः ॥ वृतो दैत्यगणैः सार्धं नरकः कालसंनिभः ॥ भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गानां पणवानां सहस्रशः । वाद्यमानान् स शुश्राव जीमूतनिनदोपमम् ॥
units.english: Putting on diverse sorts of armours, the tawny-coloured, grim-visaged and huge-bodied Daity as Dānavas, and Rākshasas issued out; of them some had swords and shields, some had arrows and quivers, some had Saktis and some had lances. Those well-armed heroes, expert in fighting, rode elephants and horses and issued out of the city shaking the earth. Encircled by Daityas Naraka, like unto Death him self, while proceeding, heard on all sides the sound of thousands of bugles, conchs, Mridangas and trumpets resembling the muttering of clouds -.

units.sanskrit: यतः कृष्णस् ततो गत्वा सर्वे ते विकृताननाः । महता छादयाम् आसुः शरवर्षेण सैनिकाः ॥ आकाशं छादयाम् आसुर् विमुञ्चन्तः सहस्रशः ॥ कृष्णः कृष्णाम्बुदाकारः शार्ङ्गं गृह्य धनुस् ततः । विस्फार्य सुमहच्चापं धनुर् जलदनिस्वनम् ॥ व्यसृजच् छरवर्षाणि दानवानां जनार्दनः । शरवर्षेण तत् सैन्यं व्यद्रवत् तु महाहवात् ॥
units.english: Those grim-visaged heroes unitedly went, where Krishna was waiting and began to fight with him. Those soldiers covered Vāsudeva with a down-pour of arrows -. Discharging thousands of Saktis, maces, lances and arrows they covered the welkin. Moving his Srānga bow, the twang whereof was like the muttering of a cloud, hither and thither, Janārddana, looking like a dark-blue cloud, began to make a down-pour of arrows on the Dānavas. And with it their highly powerful soldiers were greatly assailed.

units.sanskrit: तद् युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं घोररूपेण रक्षसा ॥ भग्नव्यूहाश् च ते सर्वे कृष्णबाणप्रपीडिताः । केचिच् छिन्नभुजाश् चैव च्छिन्नग्रीवा शिराननाः । केचिच् चक्रद्विधाच्छिन्नाः केचिद् बाणार्दितोरसः ॥
units.english: Thus there took place a dreadful encounter between him and the fierce-looking Rakshasas; and wounded by Krishna's arrows the Dānavas were routed -. Some of the Dānavas had their arms broken and some were wounded on the head and neck; some were cut in twain by the discus and some were wounded on the breast with arrows.

units.sanskrit: केचित् कौमोदकीभिन्नाः केचिच् चक्रविदारिताः ॥
units.english: Of the car-warriors, elephant-riders and cavalry some were cut into two pieces and some were wounded with arrows and lances.

units.sanskrit: एवं विपोथिता सर्वा गजाश्वरथवाहिनी । तत्रासीन् नरकेणास्य युद्धं परमदारुणम् । यत् समासेन वक्ष्यामि तन् मे निगदतः शृणु ॥ त्रासनः सुरसंघानां नरकः पुरुषोत्तमम् । योधयाम् आस तेजस्वी मधुवन्मधुसूदनम् ॥
units.english: Thus the entire army, consisting of elephants, horses, and cars, was completely crushed down. There took place a highly dreadful encounter in that battle between him and Naraka. Listen to it, shall describe it briefly. The energetic Naraka, the terror of gods, fought with the foremost of Purushas, Madhusudana, like Madhu himself.

units.sanskrit: जग्राह कार्मुकं वीरः शक्रचापम् इवोच्छ्रितम् ॥ तथार्ककिरणप्रख्यं बाणं जग्राह केशवः । दिव्येनास्त्रेण समरे पूरयाम् आस तं रथम् ॥
units.english: When in that battle, the heroic Naraka, like unto Death himself, took up with reddened eyes, a huge bow resembling that of Sakra, Keshava, taking up an arrow like the fierce ray of the sun, filled his car with celestial weapons.

units.sanskrit: उत्तमास्त्रं महापातं मुमोच नरको बली ॥ वज्रविस्फूर्जिताकारम् आयान्तं वीक्ष्य केशवः । चिच्छेदास्त्रं महाभागश् चक्रेण पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ व्यहनत् सारथिं चास्य शरैकेण जरार्दनः । सरथं सध्वजं साश्वं जघान दशभिः शरैः ॥ तनुत्रं चैव चिच्छेद शरेण मधुसूदनः । ततो विमुक्तकवचः सर्पस्येव तनुर् यथा ॥ हताश्वो विरथो वीरो वितनुत्रश् च दानवः । जग्राह विमलज्वालं लोहभारार्पितं दृढम् । द्विधा छिन्नं क्षुरप्रेण कृष्णेनाद्भुतकर्मणा । तद् युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं घोररूपेण रक्षसा । शस्त्रपातमहाघातं नरकेण महात्मना । मुहूर्तं योधयाम् आस नरकं मधुसूदनः । अथोग्रचक्रश् चक्रेण प्रदीप्तेनाकरोद् द्विधा ॥ चक्रद्विधाकृतं तस्य शरीरम् अपतद् भुवि । कृष्णम् आसाद्य देवेशं जगामास्तम् इवांशुमान् ॥
units.english: Thereupon when taking up a huge weapon the powerful Naraka was about to withstand the great and war-like slayer of Madhu Janārddana, having a countenance effulgent like lightning, he cut off that weapon with his discus and sent his charioteer to the abode of Death with one arrow. Then destroying the car with horses and standards with ten arrows the slayer of Madhu cut his coat of mail with one arrow. Thereupon having his horses slain, and stripped of his coat of mail like a serpent shorn of its skin, the heroic Dānava Naraka, all on a sudden, took up a strong iron dart effulgent like a lightning and sent it down whirling. Seeing that dart covered with gold, about to fall down, Krishna, of wonderful deeds, cut it off into two pieces with his razor-shaped weapon. Thus there went on a dreadful encounter with that highly powerful and grim-visaged Rākshasa Naraka, abounding in most excellent weapons. Fighting with Naraka for a moment the dreadful Janārddana cut him into two pieces with his effulgent discus. His body, sundered into twain with the discus, fell on earth like a mountain summit clapped by a thunder-bolt. It appeared that the sun was enshrouded by Krishna-like black clouds —.

units.sanskrit: चक्रोत्क्षिप्तनिकृत्ताङ्गम् उत्तमं पतितं रणे । वज्रेणेव विनिर्भिन्नं यथा गैरिकपर्वतम् । भूमिस् तु पतितं पुत्रं निरीक्ष्यादाय कुण्डले । उपातिष्ठत गोविन्दं वचनं चेदम् अब्रवीत् ॥ दत्तस् त्वयैव गोविन्द त्वयैव विनिपातितः । इमे ते कुण्डले देव प्रजास् तस्यानुपालय ॥
units.english: Naraka's head, cut off by the discus, appeared on the battle-field like unto a mountain of minerals clapped by a thunderbolt. Beholding his son slain, Bhumi came with the pair of Kundalas to Govinda and said Govinda, thou dost sport as a boy plays with his toys. Thou hast with thy own hand killed him whom thou didst give. Lord, however, do thou accept these Kundalas for which thou hast slain Naraka, and protect his children -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच निहत्य नरकं भौमं वासवोपमविक्रमः । वासवावरजो विष्णुर् ददर्श नरकालयम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having slain Bhumi's son Naraka powerful like Vāsava, Vishnu, the younger brother of Indra began to search his house.

units.sanskrit: ददर्श धनम् अक्षय्यं रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥ मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानि वैदूर्यस्य च संचयान् । महारजतकूटानि तथा वज्रस्य संचयान् ॥ जाम्बूनदमयान्य् अत्र शातकुम्भमयानि च । प्रदीप्तज्वलनाभानि च शीतरश्मिप्रभाणि च । जातरूपस्य शुभ्रस्य धाराः शतसहस्रशः । वरुणाद् आहृतं पूर्वं नरकेणेति नः श्रुतम् ॥ यादृशं तु गृहे दृष्टं नरकस्य धनं बहु । हते भौमे निसुन्दे च हयग्रीवे च दानवे । उपनिन्युस् ततस् तानि रत्नान्य् अन्तःपुराणि च ॥ दानवा हतशिष्टा ये कोशसंचयरक्षिणः । रुचिराभिः पताकाभिर् वसाना विविधाः कुथाः ॥ ते च विंशतिसाहस्रा द्विस्तावत्यः करेणवः । अष्टौ शतसहस्राणि देशजाश् चोत्तमा हयाः ॥ गोषु चापि कृतो यावत् कामस् तव जनार्दनः । तावतीः प्रापयिष्यामो वृष्ण्यन्धकनिवेशनम् ॥
units.english: Having arrived at the Treasury of Naraka, Janārddana saw there, diamonds, pearls, corals, sapphires, emeralds, and various other jems, gold, heaps of jewels and other precious articles, a highly costly bed shining like the moon, a lion-shaped throne effulgent like burning fire, and a huge and beautiful umbrella of the hue of the clouds of the rainy season, of the lustre of the moon and with a golden standard. Janamejaya, have heard that there was also the golden fountain of hundreds and thousands of streams, which he had brought from Varuna; what more, we had never seen or heard of even in the palaces of Kuvera, Yama and Indra, the collection of jewels that was in Naraka's treasury. Bhumi’s son Naraka, Nisunda and Hayagriva being slain, the surving warders of his Treasury took to Keshava those costly jems and the damsels of the seraglio, considering them as worthy of him -. The Daityas said:— Janārddana, all these various jems and riches, these goods made of corals, these beautiful flags set with golden threads, these twenty thousand grim-visaged elephants carrying bows, Tomaras and other weapons such-like forty-thousand she-elephants, and eight lacs of horses of most excellent breed have been brought to thee. And we will take to the houses of the Andhakas and Vrishnis as many kine as thou shalt desire to have.

units.sanskrit: कामव्याहारिणश् चैव पक्षिणः प्रियदर्शनाः ॥ चन्दनागरुकाष्ठानि तथा कालीयकान्य् अपि । वसु यत् त्रिषु लोकेषु धर्मेणाधिगतं त्वया । देवगन्धर्वरत्नानि पन्नगानां च यद् वसु । तानि सन्तीह सर्वाणि नरकस्य निवेशने ॥
units.english: Lord, we will despatch to the houses of the Yādavas, bed-steads of fine workmanship, seals, beautiful birds, sandal and Aguru woods and other jems both in mountains or collected from the three worlds that are in Naraka's palace. There are now in Naraka's houses all the riches and jems that were formerly in the possession of the gods, Gandharvas and Pannagas -.

units.sanskrit: स तत् सर्वं हृषीकेशः प्रतिगृह्य परीक्ष्य च । सर्वम् आहारयामास दानवैर् द्वारकां पुरीम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having accepted all those jewels and examined them, Hrishikesha, the slayer of Madhu, sent them all speedily to Dwāravati through the Danavas.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तद् वारुणं छत्रं स्वयम् उत्क्षिप्य माधवः । हिरण्यवर्षं वर्षन्तम् आरुरोह विहंगतम् ॥ तत्र वैदूर्यवर्णानि ददर्श मधुसूदनः । सतोरणपताकानि द्वाराणि शयनानि च ॥
units.english: Taking himself the Varuni umbrella capable of showering gold, he rode Garuda that foremost of birds, the very personification of a cloud, and set out for the foremost of mountains Mani –. Janārddana saw there on the mount Mani, gates, summits of sapphire decorated with flags and doors.

units.sanskrit: विद्युद्ग्रथितमेघाभः प्रबभौ मणिपर्वतः । हेमचित्रविमानैश् च प्रासादैर् उपशोभितः ॥
units.english: At that time adorned with rows of palaces painted in golden colours, the entire mount Mani shone like a cloud adorned with lightings.

units.sanskrit: तत्र ता वरहेमाभा ददर्श मधुसूदनः । गन्धर्वासुरमुख्यानां प्रिया दुहितरस् तथा ॥
units.english: Madhusudana saw there the pure, gold-coloured and plump-hipped daughters of the Gandharvas and leading Asuras whom Naraka had carried away by force and confined there.

units.sanskrit: त्रिविष्टपसमे देशे तिष्ठन्तम् अपराजितम् । निवसन्त्यो यथा देव्यः सुखिन्यः कामवर्जिताः ॥
units.english: Although deprived of all sorts of enjoyments, still residing there as if in the city of the celestials, they lived happily like celestial damsels.

units.sanskrit: सर्वाः काषायवासिन्यः सर्वाश् च नियतेन्द्रियाः ॥
units.english: And nobody, on account of Naraka's powers, could take them away -.

units.sanskrit: व्रतोपवासतन्वङ्ग्यः काङ्क्षन्त्यः कृष्णदर्शनम् । समेत्य यदुसिंहस्य सर्वाश् चक्रुः स्त्रियो ऽञ्जलीन् ॥
units.english: In order to behold the large-armed Krishna, the foremost of Yadus, the damsels, controlling their senses, emaciated on account of the observance of vows and fastings, clad in silken raiments and with one braid of hairs approached Janarddana with folded hands and stood encircling him.

units.sanskrit: नरकं निहतं ज्ञात्वा मुरं चैव महासुरम् । हयग्रीवं निसुन्दं च ताः कृष्णं पर्यवारयन् ॥ कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे प्रणिपेतुर् वयोधिकाः ॥ तासां परमनारीणाम् ऋषभाक्षं निरीक्ष्य तम् । सर्वासाम् एव संकल्पः पतित्वेनाभवत् ततः ॥ संप्रहृष्टा महाबाहुम् इदं वचनम् अब्रुवन् ॥ सत्यं बत पुरा वायुर् इहास्मान् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । सर्वभूतरुतज्ञश् च देवर्षिर् अपि नारदः ॥
units.english: They fearlessly surrounded Krishna because they had learnt of the death of the great Asuras Naraka, Mura, Hayagriva and Nisunda. The elderly Mānavas who were their guards, although more aged, bowed to Krishna, the descendant of Yadu, with folded hands. Beholding the moon-like countenance of the large-armed Krishna, those beautiful damsels were all worked up with desire and wished to select him as their husband. And they accordingly with joyous hearts said:—–. What the celestial saint Nārada, knowing the hearts of all creatures, and the Wind-god had said to us before, is all true.

units.sanskrit: विष्णुर् नारायणो देवः शङ्खचक्रगदासिभृत् । स भौमं नरकं हत्वा भर्ता च भविता हि सः ॥
units.english: They said that the Universal Lord Nārāyana, the holder of conch, discus and club, slaying Bhumi's son Naraka, would in no time become our husband.

units.sanskrit: सुप्रियं बत पश्यामश् चिरश्रुतम् अरिंदमम् । दर्शनेन कृतार्था हि वयम् अद्य महात्मनः ॥
units.english: We behold now our beloved lord, the slayer of his enemies of whom we have been hearing for ever. Oh! we have been blessed to-day by seeing this high-souled deity –.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ताः सान्त्वयामास प्रमदा वासवानुजः । सर्वाः कमलपत्राक्षीर् दृष्ट्या वाचा च माधवः ॥ यथार्हतः सान्त्वयित्वा समाभाष्य च केशवः । यानैः किंकरसंयुक्तैर् उवाह मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon having delightedly welcomed those lotus eyed damsels Vāsav's younger brother consoled them all. Having welcomed those ladies duly the lotus-eyed Keshava, the slayer of Madhu took them all to Dwāraka in a car protected by servants –.

units.sanskrit: शिबिकां वहतां तत्र निर्घोषः सुमहान् अभूत् ॥
units.english: Then there arose a great tumult of the Rākshas quick-coursing like air, while carrying the vehicle.

units.sanskrit: तस्य पर्वतमुख्यस्य शृङ्गं यत् परमार्चितम् । विमलार्केन्दुसंकाशं मणिकाञ्चनतोरणम् ॥ सपक्षिगणमातङ्गं सव्यालमृगपन्नगम् । शाखामृगगणैर् जुष्टं सुप्रस्तरशिलातलम् ॥
units.english: Uprooting the most charming and brilliant summit of that best of mountains, Vishnu the foremost of the strong rode that best of birds Garuda. It was like the clear sun and the moon, had gates made of jewels and gold, abounded in birds, deer, various animals and elephants, was beautified with trees and filled with monkeys. It had spacious rocks, boars, buffaloes and antelopes.

units.sanskrit: सप्रपातमहासानुं विचित्रशिखरद्रुमम् ॥ अत्यद्भुतम् अचिन्त्यं च मृगवृन्दविलोडितम् । आरोपयामास तदा गरुडे पक्षिणां वरे ॥
units.english: Its table-land was filled with springs and it had various sorts of trees. Many beasts and peacocks were roving there and it was wonderful above all comprehension –. Garuda the king of birds easily carried Janarddana with his wife and the mount Meru.

units.sanskrit: स पक्षबलविक्षेपैर् महाद्रिशिखरोपमः । दिक्षु सर्वासु संह्रादं जनयामास पक्षिराट् ॥
units.english: With the flapping of his strong wings, that king of birds, huge like a big mountain summit, raised up a tumultuous sound on all sides.

units.sanskrit: आरुजन् पर्वताग्राणि पादपांश् च समाक्षिपन् । संजहार महाभ्राणि विजहार च कानिचित् ॥
units.english: By the weight of his feet the mountain tops were all broken down, the trees were uprooted, huge clouds were dispersed and some of them assumed a wonderful form.

units.sanskrit: विषयं समतिक्रम्य देवयोश् चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । ययौ वातजवः पक्षी जनार्दनवशे स्थितः ॥
units.english: In this way, as desired by Janarddana that bird, fleet like the wind, went beyond the paths of the sun and the moon.

units.sanskrit: स मेरुगिरिम् आसाद्य देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् । देवसद्मानि सर्वाणि ददर्श मधुसूदनः ॥ विश्वेषां मरुतां चैव साध्यानां च नराधिप । शक्रसद्म समासाद्य प्रविवेश जनार्दनः ॥ प्रदाय कुण्डले दिव्ये ववन्दे तं तदाच्युतः । सभार्यो विबुधश्रेष्ठं नरश्रेष्ठो जनार्दनः ॥ सो ऽर्चितो देवराजेन रत्नैश् च प्रतिपूजितः । इदं प्रोवाच पौलोमी सत्यभामां हरिप्रियाम् । इत्य् उक्ता सा तदा देवी कृतम् इत्य् अब्रवीच् च ताम् । वासवो वासुदेवश् च सहितौ जग्मतुस् ततः । तत्रादितिम् उपास्यन्तीम् अप्सरोभिः समन्ततः । ददृशाते महात्मानौ महाभागां तपोन्विताम् ॥
units.english: And then crossing the shining babitations of the Viswadevas, Sadhyas, Maruts, the two Aswins and other auspicious regions, he arrived at the land of gods, and entered into the palace of their king. Coming down from Garuda's back, Madhava there met the king of gods. And Indra too welcomed him with great delight. Giving to the king of gods the pair of ear-rings belonging to Aditi and saluting him, Janarddana, the foremost of men, along with his wife, was welcomed by him in return. Puloma's daughter duly received Satyabhāmā -. Thereupon Vasava and Vasudeva together with their wives repaired to the prosperous abode of Aditi, the mother of celestials. Arriving there, those two great gods saw the Asuras, seated all around worshipping the great Aditi engaged in Tapas -.

units.sanskrit: प्रदायादितिनन्दनः । ववन्दे तां शचीभर्ता मातरं स्वां पुरंदरः । अदितिस् तौ सुतौ प्रीत्या परिष्वज्याभिनन्द्य च । आशिर्भिर् अनुरूपाभिर् उभाव् अभ्यवदत् तदा ॥ अगृह्णीतां वरार्हाया देव्याश् च चरणौ शुभौ ॥
units.english: Placing Janārddana before him, Aditi’s son and Sachi's lord Purandara approached his mother, saluted her, gave her over the pair of ear-rings and narrated the glorious deeds of Keshava. Hearing them, Aditi was pleased and took up her two sons on her lap. And welcoming them with auspicious blessings, she honoured them.

units.sanskrit: ते चाप्य् अभ्यवदत् प्रेम्णा देवमाता यशस्विनी । यथावद् अब्रवीच् चैव जनार्दनम् इदं वचः ॥ अधृस्यः सर्वभूतानाम् अवध्यश् च भविष्यसि । यथैव देवराजो ऽयम् अजितो लोकपूजितः ॥
units.english: Thereafter Puloma's daughter and Satyabhama with great delight saluted the feet of the goddess Aditi with veneration; welcoming them duly with affection, the illustrious mother of the gods said to Keshava:—My son, as this king of gods is worshipful to all the worlds, so you are unslayable by all creatures.

units.sanskrit: तव चेयं वरारोहा नित्यं च प्रियदर्शना । सर्वलोकेषु विख्याता दिव्यगन्धा मनोरमा । तत्पुरोगमदेवानाम् अधिपस् त्वं भविष्यसि । जरां न यास्यति वधूर् यावत् त्वं कृष्ण मानुषः ॥
units.english: This most excellent of all your wives, this beautiful and pleasant looking Satyabhāma celebrated in all the worlds, will be ever youthful and lucky. And from her person she will emit charming and celestial fragrance. Krishna, as long as you will be in your human form, this your wife will not be visited by decrepitude.

units.sanskrit: एवम् अभ्यार्चितः कृष्णो देवमात्रा महाबलः । देवराजाभ्यनुज्ञातो रत्नैश् च प्रतिपूजितः ॥ वैनतेयं समारुह्य सहितः सत्यभामया । देवाक्रीडान् परिक्रामन् पूज्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः ॥
units.english: Thus honored by the mother of gods, the highly powerful Krishna was honored by Vāsava with various jewels. Thereupon obtaining the permission of the king of gods, riding Vinata's son with Satyabhamā and worshipped by the entire host of the celestials, he began to range in the celestial gardens.

units.sanskrit: स ददर्श महाबाहुर् आक्रीडे वासवस्य ह । दिव्यम् अभ्यर्चितं चैत्यं पारिजातं महाद्रुमम् ॥ नित्यपुष्पधरं दिव्यं पुण्यगन्धम् अनुत्तमम् । यम् आसाद्य जनः सर्वो जातिं स्मरति पौर्विकीम् ॥ संरक्ष्यमाणं देवैस् तं प्रसह्यामितविक्रमः । उत्पाट्यारोपयामास विष्णुस् तं वै महाद्रुमम् ॥ ततः प्रायाद् द्वारवतीं वायुजुष्टेन वै पथा ॥
units.english: While crossing the garden of Vasava the mighty-armed Keshava saw the most excellent, sacred and celestial huge tree Pārijata always emitting holy fragrance and daily blossoming, approaching which every one regains the recollection of his pristine birth. Although gods were kept there in charge of the tree, Krishna of unlimited powers, forcibly up-rooted it and placed it on Garuda's head. Thereupon viewing the Apsaras, Upendra and Satyabhāma proceeded towards Dwarka by the ethereal way. The celestial damsels from behind saw Satyabhāma -.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद् देवराजस् तु कर्म कृष्णस्य वै तदा । अनुमेने महाबाहुः कृतं कर्मेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Hearing of this deed of Krishna the mighty-armed king of gods did not express his disapproval but rather said Krishna is never successful.

units.sanskrit: स पूज्यमानस् त्रिदशैर् महर्षिगणसंस्तुतः । प्रतस्थे द्वारकां कृष्णो देवलोकाद् अरिंदमः ॥
units.english: Thus adored by the celestials and hymned by the seven saints, the mighty-armed Krishna the slayer of his enemies, set out for Dwarka from the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभिपत्य महाबाहुर् दीर्घम् अध्वानम् अल्पवत् । आससाद महाबाहुः पुरीं द्वारवतीं तदा । पूजितो देवराजेन ददृशे यादवीं पुरीम् ॥
units.english: Wending the long distance like a short one, he espied the city of the Yadavas. Having performed that great feat Vāsava's younger brother the Lord Krishna, riding Garuda, returned to Dwāraka -.

units.sanskrit: दावाग्निज्वलितप्रख्यैर् निर्मितैर् विश्वकर्मणा । आलिखद्भिर् इवाकाशम् अतिचन्द्रार्कभास्वरैः ॥ तैर् दाशार्हैर् महाभागैर् बभासे भवनह्रदैः । वासुदेवेन्द्रपर्जन्यैर् गृहमेघैर् अलंकृता ॥ ददृशे द्वारका चारु मेघैर् द्यौर् इव संवृता । साक्षाद् भगवतो वेश्म विहितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ ददृशे वासुदेवस्य चतुर्योजनम् आयतम् । तावद् एव च विस्तीर्णम् अप्रमेयं महाधनैः ॥ प्रासादवरसंपन्नैर् युक्तं जगति पर्वतैः । यश् चकार महाभागस् त्वष्टा वासवचोदितः ॥
units.english: Viswakarmā had laid out seven high roads for the arrangement of soldiers –. The turrets of those palaces were adorned with flags, leaves and trees. The city was embellished with forest trees and the noble Dāshārhas. The city of Dwārakā, adorned with cloud-like houses and the gods Vāsudeva and Indra, looked like the welkin stricken with variegated clouds. The house, built by Vishwakarma for the Divine Vāsudeva, was four yojanas in length and the same in breadth. The house of the incomparable and the greatly rich Vāsudeva was adorned with palaces and false mountains. The great Vishwakarmā built that house under Vasava's orders -.

units.sanskrit: मेरोर् इव गिरेः शृङ्गम् उच्छ्रितं काञ्चनं महत् । रुक्मिण्याः प्रवरं वासं विहितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ विचित्रमणिसोपानं तद् विदुर् भोगवान् इति । विमलादित्यवर्णाभिः पताकाभिर् अलंकृतम् ॥ स च प्रासादमुख्यो यो जाम्बवत्या विभूषितः । प्रभयाभ्यभवत् सर्वांस् तान् अन्यान् भास्करो यथा ॥
units.english: Vishwakarmā made a highly beautiful golden palace huge like the highest summit of the mount Sumeru for Rukshmini. It was named Kānchana. Satyabhāmā had a yellow-coloured house adorned with flags effulgent like the clear sun and having stairs set with jewels. That well-furnished and best of palaces, which had huge flags all around it, and which used to put on a new appearance every moment, was built for Jāmvavati.

units.sanskrit: उद्यद्भास्करवर्णाभस् तयोर् अन्तरमाश्रितः । विश्वकर्मकृतो दिव्यः कैलासशिखरोपमः ॥
units.english: Vishwakarmā built another palace by the name of Meru, which was effulgent like burning fire and gold, and huge like the summit of the mount Kailāsha and the ocean.

units.sanskrit: गान्धारी भरतश्रेष्ठ केशवेन निवेशिता ॥
units.english: Keshava accomodated the accomplished daughter of the king of Gāndhāra in that house -.

units.sanskrit: पद्मकूटम् इति ख्यातं पद्म्वर्णं महाप्रभम् । सुभीमाया महाकूटं वासं सुपरमार्चितम् ॥
units.english: For Bhaima was built a house by the name of Padmakula. It was of the hue of a lotus, highly effulgent and had a high and picturesque turret.

units.sanskrit: सूर्यप्रभस् तु प्रासादः सर्वकामगुणैर् युतः । लक्ष्मणायाः कुरुश्रेष्ठ निर्दिष्टः शार्ङ्गधन्वना ॥
units.english: foremost of kings, Keshava, the holder of Shrānga bow, had for Lakshmanā built a house by name, Suryaprabhā in which were available all objects of desire -.

units.sanskrit: वैदूर्यमणिवर्णाभः प्रासादो हरितप्रभः । यं विदुः सर्वभूतानि परम् इत्य् एव भारत ॥ वासं तं मित्रविन्दाया देवर्षिगणपूजितम् । सुदत्ताया निवासं तं प्रशस्तं सर्वदैवतैः । महिष्या वासुदेवस्य केतुमान् इति विश्रुतः ॥ योजनायतविष्कम्भः सर्वरत्नमयः शुभः ॥ स श्रीमान् विरजो नाम व्यराजत् तत्र सुप्रभः । उपस्थानगृहं यत्र केशवस्य महात्मनः ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, the green palace, the effulgence of which imitated the lustre of Vaidurya and which was known all over the world by the name of Para, that ornament of palaces where the great Rishis used to resort, was set apart for Vāsudeva's queen Mitravindā -. That best of palaces, built by Viswakarmā like a mountain, which was spoken high of even by the gods and which was celebrated by the name of Ketumān, was intended for Keshava's queen Suvārtā -. Amongst those palaces, the most beautiful and lustrous, by name Virajā, which the celestial Architect Viswakarmā built with his own hands, and which extended over a Yojana and contained jems of every description, was the court of the high-souled Keshava.

units.sanskrit: सदने वासुदेवस्य मार्गसंजवनध्वजाः । रत्नजालानि तत्रैव तत्र तत्र निवेशिताः ॥
units.english: In that palace of Vasudeva's were placed flags with golden standards and pennons marking the roads.

units.sanskrit: आहृत्य यदुसिंहेन वैजयन्तो ऽचलो महान् । हंसकूटस्य यच्छृङ्गम् इन्द्रद्युम्नसरः प्रति । षष्टितालसमुत्सेधम् अर्धयोजनम् आयतम् ॥ सकिंनरमहानागं तद् अप्य् अमिततेजसा । पश्यतां सर्वभूतानाम् आनीतं लोकविश्रुतम् ॥
units.english: Keshava, the foremost of the Yadu race, had brought there the great mountain Vaijayanta and diverse other celestial jewels -. The highly powerful Viswakarmā, with the help of the Kinnaras and the great Nāgas, had brought and placed there, before the very eyes of the creatures, the well-known summit of the mount Hansakuta near the lake Indra dyumna which was sixty Tālas high and extended over half a Yojana.

units.sanskrit: जाम्बूनदमयं दिव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । तद् अप्य् उत्पाट्य कृष्णार्थम् आनीतं विश्वकर्मणा ॥
units.english: Viswakarmā had uprooted and brought for Krishna the golden chariot of Sumeru lying in the path of the sun and the most excellent golden summit with hundreds of lotuses known all over the three worlds –.

units.sanskrit: भ्राजमानम् अतीवोग्रं सर्वौषधिविभूषितम् । तद् इन्द्रवचनात् त्वष्टा आनयत् कार्यहेतुना । पारिजातस् तु तत्रैव केशवेनाहृतः स्वयम् ॥
units.english: In compliance with Indra's request and in the interest of a great work Twastā had brought that highly beautiful summit containing all sorts of herbs. Keshava himself had carried away the Pārijāta tree and kept it in Dwaraka.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णस्य यो ऽभ्यरक्षंस् तं देवाः पादपम् उत्तमम् । पुण्डरीकशतैर् जुष्टं विमानैश् च हिरण्मयैः ॥ विहिता वासुदेवार्थं ब्रह्मस्थलमहाद्रुमाः । पद्माकुलजलोपेता रत्नसौगन्धिकोत्पलाः । सालास् तालाः कदम्बाश् च शतशाखाश् च रोहिणाः ॥
units.english: While bringing it Krishna, of wonderful deeds, had to fight with the gods guarding that tree, Rafts made of gold and jems, lotuses and fragrant jewelled lotuses used to float on the water of the lakes and tanks which were dug for Krishna and adorned with trees covered with jewelled flowers and fruits and hundreds of golden lotuses. The huge Shāla, Tāla and Kadamva trees, with hundreds of branches, beautified the picturesque bank of those lakes.

units.sanskrit: ये च हैमवता वृक्षा ये च मेरुरुहास् तथा । आहृत्य यदुसिंहार्थं विहिता विश्वकर्मणा ॥
units.english: Vishwakarmā, for Krishna, the best of the Yadu race, had brought and planted at Dwārakā all the trees that grow on the mountains Sumeru and Himalaya.

units.sanskrit: रक्तपीतारुणप्रख्याः श्वेतपुष्पाश् च पादपाः । सर्वर्तुफलसंपन्नास् तेषु काननसंधिषु ॥
units.english: At all the boundary lines of the gardens were planted trees that yeild fruits in all the seasons and those crested with white, yellow, red, green and pink flowers.

units.sanskrit: समाकुलजलोपेताः पीतशर्करवालुकाः । तस्मिन् पुरवरे नद्यः प्रसन्नसलिला ह्रदाः ॥
units.english: The edges and water of the delightful streams and lakes, which were in that best of cities, was on the same level. And the sandal there was like green sugar.

units.sanskrit: पुष्पाकुलजलोपेता नानाद्रुमलताकुलाः । अपराश् चाभवन् नद्यो हेमशर्करवालुकाः ॥
units.english: In some of the rivers flowers used to float always; their banks were adorned with various trees and creepers and the sand was of the colour of golden sugar.

units.sanskrit: मत्तबर्हिणसंघैश् च कोकिलैश् च सदामदैः । तत्रैव गजयूथानि पुरे गोमहिषास् तथा । निवासश् च कृतस् तत्र वराहमृगपक्षिणाम् ॥ तेन ते च महाशैलाः सरितश् च सरांसि च । परिक्षिप्तानि भौमेन वनान्य् उपवनानि च ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच एवम् आलोकयाम् आस द्वारकां वृषभेक्षणः । अपश्यत् स्वगृहं कृष्णः प्रासादशतशोभितम् ॥
units.english: The trees of the city, resorted to by maddened peacocks and coels, used to look highly beautiful. The herds of elephants, cows, buffaloes, boars, deer and birds used to live happily in that city. In this way Vishwakarmā had made in that beautiful city high golden palaces with hundreds of turrets, huge mountains, rivers, lakes, forests and gardens -. Vaishampāyana said:—Thus looking at Dwāraka, Krishna, of most excellent eyes, saw his own house consisting of hundreds of palaces.

units.sanskrit: तोरणैर् ज्वलनप्रख्यैर् मणिविद्रुमराजतैः । तत्र तत्र प्रभासद्भिश् चित्रकाञ्चनवेदिकैः ॥
units.english: He saw there a million of white jewelled pillars, a gate with jems lustrous like fire and a number of effulgent golden seats placed here and there.

units.sanskrit: प्रासादस् तत्र सुमहान् कृष्णोपस्थानिको ऽभवत् । पद्माकुलजलोपेता रक्तसौगन्धिकोत्पलाः । मणिहेमनिभाश् चित्रा रत्नसोपानभूषिताः ॥ मत्तबर्हिणसंघैश् च कोकिलैश् च सदामदैः । तद् गृहं वृष्णिसिंहस्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा । महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमं समन्ताद् अर्धयोजनम् ॥
units.english: For his court a huge palace had been made entirely of gold with crystal pillars. He also saw beautiful and big lakes, with its water full of lotuses and fragrant red lotuses resorted to by maddened peacocks and coels, with golden and jewelled stairs and adorned with various other trees. That house was encircled by Viswakarma with stone walls hundred yards high which were girt with ditches. After the measurement of Indra's palace the celestial Architect had built that house on a plot of land measuring half a yojana on all sides.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तं पाण्डुरं शौरिर् मूर्ध्नि तिष्ठन् गरुत्मतः । तस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन सागरश् चुक्षुभे भृशम् । ररास च नभः कृत्स्नं तच् चित्रम् अभचत् तदा ॥ पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं संश्रुत्य कुकुरान्धकाः । विशोकाः समपद्यन्त गरुडस्य च दर्शनात् ॥ शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं गरुडस्योपरि स्थितम् । दृष्ट्वा जहृषिरे भौमा भास्करोपमतेजसम् ॥ ततस् तूर्यप्रणादश् च भेरीणां च महास्वनः । ततः सर्वे दशार्हाश् च सर्वे च कुकुरान्धकाः । प्रीयमाणाः समाजग्मुर् आलोक्य मधुसूदनम् ॥
units.english: Seated on Garuda's back she saw that sable-hued palace -. He then blew his conch the sound of which made the hairs of his enemies stand erect. At that sound the ocean was greatly agitated and the sky resounded. Hearing the sound of Panchajanya conch-shell and seeing Garuda all the members of the Kukura and Andhaka families were freed from sorrow. Beholding Keshava effulgent like the sun, with conch-shell, discus, and club in his hands, seated on Garuda, the citizens attained to an excess of joy. Thereupon they began to beat trumpets, blew bugles and set up leonine shouts. Afterwards beholding the slayer of Madhu the Kukuras, Andhakas and other Dāsharhas began to approach him with great delight -.

units.sanskrit: वसुदेवं पुरस्कृत्य भेरीशङ्खरवैः सह । उग्रसेनो ययौ राजा वासुदेवनिवेशनम् ॥
units.english: Placing Vasudeva before him and accompanied with the sound of conch-shells and trumpets, the king Ugrasenā repaired to Vāsudeva's palace.

units.sanskrit: अनन्दिनी पर्यचरत् स्वेषु वेश्मसु देवकी । रोहिणी च यथोद्देशम् आहुकस्य च याः स्त्रियः ॥
units.english: Devaki, Rohini and Ahuka's wives began to move about with joy in their own houses. few moments after, Hari whom serve Indra and other gods, arrived at the appointed house -.

units.sanskrit: अवतीर्य गृहद्वारि कृष्णस् तु यदुनन्दनः । यथार्हं पूजयाम् आस यादवान् यादवर्षभः ॥
units.english: Having got down at the entrance of his house, Krishna, the foremost of the Yadu race, showed proper respect to all the Yadus.

units.sanskrit: रामाहुकगदाक्रूर प्रद्युम्नादिभिर् अर्चितः । प्रविवेश गृहं शौरिर् आदाय मणिपर्वतम् ॥
units.english: And himself honored by Rāma, Ahuka, Gada, Pradyumna and others he entered into his residence with the mountain of jewels -.

units.sanskrit: प्रवेशयाम् आस गृहं प्रद्युम्नो रुक्मिणीसुतः ॥
units.english: Rukshmini's son Pradyumna himself took to the house the Pārijāta the most favourite of Indra's trees.

units.sanskrit: ते ऽन्योन्यं ददृशुर् भौमा देहबन्धान् अमानुषान् । न्यवेशयद् अमेयात्मा वृष्णिभिः सहितो ऽच्युतः ॥ तं च दिव्यं द्रुमश्रेष्ठं पारिजातम् अमित्रजित् । अर्च्यम् अर्चितम् अव्यग्रम् इष्टे देशे न्यवेशयत् ॥
units.english: By the power of the Pārijāta the heroes saw the beauty of their own persons and attained to great delight. Thus eulogized by the delighted Yadu chiefs Krishna entered into the house constructed by Viswakarma. Having placed that mountain of jems with summits in his inner appartment Achyuta, of incomparable energy, united with the Vrishnis, worshipped the celestial tree Pārijāta and planted it in its proper place.

units.sanskrit: अनुज्ञाय ततो ज्ञातीन् केशवः परवीरहा । ताः स्त्रियः पूजयाम् आस संक्षिप्ता नरकेण याः ॥ वस्त्रैर् आभरणैर् भोगैर् दासीभिर् धनसंचयैः । वेदक्या सह रोहिण्या रेवत्या चाहुकेन च ॥
units.english: Thereupon obtaining the permission of his own kinsmen Keshava, the slayer of heroes, honored all the maidens he had brought from Naraka's house with raiments, ornaments, maid-servants, riches and objects of enjoyment. Those maidens had already been received honourably by Devaki, Rohini, Revati and Ahuka's wives.

units.sanskrit: सत्यभामोत्तमा स्त्रीणां सौभाग्येनाभवत् तदा । कुटुम्बस्येश्वरी त्व् आसीद् रुक्मिणी भीष्मकात्मजा ॥
units.english: By his good luck Satyabhāmā ruled over all the females, and Bhishmaka's daughter Rukshmini was in charge of the relatives.

units.sanskrit: आदिदेश गृहान् कृष्णः परिबर्हांश् च पुष्कलान् ॥
units.english: Krishna allotted to each of those women, separate houses, tanks, and gardens.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ततः संपूज्य गरुडं वासुदेवो ऽनुमान्य च । सखिवच् चोपगृह्यैनम् अनुजज्ञे गृहं प्रति ॥ सो ऽनुज्ञातो हि सत्कृत्य प्रणम्य च जनार्दनम् । ऊर्ध्वम् आचक्रमे पक्षी यथेष्टं गगनेचरः ॥ स पक्षवातसंक्षुब्धं समुद्रं मकरालयम् । कृत्यकाल उपस्थास्य इत्य् उक्त्वा गरुडे गते । कृष्णो ददर्श पितरं वृद्धम् आनकदुंदुभिम् ॥ उग्रसेनं च राजानं बलदेवं च माधवः । हता ब्रह्मद्विशः सर्वे यजन्त्य् अन्धकवृष्णयः । रणात् प्रतिनिवृत्तो ऽयम् अक्षतो मधुसूदनः ॥ प्रीताश् च मुनयः सर्वे रक्षिता यदुसत्तमाः । ततः सांदीपनिं पूर्वम् उपगम्य जनार्दनः । ववन्दे सह रामेण पितरं वासवानुजः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thereupon having honored Garuda like his friend Vāsudeva took him to his own house. Having saluted Janārddana that sky-ranging bird, with his permission, rose up into the sky. At that time, having agitated completely the ocean, the abode of Makaras, with the wind caused by the flapping of his wings the bird flew towards the eastern sea –. Saying will again come at the time of work Vinatā's son departed. Krishna honored, with jewels acquired by his own prowess, his old father Anakadundubhi, the king Ugrasena, Baladeva, Satyaki Sāndipani, the Brāhmana Gārgya, and other members of the Vrishni, Andhaka and Bhoja races. The ambassadors, adorned with ear-rings and garlands, announced at the crossings and high ways of Dwārakā:—The enemies of the Brāhnanas have been slain: the slayer of Madhu has returned unscathed from the battle-field and the Vrishnis and Andhakas have acquired victory –. Afterwards having saluted Sāndipani first Janārddana bowed unto the king Ahuka. Thereupon with Rāma, Vāsava's younger brother saluted his father, with tears in his eyes, whose heart was filled with joy.

units.sanskrit: सर्वेषां नाम जग्राह दाशार्हाणाम् अधोक्षजः ॥
units.english: Afterwards approaching the Dāshārhas and calling every one of them by name Adhokshaja honored them all.

units.sanskrit: ततः सर्वाणि दिव्यानि सर्वरत्नमयानि च । आसनाग्र्याणि विविशुर् उपेन्द्रप्रमुखास् तदा ॥
units.english: descendant of Bharata, after showing these civilities all the Yadavas, headed by Upendra, sat on celestial thrones set with jewels of every description.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तद् धनम् अक्षय्यं किंकरैर् यत् समाहृतम् । सभां समानयाम् आसुः पुरुषाः कृष्णशासनात् ॥
units.english: Afterwards, commanded by Krishna, Naraka's servants brought there the riches and the assembly-hall which they had brought before.

units.sanskrit: सर्वान् दुंदुभिशब्देन पूजयिष्यञ् जनार्दनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon blowing his bugle, Janārddana, the foremost of Yadus, honored all the Dāshārhas -.

units.sanskrit: ताम् आसनवतीं रम्यां मणिविद्रुमतोरणाम् । सुदाशार्हीं सुदाशार्हा विविशुः कृष्णशासनात् ॥
units.english: Thereupon according to Krishna's order the Dāshārhas entered into the assembly-hall, charming, having seats and a door made of jewels.

units.sanskrit: शुशुभे ऽभ्यधिकं शुभ्रा सिंहैर् गिरिगुहा यथा ॥
units.english: As the cave of a mountain is inhabited by lions so that assembly-hall, filled with the leading Yadu chiefs, shone superbly beautiful.

units.sanskrit: रामेण सह गोविन्दः काञ्चनं महद् आसनम् । उग्रसेनं पुरस्कृत्य भेजे वृष्णिपुरस्कृतः ॥
units.english: Govinda, followed by the Vrishnis and Bhojas, placing Ugrasena before him, sat with Rama on the huge golden seat.

units.sanskrit: समाभाष्य यदुश्रेष्ठान् उवाच मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Welcoming all the Yadu chiefs who were seated there according to their age the foremost of Purushas said -.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच भवतां पुण्यकीर्तीनां तपोबलसमाधिभिः । अपध्यानाच् च पापात्मा भौमः स नरको हतः ॥
units.english: Krishna said:—Ye pious Yādavas, by virtue of your ascetic power and that of mental concentration, and on account of his own sin Bhumi's son Naraka has been slain.

units.sanskrit: मोक्षितं बन्धनाद् गुप्तं कन्यापुरवरं महत् । मणिपर्वतम् उत्पाट्य शिखरं चैतद् आहृतम् ॥
units.english: Many beautiful maidens have been released from his inner appartment and the summit of the mount Mani has been uprooted and brought here.

units.sanskrit: अयं धनौघः सुमहान् किंकरैर् आहृतो मया । ईशा भवन्तस् तस्येति तान् उक्त्वा विरराम ह ॥ तच् छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य भोजवृष्ण्यन्धका वचः । जहृषुर् हृष्टलोमानः पूजयन्तो जनार्दनम् ॥
units.english: My servants have also brought this collection of riches. You are now the masters of all these things. Having said this the Lord stopped. Hearing the words of Vasudeva, the Bhojas, Andhakas and Vrishnis, having their hairs stand erect in joy, worshipped Janārddana.

units.sanskrit: नैतच् चित्रं महाबाहो त्वयि देवकिनन्दन ॥ यत् कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म देवैर् अपि सुदुष्करम् । लालयेः स्वजनं भोगै रत्नैश् च स्वयम् अर्जितैः ॥
units.english: Afterwards those heroic men, with folded hands, said to them: large-armed son of Devaki, it is no wonder to thee that thou hast accomplished, for the gods, a highly difficult feat and hast propitiated thy own people with riches and other objects of pleasure acquired by thy own power -.

units.sanskrit: ततः सर्वदशार्हाणाम् आहुकस्य च याः स्त्रियः । प्रीयमाणाः सभां जग्मुर् वासुदेवदिदृक्षया ॥ देवकीसप्तमा देव्यो रोहिणी च शुभानना । अभ्यवादयतां देवौ देवकीं रामकेशवौ ॥
units.english: Thereupon the wives of the Dāshārhas and Ahuka, filled with joy, repaired to the Hail for seeing Krishna. The seven queens of Vasudeva, headed by Devaki and the beautiful-faced Rohini saw the large-armed Rāma and Krishna seated at ease. Having saluted first Rohini Rama and Krishna afterwards saluted Devaki.

units.sanskrit: सा ताभ्याम् ऋषभाक्षाभ्यां पुत्राभ्यां शुशुभे ऽधिकम् । अदितिर् देवमातेव मित्रेण वरुणेन च ॥
units.english: As Aditi, the mother of gods, looks beautiful in the company of Mitra and Varuna so the goddess shone in the company of her two lotus-eyed-sons –.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्राप्तौ नराग्र्यौ तु तस्या दुहितरं तदा । एकानंशेति याम् आहुर् नरा वै कामरूपिणीम् ॥ तथा क्षणमुहूर्ताभ्यां यया जज्ञे सहेश्वरः । यत्कृते सगणं कंसं जघान पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
units.english: Thereupon, the illusory daughter of Yashoda, whom the people describe as one and without any parts, with whom, the Purusottam Krishna, the king of gods, was born at the same moment and for whom he slew Kansa with his relatives, appeared before Krishna and Rāma, the foremost of men.

units.sanskrit: सा कन्या ववृधे तत्र वृष्णिसद्मनि पूजिता । एकानंशेति याम् आहुर् उत्पन्नां मानवा भुवि । योगकन्यां दुराधर्षां रक्षार्थं केशवस्य च ॥
units.english: Up to this time she was being adored in the Vrishni family and was being brought up and maintained like a daughter. She, whom the people of the world know as the irrepressible Yoga maiden, and as one and without any parts, was born for the protection of Keshava.

units.sanskrit: देववद् दिव्यवपुषा क्र्ष्णः संरक्षितो यया ॥
units.english: Because she protected Keshava with her goddess-like celestial body the Yadavas used to worship her with great pleasure.

units.sanskrit: तां च तत्रोपसंगम्य प्रियाम् इव सखीं सखा । दक्षिणेन कराग्रेण परिजग्राह माधवः ॥
units.english: As soon as she entered the Hall, Mādhava approached her, like unto a man his beloved female friend and held her by the hand.

units.sanskrit: मूर्ध्न्य् उपाघ्राय सव्येन परिजग्राह पाणिना ॥
units.english: The highly powerful Rāma too held her by his right hand, embraced her and smelt her head.

units.sanskrit: ददृशुस् तां प्रियां मध्ये भगिनीं रामकृष्णयोः । रुक्मपद्मकरव्यग्रां श्रियं पद्मालयाम् इव ॥
units.english: The Vrishni women then saw her between her two brothers Rāma and Krishna like unto the goddess Sree, with golden lotuses in her hands and seated on a lotus too.

units.sanskrit: अथाक्षतमहावृष्ट्या पुष्पैश् च विविधैः शुभैः । ततस् ते यादवाः सर्वे पूजयन्तो जनार्दनम् । उपोपविविशुः प्रीताः प्रशंसन्तो ऽद्भुतं कृतम् ॥
units.english: They then showered fried paddy and diverse flowers and repaired to their respective quarters -. Afterwards speaking highly of the wonderful deeds of Janarddana and honoring him the Yadavas sat delightedly on their respective thrones.

units.sanskrit: पूज्यमानो महाबाहुः पौराणां रतिवर्धनः । विजहार महाकीर्तिर् देवैर् इव स तैः सह ॥
units.english: Thus adored by his god-like kinsmen the mighty-armed and highly illustrious Mādhava, the enhancer of the joy of the citizens, began to live there happily with them –.

units.sanskrit: समासीनेषु सर्वेषु यादवेषु जनार्दनम् । नियोगात् त्रिदशेन्द्रस्य नारदो ऽभ्यागमत् सभाम् ॥
units.english: After the Yadavas had all taken their seats, the worshipful saint Nārada, according to the order of the king of gods, came to Janārddana at the meeting.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽथ संपूजितः पूज्यः शूरैस् तैर् यदुपुंगवैः । करे संस्पृश्य गोविन्दं विवेश महद् आसनम् ॥
units.english: Then worshipped by the heroic Yadu chiefs and shaking hands with Govinda he sat on a most excellent throne.

units.sanskrit: सुखोपविष्टस् तान् वृष्णीन् उपविष्टान् उवाच ह । शृणुध्वं राजशार्दूलाः कृष्णस्यास्य पराक्रमम् । यानि कर्माणि कृतवान् बाल्यात् प्रभृति केशवः ॥
units.english: Seated at ease he said to the Vrishnis:— foremost of men, know that have come here at the mandate of the king of gods. leading kings, hear now of all the heroic deeds which Krishna, the slayer of Keshi, has performed from his boyhood –.

units.sanskrit: उग्रसेनसुतः कंसः सर्वान् निर्मथ्य बान्धवान् । राज्यं जग्राह दुर्बुद्धिर् बध्वा पितरम् आहुकम् ॥
units.english: Having oppressed the Yadavas and put in chains his father Ahuka, the wicked son of Ugrasena, Kansa secured for himself the kingdom.

units.sanskrit: समाश्रित्य जरासंधं श्वशुरं कुलपांसनः । भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकान् सर्वान् अवमन्यत दुर्मतिः ॥
units.english: Seeking refuge with his father-in-law Jarāsandha, that wicked-minded wretch, the curse of his family, used to hate the other Bhojas, Vrishnis and Andhakas.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञातिकार्यं चिकीर्षंस् तु वसुदेवः प्रतापवान् । उग्रसेनस्य रक्षार्थं स्वपुत्रं पर्यरक्षत ॥
units.english: In order to accomplish a good work for his kinsmen and protect Ugrasena the powerful Vasudeva preserved his own son –.

units.sanskrit: अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि कृतवान् मधुसूदनः ॥ प्रत्यक्षं शूरसेनानां श्रूयते महद् अद्भुतम् । पूतना नाम घोरा सा महाकाया महाबला । विषदिग्धं स्तनं क्षुद्रा प्रयच्छन्ती महात्मने ॥ ददृशुस् तां विनिहतां राक्षसीं ते वनेचराः । बलेः सुतां महाघोरां भीषणां विकृताननाम् । पुनर्जातो ऽयम् इत्य् आहुर् उक्तस् तस्माद् अधोक्षजः ॥
units.english: You have all heard of the highly wondrous deeds which the slayer of Madhu performed before Shurasena and others while living with the milkmen in the suburb of Mathurā. One day while Janārddana was sporting under a cart, the highly powerful, dreadful, grim-visaged She-demon Putanā, under the guise of a bird, wished to make him suck her poisoned breast. He however killed her. Beholding however the dreadful, grim-visaged daughter of Bali, Putanā slain, the forest-ranging Gopas regarded him as one born again and gave him the name of Adhokhshaja.

units.sanskrit: अत्यद्भुतम् इदं चासीद् यच् छिशुः पुरुषोत्तमः । पादाङ्गुष्ठेन शकटं क्रीडमानो व्यलोडयत् ॥ भक्षयन् दधि गोविन्दः पयःपानं च साग्रजः । बभञ्जार्जुनवृक्षौ द्वौ ख्यातो दामोदरस् ततः । कालियश् च महानागो दुराधर्षो महाबलः । क्रीडता वासुदेवेन निर्जितो यमुनाह्रदे ॥
units.english: The Purusottama, in his infancy, performed another wonderful feat. While playing he upset a cart with his feet. He injured some of the boys for which Yashodā tied him to a wooden mortar. He, in that condition, uprooted two Arjuna trees for which he obtained the name of Dāmodara. The highly powerful and irrepressible Kālya Nāga was vanquished by him in the lake of Yamunā while sporting.

units.sanskrit: पूज्यमानस् तदा नागैर् दिव्यं वपुर् अधारयत् ॥
units.english: Adored by the Nāgas in their house in the presence of Akrura the Lord assumed a celestial body.

units.sanskrit: धृतो गोवर्धनः शैलः सप्तरात्रं महात्मना । शिशुना वासुदेवेन गवां त्राणार्थम् इच्छता ॥
units.english: Observing the cows assailed by cold and wind, the high-souled and intelligent son of Vasudeva, Krishna, although a child, held up, for saving them, the mount Govardhana for seven nights –.

units.sanskrit: तथा सुदुष्टो ऽतिबलो महाकायो नरान्तकृत् । गोपतिर् वासुदेवेन निहतो ऽरिष्टकः क्षितौ ॥
units.english: The wicked, highly powerful, huge-bodied great Asura Aristha, the destroyer of men, has been killed by Vāsudeva. When Sunamā came with his army to arrest him he assailed him through wolves.

units.sanskrit: धेनुकः स महाकायो दानवः सुमहाबलः । निहतो वासुदेवेन गवां त्राणाय दुर्मतिः ॥
units.english: For protecting the cows, the highly powerful, huge-bodied Dānava Dhenuka has been slain by Keshava.

units.sanskrit: रौहिणेयेन संगम्य वने विचरता पुनः । गोपवेषधरेणैव कंसस्य भयम् आहृतम् ॥
units.english: Ranging in the forest with Rohini's son under the guise of a milkman he created terror in Kansa.

units.sanskrit: तथा वनगतः शौरिर् दंष्ट्रायुधबलं हयम् । प्रग्रहं भोजराजस्य जघान पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
units.english: While living in Vraja, Purusottaina Shouri killed the powerful horse of the Bhoja king Kansa that had his teeth for it's weapon and was a great help to him –.

units.sanskrit: दानवो मुष्टिनैकेन कंसामात्यो निपातितः ॥
units.english: Kansa’s courtier the highly powerful Dānava Pralamva, was killed by Rohini's son with one stroke of his fist.

units.sanskrit: एतौ हि वसुदेवस्य पुत्रौ सुरसुतोपमौ । ववृधाते महात्मानौ ब्रह्मगार्ग्येण संस्कृतौ ॥ याथातथ्येन विज्ञाय संस्कारं प्रतिपादितौ ॥ यदा त्व् इमौ नरश्रेष्ठौ स्थितौ यौवनगौ मुखे । सिंहशावाव् इवोदीर्णौ मत्तौ हैमवतौ यथा ॥ ततो मनांसि गोपीनां हरमाणौ महाबलौ । आस्तां गोष्ठचरौ वीरौ देवपुत्रसमद्युती ॥ नैतौ जवे वा युद्धे वा क्रीडासु विविधासु वा । नन्दगोपस्य गोपालाः शेकुः प्रतिसमीक्षितुम् ॥
units.english: These two highly powerful sons of Vasudeva, resembling celestial youths, were initiated at that time by the Brāhmana Gārgya. The great saint knew who they really are and so they have been tutored by him from their very birth –. Thereupon those two highly powerful, foremost of men, like unto two infuriated young lions living on the Himalaya, attaining to youth, pilfered the hearts of milk-women. While those two heroic and effulgent sons of the milk-man Nanda used to move about in the pasture land the other boys, what to speak of equalling them in sport and strength, could not even look at them.

units.sanskrit: व्यूढोरस्कौ महाबाहू सालस्कन्धाव् इवोद्गतौ । श्रुत्वेमौ व्यथितः कंसो मन्त्रिभिः सहितो ऽभवत् ॥
units.english: Hearing of those two large-armed brothers, of firm shoulders, Bala and Keshava grow up like a Shāla tree Kansa was pained and consulted with his ministers.

units.sanskrit: निजग्राह ततः क्रोधाद् वसुदेवं सबान्धवम् ॥
units.english: And when he could not arrest them by any means he oppressed Vasudeva with all his kinsmen.

units.sanskrit: कालं महान्तम् अवसत् कृच्छ्रम् आनकदुंदुभिः ॥
units.english: Fettered like a felon along with Ugrasena Anakadundubhi began to spend his days in great misery.

units.sanskrit: कंसस् तु पितरं बध्वा शूरसेना? शशास ह । जरासंधं समाश्रित्य तथैवाह्वृतिभीष्मकौ ॥
units.english: Having thus kept in prison his father, Kansa, with the help of Jarāsandha, Ahbriti and Bhishmaka, governed Shurasena's kingdom -.

units.sanskrit: कस्यचित् त्व् अथ कालस्य मथुरायां महोत्सवम् । पिनाकिनं समुद्दिश्य कंसश् चक्रे नराधिपः ॥
units.english: After few days had passed in this way, the king Kansa, undertook a great festival in Mathura in honor of the trident-handed deity.

units.sanskrit: तत्र मल्लाः समापेतुर् नानादेश्या विशां पते । नर्तका गायकाश् चैव कुशला नृत्तसामसु ॥
units.english: In that festival, king, wrestlers, songsters and clever dancers had assembled there from various countries.

units.sanskrit: ततः कंसो महातेजा रङ्गवाटं महाधनम् । कुशलैः कारयाम् आस शिल्पिभिः साधुनिष्ठितैः ॥
units.english: In that festival, the highly powerful Kansa had built there a rich arena, by clever and well-trained artizans.

units.sanskrit: समाकीर्णान्य् अदृश्यन्त ज्योतिर्भिर् गगनं यथा ॥
units.english: Thousands of seats were occupied by citizens and villagers as the sky is crested with luminous bodies –.

units.sanskrit: भोजराजः श्रिया जुष्टं राजमञ्चं महर्द्धिमत् । अरुरोह ततः कंसो विमानं सुकृती यथा ॥
units.english: As the performer of pious deeds ascends the celestial chariot so the Bhoja king Kansa ascended the well-decorated platform of the arena.

units.sanskrit: शूरैर् अधिष्ठितं कंसः स्थापयाम् आस वीर्यवान् ॥
units.english: At the entrance of that arena the powerful Kansa had kept a mad elephant ridden by heroes and covered with weapons.

units.sanskrit: शुश्राव पुरुषव्याघ्रौ सूर्याचन्द्रमसाव् इव ॥ तदाप्रभृति यत्तो ऽभूद् रक्षां प्रति नराधिपः । न च शेते सुखं रात्रौ रामकृष्णौ विचिन्तयन् ॥
units.english: Thinking of Rāma and Krishna the highly powerful Kansa had no sleep even in the night previous, and hearing now of the arrival of those two foremost of men, like unto the sun and moon he became more careful for protecting himself –.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु रामकृष्णौ च तं समाजम् अनुत्तमम् । उभौ विविशतुर् वीरौ शार्दूलौ गोव्रजं यथा ॥ ततः प्रवेशे संरुद्धौ रक्षिभिः पुरुषर्षभौ । हत्वा कुवलयापीडं ससादिनम् अरिंदमौ । अवमृद्य दुराधर्षौ रङ्गं विविशतुस् तदा ॥ चाणूरान्ध्रौ विनिष्पिष्य केशवेन बलेन च । औग्रसेनिः स दुष्टात्मा सानुजो विनिपातितः ॥
units.english: Hearing of that most excellent arena those two foremost of men, the heroic Rama and Krishna, the slayers of their enemies, attempted to enter there as a tiger goes to the pasture of cows. And although prevented by the warders they entered there after killing the elephant Kuvalayāpida. Having entered that arena the irrepressible Bala and Krishna first powdered Chanura and Andhra and then killed the wicked son of Ugrasena with his younger brother –.

units.sanskrit: यत् कृतं यदुसिंहेन देवैर् अपि सुदुःसहम् । कर्म तत् केशवाद् अन्यः कर्तुम् अर्हति कः पुमान् ॥ यद् धि नाधिगतं पूर्वैः प्रह्रादबलिशम्बरैः । एतेन मुरम् आक्रम्य दैत्यं पञ्चजनं तथा । शैलसंघान् अतिक्रम्य निसुन्दः सगणो हतः ॥
units.english: Who else but Yadu's descendant could accomplish such a feat which even the gods could not do ? Keshava has brought for you all these riches which Pralhāda, Bali and even Shamvara could not obtain before. He has killed the Daityas Muru and Pānchajana. And coming out of his mountainous fastness Nisunda has been slain with all his kinsmen –.

units.sanskrit: नरकश् च हतो भौमः कुण्डले चाहृते शुभे । प्राप्तं च दिवि देवेषु केशवेन महद् यशः ॥
units.english: Having killed Bhumi's son Naraka and brought back the beautiful pair of Aditi's ear-rings Keshava attained to great fame from the celestials in their region.

units.sanskrit: वीतशोकभयाबाधाः कृष्णबाहुबलाश्रयाः । यजन्तु बहुभिर् यज्ञैर् यादवा वीतमत्सराः ॥
units.english: ye Yadavas, depending upon the strength of Krishna’s arms and shorn of pride, fear, sorrow and other impediments do you celebrate various sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: देवानां सुमहत् कार्यं कृतं कृष्णेन धीमता । क्षिप्रम् आवेदये चेदं भवतां भद्रम् अस्तु वः ॥ यद् इष्टं वो यदुश्रेष्ठाः कर्तास्मि तद् अतन्द्रितः । भवताम् अस्मि यूयं च मम युष्मास्व् अहं स्थितः ॥
units.english: great work of the gods has been performed by the intelligent Krishna. May you fare-well. have come here to communicate to you this glad tidings, ye chiefs, Vāsava has said that he would with great care procure what ever you would like to have. He is yours and you are his.

units.sanskrit: इति संबोधयन् कृष्णम् अब्रवीत् पाकशासनः । माम् अप्रैषीत् सुरश्रेष्ठः प्रीतास् तुष्टास् तथा वयम् ॥ यत्र ह्रीः श्रीः स्थिता तत्र यत्र श्रीस् तत्र संनतिः । आरण्यकाः सदा सन्तु भवतां ज्ञानहेतवः । नारद उवाच सादिता मौरवाः पाशा निसुन्दनरकौ हतौ । कृतः क्षेमः पुनः पन्थाः पुरं प्राग्ज्योतिषं प्रति ॥
units.english: Know it for certain, that the foremost of gods, the chastiser of Pāka has despatched me here to inform Krishna that the gods have been highly pleased. There lives advancement where reign the goddesses of prosperity and modesty. In the high-souled Vāsudeva all the three exist –. Narada said:—Moreover, the nooses made by Mura have been cut, Nisumva and Naraka have been slain and the road to the city of Pragyotish has been freed from all dangers.

units.sanskrit: शौरिणा पृथिवीपालास् त्रासिताः स्पर्धिनो युधि । धनुषश् च निनादेन पाञ्चजन्यस्वनेन च ॥
units.english: Even the proud kings of the world have been frightened in battle by this descendant of Shura Krishna with the twang of his bow and the sound of his conch-shell Panchajanya.

units.sanskrit: रुक्मिणं युधि निर्जित्य महाबलपराक्रमम् । रुक्मिणीम् आजहाराशु केशवो वृष्णिपुंगवः ॥ ततः पर्जन्यघोषेण रथेनादित्यवर्चसा । उवाह महिषीं भोजां शङ्खचक्रगदासिभृत् ॥ जारूथ्याम् आह्वृतिः क्राथः शिशुपालश् च निर्जितः । वक्त्रश् च सह सैन्येन शतधन्वा च दुर्जयः ॥ इन्द्रद्युम्नो हतः कोपाद् यवनश् च कशेरुमान् । हतः सौभपतिः साल्वः शौभश् च दृढधन्वना ॥
units.english: Having vanquished easily the highly powerful Rukshmi well protected by the Decean car-warriors resembling clouds, the foremost of Vrishnis Keshava carried away Rukshmini –. Afterwards Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, brought Bhoja's daughter into his house in a car effulgent like the sun and producing a rattle like unto the muttering of clouds and married her. In the city of Jāruthi he defeated Ahdriti, Kratha and Shishupala and vanquished Dantavakra and Shatadhanwā with all their soldiers. Worked up with anger the beautiful lord of Shoubha killed Shālwa, grasping firmly a bow, the Yavana Indradyumna and Kasherunām.

units.sanskrit: पर्वतानां सहस्रं च चक्रेण पुरुषोत्तमः । विकीर्य पुण्डरीकाक्षो द्युमत्सेनम् अपोथयत् ॥
units.english: Having scattered thousands of mountains the lotus-eyed Purusottama struck Dyumutsena with his discus.

units.sanskrit: महेन्द्रशिखरे चैव निमेषोन्तरचारिणौ । जघान यो नरव्याघ्रो रावणस्याभितश् चरौ ॥ इरावत्यां महाभोजाव् अग्निसूर्यसमौ युधि । गोपतिस् तालकेतुश् च निहतौ शार्ङ्गधन्वना ॥
units.english: In the city of Irāvati on the summit of the mount Mahendra there lived two followers of Rāvana Gopati and Tālaketu, who could disappear form view within the twinkling of an eye and were effulgent like sun and fire.

units.sanskrit: अक्षप्रपतने चैव निमिर् हंसश् च दानवौ । उभौ ताव् अपि कृष्णेन सराष्ट्रौ विनिपातितौ ॥
units.english: The foremost of men, Keshava, the holder of Srānga bow, killed them both, within the twinkling of an eye, the Dānavas Hansa and Dimvaka have been also slain by Krishna with their followers.

units.sanskrit: दग्धा वाराणसी चैव केशवेन महात्मना । अथैन्द्रसेनिर् आनीतः कृष्णेनाद्भुतकर्मणा ॥
units.english: Vārānashi Benares has been burnt down by the high souled Keshava and the king with his followers has been slain -. Having killed Maya in battle with knotty arrows Krishna, of wonderful deeds, has released the son of Indrasena.

units.sanskrit: सहितः सर्वयादोभिः सागरेषु महाबलः । प्राप्य लोहितकूटानि कृष्णेन वरुणो जितः ॥
units.english: The highly powerful Varuna, with all the acquatic animals, has been defeated in battle by Krishna repairing to Lohitakuta under water.

units.sanskrit: महेन्द्रभवने जातो देवैर् गुप्तो महात्मभिः । अचिन्तयित्वा देवेन्द्रं पारिजातद्रुमो हृतः ॥
units.english: Having gone to Indra’s palace, he, although prevented by the highly powerful celestials, disregarding their king, carried away the Pārijāta tree.

units.sanskrit: पाण्ड्यं पौण्ड्रं च मत्स्यं च कलिङ्गं च जनार्दनः । गान्धारीम् आवहद् धीमान् महिषीं प्रियदर्शनाम् ॥
units.english: The intelligent Janārddana has slain the kings of Pandya, Poundrya, Kalinga, Matsa and Banga. Having killed hundreds of highly powerful kings he married his beautiful queen Gāndhāri.

units.sanskrit: तथा गाण्डीवधन्वानं क्रीडन्तं मधुसूदनः । जिगाय भरत श्रेष्ठं कुन्त्याः प्रमुखतो विभुः ॥
units.english: But the Lord Madhusudana has crowned the foremost of Bharatas, Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow who used to play before Kunti, with success –.

units.sanskrit: द्रोणं द्रौणिं कृपं कर्णं भीमसेनं सुयोधनम् । बभ्रोश् च प्रियम् अन्विच्छञ् शङ्खचक्रगदासिभृत् । सौवीरराजस्य सुतां प्रसह्य हृतवान् प्रभुः ॥
units.english: This foremost of men has defeated, in battle, Drona, Drauni, Karna, Bhishma, Suyodhana and other warriors. For pleasing Vabhru the powerful Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, carried away by force the daughter of the king of Suveera -.

units.sanskrit: पर्यस्तां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां साश्वां सरथकुञ्जराम् । वेणुदारिकृते यत्नाज् जिगाय पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
units.english: When Venudāri trampled over the entire earth with his horses, cars and elephants Purusottama defeated him with great care.

units.sanskrit: अवाप्य तपसो वीर्यं बलम् ओजश् च माधवः । पूर्वदेहे जहारायं बलेस् त्रिभुवनं हरिः ॥
units.english: Acquiring, by his ascetic penances, energy, strength and power in his pristine dwarfish form Mādhava stole away from Bali the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: वज्राशनिगदाशृङ्गैस् त्रासयद्भिश् च दानवैः । यस्य नाधिगतो मृत्युः पुरं प्राग्ज्योतिषं प्रति ॥
units.english: Even when he was attacked in the city of Prāgyotish by the Dānavas with thunderbolts, clubs and swords Death could not near him -.

units.sanskrit: अभिभूतश् च कृष्णेन सगणः स महाबलः । बलेः पुत्रो महावीर्यो बाणो द्रविणवत्तरः ॥
units.english: Bali's son, the highly powerful, energetic and rich Bāna has been defeated by Krishna with all his followers.

units.sanskrit: पीठं तथा महाबाहुः कंसामात्यं जनार्दनः । पैठिकं चासिलोमानं निजघान महाबलः ॥
units.english: The highly powerful Janārddana has killed Peetha, Paithika and Asitomā the courtiers of the long-armed Kansa –.

units.sanskrit: जम्भम् ऐरावतं चापि विरूपं च महायशाः । जघान पुरुषव्याघ्रः शम्बरं चारिमर्दनः ॥
units.english: The highly illustrious Mādhava, the foremost of men, has killed the Daityas Jambha, Airāvata and Virupa, assuming the semblance of a man.

units.sanskrit: तथा नागपतिं तोये कालियं च महौजसम् । निर्जित्य पुण्डरीकाक्षः प्रेषयाम् आस सागरम् ॥
units.english: Having defeated in water the highly powerful Nāga king Kālya, the lotus-eyed Krishna has despatched him to the sea.

units.sanskrit: संजीवयाम् आस मृतं पुत्रं सांदीपनेस् तथा । निर्जित्य पुरुषव्याघ्रो यमं वैवस्वतं हरिः ॥
units.english: Having vanquished Vivaswān's son Yama, Hari, the foremost of men, has restored to life the dead son of Sāndipani.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एष महाबाहुः शास्ता सर्वदुरात्मनाम् ॥ देवांश् च ब्राह्मणांश् चैव ये द्विषन्ति सदा नृप । निहत्य नरकं भौमम् आहृत्य मणिकुण्डले । देवमातुर् ददौ चापि प्रीत्यर्थं वज्रपाणिनः ॥
units.english: Emperor Janamejaya, in this way, this high-souled one chastises those wicked souls who injure the Brāhmanas and the gods. Having slain Bhumi's son Naraka he has brought the pair of ear-rings and given them to the mother of gods for pleasing the holder of thunder-bolt –.

units.sanskrit: एवं स देवदैत्यानां सुराणां च महायशाः । भयाभयकरः कृष्णः सर्वलोकेश्वरो विभुः ॥
units.english: The highly illustrious Lord Vishnu, the master of all the worlds, is a terror to the Daityas and declares fearlessness to the celestials.

units.sanskrit: संस्थाप्य धर्मान् मर्त्येषु यज्ञैर् इष्ट्वाप्तदक्षिणैः । कृत्वा देवार्थम् अमितं स्वस्थानं प्रतिपत्स्यते ॥
units.english: Having established virtue amongst the mortals by performing various sacrifices and accomplished the great work of the gods he will return to his own region.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णो भोगवतीं रम्याम् ऋषिकान्तां महायशाः । द्वारकाम् आत्मसात्कृत्वा समुद्रं गमयिष्यति ॥
units.english: Then the highly illustrious Krishna will make the ocean devour the cities Bhogavati, a favourite resort of the Rishis, and Dwārakā –.

units.sanskrit: बहुरत्नसमाकीर्णा चैत्ययूपशताङ्किता । द्वारका वरुणावासं प्रवेक्ष्यति सकानना ॥
units.english: This city of Dwārakā, filled with various jewels and sacrificial grounds, will enter, with its gardens, into the abode sea of Varuna.

units.sanskrit: तां सूर्यसदनप्रख्यां मतज्ञः शार्ङ्गधन्वनः । विसृष्टां वासुदेवेन सागरः प्लावयिष्यति ॥
units.english: The ocean, conversant with the desire of Krishna, the holder of Shrānga bow, will inundate this city of Dwārakā constructed by Vāsudeva and resembling the residence of the sun.

units.sanskrit: सुरासुरमनुष्येषु नासिन् न भविता क्वचित् । य इमाम् आवसेत् कश्चिद् अन्यत्र मधुसूदनात् ॥
units.english: There is none amongst the gods, Asuras, and men and none will be, except the slayer of Madhu, who will be able to live here –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एष दशार्हाणां विधाय विधिना विधिम् । विष्णुर् नारायणः सोमः सूर्यश् च भविता स्वयम् ॥
units.english: Having thus instituted many excellent regulations amongst the Dāshārhas Vishnu himself will be united with Nārāyana, Shoma and Surya.

units.sanskrit: अप्रमेयो ऽनियोज्यश् च यत्रकामगमो वशी । मोदत्य् एष सदा भूतैर् बालः क्रीडनकैर् इव ॥
units.english: He is incomparable, above the reach of thought, can go any where at will and has control over his senses. As a boy plays with a toy so he sports with these creatures –.

units.sanskrit: न प्रमातुं महाबाहुः शक्यो ऽयं मधुसूदनः । स्तव्यो ऽयम् एवं शतशस् तथा शतसहस्रशः । अन्तो हि कर्मणाम् अस्य दृष्टपूर्वो न केनचित् ॥
units.english: None can measure the large-armed slayer of Madhu; there is nothing similar or otherwise with his universal form. In this way he has been eulogised hundreds and thousands of times. But none has been able to see the end of his works.

units.sanskrit: कृतवान् पुण्डरीकाक्षः संकर्षणसहायवान् ॥ इत्य् उवाच पुरा व्यासस् तपोदीर्घेण चक्षुषा । महायोगी महाबुद्धिः सर्वप्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान् ॥
units.english: Beholding with his eyes, rendered more powerful by ascetic penances, the deeds which the lotus-eyed Keshava performed with Sangkarshana's help in his boyhood, the highly intelligent and the great Yogin Vyasa, the witness of all, had already narrated them all -.

units.sanskrit: इति संस्तूय गोविन्दं महेन्द्रवचनाद् ऋषिः । यदुभिः पूजितः सर्वैर् नारदस् त्रिदिवं गतः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus chanted the glories of Govinda at the mandate of the king of gods, the celestial saint Nārada, adored by the Yadavas, repaired to the celestial region.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तद् वसु गोविन्दो दिदेशान्धकवृष्णिषु । यथार्हं पुण्डरीकाक्षो विधिवन् मधुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the lotus-eyed slayer of Madhu, Govinda, distributed those riches and jewels duly amongst the Vrishnis and Andhakas.

units.sanskrit: यादवाश् च धनं प्राप्य विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणैः । यज्ञैर् इष्ट्वा महात्मानो द्वारकाम् आवसन् पुरीम् ॥
units.english: Having obtained them the high-souled Yadavas too began to perform sacrifices with profuse presents and live in the city of Dwarakā -.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच बहूनां स्त्रीसहस्राणाम् अष्टौ भार्याः प्रकीर्तिताः । तासाम् अपत्यान् यष्टानां भगवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच अष्टौ महिष्यः पुत्रिण्य इति प्राधान्यतः स्मृताः । सर्वा वीरप्रजायिन्यस् तास्व् अपत्यानि मे शृणु ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:– reverend Sir, of the many thousand wives of Krishna you have duly mentioned the names of eight. Do you now give an account of their children. Vaishampāyana said:—Eight queens of Krishna had been recognised as leading ones. They all gave birth to heroic sons. Listen to an account of the names of their children.

units.sanskrit: रुक्मिणी सत्यभामा च देवी नग्नजिती तथा । सुदत्ता च तथा शैब्या लक्ष्मणा चारुहासिनी ॥ सुभीमा च तथा माद्री रौक्मिणेयान् इमाञ् शृणु ॥ प्रद्युम्नः प्रथमो यज्ञे शम्बरान्तकरः सुतः । द्वितीयश् चारुदेष्णश् च वृष्णिसिंहो महारथः ॥ चारुभद्रो भद्रचारुः सुदंष्ट्रो द्रुम एव च । सुषेणश् चारुगुप्तश् च चारुविन्दश् च चारुमान् । चारुबाहुः कनिष्ठश् च कन्या चारुमती तथा ॥
units.english: Krishna's principal wives were Rukshmini, Satyabhāmā, Nagnajiti, Sudattā, Saivyā, Lakshmanā, Mitravindā, Kālindi, Jāmvavati, Pouravi, Subhimā, Mādri and others. Amongst them, hear of the names of the sons of Rukshmini –. Rukshmini first gave birth to a son by name Pradyumna who killed Shamvara. Next she gave birth to the mighty car-warrior Chārudeshna, the scion of the Vrishni race, and afterwards to Chāruchandra, Chārugarbha, Sudangstra, Druma, Sushena, Chārugupta, the powerful Chāruvinda and the youngest Chāruvāhu. Besides she gave birth to a daughter by name Chārumati.

units.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे सत्यभामायां भानुर् भिमरथः क्षुपः । रोहितो दीप्तिमांश् चैव ताम्रजाक्षो जलान्तकः । चतस्रो जज्ञिरे तेषां स्वसारो गरुडध्वजात् ॥ जाम्बवत्याः सुतो जज्ञे साम्बः समितिशोभनः । मित्रबाहुर् मित्रधामा मित्रसेनस् तथैव च । मित्रवाहः सुनीथश् च नग्नजित्याः प्रजाः शृणु । भद्रकारो भद्रविन्दः कन्या भद्रवती तथा ॥
units.english: Garudadhwaja Krishna begat on Satyabhama, seven sons, namely, Bhānu, Bhimaratha, Kshupa, Rohita, Diptimān, Tāmrajaksha, and Jalāntaka and four daughters, namely Bhānu, Bhimarikā, Tāndrapaksha and Jalandhama. Jamvavati gave birth to a son, the ornament of the battle-field, by name Sāmva, as also to Mitravān, Mitravinda, Mitravāhu and Sunitha and a daughter by name Mitravati. Hear now of the children of Nagnajiti -. She gave birth to two sons, Bhadrakāra and Bhadravinda and a daughter, by name Bhadravati.

units.sanskrit: सत्यजित् सेनजिच् चैव तथा शूरः सपत्नजित् ॥
units.english: Saivyā gave birth to Sangrāmajit, Satyajit, Senajit, Shura and Sapatnijit.

units.sanskrit: सुभीमायाः सुतो माद्र्या वृकाश्वो वृकनिर्वृतिः । कुमारो वृकदीप्तिश् च लक्ष्मणायाः प्रजाः शृणु ॥
units.english: The princes Vrikāshwa, Vrikanirvitti, Vrikadipti and Subhimā were Madri's sons. king, hear now of the children of Lakshmanā.

units.sanskrit: गात्रवान् गात्रगुप्तश् च गात्रविन्दश् च वीर्यवान् । अश्रुतश् च सुतो जज्ञे कालिन्द्याः श्रुतसत्तमः । तं प्रदाय हृषीकेशस् तां भार्यां मुदितो ऽब्रवीत् । एष वाम् उभयोर् अस्तु दायादः शाश्वतीः समाः ॥
units.english: Gātravān, Gātragupta and the powerful Gātravinda were born with their youngest sister Gātravati. Kālindi gave birth to a pious son by name Asruta whom Madhusudana gave to Shrutasenā. Having given that son away Hrishikesha delightedly said to his wife: For long he will be the son of you both.

units.sanskrit: बृहत्यां तु गदस्याहुः शैब्यायाम् अङ्गदं सुतम् । उत्पन्नं कुमुदं चैव श्वेतं श्वेतां तथाङ्गनाम् ॥ अगावहः सुमित्रश् च शुचिश् चित्ररथस् तथा । वनुस्तम्बस्य जज्ञाते स्तम्बः स्तम्बवनश् च ह । निवासनो वनस्तम्बः कन्या स्तम्बवती तथा । उपासङ्गस्य तु सुतौ वज्रः सुक्षिप्र एव च ॥
units.english: Vrihati gave birth to Gada. Saivyā gave birth to Angada, Kumada, Sweta and a daughter by the name of Swetā. Sudevā gave birth to five sons by name Avagāha, Sumitra, Suchi, Chitraratha and Chitrasena and a daughter by name Chitravati. Besides Vanastambha, Stambha and Stambhavāna were born to him as sons. Of them Vanasthambha begat Mitrasena and Stambhavati. Upāsangha begat two sons, Vajrāsu and Kshipra.

units.sanskrit: कौशिक्यां सुतसोमायां यौधिष्ठिर्यां युधिष्ठिरौ । एवमादीनि पुत्राणां सहस्त्राणि निबोधत । अयुतानि तथा चाष्टौ शूरा रणविशारदाः । जनार्दनस्य प्रसवः कीर्तितो ऽयं यथा तथा । प्रद्युम्नस्य सुतो यस् तु वैदर्भ्यां राजसत्तमः । अनिरुद्धो रणे योद्धा जज्ञे स मृगकेतनः ॥
units.english: Koushiki, Sutasoma, and Youdhisthiri gave birth to Yudhisthira, the wonderful warrior Kāpāli and Garuda -. Thus the sons of Mādhava numbered one lak and eighty thousand. They were all valiant and expert in fighting. king, have thus narrated the progeny of Janārddana –. foremost of kings, Pradyumna begat on the Vidarbha princess a son by name Aniruddha. He had the emblem of a deer on his flag and no body could obstruct him in battle.

units.sanskrit: रेवत्यां बलदेवस्य जज्ञाते निशठोल्मुकौ । भ्रातरौ देवसंकाशाव् उभौ पुरुषसत्तमौ ॥ सुतनुश् च नराची च शौरेर् आस्तां परिग्रहः । पौण्ड्रश् च कपिलश् चैव वासुदेवस्य तौ सुतौ ॥
units.english: Baladeva begat on Revati two sons by name Nishatha and Ulmuka. Those two brothers were beautiful like gods. Shura's son Vasudeva begat on his two wives Sutanu and Nārāchi two sons by name Poundra and Kapila. Of them Nārāchi gave birth to Kapila and Sutanu to Paundra.

units.sanskrit: तयोर् नृपो ऽभवत् पौण्ड्रः कपिलश् च वनं ययौ ॥
units.english: Of those two sons Poundra became the king and Kapila entered into woods.

units.sanskrit: तुर्यां समभवद् वीरो वसुदेवान् महाबलः । काश्या सुपार्श्वं तनयं लेभे साम्बात् तरस्विनम् । सानोर् वज्रो ऽनिरुद्धस्य वज्रस् त्व् आदाव् अजायत ॥ वज्राज् जज्ञे प्रतिवहः सुचारुस् तस्य चात्मजः । शिनेस् तु सत्यवाग् जज्ञे सत्यकश् च महारथः । सत्यकस्यात्मजः शूरो युयुधानस् त्व् अजायत ॥
