units.english: Vasudeva begat on Sudrā the highly powerful hero Jara who was a great archer. Vasudeva begat on Kāshi a quick-coursing son by name Supārshwa. Aniruddha had two sons, Sānu and Vajrā of whom the latter was the eldest. Vajra begat Pratiratha whose son was Suchāru. Amitra, the youngest son of Vrishni, begat Sini whose sons were Satyavāk and the great car-warrior Satyaka. The heroic Yuyudhāna was Satyaka's son.

units.sanskrit: असङ्गो युयुधानस्य भूमिस् तस्याभवत् सुतः । भूमेर् युगंधरः पुत्र इति वंशः समाप्यते ॥
units.english: Yuyudhana's son was Asanga whose son was Tuni. Tuni's son was Yugandhara. With him, king, the family ends –.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच य एष भवता पूर्वं शम्बरघ्नेत्य् उदाहृतः । प्रद्युम्नः स कथं जघ्ने शम्बरं तद् ब्रवीहि मे ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच रुक्मिण्यां वासुदेवस्य लक्ष्मीकामो धृतव्रतः । शम्बरान्तकरो जज्ञे प्रद्युम्नः कामदर्शनः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:—You said before that Pradyumna had killed Shamvara. Describe to me now how Pradyumna killed him. Vaishampāyana said:—Kāma Cupid of firm vows, in order to kill Shamvara, took his birth from Rukshmini, the incarnation of Lakshmi, and Vāsudeva as his beautiful son Pradyumna.

units.sanskrit: तं सप्तरात्रे संपूर्णे निशीथे सूतिकागृहात् । जहार कृष्णस्य सुतं शिशुं वै कालशम्बरः ॥
units.english: On the seventh day at dead of night Kalashamvara stole away that infant son of Krishna from the lying-in room -.

units.sanskrit: विदितं तच् च कृष्णस्य देवमायानुवर्तिनः । ततो न निगृहीतः स दानवो युद्धदुर्मदः ॥ स मृत्युना परीतायुर् माययाभिजहार तम् । दोर्भ्याम् उत्क्षिप्य नगरं स्वं जगाम महासुरः ॥ नाम्ना मायावती नाम मायेव शुभदर्शन ॥ ददौ तं वासुदेवस्य पुत्रं पुत्रम् इवात्मजम् । तस्या महिष्या नाथिन्या दानवः कालचोदितः ॥
units.english: Krishna, who followed the celestial Māyā, knew every thing and therefore he did not kill at that time the Dānava, invincible in battle. As if urged on by Death the great Asura stole away Krishna's son. And throwing him upon his arms he took him to his own city. His beautiful and accomplished wife Māyāvati, as if the very incarnation of Māyā, had no offspring so that Dānava, as if commissioned by Death, gave over that son of Vasudeva to her like his own –.

units.sanskrit: मायावती तु तं दृष्ट्वा संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहा । अथ तस्या निरीक्षन्त्याः स्मृतिः प्रादुर्बभूव ह । अयं स नाथो भर्ता मे यस्यार्थं हि दिवानिशम् । चिन्ताशोकह्रदे मग्ना न विन्दामि रतिं क्वचित् ॥
units.english: Seeing him she was filled with joy and her hairs stood erect: she looked at him repeatedly with delight. Casting her looks on him in this way she recollected that he was her favourite husband. Remembering it she again thought He is my lord for whom am day and night plunged into the lake of anxiety and sorrow and have not been able to enjoy mental felicity any where.

units.sanskrit: अयं भगवता पूर्वं देवदेवेन शूलिना । खेदितेन कृतो ऽनङ्गो दृष्टो जात्यन्तरे मया ॥
units.english: He was formerly reduced to ashes by the divine trident handed deity stricken with sorrow for Sati. Now he has been seen by me in another birth.

units.sanskrit: कथम् अस्य स्तनं दास्ये मातृभावेन जानती । भर्तुर् भार्या त्व् अहं भूत्वा वक्ष्ये वा पुत्र इत्य् उत ॥
units.english: However, being his wife and knowing him as my husband how can give him milk and address him as my son? Thinking thus Māyāvati handed over the baby to the nurse and soon reared him up with nourishing tonics.

units.sanskrit: मायावतीम् अविज्ञानान् मेने स्वाम् एव मातरम् । सा तं संवर्धयाम् आस कार्ष्णिं कमललोचनम् । मायाश् चास्मै ददौ सर्वा दानवीः काममोहिता ॥
units.english: Informed by the nurse and out of ignorance Rukshmini's son knew Māyāvati as his mother –. Having brought up that lotus-eyed son of the Lord of Kamalā Māyāvati too, stricken with lust, instructed him in all forms of illusion.

units.sanskrit: चिकीर्षितज्ञो नारीणां सर्वास्त्रविधिपारगः ॥ तं सा मायावती कान्तं कामयाम् आस कामिनी । इङ्गितैश् चापि वीक्षन्ती प्रालोभयत सस्मिता ॥
units.english: When gradually crossing the limit of youth Pradyumna looked highly beautiful, became an expert in the use of all sorts of weapons and in deciphering the movements of women, Māyāvati, assuming the semblance of a beautiful woman, sought the company of her beloved consort and tempted him with her gestures.

units.sanskrit: प्रसज्जन्तीं तु तां देवीं बभाषे चारुहासिनीम् । मातृभावं परित्यज्य किम् एवं वर्तसे ऽन्यथा ॥ अहो दुष्टस्वभावासि स्त्रीत्वेन चलमानसा । या पुत्रभावम् उत्सृज्य मयि कामात् प्रवर्तसे ॥
units.english: Seeing that sweet-smiling lady attached to him Pradyumna said to her:—What is this? Why do you, casting off your maternal feelings, behave in this perverse way? Alas, how wicked are women. How fickle is their mind. Possessed by lust you are not regarding me as your son and behaving otherwise.

units.sanskrit: ननु ते ऽहं सुतः सौम्ये को ऽयं शीलव्यतिक्रमः । तत् त्वम् इच्छाम्य् अहं देवि कथितं कस् त्व् अयं विधिः ॥
units.english: gentle lady, what is the cause of such a perversity of nature? Am not then your son? Why do you behave in this way? wish to learn the secret of this from you.

units.sanskrit: विद्युत्संपातचपलः स्वभावः खलु योषिताम् । या नरेषु प्रसज्जन्ते नगाग्रेषु घना इव ॥
units.english: The nature of women is fickle like lightning. As the clouds are attached to the summits of a mountain so they are attached to men.

units.sanskrit: यदि ते ऽहं सुतः सौम्ये यदि वा नात्मजः शुभे । कथितं तत् त्वम् इच्छामि किम् इदं ते चिकीर्षितम् ॥
units.english: gentle lady, it matters little whether am your son or not. wish to learn from your own mouth the object of your movements.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु सा भीरुः कामेन व्यथितेन्द्रिया । प्रियं प्रोवाच वचनं विविक्ते केशवात्मजम् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed that timid damsel, having her heart stricken with lust, said to her lover, Keshava's son in a solitary place.

units.sanskrit: न त्वं मम सुतः सौम्य नापि ते शम्बरः पिता । रूपवान् असि विक्रान्तस् त्वं जात्या वृष्णिनन्दनः । पुत्रस् त्वं वासुदेवस्य रुक्मिण्या नन्दिवर्धनः ॥
units.english: You are not my son, nor Shamvara is your father –. You are a powerful and beautiful descendant of Vrishni; you are the delightful son of Vāsudeva and Rukshmini.

units.sanskrit: दिवसे सप्तमे बालो जातमात्रो ऽपवाहितः । मम भर्त्रा हृतो वीर बलवीर्यप्रवर्तिना । पितुस् ते वासुदेवस्य धर्षयित्वा गृहं महत् । सा च ते करुणं माता त्वां बालम् अनुशोचती । स हि शक्राद् अपि महान् पिता ते गरुडध्वजः । इह त्वां नाभिजानाति बालम् एवापवाहितम् ॥
units.english: After your birth on the seventh day you were brought here. When you were a helpless baby in the lying-in chamber you were stolen by my powerful husband. Tresspassing into the house of your father Vāsudeva, resembling Vasava himself, Shamvara stole you away. Stricken with sorrow for a son like you your mother is bewailing like a cow estranged from its calf. Because you were brought here in your very infancy your father, having the emblem of Garuda on his flag, and more powerful than even Shakra himself, does not know it.

units.sanskrit: कान्त वृष्णिकुमारस् त्वं न हि त्वं शम्बरात्मजः । वीर नैवंविधान् पुत्रान् दानवा जनयन्ति हि ॥ ततो ऽहं कामयामि त्वां न हि त्वं जनितो मया । रूपं ते सौम्य पश्यन्ती सीदामि हृदि दुर्बला ॥
units.english: lord, you are a Vrishni prince and not a son of Shamvara. Besides the Dānavas cannot beget a son like yourself. gentle one, seek you as my lover, because have not given birth to you. Seeing your beauty my weak heart is drooping.

units.sanskrit: तन्मे मनसि वार्ष्णेय प्रतिसंधातुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: Besides Vrishni hero, you should seek in my heart what desire is there.

units.sanskrit: एष ते कथितः सौम्य सद्भावस् त्वयि यो मम । यथा न मम पुत्रस् त्वं न पुत्रः शम्बरस्य च ॥ कामदेवश् च वीर त्वं रतिं मां विद्धि वै प्रभो । शंकरस्य च शापेन त्वम् अनङ्गगतिः पुरा ॥ तत् कालमायया रूपं कृत्वा दैत्यस्य वेश्मनि । विशीर्णा साहम् उषिता दैत्यस्यास्य च वेश्मनि । श्रुत्वैतन् निखिलं सर्वं मायावत्या प्रभाषितम् । चक्रायुधात्मजः क्रुद्धः शम्बरं स समाह्वयत् ॥ समस्तमायामायाज्ञो विक्रान्तः समरे ऽव्ययः । अष्टम्यां निहतो युद्धे मायया कालशम्बरः ॥
units.english: have thus described to you how you are not a son of myself and Shamvara and how have grown attached to you -. Pradyumna, the son of the holder of discus, had mastered all forms of illusion. So thus addressed by Māyāvati and worked up with anger, he, exclaiming his own name, called Shamvara. It was drawn by a thousand bear and tied with the ropes of snakes. However the heroic Kāma, displaying light-handedness, sundered them with his arrows into many pieces. If was dreadful, impassable and full of weapons, and it extended the territories of Yama. Hearing of the death of a young son like yourself Bhishmaka's daughter will bewail piteously. He then struck Shamvara with it and excited his anger in battle –. That arrow cutting to his very vitals, Shamvara, the enemy of gods, was greatly bewildered. And holding the reins of the car he lost consciousness. As the wind scatters clouds so those Sharabhas, having eight legs, claws and teeth, pursued the lions.

units.sanskrit: तमृक्षवन्ते नगरे निहत्यासुरसत्तमम् । गृह्य मायावतीं देवीं स्वाम् अगच्छत् पुरीं पितुः ॥ सो ऽन्तरिक्षगतो भूत्वा मायया शीघ्रविक्रमः । आजगाम पुरीं रम्यां रक्षितां तेजसा पितुः ॥ सो ऽन्तरिक्षात् प्रपतितः केशवान्तःपुरे शिशुः । मायावत्या सह तया रूपवान् इव मन्मथः ॥ तस्मिंस् तत्रावपतिते महिष्यः केशवस्य याः । विस्मिताश् चैव हृष्टाश् च भीराश् चैवाभवंस् तदा ॥ ततस् तं कामसंकाशं कान्तया सह संगतम् । प्रेक्षन्त्यो हृष्टवदनाः पिबन्त्यो नयनासवम् ॥ तं व्रीडितमुखं दृष्ट्वा सज्जमानं पदे पदे । अभवन् स्निग्धसंकल्पाः प्रहृष्टाः कृष्णयोषितः ॥ रुक्मिणी त्व् एव तं दृष्ट्वा शोकार्ता पुत्रगृद्धिनी । सपत्नीशतसंकीर्णा सबाष्पा वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥ यादृक् स्वप्नो मया दृष्टो निशाया यौवने गते । कंसारिणा समानीय दत्तं साहारपल्लवम् ॥ शशिरश्मिप्रतीकाशं मुक्तादाम च शोभनम् । केशवेनाङ्कम् आरोप्य मम कण्ठे न्यबध्यत ॥
units.english: On account of the illusion being dispelled by you we have been pleased -. Formerly pleased the goddess Umā conferred that on me and said Shamvara, take the golden club. Thus addressed by Maghavān Nārada speedily went away —. Before the completion of the seventh night Shamvara had stolen you away from the lying-in-room. large-armed hero, when Shamvara carried you away Keshava disregarded him in the interest of the great work of the gods namely the destruction of Shamvara. Know as your former wife Rati the spouse of Shamvara by name Māyāvati. slayer of your enemies, do you take this Vaishanava weapon and highly lustrous coat of mail. The king of gods has sent them for you. You should be careful when you fight with your enemy. Thus eulogised by Kāma the goddess was pleased -. giver of honor, may vanquish all my enemies. As soon as it approached him, it became a garland of lotuses around Pradyumna's neck. And he looked like the moon encircled by stars –. By the energy of that Vaishnava arrow all his flesh, bones, nerves, skull and blood were reduced to ashes. As a lover goes to his love so Rukshmini's son, fatigued with fighting, went with hasty steps into the city and met his consort -. When Pradyumna thus came down Keshava's queens were all filled with surprise, joy and fear. Afterwards seeing that young man, resembling Kāma himself, with his wife, their faces grew delighted; and they, with their eyes, as if drank his ambrosial beauty. Beholding that boy, Rukshmini, the mother of a son, encircled by her hundred co-wives, was striken with sorrow. Keshava took me on his lap and put a garland of pearls resembling the rays of the moon around my neck.

units.sanskrit: श्यामा सुचारुकेशा स्त्री शुक्लाम्बरविभूषिता । पद्महस्ता निरीक्षन्ती प्रविष्टा मम वेश्मनि ॥
units.english: youthful lady, with beautiful curling hairs, clad in a white raiment and with a lotus in her hand, entered into my room. And she sprinkled me with beautiful water.

units.sanskrit: मम मूर्धन्य् उपाघ्राय दत्ता स्रक् सा तया मम ॥
units.english: Afterwards that lady touched my head with her hands and gave me a garland of lotuses.

units.sanskrit: एवं स्वप्नं कीर्तयन्ती रुक्मिणी हृष्टमानसा । सखीजनवृता देवी कुमारं वीक्ष्य तं मुहुः । इत्य् अतो ऽनन्तरं तत्र अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् एव तत् । जीवपुत्रा त्वया पुत्र का सा भाग्यविभूषिता । किम् अर्थं चाम्बुदश्याम सभार्यस् त्वम् इहागतः ॥ अस्मिन् वयसि सुव्यक्तं प्रद्युम्नो मम पुत्रकः । व्यक्तं वृष्णिकुमारो ऽयं न मिथ्या मम तर्कितम् । विज्ञातो ऽसि मया चिह्नैर् विना चक्रं जनार्दनः ॥
units.english: Having thus described her dream, Rukshmini, encircled by her female friends, cast her looks again and again on the prince and said:—Blessed is that woman whose son is such a beautiful, long-lived boy resembling Kāma and just ushered into the first stage of youth. son, what lucky woman has been blessed with a son like yourself black like clouds Why have you come here with your wife? Alas, if the powerful Death had not carried him away my baby Pradyumna would have been of this age by this time. My surmise can never be untrue. Forsooth you are a prince of the Vrishni family; from the marks of your body you look like Janārddana without his discus.

units.sanskrit: मुखं नारायणस्येव केशाः केशान्त एव च । मूर्धवक्षोभुजैस् तुल्यो हलिनः श्वशुरस्य मे ॥
units.english: Your face and hairs resemble those of Nārāyana and your thighs, arms and breast resemble those of my father-in-law and Haladhara.

units.sanskrit: अहो जनार्दनस्यास्य दिव्या त्वम् अपरा तनुः ॥
units.english: Alas, you look like the second celestial body of Nārāyana. Who are you, my child?

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे कृष्णः सहसा प्रविवेश ह । नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शम्बरस्य वधं प्रति ॥
units.english: In the meantime Krishna all on a sudden entered there hearing from Nārada of the destruction of Shamvara -.

units.sanskrit: स्नुषां मायावतीं चैव हृष्टचेता जनार्दनः ॥ सो ऽब्रवीत् सहसा देवीं रुक्मिणीं देवताम् इव । अयं ते देवि संप्राप्तः पुत्रश् चापधरः प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Beholding his eldest son there, along with his daughter-in-law Māyāvati resembling Cupid himself, Janārddana was filled with joy and said to the goddess-like Rukshmini: goddess, here is your son the great bow-man.

units.sanskrit: अनेन शम्बरं हत्वा मायायुद्धविशारदम् । हता मायाश् च ताः सर्वा याभिर् देवान् अबाधत ॥
units.english: He has killed Shamvara, an expert of illusion and has learnt all his illusory arts by which he used to torment the gods.

units.sanskrit: सती चेयं शुभा साध्वी भार्या वै तनयस्य ते । मायावतीति विख्याता शम्बरस्य गृहोषिता । मा च ते शम्बरस्येयं पत्नीत्य् एवं व्यथा भवेत् ॥
units.english: This auspicious and chaste lady is the wife of your son. She was up to this time living in Shamvara's house under the name of Māyāvati. Do not distress your mind thinking her as the wife of Shamvara.

units.sanskrit: नेत्राग्निना त्र्यम्बकस्य शूलपाणेः पुरा युगे । कामपत्नी हि कन्यैषा कामकामा रतिः शुभा । मायारूपेण तं दैत्यं मोहयत्य् असकृच् छुभा ॥
units.english: Know her as Rati, the beloved consort of Kāma. Formerly when Manmatha became limbless being consumed by Harā's fiery anger this auspicious lady, up to this time, always kept that Daitya infatuated with her likeness made by her illusory powers.

units.sanskrit: न चैषा तस्य कौमारे वशे तिष्ठति शोभना । अत्ममायामयं रूपं कृत्वा शम्बरम् आविशत् ॥
units.english: Even in her youth this beautiful lady did not seek Shamvara; creating her own like-ness by her illusory powers she used to send her to Shamvara.

units.sanskrit: पत्न्य् एषा मम पुत्रस्य स्नुषा तव वराङ्गना । लोककान्तस्य साहाय्यं करिष्यति मनोमयम् ॥ प्रवेशयैनां भवनं पूज्या ह्य् एषा स्नुषा मम । चिरप्रनष्टं च सुतं भजस्य पुनरागतम् ॥ वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवी कृष्णेनोदाहृतं तदा । प्रहर्षम् अतुलं लेभे रुक्मिणी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: fair lady, this my son's wife, and your daughter-in-law will help Kāma and please him, She is our eldest daughter-in-law and deserves our affection. Take her to your room and nourish your lost son who has come back –. Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing those words given vent to by Krishna Rukshmini attained to an excess of delight and said:—Most fortunate am since my heroic son has come back again.

units.sanskrit: अहो धन्यतरास्मीति वीरपुत्रसमागमात् । अद्य मे सफलः कामः पूर्णश् चाद्य मनोरथः । आगच्छ पुत्र भवनं विशस्व सह भार्यया ॥
units.english: Blessed is my birth and have achieved my object since my lost son has returned with his beloved wife. Come my son and enter this room with your wife.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽभिवाद्य चरणौ गोविन्दं मातरं च सः । उत्थाप्य तं परिष्वज्य मूर्ध्न्य् उपाघ्राय वीर्यवान् । प्रद्युम्नं बलिनां श्रेष्ठं केशवः परवीरहा ॥
units.english: Thereupon having saluted his mother and Govinda Pradyumna bowed unto Haladhara. Thereupon raising up Pradyumna the foremost of the powerful Keshava, the slayer of enemy's warriors, embraced him and smelt his head.

units.sanskrit: स्नुषां चोत्थाप्य तां देवीं रुक्मिणी रुक्मभूषणां । परिष्वज्योपसंगृह्य स्नेहाद् गद्गदभाषिणी ॥
units.english: The goddess Rukshmini too, with words suppressed with affection, raised up her daughter-in-law adorned with gold, placed her on her lap and embraced her.

units.sanskrit: समेतं भवनं पत्न्या शच्येन्द्रम् अदितिर् यथा । प्रवेशयाम् आस तदा रुक्मिणी सुतम् आगतम् । एवम् उक्ता तु कृष्णेन रुक्मिणी योषितां वरा । गृहं प्रवेशयाम् आस स्नुषया सह भामिनी ।
units.english: Thereupon as Aditi conducts the king of gods with Sachi into her own room so Rukshmini took her son who had returned with his wife to her own room -. am describing the evening Mantra which Baladeva recited at that time for protecting Pradyumna. If one recites it in the evening he has his soul purified.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच हृतो यदैव प्रद्युम्नः शम्बरेणात्मघातिना । तम् एव मासं साम्बस् तु जाम्बवत्याम् अजायत ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said;—In the same month in which Pradyumna was stolen away by Shamvara desirous of killing himself Jāmvavati gave birth to Shāmva.

units.sanskrit: बाल्यात् प्रभृति रामेण मानेषु विनियोजितः । रामाद् अनन्तरं चैव मानितः सर्ववृष्णिभिः ॥
units.english: From his boyhood he was trained by Rāma in the use of arms and the other Vrishnis used to respect him considering him little inferior to Rāma.

units.sanskrit: जातमात्रे ततः कृष्णः शुभं तत् पुरम् आविशत् । निहतामित्रसामन्तः शक्रोद्यानं यथामरः ॥
units.english: From his birth Krishna, shorn of enemies and neighbouring hostile kings, lived in his capital happily as the immortals live in the garden of Nandana -.

units.sanskrit: यादवीं च श्रियं दृष्ट्वा स्वां श्रियं द्वेष्टि वासवः । जनार्दनभयाच् चैव न शान्तिं लेभिरे नृपाः ॥
units.english: At that time the hostile kings could not enjoy peace in fear of Janarddana; and witnessing the prosperity of the Yadavas even Vāsava did not like his own riches.

units.sanskrit: दुर्योधनस्य यज्ञे वै समेयुः सर्वपार्थिवाः ॥
units.english: Thereupon office on a time Duryodhana undertook the celebration of a sacrifice in Hastināpur and all the kings set out for that city.

units.sanskrit: तां श्रुत्वा माधवीं लक्ष्मीं सपुत्रं च जनार्दनम् । पुरीं द्वारावतीं चैव निविष्टां सागरान्तरे ॥ दूतैस् तैः कृतसंधानाः पृथिव्यां सर्वपार्थिवाः । श्रियं द्रष्टुं हृषीकेशम् आजग्मुः कृष्णमन्दिरम् ॥
units.english: Hearing of Janārddana with his sons, his prosperity and the city of Dwārakā situate on the bank of the ocean, those kings, collecting information through their emissaries, arrived at Krishna's palace, who was fond of guests and had controlled his senses, for seeing him -.

units.sanskrit: दुर्योधनमुखाः सर्वे धृतराष्ट्रवशानुगाः । पाण्डवप्रमुखाश् चैव धृष्टद्युम्नादयो नृपाः ॥ पाण्ड्यचोलकलिङ्गेशा बाह्लीका द्रविडाः शकाः । ते पर्वतं रैवतकं परिवार्यावनीश्वराः । विविशुर् योजनाढ्यासु स्वासु स्वास्व् अवनीष्व् अथ ॥
units.english: The king Duryodhana and others who were under the subjection of Dhritarashtra, the sons of Pandu, Dhristadyumna and others, the kings of Pandya, Chola, Kalinga, Vahlika Drāvida and Khasa with eighteen Akshowhinis of soldiers arrived at the city of Yadavas protected by Krishna's arms. After those kings had been accommodated in their respective quarters set apart for them, the lotus-eyed Hrishikesha, with leading Yadavas, went to them.

units.sanskrit: स तेषां नरदेवानां मध्ये मधुनिषूदनः । स तत्र समुदाचारं यथास्थानं यथावयः । कृत्वा सिंहासने कृष्णः काञ्चने निषसाद ह ॥
units.english: The Yadu king Madhusudana shone in the midst of those kings like the autumnal sun. Thereupon showing them civilities according to their age and place Krishna sat on his golden throne.

units.sanskrit: राजानो ऽपि यथास्थानं निषेदुर् विविधेष्व् अथ । सुराणाम् असुराणां च सदने ब्रह्मणो यथा ॥
units.english: The kings too occupied seats according to their ranks. As the gods and Asuras shine in Brahma's Durbar-Hall so those kings appeared exquisitely beautiful.

units.sanskrit: यदूनां पार्थिवानां च केशवस्योपशृण्वतः ॥
units.english: Thereupon in the hearing of Keshava, the Yadus and kings discoursed on various themes -.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे वायुर् ववौ मेघरवोद्धतः । तद् दुर्दिनतलं भित्त्वा नारदः प्रत्यदृश्यत । संवेष्टितजटाभारो वीणासक्तेन बाहुना ॥
units.english: In the meantime there blew a hurricane accompanied with the muttering of clouds charged with lighting. few moments after riving from that unfair weather, Nārada appeared there covered entirely with matted locks and with the Vinā in his hand –.

units.sanskrit: नारदो ऽग्निशिखाकारः श्रीमाञ् शक्रसखो मुनिः ॥
units.english: Sakra's friend, the ascetic Nārada, effulgent like fire, dropped before the kings like a scintillation.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् भूमौ निपतिते नारदे मुनिपुंगवे । सो ऽवगाह्य नरेन्द्राणां मध्यं सागरसंनिभम् । आसनस्थं यदुश्रेष्टम् उवाच मुनिर् अव्ययः ॥ आश्चर्यं खलु देवानाम् एकस् त्वं पुरुषोत्तम । धन्यश् चासि महाबाहो लोके नान्यो ऽस्ति कश् चन ॥ एवम् उक्तः स्मितं कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच मुनिं प्रभुः । आश्चर्यश् चैव धन्यश् च दक्षिणाभिः सहेत्य् अहम् ॥ एवम् उक्तो मुनिश्रेष्ठः प्राह मध्ये महीक्षिताम् । कृष्ण पर्याप्तवाक्यो ऽस्मि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ॥ तं प्रस्थितम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवाः प्राहुर् ईश्वरम् । गुह्यं मन्त्रम् अजानन्तो वचनं नारदेरितम् ॥ आश्चर्य इत्य् अभिहितो धन्यो ऽसीति च माधव । किम् एतन् नाभिजानीमो दिव्यं मन्त्रपदं महत् । यदि श्राव्यम् इदं कृष्ण श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥ तान् उवाच ततः कृष्णः सर्वान् पार्थिवपुंगवान् । श्रोतव्यं नारदस् त्व् एष द्विजो वः कथयिष्यति ॥
units.english: As soon as that foremost of ascetics, Nārada touched the ground the unfair weather disappeared. Having entered that ocean-like court of the kings Nārada said to the eternal Yadu king who was seated on his throne:— thou of large arms, thou alone hast become an object of wonder to the gods. Purusottama, there is none blessed like thee in the world. Thus addressed the powerful Krishna, smilingly said:—Yes am an object of surprise and good luck, especially in the matter of presents. Thus spoken to in the midst of kings the foremost of Munis, Nārada said, Krishna, have got the proper reply. now depart for my wished-for region -. The kings present in that meeting could not make out the mystery of Nārada's words. Seeing therefore, Nārada, about to start they said to Keshava, the lord of the universe :— Mādhava, Nārada said Wonder and blessed and you too replied saying Presents. Krishna, we have not been able to decipher these celestial expressions. If we are worthy of listening to the true import we wish to hear it -. Krishna then said to all those leading kings:—Yes, you are the fit persons to hear it and the twice-born Nārada will relate it.

units.sanskrit: यत् त्वयाभिहितं वाक्यं मया च प्रतिभाषितम् ॥
units.english: celestial saint, describe to these kings who are anxious to hear the true import of your question and my reply.

units.sanskrit: स पीठे काञ्चने शुभ्रे सूपविष्टः स्वलंकृतः । प्रभवं तस्य वाक्यस्य प्रवक्तुम् उपचक्रमे ॥
units.english: Thereat Nārada, seated on a white golden seat beautifully embellished, began to explain those words -.

units.sanskrit: श्रुयतां भो नृपश्रेष्ठा यावन्तः स्थ समागताः । अहं कदाचिद् गङ्गायास् तीरे त्रिषवणातिथिः । चराम्य् एकः क्षपापाये संदृश्यति दिवाकरे ॥
units.english: Narada said:— ye assembled kings, hear how have mastered this great question. Once on a time when the sun rose after the termination of the night was alone walking on the bank of the Gangā. saw a tortoise of the shape of my Vinā, extending over two Krosas.

units.sanskrit: चतुश्चरणसंश्लिष्टं क्लिन्नं शैवलपङ्किलम् । मम वीणाकृतिं कूर्मं गजचर्मचयोपमम् ॥ सो ऽहं तं पाणिना स्पृष्ट्वा प्रोक्तवाञ् जलचारिणम् । त्वम् आश्चर्यशरीरो ऽसि कूर्म धन्यश् च मे मतः ॥ तोये चरसि निःशङ्कः किं चिद् अप्य् अविचिन्तयन् ॥ स माम् उवाचाम्बुचरः कूर्मो मानुषवत् स्वयम् । किम् आश्चर्यं मयि मुने धन्यश् चाहं कथं विभो ॥ गङ्गेयं निम्नगा धन्या किम् आश्चर्यम् अतः परम् । सो ऽहं कुतूहलाविष्टो नदीं गङ्गाम् उपस्थितः । धन्यासि त्वं नदीश्रेष्ठे नित्यम् आश्चर्यदर्शने ॥
units.english: It was huge like a mountain, had four legs, two coatings, was soaked with water, and covered with mosses. Its skin was hard like that of an elephant. Then touching that acquatic animal with my hands said:— tortoise, methinks you have a wonderful body and are fortunate, for you are covered with these two invincible coatings. And not caring for any body you, without any anxiety, range in the water –. Hearing it that water-ranging tortoise said to me like a man:—What wonder is there in me, Muni? And how can be blessed? This Gangā, flowing downwards, is blessed in whom range hundreds and thousands of animals like myself. What is more wonderful than she? Thereat filled with curiosity approached the river Gangā and said:— foremost of rivers, you have many lakes in you. Adorned with many huge-bodied animals, you, protecting the hermitages, are you going to the ocean.

units.sanskrit: या त्वम् एवं महादेहैः श्वापदैर् उपशोभिता । एवम् उक्ता ततो गङ्गा रूपिणी प्रत्यभाषत । नारदं देवगन्धर्वं शक्रस्य दयितं द्विजम् ॥ नाहं धन्या द्विजश्रेष्ठ नाप्य् आश्चर्योपशोभिता । तव सत्ये निविष्टस्य वाक्यं मां प्रतिबाधते ॥
units.english: Blessed are you therefore and have many wonders in you -. Janamejaya, thus spoken to Gangā, in her own form, appeared before the foremost of the twice-born, the celestial Gandharva Nārada, the favourite of Indra and said celestial songster, foremost of the twice-born, you fond of quarrels, do not say so; am nither blessed nor do contain wonders. am afraid of the words of a truthful person like yourself.

units.sanskrit: लोकाश्चर्यकरो लोके धन्यश् चैवार्णवो द्विज । यत्राहम् इव विस्तीर्णाः शतशो यान्ति निम्नगाः ॥
units.english: twice-born one, that ocean is blessed and full of big wonders where hundreds of rivers like myself are flowing.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं त्रिपथगावाक्यं श्रुत्वार्णवम् उपस्थितः । आश्चर्यः खलु लोकानां धन्यश् चासि महार्णव । स्थाने त्वा वारिवाहिन्यः सरितो लोकभावनाः । इमाः समभिगच्छन्ति पत्न्यो लोकनमस्कृताः ॥ समुद्रस् त्व् एवम् उक्तस् तु ततो माम् अब्रवीद् वचः । स्वं जलौघतलं भित्त्वा व्युत्थितः पवनेरितः ॥ मा मैवं देवगन्धर्व नास्म्य् आश् चर्यो द्विजोत्तम । वसुधेयं मुने धन्या यत्राहम् उपरि स्थितः । ऋते तु पृथिवीं लोके किम् आश्चर्यम् अतः परम् ॥ सो ऽहं सागरवाक्येन क्षितिं क्षितितले स्थितः । कौतूहलसम् आविष्टो ह्य् अब्रुवं जगतो गतिम् ॥ आश्चर्या चासि भूतेषु महत्या क्षमया युते ॥ क्षमा त्वत्तः प्रसूता च कर्म चाम्बरगामिनाम् ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Ganga flowing in three ways went to the ocean and said:— great ocean, lord of waters, you are the origin of all waters—therefore you are blessed and full of wonders in the world. Specially, the rivers, full of waters, worshipped by the world and purifying them, come to you as your wives. Thus addressed, riving the waters, by the force of the wind, the ocean rose up and said:— celestial songster, foremost of the twice-born, do not say so; am neither full of wonders, nor am blessed. Blessed is the earth on whom live. What is more wonderful than the earth in the universe? Hearing the words of the ocean,, filled with curiosity, went to the bed of the earth and said to Prithivi the energy of the universe:— beautiful earth, endued with great patience, thou art blessed and wonderful in the universe for thou art sustaining all the worlds. Thou hast given birth to the churning rod of men and patience. Thou art the work of the sky-ranging gods.

units.sanskrit: ततो भूः स्तुतिवाक्येन सा मयोक्तेन लज्जिता । विहाय सहजं धैर्यम् अथ मां प्रत्यभाषत ॥
units.english: Excited at my words and forsaking her natural patience she replied:— celestial songster fond of quarrels, do not say so.

units.sanskrit: नास्मि धन्या न चाश्चर्या पारक्येयं धृतिर् मम ॥
units.english: am neither blessed nor wonderful. This my patience is dependant on another.

units.sanskrit: एते धन्या द्विजश्रेस्थ पर्वता धारयन्ति माम् । एष्व् आश्चर्याणि दृश्यन्ते एते लोकस्य सेतवः ॥
units.english: foremost of the twice-born, the mountains, that are upholding me, are indeed great and wonders are seen in them. They are the bridges of the worlds.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पृथिव्या वाक्येन पर्वतान् समुपस्थितः । धन्या भन्तो दृश्यन्ते बह्वाश्चर्याश् च भूधराः ॥
units.english: kings, hearing those words went to the mountains and said ye mountains, great you are and full of many great wonders.

units.sanskrit: तेन रत्नाकराः सर्वे भवन्तो भुवि शाश्वताः ॥
units.english: Besides you are the mines of gold and many precious jems, and you are living on earth for ever.

units.sanskrit: ऊचुर् मां सान्त्वयुक्तानि वचांसि वनशोभिताः ॥
units.english: The immobile mountains, adorned with forests, replied to my question in consoling accents.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षे न वयं धन्या नाप्य् आश्चर्याणि सन्ति नः । ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिर् धन्यः स चाश्चर्यः सुरेष्व् अपि ॥
units.english: Brāhmana saint, we are not great and there is no wonder in us. The creator Brahmā alone is great and wonderful even amongst the celestials -.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पितामहं गत्वा सर्वप्रभवम् अव्ययम् । सो ऽहं स्वयंभुवं देवं लोकयोनिं चतुर्मुखम् । पारंपर्याद् उपगतः प्रणामावनताननः ॥ सो ऽहं वाक्यसमाप्त्यर्थं श्रावयाम्य् आत्मयोनिनम् । न किं चिद् अन्यत् पश्यामि भूतं यद् भवता समम् । त्वत्तः सर्वम् इदं जातं जगत् स्थावरजंगमम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon thinking that with the Creator Brahmā, this cycle of questions would terminate went to him. Approaching in order, the four-headed, Self-sprung Deity, the origin of the world saluted him and said to him, expecting that my words would come to a close:—Thou art alone great, wonderful and the preceptor of the world. There is no other creature in this world which is equal to thee. From thee has emanated this universe identical with mobile and immobile creations.

units.sanskrit: भवन्ति सर्वदेवेश दृश्यं सर्वम् इदं वपुः ॥ तेन खल्व् असि देवानां देवदेवः सनातनः । तेषामेवासि यत् स्रष्टा लोकानाम् अपि संभवः ॥
units.english: king of gods, the gods, Dānavas and other creations of the three worlds, and this universe, manifest and unmanifest, have all emanated from thee. Thou art the eternal king of gods. God, while thou art the best of gods what wonder is there that thou art the origin of all the worlds.

units.sanskrit: ततो माम् आह भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । धन्याश्चर्याश्रितैर् वाक्यैः किं मां नारद भाषसे ॥
units.english: Hearing my words the Grand-Father Brahmā said:— Nārada, why do you call me great and wonderful? The Vedas, which are upholding the worlds, are great and wonderful.

units.sanskrit: ऋक्सामयजुषां सत्यम् अथर्वणि च यन् मतम् । तन्मयं विद्धि मां विप्र धृतो ऽहं तैर् मया च ते ॥
units.english: Vipra, know me as identical with the truths that lie in Rik, Saman, Yayur and Atharvan. The Vedas are upholding me and too uphold them –.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं स्वयंभुवचनाद् वेदान् वै समुपस्थितः । उवाच चैनांश् चतुरो मन्त्रप्रवचनार्चितान् ॥ धन्या भवन्तः पुण्याश् च नित्यम् आश्चर्यविश्रुताः । आधाराश् चैव विप्राणाम् एवम् आह प्रजापतिः ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of the Self-sprung Parameshtin, made up my mind for going to the Vedas. According to the words of the Grand-Father went near the four Vedas worshipped with mantras and said:— ye Vedas, the Grand-Father has said that you are great, wonderful and the source of the Brāhmanas.

units.sanskrit: स्वयंभुवो ऽपीह परं भवत्सु प्रश्न आहितः । युष्मत् परतरं नास्ति श्रुत्या वा तपसापि वा ॥
units.english: You are superior even to the Self-sprung Deity. There is none in Sruti and Tapas superior to you. Therefore have come to ask you.

units.sanskrit: प्रतूचुस् ते ततो वाक्यं देवा माम् अभितः स्थिताः । आश्चर्याश् चैव धन्याश् च यज्ञाश् चात्मपरायणाः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the Vedas, with their faces towards me, replied:—The Yajnas are great and wonderful.

units.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थे तु वयं सृष्टाः सृष्टा येन स्म नारद । ततो ऽहम् अब्रुवं यज्ञान् गृहस्थाग्निपुरस्कृतान् ॥ भो यज्ञाः परमं तेजो युष्मासु खलु लक्ष्यते । ब्रह्मणाभिहितं वाक्यं यन् मे वेदैर् इहेरितम् ॥
units.english: Nārada, we have been created for Yajnas and are not masters of ourselves. So the Yajnas lord over us. Hearing that the Vedas are superior to the Self-sprung Deity and the Yajnas are superior to the Vedas approached the Yajnas headed by the household fire and said -:— ye Yajnas, as spoken by the Grand-Father and the Vedas, great effulgence is seen in you.

units.sanskrit: आश्चर्यम् एतल् लोकेषु भवद्भ्यो नाधिगम्यते । धन्याः खलु भवन्तो ये द्विजातीनां स्ववंशिनः ॥
units.english: There is nothing in this world more wonderful than you. You are born from the twice-born and are therefore great.

units.sanskrit: तेन खल्व् अग्नयस् तृप्तिं पुष्माभिर् यान्ति तर्पिताः । भागैश् च त्रिदशाः सर्वे मन्त्रैश् चैव महर्षयः ॥
units.english: By you, with a portion of the sacrificial offerings the gods are pleased, the great saints with mantras and the Agnis with oblations –.

units.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमादयो यज्ञा मम वाक्याद् अनन्तरम् । प्रत्यूचुर् मां परं वाक्यं सर्वे यूपध्वजाः स्थिताः ॥
units.english: After had finished my say Agnisthoma and other Yajnas, stationed in the sacrificial grounds, replied:— Muni, there is no such word as wonder and great in our midst.

units.sanskrit: आश्चर्यं परमं विष्णुः स ह्य् अस्माकं परा गतिः ॥
units.english: Vishnu alone is the great wonder—and he is our supreme refuge.

units.sanskrit: यद् आज्यं वयम् अश्नीमो हुतम् अग्निषु पावनम् । तत् सर्वं पुण्डरीकाक्षो लोकमूर्तिः प्रयच्छति ॥
units.english: The lotus-eyed Vishnu, manifested as men, offers those oblations into fire on which we feed.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽपि धन्यो महाबाहुर् दक्षिणासहितः क्रतुः । यद् रूपं पुण्डरीकाक्षो दक्षिणाप्रियया सह । सो ऽहं विष्णोर् गतिं प्रेप्सुर् इह संपतितो भुवि । दृष्टश् चायं मया विष्णुर् भवद्भिर् अभिसंवृतः ॥
units.english: As the large-armed Vishnu, having eyes like red lotuses, is great with his consort, so great is a Yajna accompanied with presents. Afterwards came down on earth to ascertain Vishnu's movements and saw Krishna encircled by kings like your worthy selves.

units.sanskrit: धन्यश् चासीति भवतां मध्यस्थो ह्य् अत्र पार्थिवाः ॥
units.english: said to Mādhava surrounded by you all Thou art great and wonderful and he too replied saying with presents.

units.sanskrit: प्रत्युक्तोऽहम् अनेनाद्य वाक्यस्यास्य यद् उत्तरम् । दक्षिणाभिः सहेत्य् एवं पर्याप्तं वचनं मम ॥
units.english: This has put a stop to my words. Pursuing words in order, beginning with the tortoise have come here—and they have now been verified in this Purusha with Dakshinā.

units.sanskrit: तद् एतत् सर्वम् आख्यातं साधयामि यथागतम् ॥
units.english: have thus explained, as questioned by you, the secret of my words.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्त्वा स दिवं जगाम ह । नारदे तु गते स्वर्गं सर्वे ते पृथिवीक्षितः । विस्मिताः स्वानि राष्ट्राणि जग्मुः सबलवाहनाः ॥
units.english: now go whence have come. After the departure of Nārada to the celestial region, the kings, stricken with wonder, repaired to their respective territories with their army and conveyances.

units.sanskrit: जनार्दनो ऽपि सहितो यदुभिः पावकोपमैः । स्वम् एव भवनं वीरो विवेश यदुपुंगवः ॥
units.english: The heroic Yadu chief, Janārddana too, with the Yadavas, effulgent like fire, entered into his own palace -.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच पुनर् एव महाबाहो कृष्णस्य जगतीपतेः । न हि मे तृप्तिर् अस्तीह शृण्वतस् तस्य धीमतः । कर्मणाम् अनुसंधानं पुराणस्य महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— you of large arms, foremost of the twice-born, wish again to listen to an account of the glorious deeds of Krishna, the lord of the world. have not been satiated with listening to the extensive works of the high-souled, intelligent and ancient Purusha Krishna -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच नान्तः शक्यं प्रभावस्य वक्तुं वर्षशतैर् अपि । शरतल्पे शयानेन भीष्मेण परिचोदितः । गाण्डीवधन्वा बीभत्सुर् माहात्म्यं केशवस्य यत् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:— king, it is impossible to finish, even in hundred years, the account of the glorious deeds of Govinda. Hear now of the highly wonderful deeds of Keshava which Vibhatsu Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow, described excited by Bhisma lying on the bed of arrows.

units.sanskrit: राज्ञां मध्ये महाराज ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरम् अब्रवीत् । युधिष्ठिरं जितामित्रम् इति तच् छृणु कौरव ॥
units.english: royal descendant of Kuru, hear what he told his eldest brother Yudhisthira who had vanquished all his enemies, in the presence of the kings.

units.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच पुराहं द्वारकां यातः संबन्धीन् अवलोककः । न्यवसं पूजितस् तत्र भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकोत्तमैः ॥
units.english: Arjuna said:—Formerly to see my relations had gone to the city of Dwārakā and entertained by the Bhojas, Vrishnis and Andhakas had lived there for some time.

units.sanskrit: ततः कदाचिद् धर्मात्मा दीक्षितो मधुसूदनः । एकाहेन महाबाहुः शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: At that time the virtuous-souled and large-armed slayer of Madhu undertook the celebration of a sacrifice extending over a day according to Shastric rites.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णं विज्ञापयाम् आस परित्राहीति चाब्रवीत् ॥ ब्राह्मण उवाच रक्षाधिकारो भवतः परिरक्षस्व मां विभो । चतुर्थांशं हि धर्मस्य रक्षिता लभते फलम् ॥
units.english: When Krishna sat for the celebration of that sacrifice, one Brāhmana, describing his own affairs, sought for protection -. The Brāhmana said:— lord, thou art now in charge of the protection of subjects; besides a saviour is entitled to the one fourth share of the piety acquired by a good work.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच न भेतव्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठ रक्षामि त्वां कुतो ऽनघ । ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन भद्रं ते यद्य् अपि स्यात् सुदुष्करम् ॥
units.english: Vasudeva said:— foremost of the twice-born, may you farewell. Do not fear any body. will protect you from him, even if it be a difficult task, who is the cause of your fear.

units.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच जातो जातो महाबाहो पुत्रो मे ह्रियते विभो । त्रयो हृताश् चतुर्थं त्वं कृष्ण रक्षितुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: The Brāhmana said:— thou of large arms, my sons are stolen away as soon as they are born. sinless Krishna, three of my sons were stolen away as soon as they were born. Thou shouldst now protect the fourth son.

units.sanskrit: यथा ध्रियेद् अपत्यं मे तथा कुरु जनार्दन ॥ अर्जुन उवाच ततो माम् आह गोविन्दो दीक्षितो ऽस्मि क्रताव् इति । रक्षा च ब्राह्मणे कार्या सर्वावस्थागतैर् अपि ॥
units.english: Janārddana, my wife is under the labour pain. Thou shouldst so arrange that my child may not be stolen away -. Arjuna said:—Thereupon Govinda said to me am to day celebrating a sacrifice. But a Brāhmana should be protected by us in whatever circumstances we may be.

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाहम् एवं कृष्णस्य ततो ऽवोचं नरोत्तम । इत्य् उक्तः स स्मितं कृत्वा माम् उवाच जनार्दनः । रक्ष्यसीत्य् एवम् उक्तस् तु व्रीडितो ऽस्मि नराधिप ॥
units.english: Hearing those words of Krishna said to Govinda:—Appoint me, will remove the fear of the Brāhmana –. Thus addressed Janarddana, smiling a little, said:—Will you be able to save him? kings, was greatly ashamed hearing those words of Krishna.

units.sanskrit: ततो मां व्रीडितं ज्ञात्वा पुनर् आह जनार्दनः । त्वत्पुरोगाश् च गच्छन्तु वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथाः । ऋते रामं महाबाहुः प्रद्युम्नं च महाबलम् ॥
units.english: Seeing me thus ashamed Janārddana again said Go, if you are capable of protecting him. Except the large-armed Rāma and the great car-warrior Pradyumna, let all other members of the Vrishni and Andhaka families follow you.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽहं वृष्णिसैन्येन महता परिवारितः । अर्जुन उवाच सुमुहूर्तेन तु वयं तं ग्रामं प्राप्य भारत । विश्रान्तवाहनाः सर्वे वासायोपगतास् तदा ॥
units.english: Thereupon encircled by the Vrishni army, set out with the Brāhmana before me –. Arjuna said:— foremost of the Bharata race, within a moment we reached the boundary of the village and encamped because all our animals were tired.

units.sanskrit: ततो ग्रामस्य मध्ये ऽहं निविष्टः कुरुनन्दनः । ततः शकुनयो दीप्ता मृगाश् च क्रूरभाषिणः । संध्यारागो जपावर्णो भानुमांश् चैव निष्प्रभः । पपात महती चोल्का पृथिवी चाप्य् अकम्पत ॥ तान् समीक्ष्य महोत्पातान् दारुणांल् लोमहर्षणान् । युयुधानपुरोगाश् च वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथाः । सर्वे युक्तरथाः सज्जाः स्वयं चाहं तथाभवम् ॥
units.english: descendant of Kuru, a few moments after encircled by the huge Vrishni army entered into the city. At that time all was ablaze and burning vultures and beasts frighted me. Huge and black fire-brands fell down, the sun was shorn of its effulgence and the earth trembled. Beholding those dreadful and hair-stirring evil omens,, filled with anxiety, ordered my soldiers to get ready. Hearing it the great car warriors of the Vrishni and Andhaka families headed by Yuyudhana got ready their respective cars and too put on my arms –.

units.sanskrit: गते ऽर्धरात्रसमये ब्राह्मणो भयविक्लवः । उपागम्य भयाद् अस्मान् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: After the expiration of the mid-night that Brāhmana, stricken with fear, approached us and said My wife is on the point of giving birth to a child.

units.sanskrit: यत्ता भवन्तस् तिष्ठन्तु न भवेद् वञ्चना यथा ॥ तस्य विप्रस्य भवने ह्रियते ह्रियते इति ॥ अथाकाशे पुनर् वाचम् अश्रौषं बालकस्य वै । हाहेति ह्रियमाणस्य न च पश्यामि राक्षसम् ॥
units.english: Do you station yourselves so that may not be cheated -. In a moment, king, piteous cries were heard in the Brāhmana's house exclaiming Stolen! Stolen!. Afterwards we also heard the cries of the baby in the sky, but could not see the Rākshasa.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्माभिस् तदा तात शरवर्षैः समन्ततः । विष्टम्भिता दिशः सर्वा हृत एव स बालकः ॥
units.english: Afterwards we agitated all the quarters with a downpour of arrows, but the boy was however stolen away.

units.sanskrit: वृष्णयो हतसंकल्पास् तथाहं नष्टचेतनः । माम् एव हि विशेषेण ब्राह्मणः पर्यभाषत ॥ रक्षिष्यामीति चोक्तं ते न च रक्षसि मे सुतम् । शृणु वाक्यम् इदं शेषं यत् त्वम् अर्हसि दुर्मते ॥
units.english: When that boy was stolen away that Brāhmana crying addressed to us such harsh words that the Vrishnis lost themselves and too lost my senses. He particularly said to me:—You said that you would protect me, but could not do so. Therefore listen to these beneficial words, wicked minded wretch –.

units.sanskrit: वृथा त्वं स्पर्धसे नित्यं कृष्णेनामितबुद्धिना । यदि स्याद् इह गोविन्दो नैतद् अत्याहितं भवेत् ॥
units.english: You always vaunt with Keshava of incomparable intellect. Had Govinda been here this mischief would not have been created.

units.sanskrit: यथा चतुर्थं धर्मस्य रक्षिता लभते फलम् । पापस्यापि तथा मूढ भागं प्राप्नोत्य् अरक्षिता ॥ रक्षिष्यामीति चोक्तं ते न च शक्नोषि रक्षितुम् । मोघं गाण्डीवम् एतत् ते मोघं वीर्यं यशश् च ते ॥
units.english: stupid man, as a saviour is entitled to the one-fourth share of the virtue, so he, who cannot protect one, is constrained to participate of the sin; you said that you would protect me but you have not been able to do so. In vain is your Gāndiva, prowess and fame -.

units.sanskrit: अकिंचिद् उक्त्वा तं विप्रं ततो ऽहं प्रस्थितस् तदा । सह वृष्ण्यन्धकसुतैर् यत्र कृष्णो महाद्युतिः ॥
units.english: However did not speak anything to the Brāhmana, but went with the princes of the Vrishni and Andhaka families where the highly effulgent Krishna was.

units.sanskrit: स तु मां व्रीडितं दृष्ट्वा समाश्वस्य च माधवः । दर्शये द्विजसूनुं ते मावज्ञात्मानम् आत्मना । सुग्रीवं चैव शैब्यं च मेघपुष्पबलाहकौ । आरोप्य ब्राह्मणं कृष्णस् त्व् अवरोप्य च दारुकम् । माम् उवाच ततः शौरिः सारथ्यं क्रियताम् इति ॥ ततः समास्थाय रथं कृष्णो ऽहं ब्राह्मणः स च । अर्जुन उवाच ततः पर्वतजालानि सरितश् च सरांसि च । अपश्यं समतिक्रम्य सागरं मकरालयम् ॥
units.english: Afterwards going to city of Dwāravati saw Govinda the slayer of Madhu and he too, saw me, filled with shame and sorrow. Beholding me ashamed Mādhava consoled me and the Brāhmana with sweet words. Thereupon he said to Dāruka:—Get ready my horses, Sugriva, Saivya, Meghapushpa, and Balāhaka. Afterwards making the Brāhmana ascend the car and sending down Dāruka, Shura's descendant Krishna asked me to act as the charioteer. descendant of Kuru, afterwards, Krishna, the Brāhmana and myself set out on that car towards the north -. Arjuna said:—Thereupon crossing the mountains, rivers and forests we saw the ocean the abode of Makara.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽर्घ्यम् उदधिः साकाद् उपनिन्ये जनार्दने । प्राञ्जलिः समुपस्थाय किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत् ॥ प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां तम् उवाच जनार्दनः । अथाब्रवीत् समुद्रस् तं प्राञ्जलिर् गरुडध्वजम् । प्रसीद भगवन् मैवम् अन्यो ऽप्य् एवं गमिष्यति ॥
units.english: Thereat the ocean, in his true form, with folded hands and carrying Argya, appeared before Janārddana and said What am to do? – Having accepted the adoration from the ocean Janārddana said:— Lord of rivers, wish you to afford passage for my car. Thereupon Samudra, with folded hands, said to Garudadhwaja:—Be pleased Lord! do not act thus, or else others will do so.

units.sanskrit: त्वयैव स्थापितः पूर्वम् अगाधो ऽस्मि जनार्दन । त्वया प्रवर्तिते गाधे यास्यामि गमनीयताम् ॥ अन्ये ऽप्य् एवं गमिष्यन्ति राजानो दर्पमोहिताः । एवं निश्चित्य गोविन्द यत् क्षमं तत् समाचर ॥
units.english: Janārddana, thou didst formerly place me in this unfathomable expanse. shall have to follow the way thou wilt institute. If thou dost do so, other kings, elated with the pride of their strength, will cross me by this way. Therefore Govinda, do whatever thou dost think proper.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच ब्राह्मणार्थे मदर्थे च कुरु सागर मद्वचः । माम् ऋते न पुमान् कश्चिद् अन्यस् त्वां धर्षयिष्यति ॥
units.english: Vāsudeva said: For my sake and for this Brāhmana, follow my words. Save me no one else will be able to assail you.

units.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीत् समुद्रस् तु पुनर् एव जनार्दनम् । शोषयाम्य् एष मार्गं ते येन त्वं तात यास्यसि । रथेन सहसूतेन सध्वजेन च केशव ॥
units.english: Thereupon, in fear of a curse the ocean again said to Janārddana:—Let it be so. Krishna, slayer of Keshi, will dry up the path in which your car, adorned with flags, will proceed with its charioteer –.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच मया दत्तवरः पूर्वं न शोषं त्वम् इहार्हसि । मानुषास् ते न जानीयुर् विविधान् रत्नसंचयान् ॥
units.english: Vasudeva said:— ocean, had conferred upon you the boon formerly that you would never be dried up, lest the people might form an idea of the collection of your gems.

units.sanskrit: जलं स्तम्भय साधो त्वं ततो यास्याम्य् अहं रथी । न हि कश्चित् प्रमाणं ते रत्नानां वेत्स्यते नरः ॥
units.english: You are to stop the agitation of your water to that extent only that may admit me with my car. In that case no man will be able to estimate the collection of your jems -.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽर्णवं समुत्तीर्य कुरून् अप्य् उत्तरान् वयम् । क्षणेन समतिक्रान्ता गन्धमादनम् एव च ॥
units.english: Hearing it the ocean said So be it; and we proceeded through that lustrous red water as if we were on land. Within a moment we crossed the ocean, Uttarakuru and Gandhamādana.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तु पर्वताः सप्त केशवं समुपस्थिताः । जयन्तो वैजयन्तश् च नीलो रजतपर्वतः ॥ महामेरुः सकैलास इन्द्रकूटश् च नामतः । वर्णरूपाणि बिभ्रन्तो विविधान्य् अद्भुतानि च ॥ उपस्थाय च गोविन्दं किं कुर्मेत्य ब्रवंस् तदा । ते कृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रतिगृह्य च पर्वताः । प्रददुः कामतो मार्गं गच्छतो भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: Thereupon Jayanta, Vaijayanta, Neela, Rajata, Mahāmeru, Kailasha and Indrakuta, these seven mountains, assuming various wonderful forms, appeared before Keshava and saluting Govinda said:—What are we to do? Welcoming them all duly Hrishikesha, the slayer of Madhu, said to the mountains who stood before him with bending heads You are to give me passage. Hearing the words of Krishna and accepting them the mountains gave him the passage and disappeared. foremost of Bharata's race, beholding this work was filled with great surprise.

units.sanskrit: असक्तं च रथो याति मेघजालेष्व् इवांशुमान् ॥
units.english: However as the sun passes through clouds so our car careered on unobstructed.

units.sanskrit: सप्त द्वीपान् ससिन्धूंश् च सप्त सप्त गिरीन् अथ । लोकालोकं तथातीत्य विवेश सुमहत् तमः । ततः कदा चिद् दुःखेन रथम् ऊहुस् तुरंगमाः । पङ्कभूतं हि तिमिरं स्पर्शाद् विज्ञायते ऽनघ ॥
units.english: And that best of cars, crossing the seven insular continents, oceans and seven rivers as well as Lokaloka, entered another region –. While proceeding thus at a certain place found the horses carrying the car with great difficulty. Touching it with my hands perceived that the darkness was owing to thick mud.

units.sanskrit: अथ पर्वतभूतं तत् तिमिरं समपद्यत । ततश् चक्रेण गोविन्दः पाटयित्वा तु तत् तमः । आकाशं दर्शयाम् आस रथपन्थानम् ऊत्तमम् ॥
units.english: It gradually assumed the form of a mountain. Seeing it, Govinda dispelled that darkness and mud with his discus and the sky and the passage of the car became visible –.

units.sanskrit: भविष्यामीति संज्ञा मे भयं च विगतं मम ॥ ततस् तेजः प्रज्वलितम् अपश्यं वदतां वर । सर्वलोकं समाविश्य स्थितं पुरुषविग्रहम् ॥
units.english: When the sky became visible and we came beyond the pale of darkness my fear was removed and thought that was alive. few moments after saw in the sky a bundle of effulgence, of the shape of a man, extending over all the worlds –.

units.sanskrit: रथ एव स्थितश् चाहं स च ब्राह्मणसत्तमः ॥
units.english: Then Rishikesha entered into that bundle of effulgence and that best of Brāhmanas and myself waited on the car.

units.sanskrit: स मुहूर्तात् ततः कृष्णो निश्चक्राम तदा प्रभुः । चतुरो बालकान् गृह्य ब्राह्मणस्यात्मजांस् तदा ॥
units.english: Within a moment the powerful Krishna returned with the four sons of the Brāhmana and gave those three boys who had been stolen before and the new born baby into the hands of the Brāhmana –.

units.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टो ब्राह्मणस् तात पुत्रान् दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रभो । ततो वयं पुनः सर्वे ब्राह्मणस्य च ते सुताः । यथागता निवृत्ताः स्म तथैव भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: emperor, regaining his sons the Brāhmana was highly pleased and too was filled with great joy and surprise. foremost of the Bharatas, afterwards we, with the Brāhmana's sons, came out in the same way as we had gone there.

units.sanskrit: ततः स्म द्वारकां प्राप्ताः क्षणेन नृपसत्तम । असंप्राप्ते ऽर्धदिवसे विस्मितो ऽहं ततः पुनः ॥
units.english: foremost of kings, arriving at Dwārakā within a moment we saw that even the first part of the day was not complete. At that was again filled with surprise.

units.sanskrit: सपुत्रं भोजयित्वा तं द्विजं कृष्णो महायशाः । धनेन तर्पयित्वा च गृहं प्रास्थापयत् तदा ॥
units.english: There upon the highly illustrious Krishna fed that Brāhmana with his sons and satisfying him with riches sent him away to his own house -.

units.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच ततः कृष्णो भोजयित्वा शतानि सुबहूनि च । विप्राणाम् ऋषिकल्पानां कृतकृत्यो ऽभवत् तदा ॥ अर्चयित्वा सहस्रांशुं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम् । ततः कथान्ते तत्राहम् अभिगम्य जनार्दनम् । अपृच्छं तद् यथावृत्तं कृष्णं यद् दृष्ट्वान् अहम् ॥ कथं समुद्रः स्तब्धोदः कृतस् ते कमलेक्षण । पर्वतानां च विवरं कृतं ते कथम् अच्युत ॥
units.english: Arjuna said:— Bharata, afterwards, having fed many hundreds of Rishi-like Brāhmanas and taken his meals along with myself and other members of the Vrishni and Bhoja races, Krishna discoursed on various wonderful and divine topics –. After the termination of Janārddana's discourse,, filled with curiosity about what had seen, approached him and said:— lotus-eyed Krishna, how the water of the ocean came to a stand-still? How was that dreadfully dense darkness dispelled with thy discus? How didst thou enter into that bundle of effulgence? lord, why where the Brāhmana boys stolen by that effulgence.

units.sanskrit: कथं चाल्पेन कालेन कृतं नस् तद् गतागतम् । एतत् सर्वं यथावृत्तम् आचक्ष्व मम केशव ॥
units.english: How was such a long distance shortened? How could we go and come back within such a short time Keshava, do thou describe all these things duly to me –.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच मद्दर्शनार्थं ते बाला हृतास् तेन महात्मना । ब्रह्मतेजोमयं दिव्यम् आश्चर्यं दृष्टवान् असि । अहं स भरतश्रेष्ठ मत्तेजस् तत् सनातनम् ॥
units.english: Vasudeva said:—In order to see me that great Purusha stole away the sons of the Brāhmana thinking that for him would go there and not otherwise. foremost of Bharatas, the great divine effulgence which you saw there is nothing but me full of Brahma effulgence.

units.sanskrit: प्रकृतिः सा मम परा व्यक्ताव्यक्ता च भारत । तां प्रविश्य भवन्तीह मुक्ता भरतसत्तम ॥ सा सांख्यानां गतिः पार्थ योगिनां च तपस्विनाम् । तत् पदं परमं ब्रह्म सर्वं विभजते जगत् ॥
units.english: That is my eternal effulgent energy. That is my eternal great Prakriti, manifest and unmanifest. Entering into her understanding her nature the great Yogins attain to final liberation -. Prakriti is the refuge of the Sankhya Yogins and the ascetics. And she is the great Brāhmana. She makes divisions in the universe.

units.sanskrit: माम् एव तद् धनं तेजो ज्ञातुम् अर्हसि भारत । समुद्रः स्तब्धतोयो ऽहम् अहं स्तम्भयिता जलम् ॥
units.english: Bhārata, know her as my creative energy. am that ocean of stilled water. stilled her water.

units.sanskrit: अहं ते पर्वताः सप्त ये दृष्ट्वा विविधास् त्वया । अहं तमो घनीभूतम् अहम् एव च पाटकः ॥ अहं च कालो भूतानां धर्मश् चाहं प्रकीर्तितः । चन्द्रादित्यौ महाशैलाः सरितश् च सरांसि च । चतस्रश् च दिशः सर्वा ममैवात्मा चतुर्विधः । अर्जुन उवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश वेत्तुम् इच्छामि ते प्रभो । परं तत्त्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ त्वां प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि माधव । वासुदेव उवाच ब्रह्म च ब्राह्मणाश् चैव तपः सत्यं च भारत । उक्थ्यं बृहद्रथं चैव मत्तस् तद् विद्धि पाण्डव ॥
units.english: am those seven mountains and the pitch darkness begotten by mud which you saw. am the cloud-like darkness and its dispeller. am the author of elements and eternal religion. The moon, the sun, the huge mountains, the rivers, the lakes, the four quarters are my four-fold souls. From me have emanated the four Varnas and four Asramas. Know me as the author of four-fold learning -. Arjuna said:— lord, divine master of all creatures, Purusottama, salutation unto thee. wish to know thy true self and therefore have sought thy protection and put this question. Vasudeva said:— descendant of Bharata, son of Pandu, from me have emanated Brahman, Brāhmana, Tapas, truth and every other thing small or great.

units.sanskrit: प्रियस् ते ऽहं महाबाहो प्रियो मे ऽसि धनंजय । तेन ते कथयिष्यामि नान्यथा वक्तुम् उत्सहे । ब्रह्मा रुद्रस् तथेन्द्रश् च वरुणश् च तथा यमः । ऋषयो देवता यज्ञा मत्तेजो भरतर्षभ ॥
units.english: large-armed Dhananjaya, am your favourite and you are my favourite. And for this tell you this or else would not have done so. foremost of Bharatas, son of Prithā, am Rik, Yayush, Sāman and Atharvan –. The Rishis, the gods and the Yajnas are my energies.

units.sanskrit: पृथिवी वायुर् आकाशम् आपो ज्योतिश् च पञ्चमम् । चन्द्रादित्याव् अहोरात्रे पक्षा मासास् तथा क्षपाः । मुहूर्ताश् च कलाश् चैव क्षणाः संवत्सरास् तथा ॥
units.english: From me have emanated earth, air, ether, water, the five luminous bodies, the moon, the sun, day, night, fortnight, months, seasons, muhurttas, Kalā Khana, year, various mantras, the various Shāstras, learnings and every other thing.

units.sanskrit: मन्मयं विद्धि कौन्तेय क्षयं सृष्टिं च भारत । सच् चासच् च ममैवात्मा सद् असच् चैव यत् परम् ॥
units.english: son of Kunti, creation and destruction also proceed from me. My soul is real and unreal and am the pure Brahman -.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो ऽस्मि क्षृणेन प्रीयता भरतर्षभ । तथैव च मनो नित्यम् अभवन् मे जनार्दने ॥
units.english: Arjuna said:—At that time Hrishikesh, out of his love for me, said this to me and since then my mind is ever attached to Janārddana.

units.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुतं च दृष्टं च माहात्म्यं केशवस्य मे । यन् मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र भूयश् चातो जनार्दने ॥
units.english: had heard of Keshava's power and saw this myself. There are more powerful deeds of Janārddana than what have just described at your request -.

units.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा कुरुश्रेष्ठो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः । पूजयाम् आस मनसा गोविन्दं पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing those words the virtuous king Yudhisthira, the foremost of Kurus, worshipped Purusottama Govinda, in his mind.

units.sanskrit: विस्मितश् चाभवद् राजा सह सर्वैः सहोदरैः । जनमेजय उवाच भूय एव द्विजश्रेष्ठ यदुसिंहस्य धीमतः । कर्माण्य् अपरिमेयानि श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥ श्रूयन्ते विविधानि स्म अद्भुतानि महाद्युते । प्रब्रूयाः सर्वशस् तात तानि मे वक्तुम् अर्हसि ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच बहून्य् आश्चर्यभूतानि केशवस्य महात्मनः । कर्माण्य् उक्तानि वै राजन् भूयश् चैव श्रुतानि ते ॥
units.english: At that time Yudhisthira, all his brothers and the courtier kings were filled with surprise -. Janamejaya said:— foremost of the twice-born wish to hear again truly the incomparable deeds of the intelligent Vāsudeva the foremost of the Yadus, you of great effulgence, have attained to great delight by hearing of the numberless, wonderful, heavenly and ordinary deeds of Krishna. sinless Muni, describe them all to me. Vaishampāyana said:— king had already described the many wonderful feats of the high-souled Keshava and you too have heard them repeatedly.

units.sanskrit: गन्तुं भरतशार्दूल विस्तरस्य महात्मनः ॥
units.english: you of large arms, foremost of Bharatas, have described them many a time no doubt, but it is impossible to finish them.

units.sanskrit: अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यं लेशमात्रेण भारत । विष्णोर् अतुलवीर्यस्य प्रथितोदारकर्मणः । आनुपूर्व्या प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप ॥
units.english: But great king, while you are anxious to listen to an account of the glorious deeds of Vāsudeva of incomparable power should describe what little, can. Hear, shall describe them from the beginning –.

units.sanskrit: द्वारवत्यां निवसता यदुसिंहेन धीमता । राष्ट्राणि नृपमुख्यानां क्षोभितानि महीक्षिताम् ॥
units.english: While residing at Dwaravati, the intelligent Yadu king Keshava invaded the territories of many highly powerful kings.

units.sanskrit: यदूनाम् अन्तरप्रेप्सुर् विचक्रो दानवो हतः ॥
units.english: At that time, a Dānava, by name Vichakra, who used to seek loop-holes of the Yadavas, was killed.

units.sanskrit: पुरं प्राग्ज्योतिषं गत्वा पुनस् तेन महात्मना । समुद्रमध्ये दुष्टात्मा नरको दानवो हतः ॥
units.english: Going to the city of Prāgyotish situate at the bed of the ocean the great Keshava killed the wicked Asura Naraka.

units.sanskrit: वासवं च रणे जित्वा पारिजातो हृतो बलात् । निर्जितश् चैव भगवान् वरुणो लोहितह्रदे ॥
units.english: Vanquishing Vāsava he, by force, carried away his Pārijāta tree –. In the lake Lohita the divine Varuna was vanquished by Keshava.

units.sanskrit: दन्तवक्रश् च कारूषो निहतो दक्षिणापथे । शिशुपालश् च संपूर्णे किल्बिषैकशते हतः ॥
units.english: In the Deccan the Karusha king Dantavakra was killed. After he had committed a hundred offences Shishupala was slain.

units.sanskrit: बलेः सुतो महावीर्यो बाणो बाहुसहस्रवान् । महामृधे महाराज जित्वा जीवन् विसर्जितः ॥ निर्जिताः पावकाश् चैव गिरिमध्ये महात्मना । साल्वश् च विजितः संख्ये सौभश् च विनिपातितः ॥ विक्षोभ्य सागरं सर्वं पाञ्चजन्यो वशीकृतः । हयग्रीवश् च निहतो नृपाश् चान्ये महाबलाः ॥
units.english: king, repairing to the city of Shonita Mādhava vanquished, in a great battle, the thousand-handed and highly powerful Vāna the son of Bali protected by Shankara and left him only alive -. All the fires in the mountains were suppressed by that high-souled one and Shalwa and Soubha were defeated and killed by him in battle. Having assailed the ocean Janārddana took from him the conch-shell Paachajanya and Hayagriva and other highly powerful kings have been killed by him.

units.sanskrit: जरासंधस्य निधने मोक्षिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः । रथेन जित्वा नृपतीन् गान्धारतनया हृता ॥
units.english: On Jarasandha being slain by him all the kings have been released. Having vanquished all the kings on a single car he carried away the daughter of the Gāndhara king.

units.sanskrit: भ्रष्टराज्याश् च शोकार्ताः पाण्डवाः परिरक्षिताः । दाहितं च वनं घोरं पुरुहूतस्य खाण्डवम् ॥ गाण्डीवं चाग्निना दत्तम् अर्जुनायोपपादितम् । दौत्यं च तत्कृतं घोरं विग्रहे जनमेजय ॥
units.english: The sons of Pandu, deprived of their kingdom and stricken with sorrow, were protected by him. Having consumed the dreadful forest of Khāndava belonging to Sachi's lord he conferred Gāndiva, given by fire, on Arjuna. Janamejaya, when the dreadful conflict took place, this Yadu king Janārddana acted as the ambassador.

units.sanskrit: कुन्त्याश् च प्रमुखे प्रोक्ता प्रतिज्ञा पाण्डवान् प्रति । निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे प्रतिदास्यामि ते सुतान् ॥
units.english: On behalf of the Pāndavas he promised before Kunti, After the termination of the Bhārata war will return the kingdom to your sons.

units.sanskrit: मोक्षितश् च महातेजा नृगः शापात् सुदारुणात् । यवनश् च हतः संख्ये काल इत्य् अभिविश्रुतः ॥
units.english: By him the highly effulgent Nriga was released of his curse and the well known Kāla Yavana was killed.

units.sanskrit: वानरौ च महावीर्यौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च । विजितौ युधि दुर्धर्षौ जाम्बवांश् च पराजितः ॥
units.english: By him the highly powerful and irrepressible monkeys Mainda and Dwivida were defeated in battle and Jāmvavān was vanquished.

units.sanskrit: सांदीपनेस् तथा पुत्रस् तव चैव पिता नृप । जनमेजय युद्धेषु यथा ते कथितं पुरा ॥
units.english: Although possessed by death Sandipani's son and your father was restored to life again. Janamejaya, had already described to you how the kings met with death in many battles destructive of men -.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच कर्माण्य् अपरिमेयानि श्रुतानि द्विजसत्तम । त्वत्तः श्रुतवतां श्रेष्ठ वासुदेवस्य धीमतः ॥ यच् च तत् कथितं पूर्वं बाणं प्रति महासुरम् । कथं च देवदेवस्य पुत्रत्वम् असुरो गतः । यो ऽभिगुप्तः स्वयं ब्रह्मञ् शंकरेण महात्मना । सहवासं गतेनेह सगणेन गुहेन च ॥ बलेर् बलवतः पुत्रो ज्येष्ठो भ्रातृशतस्य यः । वृतो बाहुसहस्रेण दिव्यास्त्रशतधारिणा । दृष्ट्वा वपुः कुमारस्य क्रीडतो ऽस्य महात्मनः । बलिपुत्रो महावीर्यो विस्मयं परमं गतः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— foremost of the twice-born, have heard many incomparable deeds of that intelligent Yadu king many a time. foremost of moral men, you having asceticism for your wealth, wish now to hear how Vāsudeva behaved towards Vāna as mentioned by you before. Brahman, how could that Asura, who was protected by Shankara, obtain the sonship of that god of gods? How could he live in the company of his Guhas? The son of the powerful Bali was the eldest of a hundred brothers and had thousand hands adorned with hundreds of celestial weapons, was encircled by numberless huge-bodied Asuras and was a master of hundreds of illusion. Once on a time seeing the high-souled Kumāra Kārtikeya while sporting the highly powerful Bali's son was filled with surprise.

units.sanskrit: रुद्रस्याराधनार्थाय यथास्य स्याम् अहं सुतः ॥
units.english: Then thinking, How may be Rudra's son? he desired to carry on hard austerities for worshipping Rudra.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽग्लपयद् आत्मानं तपसा सो ऽसुरोत्तमः । देवश् च परमं तोषं जगाम च सहोमया ॥ नीलकण्ठः परां प्रीतिं गत्वा चासुरम् अब्रवीत् । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत् ते मनसि वर्तते ॥
units.english: Gradually the more that foremost of Asuras rendered himself glorious by practising hard austerities the more pleased was Siva, who is easily satisfied, with Umā. Having attained to an excess of satisfaction with the austerities of Vāna, the blue-throated deity himself went there and said to the Asura:—May you fare well: pray for a boon which you cherish at heart –.

units.sanskrit: अथ बाणो ऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं देवदेवं सनातनम् । देव्याः पुत्रत्वम् इच्छामि त्वया दत्तं त्रिलोचन ॥
units.english: Thereupon Vāna said to Maheswara, the god of gods:— three-eyed deity, my prayer is that thou mayst confer on me the son-ship of the goddess. Saying So be it Shankara said to the goddess:—Accept him as your son.

units.sanskrit: कनीयान् कार्तिकेयस्य पुत्रो ऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥
units.english: He is the younger brother of Kārtikeya.

units.sanskrit: यत्रोत्थितो महासेनः सो ऽग्निजो रुधिरे पुरे । तत्रोद्देशे पुरं चास्य भविष्यति न संशयः ॥
units.english: Forsooth, his city will be laid out at that place from where formerly Mahāsena rose up from the blood produced by fire.

units.sanskrit: नाम्ना तच् छोणितपुरं भविष्यति पुरोत्तमम् । मयाभिगुप्तं श्रीमन्तं न कश्चित् प्रसहिष्यति ॥
units.english: That best of cities will be celebrated by the name of Shonita-pura. No body will be able to withstand the beautiful Vāna completely protected by me -.

units.sanskrit: ततः स निवसन् बाणः पुरे शोणितसाह्वये । अथ वीर्यमदोत्सिक्तो बाणो बाहुसहस्रवान् । अचिन्तयन् देवगणान् युद्धम् आकाङ्क्षते सदा ॥ ध्वजं चास्य ददौ प्रीतः कुमारो ह्य् अग्नितेजसम् । न देवा न च गन्धर्वा न यक्षा न च पन्नगाः । तस्य युद्धे व्यतिष्ठन्त देवदेवस्य तेजसा ॥
units.english: Thereupon Vāna lived in the city of Shonita and governed his kingdom oppressing the gods. Gradually the thousand-armed one was so much worked up with the pride of his prowess that disregarding the gods he solicited a battle with them -. At that time Kumāra give him a standard burning like fire and an effulgent peacock to carry him. Afterwards, by the power of Maheshwara, the god of gods, Vāna so fought that none amongst the gods, Gandharvas, Yakshas and Rākshasas could keep himself firm at that time –.

units.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकेनाभिगुप्तश् च दर्पोत्सिक्तो महासुरः । भूयो मृगयते युद्धं शूलिनं सो ऽभ्यगच्छत । देहि बाहुसहस्रं मे देवेभ्यश् चाप्य् अवध्यताम् । स रुद्रम् अभिगम्याथ प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च । बलिसूनुर् इदं वाक्यं पप्रच्छ वृषभध्वजम् ॥ असकृन् निर्जिता देवाः ससाध्याः समरुद्गणाः । मया बलमदोत्सेकात् ससैन्येन तवाश्रयात् ॥
units.english: Protected completely by Tryamvaka and elated with pride the Asura, desirous of fighting, again approached Siva. Approaching Rudra and saluting him Bali's son said:—The gods, Sādhyas and Marutas, whom repeatedly vanquished with the help of my army and under your protection, have come here and are living happily. god, vanquished by me, filled with terror and despairing of my defeat the gods are living happily in the celestial city under your protection.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं निराशो युद्धस्य जीवितं नाद्य कामये । अयुध्यतो वृथा ह्य् एषां बाहूनां धारणं मम ॥
units.english: So despairing of success in battle do not wish to live any longer; there is no use of holding all these arms if cannot fight. Save fighting my mind does not fix upon any thing else.

units.sanskrit: तद् ब्रूहि मम युद्धस्य कच्चिद् आगमनं भवेत् । ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् अब्रवीद् वृषभध्वजः । भविता बाण युद्धं ते तथा तच् छृणु दानव ॥
units.english: Be thou propitiated and tell me when shall be able to fight –. Thereupon the Divine Vrishadhwaja similingly said:— Dānava Vāna, hear how you will enter upon a battle.

units.sanskrit: स्वस्थाने स्थापितस्याथ तदा युद्धं भविष्यति ॥
units.english: When this your standard, planted in your own city, will be broken, you will enter upon a battle –.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्तः प्रहसन् बाणः सुबहुशो मुदा । प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा पादयोः पतितो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ दिष्ट्या बाहुसहस्रस्य न वृथा धारणं मम । दिष्टा सहस्राक्षम् अहं विजेता पुनर् आहवे ॥ आनन्दजाश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां नेत्राभ्याम् अरिमर्दनः । पञ्चाञ्जलिशतैर् देवं पूजयन् पतितो भुवि ॥ महेश्वर उवाच सदृशं प्रात्स्यसे वीरे युद्धम् अप्रतिमं रणे ॥
units.english: Thus spoken to Vāna, smiling again and again, prostrated himself at Bhava's feet and said:—By my good luck, my holding these thousand arms has not become fruitless. will again, by my good fortune, defeat the thousand-eyed deity. Thereupon having his eyes filled with tears of joy, Vāna, the aggrandiser of his enemies, prostrated himself on the ground and adored Maheshwara with his five hundred fingers. Maheshwara said:—Rise up hero you will soon obtain a fight befitting your family and thousand arms –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तस् ततो बाणस् त्र्यम्बकेन महात्मना । हर्षेणाभ्युत्थितः शीघ्रं नत्वा स वृषभध्वजम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus addressed by the high-souled three-eyed deity Vrishadhwaja Vāna, with delight, saluted him and rose up speedily.

units.sanskrit: ययौ स्वभवनं येन यत्र ध्वजगृहं महत् ॥
units.english: Thereupon dismissed by the blue-throated deity Vāna, the victor of hostile cities, entered into the room of standards in his own palace.

units.sanskrit: तत्रोपविष्टः प्रहसन् कुम्भाण्डम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । प्रियम् आवेदयिष्यामि भवतो मनसो ऽनुगम् ॥
units.english: Seated there he smilingly said to Kumbhānda:— will give a pleasant tidings after your heart.

units.sanskrit: येनाहम् इह संप्राप्तः कुम्भाण्ड शृणु मे वचः । इत्य् एवम् उक्तः प्रहसन् बाणम् अप्रतिमं रणे । प्रोवाच राजन् किं त्व् एतद् वक्तुकामो ऽसि मत्प्रियम् । त्वत्तस् तच् छ्रोतुम् इच्छामि वरं किं लब्धवान् असि । सलिलौघाद् विनिःसृत्य कच्चिद् राज्यम् अवाप्स्यति ॥
units.english: Hearing it the minister Kumbhānda smilingly said to Vāna, incomparable in battle:— king, what pleasant news are you desirous of communicating to me? foremost of Daityas, my eyes have been expanded with joy and surprise. wish to learn what boon you have obtained –. Will he rise up from the water and regain his kingdom.

units.sanskrit: पुनः प्रत्यानयिष्यामो जित्वा सर्वान् दिवौकसः ॥ स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषं शञ्खस्वनपुरोजवम् । कच्चिन् नारायणं देवं जेष्यामः समितिंजयम् ॥ कच्चिद् वृषध्वजस् तात प्रसादसुमुखस् तव । यथा ते हृदयोत्कम्पः साश्रुबिन्दुः प्रवर्तते ॥
units.english: Shall we see again your father Bali, Virochona's son, adorned with celestial garlands and pasted with celestial unguents ? Lord, shall we, vanquishing the gods, bring again to our subjection the worlds pilfered with three steps ? Shall we vanquish the god Nārāyana, the victor of armies, who is preceeded by the grave and cool sound of his conch-shell ? From the dancing of your heart and tears of joy it appears that Vrishadhwaja has been propitiated by you.

units.sanskrit: कच्चिद् ईश्वरतोषेण कार्त्तिकेयमतेन च । प्राप्तवान् असि सर्वेषाम् अस्माकं पार्थिवं पदम् ॥ इति कुम्भाण्डवचनैश् चोदितः पुरुषर्षभः । बाणो वाचम् असंसक्तां प्रोवाच वदतां वरः ॥
units.english: Have you, by the Lord’s pleasure and Kartikeya's consent, obtained for us all the dignity of the king of the earth? – Encouraged by the words of Kumbhānda, Vāna, the foremost of Asuras and speakers, gave vent to the following powerful words:— have not been able to fight for a long time.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽहं पतितो मूर्ध्ना देवदेवस्य धीमतः । युद्धाभिलाषः सुमहान् देव संजायते मम । अपि प्राप्स्याम्य् अहं युद्धं मनसस् तुष्टिकारकम् ॥ विज्ञप्तः स मया देव प्राह मां वृषभध्वजः । ततो ऽहं देवदेवेन हरेणामित्रघातिना । प्रहस्य सुचिरं कालम् उक्तो ऽद्य वचनं प्रियम् ॥ प्राप्स्यसे सुमहद् युद्धं त्वं बाणाप्रतिमं महत् । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं तवान्तिकम् उपागतः ॥ इत्य् एवम् उक्तः कुम्भाण्डः प्रोवाच नृपतिं तदा । अहो न शोभनं राजन् यद् एवं भाषसे वचः ॥
units.english: Therefore stricken with sorrow said to the divine blue throated deity:— lord, am filled with a great desire for battle. Tell me when shall enter on a battle conducive to the satisfaction of my mind. Hearing it Hara, the god of gods, and the slayer of his enemies, smiled for some time and then said to me in sweet words:– Vāna, in no time you will face a great battle. Diti's son, when your peacock standard will be broken you will find a great battle awaiting you. After the divine Vrishadhwaja had said this saluted him and came to you -. Thus addressed Kumbhānda said to the king of Asuras: king, the words given vent to by you appear to be highly charming.

units.sanskrit: एवं कथयतोर् एव तयोर् अन्योन्यम् उच्छ्रितः । ध्वजः पपात वेगेन शक्राशनिसमाहतः ॥
units.english: While they were thus conversing the huge standard, clapped by Indra's thunderbolt, dropped down with great force -.

units.sanskrit: तं तथा पतितं दृष्ट्वा सो ऽसुरो ध्वजम् उत्तमम् । प्रहर्षम् अतुलं लेभे मेने चाहवम् आगतम् ॥ ततश् चकम्पे वसुधा शक्राशनिसमाहता । ननादान्तर्हितो भूमौ वृषदंशो जगर्ज च ॥ देवानाम् अपि यो देवः सो ऽप्य् अवर्षत वासवः । सूर्यं भित्त्वा महोल्का च पपात धरणीतले । स्वपक्षे चोदितः सूर्यो भरणीं समपीडयत् ॥
units.english: Beholding that most excellent standard thus struck down Asura Vāna was filled with joy in anticipation of an approaching battle. At that time struck by Indra's thunder-bolt the earth trembled and a cat, hiding itself under the earth, began to mew. In the city of Shonita, Vāsava, the king of gods, began to shower blood around the king's palace –. Piercing the sun huge fire-brands fell down on earth. The sun, rising with the planet Kirtika, assailed Rohini.

units.sanskrit: चैत्यवृक्षेषु सहसा धाराः शतसहस्रशः । शोणितस्यास्रवन् घोरा निपेतुस् तारका भृशम् ॥
units.english: Hundreds and thousands of dreadful streams of blood fell from Chaitya trees and stars continually fell from the sky.

units.sanskrit: राहुर् अग्रसद् आदित्यम् अपर्वणि विशां पते । लोकक्षयकरे काले निर्घातश् चाभवन् महान् ॥
units.english: Though that men-destroying hour was not a Parva yet Rāhu devoured the sun and huge-fire brands fell.

units.sanskrit: दक्षिणां दिशम् आस्थाय धूमकेतुः स्थितो ऽभवत् । श्वेतलोहितपर्यन्तः कृष्णग्रीवस् तडिद्द्युतिः । त्रिवर्णः परिघो भानोः संध्यारागम् अथावृणोत् ॥
units.english: comet appeared in the south and dreadful winds blew continually –. Encircled by three-coloured Parighas, the sun, effulgent like lightning, having white and red corners and black neck, covered the hue of the evening.

units.sanskrit: बाणस्य जन्मनक्षत्रं भर्त्सयन्न् इव सर्वशः ॥
units.english: As if chastising Rohini, the birth star of Vāna, the dreadful Angaraka entered as Rahu into Kirtikā.

units.sanskrit: अनेकशाखश् चैत्यश् च निपपात महीतले । अर्चितः सर्वकन्याभिर् दानवानां महात्मनाम् ॥
units.english: The huge Chaitrya tree, having many branches, which the Dānava maidens used to worship, fell down on earth.

units.sanskrit: बाणो बलमदोन्मत्तो निश्चयं नाधिगच्छति ॥
units.english: Vāna, elated with the pride of his strength, though he saw all these evil portends, could not make out that he would be defeated –.

units.sanskrit: विचेतास् त्व् अभवत् प्राज्ञः कुम्भाण्डस् तत्त्वदर्शिवान् । बाणस्य सचिवस् तत्र कीर्तयन् बहु किल्बिषम् ॥
units.english: But Vāna's wise and right-seeing minister Kumbhānda, struck with sorrow, spoke much on all those evil omens.

units.sanskrit: उत्पाता ह्य् अत्र दृश्यन्ते कथयन्तो नशोभनम् । तव राज्यविनाशाय भविष्यन्ति न संशयः ॥ वयं चान्ये च सचिवा भृत्या ये च तवानुगाः । यथा शक्रध्वजतरोः स्वदर्पात् पतनं भवेत् । रणम् आकाङ्क्षतो मोहात् तथा बाणस्य नर्दतः ॥ देवदेवप्रसादात् तु त्रैलोक्यविजयं गतः । बाणः प्रीतमनास् त्व् एव पपौ पानम् अनुत्तमम् । दैत्यदानवनारीभिः सार्धम् उत्तमविक्रमः ॥
units.english: He said:—These omens presage evil. Forsooth they indicate the destruction of your kingdom; on account of the evil conduct of a king like yourself, we ministers, along with your servants, will meet with destruction. Alas! As the tree, the banner of Sakra, has fallen down, so will proud Vāna, always vaunting out of ignorance, will fall. Desirous of conquering the three worlds for the favour of the god of gods, Vanā is crying out for battle. But on the other hand his destruction is drawing near -. Thereupon Vāna, of great prowess, began to drink delightedly Asava wine in the company of Daitya and Danava damsels.

units.sanskrit: कुम्भाण्डश् चिन्तयाविष्टो राजवेश्माभ्ययात् तदा । अचिन्तयच् च तत्त्वार्थं तैस् तैर् उत्पातदर्शनैः ॥ राजा प्रमादी दुर्बुद्धिर् जितकाशी महासुरः । युद्धम् एवाभिलषते न दोषान् पश्यते मदात् ॥ महोत्पातभयं चैव न तन् मिथ्या भविष्यति । अपीदानीं भवेन् मिथ्या सर्वम् उत्पातदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: Beholding those portends and filled with anxiety Kumbhānda entered into the king's palace; and thinking of those evil omens, he said:—The wicked and careless Asura king Vāna, elated with the pride of success, is desiring for a battle. He does not see his weakness out of ignorance. The evil omens that are being seen now, may not be true for the present but the fear consequent thereon can never be otherwise –.

units.sanskrit: इह त्व् आस्ते त्रिनयनः कार्त्तिकेयश् च वीर्यवान् । तेनोत्पन्नो ऽपि दोषो नः कच्चिद् गच्छेत् पराभवम् ॥
units.english: The lotus-eyed Sivā and the powerful Kārtikeya live here and so these evil omen's may be destroyed. But methinks our sins will never be dissipated.

units.sanskrit: उत्पन्नदोषप्रभवः क्षयो ऽयं भविता महान् । दौरात्म्यान् नृपतेर् अस्य दोषभूता हि दानवाः ॥
units.english: great destruction, begotten by our pride, is drawing near. Alas, by the oppressions of this king all the Dānavas have been touched by sin and this will lead to their destruction –.

units.sanskrit: देवदानवसंघानां यः कर्ता भुवनप्रभुः । स भवः कार्त्तिकेयश् च कृतवासो हि नः पुरे ॥
units.english: Hara, the lord of three worlds, the master of gods and Dānavas and the divine Kārtikeya live in our city.

units.sanskrit: तद् विशिष्टश् च बाणो ऽपि भवस्य सततं प्रियः ॥ दर्पोत्सेकात् तु नाशाय वरं याचितवान् भवम् । युद्धहेतोः स लुब्धस् तु सर्वथा न भविष्यति ॥
units.english: Guha is loved by Bhava more than his life. But Vāna is still a greater favourite. On account of his excessive pride, Vāna, for his own destruction, prayed for a battle to Bhava. And that too he has obtained. But it does not appear that a battle will take place.

units.sanskrit: यदि विष्णुपुरोगाणाम् इन्द्रादीनां दिवौकसाम् । भविता ह्य् अभयत् प्राप्तिर् भवहस्तात् कृता भवेत् । एतयोश् च हि को युद्धं कुमारभवयोर् इह । न च देववचो मिथ्या भविष्यति कथंचन । भविष्यति महद् युद्धं सर्वदैत्यविनाशनम् । एवं स चिन्तयाविष्टः कुम्भाण्डस् तत्त्वदर्शिवान् । स्वस्तिप्रणिहितां बुद्धिं चकार स महासुरः ॥
units.english: If however an encounter comes off with Indra and other gods headed by Vishnu it must be regarded as a creation of Bhava. If Bhava and Kumāra are willing to help Vāna nobody will be able to fight with them. The words of the three-eyed deity never prove untrue. Forsooth a great Daitya-destroying battle will soon take place. Thus thinking the considerate and right-seeing Asura Kumbhānda directed his understanding towards good and said Those who fight with the virtuous gods meet with destruction as Bali has been suppressed -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच क्रीडाविहारोपगतः कदाचिद् अभवद् भवः । शतानि तत्राप्सरसां चिक्रीडुश् च समन्ततः । सर्वर्तुकवने रम्ये गन्धर्वपतयस् तथा ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Once on a time Lord Bhava was sporting on the bank of a charming river. In that picturesque forest where all the seasons flourish the Gandharvas, with hundreds of Apsaras, were sporting on all sides.

units.sanskrit: कुसुमैः पारिजातस्य पुष्पैः संतानकस्य च । वेणुवीणामृदङ्गैश् च पणवैश् च सहस्रशः । वाद्यमानैः स शुश्राव गीतम् अप्सरसां तदा ॥
units.english: The river bank was fragrant like sky with the scent of Pārijāta and Santānaka flowers –. Shankara heard the Apsaras sing in accompaniment with the music of flute, Vinā, Mridanga and Panava.

units.sanskrit: सूतमागधकल्पैश् चाप्य् अस्तुवन्न् अप्सरोगणाः । देवदेवं सुवपुषं स्रग्विणं रक्तवाससम् ॥ हरं सहोमं वरदं रमयन्ति मनोरमाः । ततस् तु देव्या रूपेण विक्रलेखा वराप्सराः । भवं प्रसादयाम् आस देवी च प्राहसत् तदा ॥
units.english: Like bards and panegyrists the beautiful Apsaras pleased Umā and the beautiful-bodied Hara, the god of gods, and the giver of boons who was clad in a red raiment and adorned with garlands, singing various songs in their honor. At that time assuming the form of the goddess, the leading Apsarā, Chitralekhā pleased Bhava. The goddess laughed at it.

units.sanskrit: प्रसादयन्तीम् ईशानं प्रहसन्त्य् अप्सरोगनाः । भवस्य पार्षदा दिव्या नानारूपा महौजसः ॥ देव्या ह्य् अनुज्ञया सर्वे क्रीडन्ते तत्र तत्र ह ॥
units.english: And seeing her please Ishāna other Apsarās also laughed –. With the permission of the goddess, the highly powerful and divine follower of Bhava, assuming various forms, began to play on all sides.

units.sanskrit: महादेवस्य रूपेण तच् चिह्नं रूपम् आस्थिताः । ततो देव्यास् तु रूपेण लीलया वदनेन च । देवी प्रहासं मुमुचे ताश् चैवाप्सरसस् तदा ॥ ततः किलिकिलाशब्दः प्रादुर्भूतः समन्ततः । बाणस्य दुहिता कन्या तत्रोषा नाम भामिनी । देवं प्रक्रीडितं दृष्ट्वा देव्या सह नदीगतम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon assuming the form of Mahādeva marked with signs those frolic-some attendants began to play. And the Apsarās too, assuming the form of the goddess, sported there. Seeing it the goddesss smiled. There arose on all sides sounds of laughter and Bhava attained to an excess of delight. By an accident the beautiful daughter of Vāna, by name Ushā, saw the three-eyed deity sport with Pārvati in the river.
