units.sanskrit: दीप्यमानं महादेवं द्वादशादित्यतेजसम् । नानारूपं वपुः कृत्वा देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया । उषा मनोरथं चक्रे पार्वत्याः संनिधौ तदा । मनसा त्व् अथ संकल्पम् उषया भाषितं तथा । उषे शीघ्रं त्वम् अप्य् एवं भर्त्रा सह रमिष्यसि । यथा देवो मया सार्धं शंकरः शत्रुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Beholding Mahādeva, effulgent like twelve suns, assume various forms and sport with the goddess, for pleasing her, Ushā thought in her mind:—The lucky women thus sport in the company of their husbands. And she spoke out her resolution to her friends -. Informed of Ushā's desire Pārvati said slowly with joy:— Ushā, as the Lord Shankara, the slayer of his enemies, is sporting with me so you will soon enjoy the company of your husband –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ते तदा देव्या वाक्ये चिन्ताविलेक्षणा । उषा भावं हृदा चक्रे भर्त्रा रंस्ये कदा सह ॥ ततो हैमवती वाक्यं संप्रहस्येदम् अब्रवीत् । वैशाखे मासि हर्म्यस्थां द्वादश्यां त्वां दिनक्षये । धर्षयिष्यति यः स्वप्ने स ते भर्ता भविष्यति ॥
units.english: Thus spoken to by the goddess Ushā, with anxiety-stricken eyes, thought in her mind:—When shall sport with my husband? Thereat the goddess Haimavati, smilingly said:— Ushā! Hear when you will be united with your husband. The person, whom you will see in a dream in the night of the twelfth day of the month of Vaishāka while sleeping on the terrace of your palace, will be your husband –.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता दैत्यसुता कन्यागणसमावृता । ततः सखीभिर् हास्यन्ती हर्षेणोत्फुल्ललोचना । किंनर्यो यक्षकन्याश् च नागदैत्येशकन्यकाः । उक्ता च तत्र ताभिः सा भर्ता तव वरानने । भविष्यत्य् अचिरेणैव देव्या वचनकल्पितः ॥
units.english: Thus addressed the Daitya maiden, encircled by her friends, went away, playing happily, from that place. Then clapping their hands her friends began to ridicule Ushā whose eyes were expanded with joy –. Daughters of Yakshas, Nāgas, Daityas and many Kinnaris and Apsaras were Ushā's friends. They jokingly said:— fair lady, in no time you will have your husband as described by the goddess. You will have a husband, beautiful and of good birth as you have wished.

units.sanskrit: न हि देव्या वचो मिथ्या भविष्यति कदाचन । उषा सखीनां तद् वाक्यं प्रतिपूज्य यथाविधि । दत्तं मनोरथं देव्या भावयन्ती व्यतिष्ठत । गते ऽहनि पुनः सर्वास् ता नार्यो जग्मुर् अद्भुताः ॥ ययुः स्वान् आलयान् सर्वा देवी चादर्शणं गता । काश् चिद् अश्वैस् तथा यानैर् गजैर् अन्यास् तथा रथैः । पुरं प्रविविशुर् हृष्टाः काश्चिद् आकाशम् आस्थिताः ॥
units.english: The words of the goddess never prove untrue –. Receiving in good grace all those words of her friends Ushā began to spend her days in anticipation of the realization of the desire conferred by the goddess. The highly wonderful ladies, who had come there, sported for a few days with Umā happily and then returned to their respective habitations. The goddess too disappeared. Amongst the females, some on horse back, some in conveyances, and some in elephants, entered into the city. And some rose up into the sky –.

units.sanskrit: ततो हर्म्ये शयानां तु वैशाखे मासि भामिनीम् । द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य सखीगणवृतां तदा ॥ यथोक्तः पुरुषः स्वप्ने धर्षयाम् आस ताम् उषाम् । विवेष्टमानां रुदतीं देव्या वचनचोदितः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thereupon on the twelfth day of the light fortnight of the month of Vaishākha fair Ushā was sleeping encircled by her companions. At that time a man, as spoken of, ravished that beautiful maiden in a dream who was excited with the words of the goddess, weeping and motionless.

units.sanskrit: सा स्वप्ने धर्षिता तेन स्त्रीभावं चापि लम्भिता । तां तथा रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा सखी भयसमन्विताम् । चित्रलेखा वचः स्निग्धम् उवाच परम् आद्भुतम् ॥ उषे मा भैः किम् एवं त्वं रुदती परितप्यसे । बलेः सुतसुता च त्वं प्रख्याता किं भयान्विता ॥
units.english: The man so ravished her in the night that she got up bathed in blood all on a sudden -. Thereupon beholding her friend stricken with fear and thus weeping Chitrālekhā gave vent to the following highly wonderful and consoling words:—Do not fear, Ushā: why are you weeping and bewailing thus? Being the grand daughter of the celebrated Bali, why are you assailed with fear? you of fair eye-brows, you have no fear in the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: भयदस् तव वामोरु पिता देवान्तको रणे ॥
units.english: Besides your father is the destroyer of all the celestials in battle.

units.sanskrit: नैवंविधेषु वासेषु भयम् अस्ति वरानने ॥
units.english: Why do you fear then? fair one, there is no fear in such a room, as this.

units.sanskrit: असकृद् देवसहितः शचीभर्ता सुरेश्वरः । अप्राप्त एव नगरं पित्रा ते मृदितो रणे । महासुरवरः श्रीमान् बलेः पुत्रो महाबलः ॥
units.english: Rise up, rise up, do not be sorry. Do you not know, that Sachi's Lord the king of gods was several times defeated by your father and could not come to this city. Your father, the son of the highly powerful Asura Bali, is the source of fear to all the gods –.

units.sanskrit: एवं साभिहिता सख्या बाणपुत्री यशस्विनी । स्वप्नरूपं यथा दृष्त्वं न्यवेदयद् अनिन्दिता । उषोवाच एवं संदूषिता साध्वी कथं जीवितुम् उत्सहे । पितरं किं नु वक्ष्यामि देवशत्रुम् अरिंदमम् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by her friend the immaculate daughter of Vāna described to her what she had seen in a dream. Ushā said:—Thus contaminated how can a chaste maiden dare keep her life? What shall say to my father the enemy of the gods and the slayer of his enemies? While have sullied this powerful family death is preferable to me.

units.sanskrit: श्रेयो हि मरणं मन्ये न मे श्रेयो ऽद्य जीवितम् ॥
units.english: There is no happiness in my living.

units.sanskrit: ईप्सितो वा यथ को ऽपि पुरुषो ऽधिगतो हि मे । कथम् एवं कृता नाम कन्या जीवितुम् उत्सहे । कुलोपक्रोशनकरी कुलाङ्गारा निराश्रेया । जीवितुं स्पृहयेन् नारी साध्वीनाम् अग्रतः स्थिता ॥ इत्य् एवं बाष्पपूर्णाक्षी सखीजनवृता तदा । विललाप चिरं कालम् उषा कमललोचना ॥
units.english: Alas! have been reduced to such a plight that as if co-habited, while awake, with a desired-for person. Although was sleeping in the night, who brought me to this condition as if was wide awake? When a maiden is reduced to such a condition how can she dare live in this world? The woman, who is the foremost of chaste damsels, can long for living but how can a helpless woman, who has sullied her family, desire so –? Thus the lotus-eyed Ushā, encircled by her friends and with eyes full of tears, bewailed for some time.

units.sanskrit: ऊचुर् अश्रुपरीताक्ष्य उषां सर्वाः समागताः ॥
units.english: The friends, who were there, lost themselves seeing Ushā weep like one having none to look after her.

units.sanskrit: क्रियते न च ते सुभ्रु कच्चिद् दुष्टं मनस् तव ॥ प्रसभं देवि संयोगाद् यदि भुक्तासि भामिनि । स्वप्नयोगेन कल्याणि व्रतलोपो न विद्यते । व्यभिचारेण ते देवि नास्ति कश्चिद् व्यतिक्रमः ॥ न च स्वप्नकृतो दोषो मर्त्यलोके ऽस्ति सुन्दरि । मनसा चैव वाचा च कर्मणा च विशेषतः । दुष्टा या त्रिभिर् एतैस् तु पापा सा प्रोच्यते भुवि ॥
units.english: And with eyes full of tears they said to her:— you of fair eye-brows, if you had done something with a mad motive your mind would have been contaminated. auspicious lady, while you have been ravished by force in a dream your vow will not come to an end. Besides, fair lady, no sin is comitted in a dream in the land of mortals. So you have not transgressed any regulation by such a conduct. The saints, well-read in scriptures, hold that the woman who commits sin by mind, words and especially by deeds, is considered as fallen.

units.sanskrit: न व ते दुष्यते भीरु मनः प्रजवितं सदा । कथं त्वं दोषदुष्टा वै नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी ॥
units.english: timid girl, you have always observed celibacy and even your mind has not been seen to give way, so how can you be regarded sullied? You are a chaste, pure and noble woman.

units.sanskrit: इमाम् अवस्थां नीता त्वं नैव धर्मो विलुप्यते ॥
units.english: You were reduced to this plight while you were asleep and so your virtue will not suffer by this.

units.sanskrit: यस्या दुष्टं मनः पूर्वं कर्मणा चोपपादितम् । ताम् आहुर् असतीं नाम सती त्वम् असि भामिनि ॥ कुलजा रूपसंपन्ना नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी । इमाम् अवस्थां नीतासि कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥ इत्य् एवं उक्तां रुदतीं बाष्पेणावृतलोचनाम् । कुम्भाण्डदुहिता वाक्यं परमं त्व् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥ त्यज शोकं विशालाक्षि अपापा त्वं वरानने । स्मृतं मे यद् इदं वाक्यं याथातथ्येन तच् छृणु । उषे यद् उक्ता देव्यासि भर्तारं ध्यायती तदा । समीपे देवदेवस्य स्मर भामिनि तद् वचः ॥
units.english: She is called an unchaste woman, whose sinful mind leads her to sinful actions. But, lady, you are chaste; you are born in a great family and beautiful. You have always observed celibacy still you have been reduced to such a condition. Alas! it is difficult to tide over destiny. Having said this with tearful eyes to weeping Ushā Kumbhānda's daughter again spoke the following precious words:— you of large eyes, cast off your grief. you of a beautiful face, remember an incident which will prove that you are innocent. Hear will describe it truly. Remember what the goddess Pārvati, before Mahadeva, said to you when you thought of having a husband. At that time with delight the goddess said to you the following words after your own heart.

units.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य वैशाखे मासि यो निशि । हर्म्ये शयानां रुदतीं स्त्रीभावम् उपनेष्यति ॥ भविता स हि ते भर्ता शूरः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । न हि तद् वचनं मिथ्या पार्वत्या यद् उदाहृतम् । स्मृत्वा तु वचनं देव्याः प्रत्युवाच सखीं तदा । उषोवाच स्मरामि भामिनि वचो देव्याः क्रीडागते भवे । यथोक्तं सर्वम् अखिलं प्राप्तं हर्म्यतले मया ॥
units.english: When you will sleep in your palace on the twelfth day of the fortnight of the month of Vaishākha, the man, who will co-habit with you weeping, that hero, that slayer of enemies will be your husband. you having a moon-like face, what Pārvati said can never be untrue. Forgetting the truth you are weeping. Hearing the words of her friend and recollecting the words of the goddess Vāna's daughter cast off her sorrow –. Ushā said:— fair lady, remember now what the goddess said while sporting with Bhava. What she said exactly happened in my room.

units.sanskrit: भर्ता तु मम यद्य् एष लोकनाथस्य भार्यया । व्यादिष्टः स कथं ज्ञेयस् तत्र कार्यं विधीयताम् ॥
units.english: If the wife of Bhava, the lord of the world, wishes him to be my husband then arrange how can know his whereabouts -.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने कुम्भाण्डदुहिता पुनः । व्याजहार यथान्यायम् अर्थतत्त्वविशारदा ॥ न हि तस्य कुलं देवि न कीर्तिर् नापि पौरुषम् । कश्चिज् जानाति तत्त्वेन किम् इदं त्वं विहन्यसे ॥
units.english: After Ushā had said this Kumbhānda's daughter, well-read in the study of words, gave vent to the following reasonable words:–Why are you so overwhelmed, lady? Nobody knows the glories of his race and his manliness.

units.sanskrit: अदृष्टश् चाश्रुतश् चैव दृष्टः स्वप्ने त्वयानघे । कथं ज्ञेयो भवेद् भीरु सो ऽस्माभी रतितस्करः ॥
units.english: How can we know that thief, that unseen and unheard of person whom you saw in dream? you of red eyes, he, all on a sudden, entered into our inner appartment and ravished you by force although you were weeping.

units.sanskrit: न ह्य् अयं प्राकृतः कश्चिद् यः प्रविष्टः प्रसह्य नः । नगरं लोकविख्यातम् एकः शत्रुनिबर्हणः ॥
units.english: That subduer of enemies, who has been able to enter, by force, this celebrated city of ours, is not an ordinary man –.

units.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च महौजसौ । न शक्ताः शोणितपुरं प्रवेष्टुं भीमविक्रमाः ॥
units.english: The Adityas, Rudras and Vasus of dreadful prowess and even the effulgent Ashwinis cannot enter the city of Shonita.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽयम् एतैः शतगुणो विशिष्टः शत्रुसूदनः । प्रविष्टः शोणितपुरं बाणम् आक्रम्य मूर्धनि ॥
units.english: So that slayer of enemies, who has entered Shonitpura and kicked Vāna on his head, is indeed a hundred times more powerful than they.

units.sanskrit: यस्या नैवंविधो भर्ता भवेद् युद्धविशारदः । कस् तस्या जीवितेनार्थो भोगैर् वा स्याच् छुभेक्षणे ॥
units.english: you of fair eyes, of what use are life and objects of enjoyment to that woman who has not got such a heroic husband.

units.sanskrit: धन्यास्य् अनुगृहीतासि यस्यास् ते पतिर् ईदृशः । प्राप्तो देव्याः प्रसादेन पार्वत्या मत्तकाशिनि ॥
units.english: When by the favour of the goddess you have obtained such a Cupid-like husband consider yourself as lucky and blessed.

units.sanskrit: इदं तु ते कार्यतमं शृणु त्वं वै मयेरितम् । विज्ञेयो यस्य पुत्रस् तु यन् नामा यत् कुलश् च सः ॥
units.english: Hear, what you shall have to do now. We are to know his name, in what family he has been born and who his father is -.

units.sanskrit: दशाम् अन्त्यां समास्थाय निद्रासुखविमोहिता । उवाच कुम्भाण्डसुतां कथं ज्ञास्यामहे सखि ॥
units.english: After Kumbhānda’s daughter had said this Ushā, stricken with love, said: friend, how will you be able to know all this? People often find themselves overpowered in their own actions.

units.sanskrit: त्वम् एव चिन्तय सखि नोत्तरं प्रतिभाति मे । स्वकार्ये मुह्यते लोको यथा जीवं लभाम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: cannot therefore find out what reply to give. Find out the measure by which may keep my life –.

units.sanskrit: उषाया वचनं श्रुत्वा रामा वाक्यम् इदं पुनः । उवाच रुदतीं चैव कुभाण्डतनया सखीम् ॥ कुशला ते विशालाक्षि सर्वथा संधिविग्रहे । ततः सा चिन्तयाविष्टा वचनं प्राह दुर्वचः । चित्रलेखाम् अप्सरसं प्रणयात् तां सखीं सखी ॥
units.english: Hearing it, the beautiful daughter of Kumbhānda said again to her weeping friend Ushā:— friend, you having spacious eyes, Apsara Chitralekhā is an expert in the work of making peace and sowing dissensions. Therefore communicate this to her very soon. Thus addressed Ushā was filled with great surprise and delight. And to her friend the Apsarā Chitralekhā poor Ushā, with folded hands, said: –.

units.sanskrit: परमं शृणु मे वाक्यं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि भामिनि । भर्तारं यदि मे ऽद्य त्वं नानयिष्यसि मत्प्रियम् ॥ कान्तं पद्मपलाशाक्षं मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमम् । विक्रलेखाब्रवीद् वाक्यम् उषां तां हसती शनैः । नैषो ऽर्थः शक्यते ऽस्माभिर् वेत्तुं भामिनि सुव्रते ॥
units.english: fair lady, hear, am communicating to you a most important subject. If you do not bring here my beloved, lotus-eyed husband having the gait of an infuriated elephant will give up my life. Hearing it Chitralekhā, gladdening Ushā, slowly said:— you of firm vows, he, of whom you speak, is not known to me.

units.sanskrit: न कुलेन न वर्णेन न शीलेन न रूपतः । किं तु शक्यम् इदं कार्यं बुद्धिपूर्वं मया सखि । प्राप्तुं तच् छृणु मे वाक्यं यथा कामम् अवाप्स्यसि ॥
units.english: do not know the family, character, colour and accomplishments of that thief, nor the country where he resides. But hear, now, my friend, the words suited to the time, what will be able to accomplish with my intelligence and how you will acquire your wished-for object.

units.sanskrit: देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । ये विशिष्टाः प्रभावेन रूपेणाभिजनेन च ॥
units.english: friend, will paint the likenesses of those who are prominent by virtue of their beauty and birth amongst the gods, Dānavas, Yakshas, Uragas and Rākshasas, as well as of those who are leading and well-known in the land of men.

units.sanskrit: सप्तरात्रेण ते भीरु दर्शयिष्यामि तान् अहम् । ततो विज्ञाय पट्टस्थं भर्तारं प्रतिलप्स्यसे ॥
units.english: timid girl, within seven nights will show you their portraits and you will recognise the portrait of your beloved husband and obtain him -.

units.sanskrit: सा चित्रलेखया प्रोक्ता उषाहितचिकीर्षया । क्रियताम् एवम् इत्य् आह चित्रलेखां सखीं प्रियाम् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by Chitralekhā who was anxious to please her Ushā asked her loving friend Chitralekhā to do the same.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा सप्तरात्रेण कृत्वालेख्यगतांस् तु तान् । चित्रपट्टगतान् मुख्यान् आनयाम् आस शोभना ॥
units.english: Saying So be it beautiful Chitralekhā too, by virtue of her imagination and clever hand, painted the likenesses of all leading men within seven nights.

units.sanskrit: उषाया दर्शयाम् आस सखीनां च विशेषतः ॥ एते देवेषु ये मुख्यास् तथा दानववंशजाः । किं नरोरगयक्षाणां राक्षसानां च सर्वशः ॥ गन्धर्वासुरदैत्यानां ये चान्ये भोगिनः स्मृताः । यस् ते भर्ता यथारूपो यथाभिलषितः सखि । तं त्वं प्रत्यभिजानीहि स्वप्ने यं दृष्टवत्य् असि ॥
units.english: Thereupon spreading all the portraits painted by her she said to Ushā before all her friends:—Look here, have painted the likenesses of all leading persons amongst the gods, Dānavas, Kinnaras, Uragas, Yakshas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, Asuras, Daityas, and of other various Naga families as also of the leading figures amongst mankind. have painted their likenesses all exactly. Do you now find out that of your husband whom you saw in the dream –.

units.sanskrit: अतीत्य च यदून् सर्वान् ददर्श यदुनन्दनम् ॥ बलभद्रम् अथो दृष्ट्वा प्रद्युम्नम् अथ सात्यकिम् । तत्रानिरुद्धं दृष्ट्वा सा विस्मयोत् फुल्ललोचना । अब्रवीच् चित्रलेखां ताम् अयं चोरः स वै सखि ॥ येनाहं दूषिता पूर्वं स्वप्ने हर्म्यगता सती । सो ऽयं विज्ञातरूपो मे कुतस्त्यस् तस्करः शुभे ॥ चित्रलेखे वदस्वैनं तत्त्वतो मम शोभने । गुणशीलाभिजनतो नाम किं चास्य भामिनि ॥
units.english: Thereupon gradually passing from one to another Ushā saw that of Keshava, the Yadu king, amongst the Yadavas. Seeing Aniruddha by him her eyes grew expanded with surprise. She said to Chitralekhā:—This is the thief who, while was sleeping on the turret of my palace, ravished me in dream, a chaste lady as am. can recognize him by his beauty. beautiful Chitrālekha, describe to me at length his name, accomplishments, character and family.

units.sanskrit: ततः पश्चाद् विधास्यामि कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चयम् । चित्रलेखोवाच अयं त्रिलोक्यनाथस्य नप्ता कृष्णस्य धीमतः । देवदेवो जगन्नाथः साक्षाच् चक्रगदाधरः । न ह्य् अस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु सदृशो ऽस्ति पराक्रमे । उत्पाट्य पर्वतान् एष पर्वतैर् एव शातयेत् ॥
units.english: We should do what is proper afterwards -. Chitrālekha said:— you of expansive eyes, this your husband, of dreadful prowess, is the grand-son of the intelligent Krishna, the lord of the three worlds and the son of Pradyumna. There is none in the three worlds equal to him in prowess. He uproots the mountains and crushes them.

units.sanskrit: धन्यास्य् अनुगृहीतासि यस्यास् ते यदुपुंगवः । त्र्यक्षपत्न्या समादिष्टः सदृशः सज्जनः पतिः ॥ उषोवाच यद्य् एनं मे विशालाक्षि भर्तारम् अमरोपमम् । अन्तरिक्षचरा च त्वं योगिनी कामरूपिणी । उपायशिल्पकुशला क्षिप्रम् आनय मे प्रियम् ॥
units.english: Blessed and favoured you are, friend, since Bhavāni has selected such a great Yadu prince as your husband –. Ushā said:— you of large eyes, you of a beautiful face, you alone are capable of making us a pair. Do find out some refuge for me who am helpless. You are capable of ranging in the sky and assuming various forms. You are also clever in finding out means. Do you soon bring here my love.

units.sanskrit: सिद्धार्था संनिवर्तस्व येनोपायेन सुन्दरि ॥ भवेद् आपत्सु यन् मित्रं तन् मित्रं शस्यते बुधैः । कामार्ता चास्मि सुश्रोणि भव मे प्राणधारिणी । अद्य नानयसि क्षिप्रं प्राणांस् त्यक्ष्याम्य् अहं शुभे ॥ उषाया वचनं श्रुत्वा चित्रलेखाब्रवीद् वचः । श्रोतुम् अर्हसि कल्याणि वचनं मे शुचिस्मिते ॥
units.english: friend, fair one, think of the measure by which you will be able to accomplish this work. The learned speak highly of a friend who helps us in adversity. you of fair waist, am stricken with lust. Give me my life. If you do not even to-day bring soon my immortal-like husband will forsake my life -. Hearing Ushā's words Chitralekha said:— auspicious and sweet-smiling lady, hear what say: timid lady, as Vāna's city is protected so the city of Dwaravati is equally invincible.

units.sanskrit: गुप्तावृष्णिकुमारैश् च तथा द्वारकवासिभिः ॥
units.english: That city is girt with iron walls and the Vrishni princes and inhabitants of Dwarakā protect it.

units.sanskrit: प्रान्ते सलिलसंयुक्ता विहिता विश्वकर्मणा । रक्ष्यते पुरुषैर् घोरैः पद्मनाभस्य शासनात् ॥ शैलप्राकारपरिखा दुर्गमार्गप्रवेशिनी । सप्तप्राकाररचिता पर्वतैर् धातुमण्डितैः । न च शक्यम् अविज्ञातैः प्रवेष्टुं द्वारकां पुरीम् । आत्मानं मां च रक्षस्व पितरं च विशेषतः ॥
units.english: Around that city constructed by the Celestial Architect Viswakarmā lies a ditch full of water and at the mandate of the lotus-navelled deity great heroes protect it. There are mountain walls around the city and one is to enter there through a fort way. With seven mountains full of metals seven ditches have been made there. stranger cannot enter that city. Therefore, save me, your self and specially your father –.

units.sanskrit: तव योगप्रभावेण शक्यं तत्र प्रवेशनम् । किं मे बहुविलापेन श्रूयतां सखि कारणम् । यद्य् अहं तं न पश्यामि यास्यामि यमसादनम् ॥
units.english: Ushā said:—You will undoubtedly be able to enter there through your Yoga power. friend, what more shall say? Hear what speak. If do not behold the moon-like countenance of Aniruddha, shall forsooth repair to the temple of Yama.

units.sanskrit: दूतम् आसाद्य कार्याणां सिद्धिर् भवति भामिनि । तस्माद् दौत्येन मे गच्छ जीवन्तीं मां यदीच्छसि । यदि त्वं मे विजानासि सख्यं प्रेम्णा च भाषितम् । क्षिप्रम् आनय मे कान्तं प्राणांस् त्यक्ष्यामि वा प्रियान् ॥
units.english: generous lady, if works like these are undertaken readily they prove a success. If you therefore wish to see me alive proceed soon on your errand. If you regard me as your friend, seek your help and ask you with love to bring soon my lover.

units.sanskrit: जीवितस्य हि संदेहं क्षयं चैव कुलस्य च । कामार्ता हि न पश्यन्ति दूषणं वै कुलस्य च ॥
units.english: If one cherishes fear against her life her family meets with extinction. The woman, who is striken with love, does not see the defect of her family.

units.sanskrit: प्रयत्नो युज्यते कार्ये ष्विति शास्त्रनिदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: And they always carefully seek for them. Such is the sanction of the Shastras.

units.sanskrit: त्वं च शक्ता विशालाक्षि द्वारकायाः प्रवेशने । चित्रलेखोवाच एषा गच्छाम्य् अहं भीरु प्रविश्य द्वारकां पुरीम् । सर्वथा संस्तुता ते ऽहं वाक्यैर् अमृतकल्पकैः । कारिता च समुद्योगं प्रियैः कान्तैश् च भाषितैः । भर्तारम् आनयाम्य् अद्य तव वृष्णिकुलोद्वहम् ॥ अनिरुद्धं महाबाहुं प्रविश्य द्वारकां पुरीम् । उक्त्वा चान्तर्हिता क्षिप्रं चित्रलेखा मनोजवा ॥
units.english: You will surely be able to enter into Dwaraka, you of large eyes. request you again and again. Bring my love here. Chitrālekha said:— have been propitiated by you with nectarine words. You have, with your sweet words, made arrangements for your own work. am just going to the city of Dwārakā. Entering that city even to-day will bring your husband Aniruddha born in the family of Vrishnis -. Giving vent to those truthful words dreadful to the Dānavas, Chitralekhā, fleet like the mind, disappeared therefrom.

units.sanskrit: तृतीये तु मुहूर्ते सा नष्टा बाणपुरात् तदा । कैलासशिखराकारैः प्रासादैर् उपशोभिताम् । ददर्श द्वारकां चैव दिवि तारेव संस्थिताम् ॥
units.english: In order to please her friend she, in the third Muhurtta, reached Dwārakā governed by Krishna. She saw there Dwārakā, adorned with palaces huge as the summits of the mount Kailāsha, like a star stationed in the sky -.

units.sanskrit: तत्समीपे ऽनिरुद्धस्य भवनं सा स्म पश्यति ॥
units.english: Near it she saw Airuddha's palace.

units.sanskrit: सौवर्णवेदिकास्तम्भं रुक्मवैदूर्यतोरणम् । माल्यदामावसक्तं च पूर्णकुम्भोपशोभितम् ॥
units.english: It had golden altars and pillars made of gold and sapphires. It was adorned with garlands and jairs full of water.

units.sanskrit: बर्हिकण्ठानतग्रीवं प्रासादैर् एकसंचयैः । मणिप्रवालसंस्तीर्णं दिव्यगन्धर्वनादितम् । ददर्श भवनं यत्र प्राद्युम्निर् अवसत् सुखम् ॥ ततः प्रविश्य सहसा भवनं तस्य तन् महत् । तत्रानिरुद्धं सापश्यच् चित्रलेखा वराप्सराः । ददर्श मध्ये नारीणां तारापतिम् इवोदितम् ॥ क्रीडाविहारे नारीभिः सेव्यमानम् इतस् ततः । पिबन्तं मधु माध्वीकं श्रिया परमया युतम् । वाद्यते समतालं च गीयते मधुरं तथा । न च तस्य मनस् तत्र तम् एवार्थम् अचिन्तयत् ॥ स्त्रियः सर्वगुणोपेता नृत्यन्ते तत्र तत्र वै । न चास्य मनसस् तुष्टिं चित्रलेखा प्रपश्यति । व्यक्तम् अस्य हि तत् स्वप्नं हृदये परिवर्तते । इति तत्रैव बुद्ध्या च निश्चिता गतसाध्वसा । सा दृष्ट्वा परमस्त्रीणां मध्ये शक्रध्वजोपमम् । प्रियासु गीयमानासु नृत्यमानासु सर्वशः । चिन्तयाविष्टदेहा सा चित्रलेखा मनस्विनी । कथं कार्यम् इदं कार्यं कथं स्वस्ति भवेन् मम ॥
units.english: It had beautiful figures of peacocks on the turret and had a rows of celestial buildings set with jems and corals and filled with the music of the Gandharvas. Beholding the huge palace at the centre of Dwārakā where Pradyumna's son lived happily, Chitralekhā, all on a sudden, saw Aniruddha there. She saw there Kāma's son playing in the midst of highly beautiful women as the moon shines amongst the stars. Hundreds of women were attending on him. Seated like Kuvera on a most excellent beautiful seat Aniruddha was drinking Mādhvika wine. There were being sung sweet songs in accompaniment with time. But Aniruddha's mind was not attached thereto. Many accomplished ladies were dancing there but Chitralekha did not see him pleased thereby. At that time his mind was not much after pleasure and he was showing dislike even for drinking. Thereupon thinking Surely his mind is busy with the dream, Chitralekhhā was shorn of anxiety –. Beholding Aniruddha like Indra's standard in the midst of those beautiful women the intelligent Chitralekhā thus revolved in her mind How shall accomplish this work? How shall we meet with well-being? Beholding Aniruddha in the midst of the women in his palace, the illustrious Chitralekhā, having beautiful eyes, thought:—By my Tamasik illusion will overpower all except Aniruddha.

units.sanskrit: तामस्या छादयाम् आस विद्यया शुभलोचना ॥ हर्म्ये स्त्रीगणमध्यस्थं कृत्वा चान्तर्हितं तदा । उत्पपात गृहीत्वा सा प्राद्युम्निं युद्धदुर्मदम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon hiding herself in the sky above the palace, she, in sweet words, said to Kāma's son:— hero! descendant of Yadu, is it all well with you? Have you spent well the day and evening? large-armed son of Rati, hear, have something to communicate to you.

units.sanskrit: सा तम् अध्वानम् आगम्य सिद्धचारणसेवितम् । सहसा शोणितपुरं प्रविवेश मनोजवा ॥ अदर्शनं तम् आनीय मायया कामरूपिणी । अनिरुद्धं महाभागा यत्रोषा तत्र गच्छति ॥
units.english: have come here to inform you something of my friend Ushā. hero, have been sent to you by Ushā whom you saw in a dream and married and who has been cherishing you at her heart. gentle one, that maiden is again and again weeping, yawning and sighing for seeing you. hero, she will live if you go there. Forsooth, in your absence she will die.

units.sanskrit: उषायादर्शयच् चैनं चित्राभरणभूषितम् ॥ चित्राम्बरधरं वीरं कन्दर्पसमरूपिणम् । तृतीये तु मुहूर्ते सा प्राप्ता बाणपुरं तदा । उषां तां दर्शयाम् आस पश्यैनं यद्य् असौ भवेत् ॥ एवम् उक्ता तदा कन्या बाणस्य दुहिता ततः । तत्रोषा विस्मिता दृष्ट्वा हर्म्यस्था सखिसंनिधौ । प्रवेशयाम् आस तदा संप्राप्तं स्वगृहं ततः ॥ प्रवेशिते ऽनिरुद्धे तु प्रहृष्टा सहिता तया । सखीजनसमायुक्ता लज्जमाना शुचिस्मिता । प्रहर्षोत्फुल्लनयना प्रियं दृष्ट्वार्थकोविदा । सा हर्म्यस्था तम् अर्घ्येण यादवं समपूजयत् । चित्रलेखां परिष्वज्य प्रियाख्यानैर् अयोजयत् । त्वरिता कामिनी प्राह चित्रलेखां भयातुरा ॥ सखीदं वै कथं गुह्यं कार्यं कार्यविशारदे । गुह्ये कृते भवेत् स्वस्ति प्रकाशे जीवितक्षयः ॥ चित्रलेखाब्रवीद् वाक्यं शृणु त्वं निश्चयं सखि । कृतं पुरुषकारं हि दैवं नाशयते सखि ॥
units.english: descendant of Yadu, although thousands of women are reigning in your heart still you should hold her by the hand who cherishes you at heart. Besides while conferring on her a boon the goddess pointed to you as her becoming husband. Keeping that portrait on her person she is surviving with the hope of seeing you. hero, hear, will describe now her birth, family, character, nature, and the history of her father. Forsooth the goddess has selected her as your becoming husband. Kāma's son, that beautiful maiden is living with the hope of being united with you –. Hearing the words of Chitralekhā Aniruddha said:— beautiful lady, hear how saw her in a dream. am day and night beside myself with thinking of her beauty, weeping and other movements. Chitralekhā, wish to see my love. Therefore if am worthy of your favour and if you wish to make friends with me take me there. Crossing the road frequented by Siddhas and Chāranas Chitralekhā, all on a sudden, entered into the city of Shonitpura. Thereupon welcoming Chitralekhā with sweet words, the maiden, in fear, quickly said to her:— you clever in work, how will this work be accomplished secretly? Everything will be well if it is finished privately. If it gets wind however our life will be in danger. Hearing it Chitralekhā said:— friend, hear what have to say in this matter. The Providence destroys even manliness.

units.sanskrit: न वै देव्याः प्रसादस् ते अनुकूलो भविष्यति । अप्रमादात् कृतं गुह्यं न कश्चिज् ज्ञास्यते नरः ॥
units.english: By the favour of the goddess every thing will turn out in your favour. Besides if we carefully and secretly finish this work no body will be able to know it.

units.sanskrit: एवम् एतद् इति प्राह सानिरुद्धम् इदं वचः ॥ दिष्ट्या स्वप्नगतश् चोरो दृश्यते सुभगो जनः । यत्कृते तु वयं खिन्ना दुर्लभप्रियकाङ्क्षया ॥ कच्चित् तव महाबाहो कुशलं सर्वतोगतम् । तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा उषायाः श्लक्ष्णम् अर्थवत् । सो ऽप्य् आह यदुशार्दूलः शुभाक्षरतरं वचः ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by her friend she was consoled and said So be it. Afterwards she said to Aniruddha—By my good luck, that lucky person has been seen by me, who acted like a thief in a dream, and seeking whom as a lover, difficult to be found, was stricken with sorrow. hero, the heart of women is really tender and therefore ask you Is everything well? –. Hearing those sensible and sweet words of Ushā, Aniruddha, the foremost of Yadus, replied in still sweeter words.

units.sanskrit: हर्षविप्लुतनेत्रायाः पाणिनाश्रु प्रमृज्य च । प्रहस्य सस्मितं प्राह हृदयग्राहकं वचः ॥
units.english: Wiping the tears off the eyes of Vāna's daughter he smilingly said in words attracting her mind:— goddess, fair one, you of sweet words, give you a happy tidings.

units.sanskrit: कुशलं मे वरारोहे सर्वत्र मितभाषिणि । अदृष्टपूर्वश् च मया देशो ऽयं शुभदर्शने । निशि स्वप्ने मया दृष्टं सकृत् कन्यापुरं महत् ॥
units.english: Everything is well with me every where by your favour. fair one, had never seen this place before. Only once in a dream came to this city of maidens.

units.sanskrit: न च तद् रुद्रपत्न्या वै मिथ्या वाक्यं भविष्यति ॥
units.english: timid girl, the words of Rudra's consort can never be untrue, and therefore by your favour have come to this place.

units.sanskrit: देव्यास् तु प्रीतिम् आज्ञाय त्वत्प्रियार्थं च भाविनि । अनुप्राप्तो ऽस्मि चाद्यैव प्रसीद शरणं गतः । इत्य् उक्त्वा रमयाम् आस सो ऽनिरुद्धो महायशाः । इत्य् उक्त्वा त्वरमाणा सा गुह्यदेशे स्वलंकृता । ततश् चोद्वाहधर्मेण गान्धर्वेण समीयतुः । अन्योन्यं रेमतुस् तौ तु चक्रवाकौ यथा दिवा ॥
units.english: Thinking that the goddess will be pleased and you will be satisfied, have come here and sought your protection. Be you pleased –. Thus addressed by her lover, Ushā, adorned with beautiful ornaments, conducted him to a private room and waited there as if stricken with great fear. Thereupon united in nuptials according to Gandharva rites they spent the day like a pair of Chakravākas.

units.sanskrit: पतिना सानिरुद्धेन मुमुदे तु वराङ्गना । कान्तेन सह संयुक्ता दिव्यस्रगनुलेपना । रममाणानिरुद्धेन अविज्ञाता तु सा तदा ॥
units.english: United with her husband, Aniruddha, the beautiful Ushā, adorned with celestial garlands and unguents, attained to an excess of joy –. Although she lived happily with Aniruddha nobody could know it.

units.sanskrit: दिव्रमाल्याम्बरधरो दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः । उषया सह संयुक्तो विज्ञातो बाणरक्षिभिः ॥
units.english: But a few days after Vāna's guards came to know that Ushā was living with Aniruddha the foremost of Yadus adorned with celestial garlands and raiments and pasted with celestial unguents.

units.sanskrit: अथ तस्याम् अवस्थायां स्थविरा वेत्रपाणयः । श्रुत्वैतद् रोषयुक्तस् तु बलं बाणो निरीक्ष्य तत् । ततस् तैश् चारपुरुषैर् बाणस्यावेदितं तदा । गच्छध्वं सहिताः सर्वे हन्यताम् एष दुर्मतिः । येन नः कुलचारित्रं दूषितं दूषितात्मना ॥
units.english: Afterwards they speedily communicated to Vāna the conduct of his daughter which they had seen -. Hearing it the heroic son of Bali, Vāna, the slayer of his enemies, ordered his servant soldiers to kill Aniruddha. He said:—Do you all soon proceed and kill that sinful, wicked wretch who has sullied the character of our family.

units.sanskrit: उषायां धर्षितायां हि कुलं नो धर्षितं महत् । अहो वीर्यमहो धैर्यम् अहो धार्ष्ट्यं च दुर्मतेः । यः पुरं भवनं चेदं प्रविष्टो नः सुबालिशः ॥
units.english: Alas, Ushā being ravished our great family has been contaminated. Alas, what is the strength, patience and pride of that stupid person who has entered into my city and palace and has ravished my daughter by force though did not give her away.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा पुनस् तांस् तु किंकरांश् चोदयद् भृशम् ॥
units.english: Saying this Vāna again urged on his soldiers.

units.sanskrit: ते तस्याज्ञाम् अथो गृह्य सुसंनद्धा विनिर्ययुः । नानाशस्त्रोद्यतकरा नानारूपधरास् तु ते । दानवाः समभिक्रुद्धाः प्राद्युम्निवधकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
units.english: They issued out, obeying his command and putting on their coats of mail. In great anger those highly dreadful and powerful Dānavas, taking up various weapons, came speedily where Aniruddha was in order to kill him –.

units.sanskrit: रुदते तद्बलं दृष्ट्वा बाष्पेणावृतलोचना । प्राद्युम्निवधभीता सा बाणपुत्री यशस्विनी ॥ ततस् तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ताम् उषां मृगलोचनाम् । हा हा कान्तेति वेपन्तीम् अनिरुद्धो ऽभ्यभाषत ॥
units.english: Thereupon he saw that the soldiers, taking up various weapons, stood encircling that big house. Her eves were filled with tears. Then beholding the deer-eyed Ushā cry piteously Oh my husband! Oh my husband! and tremble. Aniruddha said:—May your fear disappear.

units.sanskrit: अभयं ते ऽस्तु सश्रोणि मा भैस् त्वं हि मयि स्थिते । संप्राप्तो हर्षकालस् ते न ते ऽस्ति भयकारणम् ॥ कृत्स्नो ऽयं यदि बाणस्य भृट्यवर्गो यशस्विनि । आगच्छेत न मे चिन्ता भीरु पश्याद्य विक्रमम् ॥ तस्य सैन्यस्य निनदं श्रुत्वाभ्यागच्छतस् ततः । सहसैवोत्थितः श्रीमान् प्राद्युम्निः किम् इति ब्रुवन् ॥ अथास्यापश्यत बलं नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् । स्थितं समन्ततस् तत्र परिवार्य गृहं महत् ॥
units.english: you of a beautiful waist, you need not fear as long as am here. illustrious lady, you have not the least ground for fear. Rather the time of your joy has arrived. If the entire collection of Vāna's servants arrives here am not the least anxious. Witness my power to-day, timid girl –. Hearing the uproar of the soldiers Pradyumna's son rose up all on a sudden and said What is this? Thereupon he saw the soldiers encircling with various weapons all sides of that big palace. Saying this and taking up his arms Aniruddha, biting his lips in anger, speedily went where the soldiers were.

units.sanskrit: ततो युद्धम् अपोढानां बाणेयानां निशम्य तु । सा चित्रलेखा सस्मार नारदं देवदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon understanding that an encounter would soon take place with the followers of Vāna Chitralekhā thought of the god-like Rishi Nārada.

units.sanskrit: स्मृतो ऽथ चित्रलेखायाः पुरं शोणितसाह्वयम् ॥
units.english: Recollected by Chitralekhā that foremost of Munis, within a moment, arrived at the city named Shonita.

units.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षे स्थितस् तत्र सो ऽनिरुद्धम् अथाब्रवीत् । ततश् च नारदं दृष्ट्वा सो ऽभिवाद्य महाबलः । प्रहृष्टः सुमना भूत्वा युद्धार्थम् अभ्यवर्तत । ततस् तेषां स्वनं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषाम् एव गर्जताम् । सहसैवोत्थितः शूरस् तोत्रार्दित इव द्विपः ॥
units.english: Stationed in the sky he said to Aniruddha:—Do not fear, hero, have come to this city. Thereupon beholding Nārada and saluting him the highly powerful Aniruddha grew delighted and made himself ready for the battle. Thereupon hearing the uproar of the soldiers he, all on a sudden, rose up like an elephant goaded with a pike.

units.sanskrit: तम् आपतन्तं दृष्ट्वैव संदष्टौष्ठं महाभुजम् । अन्तःपुरद्वारगतं परिघं गृह्य चातुलम् । वधाय तेषां चिक्षेप नानायुधविशारदः ॥ असिभिः शक्तिभिः शूलैर् निजघ्नू रणगोचरम् ॥ दानवैः समभिक्रुद्धैः प्राद्युम्निः शस्त्रकोविदैः । नाक्षुभ्यत् सर्वभूतात्मा नदन् मेघ इवोष्णगे ॥
units.english: Beholding that large-armed hero come down from the palace biting his lips they fled away stricken with fear. Seeing it Pradyumna's son, expert in various forms of war-fare, took up a Parigha, lying at the door of the inner appartment and hurled it at them. Those soldiers, masters of fighting, struck Aniruddha with a downpour of clubs, maces, swords, darts and arrows. Although completely wounded with Nārachas and Parighas by those expert Dānavas Pradyumna, roaring like an evening cloud, was not over-powered.

units.sanskrit: आविध्य परिघं घोरं तेषां मध्ये व्यवस्थितः । सूर्यो दिविचरन्मध्ये मेघानाम् इव सर्वतः ॥
units.english: As the sun ranges in the midst of clouds in the sky, so he, taking up a dreadful Parigha, stood in their midst.

units.sanskrit: दण्डकाष्ठाजिनधरो नारदो ह्रष्टचेतनः । साधु साध्व् इति वै तत्र सो ऽनिरुद्धम् अभाषत । ते हन्यमाना रौद्रेण परिघेणामितौजसा । विद्राव्य दानवान् वीरः परिघेणाशुविक्रमः । अनिरुद्धो नदन् हृष्टः सिंहनादं व्यरोचत । घर्मान्ते तोयदो व्योम्नि नदन्न् इव महास्वनः ॥
units.english: Seeing it Nārada, carrying a staff and a black antelope skin, delightedly said to Aniruddha Well-done! Well-done! Thus assailed with the dreadful Parigha by Pradyumna of incomparable power, the soldiers fled away like clouds dispersed by the wind. Having driven with Parigha the Dānavas from the battle-field the highly powerful hero Aniruddha delightedly set up a leonine shout as the clouds mutter in the sky after the termination of the rainy season.

units.sanskrit: तिष्ठध्वम् इति चुक्रोश दानवान् युद्धदुर्मदान् । प्राद्युम्निर् व्यहनच् चापि सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः ॥
units.english: Saying to the Dānavas, dreadful in battle Wait, wait! Pradyumna's son, the slayer of his enemies, began to smile.

units.sanskrit: तेन ते समरे सर्वे हन्यमाना महात्मना । यतो बाणस् ततो भीता ययुर् युद्धपराङ्मुखाः ॥
units.english: Thus assailed by that high-souled hero in battle they, flying from the battle-field and stricken with fear, went where Vāna was.

units.sanskrit: ततो बाणसमीपस्थाः श्वसन्तो रुधिरोक्षिताः । न शर्म लेभिरे दैत्या भयविक्लवलोचनाः ॥ मा भैष्ट मा भैष्ट इति राज्ञा ते तेन चोदिताः । त्रासं विसृज्य चैकस्था युध्यध्वं दानवर्षभाः ॥ तान् उवाच पुनर् बाणो भयवित्रस्तलोचनान् । किम् इदं लोकविख्यातं यश उत्सृज्य दूरतः । भवन्तो यान्ति वैक्लव्यं क्लीबा इव विचेतसः ॥ को ऽयं यस्य भयत्रस्ता भवन्तो यान्त्य् अनेकशः । भवद्भिर् न हि मे युद्धे कार्यं साहाय्यम् अद्य वै । अथ तान् वाग्भिर् उग्राभिस् त्रासयन् बहुधा बली । व्यादिदेश रणे शूरान् सर्वान् अयुतशः पुनः ॥
units.english: And even going near Vāna, those Danāvas, bathed in blood and having their eyes dilated with fear, could not enjoy peace. They began to sigh heavily again and again; they were urged on by Vanā saying No fear! No fear! ye leading Danavas, casting off fear, do ye fight again. Vāna again said to them who had their eyes dilated with fear:—-. Throwing off your glory well known in three worlds, why are you bewildered like eunuchs ? Who is he, of whom you are so much afraid, you who are born in well known families and who are clever in fighting?. You need not help me to today. Avaunt, quit my sight. Censuring them thus with very many harsh words the powerful Vāna ordered millions of other soldiers to proceed to the battle-field,.

units.sanskrit: अनीकं सुमहद्रात्रौ नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् ॥
units.english: He then appointed Rudar's army consisting of many Pramathas with various weapons in vanquishing Aniruddha.

units.sanskrit: तत्रान्तरिक्षं बहुधा विद्युद्वद्भिर् इवाम्बुदैः । बाणानीकैः समभवद् व्याप्तं संदीप्तलोचनैः ॥
units.english: Thereupon the entire firmament was covered with Vāna's soldiers having burning eyes and resembling clouds surcharged with lightning.

units.sanskrit: केचित् क्षितिस्थाः प्राक्रोशन् गजा इव समन्ततः । अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदन् घर्मान्तेष्व् इव तोयदाः ॥
units.english: Some of them stood on the surface of the earth roaring like elephants and some appeared like clouds of the rainy season.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तत् सुमहद् युद्धं समेतम् अभवत् पुनः । तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति च तदा वाचो ऽश्रूयन्त सर्वशः ॥
units.english: Thereupon when that huge army again assembled there were heard on all sides cries of Wait! Wait!.

units.sanskrit: अनिरुद्धो रणे वीरः स च तान् अभ्यवर्तत । तद् आश्चर्यं समभवद् यद् एकस् तैः समागतः । अयुध्यत महावीर्यैर् दानवैः सह संयुगे ॥ तेषाम् एव च जग्राह परिघांस् तोमरान् अपि । पुनः स परिघं घोरं प्रगृह्य रणमूर्धनि । स दैत्यसंघान् समरे निजघान महाबलान् ॥
units.english: The hero Aniruddha ran towards them. It was really a wonder, king, that he fought then single-handed with many. Engaged in the encounter with the highly powerful Dānavas he snatched away their Parighas and Tomaras and killed them with them. Taking up his most excellent Parigha again and again in the battle-field the highly powerful Aniruddha killed the Daityas endued with great power -.

units.sanskrit: निस्त्रिंशं चर्म चोत्सृष्टं जग्राह रणमूर्धनि । स तेन व्यचरन् मार्गान् एकः शत्रुनिबर्हणः ॥
units.english: At that time Kāma's son, the slayer of his enemies, taking up his Nistringsha and leathern protector, was seen moving about in twelve ways.

units.sanskrit: इति प्रकारान् द्वात्रिंशद् विचरन्न् अभ्यदृश्यत ॥ एकं सहस्रशस् तत्र ददृशू रणमूर्धनि । ततस् तेनाभिसंतप्ता रुधिरौघपरिप्लुताः । पुनर् भग्नाः प्राद्रवन्त यत्र बाणः स्थितो रणे ॥
units.english: Thus when he moved about in the battle-field in a thousand different ways the enemies saw him as the playing Death with thousands of mouth wide open. Thereupon again assailed by Aniruddha the Asuras, bathed in blood, again fled away from the battle-field and went where Vāna was.

units.sanskrit: गजवाजिरथौघैस् ते उह्यमानाः समन्ततः । एकैकस्योपरि तदा ते ऽन्योन्यं भयपीडिताः । वमन्तः शोणितं जग्मुर् विषादाद् विमुखा रणे ॥
units.english: Crying plaintively those highly powerful Asuras fled away on all sides riding elephants, horses and cars. At that time the Dānavas, who had fled from the battle-field, were so much overwhelmed with sorrow and fear that one fell upon the other and they all vomitted blood.

units.sanskrit: युध्यताम् अनिरुद्धेन यथावर्तत दारुणम् । तादृशं न भयं तेषाम् अभवद् देवसंयुगे । केचिद् वमन्तो रुधिरम् अपतन् वसुधातले । दानवा गिरिशृङ्गाभा गदाशूलासिपाणयः ॥
units.english: While fighting with Aniruddha the Dānavas experienced such a fear as they had not even while fighting with the gods in the days of yore. Some vomitted blood and some fell down on earth amongst those Danavas, resembling mountain summits who had clubs, maces and swords in their hands.

units.sanskrit: ते बाणम् उत्सृज्य रणे जग्मुर् भयसमाकुलाः । निःसङ्गभग्नां महतीं दृष्ट्वा तां वाहिनीं तदा । बाणः क्रोधात् प्रजज्वाल समिद्धो ऽग्निर् इवाध्वरे ॥ नारदो नृत्यति प्रीतो ह्य् अनिरुद्धस्य संयुगे ॥ एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे चैव बाणः परमकोपन । कुम्भाण्डसंगृहीतं तु रथम् आस्थाय वीर्यवान् । ययौ यत्रानिरुद्धो वै सो ऽसिम् उद्यम्य दारुणम् ॥
units.english: Leaving behind Vāna in the battle-field those vanquished Danavas fled away in fear to the welkin. Beholding his army thus routed to a man Vāna was inflamed with ire like unto sacrificial fire when fuels are put to it. Ranging all over the welkin, Nārada, pleased with seeing Aniruddha's fight, began to dance exclaiming Well-done! Well-done! In the meantime, powerful Vāna, worked up with anger, ascending the car, brought by Kumbhānda, drove with uplifting sword where Aniruddha was.

units.sanskrit: पट्टिसासिगदाशूलान् उद्यम्य च परश्वधान् । बभौ बाहुसहस्रेण शक्रध्वजशतैर् इव ॥
units.english: As Sakra shines with his thousand standards so that Asura appeared beautiful there holding by his thousand hands Pattiças, swords, clubs, darts and axes –.

units.sanskrit: विसृजञ् शतशो बाणान् दानवो ऽथ महाबलः । अभ्यद्रवच् च वेगेन प्राद्युम्निर् यत्र संस्थितः । वचनं तस्य संश्रुत्य प्राद्युम्निर् अपराजितः । बाणस्य वदतः संख्ये उदैक्षत ततो ऽहसत् ॥ उषा च पितरं दृष्ट्वा भयविह्वललोचना । ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गं दशनल्वं महारथम् ॥ आरुह्य स्यन्दनं वीरो बभौ बाहुसहस्रवान् । तस्य वाजिसहस्रं तु रथे युक्तं महात्मना । पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे हिरण्यकशिपोर् इव ॥
units.english: Having his thousand hands adorned with gloves, finger-protectors and various weapons that best of Dānavas shone there in exceeding beauty. Sending up a leonine shout in anger that Asura, having eyes reddened in anger, drew his huge bow and exclaimed Wait! Wait! Hearing those words of Vāna in the battle-field that unconquerable son of Pradyumna saw his face and smiled –. Like unto Hiranyakashipu's car formerly in the battle between gods and Asuras the chariot of the highly powerful Vāna was drawn by thousand horses, set with hundreds of small bells, adorned with red standards and flags, coated with bear-skin and was ten furlongs in length.

units.sanskrit: तम् आपतन्तं ददृशे दानवं यदुपुंगवः । संप्रहृष्टस् ततो युद्धे तेजसा चाप्य् अपूर्यत ॥
units.english: Beholding that Asura about to attack him, Aniruddha, the foremost of Yadus, was highly pleased and filled with anger.

units.sanskrit: असिचर्मधरो वीरः स्वस्थः संग्रामलालसः । नरसिंहो यथा पूर्वम् आदिदैत्यवधोद्यतः । आपतन्तं ददर्शाथ खड्गचर्मधरं तदा ॥ खड्गचर्मधरं तं तु दृष्ट्वा बाणः पदातिनम् । प्रहर्षम् अतुलं लेभे प्राद्युम्निवधकाङ्क्षया ॥
units.english: Like unto Narahari prepared to kill the prince of Daityas in the days of yore he stood impassionately for battle with his sword and armour on -. Vāna then saw him approach with sword and leathern-protector. Beholding him thus approach on foot with dagger and leathern protector Vāna attained to an excess of joy thinking that he would kill him.

units.sanskrit: तनुत्रेण विहीनश् च खड्गपाणिश् च यादवः । अनिरुद्धं रणे बाणो जितकाशी महाबलः । वाचं चोवाच संक्रुद्धो गृह्यतां हन्यताम् इति ॥ वाचं च ब्रुवतस् तस्य श्रुत्वा प्राद्युम्निर् आहवे । बाणस्य ब्रुवतः क्रोधाद् धसमानो ऽभ्युदैक्षत ॥
units.english: That Yādava had a sword in his hand, but no coat of mail. Still thinking Aniruddha invincible the powerful Vāna confronted him for battle –. He exclaimed in anger Arrest him! Kill him! While he thus cried in the battle-field Pradyumna's son looked, in anger, at his face and laughed.

units.sanskrit: उषा भयपरित्रस्ता रुदती तत्र भामिनी । अनिरुद्धः प्रहस्याथ समाश्वास्य च तां स्थिताम् ॥
units.english: At that time stricken with fear Ushā began to weep. Aniruddha, consoling her with a smile, stood for the battle.

units.sanskrit: अथ बाणः शरौघाणि क्षुद्रकाणां समन्ततः । चिक्षेप समरे क्रुद्धो ह्य् अनिरुद्धवधेप्सया ॥
units.english: Thereupon filled with anger, Vāna, desirous of killing Aniruddha, discharged in numerable arrows by name Khshudraka.

units.sanskrit: अनिरुद्धस् तु चिच्छेद काङ्क्षंस् तस्य पराजयम् । ववर्ष शरजालानि क्षुद्रकाणां समन्ततः । बाणोऽनिरुद्धशिरसि काङ्क्षंस् तस्य रणे वधम् ॥ बभौ प्रमुखतस् तस्य स्थितः सूर्य इवोदये ॥ सो ऽभिभूय रणे बाणम् आस्थितो यदुनन्दनः । सिंहः प्रमुखतो दृष्ट्वा गजम् एकं यथा वने ॥ ततो बाणसहस्रौघैर् मर्मभेदिभिर् आशुगैः । सो ऽतिविद्धो महाबाहुर् बाणैः संनतपर्वभिः । क्रोधेनाभिप्रजज्वाल चिकीर्षुः कर्म दुष्करम् ॥ रुधिरौघप्लुतैर् गात्रैर् बाणवर्षैः समाहतः । अभिभूतः सुसंक्रुद्धो ययौ बाणरथं प्रति ॥ सो ऽतिविद्धः शरौघैस् तु प्राद्युम्निर् नाभ्यकम्पत ॥
units.english: Aniruddha too, desirous of defeating him, cut them off –. Thereupon desiring that he would kill Aniruddha in the battle-field Vāna aimed at his head many Kshudraka arrows. Aniruddha too baffled them with his leathern-protector and appeared before him like the rising sun -. Afterwards Vāna, with a thousand quick coursing and sharpened arrows, pierced the invincible son of Pradyumna to the quick. As in the forest a lion over powers an elephant on seeing it before him so the Yadu prince Aniruddha overpowered Vāna –. There upon thus wounded with those arrows the larged-armed Aniruddha was inflamed with anger for displaying a wonderful feat. Assailed with that downpour of arrows and having his body covered with blood he went before Vanā’s car –. The soldiers then assailed Prādyumna's son with sharpened swords, maces, darts, Pattiças and Tomaras. And although sorely wounded he did not tremble.

units.sanskrit: आप्लुत्य सहसा क्रुद्धो रथेषां तस्य सो ऽच्छिनत् । जघानाश्वांश् च खड्गेन बाणस्य रथमूर्धनि ॥
units.english: Then leaping up in anger in that battle-field he, with his dagger, cut off the reins of Vāna's car and struck the horses.

units.sanskrit: तं पुनः शरवर्षेण तोमरैः पट्टिसैस् तथा । ततो ऽवप्लुत्य सहसा रथपार्श्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥ शक्तिं बाणस् ततः क्रुद्धो घोररूपां भयावहाम् । जग्राह ज्वलितां दीप्तां घण्टामालाकुलां रणे ॥
units.english: Seeing it Vāna, an expert in fighting, threw him down from there with a shower of arrows, Pattiças and Tomaras. Then desisting from the fight, the Dānavas, regarding Aniruddha dead, sent up a leonine shout and jumped up on the car. Thereupon Vāna, irate, took up the dreadful and grim-looking Sakti, effulgent like the sun and burning fire-brand and set with bells and discharged it not carrying for Ushā's widowhood.

units.sanskrit: सो ऽभिप्लुत्य तदा शक्तिं जग्राह पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ निर्बिभेद ततो बाणं स्वशक्त्यैव महाबलः । सा भित्त्वा तस्य देहं तु जगाम वसुधातलम् ॥ वैशंपायनः ततो मूर्छाभिभूतं तं कुम्भाण्डो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । उपेक्षसे दानवेन्द्र किम् एवं शत्रुम् उद्यतम् ॥ लब्धलक्ष्यो ह्य् अयं वीरो निर्विकारो ऽद्य दृश्यते । मायाम् आश्रित्य युध्यस्व नायं वध्यो ऽन्यथा भवेत् ॥ आत्मानं मां च रक्षस्व प्रमादात् किम् उपेक्षसे । वध्यताम् अयम् अद्यैव न नः सर्वान् विनाशयेत् ॥
units.english: Beholding that life-ending Sakti about to fall on him the highly powerful Kāma's son, foremost of men, leaped up, took hold of the Sakti and pierced Vāna with that. Cutting through his body it entered into the earth. Wounded sorely thereby Vāna supported himself on a standard. Thereupon seeing him unconscious Kumbhānda said -. king of Dānavas, why do you disregard this rising enemy? We see this hero has gained his aim and is impassionate. Resorting to your illusory prowess, fight with him or else he will not be slain. Save yourself and us by virtue of your illusory power. Kill him, hero, before he destroys us all.

units.sanskrit: अन्यांश् च शतशो हत्वा उषां नीत्वा व्रजिष्यति । कुम्भाण्डवचनैर् एवं दानवेन्द्रः प्रचोदितः । वाचं रूक्षाम् अभिक्रुद्धः प्रोवाच वदतां वरः ॥
units.english: Killing hundreds of others he will carry away Ushā -. Excited at these words of Kumbhānda, the king of Dānavas, the foremost of speakers, filled with great anger, gave vent to the following harsh words:— will kill him in this battle.

units.sanskrit: आदास्याम्य् अहम् एनं वै गरुत्मान् इव पन्नगम् ॥
units.english: will catch him as Garuda catches a serpent -.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्त्वा सरथः साश्वः सध्वजसारथिः । गन्धर्वनगराकारस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
units.english: Saying this the powerful Vāna, with his chariot standard and horses resembling the city of Gandharvas, disappeared therefrom showering sharpened arrows and covering him with them.

units.sanskrit: विज्ञायान्तर्हितं बाणं प्राद्युम्निर् अपराजितः । पौरुषेण समायुक्तः स प्रैक्षत दिशो दश ॥
units.english: Seeing Vāna invisible the unconquerable son of Pradyumna, endued with manliness, cast his looks on the ten quarters.

units.sanskrit: आस्थाय तामसीं विद्यां तदा क्रुद्धो बलेः सुतः । मुमोच विशिखांस् तीक्ष्णांश् छन्नो मायाधरो बली ॥
units.english: Thereupon resorting to his Tamasik learning and covered with illusory form that highly powerful Dānava, filled with anger, began to discharge sharpened arrows.

units.sanskrit: प्राद्युम्निर् विशिखैर् बद्धः सर्पभूतैः समन्ततः । देहः संवेष्टितस् तस्य बहुधा शरराशिभिः । स तु वेष्टितसर्वाङ्गो बद्धः प्राद्युम्निर् आहवे । निष्प्रयत्नः स्थितः स्वस्थो मैनाक इव पर्वतः ॥
units.english: Gradually Pradyumna's son was fettered with serpentine shafts. His body was chained with various serpents. Thus, with all his limbs bound with serpents Pradyumna's son stood inert like the mount Maināka in the battle.

units.sanskrit: ज्वालावलीढवदनैः सर्पभोगैर् विवेष्टितः । निष्प्रयत्नः स्थितश् चापि सर्पभोगमयैः शरैः । न विव्यथे स भूतात्मा सर्वतः परिवेष्टितः ॥
units.english: Although motionless like a mountain encircled by serpents of burning fangs he was not stricken with fear. And although completely fettered with serpentine shafts and rendered inactive and motionless, that one, identical with all, did not experience the least pain.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तं वाग्भिर् उग्राभिः संरब्धः समतर्जयत् । बाणो ध्वजं समाश्रित्य प्रोवाचामर्षितो वचः ॥ कुम्भाण्ड वध्यतां शीघ्रम् अयं वै कुलपांसनः । इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने कुम्भाण्डो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । राजन् वक्ष्याम्य् अहं किंचित् तन् मे शृणु यदीच्छसि ॥ अयं विज्ञायतां कस्य कुतो वायम् इहागतः । केन वायम् इहानीतः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥
units.english: Thereupon supporting himself on a standard Vāna, filled with anger, remonstrated with Aniruddha in harsh words and said:— Kumbhānda, kill soon this sinful wretch of his family having a vitiated soul who has sullied our character in the world. Thus addressed Kumbhānda said –— king, wish to speak a few words. Hear them if you wish. Whose son is this hero endued with the prowess of Indra? Learn first from where he has come and who has brought him here.

units.sanskrit: मयायं बहुशो युद्धे दृष्टो राजन् महारणे । बलवान् सत्त्वसंपन्नः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । नायं वधकृतं दोषम् अर्हते दैत्यसत्तम । गान्धर्वेण विवाहेन कन्येयं तव संगता । अदेया ह्य् अप्रतिग्राह्या अतश् चिन्त्य वधं कुरु । वधे ह्य् अस्य महान् दोषो रक्षणे सुमहान् गुणः । अयं हि पुरुषोत्कर्षः सर्वथा मानम् अर्हति ॥
units.english: king, when he fought in the great battle, marked him fighting like a celestial prince. He is powerful, endued with energy and a master of weapons –. foremost of Daityas, he does not deserve to be slain. He has espoused your daughter in Gandharva marriage. You can take her from him because you did not give her away. You should kill him after thinking over this. see a great mistake in killing him and a great virtue in protecting him. He is one of the best of men and every way deserves honor.

units.sanskrit: सर्वतो वेष्टिततनुर् न व्यथत्य् एष भोगिभिः । कुलशौण्डीर्यवीर्यैश् च सत्त्वेन च समन्वितः । पश्य राजन् यशोवीर्यैर् अन्वितं पुरुषोत्तमम् । न नो गणयते सर्वान् वधं प्राप्तो ऽप्य् अयं बली ॥
units.english: His body is fettered with serpents and still he does not feel pain. He has a good birth, valour, energy and accomplishments. Behold, king, this best of men, endued with great prowess. This powerful hero, although chained, does not care for us all.

units.sanskrit: यदि मायाप्रभावेन नात्र बद्धो भवेद् अयम् । सर्वासुरगणान् संख्ये योधयेन् नात्र संशयः ॥
units.english: Had he not been fettered by virtue of your illusory power forsooth he would have fought with all the Asuras.

units.sanskrit: सर्वयुद्धेषु मार्गज्ञो भवेद् वीर्याधिकस् तव । शोणितौघप्लुतैर् गात्रैर् नागभोगैश् च वेष्टितः । त्रिशिखां भ्रुकुटीं कृत्वा न चिन्तयति नः स्थितान् ॥
units.english: He knows all forms of warfare and is more powerful than you. His person is fettered with serpents and covered with blood; still frowning with his forehead stricken with three marks he is as if aiming at us all.

units.sanskrit: न चिन्तयति राजंस् त्वां वीर्यवान् को ऽप्य् असौ युवा ॥
units.english: Reduced to such a plight and yet dependant on the strength of his own arms he does not care for any thing, king.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रबाहोः समरे द्विबाहुः समवस्थितः । रुचितं यदि ते राजञ् ज्ञेयो वीर्यबलान्वितः ॥
units.english: Who is this young man? Although gifted with two hands he still stands for an encounter with you having a thousand hands and does not think of your prowess.

units.sanskrit: कन्या चेयं न चान्यस्य निर्यात्यानेन संगता ॥
units.english: Who is he endued with such a prowess -? Besides, king, while your daughter is attached to him you will not be able to give her away to another person.

units.sanskrit: यदि चेष्टतमः कश्चिद् अयं वंशे महात्मनः । ततः पूजाम् अयं वीरः प्राप्स्यत्य् एवासुरोत्तमः ॥ रक्ष्यताम् एष दुष्टात्मा सा च रक्ष्या कुलाधमा ॥ एवम् उक्ते तु वचने कुम्भाण्डेन महात्मना । अनिरुद्धं योधयित्वा बाणः स्वगृहम् आविशत् ॥ ययौ स्वम् एव भवनं बलेः पुत्रो महासुरः । संयतं मायया दृष्ट्वा अनिरुद्धं महाबलम् । ऋषीणां नारदः श्रेष्ठो ऽब्रजद् द्वारवतीं प्रति ॥
units.english: On the other hand, the hero has been known as one of great prowess. foremost of Asuras, if this desirable person is born in the family of a great man he is worthy of receiving adoration from you. request you, save him. Thus addressed by the high-souled Kumbhādha, Vāna, the slayer of his enemies said So be it. Thereupon handing over Aniruddha to the guards the intelligent and illustrious son of Bali repaired to his own palace. Seeing the highly powerful Aniruddha fettered through illusory power Nārada, the foremost of Rishis, set out for the city of Dwaravati.

units.sanskrit: ततो ह्य् आकाशमार्गेण मुनिर् द्वारवतीं गतः ॥
units.english: Having arrived at Dwāravati through the etherial way that best of Munis communicated to Keshava, the rider of Garuda, about the imprisonment of Aniruddha.

units.sanskrit: गते ऋषीणां प्रवरे सो ऽनिरुद्धो व्यचिन्तयत् । नष्टो ऽयं दानवः क्रूरो युद्धं प्राप्य न संशयः ॥ स गत्वा नारदस् तत्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । रुरोद बाष्परक्ताक्षी ताम् आह रुदतीं पुनः ॥ किम् इदं रुद्येत भीरु मा भैस् त्वं शुभलोचने । पश्य सुश्रोणि संप्राप्तं मत्कृते मधुसूदनम् ॥
units.english: When that foremost of Rishis Nārada set out for Dwārakā Aniruddha thought: This cruel Dānava will forsooth be slain in battle, for Nārada will speak many things truly to Keshava the holder of conch-shell, discus and club. At that time while Ushā, having her eyes full of tears on seeing her husband bound with serpents, cried he said to her:— timid girl, why do you weep thus? Do not fear, you having fair eyes; you will soon see the slayer of Madhu arrive here for me.

units.sanskrit: यस्य शङ्खध्वनिं श्रुत्वा बाहुशब्दं बलस्य च । दानवा नाशम् एष्यन्ति गर्भाश् चासुरयोषिताम् ॥
units.english: Hearing the sound of his conch shell and of the striking of his arms the Dānavas will be destroyed and the Asura women will abort.

units.sanskrit: यस्येन्द्रप्रमुखा देवाः सादित्याः समरुद्गणाः । बाहुच्छायां समाश्रित्य वसन्ति दिवि देवताः ॥ तस्योत्पन्नम् इदं लोके भयदस्य महद्भयम् । यस्यानिरुद्धः पौत्रः स वीरः केनापि नो हृतः ॥
units.english: He, under the shade of whose arms, Adityas, Maruts and the gods headed by Indra, are living without any anxiety in the celestial region, has been visited by such a great calamity in this world. Alas! who has stolen away his heroic grandson Aniruddha –.

units.sanskrit: अहो नास्ति भयं नूनं तस्य लोके सुदुर्मतेः । वासुदेवस्य यः क्रोधं प्रज्वालयति दुःसहम् ॥
units.english: Alas, that wicked-minded one, who has excited this unbearable fire of Vasudeva's anger, has indeed no fear in this world.

units.sanskrit: व्यादितास्यस्य यो मृत्योर् दंष्ट्राग्रे परिवर्तते । स वासुदेवं समरे मोहात् प्रत्युदियाद् रिपुः ॥
units.english: He is standing before the teeth of Death with his mouth wide open. Indeed such an enemy can stand before Vasudeva in battle.

units.sanskrit: कथं जीवन् विमुच्येत साक्षाद् अपि शतक्रतुः ॥
units.english: Committing such an ill turn by the Yadu king Keshava can even Sachi's lord escape with his life? -.

units.sanskrit: कृतागा न स शोच्यस् तु वयं त्व् अद्य विनाकृताः । विप्रयोगेन नाथस्य कृतान्तवशगाः कृताः ॥
units.english: Alas, our husband has been stolen away today or our lord has forsaken us and made us objects of pity. Oh on account of the separation of our lord, we have been brought under control by death.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं ता रुदन्त्यश् च वदन्त्यश् च पुनः पुनः । तासां बाष्पाभिपूर्णानि नयनानि चकाशिरे । सलिलेनाप्लुतानीव पङ्कजानि जलागमे ॥ कुररीणाम् इवाकाशे रुदतीनां सहस्रशः ॥ तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरम् अपूर्वं भयम् आगतम् । उत्पेतुः सहसा खेभ्यो गृहेभ्यः पुरुषर्षभाः ॥
units.english: Exclaiming thus those beautiful women continually wept and shed profuse tears. Their eyes, full of tears, imitated the beauty of lotuses immersed in water in the rainy season –. Their eyes appeared to have been bathed in blood. The cries of those women in the palace set up a noise like that of thousands of female ospreys crying in the sky -. Hearing that unheard, of lamentation caused by fear the Yadu chiefs all on sudden leaped down from their respective houses. As the lions, when assailed, come out of their caves, so the Yadavas, coming out, said, their voice being choked with affection—Krishna protects us all completely.

units.sanskrit: कस्माद् एषो ऽनिरुद्धस्य श्रूयते सुमहास्वनः । संनाहभेरी कृष्णस्य सभायाम् आहता तदा । तस्याः शब्देन ते सर्वे सभाम् आगम्य विष्ठिताः ॥
units.english: Whence is then this fear? Why is such a noise heard in Aniruddha's house? –. Thereupon the huge bugle of Krishna's court was brought and sounded; and at that sound all the Yadavas assembled there.

units.sanskrit: अन्योन्यस्य हि ते सर्वे यथान्यायम् अवेदयन् ॥
units.english: They asked one another What is the matter? And they answered one another as they had heard -.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते बाष्पपूर्णाक्षाः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः । निःश्वसन्तो व्यतिष्ठन्त यादवा युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥
units.english: Hearing it the eyes, reddened in anger, of the Yadavas dreadful in battle, were filled with tears; and they sighed there idly.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठं निःश्वसन्तं मुहुर् मुहुः ॥
units.english: Then beholding even Krishna the foremost of strikers sigh again and again and others sit silently Viprithu said:—.

units.sanskrit: किम् एवं चिन्तयाविष्टः पुरुषेन्द्र भवान् इह । तव बाहुबलप्राणम् आश्रिताः सर्वयादवाः । तथैव बलहा शक्रस् त्वय्य् आवेश्य जयाजयौ । तान् मज्जमानान् एकस् त्वं समुद्धर महाभुज ॥
units.english: Krishna, you are the foremost of men; why are you then possessed by anxiety? The Yadavas, living under the protection of your arms, are ranging freely at large. Leaving the charge of success and defeat to you even the powerful Sakra is sleeping happily. See your kinsmen are sunk in unfathomable ocean of grief. large-armed hero, save them.

units.sanskrit: किम् एवं चिन्तयाविष्टो न किंचिद् अपि भाषसे । चिन्तां कर्तुं वृथा देव न त्वम् अर्हसि माधव ॥
units.english: What is the cause of your anxiety? Mādhava, why do you not speak any thing? You should not indulge in such idle thoughts.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्तः कृष्णस् तु निःश्वस्य सुचिरं पुनः । प्राह वाक्यं स वाक्यज्ञो बृहस्पतिर् इव स्वयम् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed Vāsudeva, a clever speaker like Vrihaspati himself, sighed again and again for some time and then said:— Viprathu, was anxiously thinking about this –.

units.sanskrit: विचिन्तयंस् त्व् अहं चास्य कार्यस्य न लभे गतिम् । तथाहं भवताप्य् उक्तो नोत्तरं विदधे क्वचित् ॥
units.english: Even thinking have not been able to settle anything. Therefore could not give you any reply although you asked me.

units.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं यादवाः सर्वे यथा चिन्तान्वितो ह्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: Hear, Yadavas, will describe to you in truth, why have been filled with anxiety.

units.sanskrit: अनिरुद्धे हृते वीरे पृथिव्यां सर्वपार्थिवाः । अशक्तान् इव मन्यन्ते सर्वान् अस्मान् सबान्धवान् ॥
units.english: On account of the captivity of the heroic Aniruddha all the kings of the earth and my friends will consider me incapable.

units.sanskrit: आहुकश् चैव नो राजा हृतः साल्वेन वै पुरा । प्रद्युम्नश् चापि नो बाल्ये शम्बरेण हृतो ह्य् अभूत् । स तं निहत्य समरे प्राप्तो रुक्मिणिनन्दनः ॥
units.english: Formerly our king Ahuka was taken captive by Shālwa—but we brought him back after a dreadful fight. Rukshmini's son Pradyumna was stolen away by Shamvara in his infancy. But he, having slain him in battle, has come back.

units.sanskrit: इदं तु सुमहत्कष्टं प्राद्युम्निः क्व प्रवासितः । नैवंविधम् अहं दोषं स्मरामि मनुजर्षभाः ॥
units.english: But where has Aniruddha been exiled? ye foremost of men, do not recollect had before experienced such sorrow and mental agony -.

units.sanskrit: सानुबन्धस्य तस्याहं हरिष्ये जीवितं रणे ॥
units.english: will in battle kill him with his own people who has put on my head this foot covered with ashes.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्ते कृष्णेन सात्यकिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । सपर्वतवनोद्देशां मार्गन्तु वसुधाम् इमाम् । आभ्यन्तराश् च बाह्याश् च व्यादिश्यन्तां चरा नृप ॥
units.english: After Krishna had said this Sātyaki observed:— Krishna, despatch spies all over for finding out Aniruddha. Let them search the earth with mountains and forests. Let open and secret emissaries be engaged in this work -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा आहुकस् त्वरितो ऽब्रवीत् । अभ्यन्तरं च मार्गध्वं बाह्यतश् च समन्ततः ॥ हया रथाश् च व्यादिष्टाः पार्थिवेन महात्मना । वेणुमन्तं लतावेष्टं तथा रैवतकं गिरिम् । ऋक्षवन्तं गिरिं चैव मार्गध्वं त्वरिता हयैः ॥ गन्तव्यं चापि निःसङ्गम् उद्यानेषु समन्ततः ॥ हयानां च सहस्राणि रथानां चाप्य् अनेकशः । आरुह्य त्वरिताः सर्वे मार्गध्वं यदुनन्दनम् ॥ सेनापतिर् अनाधृष्टिर् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत् । कृष्णम् अक्लिष्टकर्माणम् अच्युतं भीतभीतवत् ॥ शृणु कृष्ण वचो मह्यं यदि ते रोचते विभो । असिलोमा पुलोमा च निसुन्दनरकौ हतौ । सौभः साल्वश् च निहतौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च । हयग्रीवश् च सुमहान् सानुबन्धस् त्वया हतः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing the word of Keshava king Ahuka speedily ordered the messengers for finding out Aniruddha. Ordering them Search out all the countries lying on and under the earth the high-souled king Ahuka gave them sufficient horses and cars. He said:—Do you soon go on horse back and search the mountains Rikshavān and Raivataka covered with trees and creepers. Enter without any hesitation into the gardens and forests there and search every creek and corner. Riding on horses and elephants do you soon find out Aniruddha the enhancer of the joy of the Yadavas –. Thereupon the Commander-in-chief Anādhristhi said to the eternal Krishna of unwearied actions:— lord Krishna, from long have been cherishing a desire of communicating something to thee. Hear, if thou dost like, will communicate it at present. Asilomā, Puloma, Nisunda, Naraka, Soubha, Shalwa, Mainda, and Dwivida have all been slain by thee –. When a highly dreadful encounter took place on account of the gods thou didst kill Hayagriva with all his kinsmen.

units.sanskrit: सर्वाण्य् एतानि कर्माणि निःशेषाणि रणे रणे । कृतवान् असि गोविन्द पार्ष्णिग्राहश् च नास्ति ते ॥
units.english: Govinda, in every battle thou didst accomplish all these works completely. No one even acted as thy charioteer -.

units.sanskrit: पारिजातस्य हरणे यत् कृतं कर्म दुष्करं ॥ तत्र शक्रस् त्वया कृष्ण ऐरावतशिरोगतः । निर्जितो बाहुवीर्येण स्वयं युद्धविशारदः ॥ तत्रानुबन्धश् च महांस् तेन कार्यस् त्वया सह ॥ इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने कृष्णो नाग इव श्वसन् । उवाच वचनं धीमान् अनाधृष्टिं महाबलम् ॥ सेनानीस् तात मा मैवं न देवाः क्षुद्रकर्मिणः । देवतार्थं च मे यत्नो महान् दानवसंक्षये । तेषां प्रियार्थं च रणे हन्मि दृप्तान् महासुरान् ॥
units.english: Krishna, while carrying away Pārijatā thou didst perform a great and arduous feat with Anuvandha, Mādhava; in that battle thou didst alone, by the strength of thy own arms, vanquish Vāsava, expert in fighting, seated on his elephant Airavata. On account of that encounter a great hostility has been created between you both –. Methinks Maghavān himself has taken away Aniruddha; who else but him can satisfy his enmity on thee ? After the highly powerful Anadhristhi had said this Krishna, sighing like a serpent, said:—Do not say so, sir; the gods are not mean, ungrateful, womanish and stupid. work hard on behalf of the gods for destroying the Dānavas. To please them have killed the proud Asuras in battle.

units.sanskrit: तत्परस् तन्मनाश् चास्मि तद्भक्तस् तत्प्रिये रतः । कथं पापं करिष्यन्ति विज्ञायैवंविधं हि माम् ॥
units.english: The gods are my support, my mind is devoted to them, and am their devoted votary. Therefore knowing me, how can they injure me? You say so out of your own meanness—they are not mean.

units.sanskrit: अक्षुद्राः सत्यवन्तश् च नित्यं भक्तानुयायिनः । न तेषु पापं विज्ञेयं बालिश त्वं प्रभाषसे ॥
units.english: They are truthful and compassionate unto their votaries. fear no danger from them.

units.sanskrit: देवेषु समहेन्द्रेषु नैतत्कर्म विधीयते ॥
units.english: tell you for certain, this is not the work of Mahendra or any other gods.

units.sanskrit: एवं चिन्तयमानस्य कृष्णस्याद्भुतकर्मणः । कृष्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तदाक्रूरो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । मधुरं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा अर्थवाक्यविशारदः ॥ यच् छक्रस्य प्रभोः कार्यं तद् अस्माकं विनिश्चितम् । संरक्ष्याश् च वयं देवैर् अस्माभिश् चापि देवताः । स्निग्धगम्भीरया वाचा पुनः कृष्णो ऽभ्यभाषत ॥ नायं देवैर् न गन्धर्वैर् नापि यक्षैर् न राक्षसैः । प्रद्युम्नपुत्रो ऽपहृतः पुंश्चल्या तु हृतः स्त्रिया ॥ मायाविदग्धाः पुंश्चल्यो दैत्यदानवयोषितः । ताभिर् हृतो न संदेहो नान्यतो विद्यते भयम् ॥
units.english: Aniruddha must have been taken away by some harlot -. Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing those words of anxious Krishna of wonderful deeds, Akrura, capable of understanding the true meaning of words, said in sweet words:— Lord, Indra's work is identical with ours and ours is the same as that of Sachi's lord. We are for the gods and they should be protected by us. We are born as men for the gods –. Thus excited by Akrura's words Krishna, the slayer of Madhu, said in sweet and grave words:—Pradyumna has not been taken away by any amongst the Devatas, Gandharvas, Yakshasas or Rākshasas. That highly illustrious hero must have been tempted away by some courtezan. The women of the Daityas and Dānavas are by nature loose and tempting. Forsooth Pradyumna must have been taken away by them. We need entertain fear from no other quarter –.

units.sanskrit: उदतिष्ठन् महानादस् तदा कृष्णं प्रशंसयन् । हर्षयन् स तु सर्वेषां । मधुरः श्रूयते शब्दो माधवस्य निवेशने ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—After the high-souled Krishna had said this the Yadavas understood as the matter really was and they all highly applauded him. The bards, panegyrists, poets and songsters began to sing delightedly songs of praise in Mādhava's house.

units.sanskrit: ते चराः सर्वतः सर्वे सभाद्वारम् उपागताः । शनैर् गद्गदया वाचा इदं वचनम् अब्रुवन् ॥
units.english: In the meantime, the messengers, who had been despatched to find out Aniruddha, returned at the gate of the Durbar Hall and slowly and sorrowfully said.

units.sanskrit: उद्यानानि शिलाः शैला गुहा नद्यः सरांसि च । एकैकं शतशो राजन् मार्गितं न च दृश्येत ॥
units.english: king, all the gardens mountains, forests, caves, rivers, and tanks, we have searched hundreds of times, but we saw Aniruddha nowhere.

units.sanskrit: अन्ये कृष्णं चरा राजन्न् उपागम्य तदाब्रुवन् । सर्वे नो विदिता देशाः प्राद्युम्निर् न च दृश्यते । तदाज्ञापय नः क्षिप्रम् अनिरुद्धस्य मार्गणे ॥
units.english: king Janamejaya, other messengers sent by Krishna returned and said:—We have searched everywhere, but Pradyumna has not been seen. Yadu chief, order hereafter what we should do about searching for Aniruddha –.

units.sanskrit: ततस् ते दीनमनसः सर्वे बाष्पाकुलेक्षणाः । अन्योन्यम् अभ्यभाषन्त किम् अतः कार्यम् उत्तरम् ॥ संदष्टौष्ठपुटाः केचित् केचिद् बाष्पाविलेक्षणाः । एवं चिन्तयतां तेषां बह्वर्थम् अभिभाषताम् । अनिरुद्धः कुतश् चेति संभ्रमः सुमहान् अभूत् । अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्ते यादवा जातमन्यवः । तां निशां विमनस्कास् ते गमयेयुः कथंचन ॥
units.english: Hearing those words the Yadavas were all dejected at heart and their eyes were filled with tears. They spoke amongst one another, What should we do now? Amongst them many had their eyes filled with tears, some bit their lips, and some frowned and all thought how they could accomplish their object –. Thus thinking they gave vent to various words. They were stricken with great anxiety and thought where Aniruddha could have been. The Yādavas, filled with anger, looked upon one another, and with great anxiety spent the night some how thinking where Aniruddha could have been taken away.

units.sanskrit: एवं च ब्रुवतां तेषां प्रभाता रजनी तदा । ततस् तूर्यनिनादैश् च शङ्खानां च महास्वनैः । प्रबोधनं महाबाहोः कृष्णस्याक्रियतालये ॥
units.english: While they thus conversed the night passed away. At that time, the men, appointed for the purpose, aroused Krishna with the sound of bugles and conch-shells in his palace.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते विमले प्रादुर्भूते दिवाकरे । प्रविवेश सभाम् एको नारदः प्रहसन्न् इव ॥
units.english: Thereupon in the clear morning when the sun rose the Rishi Nārada, alone, smilingly entered the Darbar Hall.

units.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु यादवान् सर्वान् कृष्णेन सह संगतान् । ततः स जयशब्देन माधवं प्रत्यपूजयत् । अथाभ्युत्थाय विमनाः कृष्णः समितिदुर्जयः । मधुपर्कं च गां चैव नारदाय ददौ प्रभुः ॥
units.english: Seeing Krishna there along with all the Yadavas he applauded Mādhava exclaiming his victory and honored Ugrasena and others. Though the highly powerful Krishna, invincible in battle, was absent-minded still he rose up and received Nārada dedicating to him Madhuparka and cows –.

units.sanskrit: स विष्टरे स्थितः शुभ्रे स्पर्ध्यास्तरणसंवृते । ऋज्वासीनो यथान्यायम् उवाचेदं वचो ऽर्थवत् ॥
units.english: Afterwards seated on a white seat covered with a costly cover the celestial saint gave vent to the following pregnant words.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ते तु वचने नारदेन महात्मना । वासुदेवो ऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं श्रूयतां भगवन्न् इदम् ॥ अनिरुद्धो हृतो ब्रह्मन् केनापि निशि सुव्रत । तस्यार्थे सर्व एवास्म चिन्तयाविष्टचेतसः ॥
units.english: Nārada said:—Why are you all, like eunuchs, possessed by anxiety, silent, dispirited and discouraged? After the high-souled Nārada had said this Vāsudeva replied:— reverend sir, Brahman, Aniruddha has been stolen away by somebody in the night. We are all anxious for him.

units.sanskrit: एष ते यदि वृत्तान्तः श्रुतो दृष्टो ऽपि वा मुने ॥ भगवन् कथ्यतां साधु प्रियम् एतन् ममानघ । इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने केशवेन महात्मना । प्रहस्य नारदः प्राह श्रूयतां मधुसूदन ॥ निर्वृत्तं सुमहद् युद्धं महापुरुषसेवितम् । अनिरुद्धस्य चैकस्य बाणस्य च महामृधे ॥ उषा नाम सुता तस्य बाणस्याप्रतिमौजसः । तस्यार्थे चित्रलेखा वै जहाराशु तम् अप्सराः ॥
units.english: Tell us, Muni of firm vows, if you have heard or seen anything about him. sinless one, by this you will do me a good work –. Thus addressed by the high-souled Keshava he smilingly replied:—Hear, Madhusudana, Vāna, of incomparable energy has a daughter by name Ushā. Vanquished in battle, Vāna, resorting in fear to his illusory powers, has fettered the highly powerful Aniruddha with serpentine shafts. Aniruddha is not still deprived of life; that hero is waiting patiently. Therefore Krishna, those, who long for victories, should not now try to keep their own lives. Rise up soon and you will acquire success and fame –. Vaishampāyana said:—Thus addressed the powerful and energetic Vāsudeva made all arrangements for marching.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णकेशः प्रवलयो जिष्णुः कृष्णश् च वर्णतः । चतुर्दंष्ट्रश् चतुर्बाहुश् चतुर्वेदषडङ्गवित् ॥
units.english: Thereupon Krishna, with delight, sat on Garuda's back. He was adorned with most excellent bracelets, had black hairs, was dark-hued and victorious; had four rows of teeth and four arms.

units.sanskrit: श्रीवत्साङ्को ऽरविन्दाक्ष ऊर्ध्वलोमा मृदुत्वचः । समाङ्गुलिः समनखो रक्ताङ्गुलिनखान्तरः ॥ स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषो वृत्तबाहुर् महाभुजः । आजानुबाहुः सिंहास्यः सिंहसंहननो युवा । सहस्रम् इव सूर्याणां दीप्यमानः प्रकाशते ॥
units.english: He was the master of the four Vedas with their auxilliaries, had the mystic mark of Srivatsa on his breast, lotus-like eyes, stirring hairs, soft skin, equal fingers, equal nails, red fingers, red nails, and red eyes. His voice was sweet and grave and he had large arms extending to knees and a copper-coloured countenance. His gait was like that of a lion and he was effulgent like a thousand suns.

units.sanskrit: यः प्रभुर् भाति भूतात्मा भूतानां भावनः प्रभुः । यस्याष्टगुणम् ऐश्वर्यं ददौ प्रीतः प्रजापतिः ॥ स्तूयमानः स्तवैः सर्वैः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः । ऋषिभिश् च महाभागैर् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः ॥
units.english: He is the lord and protector of creatures and is identical with them. The Lord Prajāpati, with pleasure conferred on him eight-fold spiritual powers. He is eternal and his pure glories are sung by Prajāpati, Saddhyas, gods, bards and panegyrits and the great Rishis, masters of the Vedas and their auxilliaries.

units.sanskrit: आस्थितो गरुडं देवस् तस्य चानु हलायुधः । पृष्ठतो ऽनु बलस्यापि प्रद्युम्नः शत्रुकर्शनः ॥
units.english: After Krishna had sat on Garuda's back Halāyudha and Pradyumna, the grinder of enemies, sat behind him.

units.sanskrit: श्रूयन्ते स्म तदा वाचः सूतमागधबन्दिनाम् । जय बाणं महाबाहो ये चास्यानुचरा रणे । न हि ते प्रमुखे स्थातुं कश्चिच् छक्तो महामृधे ॥
units.english: At that time the Siddhas, Charanas and the great Rishis said to Keshava in the sky:— thou of large arms, do thou vanquish Vāna with all his followers. No one will be able to stand before thee in the great battle.

units.sanskrit: प्रसादे ते ध्रुवा लक्ष्मीर् विजयश् च पराक्रमे । विजेष्यसि रणे शत्रुं दैत्येन्द्रं सहसैनिकम् ॥
units.english: Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity, depends on thy pleasure and sure victory depends on thy strength. Thou wilt defeat in battle thy enemy the Daitya king with all his soldiers.

units.sanskrit: शृण्वन् वाचो ऽन्तरिक्षस्थः प्रययौ केशवो रणे ॥
units.english: Keshava marched on hearing all those words -.

units.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस् तूर्यनिनादैश् च शङ्खानां च महास्वनैः । बन्दिमागधसूतानां सर्वैश् चापि सहस्रशः ॥ जयाजय जगन्नाथ जय चक्रगदाधर । वैनतेयस्य भद्रं ते बृंहितं हरितेजसा ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—At that time with the sound of conch-shells and bugles, the songs of bards and panegyrists by thousands and blessings of men exclaiming victory Janarddana appeared like the moon, sun and Sakra. king, when Vinatā's son flew up into the sky his, beauty, increased by Hari's energy, became immense -.

units.sanskrit: अथाष्टबाहुः कृष्णस् तु पर्वताकारसंनिभः । विबभौ पुण्डरीकाक्षो विकाङ्क्षन् बाणसंक्षयम् ॥
units.english: Desirous of killing Vāna the lotus-eyed Keshava assumed a form having eight arms and resembling a mountain. At that time Janārddana, the holder of Shranga-bow, assumed innumerable heads.

units.sanskrit: असिचक्रगदाबाणा दक्षिणं पार्श्वम् आस्थिताः । चर्म शार्ङ्गं तथा चापं शङ्खं चैवास्य वामतः ॥
units.english: In his four right hands he had sword, discus, club and arrows and by his left four hands he held the leathern protector, the Srānga-bow, the thunder-bolt and conch-shell.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रं चैव कायानां वहन् संकर्षणस् तदा ॥ श्वेतप्रहरणो ऽधृष्यः कैलास इव शृङ्गवान् । सनत्कुमारस्य वपुः प्रादुर् आसीन् महात्मनः । प्रद्युम्नस्य महाबाहोः संग्रामे विक्रमिष्यतः ॥ स पक्षबलविक्षेपैर् विधुन्वन् पर्वतान् बहून् । सिद्धचारणसंघानां शुभं मार्गम् अवातरत् ॥
units.english: Seated on Garudha's back, Sanghkarshana, holding a thousand forms and white weapons, irrepressible unto all creatures like the mount Kailāsha with its summit, shone like the rising moon. With a view to display his prowess in battle the high-souled Pradyumna assumed a form like that of Sanatkumār –. Thereupon shaking innumerable mountains and obstructing the course of the wind with the forcible flapping of his wings the powerful Vinatā's son went on. Endued with the speed of the mind he crossed the most sacred route of the Siddhas and Chāranas.

units.sanskrit: अथ रामो ऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं कृष्णम् अप्रतिमम् रणे । स्वाभिः प्रभाभिर् हीनाः स्मः कृष्ण कस्माद् अपूर्ववत् ॥
units.english: At that time Rāma said to Krishna, incomparable in battle:— Krishna, what wonder is this that we have all on a sudden been shorn of our effulgence? We have all a golden hue.

units.sanskrit: किम् इदं ब्रूहि नस् तत्त्वं किं मेरोः पार्श्वगा वयम् ॥ भगवान् उवाच मन्ये बाणस्य नगरम् अभ्याशस्थम् अरिंदम । अग्नेर् आहवनीयस्य प्रभया स्म समाहताः । तेन नो वर्णवैरूप्यम् इदं जातं हलायुध ॥
units.english: What is the cause? Have we come to the side of the mount Sumeru? – The Lord said:—Methinks, slayer of thy enemies, Vāna's city is near at hand. To protect him, the fire, stationed in his city, is coming out blazing. holder of plough-share, we have been possessed by the effulgence of the fire of oblation: this has changed our colour.

units.sanskrit: राम उवाच यदि स्म संनिकर्षस्था यदि निष्प्रभतां गताः । त्वया विधाने विहिते करिष्याम्य् अहम् उत्तरम् ॥ एतच् छ्रुत्वा तु गरुडो वासुदेवस्य भाषितम् । चक्रे मुखसहस्रं हि कामरूपी महाबलः । गङ्गाम् उपागमत् तूर्णं वैनतेयस् ततो बली ॥ आप्लुत्याकाशगङ्गायाम् आपीय सलिलं बहु । तेनाग्निं शमयाम् आस बुद्धिमान् विनतात्मजः । अग्निर् आहवनीयस् तु ततः शान्तिम् उपागमत् ॥ तं दृष्ट्वाहवनीयं तु शान्तम् आकाशगङ्गया । परमं विस्मयं गत्वा सुपर्णो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: Rāma replied:—If by approaching the city of Vāna we have been shorn of the lustre of our body, do what you think proper afterwards –. After you have found out a means shall do what think proper. Vaishampāyana continued:—Hearing those words spoken by Vāsudeva the highly powerful Garuda, capable of assuming forms at will, assumed a thousand mouths. Afterwards the highly powerful son of Vinatā leaped up and went to the etherial Gangā. Then drinking profuse water, he began to shower it on the fire.
