The intelligent son of Vinatā having concerted this measure the fire was at once extinguished. Then seeing that fire extinguished with the water of the etherial Gangā, Suparna, filled with surprise, said:—Oh! How powerful is this fire like that at the end of a cycle.

units.sanskrit: तद् एव वर्णवैरूप्यं चक्रे कृष्णस्य धीमतः । ततः प्रशान्ते दहने संप्रतस्थे स पक्षिराट् । स्वपक्षबलविक्षेपैः कुर्वन् घोरं महास्वनम् ॥
units.english: It disfigured the color of even the intelligent Krishna. After extinguishing the fire the king of birds, Garuda, went on making a great sound with the flapping of his powerful wings.

units.sanskrit: आस्थिता गरुडं ह्य् एते नानारूपा भयावाहाः । किम् अर्थम् इह संप्राप्ताः के वापीमे जनास् त्रयः ॥ निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छन्त ते गिरिव्रजवह्नयः । प्रावर्तयंश् च संग्रामं तैस् त्रिभिः सह यादवैः ॥
units.english: Seeing them the fires, the followers of Rudra, thought:—Who are these three dreadful men of many forms who are riding Garuda? Why have they come here? Those fires of the mountain thought in this way for some, but could not settle anything. They then began to fight with the three Yadus.

units.sanskrit: तेषां युद्धे प्रसक्तानां संनादः सुमहान् अभूत् ॥
units.english: great noise arose when they engaged in fighting -.

units.sanskrit: तं च श्रुत्वा महानादं सिंहानाम् इव गर्जताम् । अथाङ्गिराः स्वपुरुषं प्रेषयाम् आस बुद्धिमान् । यत्र तद् वर्तते युद्धं तत्र गच्छस्व माचिरम् । तथेत्य् उक्त्वा स तद् युद्धं वर्तमानम् अवैक्षत । अग्नीनां वासुदेवेन संसक्तानां महामृधे ॥
units.english: Hearing their great uproar like that of roaring lions the intelligent Chief of the Fires Angirā sent a man to the scene of the action saying Soon proceed where the battle is raging. Another Asura, fleet like the mind, was quickly despatched by Vanā saying Go and see what is the matter. Saying So be it the man at once started and saw the fires fighting with Vāsudeva.

units.sanskrit: ते जातवेदसः सर्वे कल्माषः खसृमस् तथा । दहनः शोषणश् चैव तपनश् च महाबलः । स्वधाकारस्य विषये प्रख्याताः पञ्च वह्नयः ॥
units.english: He saw that the five principal fire-gods, Kalmāsha, Kusuma, Dahana, Shoshana and the highly powerful Tapana well known in the offering of Swāha and other minor fire-gods were all fighting with their respective armies.

units.sanskrit: पटरः पतगः स्वर्णो अगाधो भ्राज एव च । स्वाहाकाराश्रया पञ्च अयुध्यंस् ते ऽपि चाग्नयः ॥
units.english: Pithara, Pataga, Swarna, Agādha and Vraja, these five presiding gods of Swadhā were also fighting; the two highly effulgent fire-gods, in charge of Jyotisthoma and Vasatkāra, were also fighting.

units.sanskrit: तयोर् मध्ये ऽङ्गिराश् चैव महर्षिर् विबभौ प्रभुः ॥ आग्नेयं रथम् आस्थाय शूलम् उद्यम्य भास्वरम् । स्थितम् अङ्गिरसं दृष्ट्वा स्यन्दने पुरुषोत्तमः । कृष्णः प्रोवाच वचनं स्मयन्न् इव पुनः पुनः ॥ तिष्ठध्वम् अग्नयो यूयम् एष वो विदधे भयम् । ममास्त्रतेजसा दद्घा दिशो यास्यथ विक्षताः ॥
units.english: Ascending a fiery car the great saint Angirā, uplifting his effulgent mace, was shining in that battle-field, in the midst of fire-gods. Then beholding Angira discharge his sharpened arrows, Krishna, filled with anger, smiled again and again and said:— ye fire-gods, wait patiently a few moments. The time of your destruction is drawing near. Within a moment, consumed by the energy of my weapons, you shall have to fly away on all sides.

units.sanskrit: अथाङ्गिरास् त्रिशूलेन दीप्तेन समधावत । आददान इव क्रोधात् कृष्णप्राणान् मधामृधे ॥ त्रिशूलं तस्य तद् दीप्तं चिच्छेद परमेषुभिः । अर्धचन्द्रैस् तथा तीक्ष्णैर् यमान्तकनिभैर् युधि ॥
units.english: Thereupon in that great battle, as if to take Krishna's life Angirā ran with a burning Trishula in his hand. Then cutting off his mace with crescent-shaped and sharpened arrows the intelligent Krishna, effulgent like Yama, the destroyer of all creatures, struck Angirā on the breast with a death-like-arrow.

units.sanskrit: रुधिरौघप्लुतैर् गात्रैस् तदाग्निर् चिह्वलन्न् इव । शेषास् ततो ऽग्नयः सर्वे चत्वारो ब्रह्मणः सुताः । अथ बाणपुरं दृष्ट्वा दूरात् प्रोवाच नारदः । एतत् तच्छोणितपुरं कृष्ण पश्य महाभुज ॥
units.english: Thereat Angirā fell down bathed in blood and with his body mangled. Seeing it the four fire-gods, the sons of Brahmā along with others speedily fled away to Vāna's city –. Thereupon seeing Vāna's city from a distance Nārada said Behold, large-armed Krishna, there is the city of Shonita.

units.sanskrit: अत्र रुद्रो महातेजा रुद्राण्या सहितो ऽवसत् । गुहश् च बाणगुप्त्यर्थं सततं क्षेमकारणात् ॥
units.english: For protecting Vāna and for his well-being Kārtikeya and the highly effulgent Rudra with his consort always live there.

units.sanskrit: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कृष्णस् त्व् इदम् अथाब्रवीत् । यदि वावतरेद् रुद्रो बाणसंरक्षणं प्रति । शक्तितो वयम् अप्य् अत्र सह योत्स्याम तेन वै ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Nārada, Krishna smilingly said:—Hear and understand what say great Muni. If Rudra himself comes to the battle-field for protecting Vāna we will also fight with him to our best.

units.sanskrit: एवं विवदतोस् तत्र कृष्णनारदयोस् तदा । प्राप्ता निमेषमात्रेण शीघ्रत्वाद् गरुडेन ते । वायुवेगेन तं दध्मौ मेघश् चन्द्रम् इवोद्गिरन् ॥ प्रविवेश पुरं कृष्णो बाणस्याद्भुतकर्मणः ॥ वैशंपायनः ततः शङ्खप्रणादेन भेरीणां च महास्वनैः । कोटिशश् चापि बहुधा दीप्तप्रहरणं तदा ॥
units.english: While Krishna and Nārada were thus conversing the quick-coursing Garuda at once took them to the city of Vāna. Then the lotus-eyed and cloud-like Keshava blew his moon-like conch-shell. Blowing that conch and creating terror in Vāna of wonderful deeds the powerful Mādhava entered into his city. Seeing them thus enter Vāna's soldiers got themselves ready for action sounding bugles and conch shells. Millions of paid soldiers, holding effulgent weapons, marched out to the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: तद् असंख्येयम् एकस्थं महाभ्रघनसंनिभम् । ते प्रदीप्तप्रहरणा दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः । प्रमाथगणमुख्याश् च ते ऽयुध्यन् कृष्णसंगताः ॥ सर्वतस् तैः प्रदीप्तास्यैः सार्चिष्मद्भिर् इवानलैः । अभ्युपेत्य तदात्युग्रैर् यक्षराक्षसकिंनरैः । प्रोवाच वचनं तत्र परस्य बलनाशनम् । कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो विधत्स्वैषां महद् भयम् ॥
units.english: Those innumerable soldiers, of incomparable prowess, united, looked like huge black clouds. Afterwards the Daityas, Dānavas and the leading Pramathas, with various burning weapons, began to fight with the eternal Krishna. When Krishna, Sangkarshana, Pradyumna and Garuda began to fight Yakshas, Rakshasas and Pannagas, irrepressible like burning fire, came from all sides, with their mouths wide open, to the battle-field for drinking blood. Beholding Vāna's army the highly powerful Balabhadra said to Krishna, the slayer of hostile armies:— large-armed Krishna, do that by which these soldiers may be completely terror-stricken.

units.sanskrit: इति संचोदितः कृष्णो बलभद्रेण धीमता । स विधूयासुरगणान् क्रव्यादान् अस्त्रतेजसा । प्रययौ त्वरया युक्तो यतो ऽदृश्यत तद्बलम् ॥ शूलपट्टिसशक्त्यृष्टि+ +पिनाकपरिघायुधम् । प्रमाथगणभूयिष्ठं बलं तद् अभवत् क्षितौ ॥ शैलमेघप्रतीकाशैर् नानारूपैर् भयानकैः । वेताऌऐश् च पिशाचैश् च भक्षयद्भिश् च मांसकम् । शुशुभे तत्र बहुलैर् अनीकैर् बहुधान्विभिः । मुसलैर् असिभिः शूलैर् गदाभिः परिघैस् तथा ॥ अधावत् तद् असंख्येयं शुशुभे सर्वतो बलम् । ततः संकर्षणो देवम् उवाच मधुसूदनम् । वैनतेयगतो रामस् तान् दृष्ट्वा कृष्णम् अब्रवीत् । इति ब्रुवाणं रामं तं कृष्णो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । एभिः सह समागन्तुम् इच्छेयं युद्धदुर्मदैः ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by the intelligent Balabhadra Purusottama Krishna, the foremost of the masters of weapons, took up fiery weapons dreadful like Death. Grinding the Asuras and birds of prey with those weapons Janārddana speedily went where the soldiers were seen. Standing on the ground in numberless detachments that Asura army, consisting mainly of Pramathas, holding darts, Pattiças, Saktis, Rishthis, Pinākas and Parighas, and having many dreadful beasts of burdens huge like mountains and clouds, appeared like clouds scattered by the wind. And many bow-men increased the beauty of that show. Running hither and thither with maces, darts, swords, clubs and Parighas that innumerable Asura host increased the beauty of the battle-field. Thereupon the beautiful Sangkarshana, seated on Garuda's back, said to Krishna, the slayer of Madhu:— large-armed Krishna, Purusottama, wish to fight with this Asura host. Hearing it Krishna said: -. too feel the same inclination. wish to fight in the battle-field with these leading warriors.

units.sanskrit: युध्यतः प्राङ्मुखस्यास्तु सुपर्णो वै ममाग्रतः । सव्ये पार्श्वे च प्रद्युम्नस् तथा मे दक्षिणे भवान् ॥ रक्षितव्यम् अथान्योन्यम् अस्मिन् घोरे महामृधे । एवं ब्रुवन्तस् ते ऽन्योन्यम् अधिरूढाः खगोत्तमम् ॥ ततो युद्धं महच् चक्रे लाङ्गलेनाथ लाङ्गली । युध्यतो रौहिणेयस्य रौद्रं रूपम् अभूत् तदा । युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि कालस्येव दिधक्षतः ॥ चरत्य् अतिबलो युद्धे युद्धमार्गविशारदः ॥ प्रद्युम्नः शरजालैस् तान् समन्तात् प्रत्यवारयत् । दानवान् पुरुषव्याघ्रो युद्यमानान् सहस्रशः ॥
units.english: When will fight with my face towards the west Suparna will stand before me. Pradyumna will stand on my left side and you will stand on my right. In this dreadful fight we will all protect one another –. Vaishampāyana said:—Thus conversing with one another they, holding mace, club and ploughshare respectively huge like mountain summits, rode Garuda the foremost of birds. Thereupon, Janamejaya, when Rohini's son engaged in the battle his form grew dreadful like Kāla, as if desirous of consuming all, at the end of a cycle. Ranging in the battle-field the highly powerful Baladeva, expert in fighting, drew the enemies with his plough-share and grinded them with his mace. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the foremost of men, thwarted the fighting Dānavas with his arrows.

units.sanskrit: स्निग्धाञ्जनचयप्रख्यः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । प्रध्माप्य बहुशः शङ्खम् अयुध्यत जनार्दनः ॥
units.english: Blowing his conch-shell Janārddana, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, resembling a mass of collyrium, fought in many ways.

units.sanskrit: नीता वैवस्वतमुखं वैनतेयेन धीमता । तैर् हन्यमानं दैत्यानाम् अनीकं भीमविक्रमैः । गच्छ बाणपुरं शीघ्रं जहि कृष्णहलायुधौ ॥ तथेत्य् अन्तर्दधे सो ऽपि ययौ यत्र हरिर् हली । कारयाम् आस रुद्रस् तु प्रयानोद्योगम् उत्तमम् ॥ ज्वरस् तु रणम् आगत्य ददर्श हलिनं रणे । ज्वरस् त्रिपादस् त्रिशिरास् तदा समरदुर्जयः ॥
units.english: Having struck the Daityas with his wings and mutilated them with his nails and beak the intelligent son of Vinata despatched them to the abode of Yāma. Thus assailed with a downpour of arrows and overpowered by those four heroes the dreadful army of the Asuras fled away from the battle-field –. Beholding his army thus routed and with a view to protect them Rudra's follower, Jvara, came walking to the battle-field sighing again and again like a maniac. He had three legs, three heads, six arms, nine faces and a consuming weapon and was like Yama himself.

units.sanskrit: भस्मप्रहरणो घोरः कालान्तकयमोपमः । नदन् मेघसहस्रस्य तुल्यनिर्घातनिस्वनः ॥
units.english: He roared like thousands of muttering clouds, sighed and yawned repeatedly, was dozing, had his hairs erect and eyes filthy.

units.sanskrit: हलायुधम् अभिक्रुद्धः साक्षेपम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । किम् एवं बलमत्तो ऽसि न मां पश्यसि संयुगे । तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् मोक्ष्यसे रणमूर्धनि ॥
units.english: Having made his face more terrible with his eyes he, in anger, said to the holder of plough-share:—–. Why are you elated with the pride of your strength? Do you not see that have come to the battle-field? Wait a few moments. While you have come before me in the battle-field you will not return with your life.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्त्वा प्रहसन् हलायुधम् अभिद्रवत् । युगान्ताग्निनिभैर् घोरैर् मुष्टिभिर् जनयन् भयम् ॥
units.english: Saying this, smiling and showing his fist dreadful like the fire of dissolution Jvara ran towards Halāyudha –.

units.sanskrit: चरतस् तस्य संग्रामे मण्डलानि सहस्रशः । रौहिणेयस्य शैघ्र्येण नावस्थानम् अदृश्यत ॥
units.english: Rohini's son however began to move about so quickly in thousands of circular ways that Jvara could not find an opportunity.

units.sanskrit: तस्य भस्म तदा क्षिप्तं ज्वरेणाप्रतिमौजसा । शैघ्र्याल् लक्ष्ये निपतितं शरीरे पर्वतोपमे ॥ तद् भस्म वक्षसस् तस्य मेरोः शिखरम् आगतम् । रोषेणाभिप्रजज्वाल भस्मना कृष्णपूर्वजः । निःश्वसञ् जृम्भमाणश् च निद्रान्विततनुर् मुहुः ॥
units.english: Then aiming at his body huge like a mountain Jvara, of incomparable energy, hurled his consuming weapon which fell on his breast. Dropping on the summit of the mount Sumeru from Rāma's breast that burning weapon shattered it into pieces. Krishna's elder brother was however being consumed by the remnant that was left on his breast. Sighing and yawning every moment he began to move about recklessly.

units.sanskrit: संहृष्टलोमा ग्लानाक्षः क्षिप्तचित्त इव श्वसन् ॥
units.english: His eyes were dilated, hairs stood erect and all his senses were bewildered. He began to sigh like a maniac.

units.sanskrit: ततो हलधरो मत्तः कृष्णम् आह विचेतनः । कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो प्रदीप्तो ऽस्म्य् अभयंकर । दह्यामि सर्वतस् तात कथं शान्तिर् भवेन् मम ॥
units.english: Thereupon almost losing consciousness Haladhara said to Krishna:— Krishna, large-armed Krishna, thou the giver of protection, am being consumed, nay am being consumed completely. How shall be saved? Thus addressed by the highly powerful Bala Krishna, the foremost of strikers, smilingly said:—No fear.

units.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने परिष्वक्तो हलायुधः । कृष्णेन परमस्नेहात् ततो दाहात् प्रमुच्यत ॥
units.english: Saying this he embraced Halāyudha –. He was then saved by loving Krishna from being burnt.

units.sanskrit: मोक्षयित्वा बलं तत्र दाहात् तु मधुसूदनः । प्रोवाच परमक्रुद्धो वासुदेवो ज्वरं तदा । तां दर्शयस्व समरे मयि युद्धविशारद ॥
units.english: Having saved Rāma from being consumed the slayer of Madhu, Vasudeva, highly angered, said to Jvara:— Jvara, come and fight with me. Show to me the extent of your strength and power in this battle.

units.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो ज्वरो राजन् दुःखानाम् अग्रणीर् हरिम् । सव्येतराभ्यां बाहुभ्याम् एवम् उक्तो ज्वरस् तदा । चिक्षेप चैनं तद् भस्म ज्वालागर्भं महागदः ॥
units.english: Thus addressed the highly powerful Jvara, with his right hand, discharged his great burning weapon on Krishna's body. At this the powerful Krishna, the foremost of strikers, experienced a burning sensation for a few moments.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रदीप्तस् तु विभुर् मुहूर्तम् अभवत् तदा । ततो ऽसहञ् जगन्नाथः आनने समपोथयत् । स संप्रहारस् तुमुलस् तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः । ज्वरस्य च महान् आसीत् कृष्णस्य च महात्मनः । कृष्णज्वरभुजप्राणैर् युद्धम् आसीत् सुदारुणम् । नैवम् एवं प्रहर्तव्यम् इति तत्राभवत् स्वनः । ततो ज्वरं कनकविचित्रभूषणं न्यपीडयद् भुजवलयेन संयुगे । यम् अक्षयं समुपनयञ् जगत्पतिः शरीरधृग् गगनचरं महामृधे ॥
units.english: Immediately after the fire was put out. Thereupon Jvara, with his serpent-like long arms, struck Krishna on the neck and then dealt a blow on his breast. Thus there took place a great encounter, in the battle-field, between Jvara and the highly energetic Krishna the foremost of men. The sound of the stricking of arms caused by Krishna and Jvara in that highly dreadful battle was like that of a thunder striking a mountain summit. Occasionally was heard Do not strike in this way: you should do it in this way. In that great battle those two highly powerful ones so fought for a moment, that Lord of the Universe, under the guise of a man, thinking that he would come to an end, grinded the sky-ranging Jvara adorned with golden ornaments with his arms -.

units.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच मृत इत्य् अभिविज्ञाय ज्वरं शत्रुनिषूदनः । कृष्णो भुजबलाभ्यां तं चिक्षेपाथ महीतले ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Considering Jvara, assailed with his arms, dead Krishna, the slayer of enemies, threw him down on the surface of the earth.

units.sanskrit: अमुक्त्वा विग्रहं तस्य कृष्णस्याप्रतिमौजसः ॥
units.english: Released from his arms, Jvara, of incomparable energy, did not leave Krishna's body but entered into it.

units.sanskrit: स ह्य् आविष्टस् तदा तेन ज्वरेणाप्रतिमौजसा । कृष्णः स्खलन्न् इव मुहुः क्षितौ समभिवर्तत ॥ रोमाञ् चोत्थितगात्रस् तु निद्रया चाभिभूयते ॥ तस्य स्थैर्यं समालम्ब्य कृष्णः परपुरंजयः । विकुर्वति महायोगी जृम्भमाणः पुनः पुनः । सो ऽसृजज् ज्वरम् अन्यं तु पूर्वज्वरविनाशनम् ॥
units.english: Possessed by Jvara fever of incomparable energy Krishna had his movements slackened and repeatedly supported himself by touching the ground. He was possessed by sleep, his steps were slackened and his hairs stood erect. He repeatedly sighed and yawned. Thus possessed by weakness and yawning repeatedly the great Yogin Krishna, the victor of the enemy's cities, regained his natural state after a long time -. Thereupon knowing himself possessed by Jvara Purosottama created another for its destruction.

units.sanskrit: घोरं वैष्णवम् अत्युग्रं सर्वप्राणिभयंकरं । सृष्टवान् अथ तेजस्वी बलवान् भीमविक्रमः । कृष्णज्वरो ज्वरं पूर्वं गृहीत्वा स्वेन तेजसा । ततो माहेश्वरो युद्धे ताडयाम् आस वैष्णवम् । बाहुना ताडितस् तेन ननाद बहुविस्तरम् ॥
units.english: With his energy, the energetic Janārddana, of dreadful power, created a dreadful Jvara, highly terrible unto creatures. Catching hold, by force, of the former Jvara the one, created by Krishna, presented it before him. Having thus driven out that Jvara from his body through one created by him the highly powerful and angry Vāsudeva struck him down on the ground and was about to tear him into pieces.

units.sanskrit: ततो रौद्रो ज्वरो राजन् मुष्टिनाथ जघान तम् । इत्य् उक्त्वा सुमहानादं चकार रणमूर्धनि ॥ उत्थाय च हृषीकेशो ज्वरं माहेश्वरं रणे । हन्तुम् ऐच्छत् तदा लोको निर्ज्वरो ऽस्त्व् इति केशवः । मा वधीर् ज्वरम् एतं वै रक्षणीयस् त्वयानघ । इत्य् एवम् उक्ते वचने तं मुमोच हरिः स्वयम् ॥ भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य जगतः परमो गुरुः ॥
units.english: Thereat Jvara, bewildered, said Janārddana, it behoveth thee to protect me. However while Krishna, of incomparable energy, was about to strike that Jvara on the ground an invisible voice was heard in the sky:— Krishna, large-armed Krishna, the enhancer of the delight of the Yādavas, do not kill this Jvara. sinless one, he is worthy of being protected by thee –. Thus addressed Hari, the lord of the past, future and present and the great preceptor of the world let Jvara off.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो हृषीकेशं ज्वरो वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत् । कृष्णस्य पादयोर् मूर्ध्ना शरणं सो ऽगमज् ज्वरः ॥
units.english: Thereupon prostrating himself with bent head at Hrishikesha's feet Jvara said:— descendant of Yadu, Govinda, hear what have to submit unto thee.

units.sanskrit: यो मे मनोरथा देव तं त्वं कुरु महाभुज । अहम् एको ज्वरस् तात नान्यो लोके ज्वरो भवेत् । तव प्रसादान् नान्यः स्याज् ज्वरः समितिशोभन ॥
units.english: Hear, large-armed deity, what have got in my mind and do thou accomplish it. lord, pray from thee for this boon only that may be the only Jvara in this world and no one else may flourish.

units.sanskrit: वरार्थिनां वरो देयो भवांश् च शरणं गतः । भगवान् उवाच एक एव ज्वरो लोके भवान् अस्तु यथासुखम् । यो ऽयं मया ज्वरो सृष्टो मय्य् एवैष प्रलीयताम् ॥ वैशंपायन उवाच एवम् उक्ते तु वचने ज्वरं प्रति महायशाः । कृष्णः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः पुनर् वाक्यम् उवाच ह ॥
units.english: The lord said:—It is proper to confer a boon on one who prays for it. Besides you have sought my protection. May you fare well therefore, Jvara. You will have what you are praying for. As before you will be the only Jvara. May he, whom have created, dissolve in me –. Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this the highly illustrious Krishna, the foremost of strikers, again spoke to Jvara:—Hear, how you will range in the world, having spread yourself amongst the entire creation mobile and immobile.

units.sanskrit: त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं मत्प्रियं यदि काङ्क्षसे । चतुष्पादान् भजैकेन द्वितीयेन च स्थावरान् ॥ तृतीयो यश् च ते भागो मानुषेषूपपत्स्यते । चतुर्धा यस् तृतीयस्य भविष्यति च ते ध्रुवम् । एकान्तरश् चतुर्भागः खोरकश् च चतुर्थकः ॥ मानुषेष्व् अथ भेदने वस त्वं प्रविभज्य वै । जातिष्व् अथावशेषासु निवस त्वं शृणुष्व मे ॥
units.english: If you seek my pleasure divide yourself into three parts. With one do you possess the four-legged animals, with the second the immobile objects and with the third the human beings. And with the fourth portion of your third part you will always live in the midst of the birds. Dividing yourself into four parts namely appearing every day, after two days, three days and four days you are to live amongst mankind. Hear how you are to live amongst other creatures.

units.sanskrit: वृक्षेषु कीटरूपेण तथा संकोचपत्रकः । पाण्डुपत्रश् च विख्यातः फलेष्व् आतुर्यम् एव च ॥ अपां तु नीलिकां विद्याच् छिखोद्भेदश् च बर्हिणाम् । पद्मिनीषु हिमो भूत्वा पृथिव्याम् अपि चोषरः ॥
units.english: In trees you will live in the shape of an insect and the disease that withers up the leaves and turns them pale; in the fruits you will live like Aturya disease; in the lotuses like frost, in the earth like a desert, in the water like Neelikā a plant, in the peacocks like the growing of the tuft, in the mountain like mineral and in the cows like Khoraka or a cow-disease; you will live on earth under these numerous forms.

units.sanskrit: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनाच् चापि प्राणिनां वधम् एष्यसि । ऋते देवमनुष्येभ्यो नान्यस् त्वां विसहिष्यति ॥
units.english: With your very view and touch the animals will be shorn of their lives. Only gods and men will be able to withstand you -.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच कृष्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा ज्वरो हृष्टमना ह्य् अभूत् । प्रोवाच वचनं किंचित् प्रणमित्वा कृताञ्जलिः ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing the words of Krishna Jvara was delighted and with folded hands saluted him and said:— Mādhava, blessed am for thy giving me soverignty over all creatures and objects.

units.sanskrit: भूयश् च ते वचः कर्तुम् इच्छामि पुरुषर्षभ । तद् आज्ञापय गोविन्द किं करोमि महाभुज । त्रिपुरहरेण हरेण निर्मितः । रणशिरसि विनिर्जितस् त्वया । प्रभुर् असि मे ऽद्य तवास्मि किंकरः ॥
units.english: Purusottama wish now to carry out any other order of yours. large-armed Govinda, order me what am to do. Formerly had been created by Hara the slayer of Tripura and of other animals. Now vanquished by thee in battle have become thy servant. Thou art now my master –.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ज्वरस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वासुदेवो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । ज्वर उवाच धन्यो ऽस्म्य् अनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि यत् त्वया मत्प्रियं क्र्टं । आज्ञापय प्रिअं किं ते चक्रायुध करोम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Hearing the words of Jvara Vasudeva said:—Hear, what resolution cherish at heart. Jvara said:— holder of discus, have been favoured and blessed with what good thou hast done for me. Order me, what what pleasure of thine may carry out.

units.sanskrit: भगवान् उवाच महामृधे तव मम च द्वयोर् इमं पराक्रमं भुजबलकेवलास्त्रयोः । प्रणम्य माम् एकमनाः पठेत् तु यः स वै भवेज् ज्वर विगतज्वरो नरः ॥
units.english: The lord said:— Jvara, the man, who having saluted me, will attentively read this account of prowess displayed only by our arms in the great battle, will be freed from fever.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तस् तु कृष्णेन ज्वरः साक्षान् महात्मना । प्रणम्य शिरसा कृष्णम् अपक्रान्तस् ततो रणात् ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by Krishna, the foremost of Yadus, the highly powerful Jvara said:—So be it. Having thus obtained the boon and promised, Jvara, saluting Krishna, left the battle-field –.

units.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच ततस् ते सहिताः सर्वे त्रयस्त्रय इवाग्नयः । अर्दयन् वैनतेयस्था नदन्तो ऽतिबला रणे ॥ चक्रलाङ्गलपातैश् च बाणवर्षैश् च पीडितम् । संचुकोप महानीकं दानवानां महात्मनाम् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Thereupon riding quickly Vinatā's son, those three heroes, stationed in the battle-field like three fire-gods, began to fight there. Seated on Garuda's back those highly powerful three heroes assailed and dispersed the Dānava army with a downpour of arrows. Assailed with the strokes of discus, plough-share and arrows the irrepressible and huge Danava army were worked up with anger.

units.sanskrit: कृष्णबाणाग्निर् उद्भूतो विवृद्धिम् उपगच्छति ॥ स दानवसहस्राणि तस्मिन् समरमूर्धनि । सेनां बाणः समासाद्य वारयन् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥ लाघवं समुपागम्य किम् एवं भयविक्लवाः । दैत्यवंशसमुत्पन्नाः पलायध्य्वं महामृधे ॥ कवचासिगदाप्रासान् खड्गचर्मपरश्वधान् । उत्सृज्योत्सृज्य गच्छन्ति किं भवन्तो ऽन्तरिक्षगाः ॥
units.english: As fire increases in a room with dry fuels so the fire, engendered by Krishna’s arrows, increased that fire burning like that of dissolution, and consumed thousands of Dānavas in the battle-field -. Beholding his soldiers assailed and burnt with various arrows of Krishna, and take to their heels Vāna came there and prevented them saying Born in the race of the Daityas why do ye, overwhelmed with fear and displaying your weakness, fly away from the battle-field? Why do you take to your heels leaving off your respective coats of mail, swords, daggers, darts, leathern protectors and axes? Think of your birth and living with Hara and then decide whether you should fly away.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उच्चारितां वाचं शृण्वन्तस् ताम् अचिन्त्य वै । अपक्रामन्त ते सर्वे दानवा भयपीडिताः ॥ भग्नावशेषं युद्धाय मनश् चक्रे पुनस् तदा ॥ कुम्भाण्डो नाम बाणस्थ सखामात्यश् च वीर्यवान् । बलं भग्नं समालोक्य वचनं चेदम् अब्रवीत् ॥
units.english: now stand before you. Although they heard the words given vent to by Vāna, the Dānavas, beside themselves with fear, paid no heed to them and fled away. Of the soldiers remaining there only the Pramathas stood firm and desired to fight again -. Beholding his soldiers routed, Kumbhānda, Vāna's powerful minister and friend, said:— ye leading Dānavas, behold Shankara, Kārtikeya and Vāna in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: किमर्थं युद्धम् उत्सृज्य भवन्तो भयमोहिताः ॥
units.english: Still, possessed by fear, why are you flying away leaving your own armies? Give up hope of your lives and fight.

units.sanskrit: एवं कुम्भाण्डवाक्यं ते शृण्वन्तो भयविह्लवाः । चक्राग्निभयवित्रस्ताः सर्वे यान्ति दिशो दश ॥
units.english: Before they heard those words of Kumbhānda, the Danavas stricken with the fear of the fire of Krishna's discus, fled away on all sides.

units.sanskrit: भग्नं बलं ततो दृष्ट्वा कृष्णेनामिततेजसा । संरक्तनयनः स्थाणुर् युद्धाय पर्यवर्तत ॥ बाणसंरक्षणं कर्तुं रथम् आस्थाय सुप्रभम् । देवः कुमारश् च तथा रथेनाग्निनिभेन वै । संदष्टौष्ठपुटो रुद्रः प्रधावति यतो हरिः ॥
units.english: Thereupon beholding all the soldiers routed by Krishna, Siva, of incomparable prowess, had his eyes reddened with anger. And in order to protect Vāna, he stood on his lustrous car and prepared himself for fighting. Kumāra too ascended a car burning like car. Powerful Rudra, ascending a car drawn by lions and biting his hips, drove where Hari was –.

units.sanskrit: पिबन्न् इव तदाकाशं सिंहयुक्तो महास्वनः । रथो भाति घनोन्मुक्तः पौर्णमास्यां यथा शशी ॥
units.english: At that time his car, as if devouring the sky, making a great sound and drawn by lions, looked like the full-moon freed from clouds.

units.sanskrit: नदद्भिर् विविधान् नादान् रथो देवस्य सो ऽभयात् ॥
units.english: Filled with various ghosts making diverse sounds that car of the god of gods proceeded towards the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: के चित् सिंहमुखास् तत्र तथा व्याघ्रमुखाश् च ह । नागाश्वोष्ट्रमुखास् तत्र प्रावेपन्न् अभिपीडिताः । व्यालयज्ञोपवीताश् च के चित् तत्र महाबलाः ॥ खरोष्ट्रगजवक्त्राश् च अश्वग्रीवाश् च संस्थिताः ॥
units.english: Of those ghosts some had the faces of lions, some those of tigers, some those of serpents, some those of horses and some those of camels; they too, filled with fear, were trembling. Amongst those highly powerful ghosts, some had the faces of asses, some those of camels, some those of peacocks, Some those of horses, some those of rams, and some those of cats.

units.sanskrit: छागमार्जारवक्त्राश् च मेषवक्त्रास् तथा परे । चीरिणः शिखिनश् चान्ये जटिलोर्ध्वशिरोरुहाः ॥
units.english: Some had the faces of sheep, some put on bark, some had tufts of hairs on their heads, some wore matted locks, some had hairs bound up, and some were naked.

units.sanskrit: भग्नाः परिपतन्ति स्म शङ्खदुंदुभिनिस्वनैः । के चित् सौम्यमुखास् तत्र दिव्यैः शस्त्रैर् अलंकृताः ॥ नानापुष्पकृतापीडा नानाप्रहरणायुधाः । रुधिरार्द्रमहादंष्ट्रा महामांसबलिप्रियाः ॥
units.english: They all blew conch-shells and bugles when they proceeded to the battle-field. Of them some had beautified faces and were adorned with celestial weapons and flowers. Some were dwarfish and some were grim-visaged. Some put on lion and tiger skins. Some had faces covered with blood, huge-teeth and were fond of flesh.

units.sanskrit: देवं संपरिवार्याथ महाशत्रुप्रमर्दनम् । लीलायमानास् तिष्ठन्ति संग्रामाभिमुखोन्मुखाः ॥
units.english: They all stood encircling Shankara the destroyer of great enemies in the battle-field and were waiting there at ease.

units.sanskrit: ततो दिव्यं रथं दृष्ट्वा रुद्रस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । कृष्णो गरुडम् आस्थाय ययौ रुद्राय संयुगे । हरिं विव्याध कुपितो नाराचानां शतेन सः ॥ स शरैर् अर्दितस् तेन हरेणामित्रघातिना । हरिर् जग्राह कुपितो ह्य् आस्त्रं पार्जन्यम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Beholding that car of the indefatigable Rudra. Krishna, riding Garuda, proceeded to the battle-field. Then beholding Hari proceed on Garuda discharging arrows, Hara, ever standing at the head in a battle, struck him in anger with hundreds, of winged arrows. Assailed with shafts by Hara, the grinder of enemies, Hari too, irate, took up most excellent weapons given by Indra.

units.sanskrit: प्रचचाल ततो भूमिर् विष्णुरुद्रप्रपीडिता ॥
units.english: Thereupon assailed by Krishna and Rudra the earth shook and the elephants trembled raising their heads.

units.sanskrit: पर्वताः प्रस्तुतास् तत्र जलधाराभिर् आप्लुताः ॥
units.english: The mountains were covered with the water of streams; some had their summits scattered on all sides.

units.sanskrit: दिशश् च विदिशश् चैव भूमिर् आकाशम् एव च ॥
units.english: In that encounter between Hara and Hari the quarters, sky and earth were as if all ablaze.

units.sanskrit: समन्ततश् च निर्घाताः पतन्ति धरणीतले ॥ शिवाश् चैवाशिवान् नादान् नदन्ते भीमदर्शनाः । वासवश् चानदद् घोरं रुधिरं चाप्य् अवर्षत ॥ उल्का च बाणसैन्यस्य मुखान्य् आवृत्य तिष्ठति । एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मा सर्वैर् देवगणैर् वृतः । त्रिपुरान्तकम् उद्यन्तं ज्ञात्वा रुद्रम् उपागमत् ॥ गन्धर्वाप्सरसश् चैव यक्षा विद्याधरास् तथा । ततः पार्जन्यम् अस्त्रं तत् क्षिप्तं रुद्राय विष्णुना । ययौ ज्वलन्न् अथ तदा यतो रुद्रो रथे स्थितः । ततः शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम् । निष्पेतुः सर्वतो दिग्भ्यो यतो हरतनुस् ततः ॥ अथाग्नेयं महारौद्रम् अस्त्रम् अस्त्रविदां वरः । मुमोच रुषितो रुद्रस् तद् अद्भुतम् इवाभवत् ॥
units.english: Fire-brands fell on earth from all sides and dreadful-looking jackals began to emit inauspicious cries. With a great noise Indra began to send down showers of blood and fire-brands covered the rear of Vāna's army. The wind blew high, and the luminous bodies and herbs, shorn of lustre, flew about in the sky. At that time the Grandfather, knowing that Rudra, the destroyer of Asuras, had entered upon a battle, came there encircled by the celestials The Apsaras, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, and Chāranas, stationed in the sky, began to witness that encounter. Then Vishnu discharged Indra's weapon at Rudra –. Burning it went up to the car where Rudra was. The very next moment hundreds and thousands of arrows dropped before Hara's car. Seeing it and filled with anger Hara discharged the highly dreadful fiery weapon. It appeared indeed highly wonderful. At that time Krishna and the three other heroes were entirely covered with arrows; and scorched with the fire of the weapon they were so much emaciated that they were not visible.

units.sanskrit: ततो विशीर्णदेहास् ते चत्वारो ऽपि समन्ततः । ततो विशीर्णदेहास् ते चत्वारो ऽपि समन्ततः । नादृश्यन्त शरैश् छन्ना दह्यमानाश् च वह्निना ॥ ततो भूतानि वित्रेसुर् देवाश् च भयविक्लवाः । सिंहनादं ततश् चक्रुः सर्व एवासुरोत्तमाः । हतो ऽयम् इति विज्ञाय आग्नेयान्तर्हिते हरौ ॥ ततस् तद् विषहित्वाजौ ह्य् अस्त्रम् अस्त्रविदां वरः । ततः क्रुद्धो हृषीकेशः प्रतिषिध्याग्निसंचयं । जग्राह वारुणं सो ऽस्त्रं वासुदेवः प्रतापवान् ॥ उद्यते वारुणास्त्रे तु वासुदेवेन धीमता । प्रयुक्ते वासुदेवेन वारुणास्त्रे ऽतितेजसि । आग्नेयं प्रशमं यातम् अस्त्रं वारुणतेजसा ॥
units.english: Having thus counteracted those four weapons with his four arrows Mādhava discharged his Vaishnava weapon like unto Antaka the destroyer with his mouth wide open. When the Vaishnava weapon was discharged all the Bhutas, Yakshas and Asuras of Vāna's host, unconscious and stricken with fear, fled on all sides. As the king of gods, the wielder of thunderbolt, proceeds encircled by the celestials, so Vāna went surrounded by the highly powerful and mighty car-warriors, the Daityas holding dreadful arms -. Assuming a dreadful form Vāna, holding a bow, got upon the car brought by the Dānavas for fighting with those foremost of Yadus.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् प्रतिहते ह्य् अस्त्रे वासुदेवेन संयुगे । पैशाचं राक्षसं चैव रौद्रम् आङ्गिरसं भवः । मुमोचास्त्राणि चत्वारि युगान्ताग्निनिभानि सः ॥
units.english: Afterwards as at the time of the universal dissolution the ocean, abounding in waves increased by the wind, is agitated so that ocean, of great force abounding in cars of the heroes, went on. Then Rudra, burning in double effulgence on account of his anger and strength, took up his arrow having sharpened darts on four sides with which he had killed Tripura.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेवो ऽपि चास्त्राणि दृष्ट्वा विप्रहितानि वै । अत्राणां वारुणार्थाय वासुदेवो मुमोच ह ॥ जग्राह वैष्णवं सो ऽस्त्रं व्यादितास्यान्तकोपमम् ॥
units.english: When the three-eyed deity took up that arrow, set it to his bow and was about to discharge it the high-souled Vāsudeva, cognizant of the minds of all, came to know of it. Rudra said to Brahmā:— lord, will not fight any more. By this encounter of Krishna and Vāna the earth will be relieved of her burden –. Thereupon with great pleasure Krishna and Rudra retired from the battle-field and embraced one another. Here saw Hara in Hari's form and Hari in Hara's.

units.sanskrit: पुनश् चासीत् कथं युद्धं परेषां लोमहर्षणम् । कुम्भाण्डसंगृहीताश्वे रथे तिष्ठन् गुहस् तदा । अभिदुद्राव कृष्णं च बलं प्रद्युम्नम् एव च ॥ ततः शरशतैर् उग्रैस् तान् विव्याध रणे गुहः । शरौघाचितगात्रास् ते त्रयस्त्रय इवाग्नयः । तान् अस्त्रांस् त्रिभिर् एवास्त्रैर् विनिवार्य स पावकिः । शैलवारुणसावित्रैस् तान् स विव्याध सायकैः । तस्य दीप्तशरौघस्य दीप्तचापधरस्य च । शरौघान् अस्त्रमायाभिर् ग्रसन्ति स्म महात्मनः ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:—After the high-souled Krishna and Rudra had retired from the battle-field, how did the hair-stirring battle of the enemies continue ? Vaishampāyana said:—Stationed on the car brought by Kumbhānda, Guha Kārtikeya drove towards Krishna, Baladeva and Pradyumna and struck them with hundreds of dreadful and sharpened arrows. Bathed in blood those three gods, like unto three fires, fought with Kumara –. After those heroes, expert in fighting, had struck Kumāra with three weapons given by Wind-God, Fire-God and Indra he, too, with three weapons, counteracted them and struck the Yadavas with three other weapons, namely Shaila, Vāruna and Sāvitri. They however, devoured, by virtue of their illusory powers, all the weapons shot by the great Kumāra, the holder of burning bow and shaft.

units.sanskrit: बाणौघे विवृते तस्मिन् परमक्रोधदीपितः । यदा तदा गुहः क्रुद्धः प्रज्वलन्न् इव तेजसा । प्रयुक्ते ब्रह्मशिरसि सहस्रांशुसमप्रभे । उग्रे परमदुर्धर्षे लोकक्षयकरे तदा ॥ प्रधावन् सर्वभूतानि दह्यमानानि सर्वतः । तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र दिग्वासाः साभवत् तदा । अपाक्रामद् गुहो युद्धाद् युद्धायैव च केशवः । रामप्रद्युम्नसंयुक्तो गरुडे गरुडध्वजः ॥ वैशंपायनः निर्जिते च ज्वरे तस्मिन् हरे चैव गुहे तदा । ततस् तूर्यप्रणादैश् च भेरीणां च महास्वनैः । सिंहनादैश् च दैत्यानां बाणः कृष्णम् अभिद्रवत् ॥
units.english: Then the highly powerful Guha, burning in effulgence and biting his lips, took up the dreadful weapon Brahmashira like unto the Destroyer himself -. When the highly dreadful weapon Brahmashira, endued with the effulgence of a thousand suns and destructive of the world, was discharged by Kumāra the creatures lost their consciousness through its warmth and fled away on all sides and the whole universe bewailed. Seeing it the powerful Keshava, the slayer of Keshi, took up his discus the destroyer and counteractor of all weapons. As in the rainy season the clouds cover the rays of the sun, so that discus, of the high-souled Keshava, clouded, with its lustre, that of Brahmashira weapon -. He then discharged, in anger, that celestial burning Sakti set with bells, effulgent like a fire-brand and resembling the fire of dissolution –. He then set up a powerful shout which struck terror unto his enemies. Beholding that burning Sakti the gods and their king were greatly depressed and said—Perhaps Krishna will be consumed.

units.sanskrit: नानाप्रहरणोपेतं नानाङ्गदविभूषितम् । अद्य बाहुसहस्रं मे कोटिभूतं निशामय ॥
units.english: You will see to-day my thousand arms, adorned with various weapons and ornaments, multiply into a million -.

units.sanskrit: गर्जतस् तस्य वाक्यौघाः समुद्राद् इव सिन्धवः । निश्चरन्ति महाघोरा वातोद्धूता इवोर्मयः ॥ रोषपर्याकुले चैव नेत्रे तस्य बभूवतुः । जगद् दिधक्षन्न् इव खे महासूर्य इवोदितौ ॥ क्षोभविस्फूर्जिते तस्य रक्तनेत्रे बभूवतुः । जगद् दिधक्षू युगपन् महासूर्याविवोदितौ । भगवान् उवाच बाण किं गर्जसे शूरा न गर्जन्ति रणे स्थिताः । एह्य् एहि युध्यस्व रणे किं मिथ्यागर्जितेन ते ॥
units.english: While Vāna was thus roaring his words as if travelled all over like the dreadful waves of an ocean raised by the wind. As if desirous of consuming the world the eyes of that highly powerful Asura, filled with anger, shone like two suns rising in the firmament. Hearing those proud words of Vāna Nārada so laughed aloud that as if the sky was sundered in twain. Seated on a Yoga seat that ascetic, filled with curiosity, moved about on all sides for seeing the battle -. Krishna said:— Vāna, why are you roaring thus out of foolishness? The heroes do not vaunt thus. What is the use of vaunting? Come and fight with me in the battle field.

units.sanskrit: यदि युद्धानि वचनैः सिध्यन्ति दितिनन्दन । भवान् एव जयेन् नित्यं बह्वबद्धं प्रभाषसे ॥
units.english: son of Diti, you have given vent to many unconnected words. If by words victory is accomplished in a battle, you would have been no doubt victorious.

units.sanskrit: एह्य् एहि जय मां बाण जितो वा वसुधातले । स्मयन् बाणस् ततः कृष्णं शरवर्षैर् अवाकिरत् । ततः परिघनिस्त्रिंशैर् गदातोमरशक्तिभिः । विनिन्दमानौ संयत्तौ युद्धे चेरतुर् ओजसा ॥ मुसलैः पट्टिसैश् चापि छादयाम् आस केशवम् ॥ योधयाम् आस समरे द्विबाहुम् अथ लीलया । सहस्रबाहुना सार्धम् अष्टबाहुर् अयुध्यत । बाणेन सह संगम्य शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः ॥ लाघवं वीक्ष्य कृष्णस्य बलिसूनू रुषान्वितः । यद् अस्त्रं परमं दिव्यं तपसा निर्मितं महत् । तद् अप्रतिहितं युद्धे सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् । तस्मिन् मुक्ते दिशः सर्वास् तमोपहतमण्डलाः । ... सुघोराणि च सर्वशः । तमसा संवृते लोके ... । साधु साध्व् इति बाणं तु पूजयन्ति स्म दानवाः । अहो धिग् इति देवानां चरते वाग् उदीरिता ॥
units.english: Come Vāna; either defeat me or vanquished by me lie down on earth for good with your face down. Saying this Krishna struck Vāna with arrows cutting him to the quick. Thus mangled in that dreadful encounter by Krishna with arrows cutting to the very vitals Vāna, with great care, covered Krishna with burning arrows. With Parighas, Nisthringsas, clubs, Tomaras, Saktis, maces and Pattishas he completely covered Keshava. Proud Vāna, having a thousand arms, easily fought in the battle-field with two-armed Keshava. Although having eight-arms Keshava, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, fought with thousand-armed Vāna in that battle. Then beholding Krishna's superior training Bali's son was greatly worked up with anger. He then discharged that celestial great weapon destructive of all enemies which Brahmā, by his ascetic powers, had formerly created for Hiranyakashipu. When that weapon was shot off all the quarters were enshrouded with darkness and thousands of dreadful omens were seen on all sides. When all the worlds were covered with darkness every thing was beyond the range of perception -. The Dānavas applauded Wāna, saying Well done! Well done! and words of exclamations by the gods as Alas! were heard.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्त्रबलवेगेन सार्चिष्मत्यः सुदारुणाः । नाकम्पत तदा वायुर् न मेघाः संचरन्ति च । अस्त्रे विमुक्ते बाणेन दह्यमाने च केशवे ॥
units.english: dreadful downpour of burning arrows was caused by the power and force of that weapon. When that weapon was discharged by Vāna and Keshava was being burnt, wind, storm or clouds did not move.

units.sanskrit: ततो वितिमिरे लोके स चाग्निः प्रशमं गतः । दानवा मोघसंकल्पाः सर्वे ऽभुवंस् तदा भृशम् । दानवास्त्रं प्रशान्तं तु पर्जन्यास्त्रे ऽभिमन्त्रिते । ततो देवगणाः सर्वे प्रणेदुर् जहृषुस् तदा ॥
units.english: When the divine slayer of Madhu took up Indra's weapon like unto inevitable death in the battle-field all the worlds were shorn of darkness, the fire was extinguished and the Dānavas completely lost their hearts. Seeing the Dānava weapon counteracted as soon as Indra's weapon was got ready the gods began to laugh and roar like lions –.

units.sanskrit: हते शस्त्रे महाराज दैतेयः क्रोधमूर्छितः । भूयः संछादयाम् आस केशवं गरुडे स्थितम् । पुनः संवारयाम् आस केशवः शत्रुसूदनः ॥
units.english: Beholding his weapon thus counteracted Diti's son Vāna was beside himself with rage, said harsh words to Keshava who was on Garuda and covered him with maces and Pattiças. Keshava, the slayer of his enemies, however soon counteracted similingly his uplifted weapon.

units.sanskrit: तस्य शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्तैः शरैर् अशनिसंनिभैः । तिलशस् तद् रथं चक्रे साश्वध्वजपताकिनम् ॥
units.english: In that great battle with arrows, like unto thunderbolts, shot off his Srānga bow Keshava sundered Vāna's car, with horses and standards, into pieces.

units.sanskrit: चिच्छेद कवचं कायान् मुकुटं च महाप्रभम् । कार्मुकं च महातेजा हस्ताच् चापं च केशवः ॥
units.english: The very next moment the highly powerful Keshava separated from Vāna's person his highly lustrous crown, coat of mail, bow and shield.

units.sanskrit: विव्याध चैनम् उरसि नाराचेन स्मयन्न् इव ॥ स मर्माभिहतः संख्ये प्रमुमोहाल्पचेतनः ॥
units.english: And smilingly he struck him on the breast with winged arrows. Cut to the very quick Vāna lost his consciousness and swooned away.

units.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मूर्छितं बाणं प्रहारपरिपीडितम् । प्रासादवरशृङ्गस्थो नारदो मुनिपुंगवः ॥ उत्थायापश्यत तदा कक्षास्फोटनतत्परः । जय बाणं महाबाहो दैतेयं देवपूजित । यद् अर्थम् अवतीर्णो ऽसि तत् कर्म सफलं कुरु ॥ एवं स्तुत्वा तदा देवं बाणैः खं द्योतयञ् शितैः । इतस् ततः संपतद्भिर् नारदो व्यचरद् रणे ॥
units.english: Seeing Vāna thus struck and swoon away Nārada, who was sitting on the highest top of the palace, rose up with clapping and said great fortune! Great fortune, blessed is my life and birth since have witnessed today this wonderful prowess of Dāmodara. thou of large arms, thou adored by the gods, do thou accomplish that for which thou hast incarnated thyself. Destroy soon Diti's son Vāna. Having thus sung the glories of the Lord Krishna and emblazoned the battle-field with sharpened arrows he moved about in the battle-field –.

units.sanskrit: प्रायुध्येतां ध्वजौ तत्र ताव् अन्योन्यम् अभिद्रुतौ । युद्धं चाभूद् वाहनयोर् उभयोर् देवदैत्ययोः । गरुडस्य च संग्रामे मयूरस्य च युध्यतः ॥
units.english: In that battle their standards, encountering each other, fought; so did the horses of the Devas and Dānavas. When Garuda and the peacock fought they struck each other with wings, beaks and talons.

units.sanskrit: जग्राह शिरसि क्रुद्धस् तुण्डेनाभ्यहनत् तदा ॥ दक्षिणेन च पक्षेण निजघान महाबलः । आकृष्य चैनं तरसा विकृष्य च महाबलः । निःसंज्ञं पातयाम् आस गगनाद् इव पर्वतम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon leaping up in anger the highly powerful son of Vinatā speedily caught hold of the peacock's head with his beaks and struck him with his wings and talons. Thus repeatedly drawn by the highly powerful son of Vinatā the peacock fell down unconscious as the sun drops down from the sky.

units.sanskrit: बाणः परमसंविग्नश् चिन्तयन् कार्यम् आत्मनः ॥ मयातिबलमत्तेन न कृतं सुहृदां वचः । पश्यतां देवदैत्यानां प्राप्तो ऽस्म्य् आपदम् उत्तमाम् । चिन्तयद् भगवान् रुद्रो बाणरक्षणम् आतुरः ॥
units.english: When the highly powerful peacock fell down on the ground, Vāna, stricken with great anxiety, thought:—Elated with the pride of my strength have not regarded the words of my friends. And therefore have met with discomfiture before the very eyes of the gods and Daityas. Beholding Vāna thus depressed and distressed the Lord Rudra grew anxious for protecting him.

units.sanskrit: ततो नन्दिं महादेवः प्राह गम्भीरया गिरा । नन्दिकेश्वर संयाहि यतो बाणस् ततो रथम् ॥
units.english: Mahādeva, then in grave words, said to Nandi –, sinless Nandi, go speedily where Vāna stands in the battle-field and give him this celestial car drawn by lions.

units.sanskrit: प्रमाथगणपार्श्वे हि न हि मे स्थास्यते मनः । तथेत्य् उक्त्वा पुनर् नन्दी रथेन रथिनां वरः । यतो बाणस् ततो गत्वा बाणम् आह शनैर् इदम् ॥
units.english: do not wish to fight. Let me stand here amongst the Pramathas. You better go and protect Vāna Saying So be it, Nandi, the foremost of car-warriors, went to Vāna with the car and spoke to him slowly.

units.sanskrit: दैत्येमं रथम् आतिष्ठ शीघ्रम् एहि महाबल । तं स्यन्दनम् अधिष्ठाय भवस्यामिततेजसः । प्रादुश् चक्रे तदा रौद्रम् अस्त्रम् अस्त्रविदां वरः । दीप्तं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम बाणः क्रुद्धो ऽतिवीर्यवान् ॥
units.english: highly powerful Daitya, get upon this car soon; hero, will be your charioteer. Do not delay; ascend this car. Ascending that car, constructed by Brahmā, of Bhava of incomparable energy the powerful Vāna, in anger, brought into requisition the burning Roudra weapon Brahmashira, capable of destroying all other arms.

units.sanskrit: प्रदीप्ते ब्रह्मशिरसि लोकः क्षोभम् उपागमत् । लोकसंरक्षणार्थं हि तत् सृष्टं पद्मयोनिना ॥
units.english: Although the Lotus-sprung Brahmā had created that weapon for protecting the worlds still they were all agitated when it was ablaze.

units.sanskrit: तच् चक्रेण निहत्यास्त्रं प्राह कृष्णः प्रतापवान् । लोके प्रख्यातयशसं बाणम् अप्रतिमं रणे ॥ कत्थितानि क्व ते बाण तानि किं न विकत्थसे । कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम पूर्वम् आसीन् महाबलः । महाबलः स रामेण ... । तथा तवापि दर्पो ऽयं बाहूनां वीर्यसंभवः । चक्रं ते दर्पशमनं करोति रणमूर्धनि ॥
units.english: Seeing it and destroying it with his discus Krishna said to Vāna, illustrious in the world and incomparable in battle:— Vāna, where are your vauntings now? now stand for battle: fight and display your prowess. Formerly there was a king having a thousand arms by namely Kārtavirya. His arms were reduced to two by Rāma in battle. Your pride, begotten by the strength of your arms, will share the same fate. will soon destroy your pride in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: यावत् ते दर्पशमनं करोम्य् अद्य स्वबाहुना । तिष्ठेदानीं न मे ऽद्य त्वं मोक्ष्यसे रणमूर्धनि ॥
units.english: If you wait here for a moment will chop off your arms which have created such a haughtiness in you. You will not be suffered to leave me with your life.

units.sanskrit: अथ तद् दुर्लभं दृष्ट्वा युद्धं परमदारुणम् । तथा देवासुरसमं हर्षान् नृत्यति नारदः ॥
units.english: Seeing that highly dreadful encounter like unto that between the gods and demons Nārada began to dance with glee.

units.sanskrit: निर्जिताश् च गणाः सर्वे प्रद्युम्नेन महात्मना । ततश् चक्रं सहस्रारं नदन् मेघ इवोष्णगे । जग्राह पुरुषव्याघ्रो बाणबाहुप्रशान्तये ॥ तेजो यज् ज्योतिषां चैव तेजो वज्राशनेस् तथा । त्रेताग्नेश् चैव यत् तेजो यच् चाग्नेर् ब्रह्मचारिणः । ऋषीणां च तपो ज्ञानं तच् चक्रे पर्यवस्थितम् ॥ पतिव्रतानां यत् तेजः प्राणं च मृगपक्षिणाम् । नागराक्षसयक्षाणां गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् अपि । त्रैलोक्यस्य च यत् तेजः सर्वं चक्रे व्यवस्थितम् । तेजसा तेन संयुक्तं भास्वता प्रज्वलभृशम् । वपुषा तेज आदत्ते बाणस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम् ॥ ज्ञात्वातितेजसं चक्रं कृष्णेनाभ्युद्यतं रणे । अप्रमेयं ह्य् अविहितं रुद्राणीम् अब्रवीच् छिवः ॥
units.english: Vanquished by the high-souled Pradyumna, the ghosts, leaving the battle-field, went to Shankara. Thereupon Krishna, resembling the muttering of the clouds of the rainy season, soon took up his thousand-bladed discus destructive of the Daityas in the battle-field. In that discus were combined the energies of luminous bodies, thunder, lightnings and of the king of gods. In it were the energies of the three-fold fires, Brahma fire and of the austerities and penances of the Rishis. In it was the energy of chaste women, the strength of the birds and beasts and the energy of the holder of the discus. In it was the strength of the Rākshasas, Yakshas and Gandharvas -. In it was the power of all other creatures living in the three worlds. That powerful discus of the Lord, effulgent like the sun, stood before Vāna and deprived him of his energy. Beholding the Lord with uplifted discus in the battle-field and knowing that it, endued with great energy, was incomparable and could not be counteracted Shiva said to Girija:— goddess, the discus, which Keshava has taken up, is unconquerable in the three worlds.

units.sanskrit: अजेयम् एतत् त्रैलोक्ये चक्रं कृष्णेन धार्यते । ततस् त्र्यक्षवचः श्रुत्वा देवी लम्बाम् अथाब्रवीत् । ततो योगं समाधाय अदृश्या हिमवत्सुता । कृष्णस्यैकस्य तद् रूपं दर्शयन्त्य् आगतान्तिकम् । चक्रोद्यतकरं दृष्ट्वा भगवन्तं रणाजिरे । प्रमुखे वासुदेवस्य दिग्वासाः कोटवी स्थिता ॥ तां दृष्ट्वाथ पुनः प्राप्तां देवीं रुद्रस्य संगताम् । लम्बाद्वितीयां तिष्ठन्तीं कृष्णो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । हन्मि बाणं न संशयः । महाभागं महादेवम् अनन्तं नीलम् अव्ययम् । पद्मनाभं हृषीकेश लोकानाम् आदिसंभवम् । देवदेव जगन्नाथ विष्णो जिष्णो जगत्पते । नार्हसे देव हन्तुं वै बाणम् अप्रतिमं रणे ॥
units.english: Thereupon release Vāna before Keshava discharges this discus. Hearing the words of the three-eyed deity the goddess said to Lamvā:— Lamva, go soon and protect Vāna. Saying this Himalaya's daughter disappeared from view by her yoga powers; and going only to Krishna she showed her true form. On the other side seeing the Lord stand in the battle-field with uplifted discus Lamvā disappeared from view and left off her clothes. In order to protect Vāna, the goddess Kottavi, appeared naked before Vasudeva. Seeing her again return and appear before him with Rudra's consent Krishna said:— you of red eyes, you have again come naked to the battle-field for saving Vāna. Forsooth will kill Vāna. Thus addressed by Krishna Lamvā said:– god, know the great Purusottama, eternal, undecaying and lotus-navelled Hrishikesha, the creator of the world as the prime cause of the universe. Keshava, thou shouldst not slay Vāna who has no match in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: प्रयच्छ ह्य् अभयं बाणे जीवपुत्रीत्वम् एव च ॥
units.english: Do thou promise Vāna protection and let me see my son alive.

units.sanskrit: न मे मिथ्या समुद्योगं कर्तुम् अर्हसि माधव ॥
units.english: Mādhava, conferred on him a boon saying that would protect him. Thou shouldst not falsify my words.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ते तु वचने कृष्णः परपुरंजयः । क्रुद्धः प्रभाषते वाक्यं शृणु सत्यं तु भामिनी ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by the goddess, Krishna, the creator of enemy's cities, in anger said:—Hear the truth, lady.

units.sanskrit: बाणो बाहुसहस्रेण नर्दते दर्पम् आश्रितः । द्विबाहुना च बाणेन जीवपुत्री भविष्यसि । संत्यज्य चासुरं दर्पं न च मां संश्रयिष्यति ॥ एवम् उक्ते तु वचने कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । प्रोवाच देवी बाणो ऽयं देवदेवो भवेद् इति ॥
units.english: will forsooth cut off to-day his thousand arms, elated with the pride of which Vāna is roaring in the battle-field. Your son will live even if Vāna has two arms -. And resorting to his demonaic pride he will not approach me any more. Thus addressed by Krishna of unwearied actions the goddess said:— god of gods, let Vāna be so.

units.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहुः कृष्णः प्रहरतां वरः । प्रोवाच बाणं समरे भ्रामयंश् चक्रम् उत्तमम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon the highly powerful and large-armed Krishna, the foremost of speakers and strikers, welcoming Kārtikeya's mother, said to Vāna in anger:—Fie on your manliness, Vāna.

units.sanskrit: युध्यतां युध्यतां संख्ये भवतां कोटवी स्थिता । अशक्तानाम् इव रणे धिग्बाण तव पौरुषम् ॥
units.english: Whenever you have been engaging in an encounter with me Kottavi, considering you weak, is coming and standing in the battle-field.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ततः कृष्णस् तच् चक्रं परमास्त्रवित् । निमीलिताक्षो व्यसृजद् बाणं प्रति महाबलः ॥ क्षेपणाद् यस्य मुह्यन्ति लोकाः सस्थाणुजङ्गमाः । क्रव्यादानि च भूतानि तृप्तिं यान्ति महामृधे ॥
units.english: Saying this the self-controlled and highly powerful Krishna opened his eyes and discharged his discus aiming it at Vāna. With great force Gadādhara, worked up with ire, took up that wonderful discus, effulgent like the sun, at the discharge of which, all the worlds, mobile and immobile, become unconscious and flesh-eating creatures find great pleasure, discharged it and cut off Vāna's arms.

units.sanskrit: चिच्छेद बाहूंश् चक्रेण श्रीधरः परमौजसा । अलातचक्रवत् तूर्णं भ्रममाणं रणाजिरे । क्षिप्तं तु वासुदेवेन बाणस्य रणमूर्धनि । बाणस्य रथमार्गे च द्वितीय इव भास्करः । वैशंपायन उवाच कृतकृते तु संप्राप्ते चक्रे दैत्ये विपातिते । शरीरेण प्रस्रवता रुधिरौघपरिप्लुतः । अभवत् पर्वताकारश् छिन्नबाहुर् महासुरः ॥
units.english: When discharged by Shridhara, parmeating the universe, that firmament-like discus so moved about in the battle-field that no body could see its true form. Gradually cutting off Vāna's thousand arms and making him the owner of only two the Sudarshana discus returned into Krishna's hands -. Vaishampāyana said:—When the Daitya-killing discus returned successful into Krishna’s hands the huge-bodied great Asura Vāna, bathed in streaming blood, who had his thousand arms chopped off, was maddened with the smell of blood and repeatedly roared like a muttering cloud.

units.sanskrit: व्याविध्य सहसा कृष्णः शिरश् छेत्तुं समारभत् । तम् उपेत्य महादेवः कुमारसहितो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ सहोमया हरो देवो ज्वरेण च समन्वितः । कृष्ण कृष्ण महादेव जाने त्वां पुरुषोत्तमम् । लोकानां त्वं गतिर् देव त्वत्प्रसूतम् इदं जगत् । अजेयस् त्वं त्रिभिर् लोकैः सदेवासुरमानुषैः ॥
units.english: Hearing his leonine shout Krishna, the slayer of his enemies, was about to hurl his discus again for killing him. Thereat approaching him with Kumāra Mahadeva said:— Krishna, thou of large arms, know thee as the eternal God Purusottama, the destroyer of Madhu and Kaitabha. Thou art the refuge of the world and the universe has emanated from thee. Thou art unconquerable unto the entire world consisting of gods, Asuras and Pannagas.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् संहर दिव्यं त्वम् इदं चक्रं समुद्यतम् । अनिवार्यम् असंहार्यं रणे शत्रुभयंकरम् ॥
units.english: Therefore do thou withdraw thy uplifted, irrepressible, celestial discus terrible unto the enemies.

units.sanskrit: बाणस्यास्याभयं दत्तं मया केशिनिषूदन । मान्यस् त्वं देव देवानाम् असुराणां च सर्वशः ॥ अन्यथा छेदनं कुर्यां बाणस्यास्य दुरात्मनः । नमस् ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत् कार्यं तन् महेश्वर । न तावत् क्रियते तस्मान् माम् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: slayer of Keshi, have promised Vāna protection and therefore do request thee to desist -. Krishna said:— god, salutation unto thee who art adorable unto the gods and Asuras. withdraw my discus. At thy request Vāna will live. Maheshawara, at thy request do not accomplish Vāna's destruction for which had come here. Permit me now to return -.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवं कृष्णस् तूर्णं गरुत्मता । गते कृष्णे ततो नन्दी बाणम् आह शुभं वचः । गच्छ बाण क्षतेनैव देवदेवस्य चाग्रतः ॥
units.english: Saying this to Mahadeva Krishna went where Aniruddha was waiting bound with arrows. After Krishna's departure Nāndi spoke to Vāna the following well-meaning words: Vāna, with these wounds appear before the god of gods.

units.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा नन्दिवाक्यं तु बाणो ऽगच्छत शीघ्रगः । छिन्नबाहुं ततो बाणं दृष्ट्वा नन्दी प्रतापवान् । अपवाह्य रथेनैव यतो देवस् ततो ययौ ॥
units.english: Hearing the words of Nandi, Vāna too felt a desire of going away speedily. Beholding Vāna divested of his arms the powerful Nandi took him on his car to the rider of a bull Shiva.

units.sanskrit: ततो नन्दी पुनर् बाणं प्राग् उवाचोत्तरं वचः । बाण बाण प्रनृत्यस्व श्रेयस् तव भविष्यति ॥
units.english: He again spoke these well-meaning words to Vāna:— Vāna, the god of gods is propitiated with you. Dance before him and you will meet with your well-being.

units.sanskrit: शोणितौघप्लुतैर् गात्रैर् नन्दिवाक्यप्रचोदितः । जीवितार्थी ततो बाणः प्रमुखे शंकरस्य वै ॥
units.english: Urged on by Nandi's words, the bewildered, terror-stricken Dānava Vāna, desirous of living, began to dance with his body, bathed in blood before Shankara.

units.sanskrit: नन्दिवाक्यप्रजवितं भक्तानुग्रहकृद् भवः । करुणावशम् आपन्नो महादेवो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । प्रसादसुमुखो ऽहं ते वरकालो ऽयम् आगतः ॥
units.english: Beholding Vāna, stricken with fear, dance again at Nandi's words, Mahādeva, ever kind unto his votaries, stricken with compassion, said:—-. am pleased with you. The time has come when you may pray for a boon.

units.sanskrit: वरान् मनसि संधार्य प्रवक्तुम् उपचक्रमे । बाण उवाच अजरश् चामरश् चैव भवेयं सततं विभो । एष मे प्रथमो देव वरो ऽस्तु यदि मन्यसे ॥
units.english: Therefore pray for one you are cherishing at heart. Vāna said:– Lord, God, if thou art desirous of giving me a boon grant me one by which may become immortal and freed from fever.

units.sanskrit: तुल्यो ऽसि दैवतैर् बाण न मृत्युस् तव विद्यते । अन्यं वरं वृणीष्वाद्य अनुग्राह्यो ऽसि मे सदा ॥
units.english: You will not meet with death. Furthermore, am always kind to you. Pray for another boon.

units.sanskrit: बाण उवाच यथाहं शोणितादिग्धो भृशार्तो व्रणपीडितः । भक्तानां नृत्यताम् एवं पुत्रजन्म भेवेद् भव ॥
units.english: Vāna said:— Bhava, may those thy votaries, who will dance as am doing covered with blood and inflicted with wounds, have sons.

units.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच निराहाराः क्षमायुक्ताः सत्यार्जवपरायणाः । मद्भक्ता ये हि नृत्यन्ति तेषाम् एवं भविष्यति ॥
units.english: The Lord said:—Those of my votaries, who abstaining from food and being patient, truthful and honest will thus dance, will have sons.

units.sanskrit: तृतीयं त्वम् अथो बाण वरं वर मनोगतम् ।
units.english: my son Vāna, may your desire become fruitful. Pray for a third boon.

units.sanskrit: वरेण सा तृतीयेन शान्तिं गच्छतु मे भव ॥ महेश्वर उवाच एवं भवतु भद्रं ते न रुजा प्रभविष्यति । न भविष्यति गात्रेषु बलवांश् च भविष्यसि । न ते ऽहं विमुखस् तात प्रसादसुमुखो ह्य् अहम् ॥ बाण उवाच प्रमाथगणवंशस्य प्रथमः स्याम् अहं विभो । महाकाल इति ख्यातः ख्यातिं गच्छेयम् ईश्वर ॥
units.english: Vāna said:— Bhava, may my body, inflicted with wounds by the discus, find relief by thy third boon. Rudra said:—So it will be and your body will be freed from pain. It will be healthy and unscathed as before. am never unkind to you, specially have been greatly pleased with you. If you wish you may pray for the fourth boon. Vāna said:— lord, may be the first of the families of Pramathas and be renowned forever under the name of Mahākāla –.

units.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं भविष्यतीत्य् आह देवो बाणं महाद्युतिः । दिव्यरूपो ऽक्षतो गात्रैर् नीरुजस् त्वं ममाश्रयात् ॥
units.english: Vaishampāyana said:—Saying So be it, the highly effulgent Lord Shankara again said:—By being under my protection you will have a celestial form, be of unscathed body and freed from diseases.

units.sanskrit: ममातिसर्गाद् बाण त्वं भव चैवाकुतोब्यहः । भूयो ऽपि ते वरं दद्मि प्रख्यातबलपौरुष । बाण उवाच वैरूप्यम् अङ्गजं किं चिन् मा भून् मे देवसत्तम । द्विबाहुत्वे ऽपि मे देहो न विरूपो भवेद् भव ॥
units.english: By living always near me you will have no fear. give you this fifth boon that you will be well-known by your strength and manliness. Vāna, if you have any other desire in your mind pray for another boon. Vāna said:— lord, by thy favour my body may not be disfigured. may not be ugly even if have two arms.

units.sanskrit: हर उवाच भविता सर्वम् एतत् ते यथेच्छसि महासुर । भक्तस् त्वं मे न चादेयं भक्तानां विद्यते मम । ततो ऽब्रवीन् महादेवो बाणं स्थितम् अथान्तिके । एवं भविष्यते बाण यत् त्वया समुदाहृतम् ॥
units.english: Hara said:— great Asura, have nothing which can not give away to my votaries. Besides you are my greatest votary. What you have wished will be accomplished. Thereupon Mahadeva again said to Vāna who stood by him:— Vāna, what you have said, will be so.

units.sanskrit: पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां तत्रैवान्तर् अधीयत ॥
units.english: Saying it the Lord, encircled by ghosts, disappeared before all creatures -.

units.sanskrit: जगाम सह रुद्रेण महाकालत्वम् आगतः । वासुदेवो ऽपि बहुधा नारदं पर्यपृच्छत । क्वानिरुद्धस् तु भगवान् संयतो नागबन्धनैः । अनिरुद्धे हृते वीरे क्षुभिता द्वारका पुरी । शीघ्रं तं मोक्षयिष्यामि यद् अर्थं वयम् आगताः ॥
units.english: And having attained to the dignity of Mahākala he went with Rudra. Vāsudeva too, on the other hand, repeatedly asked Nārada, saying:— reverend sir, my mind is overpowered with affection. wish to know truly where Aniruddha is waiting bound with the noose of serpents. The heroic Aniruddha being taken away stealthily the city of Dwārakā is filled with anxiety. will therefore soon release him for whom have come here.

units.sanskrit: अद्य तं नष्टशत्रुं वै द्रष्टुम् इच्छामहे वयम् । स प्रदेशस् तु भगवन् विदितस् तव सुव्रत ॥
units.english: sir, wish to see even to-day Aniruddha who has his enemies slain. Tell me if you know the place.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तस् तु कृष्णेन नारदः प्रत्यभाषत । कन्यापुरे कुमारो ऽसौ बद्धो नागैश् च माधव ॥
units.english: Thus addressed by Krishna Nārada replied: -. Mādhava, the prince Aniruddha is waiting, bound with serpents, in the female appartment.

units.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे शीघ्रं चित्रलेखा ह्य् उपस्थिता । बाणस्योत्तमसत्त्वस्य दैत्येन्द्रस्य महात्मनः । इदम् अन्तःपुरं देव प्रविशस्व यथासुखम् ॥ ततः प्रविष्टास् ते सर्वे अनिरुद्धस्य मोक्षणे । बलः सुपर्णः कृष्णश् च प्रद्युम्नो नारदस् तथा । शररूपा महासर्पा वेष्टयित्वा तनुं स्थिताः ॥
units.english: In the meantime quickly coming there Chitralekhā said:— lord, this is the female appartment of the high-souled and energetic king of Daityas Vāna. Do thou enter here at ease. Thereupon Baladeva, Krishna, Pradyumna, Narada and Suparna entered into the female appartment for releasing Aniruddha. Seeing Garuda, all the huge serpents, which stuck to Aniruddha's person in the shape of arrows, at once left him. Coming out of his body those serpents dropped on the ground as arrows.

units.sanskrit: दृष्टः स्पृष्टश् च कृष्णेन सो ऽनिरुद्धो महात्मना । स्थितिः प्रीतिमना भूत्वा प्राञ्जलिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥ देवदेव सदा युधे जेता त्वम् असि कस् तव । शक्तो वै प्रमुखे स्थातुं साक्षाद् अपि शतक्रतुः ॥
units.english: Afterwards observed and addressed by Krishna the highly illustrious Aniruddha, delighted and with folded hands, said -:— god of gods, Keshava, thou art always victorious over thy enemies: even the performer of hundred sacrifices cannot stand before thee. Thereupon with a delighted mind the noble-minded Aniruddha saluted the highly powerful and illustrious Balabhadra.

units.sanskrit: आरोह गरुडं तूर्णं गच्छाम द्वारकां पुरीम् । इत्युक्तः सो ऽधिरूढस् तु सह दानवकन्यया ॥ गुरुभिः समनुज्ञातास् ततस् ते प्रययुस् तदा । चित्रलेखासमायुक्तो या प्रिया तस्य नित्यशः । ततस् ते दीर्घम् अध्वानं प्रययुः पुरुषर्षभाः । चक्रायुधो गृह्य तदानिरुद्धं । निघ्नं चक्रे बाणम् उदीर्णचक्रम् । छित्त्वा तु बाणस्य स बाहुचक्रं । चक्रायुधो गृह्य तदानिरुद्धम् । पुरो महाबाणम् उदीर्णचक्र+ । आरुह्य गरुडं सर्वे जित्वा बाणं महासुरम् ॥
units.english: Afterwards with folded hands he bowed unto the great Garuda. Ushā too, encircled by her friends, saluted the highly powerful and irrepressible Vāshudeva and Suparna of unimpeded course. And with bashfulness she also bowed unto the holder of the flowery bow -. And having showered blessings on him he said:— Govinda, by good luck thou hast been united with Pradyumna, Thereupon all the Yadavas with Aniruddha saluted the celestial saint Nārada. Having honored them all in return he said to Krishna:— Lord, celebrate a marriage acquired by prowess for Aniruddha. have a great desire to see exchange of jokes between the parties of bridegroom and bride. Hearing the words of Nārada all laughed and Krishna said:— revered Sir, it will soon be accomplished.

units.sanskrit:
ततो ऽम्बरतलस्थास् ते वारुणीं दिशम् आश्रिताः । अपश्यन्त महात्मानो गावो दिव्यपयःप्रदाः । वेलावनविचारिण्यो नानावर्णाः सहस्रशः ॥ अभिज्ञाय तदा रूपं कुम्भाण्डवचनश्रवात् । कृष्णः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठस् तत्त्वतो ऽर्थविशारदः । निशम्य बाणगावस् तु तासु चक्रे मनस् तदा ।
आस्थितो गरुडं देवः सर्वलोकादिर् अव्ययः ॥
गरुड प्रयाहि तत्र त्वं यत्र बाणस्य गोधनम् ।
यासां पीत्वा किल क्षीरम् अमृतत्वम् अवाप्नुयात् । आह मां सत्यभामा च बाणगावो ममानय ।
यासां पीत्वा किल क्षीरं न जीर्यन्ति महासुराः ॥
ता ममानय भद्रं ते यदि कार्यं न लुप्यते ।
अथ कार्यनिरोधः स्यान् नैव तासु मनः कृथाः ॥
दृश्यन्ते गाव एतास् ता मां दृष्ट्वा वरुणालयम् ।
विशन्ति सहिताः सर्वाः कार्यम् अत्र विधीयताम् ॥ तथेत्य् उक्त्वा तु गरुडः पक्षवातेन सागरम् ।
सो ऽवगाढो हि सहसा वरुणालयम् अन्तिकात् ॥ दृष्ट्वा जवेन गरुडं प्राप्तं वै वरुणालयम् । वारुणाश् च गणाः सर्वे विभ्रान्ताः प्राचलंस् तदा ।
ततस् तु वारुणं सैन्यम् अभियातं सुदारुणम् ।
प्रमुखे वासुदेवस्य नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् ॥ तद् युद्धम् अभवद् घोरं वारुणैः पन्नगारिणा ।
तेषाम् आपततां संख्ये वारुणानां सहस्रशः ।
देहा विद्योतयन्ति स्म कृत्स्नं वै वरुणालयम् ।
ते भग्नाः सहसा यान्ति तम् एव वरुणालयम् ॥
units.english: In the meantime Kumbhānda, with all the articles for the wedding, arrived before Krishna and saluted him. Kumbhānva said:— Krishna, thou of large arms, do thou promise me safety. With folded hands seek refuge with thee. Krishna, at Nārada's request, had already stopped his going. Now seeing the high-souled Kumbhānda before and promising him protection he said:— Kumbhānda, have been pleased with hearing of your good deeds. You will now become the king of this kingdom. confer this kingdom on you. The Divine Regent of fire was present there in person –. The Gandharvas sang melodious and auspicious songs and the Apsaras danced thus beautifying that marriage party. Beholding Krishna, the destroyer of his enemies, about to start for Dwārakā Kumbhānda, with folded hands, said:—Hear, lotus-eyed slayer of Madhu, have something to communicate unto thee. They give nectar-like milk, drinking which a man becomes highly powerful and invincible in battle –. And bent on going there he expressed his desire. Indra and Maruts, desirous of achieving victory, set out for Dwārakā where Krishna resides. Proceeding a long way towards Varuna's region by the etherial way they saw those cows yielding celestial milk. Those cows, of various colours, were grazing in a forest situate on the bank of an ocean. Reading the signs described by Kumbhānda they at once recognized them. Beholding those cows of Vāna the eternal Krishna, the prime cause of the universe, well read in the essence of things and the foremost of strikers, felt a desire for possessing them and said to Garuda –. Krishna said:— Garuda, those are the precious kine of Vāna drinking whose milk a man becomes immortal. son of Vinatā, surely these are the kine of which Satyā spoke to me -. Garuda said:—These are the kine no doubt. had seen them before in Varuna's abode. Keshava, seeing me all on a sudden they are entering into Varuna's palace. Therefore thou shouldst do some thing at once for possessing them. Saying this Vinata's son agitated the ocean with the flapping of his wings and entered into Varuna's abode. Thereupon seeing Garuda enter by force into Varuna's residence all his followers were stricken with fear and bewildered.

units.sanskrit: वरुणेन प्रयुक्तानि दीप्तशस्त्राणि संयुगे ॥ तान्य् अयुध्यन्त कृष्णेन प्रद्युम्नेन बलेन च । तानि सर्वाणि सहसा निजघान रणे हरिः । तद् बलं कृष्णबाणौघैर् दह्यमानं समन्ततः । भग्नं वरुणम् आश्रित्य नैव स्थानम् अविन्दत ॥
units.english: Afterwards when Varuna's irrepressible army, with diverse weapons, appeared before Vāsudeva, they had to fight a terrible fight with Garuda the enemy of serpents. Although thousands of Varuna's irrepressible soldiers came to the battle-field they were all routed by the high-souled Keshava. The sixty thousand cars of Varuna with burning weapons, that had come to fight there, all fled away and entered into Varuna's abode. Consumed entirely by Krishna with his arrows they broke down seeing nobody to protect them.

units.sanskrit: तद् बलं बलिभिः शूरैर् बलदेवजनार्दनैः । प्रद्युमेनानिरुद्धेन गरुडेन च सर्वशः । ततो भग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । वरुणस् त्व् अथ संक्रुद्धो निर्ययौ यत्र केशवः । ऋषिभिर् देवगन्धर्वैस् तथैवाप्सरसां गणैः । छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन पाण्डुरेण वपुष्मता । सलिलस्राविणा श्रेष्ठं चापम् उद्यम्य विष्ठितः ॥ अपां पतिर् अभिक्रुद्धः पुत्रपौत्रबलान्वितः । हरिं हर इव क्रोधाद् बाणजालैः समावृणोत् ॥
units.english: That army was completely killed with arrows by powerful and heroic Baladeva, Janārddana, Pradyumna, Aniruddha and Garuda -. Seeing thus his own army routed by Krishna of unwearied actions Varuna was greatly worked up with anger and went where Keshava was. He was seen in the battle-field eulogised by the gods, Rishis, Gandharvas and bands of Apsaras. beautiful yellow-colored umbrella, with water streaming from it, was held over his head. The lord of waters, followed by his sons, grand-sons and soldiers, took up his bow in anger, stringed it and invited Hari for battle. Thereupon blowing his conch-shell the lord of waters, in anger, ran towards Hari like Hara and covered him with arrows.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रध्माय जलजं पाञ्चजन्यं महाबलः । बाणवर्षाकुलाः सर्वा दिशश् चक्रे जनार्दनः ॥
units.english: Then the highly powerful Janārddana blew his conch-shell Pānchajanya and agitated all the quarters with shafts.

units.sanskrit: स्मयन्न् इव तदा कृष्णं वरुणः प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥
units.english: Although assailed with clean shafts in the battle-field Varuna smilingly fought with Krishna -.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेवो ऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं प्रमुखे तस्य संस्थितः ॥ इदम् अस्त्रं महाघोरं वैष्णवं शत्रुमर्दनम् । मयोद्यतं वधार्थं ते तिष्ठेदानीं स्थिरो भव ॥
units.english: Seeing it Janārddana got ready in the battle-field the dreadful Vaishnava weapon and said to the intelligent Varuna who stood before him Wait here for a moment: for killing you this dreadful Vaishnava weapon, destructive of enemies, has been taken up by me.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तद् वरुणो देवो ह्य् अस्त्रं वैष्णवम् उद्यतम् । वारुणास्त्रेण संयोज्य ननाद स महाबलः ॥
units.english: Seeing the Vaishnava weapon upheld the highly powerful Varuna took up his Varuna weapon and sent up a leonine shout.

units.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्रवितता ह्य् आपो वरुणास्याभिनिःसृताः । वैष्णवास्त्रस्य शमने वर्तन्ते समितिंजय ॥
units.english: Victor of armies, when that Varuna weapon was discharged for counteracting Vaishnava weapon from it streamed down profuse water.

units.sanskrit: ततः प्रज्वलिताः सर्वे वारुणाश् चक्रतेजसा । दह्यन्ते वारुणाः सर्वे ततो ऽस्त्रे ज्वलिते पुनः । स्मर तां प्रकृतिं पूर्वाम् अव्यक्तां व्यक्तलक्षणां । तमो जहि महाभाग रजसा मुह्यसे कथम् ॥ सत्त्वस्थो नित्यम् आसीत् त्वं योगीश्वर महामते । पञ्चभूताश्रयान् दोषान् अहंकारं च संत्यज ॥
units.english: However with the energy of Vaishnava weapon that water was ablaze. Thus when Varuna weapon was burnt down and Vaishnava weapon grew ablaze again all, filled with fear, fled away on all sides. Seeing it ablaze Varuna said to Krishna –:— great one, remember the manifest Prakriti which was unmanifest before, Lord of yoga, thou art always pervaded by Sattwa goodness still why are you possessed by the disorganising tendency? Cast off Tama disorganising tendency god, throw off your egoism and other weaknesses begotten by the five elements.

units.sanskrit: येयं ते वैष्णवी मूर्तिस् तस्या ज्येष्ठो ह्य् अहं तव । ज्येष्ठभावेन मान्यस् ते किं मां दग्धुम् इच्छसि ॥ नाग्निर् विक्रमते ह्य् अग्नौ त्यज कोपं युधां वर । त्वयि न प्रभविष्यन्ति जगतः प्रभवो ह्य् असि ॥
units.english: am the eldest of thy Vaishnava form. Though deserve thy respect, being the elder brother, still why dost thou wish to consume me? foremost of warriors, fire does not display its power towards another fire. Therefore do thou relinquish your anger directed towards me. Thou art the primary cause of the universe and there is none who can lord over thee.

units.sanskrit: पूर्वं हि या त्वया सृष्टा प्रकृतिर् विकृतात्मिका । धर्मिणी बीजभावेन पूर्वधर्मसमाश्रिता ॥
units.english: Prakriti, capable of manifestating herself, was formerly created by thee. That Prakriti, subject to an end, resorted to thy energy on account of thine, being the origin of the universe.

units.sanskrit: आग्नेयं चैव सौम्यं च प्रकृत्यैवेदम् आदितः । त्वया सृष्टं जगद् इदं स कथं मन्यसे मयि ॥ अजेयः शाश्वतो नित्यं स्वयंभूर् भूतभावनः । रक्ष मां रक्षणीयो ऽहं त्वयानघ नमो ऽस्तु ते । आदिकर्तासि लोकस्य त्वयैव बहुलीकृतम् ॥
units.english: Through Prakriti thou didst create this universe identical with Vishnu, Agni, and Soma; and why dost thou then attack it now? Salutation unto thee who art the origin of elements, self-born, eternal, undecaying and identical with all, manifested and unmanifested. Do thou protect me, thou of great effulgence, who am worthy of being protected. Thou art the prime cause of the universe. Through thee the creation has multiplied itself.

units.sanskrit: किं क्रीडसि महादेव बालः क्रीडनकैर् इव । न ह्य् अहं प्रकृतिद्वेषी नाहं प्रकृतिदूषकः ॥ प्रकृतिर् या विकारेषु वर्तते पुरुषोत्तम । विकारो ऽसि विकाराणां विकारायतने ऽनघ । तान् अधर्मविदो मन्दान् भवान् विकुरुते सदा ॥ इयं हि प्रकृतिर् दोषैस् तमसा युज्यते सदा । रजसा वापि संदुष्टा ततो मोहः प्रवर्तते ॥
units.english: As the boy plays with his toys so thou dost play with thy creations. am not against Prakriti nor do contaminate it. Thou dost put an end to the changes of Nature when she is subject to them. That, which creates change even in changes, cannot create any change in thee. Thou dost create changes in the impious and wicked. When the world is pervaded by the sinful tendencies, begotten by Nature, namely, the qualities of Raja self-concentration and Tama disorganization then stupefication possesses her.

units.sanskrit: परावरज्ञः सर्वज्ञ ऐश्वर्यविधिम् आस्थितः । किं मोहयसि नः सर्वान् प्रजापतिर् इव स्वयम् ॥ वरुणेनैवम् उक्तस् तु कृष्णो लोकपरायणः । इत्येवमुक्तः प्रहसन् कृष्णो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । वरुणो ह्य् अब्रवीद् बूयः शृणु मे मधुसूदन । वरुण उवाच कथं च समयं कृत्वा कुर्यां विफलम् अन्यथा ॥ त्वम् एव देव सर्वस्य यथा समयभेदकः । चारित्रं दुष्यते तात न च सद्भिः प्रशस्यते ॥
units.english: lord, thou art the fountain of supreme knowledge, omniscient and the creator: why dost thou stupify me? – Thus addressed by Varuna, Krishna, the omniscient hero, the creator of the world, was filled with joy. Thus spoken to Krishna smilingly said:— hero of dreadful prowess, do give me these kine for pacifying me. Thus addressed by Krishna, Varuna, clever in speaking, again said:—Hear, slayer of Madhu –. lord, had made a contract with Vāna. How can break it now? Keshava, thou canst make every one break his promise. But Sire, if a person's character is lost he becomes an object of censure unto the pious.

units.sanskrit: धर्मभाग् ईश्वरो नित्यं वर्जते मधुसूदन । न च लोकान् अवाप्नोति पापः समयभेदकः ॥
units.english: slayer of Madhu, only the pious always deserve respect from all. But the sinful breaker of his promise does not attain to any blissful region.

units.sanskrit: प्रसीद धर्मलोपश् च मा भून् मे मधुसूदन । न मां समयभेदेन योक्तुम् अर्हसि माधव । जीवन् नाहं प्रदास्यामि गावो वै वृषभेक्षण । हत्वा मां नय गावस् त्वम् एष मे समयः कृतः ॥
units.english: Be thou propitiated therefore, slayer of Madhu and do that by which my virtue may not be lost. Mādhava, it does not behove thee to engage me in a work which will lead to a breach of promise. thou having eyes like those of a bull, had formerly promised, that if alive would never give away these kine. If thou dost wish to possess these kine kill me and take them away.

units.sanskrit: एतच् च मे समाख्यातं समयं मधुसूदन । सत्यम् एव महाबाहो न मिथ्या तु सुरेश्वर ॥
units.english: thou of large arms, king of the celestials, slayer of Madhu, have thus described unto thee my promise. Not a single portion of it is false. Every bit of it is true.

units.sanskrit: यद्य् एवाहम् अनुग्राह्यो रक्ष मां मधुसूदन । एष ते बाणविषयः प्रोक्तस् ते जनमेजय । वरुणेनैवम् उक्तस् तु मुक्त्वा गा वै महायशाः । एवम् उक्तो ऽथ बाणस्य गावो मुक्त्वा महायशाः । मानयन् वरुणं देवो गा बाणस्य व्यमुञ्चत । तस्मान् मुक्तो ऽसि यद्य् एवं बाणेन समयः कृतः । प्रसृतैर् मधुरैर् वाक्यैस् तत्त्वार्थम् अनुभाषितैः ॥
units.english: Mādhava, if thou hast any pity for me, save me. If, thou of large arms, dost thou wish to take these kine away, kill me and take them. Vaishampāyana said:—Thus addressed by Varuna Krishna, the multiplier of the Yadu race thought, that what Varuna had said about the kine could not be gainsaid and was accordingly silenced. Thereupon Keshava, who could understand all, smilingly said to Varuna:— Lord Varuna, on account of your contract with Vāna you are saved. Specially you have expressed the truth in sweet and charming words.

units.sanskrit: कथं पापं करिष्यामि वरुण त्वय्य् अहं प्रभो । गच्छ मुक्तो ऽसि वरुण सत्यसंधो ऽस्तु नो भवान् । त्वत्प्रियार्थं मया मुक्ता बाणगावो न संशयः ॥
units.english: How can then perform an iniquity by you? lord of water, you are truthful and therefore for pleasing you let loose Vāna's cows. And you too are released. There is no doubt about it. Depart now.

units.sanskrit: अर्घम् आदाय वरुणः केशवं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥ केशवो ऽर्धं तदा गृह्य वरुणाद्यदुनन्दनः । इत्य् उक्त्वा वरुणं देवो गा बाणस्य विमुञ्चत । प्रययौ द्वारकां चापि शक्राद्यैर् अमरैर् वृतः ॥
units.english: Thereupon sounding bugles Varuna adored Keshava with Arghya. After the Yadu chief Keshava had accepted it from Varuna, the lord of waters, adored Baladeva with a controlled mind. Giving protection unto Varuna, Shouri, the heroic descendant of Shura, with Sachi’s lord set out for Dwārakā.

units.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः समरुतः ससाध्याः समितिंजय । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश् चैव किंनराश् चान्तरिक्षगाः । आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च महाबलौ । विद्याधरगणाश् चैव ये चान्ये सिद्धचारणाः । नारदश् च महाभागः प्रस्थितो द्वारकां प्रति । तुष्टो बाणजयं दृष्ट्वा वरुणं च कृतप्रियम् ॥
units.english: The Devas, Maruts, Sāddhyas, Siddhas, Chāranas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, Kinnaras followed Krishna, the eternal lord of all creatures in the etherial way, –. When Keshava, on acquiring victory and fame, proceeded the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Ashwinis, Yakshas, Rākshasas, Siddhas, Chāranas, and Vidyadharas followed him. Pleased at seeing Vāna and Varuna defeated the great and ever quarrelsome Nārada, set out for Dwārakā.

units.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरप्रख्यैर् नीलग्रीवधरैश् च तैः । दुराद् एव तु तां दृष्ट्वा द्वारकां द्वारमालिनीम् । पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं चक्रे चक्रगदाधरः ॥
units.english: Thus proceeding Keshava, the holder of discus and club, saw from a distance the city of Dwarakā having many doors and adorned with blue-turreted, beautiful palaces resembling the summits of the mount Kailāsha and blew his conch-shell Pānchajanya.

units.sanskrit: संज्ञां प्रयच्छते देवो द्वारकापुरवासिनाम् । तेनाध्मातो महाशङ्खः पूरयाम् आस रोदसी । देवानुयात्रनिर्घोषं पाञ्चजन्यस्य निस्वनम् । श्रुत्वा द्वारवती सर्वा प्रहर्षम् अतुलं गता ॥
units.english: As the blare of Pānchajanya used to indicate Keshava's arrival and departure he, with it, communicated the news of his approach to the citizens of Dwārakā. Hearing the sound of Pānchajanya the inhabitants of Dwaraka adorned their respective habitations with profuse flowers, jars full of water and fried paddy.

units.sanskrit: विप्राश् चार्घं समादाय तथैव कुलनैगमाः । जयशब्दैश् च विविधैः पूजयन्ति स्म माधवम् । अवन्दन्यादवाः कृष्णं श्रिया परमया युतम् ॥
units.english: The streets of that prosperous city, abounding in many jems, were cleansed; the Brāhmanas and the elderly persons with arghya and exclaiming his many victories adored Mādhava. People bowed unto Krishna, highly beautiful and resembling a mass of collyrium who sat on Vinatā's son.

units.sanskrit: अनन्तं केशिहन्तारं श्रेष्ठिपूर्वाश् च श्रेणयः । ऋषिभिर् देवगन्धर्वैश् चारणैश् च समन्ततः । संस्तूयमानो गोविन्दो द्वारकोपरि विष्ठितः ॥
units.english: The Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Sudras in order adored the highly powerful Ananta, the slayer of Keshi. Waiting in a garden of Dwārakā, the lotus-eyed Mādhava was eulogised by the Rishis, gods, Gandharvas and Chāranas.

units.sanskrit: तदाश्चर्यम् अपश्यन्त दाशार्हगणसत्तमाः । प्रहर्षम् अतुलं प्राप्ता दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं महाभुजम् । बाणं जित्वा महादेवम् आयान्तं पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ द्वारकावासिनां वाचश् चरन्ति बहुधा तदा । प्राप्ते कृष्णे महाभागे सात्वतानां महारथे ॥ गत्वा च दूरम् अध्वानं सुपर्णो द्रुतम् आगतः । धन्याः स्मो ऽनुगृहीताः स्मो येषां नो जगतः पतिः । वैनतेयं समारुह्य बाणं जित्वा सुदुर्जयम् । प्राप्तो ऽयं पुण्डरीकाक्षो मनांस्य् आह्लादयन्न् इव ॥
