units.english: Seeing those wonders and the large-armed Krishna the great Dāshārhas attained to an excess of joy. Beholding the great Purusottama return after defeating Vāna, the inhabitants of Dwārakā began to talk on diverse topics. After the great Krishna, the greatest car-warrior amongst the Yadavas, had returned from that long distance whither he had gone through the help of Suparna they conversed amongst themselves. Blessed and favoured are we since the kind lord of the universe, the long and mighty-armed Krishna is our protector. Riding on Vinatā's son the lotus-eyed deity defeated the irrepressible Vāna: and now returning to Dwārakā he has gladdened our hearts.

units.sanskrit: एवं कथयताम् एव द्वारकावासिनां तदा । वासुदेवगृहं देवा विविशुस् ते महारथाः ॥
units.english: While the inhabitants of Dwārakā thus conversed, the gods, the car-warriors, entered into Vasudeva’s palace.

units.sanskrit: अवतीर्य सुपर्णात् तु वासुदेवो बलस् तदा । प्रद्युम्नश् चानिरुद्धश् च गृहान् प्रविविशुस् तदा । स्थितान्य् एव प्रदृश्यन्ते नानारूपाणि सर्वशः ॥ सिंहर्षभमृगैर् नागैर् वाजिसारसबर्हिणैः । भास्वन्ति तानि दृश्यन्ते विमानानि सहस्रशः ॥
units.english: Then coming down from Garuda's back Vāsudeva, Bahadeva, Pradyumna and Aniruddha entered into the palace. Celestial cars of various forms were then seen moving about in the sky. Drawn by swans, bulls, deer, elephants, horses, Sarasas and peacocks, those thousands of cars displayed a great beauty there -.

units.sanskrit: एते रुद्रास् तथादित्या वसवो ऽथाश्विनाव् अपि । साध्या देवास् तथान्ये चाप्य् अवन्दंस् तान् यथाक्रमम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon in sweet words Krishna addressed Pradyumna and other princes:—Salute them in due order—those Rudras, Adityas who have come here.

units.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षं महाभागं दानवानां भयंकरम् । सप्तर्षयो महाभागा मत्प्रियार्थम् इहागताः । ऋषयश् च महात्मानो वन्दध्वं च यथासुखम् ॥
units.english: Do you all salute the thousand-eyed Nāga who has come here with his followers and dreadful Dānavas. The seven great Rishis, other saints, and those holders of discuses have all come here for pleasing me—do ye adore them all.

units.sanskrit: सागराश् च ह्रदाश् चैव मत्प्रियार्थम् इहागताः । वासुकिप्रमुखाश् चैव नागा वै सुमहाबलाः । गावश् च मत्प्रियार्थं वै वन्दध्वं च यथाक्रमम् ॥
units.english: The oceans and other quarters have come here for satisfying me. Do you adore them in due order. The great Nāgas headed by Vāsuki and cows have come here for pleasing me: do you adore them in due order.

units.sanskrit: ज्योतींषि सह नक्षत्रैर् यक्षराक्षसकिंनरैः । वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा कुमाराः प्रणताः स्थिताः । सर्वान् दिवौकसो दृष्ट्वा पौरा विस्मयम् आगताः । पूजार्थम् अथ संभारान् प्रगृह्य द्रुतम् आगताः । अहो वै महद् आश्चर्यं वासुदेवस्य संश्रयात् । ततश् चन्दनचूर्णैश् च पुष्पवर्षैश् च सर्वशः । लाजैः प्रणामैर् धूपैश् च वाग्बुद्धिनियतास् तथा । द्वारकावासिनः सर्वे पूजयन्ति दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: The Yakshas, Rākshasas, Kinnaras, stars and other luminous bodies have come here for pleasing me: do you adore them in due order. Hearing the words of Vasudeva the princes, in due order, saluted the high-souled gods and stood before them. Beholding the celestials the citizens, filled with surprise, soon collected articles for Puja and said:—Oh under the protection of Vasudeva, we have, even here, witnessed this great wonder. Afterwards showering flowers, scents and powdered sandal they adored the gods. Controlling their senses and intellectual faculties the other inhabitants of Dwārakā worshipped the gods with fried paddy, incense and prostration.

units.sanskrit: आहुकं वसुदेवं च साम्बं च यदुनन्दनम् । सात्यकिं चोल्मुकं चैव विपृथुं च महाबलम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon Vāsava embraced Ahuka, Vasudeva, Shamva, Satyaki, Nishatha, Ulmukha, the highly powerful Viprithu and the great Akrura and smelt their heads.

units.sanskrit: अथ शक्रो महाभागः समक्षं यदुमण्डले । स्तुवन्तं केशिहन्तारं तत्रोवाचोत्तरं वचः । अन्धकं च शुभाक्षं च ततो वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥ वासवः सात्वतान् सर्वान् एष वो यदुनन्दनः । योजयित्वा रणे चैव यशसा पौरुषेण च ॥
units.english: Afterwards aiming at the slayer of Keshi, worthy of being eulogised, the great Shakra, in the midst of the Yādavas, gave vent to the following most excellent words:—This foremost of Sātwatas and Yadus has displayed his glory and manliness in the battle field whilst releasing Aniruddha.

units.sanskrit: महादेवस्य मिषतो गुहस्य च तथैव च । एष बाणं रणे जित्वा द्वारकां पुनर् आगताः ॥
units.english: Having vanquished Vāna in the battle-field before Mahadeva and Guha he has returned to Dwarakā.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रबाहोर् बाहूनां कृत्वा क्षयम् अनुत्तमम् । स्थापयित्वा द्विबाहुत्वे प्राप्तो ऽयं स्वपुरीं हरिः ॥
units.english: His thousands arms were reduced by him into two -. Having left him only with two arms Hari has returned to his own city.

units.sanskrit: यदर्थं जन्म कृष्णस्य मानुषेषु महात्मनः । तद् अप्य् अवसितं कृत्स्नं नष्टशोका वयं कृताः ॥
units.english: All the works, for which the high-souled Krishna has been born in the land of men, have been accomplished and we too have been divested of sorrow.

units.sanskrit: पिबन्तो मधुमाध्वीकं रंस्यामः प्रीतिसंयुताः । कालो यास्यत्य् अविरतं विषयेष्व् एव सज्जताम् ॥
units.english: Without any anxiety do you drink Madhvika wine. Thus attached to worldly objects you will be able to spend your days happily.

units.sanskrit: प्रनष्टशोका रंस्यामः सर्व एवामराः सुखम् ॥
units.english: Under the protection of this high-souled one, too, shorn of grief, will live happily with the celestials.

units.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा परिष्वज्य कृष्णं कमललोचनम् । एवं स्तुत्वा सहस्राक्षः केशवं दानवान्तकम् । आपृच्छ्य तं महाभागः सर्वैर् देवगणैर् वृतः ॥ ऋषयश् च महात्मानो जयाशीर्भिर् महौजसम् । यथागतं पुनर् याता यक्षराक्षसकिंनराः ॥
units.english: Having thus chanted the glories of the great Keshava the destroyer of Dānavas and adored of the world, the thousand-eyed Purandara, encircled by the gods, embraced him. Thereupon obtaining his permission, he, along with the gods and Marutas, set out for the celestial region. Having honored the highly powerful Keshava with blessings of victory the great Rishis, along with Yakshas, Rakshasas and Kinnaras, repaired to their respective quarters.

units.sanskrit: पुरंदरे दिवं याते पद्मनाभो महाबलः । अपृच्छत महाभागः सर्वान् कुशलम् अव्ययम् ॥
units.english: After the departure of Purandara for the celestial region the highly powerful and great lotus-navelled deity enquired after their well-being.

units.sanskrit: ततः किलकिलाशब्दं निर्वमन्तः सहस्रशः । गच्छन्ति कौमुदीं द्रष्टुं सो ऽनघः प्रियया सह । द्वारकां प्राप्य कृष्णस् तु रेमे यदुगणैर् वृतः ॥ विविधान् सर्वकामार्थाञ् श्रिया परमया युतः । एवम् एषो ऽवतीइर्णो वै पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते । विष्णुर् यदुकुलश्रेष्ठो वासुदेवेति विश्रुतः ॥ एतैश् च कारणैः श्रीमान् वसुदेवकुले प्रभुः । जातो वृष्णिषु देवक्यां यन् मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥
units.english: Thereupon there arose on all sides tumult of persons for seeing the moon-like countenance of Keshava. Seeing their devotion the sinless Keshava was highly pleased. Having thus returned to Dwārakā, Krishna, obtaining all objects of desire, riches and prosperity, lived happily with the Yādavas -. my child, seeing thee safely return we are all enjoying with the Apsaras. Thus after the departure of her companions Māyāvati first invited the beautiful Asura princess Ushā and took her to her own residence. Vaishampāyana said:— upholder of the Kuru race, have thus described to you how Vāna was vanquished by Vishnu in battle and left alive. king, thus incarnating himself on earth Vishnu was celebrated by the name of Vāsudeva the foremest of the Yadu race. You had formerly questioned me as to the cause of the powerful Vishnu's taking birth from Devaki in Vasudeva's family in the Vrishni race.

units.sanskrit: निवृत्ते नारदप्रश्ने मयोक्तं ते समासतः । उक्तास् ते विस्तराः सर्वे पूर्वं ये जनमेजय ॥ विष्णोस् तु माथुरे कल्पे यत्र ते संशयो महान् । आश्चर्यश् चैव नान्यो ऽस्ति कृष्णश् चाश्चर्यसंनिधिः । सर्वेष्व् आश्चर्यकल्पेषु नास्त्य् आश्चर्यम् अवैष्णवम् ॥
units.english: Janameyaja, you heard all that had said at length relating to Nārada's question and Vasudeva's reply in the episode of the wonderful incident. have removed your doubts about Krishna’s life and conduct in Mathurā and have described all his movements. Krishna is the abode of wonders: there is nothing more wonderful than he. There is no wonder which has not been performed by Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: स एव धन्यो धनिनां धन्यकृद् धन्यभावनः । देवेष्व् अपि सदैत्येषु नास्ति धन्यतरो ऽच्युतात् ॥
units.english: Vishnu is the foremost of the blessed—the origin and bestower of good fortune. Amongst the Aditvas and Daityas there is none more wonderful than Achyuta.

units.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ मरुतस् तथा । गगनं भूर् दिशश् चैव सलिलं ज्योतिर् एव च ॥
units.english: He is Adityas, Vasas, Rudras, Maruts, the two Ashwinis, the sky, earth, quarters, water and luminous bodies.

units.sanskrit: सत्यं धर्मस् तपश् चैव ब्रह्म चैव सनातनम् । अनन्तश् चैव नागानां रुद्राणां शंकरः स्मृतः । जङ्गमाजङ्गमं चैव जगन्नारायणोद्भवं । एतस्माच् च जगत् सर्वं प्रसूयेत जनार्दनात् । नमस्यामो जगन्नाथं देवकीं च हरिं सदा ॥
units.english: Vishnu alone is the creator, preserver and destroyer, truth, Tapas and the grand-father Brahma. This lord of the celestials is the whole universe, is Ananta amongst the Nāgas and Shankara amongst the Rudras. This universe, mobile and immobile, has emanated from Nārāyana. Janārddana has created this whole universe. That Eternal One alone is always adorable unto the gods.

units.sanskrit: इत्युक्तं बाणयुद्धं ते माहात्म्यं केशवस्य च । ये चेदं धारयिष्यन्ति बाणयुद्धम् अनुत्तमम् । केशवस्य च माहात्म्यं नाधर्मस् तान् भजिष्यति ॥
units.english: Thus have recounted Keshava's glories and Vāna's battle. Listening to them you will acquire incomparable family prestige. Sin will not invade them, who will meditate on Vāna's battle and the most excellent deed of Keshava.

units.sanskrit: एषा ते वैष्णवी चर्या मया कार्त्स्न्येन कीर्तिता । पृच्छतस् तात यज्ञे ऽस्मिन् निवृत्ते जनमेजय ॥
units.english: Janamejaya, thus after the termination of the sacrifice as questioned by you, have described all the glorious deeds of Vishnu.

units.sanskrit: आश्चर्यपर्वम् अखिलं यो हीदं धारयेन् नृप । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति । न तस्य दुर्लभं किं चिद् इह लोके परत्र च ॥ ब्राह्मणः सर्ववेदी स्यात् क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् । वैश्यो धनसमृद्धः स्याच् छूद्रो गच्छेच् च सद्गतिम् । नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात् किंचिद् दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात् ॥
units.english: king, the man who can meditate on all these wonderful themes, in his mind, is freed from sins and repairs to the region of Vishnu. He, who will recite this every morning, will meet with no calamity either in this world or in the next. By reciting it the Brāhmanas will be versed in the Saman, the Kshatriyas will acquire victories, the Vaishyas will amass riches and the Sudras will fare well. He, who will recite this, will be visited by no misfortune and live a long life.

units.sanskrit: श्रुतवान् अमलो भूत्वा हरिवंशं द्विजर्षभाः ॥
units.english: Souti said:— foremost of the twice-born, hearing this Harivamsha, Parikshit's son Janamejaya was freed from sins.

units.sanskrit: एवं शौनक संक्षेपाद् विस्तरेण तथैव च । प्रोक्ता वै सर्ववंशास् ते किं भूयः कथयामि ते ॥ शौनक उवाच जनमेजयस्य के पुत्राः पठ्यन्ते लोमहर्षणे । हरिवंशस्य शेषस्य कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् । कस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितो वंशः पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ॥
units.english: Sounaka, have thus described to you Hari's family at length and in brief. What more do you wish to hear again? -. . Shounaka said:— son of Lomaharshana, who are the sons of Janamejaya? And by whom the family of Pandavas was founded? have been stricken with curiosity to hear this history.

units.sanskrit: त्वत्तः कथयतः सर्वं वेद्म्य् अहं तं परिस्फुटम् । सूत उवाच पारिक्षितस्य काश्यायां द्वौ पुत्रौ संबभूवतुः । चन्द्रापीडश् च नृपतिः सूर्यापीडश् च मोक्षवित् ॥
units.english: wish therefore to learn every detail about it as you have said -. Souti said:—Parikshit's son Janamejaya begat on his wife Kāshyā two sons, the king Chandrāpida and Suryāpida who was conversant with the knowledge of emancipation.

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रापीडस्य पुत्राणां शतम् उत्तमधन्विनाम् । जनमेजय इत्य् एव क्षत्रं भुवि परिश्रुतम् ॥
units.english: By performing works befitting the Kshatriyas, the hundred sons of Chandrāpida, who were all clever archers, acquired celebrity on earth under the appellation of Janamejayas –.

units.sanskrit: तेषां ज्येष्ठस् तु राजासीत् पुरे वारणसाह्वये । सत्यकर्णो महाबाहुर् यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः ॥
units.english: Of them the eldest Satyakarana of long arms, the performer of many sacrifices accompanied with profuse gifts, was installed on the throne of Hastināpur.

units.sanskrit: अपुत्रः स तु धर्मात्मा प्रविवेश तपोवनम् ॥ तस्माद् वनगताद् गर्भं यादवी प्रत्यपद्यत । सुचारोर् दुहिता सुभ्रूर् मालिनी भ्रातृमालिनि ॥
units.english: Satyakarna's son the virtuous and powerful Swetakarna had no issue and he therefore entered into woods with his spouse –. The beautiful Yadu princess Mālini, of fair eye-brows, conceived through the forest-ranging Swetakarna.

units.sanskrit: स त्व् अजन्मनि गर्भस्य श्वेतकर्णः प्रजेश्वरः । अन्वगच्छत तं पूर्वैर् महाप्रस्थानम् अच्युतम् ॥
units.english: Just in the beginning of this conception the patriarch Swetakarna entered like his fore-fathers into woods for good -.

units.sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा संप्रयातं तं मालिनी पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात् । पथि सा सुषुवे सुभ्रूर् वने राजीवलोचनम् ॥
units.english: Beholding her husband retire into forest, Mālini, who was quick with a child, followed him, and on the way gave birth to a son having eyes like lotus petals.

units.sanskrit: पतिव्रता महाभागा द्रौपदीव पुरा पतीन् ॥ सुकुमारः कुमारो ऽसौ गिरिकुञ्जे रुरोद ह । दयार्थं तस्य मेघास् तु प्रादुरासन् महात्मनः ॥ श्रविष्ठायाश् च पुत्रौ द्वौ पैप्पलादौ च तौ द्विजौ । दृष्ट्वा कृपान्वितौ गृह्य तं प्रक्षालयतां जले ॥ विघृष्टे तस्य ते पार्श्वे खेलेन रुधिरस्रवे । ततो ऽजपार्श्व इति तौ चक्राते तस्य नाम ह ॥ स तु वेमकशालायां उभाभ्याम् अभिवर्धितः ॥
units.english: As Draupadi followed her husbands in the days of yore so the chaste and noble Mālini followed her consort leaving the new-born baby behind. While that tender baby, divorced from his mother, was crying in the mountain cave, some cranes, stricken with compassion for the great prince, came there –. Seeing that crying prince Shravistha's sons the Rishis Paippaladi and Koushika felt compassion and took him up. They then washed with water his two sides which were bruised against the rock and covered with blood. The sides of the prince were dark-blue like those of a goat and were high and well-formed. He therefore passed by the name of Ajapārsha. Thereupon those two foremost of the twice-born Paippaladi and Koushika named him Ajapārsha and brought him up in the house of a Rishi named Vemaka –.

units.sanskrit: सेवकस्य तु तां भार्याम् ऊहतुस् तस्य कारणात् । वेमक्याः स तु पुत्रो ऽभूद् ब्राह्मणौ सुचिवौ च तौ ॥
units.english: Vemaka's wife brought up Ajapārsha as her son, so he became Vemaka's son and those two Brāhmanas became his councillors.

units.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च युगपत् तुल्यजीविनः । स एष पौरवो वंशः पाण्डवानां प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
units.english: Ajapārsha and the sons and grand-sons of Paippaladi and Koushika lived the same life. This Ajapārsha, born in the race of Puru, founded the family of the Pandavas -.

units.sanskrit: जरासंक्रमणे पूर्वं तदा प्रीतेन धीमता ॥ अचन्द्रार्कग्रहा भूमिर् भवेद् अपि न संशयः । अपौरवा न तु मही भविष्यति कदाचन ॥
units.english: Formerly while transferring his decrepitude Nashusha's son the intelligent Yayāti sang this verse: Earth will forsooth be divested of the sun, moon and planets but she will never be shorn of the Purus –.

units.sanskrit: शौनक उवाच उक्तो ऽयं हरिवंशस् ते पर्वाणि निखिलानि च । प्रीणात्य् अस्मान् अमृतवत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
units.english: Sounaka said:— have thus recited to you the entire Harivamsha with all its Parvas as recounted by Vyasa's disciple. May this endless history of Hari's family, nectar-like and destructive of all sins, please us.

units.sanskrit: सुखश्रव्यतया धीर मनो ह्लादयतीव नः । जनमेजयस् तु नृपतिः श्रुत्वाख्यानम् अनुत्तमम् । सौते किम् अकरोत् पश्चात् सर्पसत्राद् अनन्तरम् ॥ यद् आरभत पारिक्षित् तन् मे कथय सुव्रत । सूत उवाच जनमेजयस् तु नृपतिः श्रुत्वाख्यानम् अनुत्तमम् । तस्मिन् सत्रे समाप्ते तु राजा पारिक्षितस् तदा । यष्टुं स वाजिमेधेन संभारान् उपचक्रमे ॥
units.english: you endued with patience, because this history is pleasant to ears it has greatly gladdened our hearts. Afterwards, Sauti, what did the king Janamejaya do on the termination of the Sarpayajna after listening to this most excellent history -? Souti said:—Hear, will describe to you all what the king Janamejaya did listening to this most excellent history after the termination of the Sarpayajna. When this sacrifice was finished Parikshit's son Janamejaya collected materials for the celebration of a horse-sacrifice.

units.sanskrit: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान् आहूयेदम् उवाच ह । यक्ष्ये ऽहं वाजिमेधेन हय उत्सृज्यताम् इति ॥
units.english: Then inviting the Ritwikas, priests and preceptors he said:— am desirous of celebrating a horse-sacrifice. Do ye dedicate these horses -.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्य विज्ञाय चिकीर्षितं तदा कृष्णो महात्मा सहसाजगाम । पारिक्षितं द्रष्टुम् अदीनसत्त्वम् द्वैपायनः सर्वपरावरज्ञः ॥
units.english: Thereupon informed of the object of Parikshit's son Janamejaya, of indefatigable energy, the virtuous-souled Krishna Dwaipāyana, the foremost of the omniscient, all on sudden came there for witnessing the sacrifice.

units.sanskrit: पारिक्षितस् तु नृपतिर् दृष्ट्वा तम् ऋषिम् आगतम् । अर्घ्यपाद्यासनं दत्त्वा पूजयामास शास्त्रतः ॥
units.english: Beholding the great Rishi Veda-Vyasa arrive there the king Janamejaya offered him Arghya, a seat and water for washing his feet according to the rules laid down in Sastras.

units.sanskrit: ततस् तेषूपविष्टेषु सदस्यैः सह शौनक । कथा बहुविधाश् चित्राश् चक्राते वेदसंहिताः ॥
units.english: Shounaka, after they had both taken their seats the courtiers, from all sides, began to discourse on diverse Vedic themes.

units.sanskrit: ततः कथान्ते नृपतिश् चोदयामास तं मुनिम् । पितामहं पाण्डवानां आत्मनः प्रपितामहम् ॥ महाभारतम् आख्यानं बह्वर्थं बहुविस्तरम् । निमेषमात्रम् इव मे सुखश्रव्यतया गतम् ॥
units.english: After they had finished their discourses, king Janamejaya said to the great Muni Veda-Vysa, the grand-father of the Pandavas and his own great grand-father –:—The story of the Mahabharata, having many meanings and abounding in Srutis, is exceedingly pleasant to ears. It was finished as if in a moment.

units.sanskrit: त्वया त्व् अभिहितं ब्रह्मञ् शङ्खे क्षीरम् इवाहितम् ॥
units.english: The history, which spreads glories and gives fame like unto milk in a conch-shell, has been beautifully recorded by thee.

units.sanskrit: नामृतेनापि तृप्तिः स्याद् यथा स्वर्गसुखेन वा । तथा तृप्तिं न गच्छामि श्रुत्वेमां भारतीं कथाम् ॥
units.english: As a man is not satisfied with ambrosia and bliss of heaven, so am not with listening to the stories of the Mahabharata.

units.sanskrit: अनुमान्य तु सर्वज्ञं पृच्छामि भगवन्न् अहम् । हेतुः कुरूणां नाशस्य राजसूयो मतो मम ॥
units.english: Thou art omniscient, Brahman and therefore accost thee whether Rajasuya was not the cause of the destruction of the Kurus.

units.sanskrit: दुःसहानां यथा ध्वंसो राजन्यानाम् उपप्लवः । राजसूयं तथा मन्ये युद्धार्थम् उपकल्पितम् ॥
units.english: It appears to me that as many unconquerable kings meet with death at the time of revolution so the Rajasuya Yajna was ordained for battle.

units.sanskrit: राजसूयो हि सोमेन श्रूयते पूर्वम् आहृतः । तस्यान्ते सुमहद्युद्धम् अभवत् तारकामयम् ॥
units.english: have heard that when this Rajasuya was undertaken by Soma it was followed by the war of which Taraka was the root.

units.sanskrit: आहृतो वरुणेनापि तस्यान्ते सुमहाक्रतोः । देवासुरम् अभूद् युद्धं सर्वभूतक्षयावहम् ॥
units.english: Afterwards when Varuna undertook this great sacrifice it was followed by the war between gods and Asuras.

units.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस् तु राजर्षिर् एतं क्रतुम् अवाप्तवान् । तत्राप्य् आडीबकम् अभूद् युद्धं क्षत्रविनाशनम् ॥
units.english: When the royal saint Harishchandra undertook this sacrifice it was followed by the battle Adivaka in which many Kshatriyas were killed.

units.sanskrit: ततो ऽनन्तरम् आर्येण पाण्डवेनापि दुस्तरः । महाभारतसंहारः संभृतो ऽग्निर् इव क्रतुः ॥
units.english: Last of all when the worshipful Pandavas undertook this most arduous sacrifice it was followed by the great Bhārata war.

units.sanskrit: राजसूयो महायज्ञः किमर्थं न निवारितः ॥ राजसूये ह्य् असंहार्ये यज्ञाङ्गैश् च दुरासदैः । मिथ्याप्रणीते यज्ञाङ्गे प्रजानां संक्षयो ध्रुवः ॥
units.english: great sir, why did you not all put a stop to that Rajasuya Yajna the root of the world-destroying war? It is difficult to celebrate this sacrifice well with all its branches. When one of the branches of a sacrifice is neglected it leads to the destruction of people.

units.sanskrit: भवान् अपि च सर्वेषां पूर्वेषां नः पितामहः । ते कथं भगवन् नेत्रा बुद्धिमन्तश् च्युता नयात् । अनाथा ह्य् अपराध्यन्ते कुनेतारश् च मानवाः ॥
units.english: Thou art the grand-father of our ancestors, their first lord and art cognizant of the past and future. Thyself living as their guide why did those intelligent kings, as if having none to govern them, and deviating from the paths of morality, commit sin? -.

units.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच कालेनाद्य परीतास् ते तव वत्स पितामहाः । न मां भविष्यं पप्रच्छुर् न चापृष्टो ब्रवीम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: Vyasa said:— king, forsooth urged on by Destiny those kings acted against the established usages and customs. They did not ask me any thing about the future. And, too did not tell them any thing unasked.

units.sanskrit: परिहर्तुं न शक्ष्यामि कालनिष्ठां हि तां गतिम् ॥
units.english: Besides was not capable of counteracting the future result, for none can with stand the work of Destiny.

units.sanskrit: त्वया त्व् इदम् अहं पृष्टो वक्ष्याम्य् आगन्तु भावि यत् । अतश् च बलवान् कालः श्रुत्वापि न करिष्यसि ॥
units.english: will describe to you the future subject about which you have questioned me. But Destiny is now very powerful. And even listening to my words you will not be able to carry them out.

units.sanskrit: न संरम्भान् न चारम्भान् न वै स्थास्यसि पौरुषे । अश्वमेधः क्रतुः श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रियाणां परिश्रुतः । तेन भावेन ते यज्ञं वासवो धर्षयिष्यति ॥ यदि तच् छक्यते राजन् परिहर्तुं कथंचन । दैवं पुरुषकारेण मा यजेथाश् च तं क्रतुम् ॥ न चापराधः शक्रस्य नोपध्यायगणस्य ते । तव वा यजमानस्य कालो ऽत्र परमेश्वरः ॥
units.english: Either through fear or zeal you will not be able to stand in the ways of a man for it is impossible to overcome predestination. The Sruti lays down that the Kshatriyas should celebrate Ashwamedha, the foremost of sacrifices. On account of the greatness of that sacrifice Vāsava will violate your Ashwamedha. king, even if you are capable of withstanding Vāsava either by your manliness or through the will of the Providence you should not celebrate such a sacrifice. However you, Sakra, or the presiding priests will commit no sin thereby for Destiny is all-powerful. Ordained by Destiny Brahmā will obstruct the termination of Indra's sacrifice.

units.sanskrit: यथा यष्टा नृपः स्वर्गं गमिष्यति युगक्षये । तथा यज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजातयः ॥
units.english: In the course of time and according to the will of the Providence creation will come to an end with the termination of a cycle and the Brāhmanas will sell the fruits of sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच निवृत्ताव् अश्वमेधस्य किं निमित्तं भविष्यति । श्रुत्वा परिहरिष्यामि भगवन् यदि शक्यते ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— reverend sir, tell me, what cause will arrive for putting a stop to the horse-sacrifice. Hearing it will desist.

units.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच निमित्तं भविता तत्र ब्रह्मकोपकृतं प्रभो । यतस्व परिहर्तुं तद् इत्य् एतद् भद्रम् अस्तु ते ॥ त्वया धृतः क्रतुश् चैव वाजिमेधः परंतप । क्षत्रिया नाहरिष्यन्ति यावद् भूमिर् धरिष्यति ॥
units.english: Vyasa said:— king, the cause thereof will be the ireful curse of a Brāhmana. You may fare well if you try to avoid it. slayer of enemies, as long as the world will last, the Kshatriyas will not be able to collect materials for your horse-sacrifice –.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच निवृत्ताव् अश्वमेधस्य विप्रशापाग्नितेजसा । अहं निमित्तं इति चेद् भयं तीव्रं च जायते ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:—Aswamedha will be stopped by the power of the fiery curse of a Brāhmana, but will be the instrument thereof. Indeed am filled with fear and shame.

units.sanskrit: कथं ह्य् अकीर्त्त्या संयुक्तः सुकृती मद्विधो जनः । लोकान् उत्सहते गन्तुं खं सपाश इव द्विजः ॥
units.english: How will a man like myself, the performer of many good deeds, like unto a bird, tied with a noose, flying into the sky, engage in such a cursed work, and exert to live? If engage in such a work, through me a rite, practised from generation to generation, will be spoiled.

units.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य पुनरावृत्तिर् यद्य् अस्त्य् आश्वासयस्व माम् ॥
units.english: Console me, saying that the horse-sacrifice will again be undertaken by kings –.

units.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच उपात्तयज्ञो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेषु निवत्स्यति । विहितो यज्ञ एषो ऽत्र देवैश् च ब्राह्मणैर् अपि । औद्भिदो भविता कश्चित् सेनानीः काश्यपो द्विजः । अश्वमेधं कलियुगे पुनः प्रत्याहरिष्यति ॥ तद्युगे तत्कुलीनश् च राजसूयम् अपि क्रतुम् । आहरिष्यति राजेन्द्र श्वेतग्रहम् इवान्तकः ॥
units.english: Vyasa said:—As an energy, counteracted by another, lives in it, so the Aswamedha sacrifice, although stopped, will exist in the gods and Brāhmanas. Leading the life of a soldier, some descendants of Kashyapa will again revive this horse-sacrifice in the Kali-Yuga. king, as the hour of universal dissolution brings into being many evil portends such as white planets so a Brāhmana, born in his race, will revive this sacrifice in the cycle of Kali.

units.sanskrit: यथाबलं मनुष्याणां कर्तॄणां दास्यते फलम् । युगान्तद्वारम् ऋषिभिः संवृतं विचरिष्यति ॥ तदाप्रभृति हास्यन्ते नृणां प्राणाः पुराकृतीः । विनिवर्तिष्यते लोके वृत्तान्ते वृत्तिमत्स्व् अपि ॥ तदा सूक्ष्मो महोदर्को दुस्तरो दानमूलवान् । चातुराश्रम्यशिथिलो धर्मः प्रविचलिष्यति ॥
units.english: This sacrifice will bestow proper fruits on men celebrating it and they will range at the gate of the end of the cycle encircled by the Rishis. From that time the senses of men will not renounce the fruits of the pristine good works and will not be attached to them in this world. highly subtle religion, deviating from the duties of the four orders, and having charity at its root only, the offspring of the time, will flourish.

units.sanskrit: तदा ह्य् अल्पेन तपसा सिद्धिं यास्यन्ति मानवाः । धन्या धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगाम्ते जनमेजय ॥
units.english: Practising austerities to a small extent men, Janamejaya, at the end of this cycle will acquire spiritual powers. Thus blessed they will practise pious rites –.

units.sanskrit: जनमेजय उवाच आसन्नं विप्रकृष्टं वा यदि कालं न विद्महे । तस्माद् द्वापरविध्वंसाद् युगान्तं स्पृहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
units.english: Janamejaya said:— do not know whether the time for Moksha emancipation is distant or near. Therefore wish to know about the cycle of Kali which has followed Dwāpara struck with the arrows of virtue and sin.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्ता वयं च धर्मं स्वं सुखम् अल्पेन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: With deeds easily performed we will acquire virtue.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् समुद्वेगकरे युगान्ते प्रत्युपस्थिते । प्रनष्टधर्मं धर्मज्ञ निमित्तैर् वक्तुम् अर्हसि ॥ सूत उवाच पृष्ट एवं भविष्यस्य गतिं तत्त्वेन चिन्तयन् । एवं भविष्ये तु गतिं योगेनैव विचिन्तयन् । युगान्ते पूर्वरूपाणि भगवान् अब्रवीत् तदा ॥
units.english: Stricken with this desire we have been born in this Kali-yuga -. Shounaka said thou conversant with religion the cycle of Kali, a source of trouble to the creatures and the destruction of virtue, is about to set in. Do thou therefore describe it with its characteristics . Shouti said:—Thus accosted the Divine Vyāsa accurately thought of the condition of men in the Kali-yuga and began to describe the future cycle.

units.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच अरक्षितारो हर्तारो बलिभागस्य पार्थिवाः । युगान्ते प्रभविष्यन्ति स्वरक्षणपरायणाः ॥ अक्षत्रियाश् च राजानो विप्राः शूद्रोपजीविनः । शूद्राश् च ब्राह्मणाचारा भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥ शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते जनमेजय । शिल्पवन्तो ऽनृतपराः नरा मद्यामिषप्रियाः । राजवृत्ते स्थिताश् चोरा राकानश् चोरशीलिनः । भृत्या अनिर्विष्टभुजो भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥ धनानि श्लाघनीयानि सतां वृत्तम् अपूजितम् । अकुत्सना च पतिते भविष्यति युगक्षये ॥ अशान्तास् तापसा नित्यं भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे । उनषोडशवर्षाश् च प्रजास्यन्ति नरास् तदा ॥ सर्वे ब्रह्म वदिष्यन्ति सर्वे वाजसनेयिनः । शूद्रा भोवादिनश् चैव भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥
units.english: Vyasa said:—When Kali will set in the kings, incapable of protecting their subjects, will only guard themselves busily exacting tributes from them. At the end of this cycle the kings will not act like the Kshatriyas, the Brāhmanas will carry on their livelihood like the Sudras and the Sudras will behave like the Brāhmanas. Janamejaya, at the end of this cycle the Brāhmanas, well read in Srutis and Vedas, will take up arrows and Havi will be divorced from sacrifices and all people will take their meals in the same row. When the last of the cycles Kali will appear men will be artizans, untruthful, fond of wine and meat and know the wives of their friends. In the Kali Yuga the thieves will fare like the kings and the kings will act like thieves and the servants will enjoy unfixed incomes. In the last cycle wealth will be spoken of highly, the character of the pious will be despised and the fallen will not be censured. The widows, divorced from the consciousness of virtue and sin, the ascetics and men of fifteen years of age will procreate offspring through promiscuous intercourse. In that last cycle the villagers will sell food, the Brāhmanas will sell the Vedas, and the women will sell their persons. In this cycle all will read the Vedas and celebrate Vajasaneyi sacrifices and the Sudras will boldly address all as .

units.sanskrit: शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति शाक्यबुद्धोपजीविनः ॥ श्वापदप्रचुरत्वं च गवां चैव परिक्षयः । अन्त्या मध्ये निवत्स्यन्ति मध्याश् चान्तावसायिनः । यथानिम्नं प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥
units.english: The Sudras following the tenets of Buddha will abstain from taking meat. And with white teeth, keen observation and shaving their heads and wearing silk raiments they will practise religion -. The Mlechchas will live in the province of Kurupānchāla and people of that country will live in that of the former. In the end of the cycle men will go downwards.

units.sanskrit: तथा द्विहायना दम्यास् तथा पल्वलकर्षकाः । चित्रवर्षी च पर्जन्यो युगे क्षीणे भविष्यति ॥ सर्वे चोरकुले जाताश् चोरयानाः परसरम् । स्वल्पेनाढ्या भविष्यन्ति यत् किंचित् प्राप्य दुर्गताः । न ते धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति मानवा निर्गते युगे । ऊषराबहुला भूमिः पन्थानो नगरान्तरा । सर्वे वाणिजकाश् चैव भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥
units.english: The Brāhmanas will sell the fruits of Tapas and sacrifices and the seasons will be perverted. The beasts, with tusks and teeth, will be set to ploughs and carts: men will till with the water of ponds and the clouds will irregularly discharge their contents. The thieves will steal the wealth of one another and wretched men will be rich acquiring very little money. In this last cycle men will be divorced from religious rites, the divisions of the land will abound in deserts, and the cities will be traversed by many roads. In the Kali yuga every body will become a merchant and the sons will divide the ancestral gifts.

units.sanskrit: हरणाय प्रपत्स्यन्ते लोभानृतविरोधिताः ॥
units.english: Impelled by covetuousness and false-hood people will fight with one another and rob their wealth.

units.sanskrit: सौकुमार्ये तथा रूपे रत्ने चोपक्षयं गते । भविष्यन्ति युगस्यान्ते नार्यः केशैर् अलंकृताः ॥
units.english: In the absence of beauty, personal grace and ornaments the women will be only adorned with hairs -. In this last cycle, men, divorced from all objects of enjoyment, as garlands, sandal, etc.

units.sanskrit: निर्विहारस्य भीतस्य गृहस्थस्य भविष्यति । कुशीलानार्यभूयिष्ठं वृथारूपसमावृतम् । पुरुषाल्पं बहुस्त्रीकं तद् युगान्तस्य लक्षणम् ॥
units.english: , will find pleasure only in their wives –. When the wicked and non-aryans will multiply, when the number of males will decrease, and dis-proportionate to it that of women will increase know this as the real sign of the end of the cycle.

units.sanskrit: बहुयाचनका लोका दास्यन्ते च परस्परम् । अविचार्य ग्रहीष्यन्ति दानं वर्णान्तरात् तथा । राजचोरादिदण्डार्तो जनः क्षयम् उपैष्यति ॥
units.english: Then every body will be a beggar: and no one will give alms. Without distinction people will accept gifts from other Varnas orders, And afflicted by the king, thieves and fire, people will meet with extinction.

units.sanskrit: ईहयासुखिनो लोका भविष्यन्ति गते युगे ॥ वर्षासु वाताः पुरुषा नीचाः शर्करवर्षिणः । संदिग्धः परलोकश् च भविष्यति युगक्षये ॥
units.english: In this last cycle people will not get crops, youthful persons will be visited by decrepitude and people will be unhappy for their bad ambition. Blowing high and downwards the wind will shower dust in the rany season and people will feel doubts about the next world.

units.sanskrit: आत्मनश् च दुराचारा ब्रह्मदूषणतत्पराः । आत्मानं बहु मन्यन्ते मन्युर् एवाभ्ययाद् द्विजान् । वैश्याचाराश् च राजन्या धनधान्योपजीविनः । युगापक्रमणे पूर्वं भविष्यन्ति द्विजातयः ॥
units.english: Every one will be wicked by nature, will villify the God and be egoistic: being covetous the Brāhmanas will blame others. Adopting the ways of the Vaishyas the Kshatriyas will maintain themselves by cultivation and trade and the Brāhmanas will destroy the dignity of religion -.

units.sanskrit: ऋणं च विनयभ्रंशो युगे क्षीणे भविष्यति ॥
units.english: In the end of the cycle men will not observe their vows and promise.

units.sanskrit: भविष्यत्य् अफलो हर्षः क्रोधश् च सफलो नृणाम् । अशास्त्रविदुषां पुंसाम् एवम् एव स्वभावतः । शास्त्रोक्तस्याप्रवक्तारो भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥
units.english: Fruitless will be a man’s joy and fruitful will be his anger. For milk the sheep will be regarded. In the end of the cycle, men, shorn of the knowledge of scriptures, will naturally behave thus. Disregarding moral laws, men, proud of their own learning, will interpret the Sastras.

units.sanskrit: सर्वः सर्वं विजानाति वृद्धान् अनुपसेव्य च । न कश्चिद् अकविर् नाम युगान्ते प्रत्युपस्थिते ॥
units.english: When the last cycle will set in every one, without the instruction of their elders, will acquire knowledge in all branches and there will be no one who will not be a poet.

units.sanskrit: न क्षत्राणि नियोक्ष्यन्ति विकर्मस्था द्विजातयः । चोरप्रायाश् च राजानो युगान्ते प्रत्युपस्थिते ॥ कुण्डा वृषा नैकृतिकाः सुरापा ब्रह्मवादिनः । अश्वमेधेन यक्ष्यन्ति युगान्ते जनमेजय ॥
units.english: Deviating from their right duties the Brāhmanas will turn out astrologers and the kings will become thieves –. In the end of the cycle those men, who will co-habit with bastard women, be deceiptful and drunkards, will be Brahmavadins and celebrate horse sacrifices.

units.sanskrit: अयाज्यान् याजयिष्यन्ति तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षिणः । ब्राह्मणा धनतृष्णार्ता युगान्ते समुपस्थिते ॥
units.english: Eager for acquiring riches the Brāhmanas will officiate as priests for unworthy persons and partake of the forbidden food.

units.sanskrit: भोगार्थम् अभिपत्स्यन्ते न च कश्चित् पठिष्यति । एकशङ्खास् तथा नार्यो गवेधुकपिनद्धकाः ॥
units.english: Every one will recite Bho! and no one will study the Vedas. The women will put on one conch bangle and use an ornament of the shape of a paddy.

units.sanskrit: नक्षत्राणि विहीनानि विपरीता दिशस् तथा । संध्यारागो ऽथ दिग्दाहो भविष्यत्य् अपरे युगे ॥
units.english: The stars will not be united with proper planets, the quarters will be contrary—the appearance of an evening and burning will always be seen.

units.sanskrit: पितॄन् पुत्रा नियोक्ष्यन्ति वध्वः श्वश्रूश् च कर्मसु । वाक्शरैस् तर्जयिष्यन्ति गुरूञ् शिष्यास् तथैव च । मुखेषु च प्रयोक्ष्यन्ति प्रमत्ताश् च नरास् तदा । अकृताग्राणि भोक्ष्यन्ति नराश् चैवाग्निहोत्रिणः । भिक्षां बलिम् अदत्त्वा च भोक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषाः स्वयम् ॥
units.english: The son will engage his father in works and the daughter-in-law will order her mother-in-law. Men will co-habit with beasts and women of different castes. The disciples will wound their preceptors with wordy shafts and men, maddened, will speak many things. Without offering the first four oblations to the gods the Agnihotris will take their meals; and without offering food to their guests, men will eat themselves.

units.sanskrit: पतीन् सुप्तान् वञ्चयित्वा गमिष्यन्ति स्त्रियो अण्यतः । पुरुषाश् च प्रसुप्तासु भार्यासु च परस्त्रियम् ॥ नाव्यधितो नाप्य् अरुजो जनः सर्वो ऽभ्यसूयकः । न कृतप्रतिकर्ता च काले क्षीणे भविष्यति ॥ जनमेजय उवाच एषं विलुलिते लोके मनुष्याः केन पालिताः । निवत्स्यन्ति किमाचाराः किमाहारविहारिणः ॥ किंकर्माणः किमीहन्तः किंप्रमाणाः किमायुषः । व्यास उवाच अत ऊर्ध्वं च्युते धर्मे गुणहीनाः प्रजास् ततः । शीलव्यसनम् आसाद्य प्राप्स्यन्ते ह्रासम् आयुषः ॥
units.english: Deceiving their sleeping husbands the women will visit other men, and men too, leaving their sleeping wives, will go to other women. When the cycle will run out people will be visited with diseases, mental agony and envy and they will not remedy their own actions –. Janamejaya said:—When the whole world will thus be sullied, by whom men will be protected? How will they behave? What will they take and how will they enjoy? What will be their actions and endeavours? How long will they live? And meeting with what end will they attain to Satya-Yuga? –. Vyasa said:—When religion will be shaken and good conduct will be extinct, men, shorn of accomplishments, will be short-lived. With the decrease of the duration of life, there will be decay of strength.

units.sanskrit: वैवर्ण्याद् व्याधिसंपीडा निर्वेदो व्याधिपीडनात् ॥
units.english: It will lead to the perversity of colour which will produce diseases.

units.sanskrit: निर्वेदाद् आत्मसंबोधः संबोधाद् धर्मशीलता । एवं गत्वा परां काष्ठां प्रपत्स्यन्ति कृतं युगम् ॥
units.english: This will give birth to repentence which will beget the consciousness of the God. And this will produce again virtue. With this end they will attain to the Satya Yuga.

units.sanskrit: उद्देशतो धर्मशीलाः केचिन् मध्यस्थतां गताः । विमर्शशीलाः केचित् तु हेतुवादकुतूहलाः ॥ प्रत्यक्षम् अनुमानं च प्रमाणम् इति निश्चिताः । अप्रमाणं करिष्यन्ति वेदोक्तम् अपरे जनाः ॥
units.english: Some, observing virtue in words only, will grow indifferent and some, being conscientious, will, with curiosity, enquire into causes. Having their minds freed from doubts, some men, proud of their learning, will find out unity between inference and evidence –. Others will disprove the Vedas.

units.sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति नरा मूढा मन्दाः पण्डितमानिनः ॥
units.english: The wicked and ignorant men, proud of their learning, will be atheists.

units.sanskrit: तदात्वमात्रश्रद्धेयाः शास्त्रज्ञानविमूर्छिताः । दाम्भिकास् ते भविष्यन्ति वादशीलपरायणाः ॥ तदा विचलिते धर्मे जनाः शेषपुरस्कृताः । शुभान्य् एवाचरिष्यन्ति दानसत्यसमन्विताः ॥
units.english: They will be proud and divorced from the knowledge of Sastras. They will have reverence for the apparent meaning and be fond of discussions. When at the revolution of the cycle religion will be shaken people will follow the last Vishnu's dispensation; and with gifts and truthfulness they will perform many merciful acts -.

units.sanskrit: सर्वभक्षो ह्य् असंगुप्तो निर्गुणो निरपत्रपः । भविष्यति तदा लोकस् तत् कषायस्य लक्षणम् ॥
units.english: During that period people will eat every sort of things, be of uncontrolled senses, devoid of accomplishments and shameless. Know this as the consummate sign of sinfulness.

units.sanskrit: विप्राणां शाश्वतीं वृत्तिं यदा वर्णावरो जनः । अभिपत्स्यति वृत्त्यर्थं तत् कषायस्य लक्षणम् ॥
units.english: When the Kshatriyas and other orders, will resort to begging, the eternal means of subsistence unto the Brāhmanas, for their livelihood know it as the sign that sin has set in.

units.sanskrit: कषायोपप्लवे काले ज्ञानविद्याप्रणाशने । सिद्धिम् अल्पेन कालेन यास्यन्ति निरुपस्कृताः ॥
units.english: When this cycle, destructive of knowledge and learning, will be filled with sin, people, leading the life of celibacy, will attain to the consummation of spiritualism within a short time.

units.sanskrit: महायुद्धं महानादं महावर्षं महाभयम् । विप्ररूपाणि रक्षांसि राजानः कर्णवेदिनः । चरिष्यन्ति वसुंधरां । व्यवाहारोपवृत्ताश् च च्युता धर्माच् च शाश्वतात् ॥ हर्तारः पररत्नानां परदारप्रधर्षकाः । कामात्मानो दुरात्मानः सोपधाः प्रियसाहसाः ॥ तेषु प्रभवमानेषु तुल्यशीलेषु सर्वतः । अभाविनो भविष्यन्ति मुनयो बहुरूपिणः ॥
units.english: In the last cycle will take place great wars, great tumults, great showers and fears: know these to be the signs of sinfulness. In the end of the Yuga the Rakshasas will assume the forms of the Brāhmanas and the kings, bent upon speaking harsh words, will enjoy the earth. When men, divorced from the study of the Vedas, celebration of sacrifices and morals, proud, avaricious, eating all, performing useless rites, stupid, selfish, covetous, putting on worthless dresses, mean, deviating from the eternal religion, the stealers of other's riches, the ravishers of others wives, lustful, wicked, deceiptful and brave, will be born with equal character the various ascetics will hide themselves –.

units.sanskrit: उत्पन्ना ये कृतयुगे प्रधानपुरुषाश्रयाः । कथायोगेन तान् सर्वान् पूजयिष्यन्ति मानवाः ॥
units.english: With words men will worship those persons, devoted to the God, who were born in the Krita age.

units.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यहराश् चैव भाण्डानां चैव हारिणः ॥
units.english: Men will steal corns, raiments, edibles and even dry cow-dung.

units.sanskrit: चोराश् चोरस्य हर्तारो हन्ता हर्तुर् भविष्यति । चोराश् चोरक्षये चापि कृते क्षेमं भविष्यति ॥
units.english: The thieves will steal the property of other thieves and murderers will kill other murderers. When thieves will kill the other thieves people will fare well.

units.sanskrit: निःसारे क्षुभिते लोके निष्क्रिये व्यन्तरे स्थिते । नराः श्रयिष्यन्ति वनं करभारप्रपीडिताः ॥
units.english: When the world will be impoverished, oppressed and divorced from evening prayers and when all the orders will live in the same style men, pressed down by the weight of taxes, will retire into woods.

units.sanskrit: पितॄन् आज्ञापयिष्यन्ति पुत्राः कर्माणि सर्वशः । वाक्शरैस् तर्जयिष्यन्ति गुरूञ् शिष्याः समन्ततः । कोटिमूषकसर्पाश् च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान् ॥
units.english: The sons will engage the father in all works and the daughter-in-law will make the mother-in law work. And when sacrifices will be stopped the disciples will pain the preceptor with wordy shafts. The Rākshasas, the voracious animals, insects, mice and serpents will injure men.

units.sanskrit: क्षेमं सुभिक्षम् आरोग्यं सामग्र्यम् अथ बन्धुभिः । उद्देशेन नरश्रेष्ठ भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥
units.english: king, in the close of the cycle, peace, prosperity, health, friends and literature of the people will suffer decrease.

units.sanskrit: मण्डलैः प्रभविष्यन्ति देशे देशे पृथक् पृथक् ॥ स्वदेशेभ्यः परिभ्रष्टा निःसाराः सह बन्धुभिः । नरास् तदा भविष्यन्ति सर्वे कालप्रतीक्षिणः ॥
units.english: Being themselves their own masters and thieves, kings, loaded with the miseries of the cycle, will roam in circles in various countries. Travelling in their own countries and growing useless, men, with their friends, will await the appointed time –.

units.sanskrit: प्रचरिष्यन्ति दुर्भिक्ष+ +व्याधिभिः परिपीडिताः । अङ्गान् वङ्गान् कलिङ्गांश् च काश्मीरान् अथ मेकलान् । कृत्स्नं च हिमवत्पार्श्वं कूलं च लवणाम्भसः । अरण्यानि च वत्स्यन्ति नरा म्लेच्छगणैः सह ॥
units.english: Assailed with fear and hunger and carrying their sons on their shoulders men will cross the Koushiki and seek shelter in the provinces of Anga, Banga, Kalinga, Kashmira, Mekala and Rishikāntagiri. Men will live with the Mlechchas on the sides of the Himalaya, the bank of the ocean of salt water or in the forests. The earth will be shorn and yet not shorn of its inhabitants.

units.sanskrit: गोप्तारश् चाप्य् अगोप्तारः प्रभविष्यन्ति शासिनः ॥
units.english: Although armed the guards will not do their duties.

units.sanskrit: मधुशाकफलैर् मूलैर् वर्तयिष्यन्ति मानवाः ॥ चीरं पर्णं च विविधं वल्कलान्य् अजिनानि च । स्वयं कृत्वा निवत्स्यन्ति यथा मुनिजनास् तथा ॥
units.english: Men will live on deer, fish, birds, beasts of prey, serpents, insects, vegetables, fruits and roots –. Like Munis men will collect themselves and put on bark, leaves and deer-skin.

units.sanskrit: बीजानाम् आकृतिं निम्नेष्व् ईहन्ते काष्ठशङ्कुभिः । अजैडकं खरोष्ट्रं च पालयिष्यन्ति यत्नतः ॥
units.english: Although living in mountain caves they will grow anxious for knowing and eating paddy growing in villages or in the forest. They will with care rear up sheep, goats, asses and camels -.

units.sanskrit: नदीस्रोतांसि रोत्स्यन्ति तोयार्थं कूलम् आश्रिताः । पक्वान्नव्यवहारेण विपणन्तः परस्परम् ॥
units.english: Living on the bank of rivers for water they will obstruct the currents. And they will sell and buy cooked food amongst themselves.

units.sanskrit: तनूरुहैर् यथाजातैः समलान्तरसंवृतैः । बह्वपत्याः प्रजाहीनाः क्रूरा लक्षणवर्जिताः ॥
units.english: For taking their own shares the sons will fight over the capital. Under the influence of the age people will have children, have none and will be shorn of the good marks of their families.

units.sanskrit: हीनाद्द् हीनं तदा धर्मं प्रजा समनुवर्त्स्यति ॥
units.english: People, in that cycle, will follow a degraded faith preached by a degraded person.

units.sanskrit: आयुस् तत्र च मर्त्यानां परं त्रिंशद् भविष्यति । दुर्बला विषयग्लाना रजसा समभिप्लुताः ॥ भविष्यति तदा तेषां रोगैर् इन्द्रियसंक्षयः । आयुःप्रक्षयसंरोधाद्द् हिंसा चोपरमिष्यति ॥
units.english: The duration of a man’s life will be thirty years. And attacked by fever they will grow weak and lose their wealth; their physical organs will be enfeebled by diseases and they will be visited by sorrow consequent upon the decrease of their longevity.

units.sanskrit: सत्यं चापि प्रपत्स्यन्ति व्यवहारापशङ्कया ॥ भविष्यन्ति च कामानाम् अलाभाद् धर्मशीलिनः । करिष्यन्ति च संकोचं स्वपक्षक्षयपीडिताः ॥ एवं शुश्रूषवो दाने सत्ये प्राणाभिरक्षणे । चतुष्पादप्रवृत्तं च धर्मम् आप्स्यन्ति मानवाः ॥
units.english: They will be busily engaged with visiting and serving the pious and on account of the wane of their conduct they will attain to Satya-Yuga. They will practise pious rites because they will not get objects of desire; and they will shrink from committing oppressions on account of their weakness proceeding from the destruction of their own men -. Thus making gifts, observing truth and cherishing reverence for the safety of their own lives they will satisfy the four-fold duties and meet with well-being.

units.sanskrit: तेसां धर्माभिमानानां गुणेषु परिवर्तताम् । स्वादु किं न्व् इति विज्ञाय धर्म एव स्वदिष्यति ॥
units.english: Amongst those men rolling with the senses and their objects, some will acquire the true knowledge and say "Whether virtue or death has sweet fruits."

units.sanskrit: यथा हानिः क्रमप्राप्ता तथा वृद्धिः क्रमागता । यदा हानिर् भविष्यति कलेः सर्वाणि भूपते । प्रगृहीते ततो धर्मे प्रपत्स्यन्ति कृतं पुनः ॥ साधुवृत्तिः कृतयुगे कषाये हानिर् उच्यते । एक एव तु कालः स हीनवर्णो यथा शशी ॥ छन्नो हि तमसा सोमो यथा कलियुगे तथा । पूर्णश् च तपसा हीनो यथा कलियुगे तथा ॥ अर्थवादपरो धर्मो वेदार्थ इति तु विदुः । अनिर्णिक्तम् अविज्ञातं दायाद्यम् इव धार्यते ॥ इष्टं दानं तपो नाम ब्रह्मचर्यं सुपूजितम् । गुणैः कर्माभिनिर्वृत्तिर् गुणास् तथ्येन कर्मणा ॥
units.english: As decline gradually takes place so does advancement. Afterwards when religion will be completely followed by men Krita-yuga will set in. As the moon increases in the light half of the month and decreases in the dark half, so good conduct multiplies in the Krita-Yuga and suffers decrease in the Kali. However the time is one: according to increase and decrease, Satya, Treta, Dvapara and Kali are its four stages. As the moon is enshrouded by darkness in the dark fortnight and becomes full in the light fortnight so virtue increases in the Satya and decreases in the Kali Yuga. As a man does not regard an ancestral lump of gold covered with dust as gold and thinks himself poor, and again considers himself rich when he finds it gold after it is cleansed, so when the great soul is covered with Maya pervaded by the quality of darkness, men call it a creature and when it is divorced from Maya they call it pure intelligence. It is thus said in the Vedas and the learned men also have explained its meaning. By penances having heaven etc., for their object, eternal fruits are begotten: these fruits produce gunas or qualities and thus their actions are accomplished. By these truthful actions even body is not liberated.

units.sanskrit: आशीस् तु पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा देशकालानुवर्तिनी । युगे युगे यथाकालम् ऋषिभिः समुदाहृता ॥
units.english: The fruits of actions follow the country, time and worthy person in various Yugas: and thus difference is seen in them. So the Rishis have said;

units.sanskrit: इह धर्मार्थकामानां वेदानां च प्रतिक्रिया । आशिषश् च शुभाः पुण्यास् तथैवायुर् युगे युगे ॥
units.english: in various cycles differences in worldly profit, objects of desire, adoration of the deities and duration of life, are created. As according to the nature of the Providence the revolution of cycles takes place, so the rise and decay takes place in the world which cannot stand inactive even for a moment.
